items.source:
//@version=6
indicator('Opening Range Breakout (TheKatalyst)', overlay=true)

//Update 12/13/24: Added multiple trading session capability.
//Update 12/16/24: Fixed an issue when plotting ORB High/Low of a lower timeframe than the current chart.
//Update 3/10/24: Fixed Day Light Savings Discrepancy
//Update 3/14/24: Added the ability to customize different session colors, specify how many previous sessions are displayed, and enable midpoint lines. Thank you for the suggestions everyone!

// User input for the opening range duration
rangeOption = input.string('5m', title='Opening Range Duration', options=['30s', '1m', '2m', '5m', '10m', '15m'])

// Convert user-selected duration to milliseconds
rangeDurationSec = rangeOption == '30s' ? 30 : rangeOption == '1m' ? 60 : rangeOption == '2m' ? 120 : rangeOption == '5m' ? 300 : rangeOption == '10m' ? 600 : 900

// Convert rangeOption into a valid Pine Script timeframe
validTF = rangeOption == '30s' ? "1" : str.replace(rangeOption, "m", "")

// User input for limiting the number of previous sessions displayed
maxSessions = input.int(3, title='Number of Previous Sessions to Display', minval=1, maxval=50)

// Midpoint line settings
enableMidpointLine = input.bool(false, title='Enable Midpoint Line')
midpointLineColor = input.color(color.white, title='Midpoint Line Color')
midpointLineTransparency = input.int(50, title='Midpoint Line Transparency', minval=0, maxval=100)

// User inputs for line and label customization
lineTransparency = input.int(0, title='Line Transparency', minval=0, maxval=100)
lineStyleOption = input.string('Dashed', title='Line Style', options=['Solid', 'Dashed', 'Dotted'])
lineStyle = lineStyleOption == 'Solid' ? line.style_solid : lineStyleOption == 'Dashed' ? line.style_dashed : line.style_dotted
labelTransparency = input.int(0, title='Label Transparency', minval=0, maxval=100)

// No-Trade Zone settings
enableNoTradeZone = input.bool(false, title='Enable No Trade Zone')

// Session-specific settings
showRTH = input.bool(true, title='Enable US RTH Session')
rthLineColor = input.color(color.yellow, title='US RTH Line Color')
rthNoTradeColor = input.color(color.red, title='US RTH No Trade Zone Color')

showNewYork = input.bool(false, title='Enable New York Session')
nyLineColor = input.color(color.blue, title='New York Line Color')
nyNoTradeColor = input.color(color.orange, title='New York No Trade Zone Color')

showLondon = input.bool(false, title='Enable London Session')
londonLineColor = input.color(color.green, title='London Line Color')
londonNoTradeColor = input.color(color.purple, title='London No Trade Zone Color')

showTokyo = input.bool(false, title='Enable Tokyo Session')
tokyoLineColor = input.color(color.aqua, title='Tokyo Line Color')
tokyoNoTradeColor = input.color(color.gray, title='Tokyo No Trade Zone Color')

showSydney = input.bool(false, title='Enable Sydney Session')
sydneyLineColor = input.color(color.fuchsia, title='Sydney Line Color')
sydneyNoTradeColor = input.color(color.teal, title='Sydney No Trade Zone Color')

// Function to check if DST is active (for US/Eastern Timezone)
isDSTActive() =>
    yearStart = year(timenow)
    dstStart = timestamp(yearStart, 3, 14 - dayofweek(timestamp(yearStart, 3, 14)), 2, 0, 0)
    dstEnd = timestamp(yearStart, 11, 7 - dayofweek(timestamp(yearStart, 11, 7)), 2, 0, 0)
    time >= dstStart and time < dstEnd

// Function to plot the session opening range
plotSessionRange(sessionName, sessionStartHour, sessionStartMin, durationSec, lineColor, noTradeColor, isEnabled, isDST=false) =>
    if isEnabled
        var float rangeHigh = na
        var float rangeLow = na
        var line[] upperLines = array.new_line(0)
        var line[] lowerLines = array.new_line(0)
        var line[] midpointLines = array.new_line(0)
        var linefill[] fillZones = array.new_linefill(0)
        var label seshlabel = na

        adjustedStartHour = isDST ? sessionStartHour - 1 : sessionStartHour
        sessionStartTime = timestamp('UTC', year, month, dayofmonth, adjustedStartHour, sessionStartMin, 0)
        sessionEndTime = sessionStartTime + durationSec * 1000

        // Fetch the correct high and low from the lower timeframe
        lowerTFHigh = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, validTF, high, lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)
        lowerTFLow = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, validTF, low, lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)

        isSessionStart = time[1] < sessionStartTime and time >= sessionStartTime
        if isSessionStart
            rangeHigh := na
            rangeLow := na

        isSessionActive = time >= sessionStartTime and time < sessionEndTime
        if isSessionActive
            rangeHigh := na(rangeHigh) ? lowerTFHigh : math.max(rangeHigh, lowerTFHigh)
            rangeLow := na(rangeLow) ? lowerTFLow : math.min(rangeLow, lowerTFLow)

        isSessionEnd = time[1] < sessionEndTime and time >= sessionEndTime
        if isSessionEnd
            upperLine = line.new(bar_index, rangeHigh, bar_index + 1, rangeHigh, color=color.new(lineColor, lineTransparency), width=2, style=lineStyle, extend=extend.right)
            lowerLine = line.new(bar_index, rangeLow, bar_index + 1, rangeLow, color=color.new(lineColor, lineTransparency), width=2, style=lineStyle, extend=extend.right)
            array.push(upperLines, upperLine)
            array.push(lowerLines, lowerLine)
            seshlabel := label.new(bar_index, rangeHigh, sessionName + ' ' + rangeOption + ' OR: ' + str.tostring(rangeHigh) + " - " + str.tostring(rangeLow) , color=color.new(lineColor, labelTransparency), textcolor=color.white) 
            
            if enableNoTradeZone
                fillZone = linefill.new(upperLine, lowerLine, color=color.new(noTradeColor, 90))
                array.push(fillZones, fillZone)

            if enableMidpointLine
                midpoint = (rangeHigh + rangeLow) / 2
                midpointLine = line.new(bar_index, midpoint, bar_index + 1, midpoint, color=color.new(midpointLineColor, midpointLineTransparency), width=1, style=line.style_dotted, extend=extend.right)
                array.push(midpointLines, midpointLine)
            
            // Remove excess previous sessions if they exceed maxSessions
            if array.size(upperLines) > maxSessions
                line.delete(array.shift(upperLines))
                line.delete(array.shift(lowerLines))
                if enableNoTradeZone
                    linefill.delete(array.shift(fillZones))
                if enableMidpointLine
                    line.delete(array.shift(midpointLines))

// Ensure only selected sessions are plotted
plotSessionRange('US RTH', 14, 30, rangeDurationSec, rthLineColor, rthNoTradeColor, showRTH, isDST=isDSTActive())
plotSessionRange('New York', 13, 30, rangeDurationSec, nyLineColor, nyNoTradeColor, showNewYork, isDST=isDSTActive())
plotSessionRange('London', 8, 0, rangeDurationSec, londonLineColor, londonNoTradeColor, showLondon)
plotSessionRange('Tokyo', 23, 0, rangeDurationSec, tokyoLineColor, tokyoNoTradeColor, showTokyo)
plotSessionRange('Sydney', 21, 0, rangeDurationSec, sydneyLineColor, sydneyNoTradeColor, showSydney)

// This Pine Script® code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
// © gggoaaat

//@version=6
indicator("Opening Range Breakout (ORB) with Fib Retracement", "ORB", overlay = true)

Time_Group = "Orb Time Range"
sessionTime = input.session("0930-0945", title="Range", group = Time_Group, inline="1", tooltip = "Time Range Start to End")
sessionZone = input.string("GMT-4", "Zone", tooltip = "Timezone", options= ['GMT-12', 'GMT-11:30', 'GMT-11', 'GMT-10:30', 'GMT-10','GMT-9:30', 'GMT-9', 'GMT-8:30', 'GMT-8', 'GMT-7:30','GMT-7', 'GMT-6:30', 'GMT-6', 'GMT-5:30', 'GMT-5','GMT-4:30', 'GMT-4', 'GMT-3:30', 'GMT-3', 'GMT-2:30','GMT-2', 'GMT-1:30', 'GMT-1', 'GMT-0:30', 'GMT+0','GMT+0:30', 'GMT+1', 'GMT+1:30', 'GMT+2', 'GMT+2:30','GMT+3', 'GMT+3:30', 'GMT+4', 'GMT+4:30', 'GMT+5','GMT+5:30', 'GMT+6', 'GMT+6:30', 'GMT+7', 'GMT+7:30','GMT+8', 'GMT+8:30', 'GMT+9', 'GMT+9:30', 'GMT+10','GMT+10:30', 'GMT+11', 'GMT+11:30', 'GMT+12', 'GMT+12:30','GMT+13', 'GMT+13:30', 'GMT+14'], group = Time_Group, inline="1")

group_lines = "Line Management"
showAllLevels = input.bool(true, "Show All Fib levels", group = group_lines)
showExtendedLines = input.bool(true, "Show Extended Fib Retracement Lines", group = group_lines)

group_colors = "Orb Colors"
inputFibColor1 = input.color(color.green, "Buy", inline="1", group = group_colors)
inputFibColor2 = input.color(color.red, "Sell", inline="1", group = group_colors)
inputFibColor3 = input.color(color.rgb(120, 123, 134, 50), "Lines", inline="1", group = group_colors)

toInteger(_type)=>                                                           // casts float, integer, or string to integer
    forceString = str.format("{0}", _type)                                   // casts type to string
    stripCommas = str.replace_all(forceString, ",", "")                      // strip string commas
    int(str.tonumber(stripCommas)) 

InSession(sessionTime, sessionTimeZone=syminfo.timezone) =>
    not na(time(timeframe.period, sessionTime, sessionTimeZone))


inSession    = InSession(sessionTime, sessionZone) and timeframe.isintraday
sessionStart = inSession and not inSession[1]
// === CALCULATE HIGH/LOW ===

var finalTop = high
var finalLow = low

var float highestPrice = na
var float lowestPrice  = na
if sessionStart
    highestPrice := high
    lowestPrice  := low
else if inSession
    highestPrice := math.max(highestPrice, high)
    lowestPrice  := math.min(lowestPrice, low)
else
    finalTop := highestPrice
    finalLow := lowestPrice

// Fibonacci levels
fibLevels = array.new_float()
array.push(fibLevels, 0.0)
array.push(fibLevels, 0.236)
array.push(fibLevels, 0.382)
array.push(fibLevels, 0.5 )
array.push(fibLevels, 0.618)
array.push(fibLevels, 0.786)
array.push(fibLevels, 1)
array.push(fibLevels, input.float(1.618,  "Fib Val", inline="1", group = "Buy Retracement Values"))
array.push(fibLevels, input.float(2.618,  "Fib Val", inline="1", group = "Buy Retracement Values"))
array.push(fibLevels, input.float(3.618,  "Fib Val", inline="2", group = "Buy Retracement Values"))
array.push(fibLevels, input.float(4.618,  "Fib Val", inline="2", group = "Buy Retracement Values"))
array.push(fibLevels, input.float(-1.618, "Fib Val", inline="3", group = "Sell Retracement Values"))
array.push(fibLevels, input.float(-2.618, "Fib Val", inline="3", group = "Sell Retracement Values"))
array.push(fibLevels, input.float(-3.618, "Fib Val", inline="4", group = "Sell Retracement Values"))
array.push(fibLevels, input.float(-4.618, "Fib Val", inline="4", group = "Sell Retracement Values"))

// Calculate retracement levels

GetRange(_high, _low) =>
    retracementLevels1 = array.new_float()
    for i = 0 to array.size(fibLevels) - 1
        fib = array.get(fibLevels, i)
        if fib >= 0
            level = _low + (_high - _low) * fib
            array.push(retracementLevels1, level)
        else
            level = _high + (_high - _low) * fib
            array.push(retracementLevels1, level)
    
    retracementLevels1

retracementLevels = GetRange(finalTop, finalLow)


valueU4326  = array.get(retracementLevels, 10)
valueU3618  = array.get(retracementLevels, 09)
valueU2618  = array.get(retracementLevels, 08)
valueU1618  = array.get(retracementLevels, 07)

value236    = array.get(retracementLevels, 01)
value382    = array.get(retracementLevels, 02)
value500    = array.get(retracementLevels, 03)
value618    = array.get(retracementLevels, 04)
value786    = array.get(retracementLevels, 05)

valueD1618  = array.get(retracementLevels, 11)
valueD2618  = array.get(retracementLevels, 12)
valueD3618  = array.get(retracementLevels, 13)
valueD4326  = array.get(retracementLevels, 14)

retracementLevelsBelow1 = GetRange(finalLow, valueD1618)
retracementLevelsBelow2 = GetRange(valueD1618, valueD2618)
retracementLevelsBelow3 = GetRange(valueD2618, valueD3618)
retracementLevelsBelow4 = GetRange(valueD3618, valueD4326)

retracementLevelsAbove1 = GetRange(finalTop, valueU1618)
retracementLevelsAbove2 = GetRange(valueU1618, valueU2618)
retracementLevelsAbove3 = GetRange(valueU2618, valueU3618)
retracementLevelsAbove4 = GetRange(valueU3618, valueU4326)

// isItAboveHigh = ta.highest(60) > finalTop
// isItBelowLow =  ta.lowest(60) < finalLow
// ifAboveLevel1 = isItAboveHigh //and high > array.get(retracementLevels, 07) 
// ifAboveLevel2 = ta.highest(60) > valueU1618
// ifAboveLevel3 = ta.highest(60) > valueU2618
// ifAboveLevel4 = ta.highest(60) > valueU3618

// ifBelowLevel1 = isItBelowLow //and low < valueD1618
// ifBelowLevel2 = ta.lowest(60) < valueD1618
// ifBelowLevel3 = ta.lowest(60) < valueD2618
// ifBelowLevel4 = ta.lowest(60) < valueD3618


// // === PLOT ===
plotHigh = plot(finalTop, "Top", color=color.green, linewidth=4, trackprice = true, style = plot.style_steplinebr)
plotLow = plot(finalLow,  "Bottom", color=color.red, linewidth=4, trackprice = true, style = plot.style_steplinebr)

plotFib01 = plot(showAllLevels ? value236 : na, color=inputFibColor3, title="Fib 23.6%",   linewidth=1, trackprice = false, style = plot.style_steplinebr)
plotFib02 = plot(showAllLevels ? value382 : na, color=inputFibColor3, title="Fib 38.2%",   linewidth=1, trackprice = false, style = plot.style_steplinebr)
plotFib03 = plot(showAllLevels ? value500 : na, color=inputFibColor3, title="Fib 50.00%",  linewidth=1, trackprice = false, style = plot.style_steplinebr)
plotFib04 = plot(showAllLevels ? value618 : na, color=inputFibColor3, title="Fib 61.8%",   linewidth=1, trackprice = false, style = plot.style_steplinebr)
plotFib05 = plot(showAllLevels ? value786 : na, color=inputFibColor3, title="Fib 78.6%",   linewidth=1, trackprice = false, style = plot.style_steplinebr)

plotFib07 = plot(showAllLevels ? valueU1618 : na, color=inputFibColor1, title="1st Level",   linewidth=2, trackprice = true, style = plot.style_steplinebr)
plotFib08 = plot(showAllLevels ? valueU2618 : na, color=inputFibColor1, title="2nd Level",   linewidth=2, trackprice = true, style = plot.style_steplinebr)
plotFib09 = plot(showAllLevels ? valueU3618 : na, color=inputFibColor1, title="3rd Level",   linewidth=2, trackprice = true, style = plot.style_steplinebr)
plotFib10 = plot(showAllLevels ? valueU4326 : na, color=inputFibColor1, title="4th Level",   linewidth=2, trackprice = true, style = plot.style_steplinebr)
plotFib11 = plot(showAllLevels ? valueD1618 : na, color=inputFibColor2, title="1st Level",   linewidth=2, trackprice = true, style = plot.style_steplinebr)
plotFib12 = plot(showAllLevels ? valueD2618 : na, color=inputFibColor2, title="2nd Level",   linewidth=2, trackprice = true, style = plot.style_steplinebr)
plotFib13 = plot(showAllLevels ? valueD3618 : na, color=inputFibColor2, title="3rd Level",   linewidth=2, trackprice = true, style = plot.style_steplinebr)
plotFib14 = plot(showAllLevels ? valueD4326 : na, color=inputFibColor2, title="4th Level",   linewidth=2, trackprice = true, style = plot.style_steplinebr)

plotLow1Fib03  = plot(showAllLevels ? array.get(retracementLevelsBelow1, 03) : na, style=plot.style_steplinebr,  color=inputFibColor3, title="LL1 50.00%", linewidth=1, trackprice = false)

plotHigh2Fib03 = plot(showAllLevels ? array.get(retracementLevelsAbove2, 03) : na, style=plot.style_steplinebr,  color=inputFibColor3, title="HL2 50.00%", linewidth=1, trackprice = false)
plotLow3Fib03  = plot(showAllLevels ? array.get(retracementLevelsBelow3, 03) : na , style=plot.style_steplinebr, color=inputFibColor3, title="Fib LL3 50.00%", linewidth=1, trackprice = false)
plotHigh3Fib03 = plot(showAllLevels ? array.get(retracementLevelsAbove3, 03) : na , style=plot.style_steplinebr, color=inputFibColor3, title="Fib HL3 50.00%", linewidth=1, trackprice = false)
plotLow4Fib03  = plot(showAllLevels ? array.get(retracementLevelsBelow4, 03) : na , style=plot.style_steplinebr, color=inputFibColor3, title="Fib LL4 50.00%", linewidth=1, trackprice = false)
plotHigh4Fib03 = plot(showAllLevels ? array.get(retracementLevelsAbove4, 03) : na , style=plot.style_steplinebr, color=inputFibColor3, title="Fib HL4 50.00%", linewidth=1, trackprice = false)


drawLineToNextDay(level, title, _color) =>
    var line lineID = na
    // Calculate the time of the next day
    nextDay = timestamp(year, month, dayofmonth + 14, 0, 0)
    lineID := line.new(x1=bar_index + 1, y1=level, x2=bar_index + 2, y2=level, width=1, color=_color, extend = extend.right, style = line.style_solid)
    lineID


if showExtendedLines
    extLineFibU1236 = drawLineToNextDay(array.get(retracementLevelsAbove1, 01), " ", inputFibColor3)
    extLineFibU2236 = drawLineToNextDay(array.get(retracementLevelsAbove2, 01), " ", inputFibColor3)
    extLineFibU3236 = drawLineToNextDay(array.get(retracementLevelsAbove3, 01), " ", inputFibColor3)
    extLineFibU4236 = drawLineToNextDay(array.get(retracementLevelsAbove4, 01), " ", inputFibColor3)
    
    extLineFibD1236 = drawLineToNextDay(array.get(retracementLevelsBelow1, 01), " ", inputFibColor3)
    extLineFibD2236 = drawLineToNextDay(array.get(retracementLevelsBelow2, 01), " ", inputFibColor3)
    extLineFibD3236 = drawLineToNextDay(array.get(retracementLevelsBelow3, 01), " ", inputFibColor3)
    extLineFibD4236 = drawLineToNextDay(array.get(retracementLevelsBelow4, 01), " ", inputFibColor3)
    
    extLineFibU1382 = drawLineToNextDay(array.get(retracementLevelsAbove1, 02), " ", inputFibColor3)
    extLineFibU2382 = drawLineToNextDay(array.get(retracementLevelsAbove2, 02), " ", inputFibColor3)
    extLineFibU3382 = drawLineToNextDay(array.get(retracementLevelsAbove3, 02), " ", inputFibColor3)
    extLineFibU4382 = drawLineToNextDay(array.get(retracementLevelsAbove4, 02), " ", inputFibColor3)
    
    extLineFibD1382 = drawLineToNextDay(array.get(retracementLevelsBelow1, 02), " ", inputFibColor3)
    extLineFibD2382 = drawLineToNextDay(array.get(retracementLevelsBelow2, 02), " ", inputFibColor3)
    extLineFibD3382 = drawLineToNextDay(array.get(retracementLevelsBelow3, 02), " ", inputFibColor3)

items.author: rupatil
items.source:
//@version=5
indicator("RV- Opening Range Breakout (ORB) V1.1", "RV- ORB V1.1", overlay=true, max_lines_count=500, max_labels_count=500)

//---------------------"Opening Range Breakout (ORB)"-----------------------------------
string GRP5 = "════════ Opening Range Breakout (ORB) ═══════════"
// User Inputs

UpORB = input(true, title='Show Opening Range High', group=GRP5)
DownORB = input(true, title='Show Opening Range Low', group=GRP5)
show_percentage_move = input(true, title="Show Percentage Move Between High and Low", group=GRP5)
timeframe_option = input.string('15', title='Select Opening Range Candle (in minutes)', options=['5', '15', '30', '45', '60', '120'], group=GRP5)
days_to_average = input.int(20, title="Average of no of Day's ORB Candle Range", minval=1, maxval=30, group=GRP5)

// Convert string option to integer
var int selected_timeframe = 0
if (timeframe_option == '5')
    selected_timeframe := 5
else if (timeframe_option == '15')
    selected_timeframe := 15
else if (timeframe_option == '30')
    selected_timeframe := 30
else if (timeframe_option == '45')
    selected_timeframe := 45
else if (timeframe_option == '60')
    selected_timeframe := 60
else
    selected_timeframe := 120

// Helper Functions
is_newbar(res) => ta.change(time(res)) != 0
adopt(r, s) => request.security(syminfo.tickerid, r, s)

// Variables
high_range = ta.valuewhen(is_newbar('D'), high, 0)
low_range = ta.valuewhen(is_newbar('D'), low, 0)
FH = UpORB ? adopt(str.tostring(selected_timeframe), high_range) : na
FL = DownORB ? adopt(str.tostring(selected_timeframe), low_range) : na

// Calculate AORB for the past user-defined number of days
var float AORB = na
if (not na(FH) and not na(FL))
    AORB := (FH - FL) * 100 / FH

// Calculate the average AORB over the past N days excluding today
AORB_series = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "D", ta.valuewhen(not na(AORB), AORB, 1))
AORB_avg = ta.sma(AORB_series, days_to_average)

// Variables to store previous day and week high and low
var float prevDayHigh = na
var float prevDayLow = na
var float dayHigh = na
var float dayLow = na

var float prevWeekHigh = na
var float prevWeekLow = na
var float weekHigh = na
var float weekLow = na

// Update daily high and low
if ta.change(time('D'))
    prevDayHigh := dayHigh
    prevDayLow := dayLow
    dayHigh := high
    dayLow := low
else
    dayHigh := math.max(nz(dayHigh, high), high)
    dayLow := math.min(nz(dayLow, low), low)

// Update weekly high and low
if ta.change(time('W'))
    prevWeekHigh := weekHigh
    prevWeekLow := weekLow
    weekHigh := high
    weekLow := low
else
    weekHigh := math.max(nz(weekHigh, high), high)
    weekLow := math.min(nz(weekLow, low), low)

// Plotting
FHP = plot(UpORB ? FH : na, color=color.rgb(76, 175, 80), style=plot.style_circles, display=display.none, title="First Bar High")
FLP = plot(DownORB ? FL : na, color=color.red, style=plot.style_circles, display=display.none, title="First Bar Low")
fill(FHP, FLP, color=(UpORB and DownORB) ? color.new(#aacfff, 70) : na, title="First Bar H-L Fill")

// Plot the previous day's high and low levels on today's chart
pdh = plot(prevDayHigh, display=display.none, color=color.green, title="Previous Day High")
pdl = plot(prevDayLow, display=display.none, color=color.red, title="Previous Day Low")
fill(pdh, pdl, color=color.new(#fca0a0, 70), title="Previous Day H-L Fill")

// Plot the previous week's high and low levels on today's chart
pwh = plot(prevWeekHigh, display=display.none, color=color.green, title="Previous Week High")
pwl = plot(prevWeekLow, display=display.none, color=color.red, title="Previous Week Low")
fill(pwh, pwl, color=color.new(#96faab, 70), title="Previous Week H-L Fill")

// -----------------------LABEL------------------------
label_bg_color = input.color(color.new(color.black, 0), title="Label Background Color")
label_text_color = input.color(color.white, title="Label Text Color")
label_size = input.string('normal', title="Label Size", options=['tiny', 'small', 'normal', 'large'])
label_style_option = input.string('label_left', title="Label Style", options=['label_down', 'label_up', 'label_left', 'label_right'])
label_position_option = input.string('auto', title="Label Position", options=['FH', 'FL', 'center', 'auto'])

// Determine the label style
var string label_style = 'label_down'
if label_style_option == 'label_up'
    label_style := 'label_up'
else if label_style_option == 'label_left'
    label_style := 'label_left'
else if label_style_option == 'label_right'
    label_style := 'label_right'

// Calculate the percentage move between the first high and low for the current day
var label lbl_0 = na
if (not na(FH) and not na(FL))
    AORB = (FH - FL) * 100 / FH
    var float label_y = na
    if label_position_option == 'auto'
        label_y := close > FH ? FH : close < FL ? FL : (FH + FL) / 2
    else if label_position_option == 'FH'
        label_y := FH
    else if label_position_option == 'FL'
        label_y := FL
    else
        label_y := (FH + FL) / 2

    if show_percentage_move
        label_text = str.tostring(AORB, '#.##') + '% (' + timeframe_option + ' Min)\n' + str.tostring(AORB_avg, '#.##') + '% (Last '  + str.tostring(days_to_average) + ' D Avg)'
        lbl_0 := label.new(bar_index, label_y, xloc=xloc.bar_index, text=label_text, color=label_bg_color, style=label_style == 'label_down' ? label.style_label_down : label_style == 'label_up' ? label.style_label_up : label_style == 'label_left' ? label.style_label_left : label.style_label_right, textcolor=label_text_color, size=label_size == 'tiny' ? size.tiny : label_size == 'small' ? size.small : label_size == 'normal' ? size.normal : size.large, textalign=text.align_center)

        // Delete the previous label to avoid overlapping
        if (not na(lbl_0[1]))
            label.delete(lbl_0[1])

items.source:
//@version=6
indicator("ORB 369 - Opening Range Breakout", overlay = true, max_boxes_count = 500)

// --- Inputs ---
grp_orb = "ORB Settings"
orb_time = input.session("0930-0945", "ORB Time Session (NY Time)", group = grp_orb, tooltip = "The 15-minute window to establish the range.")
timezone = input.string("America/New_York", "Timezone", group = grp_orb)

grp_style = "Style & Colors"
up_color   = input.color(color.green, "Bullish Breakout Color", group = grp_style)
down_color = input.color(color.red, "Bearish Breakout Color", group = grp_style)
range_col  = input.color(color.new(color.gray, 50), "Range Border Color", group = grp_style)
mid_col    = input.color(color.new(color.gray, 70), "Midline Color", group = grp_style)

grp_sd = "Supply & Demand"
show_sd    = input.bool(true, "Detect S/D inside ORB?", group = grp_sd, tooltip = "Identifies unmitigated wicks/zones within the 15m range.")
sd_color   = input.color(color.new(color.blue, 80), "S/D Zone Color", group = grp_sd)

// --- Logic: Session & Range ---
// Check if we are within the specified session
in_session = not na(time(timeframe.period, orb_time, timezone))
is_new_day = ta.change(time("D", timezone)) != 0

var float orb_high = na
var float orb_low  = na
var float orb_mid  = na
var bool breakout_hit = false

// Reset at the start of a new day
if is_new_day
    orb_high := na
    orb_low  := na
    orb_mid  := na
    breakout_hit := false

// Capture High/Low during the 15m session
if in_session
    if na(orb_high) or high > orb_high
        orb_high := high
    if na(orb_low) or low < orb_low
        orb_low := low
    orb_mid := (orb_high + orb_low) / 2

// --- Logic: Supply & Demand (Inside Range) ---
// Simple logic: Identify aggressive moves or unmitigated wicks within the 15m window
var box sd_zone = na
if in_session and show_sd
    // Logic: If candle is bullish, potential demand at the bottom; if bearish, supply at top
    if close > open
        sd_zone := box.new(bar_index, high, bar_index, low, bgcolor = sd_color, border_color = na)
    else
        sd_zone := box.new(bar_index, high, bar_index, low, bgcolor = sd_color, border_color = na)
    box.delete(sd_zone[1]) // Keep only the most recent within the window

// --- Plotting the Range ---
plot(orb_high, "ORB High", color = range_col, style = plot.style_stepline, linewidth = 2)
plot(orb_low,  "ORB Low",  color = range_col, style = plot.style_stepline, linewidth = 2)
plot(orb_mid,  "ORB Mid",  color = mid_col,   style = plot.style_linebr,   linewidth = 1)

// --- Breakout Detection (5m timeframe recommended) ---
// Only trigger after the session has ended
session_ended = not in_session and not na(orb_high)
bull_break = session_ended and close > orb_high and close[1] <= orb_high
bear_break = session_ended and close < orb_low  and close[1] >= orb_low

// Color Bars
barcolor(bull_break ? up_color : bear_break ? down_color : na)

// --- Alerts ---
if bull_break
    alert("ORB Bullish Breakout: " + str.tostring(close), alert.freq_once_per_bar)
if bear_break
    alert("ORB Bearish Breakout: " + str.tostring(close), alert.freq_once_per_bar)

// --- Visual Cues ---
plotshape(bull_break, "Bull Break Label", shape.triangleup, location.belowbar, up_color, size = size.small)
plotshape(bear_break, "Bear Break Label", shape.triangledown, location.abovebar, down_color, size = size.small)

items.source:
// This source code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
// © ebecihalil

//@version=6
indicator("Opening Range Breakout", shorttitle="ORB", overlay=true, 
      max_boxes_count=500, max_lines_count=500, max_labels_count=500)

// ---------------------------------------
// STATE VARIABLES
// ---------------------------------------
var bool breakoutTriggered = false
var bool retestTriggered   = false
var int breakoutBar        = na
var string breakoutType    = ""
var bool retestLabelDrawn  = false
var label retestLabelId    = na     // handle for the ACTIVE retest label only

// Active retest / level logic
var float upperLevel = na
var float lowerLevel = na
var bool levelsFrozen = false
var bool finalSignalTriggered = false
var int retestBar = na           // bar index of active retest

// Optional active-level lines (transient only)
var line upperLine = na
var line lowerLine = na

// ----------------------------
// USER SETTINGS
// ----------------------------
sessionChoice = input.string("New York Session", "Select Session", options=["Asia Session", "London Session", "New York Session"],tooltip = "Select which trading session to use for building the ORB.\n\n• Asia Session (Tokyo,China, etc.)\n• London Session(EuroZone and European Equities)\n• New York Session (US Equities and Indicies)")
orbMinutes = input.int(30, "ORB Range (min)", options=[5, 15, 30],tooltip = "Defines the length of the Opening Range.\n\nExample:\n30 min → The indicator calculates the high & low of the first 30 minutes of the selected session.\n\nAfter the range completes, breakouts, retests and Buy/Sell opportunities are monitored outside this window.")

orbMinutesLabel = str.tostring(orbMinutes) + " min"

highColorInput = input.color(color.red, "High Line Color")
lowColorInput = input.color(color.green, "Low Line Color")
boxColorInput = input.color(color.new(color.blue, 85), "Box Background Color")

// ----------------------------
// TIMEZONE-AWARE SESSION START/END
// ----------------------------
var string nyTz   = "America/New_York"
var string lonTz  = "Europe/London"
var string asiaTz = "Asia/Tokyo"

midnightNY   = timestamp(nyTz, year(time, nyTz), month(time, nyTz), dayofmonth(time, nyTz), 0, 0)
midnightLon  = timestamp(lonTz, year(time, lonTz), month(time, lonTz), dayofmonth(time, lonTz), 0, 0)
midnightAsia = timestamp(asiaTz, year(time, asiaTz), month(time, asiaTz), dayofmonth(time, asiaTz), 0, 0)

sessionStart = 0
sessionEnd   = 0
if sessionChoice == "New York Session"
    sessionStart := midnightNY + 9*60*60*1000 + 30*60*1000
    sessionEnd   := midnightNY + 16*60*60*1000
else if sessionChoice == "London Session"
    sessionStart := midnightLon + 8*60*60*1000
    sessionEnd   := midnightLon + 16*60*60*1000 + 30*60*1000
else
    sessionStart := midnightAsia + 9*60*60*1000
    sessionEnd   := midnightAsia + 15*60*60*1000

inSession = time >= sessionStart and time < sessionEnd

// ----------------------------
// ORB VARIABLES
// ----------------------------
var float orbHigh = na
var float orbLow  = na
var int orbStartBar = na
var int orbStartTime = na
var int frozenRightEnd = na

sessionChanged = ta.change(sessionStart) != 0
if sessionChanged
    orbHigh := na
    orbLow := na
    orbStartBar := na
    orbStartTime := na
    frozenRightEnd := na

    // RESET breakout / active retest tracking 
    breakoutTriggered := false
    retestTriggered   := false
    breakoutBar       := na
    breakoutType      := ""
    retestLabelDrawn  := false

    // Clear the stored handle for the active retest 
    retestLabelId := na

    // reset active level logic
    upperLevel := na
    lowerLevel := na
    levelsFrozen := false
    finalSignalTriggered := false
    retestBar := na

if inSession and na(orbStartBar)
    orbStartBar := bar_index
    orbStartTime := time

orbDurationMs = orbMinutes * 60 * 1000
inORBWindow = inSession and time < orbStartTime + orbDurationMs

if inORBWindow
    orbHigh := na(orbHigh) ? high : math.max(orbHigh, high)
    orbLow  := na(orbLow)  ? low  : math.min(orbLow, low)

// ----------------------------
// TIMEFRAME CHECK
// ----------------------------
chartTFMinutes = (
    timeframe.isdaily ? 1440 :
    timeframe.isweekly ? 10080 :
    timeframe.ismonthly ? 43200 :
    timeframe.multiplier
)

canDraw = not na(orbHigh) and not na(orbLow) and not na(orbStartBar) and chartTFMinutes <= orbMinutes

// ----------------------------
// DRAWING ORB BOX & LINES
// ----------------------------
var box orbBox = na
var line topLine = na
var line botLine = na
var label topLabel = na
var label botLabel = na

if inSession
    frozenRightEnd := bar_index
rightEnd = frozenRightEnd

if canDraw
    if na(orbBox)
        orbBox := box.new(orbStartBar, orbHigh, rightEnd, orbLow, bgcolor=boxColorInput, border_color=color.new(boxColorInput,0))
    else
        box.set_left(orbBox, orbStartBar)
        box.set_right(orbBox, rightEnd)
        box.set_top(orbBox, orbHigh)
        box.set_bottom(orbBox, orbLow)

    extension = 20
    lineEnd = math.min(rightEnd + extension, bar_index + 499)

    if na(topLine)
        topLine := line.new(orbStartBar, orbHigh, lineEnd, orbHigh, style=line.style_dotted, width=2, color=highColorInput)
    else
        line.set_xy1(topLine, orbStartBar, orbHigh)
        line.set_xy2(topLine, lineEnd, orbHigh)

    if na(botLine)
        botLine := line.new(orbStartBar, orbLow, lineEnd, orbLow, style=line.style_dotted, width=2, color=lowColorInput)
    else
        line.set_xy1(botLine, orbStartBar, orbLow)
        line.set_xy2(botLine, lineEnd, orbLow)

    if na(topLabel)
        topLabel := label.new(lineEnd, orbHigh, "High: "+str.tostring(orbHigh, format.mintick), style=label.style_label_left, color=highColorInput, textcolor=color.white)
    else
        label.set_xy(topLabel, lineEnd, orbHigh)

    if na(botLabel)
        botLabel := label.new(lineEnd, orbLow, "Low: "+str.tostring(orbLow, format.mintick), style=label.style_label_left, color=lowColorInput, textcolor=color.white)
    else
        label.set_xy(botLabel, lineEnd, orbLow)

// WARNING LABEL
var label warn = na
warningText = "⚠️ ORB (" + orbMinutesLabel + ")\nwon't display in this timeframe \n Please Select a lower timeframe"

futureBars = 4
futureX = bar_index + futureBars

if chartTFMinutes > orbMinutes
    if na(warn)
        warn := label.new(futureX, high, "←  " + warningText, xloc=xloc.bar_index, yloc=yloc.price, style=label.style_label_left, color=color.red, textcolor=color.white, size=size.small)
    else
        label.set_xy(warn, futureX, high)
        label.set_text(warn, "←  " + warningText)
else
    if not na(warn)
        label.delete(warn)
        warn := na

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// ORB BREAKOUT SIGNALS 
// ------------------------------------------------------------
orbCompleted = canDraw and not inORBWindow

closeAboveORB = orbCompleted and close > orbHigh and inSession
closeBelowORB = orbCompleted and close < orbLow and inSession

if not breakoutTriggered
    if closeAboveORB
        label.new(bar_index, high,
            "BREAKOUT",
            style=label.style_label_down,
            color=color.rgb(14, 51, 216),
            textcolor=color.white,
            yloc=yloc.abovebar)
        breakoutTriggered := true
        breakoutBar := bar_index
        breakoutType := "buy"

    if closeBelowORB
        label.new(bar_index, low,
            "BREAKOUT",
            style=label.style_label_up,
            color=color.rgb(14, 51, 216),
            textcolor=color.white,
            yloc=yloc.belowbar)
        breakoutTriggered := true
        breakoutBar := bar_index
        breakoutType := "sell"

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// RETEST LOGIC 
// ------------------------------------------------------------
canRetest = breakoutTriggered and not retestTriggered and bar_index > breakoutBar and inSession
touchingBox = canRetest and (high >= orbLow and low <= orbHigh)

// RETEST SUCCESS (capture active retest and freeze levels)
if touchingBox
    retestTriggered := true
    // create RETEST label and store handle for the ACTIVE retest only
    if breakoutType == "buy"
        retestLabelId := label.new(bar_index, high, "RETEST", style=label.style_label_down, color=color.new(#db8411, 0), textcolor=color.white, yloc=yloc.abovebar)
    else
        retestLabelId := label.new(bar_index, low, "RETEST", style=label.style_label_up, color=color.new(#db8411, 0), textcolor=color.white, yloc=yloc.belowbar)

    retestLabelDrawn := true

    // capture the highest high & lowest low between breakoutBar and this retest bar (inclusive)
    rBar = bar_index
    retestBar := rBar
    lengthRange = rBar - breakoutBar
    float tempHigh = na
    float tempLow  = na
    for offset = 0 to lengthRange
        h = high[offset]
        l = low[offset]
        tempHigh := na(tempHigh) ? h : math.max(tempHigh, h)
        tempLow  := na(tempLow)  ? l : math.min(tempLow, l)

    upperLevel := tempHigh
    lowerLevel := tempLow
    levelsFrozen := true
    finalSignalTriggered := false

// RETEST FAILS
retestFailedSell  = breakoutType == "buy"  and close < orbLow and inSession
retestFailedBuy   = breakoutType == "sell" and close > orbHigh and inSession

if retestFailedSell or retestFailedBuy
    // delete only the ACTIVE retest label (historical ones remain)
    if not na(retestLabelId)
        label.delete(retestLabelId)
        retestLabelId := na

    // reset active retest tracking (failed)
    retestTriggered := false
    retestLabelDrawn := false

    // reset breakout tracking (active cycle aborted)
    breakoutTriggered := false
    breakoutType := ""
    breakoutBar := na

    // reset active levels / flags
    upperLevel := na
    lowerLevel := na
    levelsFrozen := false
    finalSignalTriggered := false
    retestBar := na

    // create NEW breakout (opposite side) as in original design
    if retestFailedSell
        label.new(bar_index, low,
            "BREAKOUT",
            style=label.style_label_up,
            color=color.rgb(14, 51, 216),
            textcolor=color.white,
            yloc=yloc.belowbar)
        breakoutTriggered := true
        breakoutBar := bar_index
        breakoutType := "sell"

    if retestFailedBuy
        label.new(bar_index, high,
            "BREAKOUT",
            style=label.style_label_down,
            color=color.rgb(14, 51, 216),
            textcolor=color.white,
            yloc=yloc.abovebar)
        breakoutTriggered := true
        breakoutBar := bar_index
        breakoutType := "buy" 

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// BUY / SELL SIGNAL
// ------------------------------------------------------------
if levelsFrozen and not finalSignalTriggered and inSession and not na(retestBar) and bar_index > retestBar
    // BUY cycle: only check buy condition
    if breakoutType == "buy" and not na(upperLevel) and close[1] > upperLevel
        label.new(bar_index, high,
            "BUY",
            style = label.style_label_down,
            color = color.rgb(16, 163, 48), // blue
            textcolor = color.white,
            yloc = yloc.abovebar)
        finalSignalTriggered := true

        // active-level lines cleanup (transient only)
        if not na(upperLine)
            line.delete(upperLine)
            upperLine := na
        if not na(lowerLine)
            line.delete(lowerLine)
            lowerLine := na

        // mark active retest handle cleared 
        retestLabelId := na
        // freeze flags cleared for active level visuals only 
        levelsFrozen := false

    // SELL cycle: only check sell condition
    if breakoutType == "sell" and not na(lowerLevel) and close[1] < lowerLevel
        label.new(bar_index, low,
            "SELL",
            style = label.style_label_up,
            color = color.red,
            textcolor = color.white,
            yloc = yloc.belowbar)
        finalSignalTriggered := true

        // active-level lines cleanup (transient only)
        if not na(upperLine)
            line.delete(upperLine)
            upperLine := na
        if not na(lowerLine)
            line.delete(lowerLine)
            lowerLine := na

        // clear active retest handle so historical retest stays forever
        retestLabelId := na
        levelsFrozen := false

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Active-only level drawing (transient)
// ------------------------------------------------------------
if levelsFrozen and not finalSignalTriggered
    if na(upperLine)
        upperLine := line.new(retestBar, upperLevel, bar_index + 50, upperLevel, style=line.style_dotted, width=1, color=color.rgb(39,96,253))
    else
        line.set_xy1(upperLine, retestBar, upperLevel)
        line.set_xy2(upperLine, bar_index + 50, upperLevel)

    if na(lowerLine)
        lowerLine := line.new(retestBar, lowerLevel, bar_index + 50, lowerLevel, style=line.style_dotted, width=1, color=color.red)
    else
        line.set_xy1(lowerLine, retestBar, lowerLevel)
        line.set_xy2(lowerLine, bar_index + 50, lowerLevel)
else
    // remove transient lines when no active retest waiting
    if not na(upperLine)
        line.delete(upperLine)
        upperLine := na
    if not na(lowerLine)
        line.delete(lowerLine)
        lowerLine := na
// ------------------------------------------------------------
// ALERT CONDITIONS FOR BUY & SELL SIGNALS
// ------------------------------------------------------------

// Buy alert triggers at the same time the BUY label is created
alertcondition(
     levelsFrozen and breakoutType == "buy" and not finalSignalTriggered and not na(upperLevel) and close[1] > upperLevel,
     title = "ORB BUY Signal",
     message = "ORB BUY signal triggered."
)

// Sell alert triggers at the same time the SELL label is created
alertcondition(
     levelsFrozen and breakoutType == "sell" and not finalSignalTriggered and not na(lowerLevel) and close[1] < lowerLevel,
     title = "ORB SELL Signal",
     message = "ORB SELL signal triggered."
)

items.source:
//@version=6
indicator('PumpC Opening Range Breakout (ORB) Multi Range', shorttitle='PumpC Multi ORB', overlay=true, max_boxes_count=500, max_labels_count=500, max_lines_count=500, max_bars_back=500, dynamic_requests=true)

//────────────────────────────────────────────
// 1. Mode Selection
//────────────────────────────────────────────
var GROUP_MODE = "1. Mode Selection"
mode            = input.string("Auto", "Session Mode", options=["Auto", "Futures", "Stocks"], group=GROUP_MODE)
isAuto          = mode == "Auto"
isFutMan        = mode == "Futures"
isStkMan        = mode == "Stocks"
isLikelyFutures = syminfo.type == "futures"
useFutures      = isFutMan or (isAuto and isLikelyFutures)
useStocks       = isStkMan or (isAuto and not isLikelyFutures)
isFutures       = useFutures
isStocks        = useStocks

//────────────────────────────────────────────
// 2. ORB Controls
//────────────────────────────────────────────
var GROUP_CONTROLS = "2. ORB Controls"
showOne           = input.bool(true, title="Delete Historic Extension Levels", group=GROUP_CONTROLS)
showLabels        = input.bool(true, title="Show Labels", group=GROUP_CONTROLS)
labelPosition     = input.string("Start", title="Label Position", options=["Start", "End"], group=GROUP_CONTROLS)
orbRangeMode      = input.string("5 min", title="ORB Range", options=["5 min", "15 min", "30 min", "60 min"], group=GROUP_CONTROLS)

useORB15 = orbRangeMode == "15 min"
useORB30 = orbRangeMode == "30 min"
useORB60 = orbRangeMode == "60 min"
orbMinutes = useORB60 ? 60 : useORB30 ? 30 : useORB15 ? 15 : 5

//────────────────────────────────────────────
// 3. ORB Levels
//────────────────────────────────────────────
var GROUP_LEVELS = "3. ORB Levels"
show_orb_open  = input.bool(true, title="ORB Open", inline="orbopen", group=GROUP_LEVELS)
color_ORB_Open = input.color(color.green, title="", inline="orbopen", group=GROUP_LEVELS)

show_level_1 = input.bool(true, title="ORB High/Low", inline="lvl1", group=GROUP_LEVELS)
color_level_1_plus = input.color(color.black, title="High", inline="lvl1", group=GROUP_LEVELS)
color_level_1_minus = input.color(color.black, title="Low", inline="lvl1", group=GROUP_LEVELS)

show_level_2 = input.bool(true, title="Half Range", inline="lvl2", group=GROUP_LEVELS)
mult_level_2 = 0.5
color_level_2_plus = input.color(color.red, title="0.5", inline="lvl2", group=GROUP_LEVELS)

show_level_3 = input.bool(true, title="Extension 1", inline="lvl3", group=GROUP_LEVELS)
mult_level_3 = input.float(0.5, title="", step=0.01, inline="lvl3", group=GROUP_LEVELS)
color_level_3_plus = input.color(color.gray, title="+", inline="lvl3", group=GROUP_LEVELS)
color_level_3_minus = input.color(color.gray, title="-", inline="lvl3", group=GROUP_LEVELS)

show_level_4 = input.bool(true, title="Extension 2", inline="lvl4", group=GROUP_LEVELS)
mult_level_4 = input.float(1, title="", step=0.01, inline="lvl4", group=GROUP_LEVELS)
color_level_4_plus = input.color(color.gray, title="+", inline="lvl4", group=GROUP_LEVELS)
color_level_4_minus = input.color(color.gray, title="-", inline="lvl4", group=GROUP_LEVELS)

//────────────────────────────────────────────
// 4. Style Controls
//────────────────────────────────────────────
var GROUP_STYLE = "4. Style Controls"
orbOpenWidth  = input.int(1, "ORB Open Width", minval=1, maxval=5, group=GROUP_STYLE)
orbOpenStyle  = input.string("Solid", "ORB Open Style", options=["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], group=GROUP_STYLE)
orbRangeWidth = input.int(2, "ORB High/Low Width", minval=1, maxval=5, group=GROUP_STYLE)
orbRangeStyle = input.string("Solid", "ORB High/Low Style", options=["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], group=GROUP_STYLE)
halfWidth     = input.int(1, "Half Range Width", minval=1, maxval=5, group=GROUP_STYLE)
halfStyle     = input.string("Dashed", "Half Range Style", options=["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], group=GROUP_STYLE)
extWidth      = input.int(1, "Extension Width", minval=1, maxval=5, group=GROUP_STYLE)
extStyle      = input.string("Dotted", "Extension Style", options=["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], group=GROUP_STYLE)

//────────────────────────────────────────────
// 5. ORB Box Overlay
//────────────────────────────────────────────
var GROUP_BOX = "5. ORB Box Overlay"
showBox = input.bool(true, "Enable ORB Box", group=GROUP_BOX)
boxColor = input.color(color.new(color.black, 95), "ORB Box Color", group=GROUP_BOX)
showBoxHistory = input.bool(true, "Show Historical ORB Boxes", group=GROUP_BOX)

//────────────────────────────────────────────
// 6. Session VWAP
//────────────────────────────────────────────
var GROUP_VWAP = "6. Session VWAP"
showSessionVWAP = input.bool(true, title="Show Session VWAP", group=GROUP_VWAP, inline="1")
sessionVWAPColor = input.color(color.orange, "VWAP Color", group=GROUP_VWAP, inline="1")
vwapTimeframe = input.timeframe("D", title="VWAP Reset Timeframe", group=GROUP_VWAP)
max_tf_show_vwap = input.timeframe("15", "Show only on chart TF ≤", group=GROUP_VWAP)

//────────────────────────────────────────────
// Helpers
//────────────────────────────────────────────
tfInMinutes(simple string tf="") =>
    float chartTf = timeframe.multiplier * (timeframe.isseconds ? 1. / 60 : timeframe.isminutes ? 1. : timeframe.isdaily ? 60. * 24 : timeframe.isweekly ? 60. * 24 * 7 : timeframe.ismonthly ? 60. * 24 * 30.4375 : na)
    float result = tf == "" ? chartTf : request.security(syminfo.tickerid, tf, chartTf)
    result

styleFromInput(string s) => s == "Dashed" ? line.style_dashed : s == "Dotted" ? line.style_dotted : line.style_solid

fmt(float v) => na(v) ? "n/a" : str.tostring(v, format.mintick)

showPlots = tfInMinutes() <= 5

chart_sec_vwap = timeframe.in_seconds(timeframe.period)
limit_sec_vwap = timeframe.in_seconds(max_tf_show_vwap)
showVWAPPlots = not na(chart_sec_vwap) and not na(limit_sec_vwap) and chart_sec_vwap <= limit_sec_vwap

labelPos() => labelPosition == "End" ? time_close("D") : time

var line[] orbLines = array.new_line()
var label[] orbLabels = array.new_label()

clearObjects() =>
    if array.size(orbLines) > 0
        for i = 0 to array.size(orbLines) - 1
            line.delete(array.get(orbLines, i))
    if array.size(orbLabels) > 0
        for i = 0 to array.size(orbLabels) - 1
            label.delete(array.get(orbLabels, i))
    array.clear(orbLines)
    array.clear(orbLabels)

addLine(int x1, float y, int x2, color col, int width, style) =>
    line ln = line.new(x1=x1, y1=y, x2=x2, y2=y, xloc=xloc.bar_time, style=style, color=col, width=width)
    array.push(orbLines, ln)
    ln

addLabel(float y, string txt, color col) =>
    label lb = label.new(x=labelPos(), y=y, xloc=xloc.bar_time, text=txt, textcolor=col, style=label.style_none, size=size.small)
    array.push(orbLabels, lb)
    lb

//────────────────────────────────────────────
// VWAP Logic
//────────────────────────────────────────────
srcVWAP = hl2

var float vwapsumSession = na
var float volumesumSession = na
var float sessionVWAP = na

newVWAPPeriod = timeframe.change(vwapTimeframe)

if newVWAPPeriod
    vwapsumSession := srcVWAP * volume
    volumesumSession := volume
    sessionVWAP := volumesumSession != 0 ? vwapsumSession / volumesumSession : na
else
    vwapsumSession := nz(vwapsumSession) + srcVWAP * volume
    volumesumSession := nz(volumesumSession) + volume
    sessionVWAP := volumesumSession != 0 ? vwapsumSession / volumesumSession : na

plotSessionVWAP = newVWAPPeriod ? na : sessionVWAP

plot(showSessionVWAP and showVWAPPlots ? plotSessionVWAP : na, title="Session VWAP", style=plot.style_linebr, color=sessionVWAPColor, linewidth=2)

//────────────────────────────────────────────
// ORB Capture Logic
//────────────────────────────────────────────
get830CandleFullValues() =>
    is830Candle = hour == (isFutures ? 8 : 9) and minute == 30
    o = is830Candle ? open : na
    h = is830Candle ? high : na
    l = is830Candle ? low : na
    v = is830Candle ? volume : na
    [o, h, l, v]

[o830_5, h830_5, l830_5, v830_5] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "5", get830CandleFullValues(), barmerge.gaps_off)
[o830_15, h830_15, l830_15, v830_15] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "15", get830CandleFullValues(), barmerge.gaps_off)
[o830_30, h830_30, l830_30, v830_30] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "30", get830CandleFullValues(), barmerge.gaps_off)
[o830_60, h830_60, l830_60, v830_60] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "60", get830CandleFullValues(), barmerge.gaps_off)

o830 = useORB60 ? o830_60 : useORB30 ? o830_30 : useORB15 ? o830_15 : o830_5
h830 = useORB60 ? h830_60 : useORB30 ? h830_30 : useORB15 ? h830_15 : h830_5
l830 = useORB60 ? l830_60 : useORB30 ? l830_30 : useORB15 ? l830_15 : l830_5
v830 = useORB60 ? v830_60 : useORB30 ? v830_30 : useORB15 ? v830_15 : v830_5

get830Time() =>
    is830 = hour == (isFutures ? 8 : 9) and minute == 30
    is830 ? time : na

orbTimeRaw = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "5", get830Time(), barmerge.gaps_off)
var int ORB_Time = na
if not na(orbTimeRaw)
    ORB_Time := orbTimeRaw

getSessionEndTime() => timestamp("America/New_York", year, month, dayofmonth, 16, 0)
sessionEndRaw = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "5", getSessionEndTime(), barmerge.gaps_off)
var int Session_EndTime = na
if not na(sessionEndRaw)
    Session_EndTime := sessionEndRaw

var float ORB_Open = na
var float ORB_High = na
var float ORB_Low = na
var float ORB_Volume = na
var box orbBox = na

if not na(o830)
    ORB_Open := o830
if not na(h830)
    ORB_High := h830
if not na(l830)
    ORB_Low := l830
if not na(v830)
    ORB_Volume := v830

ORB_Range = ORB_High - ORB_Low

startHour = isFutures ? 8 : 9
endHour   = startHour + ((useORB30 or useORB60) ? 1 : 0)
endMinute = useORB60 ? 30 : useORB30 ? 0 : useORB15 ? 45 : 35
isEndCandleClose = hour == endHour and minute == endMinute
justClosedORB = isEndCandleClose and not na(ORB_Time) and not na(Session_EndTime) and not na(ORB_Range) and ORB_Range > 0 and not na(close[1])

//────────────────────────────────────────────
// Box
//────────────────────────────────────────────
if justClosedORB and showBox and showPlots
    if not showBoxHistory
        box.delete(orbBox)
    orbBoxEndTime = ORB_Time + orbMinutes * 60 * 1000
    orbBox := box.new(left=ORB_Time, right=orbBoxEndTime, top=ORB_High, bottom=ORB_Low, xloc=xloc.bar_time, bgcolor=boxColor, border_color=boxColor)

//────────────────────────────────────────────
// Levels
//────────────────────────────────────────────
Level_two_plus    = ORB_Low + ORB_Range * mult_level_2
Level_three_plus  = ORB_High + ORB_Range * mult_level_3
Level_three_minus = ORB_Low  - ORB_Range * mult_level_3
Level_four_plus   = ORB_High + ORB_Range * mult_level_4
Level_four_minus  = ORB_Low  - ORB_Range * mult_level_4

if justClosedORB and showPlots
    if showOne
        clearObjects()

    if show_orb_open
        addLine(ORB_Time, ORB_Open, Session_EndTime, color_ORB_Open, orbOpenWidth, styleFromInput(orbOpenStyle))
        if showLabels
            addLabel(ORB_Open, "ORB Open [" + fmt(ORB_Open) + "]", color_ORB_Open)

    if show_level_1
        addLine(ORB_Time, ORB_High, Session_EndTime, color_level_1_plus, orbRangeWidth, styleFromInput(orbRangeStyle))
        addLine(ORB_Time, ORB_Low, Session_EndTime, color_level_1_minus, orbRangeWidth, styleFromInput(orbRangeStyle))
        if showLabels
            addLabel(ORB_High, "+OR [" + fmt(ORB_High) + "]", color_level_1_plus)
            addLabel(ORB_Low, "-OR [" + fmt(ORB_Low) + "]", color_level_1_minus)

    if show_level_2
        addLine(ORB_Time, Level_two_plus, Session_EndTime, color_level_2_plus, halfWidth, styleFromInput(halfStyle))
        if showLabels
            addLabel(Level_two_plus, "+0.5 OR [" + fmt(Level_two_plus) + "]", color_level_2_plus)

    if show_level_3
        addLine(ORB_Time, Level_three_plus, Session_EndTime, color_level_3_plus, extWidth, styleFromInput(extStyle))
        addLine(ORB_Time, Level_three_minus, Session_EndTime, color_level_3_minus, extWidth, styleFromInput(extStyle))
        if showLabels
            addLabel(Level_three_plus, "+" + str.tostring(mult_level_3) + "x OR [" + fmt(Level_three_plus) + "]", color_level_3_plus)
            addLabel(Level_three_minus, "-" + str.tostring(mult_level_3) + "x OR [" + fmt(Level_three_minus) + "]", color_level_3_minus)

    if show_level_4
        addLine(ORB_Time, Level_four_plus, Session_EndTime, color_level_4_plus, extWidth, styleFromInput(extStyle))
        addLine(ORB_Time, Level_four_minus, Session_EndTime, color_level_4_minus, extWidth, styleFromInput(extStyle))
        if showLabels
            addLabel(Level_four_plus, "+" + str.tostring(mult_level_4) + "x OR [" + fmt(Level_four_plus) + "]", color_level_4_plus)
            addLabel(Level_four_minus, "-" + str.tostring(mult_level_4) + "x OR [" + fmt(Level_four_minus) + "]", color_level_4_minus)

//────────────────────────────────────────────
// Dashboard
//────────────────────────────────────────────
sessStart = timestamp("America/New_York", year, month, dayofmonth, isFutures ? 8 : 9, 30)
sessEnd   = timestamp("America/New_York", year, month, dayofmonth, 16, 0)
inSession = time >= sessStart and time < sessEnd
orbIsToday = not na(ORB_Time) and ORB_Time == sessStart
orbReady = inSession and orbIsToday and not na(ORB_High) and not na(ORB_Low) and not na(ORB_Range) and ORB_Range > 0 and time >= ORB_Time + orbMinutes * 60 * 1000

//────────────────────────────────────────────
// ORB Alerts — Today-only gate
//────────────────────────────────────────────
orbReadyForAlerts = orbReady

alertcondition(orbReadyForAlerts and close >= ORB_High and close[1] < ORB_High and close[1] >= ORB_Low, title="🔔 ORB Breakout: Close Above High (From Inside)", message="{{ticker}} {{interval}} ➔ Price broke and closed ABOVE ORB High, starting from inside.")
alertcondition(orbReadyForAlerts and close <= ORB_Low and close[1] < ORB_High and close[1] >= ORB_Low, title="🔔 ORB Breakdown: Close Below Low (From Inside)", message="{{ticker}} {{interval}} ➔ Price broke and closed BELOW ORB Low, starting from inside.")
alertcondition(orbReadyForAlerts and high > ORB_High and close <= ORB_High, title="⚠️ ORB Fallout: Wick Above High", message="{{ticker}} {{interval}} ➔ Wick broke ORB High but closed BACK inside.")
alertcondition(orbReadyForAlerts and low < ORB_Low and close >= ORB_Low, title="⚠️ ORB Fallout: Wick Below Low", message="{{ticker}} {{interval}} ➔ Wick broke ORB Low but closed BACK inside.")

//@version=6
indicator("Opening Range Breakout with Multi-Timeframe Liquidity]", overlay = true, max_lines_count = 500, max_labels_count = 500, max_boxes_count = 500)

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
//inputs
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{

//Historical Display
showHist = input.bool(false, title = "Show Historical Data", group = "Historical Display", tooltip = "Displays All Data from Previous Sessions")
//Opening Range
orTF = input.timeframe("15", title = "Time Period", group = "Opening Range", tooltip = "Sets the Length of Time used for determining Opening Range.") 
//Custom Range
crTog = input.bool(false, title = "", inline = "Custom", group = "Custom Range")
crSesh = input.session("0930-0945", title = "", inline = "Custom", group = "Custom Range")
tz = input.string("UTC+4", title = "", group = "Custom Range", inline = "Custom", options = ["UTC-10", "UTC-8", "UTC-7", "UTC-6", "UTC-5", "UTC-4", "UTC-3", "UTC+0", "UTC+1", "UTC+2", "UTC+3", "UTC+3:30", "UTC+4", "UTC+5", "UTC+5:30", "UTC+5:45", "UTC+6","UTC+6:30", "UTC+7", "UTC+8", "UTC+9", "UTC+9:30", "UTC+10", "UTC+11", "UTC+12", "UTC+12:45", "UTC+13"])

//Trading Sessions - MAIN TOGGLE ADDED
enableTradingSessions = input.bool(true, "Enable Trading Sessions", group = "Trading Sessions", tooltip = "Master switch to enable/disable all trading session displays")
bool showSessionNames     = input.bool(true, "Show Session Names", group = "Trading Sessions")
bool showSessionOC        = input.bool(false, "Draw Session Open/Close Lines", group = "Trading Sessions")
bool showSessionHL        = input.bool(true, "Draw Session High/Low Lines", group = "Trading Sessions")

//Session High/Low Line Settings - MODIFIED to have individual session colors
sessionHLWidth = input.int(1, title = "High/Low Line Width", minval = 1, maxval = 10, group = "Session High/Low Settings")

const string TZ_TOOLTIP_TEXT = "The session's time zone, specified in either GMT notation (e.g., 'GMT-5') or as an IANA time zone database name (e.g., 'America/New_York')."
 + " We recommend the latter since it includes other time-related changes, such as daylight savings."

const string FIRST_SESSION_GROUP = "Tokyo Session"
showFirst         = input.bool(true, "Show Tokyo Session", group = FIRST_SESSION_GROUP)
firstSessionName  = input.string("Tokyo", "Displayed Name", group = FIRST_SESSION_GROUP)
firstSessionTime  = input.session("0400-1300", "Session Time", group = FIRST_SESSION_GROUP)
firstSessionTZ    = input.string("UTC+4", "Session Timezone", group = FIRST_SESSION_GROUP, tooltip = TZ_TOOLTIP_TEXT)
firstSessionColor = input.color(color.new(#2962FF, 95), "Session Color", group = FIRST_SESSION_GROUP)
tokyoHighColor = input.color(#2962FF, title = "Tokyo High Color", group = FIRST_SESSION_GROUP)
tokyoLowColor = input.color(#1E88E5, title = "Tokyo Low Color", group = FIRST_SESSION_GROUP)

const string SECOND_SESSION_GROUP = "London Session"

// Helper function for timeframe multiplier
tfMulti(tf) =>
    ts = timeframe.in_seconds("")
    htfs = timeframe.in_seconds(tf)
    htfs/ts

// Helper function to convert timeframe to display text
tfToText(tf) =>
    switch tf
        "1" => "1m"
        "5" => "5m"
        "15" => "15m"
        "30" => "30m"
        "60" => "1H"
        "240" => "4H"
        "1D" => "1D"
        "1W" => "1W"
        "1M" => "1M"
        => tf

displayLimitLine(_array) =>
    if array.size(_array) > displayLimit/2
        a = array.shift(_array)
        line.delete(a)

displayLimitLabel(_array) =>
    if array.size(_array) > displayLimit/2
        a = array.shift(_array)
        label.delete(a)

removeMitigatedLines(_array, _hl) =>
    m = false
    if array.size(_array) > 0 and removeMitigated        
        for i = array.size(_array) - 1 to 0 by 1
            l = array.get(_array, i)
            hh = candleType == "Close" ? close[1] : high
            ll = candleType == "Close" ? close[1] : low
            if _hl == "High" and hh > line.get_y1(l)
                array.remove(_array, i)
                if mitiOptions == "Show"
                    line.new(line.get_x1(l),line.get_y1(l),time,line.get_y1(l), xloc=xloc.bar_time, color = color.new(htfHighLiquidityColor, 70))
                line.delete(l)
                m := true
            if _hl == "Low" and ll < line.get_y1(l)
                array.remove(_array, i)
                if mitiOptions == "Show"
                    line.new(line.get_x1(l),line.get_y1(l),time,line.get_y1(l), xloc=xloc.bar_time, color = color.new(htfLowLiquidityColor, 70))
                line.delete(l) 
                m := true  
    displayLimitLine(_array) 
    m

removeMitigatedLinesWithLabels(_array, _arrayLabels, _hl, _isHTF = true) =>
    m = false
    if array.size(_array) > 0 and removeMitigated        
        for i = array.size(_array) - 1 to 0 by 1
            l = array.get(_array, i)
            hh = candleType == "Close" ? close[1] : high
            ll = candleType == "Close" ? close[1] : low
            if _hl == "High" and hh > line.get_y1(l)
                array.remove(_array, i)
                // Remove corresponding label
                if array.size(_arrayLabels) > i
                    labelToDelete = array.get(_arrayLabels, i)
                    array.remove(_arrayLabels, i)
                    label.delete(labelToDelete)
                if mitiOptions == "Show"
                    colorToUse = _isHTF ? htfHighLiquidityColor : ltfHighLiquidityColor
                    line.new(line.get_x1(l),line.get_y1(l),time,line.get_y1(l), xloc=xloc.bar_time, color = color.new(colorToUse, 70))
                line.delete(l)
                m := true
            if _hl == "Low" and ll < line.get_y1(l)
                array.remove(_array, i)
                // Remove corresponding label
                if array.size(_arrayLabels) > i
                    labelToDelete = array.get(_arrayLabels, i)
                    array.remove(_arrayLabels, i)
                    label.delete(labelToDelete)
                if mitiOptions == "Show"
                    colorToUse = _isHTF ? htfLowLiquidityColor : ltfLowLiquidityColor
                    line.new(line.get_x1(l),line.get_y1(l),time,line.get_y1(l), xloc=xloc.bar_time, color = color.new(colorToUse, 70))
                line.delete(l) 
                m := true  
    displayLimitLine(_array) 
    displayLimitLabel(_arrayLabels)
    m

extendLineToCurrent(lineArray) =>

method setName(SessionDisplay this, string name) =>
    sessionLabel = this.sessionLabel
    sessionBox = this.sessionBox
    boxText = array.new<string>()
    if showSessionNames
        boxText.push(name)
    
    sessionLabel.set_y(sessionBox.get_bottom())
    sessionLabel.set_text(array.join(boxText, "\n"))

method createSessionDisplay(SessionInfo this) =>
    boxColor = this.color
    opaqueColor = color.new(boxColor, 0)
    dis = SessionDisplay.new(
      sessionBox = box.new(bar_index, high, bar_index, low, bgcolor = boxColor, border_color = na),
      sessionLabel = label.new(bar_index, low, "", style = label.style_label_upper_left, textalign = text.align_left, textcolor = opaqueColor, color = color(na)),
      openLine   = showSessionOC ? line.new(bar_index, open, bar_index, open, color = opaqueColor, style = line.style_dashed, width = 1) : na,
      closeLine  = showSessionOC ? line.new(bar_index, close, bar_index, close, color = opaqueColor, style = line.style_dashed, width = 1) : na,
      highLine   = showSessionHL ? line.new(bar_index, high, bar_index, high, color = this.highColor, style = line.style_solid, width = sessionHLWidth) : na,
      lowLine    = showSessionHL ? line.new(bar_index, low, bar_index, low, color = this.lowColor, style = line.style_solid, width = sessionHLWidth) : na,
      sessionOpen = open,
      sessionHigh = high,
      sessionLow = low
      )
    if showSessionOC
        linefill.new(dis.openLine, dis.closeLine, boxColor)
    dis.setName(this.name)
    this.active := dis
    
method updateSessionDisplay(SessionInfo this) =>
    sessionDisp = this.active
    sessionBox = sessionDisp.sessionBox
    openLine = sessionDisp.openLine
    closeLine = sessionDisp.closeLine
    highLine = sessionDisp.highLine
    lowLine = sessionDisp.lowLine
    
    sessionDisp.sessionHigh := math.max(sessionDisp.sessionHigh, high)
    sessionDisp.sessionLow := math.min(sessionDisp.sessionLow, low)

    sessionBox.set_top(math.max(sessionBox.get_top(), high))
    sessionBox.set_bottom(math.min(sessionBox.get_bottom(), low))
    sessionBox.set_right(bar_index)
    sessionDisp.setName(this.name)

    if showSessionOC
        openLine.set_x2(bar_index)
        closeLine.set_x2(bar_index)
        closeLine.set_y1(close)
        closeLine.set_y2(close)

    if showSessionHL
        highLine.set_x2(bar_index)
        lowLine.set_x2(bar_index)
        highLine.set_y1(sessionDisp.sessionHigh)
        highLine.set_y2(sessionDisp.sessionHigh)
        lowLine.set_y1(sessionDisp.sessionLow)
        lowLine.set_y2(sessionDisp.sessionLow)

    sessionDisp

method deleteSessionDisplay(SessionDisplay this) =>
    if not na(this)
        if not na(this.sessionBox)
            this.sessionBox.delete()
        if not na(this.sessionLabel)
            this.sessionLabel.delete()
        if not na(this.openLine)
            this.openLine.delete()
        if not na(this.closeLine)
            this.closeLine.delete()
        if not na(this.highLine)
            this.highLine.delete()
        if not na(this.lowLine)
            this.lowLine.delete()

method update(SessionInfo this) =>
	bool isChange = timeframe.change("1D")
    bool inSession = not na(time("", this.session, this.timezone))
    
    if isChange and not na(this.active)
        this.active.deleteSessionDisplay()
        this.active := na
    
    if inSession
        if na(this.active)
            this.createSessionDisplay()
        else 
            this.updateSessionDisplay()
    else if not na(this.active) and not inSession
        this.active.deleteSessionDisplay()
        this.active := na

getSessionInfos()=>

        if showFourth
            sessionInfosArray.push(SessionInfo.new(fourthSessionColor, fourthSessionName, fourthSessionTime, fourthSessionTZ, sydneyHighColor, sydneyLowColor))
    sessionInfosArray

htf2_close = enableMTF ? request.security(syminfo.tickerid, htfTimeframe2, close, lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_off) : na

// MTF Trend Bias
bullishBias = enableMTF ? (htf2_close > htf2_trend and ema > htf1_ema) : true
bearishBias = enableMTF ? (htf2_close < htf2_trend and ema < htf1_ema) : true

// EMA Stack Analysis
emaStack = enableMTF ? (ema > htf1_ema ? 1 : ema < htf1_ema ? -1 : 0) : 0

// Key Liquidity Pivot Calculations
// HTF Key Liquidity
var htfTime = 0

var htfClose = 0.0
if enableHTFLiquidity
    [_htfTime, _htfOpen, _htfHigh, _htfLow, _htfClose] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, htfLiquidityTF, [time, open, high, low, close], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_off)
    htfTime := _htfTime
    htfOpen := _htfOpen  
    htfHigh := _htfHigh
    htfLow := _htfLow
    htfClose := _htfClose

pivotHighHTF = enableHTFLiquidity ? ta.pivothigh(htfHigh, leftBars*tfMulti(htfLiquidityTF), rightBars+tfMulti(htfLiquidityTF)) : na
pivotLowHTF = enableHTFLiquidity ? ta.pivotlow(htfLow, leftBars*tfMulti(htfLiquidityTF), rightBars+tfMulti(htfLiquidityTF)) : na

// LTF Key Liquidity

    ltfTime := _ltfTime
    ltfOpen := _ltfOpen
    ltfHigh := _ltfHigh  
    ltfLow := _ltfLow
    ltfClose := _ltfClose

pivotHighLTF = enableLTFLiquidity ? ta.pivothigh(ltfHigh, leftBars*tfMulti(ltfLiquidityTF), rightBars+tfMulti(ltfLiquidityTF)) : na
pivotLowLTF = enableLTFLiquidity ? ta.pivotlow(ltfLow, leftBars*tfMulti(ltfLiquidityTF), rightBars+tfMulti(ltfLiquidityTF)) : na

// Extract all ta.* function calls for consistency
orbBullishBreak = ta.crossover(close, orh)
orbBearishBreak = ta.crossunder(close, orl)
emaCrossUp = ta.crossover(close, ema)
emaCrossDown = ta.crossunder(close, ema)

//Establishing When the OR Sesssion is
new_tf = timeframe.change(orTF)
if crTog

else 
    if session.isfirstbar
        or_sesh := true
    else if not session.isfirstbar and new_tf
        or_sesh := false

or_start = or_sesh and not or_sesh[1]
or_end = or_sesh[1] and not or_sesh

//On Start of OR Session
if or_start
    if showHist == false
        or_bx.delete()
        h_ln.delete()
        l_ln.delete()
        m_ln.delete()
        or_fill.delete()

    h_lab.delete()
    l_lab.delete()

    orh := high
    orl := low
    prev_orm := orm[1]

    or_bx := box.new(bar_index,high,bar_index,low, bgcolor = orFillColor, border_width = 0)

    or_token := false
    
    // Reset alert flags
    orbBullishBreakSent := false
    orbBearishBreakSent := false

// Initialize Trading Sessions
if na(sessionInfos) and enableTradingSessions
    sessionInfos := getSessionInfos()

//Running while OR Session is Live
if or_sesh
    if high > orh
        orh := high
    if low < orl
        orl := low
    or_bx.set_top(orh)
    or_bx.set_bottom(orl)
    or_bx.set_right(bar_index)
    if orh != orl
        or_token := true
        
//On End of OR Session
if or_end and or_token
    h_ln := line.new(bar_index,orh,bar_index,orh, color = orColor)
    l_ln := line.new(bar_index,orl,bar_index,orl, color = orColor)

    day_dir := orm > prev_orm ? 1 : orm < prev_orm ? -1 : 0
    
    // Create fill with initial color based on selected method

     (day_dir == 1 ? greenFill : day_dir == -1 ? redFill : orFillColor) : orFillColor
    or_fill := linefill.new(h_ln,l_ln, initial_fill_color)

//Running outside of OR Session
if not or_sesh and or_token

    l_ln.set_x2(bar_index)
    m_ln.set_x2(bar_index)
    h_lab.set_x(bar_index)
