//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{

// HTF Key Liquidity Levels (Higher Timeframe - Major Levels)
if enableLiquidity and enableHTFLiquidity
    dis = rightBars+tfMulti(htfLiquidityTF)
    if not na(pivotHighHTF)
        newLine = line.new(htfTime[dis],htfHigh[dis],htfTime[+1],htfHigh[dis],color = htfHighLiquidityColor, xloc=xloc.bar_time, extend=liquidityExtMax?extend.right:extend.none, width = keyLiquidityLineWidth)
        array.push(htfHighLiquidityArray, newLine)
        // Add timeframe text label like ORB style
        newLabel = label.new(htfTime[+1], htfHigh[dis], text = tfToText(htfLiquidityTF), tooltip = str.tostring(htfHigh[dis], format.mintick), style = label.style_label_left, color = invis, textcolor = color.new(htfHighLiquidityColor, 0), size = txtSize, xloc=xloc.bar_time)
        array.push(htfHighLiquidityLabels, newLabel)
            
    if not na(pivotLowHTF)
        newLine = line.new(htfTime[dis],htfLow[dis],htfTime[+1],htfLow[dis],color = htfLowLiquidityColor, xloc=xloc.bar_time, extend=liquidityExtMax?extend.right:extend.none, width = keyLiquidityLineWidth)
        array.push(htfLowLiquidityArray, newLine)
        // Add timeframe text label like ORB style
        newLabel = label.new(htfTime[+1], htfLow[dis], text = tfToText(htfLiquidityTF), tooltip = str.tostring(htfLow[dis], format.mintick), style = label.style_label_left, color = invis, textcolor = color.new(htfLowLiquidityColor, 0), size = txtSize, xloc=xloc.bar_time)
        array.push(htfLowLiquidityLabels, newLabel)

    // Process HTF liquidity mitigation
    htfHighLineAlert = removeMitigatedLinesWithLabels(htfHighLiquidityArray, htfHighLiquidityLabels, "High", true)
    htfLowLineAlert = removeMitigatedLinesWithLabels(htfLowLiquidityArray, htfLowLiquidityLabels, "Low", true)
    
    // Extend HTF liquidity lines and update label positions
    if liquidityExtCurrent
        extendLineToCurrent(htfHighLiquidityArray)
        extendLineToCurrent(htfLowLiquidityArray)
        // Update label positions to end of extended lines
        if array.size(htfHighLiquidityLabels) > 0
            for i = 0 to array.size(htfHighLiquidityLabels) - 1
                lbl = array.get(htfHighLiquidityLabels, i)
                if not na(lbl)
                    timeExt = time + ((time[1]-time[2])*20)
                    label.set_x(lbl, timeExt)
        if array.size(htfLowLiquidityLabels) > 0
            for i = 0 to array.size(htfLowLiquidityLabels) - 1
                lbl = array.get(htfLowLiquidityLabels, i)
                if not na(lbl)
                    timeExt = time + ((time[1]-time[2])*20)
                    label.set_x(lbl, timeExt)

// LTF Key Liquidity Levels (Lower Timeframe - Precision Levels)
if enableLiquidity and enableLTFLiquidity
    dis = rightBars+tfMulti(ltfLiquidityTF)
    if not na(pivotHighLTF)
        newLine = line.new(ltfTime[dis],ltfHigh[dis],ltfTime[+1],ltfHigh[dis],color = ltfHighLiquidityColor, xloc=xloc.bar_time, extend=liquidityExtMax?extend.right:extend.none, width = keyLiquidityLineWidth)
        array.push(ltfHighLiquidityArray, newLine)
        // Add timeframe text label like ORB style
        newLabel = label.new(ltfTime[+1], ltfHigh[dis], text = tfToText(ltfLiquidityTF), tooltip = str.tostring(ltfHigh[dis], format.mintick), style = label.style_label_left, color = invis, textcolor = color.new(ltfHighLiquidityColor, 0), size = txtSize, xloc=xloc.bar_time)
        array.push(ltfHighLiquidityLabels, newLabel)
            
    if not na(pivotLowLTF)
        newLine = line.new(ltfTime[dis],ltfLow[dis],ltfTime[+1],ltfLow[dis],color = ltfLowLiquidityColor, xloc=xloc.bar_time, extend=liquidityExtMax?extend.right:extend.none, width = keyLiquidityLineWidth)
        array.push(ltfLowLiquidityArray, newLine)
        // Add timeframe text label like ORB style
        newLabel = label.new(ltfTime[+1], ltfLow[dis], text = tfToText(ltfLiquidityTF), tooltip = str.tostring(ltfLow[dis], format.mintick), style = label.style_label_left, color = invis, textcolor = color.new(ltfLowLiquidityColor, 0), size = txtSize, xloc=xloc.bar_time)
        array.push(ltfLowLiquidityLabels, newLabel)

    // Process LTF liquidity mitigation
    ltfHighLineAlert = removeMitigatedLinesWithLabels(ltfHighLiquidityArray, ltfHighLiquidityLabels, "High", false)
    ltfLowLineAlert = removeMitigatedLinesWithLabels(ltfLowLiquidityArray, ltfLowLiquidityLabels, "Low", false)
    
    // Extend LTF liquidity lines and update label positions
    if liquidityExtCurrent
        extendLineToCurrent(ltfHighLiquidityArray)
        extendLineToCurrent(ltfLowLiquidityArray)
        // Update label positions to end of extended lines
        if array.size(ltfHighLiquidityLabels) > 0
            for i = 0 to array.size(ltfHighLiquidityLabels) - 1
                lbl = array.get(ltfHighLiquidityLabels, i)
                if not na(lbl)
                    timeExt = time + ((time[1]-time[2])*20)
                    label.set_x(lbl, timeExt)
        if array.size(ltfLowLiquidityLabels) > 0
            for i = 0 to array.size(ltfLowLiquidityLabels) - 1
                lbl = array.get(ltfLowLiquidityLabels, i)
                if not na(lbl)
                    timeExt = time + ((time[1]-time[2])*20)
                    label.set_x(lbl, timeExt)

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
//Alert Logic - ORB and Liquidity Breakouts
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{

if alertsEnabled and not or_sesh and or_token

    // ORB BULLISH BREAKOUT
    if alertORBreakout and orbBullishBreak and not orbBullishBreakSent
        volumeConfirmed = not showVolumeAnalysis or volume > volumeMA * 1.2
        mtfConfirmed = not enableMTF or bullishBias or neutralBias
        
        alertType = volumeConfirmed and mtfConfirmed ? "HIGH QUALITY" : "STANDARD"
        alertIcon = volumeConfirmed and mtfConfirmed ? "🚀⭐" : "🚀"
        
        alertMessage = alertIcon + " " + alertType + " BULLISH ORB BREAKOUT!\n"
        alertMessage := alertMessage + "Price broke above ORH: " + str.tostring(orh, format.mintick) + "\n"
        alertMessage := alertMessage + "Current Price: " + str.tostring(close, format.mintick) + "\n"
        
        if showVolumeAnalysis
            alertMessage := alertMessage + "Volume: " + str.tostring(volumeStrength) + "% of avg " + (volumeConfirmed ? "✅" : "❌") + "\n"
        if enableMTF
            mtfStatus = bullishBias ? "Bullish" : bearishBias ? "Bearish" : "Neutral"
            alertMessage := alertMessage + "MTF Bias: " + mtfStatus + " " + (mtfConfirmed ? "✅" : "❌") + "\n"
        
        alertMessage := alertMessage + "Action: " + (volumeConfirmed and mtfConfirmed ? "Strong bullish momentum" : "Standard breakout")
        
        alert(alertMessage, alert.freq_once_per_bar)
        orbBullishBreakSent := true

    // ORB BEARISH BREAKOUT  
    if alertORBreakout and orbBearishBreak and not orbBearishBreakSent
        volumeConfirmed = not showVolumeAnalysis or volume > volumeMA * 1.2
        mtfConfirmed = not enableMTF or bearishBias or neutralBias
        
        alertType = volumeConfirmed and mtfConfirmed ? "HIGH QUALITY" : "STANDARD"
        alertIcon = volumeConfirmed and mtfConfirmed ? "🔻⭐" : "🔻"
        
        alertMessage = alertIcon + " " + alertType + " BEARISH ORB BREAKOUT!\n"
        alertMessage := alertMessage + "Price broke below ORL: " + str.tostring(orl, format.mintick) + "\n"
        alertMessage := alertMessage + "Current Price: " + str.tostring(close, format.mintick) + "\n"
        
        if showVolumeAnalysis
            alertMessage := alertMessage + "Volume: " + str.tostring(volumeStrength) + "% of avg " + (volumeConfirmed ? "✅" : "❌") + "\n"
        if enableMTF
            mtfStatus = bullishBias ? "Bullish" : bearishBias ? "Bearish" : "Neutral"
            alertMessage := alertMessage + "MTF Bias: " + mtfStatus + " " + (mtfConfirmed ? "✅" : "❌") + "\n"
        
        alertMessage := alertMessage + "Action: " + (volumeConfirmed and mtfConfirmed ? "Strong bearish momentum" : "Standard breakdown")
        
        alert(alertMessage, alert.freq_once_per_bar)
        orbBearishBreakSent := true

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
//Trading Sessions Processing
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{

if enableTradingSessions and not na(sessionInfos)
    for info in sessionInfos
        info.update()

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
//Display
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{

// EMA Plot
plot(showEMA ? ema : na, title = "EMA", color = emaColor, linewidth = emaWidth)

// Liquidity Alert Conditions for TradingView Alert Creation (Visual Only)
alertcondition(orbBullishBreak, "ORB Bullish Breakout", "Price broke above ORH!")
alertcondition(orbBearishBreak, "ORB Bearish Breakout", "Price broke below ORL!")

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}

items.name: ORB opening range breakout
items.title: ORB opening range breakout
items.author: nkwdesmond
items.source:
// This Pine Script™ code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
// © nkwdesmond

//@version=6
indicator('ORB opening range breakout', 'ORB', max_lines_count = 500, max_labels_count = 500, overlay = true)

timeRange = input.int(5, title = 'ORB time (minutes)', minval = 1, group = 'ORB', inline='ORB')
ORBBodyBool = input.bool(true, title = 'ORB region', group = 'ORB', inline='ORB')
ORBColour = input(title = '', defval = color.rgb(227, 166, 83, transp = 75), group = 'ORB', inline='ORB')
var int timeRangeMilli = timeRange * 60 * 1000

levelSettingOption = input.string('Individual level for each day', title = 'Display', options = ['Individual level for each day', 'Most recent level on most recent day', 'Most recent level across the chart'], group = 'Price level', display = display.none)
levelSetting = levelSettingOption == 'Most recent level on most recent day' ? 'b' : levelSettingOption == 'Most recent level across the chart' ? 'c' : 'a'

ORBHighLevel = input.bool(true, title = 'ORB high', group = 'Price level', inline = 'ORBHigh')
ORBHighPrice = input.bool(true, title = 'ORB high', group = 'Price axis')
ORBHighColour = input(title = '', defval = color.rgb(227, 166, 83, transp = 100), group = 'Price level', inline = 'ORBHigh')
ORBHighLineWidth = input(1, 'Width', group = 'Price level', inline = 'ORBHigh', display = display.none)
ORBHighStyleOption = input.string('solid (─)', title = '', options = ['solid (─)', 'dotted (┈)', 'dashed (╌)', 'arrow left (←)', 'arrow right (→)', 'arrows both (↔)'], group = 'Price level', inline = 'ORBHigh', display = display.none)
ORBHighLineStyle = ORBHighStyleOption == 'dotted (┈)' ? line.style_dotted : ORBHighStyleOption == 'dashed (╌)' ? line.style_dashed : ORBHighStyleOption == 'arrow left (←)' ? line.style_arrow_left : ORBHighStyleOption == 'arrow right (→)' ? line.style_arrow_right : ORBHighStyleOption == 'arrows both (↔)' ? line.style_arrow_both : line.style_solid

ORBLowLevel = input.bool(true, title = 'ORB low', group = 'Price level', inline = 'ORBLow')
ORBLowPrice = input.bool(true, title = 'ORB low', group = 'Price axis')
ORBLowColour = input(title = '', defval = color.rgb(227, 166, 83, transp = 100), group = 'Price level', inline = 'ORBLow')
ORBLowLineWidth = input(1, 'Width', group = 'Price level', inline = 'ORBLow', display = display.none)
ORBLowStyleOption = input.string('solid (─)', title = '', options = ['solid (─)', 'dotted (┈)', 'dashed (╌)', 'arrow left (←)', 'arrow right (→)', 'arrows both (↔)'], group = 'Price level', inline = 'ORBLow', display = display.none)
ORBLowLineStyle = ORBLowStyleOption == 'dotted (┈)' ? line.style_dotted : ORBLowStyleOption == 'dashed (╌)' ? line.style_dashed : ORBLowStyleOption == 'arrow left (←)' ? line.style_arrow_left : ORBLowStyleOption == 'arrow right (→)' ? line.style_arrow_right : ORBLowStyleOption == 'arrows both (↔)' ? line.style_arrow_both : line.style_solid

LabelBool = input.bool(false, title = 'Enable labels (Alternatively go to Chart settings > Scales and lines > Indicators and financials > check Name to display label on price axis)', group = 'Label')

GetORB() => // going into a 1min chart and running this entire function
    var float ORBHigh = na
    var float ORBLow = na
    var int StartTime = na // get the UNIX time for the first bar
    var int EndTime = na
    if session.isfirstbar_regular
        StartTime := time
        EndTime := time + timeRangeMilli
        ORBHigh := high
        ORBLow := low
    else if StartTime <= time and time < EndTime // check time again in function in the event main chart timeframe is higher than ORB time range
        ORBHigh := na(ORBHigh) ? high : math.max(ORBHigh, high)
        ORBLow := na(ORBLow) ? low : math.min(ORBLow, low)
    [ORBHigh, ORBLow]
[ORBHigh, ORBLow] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "1", GetORB(), lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)
// plot(ORBLow , style=plot.style_line, color=color.green, title="ORB High", linewidth=2)

// var float ORBHigh = na
// var float ORBLow = na

if timeframe.isintraday
    var line ORBHighLine = na
    var line ORBLowLine = na

    var box ORBBody = na
    
    var int StartTime = na
    var int EndTime = na

    if bar_index == 0
        if ORBHighLevel // bar_index +1 because there is a glitch where when both x-values are the same, a vertical line ends up forming
            ORBHighLine := line.new(bar_index, ORBHigh, bar_index + 1, ORBHigh, color = ORBHighColour, style = ORBHighLineStyle, width = ORBHighLineWidth, extend = levelSetting == 'c' ? extend.both : extend.right)
        if ORBLowLevel
            ORBLowLine := line.new(bar_index, ORBLow, bar_index + 1, ORBLow, color = ORBLowColour, style = ORBLowLineStyle, width = ORBLowLineWidth, extend = levelSetting == 'c' ? extend.both : extend.right)
        if ORBBodyBool
            ORBBody := box.new(bar_index, ORBHigh, bar_index + 1, ORBLow, border_color = na, bgcolor = ORBColour)

    if session.isfirstbar_regular // ORBHighLine line should only be drawn starting from first regular bar
        // StartTime := time // issue in hourly chart as first half hour is not treated as market hour
        // EndTime := time + timeRangeMilli
        // [oh, ol] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "1", GetORB())
        // ORBHigh := oh
        // ORBLow := ol
        if levelSetting != 'a' // adjust the old lines if option 'a' is not selected
            line.set_x1(ORBHighLine, bar_index)
            line.set_x2(ORBHighLine, bar_index + 1)
            line.set_y1(ORBHighLine, ORBHigh)
            line.set_y2(ORBHighLine, ORBHigh)

            line.set_x1(ORBLowLine, bar_index)
            line.set_x2(ORBLowLine, bar_index + 1)
            line.set_y1(ORBLowLine, ORBLow)
            line.set_y2(ORBLowLine, ORBLow)

            box.set_left(ORBBody, bar_index)
            box.set_right(ORBBody, bar_index + 1)
            box.set_top(ORBBody, ORBHigh)
            box.set_bottom(ORBBody, ORBLow)
        else // option 'a' is selected
            line.set_extend(ORBHighLine, extend.none)
            line.set_extend(ORBLowLine, extend.none)
            if ORBHighLevel // bar_index +1 because there is a glitch where when both x-values are the same, a vertical line ends up forming
                ORBHighLine := line.new(bar_index, ORBHigh, bar_index + 1, ORBHigh, color = ORBHighColour, style = ORBHighLineStyle, width = ORBHighLineWidth, extend = levelSetting == 'c' ? extend.both : extend.right)
            if ORBLowLevel
                ORBLowLine := line.new(bar_index, ORBLow, bar_index + 1, ORBLow, color = ORBLowColour, style = ORBLowLineStyle, width = ORBLowLineWidth, extend = levelSetting == 'c' ? extend.both : extend.right)
            if ORBBodyBool
                ORBBody := box.new(bar_index, ORBHigh, bar_index + 1, ORBLow, border_color = na, bgcolor = ORBColour)
    if not session.isfirstbar_regular and session.ismarket
        // if StartTime <= time and time < EndTime // issue in hourly chart as first half hour is not treated as market hour
        //     [oh, ol] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "1", GetORB())
        //     ORBHigh := oh
        //     ORBLow := ol
        if ORBHigh != ORBHigh[1]
            line.set_y1(ORBHighLine, ORBHigh) // shift ORBHigh in real-time
            line.set_y2(ORBHighLine, ORBHigh)
            box.set_top(ORBBody, ORBHigh)
        if ORBLow != ORBLow[1]
            line.set_y1(ORBLowLine, ORBLow) // shift ORBLow in real-time
            line.set_y2(ORBLowLine, ORBLow)
            box.set_bottom(ORBBody, ORBLow)
        line.set_x2(ORBHighLine, bar_index)
        line.set_x2(ORBLowLine, bar_index)
        box.set_right(ORBBody, bar_index)

    if LabelBool
        ORBHighLabelBool = input.bool(true, title = 'ORB high', group = 'Label', inline = 'ORBHigh')
        ORBHighLabelPriceBool = input.bool(true, title = 'Display price in label', group = 'Label', inline = 'ORBHigh')
        ORBHighLabelAlignOption = input.string('align left', title = '', options = ['align left', 'align center', 'align right'], group = 'Label', inline = 'ORBHigh', display = display.none)
        ORBHighLabelAlign = ORBHighLabelAlignOption == 'align left' ? text.align_left : ORBHighLabelAlignOption == 'align center' ? text.align_center : text.align_right
        ORBHighLabelText = input.string('ORB high ', title = 'Text', group = 'Label', inline = 'ORBHigh', display = display.none)
        ORBHighLabelTextColour = input(title = '', defval = #000000, group = 'Label', inline = 'ORBHigh')
        ORBHighLabelTextSize = input.int(12, title = '', minval = 1, group = 'Label', display = display.none, inline = 'ORBHigh')
        ORBHighOffset = input.int(0, title = 'Bar offset', group = 'Label', display = display.none, inline = 'ORBHigh')

        ORBLowLabelBool = input.bool(true, title = 'ORB low', group = 'Label', inline = 'ORBLow')
        ORBLowLabelPriceBool = input.bool(true, title = 'Display price in label', group = 'Label', inline = 'ORBLow')
        ORBLowLabelAlignOption = input.string('align left', title = '', options = ['align left', 'align center', 'align right'], group = 'Label', inline = 'ORBLow', display = display.none)
        ORBLowLabelAlign = ORBLowLabelAlignOption == 'align left' ? text.align_left : ORBLowLabelAlignOption == 'align center' ? text.align_center : text.align_right
        ORBLowLabelText = input.string('ORB low ', title = 'Text', group = 'Label', inline = 'ORBLow', display = display.none)
        ORBLowLabelTextColour = input(title = '', defval = #000000, group = 'Label', inline = 'ORBLow')
        ORBLowLabelTextSize = input.int(12, title = '', minval = 1, group = 'Label', display = display.none, inline = 'ORBLow')
        ORBLowOffset = input.int(0, title = 'Bar offset', group = 'Label', display = display.none, inline = 'ORBLow')

        var label ORBHighLabel = na
        var label ORBLowLabel = na

        if bar_index == 0
            if ORBHighLabelBool
                ORBHighLabel := label.new(bar_index + ORBHighOffset, ORBHigh, text = ORBHighLabelPriceBool ? ORBHighLabelText + str.tostring(ORBHigh, format.mintick) : ORBHighLabelText, color = ORBHighColour, style = label.style_label_left, textcolor = ORBHighLabelTextColour, size = ORBHighLabelTextSize, textalign = ORBHighLabelAlign)
            if ORBLowLabelBool
                ORBLowLabel := label.new(bar_index + ORBLowOffset, ORBLow, text = ORBLowLabelPriceBool ? ORBLowLabelText + str.tostring(ORBLow, format.mintick) : ORBLowLabelText, color = ORBLowColour, style = label.style_label_left, textcolor = ORBLowLabelTextColour, size = ORBLowLabelTextSize, textalign = ORBLowLabelAlign)

        if session.ismarket
            if ORBHigh != ORBHigh[1]
                label.set_y(ORBHighLabel, ORBHigh)
                if ORBHighLabelPriceBool
                    label.set_text(ORBHighLabel, ORBHighLabelText + str.tostring(ORBHigh, format.mintick))
            if ORBLow != ORBLow[1]
                label.set_y(ORBLowLabel, ORBLow)
                if ORBLowLabelPriceBool
                    label.set_text(ORBLowLabel, ORBLowLabelText + str.tostring(ORBLow, format.mintick))
        
        label.set_x(ORBHighLabel, bar_index + ORBHighOffset)
        label.set_x(ORBLowLabel, bar_index + ORBLowOffset)

plot(timeframe.isintraday and ORBHighPrice ? ORBHigh : na, title = 'High', color = ORBHighColour, editable = false, display = display.price_scale)
plot(timeframe.isintraday and ORBLowPrice ? ORBLow : na, title = 'Low', color = ORBLowColour, editable = false, display = display.price_scale)

BBBool = input.bool(false, title = 'Bollinger Band', group = 'BB')
length = input.int(20, minval=1, group = 'BB')
maType = input.string("SMA", "Basis MA Type", options = ["SMA", "EMA", "SMMA (RMA)", "WMA", "VWMA"], group = 'BB')
src = input(close, title="Source", group = 'BB')
mult = input.float(2.0, minval=0.001, maxval=50, title="StdDev", group = 'BB')
offset = input.int(0, "Offset", minval = -500, maxval = 500, display = display.data_window, group = 'BB')

ma(source, length, _type) =>
    switch _type
        "SMA" => ta.sma(source, length)
        "EMA" => ta.ema(source, length)
        "SMMA (RMA)" => ta.rma(source, length)
        "WMA" => ta.wma(source, length)
        "VWMA" => ta.vwma(source, length)

var series float basis = na
var series float upper = na
var series float lower = na

if BBBool
    basis := ma(src, length, maType)
    dev = mult * ta.stdev(src, length)
    upper := basis + dev
    lower := basis - dev
plot(BBBool ? basis : na, "Basis", color=#2962FF, offset = offset)
p1 = plot(BBBool ? upper : na, "Upper", color=#F23645, offset = offset)
p2 = plot(BBBool ? lower : na, "Lower", color=#089981, offset = offset)
fill(p1, p2, title = "Background", color=color.rgb(33, 150, 243, 95))

items.title: Worldwide Sessions and Opening Range Breakout
items.author: tyler-johnson
items.source:
// This Pine Script® code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
// © tyler-johnson

//@version=6
indicator("Worldwide Sessions and Opening Range Breakout", shorttitle = "ORB Sess", overlay = true)

string orb_tf = input("15", title = "ORB Timeframe", tooltip = "The timeframe to calculate the opening range. This is in TV format (eg. 30s, 15, 2h).")
bool next_session_enabled = input(true, title = "Mark Next Session Start and End", tooltip = "Indicates when the next session will begin and the current session ends.")
bool london_enabled = input(true, title = "London Session Enabled")
bool asia_enabled = input(true, title = "Asia Session Enabled")
bool newyork_enabled = input(true, title = "New York Session Enabled")

int orb_width_sec = timeframe.in_seconds(orb_tf)
int tf_sec = timeframe.in_seconds()

f_gcd(int a, int b) =>
    // Ensure numbers are positive, as GCD is defined for positive integers.
    int ra = math.abs(a)
    int rb = math.abs(b)
    
    // The Euclidean algorithm loop
    while rb != 0
        temp = rb
        rb := ra % rb
        ra := temp

    ra // The result is the final value of 'a'

f_ranges_overlap(float start1, float end1, float start2, float end2) =>
    // Normalize ranges to ensure the start is always less than or equal to the end.
    r1_start = math.min(start1, end1)
    r1_end   = math.max(start1, end1)
    r2_start = math.min(start2, end2)
    r2_end   = math.max(start2, end2)
    
    // The ranges overlap if the first range's start is before the second's end
    // AND the second range's start is before the first's end.
    r1_start < r2_end and r2_start < r1_end

f_slice_array_by_time(array<float> input_array, int array_start_time_ms, int sub_timeframe_duration_sec, int slice_start_time_ms, int slice_duration_sec) =>
    // --- CONVERSION STEP ---
    // Convert durations from seconds to milliseconds to match the start time units.
    sub_timeframe_duration_ms = sub_timeframe_duration_sec * 1000
    slice_duration_ms = slice_duration_sec * 1000

    // Get the size of the input array
    arr_size = array.size(input_array)
    
    // If the input array is empty or sub_timeframe is zero, we can't proceed.
    if arr_size == 0 or sub_timeframe_duration_ms <= 0
        array.new_float(0)
    else
        // 1. Calculate the end times for the source array and the desired slice (all in milliseconds)
        array_end_time_ms = array_start_time_ms + (arr_size * sub_timeframe_duration_ms)
        slice_end_time_ms = slice_start_time_ms + slice_duration_ms

        // 2. Determine the actual start and end times of the overlapping period
        intersection_start = math.max(array_start_time_ms, slice_start_time_ms)
        intersection_end = math.min(array_end_time_ms, slice_end_time_ms)

        // 3. If there is no overlap, return an empty array
        if intersection_start >= intersection_end
            array.new_float(0)
        else
            // 4. Calculate the starting and ending indices for the slice
            start_offset = intersection_start - array_start_time_ms
            start_index = int(math.floor(start_offset / sub_timeframe_duration_ms))

            end_offset = intersection_end - array_start_time_ms
            // Use ceil to include the partial interval at the end, as slicing is exclusive of the end index.
            end_index = int(math.ceil(end_offset / sub_timeframe_duration_ms))

            // 5. Ensure indices are within the bounds of the array
            start_index := math.max(0, start_index)
            end_index := math.min(arr_size, end_index)

            // 6. Slice the array and return the result
            array.slice(input_array, start_index, end_index)

f_get_range_in_window(int start_time, int end_time) =>
    var float hi = na
    var float lo = na
    int orb_end = start_time + orb_width_sec * 1000

    if f_ranges_overlap(time, time_close, start_time, orb_end)
        // find the common denominator between the timeframes so we can perfectly divide each
        dtf = f_gcd(tf_sec, orb_width_sec)
        // request the highs and lows by the sub timeframe
        [h, l] = request.security_lower_tf(syminfo.tickerid, timeframe.from_seconds(dtf), [high, low])
        // extract ONLY the values that are inside the ORB timeframe
        r_hi = array.max(f_slice_array_by_time(h, time, dtf, start_time, orb_width_sec))
        r_lo = array.min(f_slice_array_by_time(l, time, dtf, start_time, orb_width_sec))
        // reduce to the highest high and lowest low
        hi := na(hi) ? r_hi : math.max(hi, r_hi)
        lo := na(lo) ? r_lo : math.min(lo, r_lo)
    else if not f_ranges_overlap(time, time_close, start_time, end_time)
        hi := na
        lo := na

    if time_close < orb_end or time >= end_time
        [na, na]
    else 
        [hi, lo]

// Define conversion constants for clarity and maintainability.
const int MS_IN_SECOND = 1000
const int MS_IN_MINUTE = 1000 * 60
const int MS_IN_HOUR   = 1000 * 60 * 60

// Helper function to pad single-digit numbers with a leading zero (e.g., 7 -> "07").
f_pad(number) => (number < 10 ? "0" : "") + str.tostring(number)

f_formatDurationHMS(totalMilliseconds) =>
    // --- Calculations ---
    // Calculate total hours from the milliseconds.
    int hours = math.floor(totalMilliseconds / MS_IN_HOUR)
    int remainder_after_hours = totalMilliseconds % MS_IN_HOUR

    // From the remainder, calculate the number of full minutes.
    int minutes = math.floor(remainder_after_hours / MS_IN_MINUTE)
    int remainder_after_minutes = remainder_after_hours % MS_IN_MINUTE

    // From the final remainder, calculate the number of seconds.
    int seconds = math.floor(remainder_after_minutes / MS_IN_SECOND)

    result = array.new<string>(0)

    if hours > 0
        array.push(result, str.tostring(hours) + "h")

    if minutes > 0
        array.push(result, str.tostring(minutes) + "m")

    if seconds > 0
        array.push(result, str.tostring(seconds) + "s")

    array.join(result, " ")

string asia_timezone = "Asia/Hong_Kong"
int asia_start = asia_enabled ? timestamp(asia_timezone, year(time, asia_timezone), month(time, asia_timezone), dayofmonth(time, asia_timezone), 8, 0) : 0
int asia_end = asia_enabled ? timestamp(asia_timezone, year(time, asia_timezone), month(time, asia_timezone), dayofmonth(time, asia_timezone), 16, 0) : 0
bool is_asia = asia_enabled and time >= asia_start and time < asia_end
float asia_high = na
float asia_low = na

if asia_enabled
    [h, l] = f_get_range_in_window(asia_start, asia_end)
    asia_high := h
    asia_low := l

bgcolor(asia_enabled and is_asia ? color.new(color.blue, 90) : na, title = "Asia Session")
plot(asia_enabled ? asia_high : na, "Asia Opening Range High", color = color.blue, style = plot.style_linebr)
plot(asia_enabled ? asia_low : na, "Asia Opening Range Low", color = color.blue, style = plot.style_linebr)

string london_timezone = "Europe/London"
int london_start = london_enabled ? timestamp(london_timezone, year(time, london_timezone), month(time, london_timezone), dayofmonth(time, london_timezone), 8, 0) : 0
int london_end = london_enabled ? timestamp(london_timezone, year(time, london_timezone), month(time, london_timezone), dayofmonth(time, london_timezone), 16, 30) : 0
bool is_london = london_enabled and time >= london_start and time < london_end
float london_high = na
float london_low = na

if london_enabled
    [h, l] = f_get_range_in_window(london_start, london_end)
    london_high := h
    london_low := l

bgcolor(london_enabled and is_london ? color.new(color.yellow, 90) : na, title = "London Session")
plot(london_enabled ? london_high : na, "London Opening Range High", color = color.yellow, style = plot.style_linebr)
plot(london_enabled ? london_low : na, "London Opening Range Low", color = color.yellow, style = plot.style_linebr)

string newyork_timezone = "America/New_York"
int newyork_start = newyork_enabled ? timestamp(newyork_timezone, year(time, newyork_timezone), month(time, newyork_timezone), dayofmonth(time, newyork_timezone), 9, 30) : 0
int newyork_end = newyork_enabled ? timestamp(newyork_timezone, year(time, newyork_timezone), month(time, newyork_timezone), dayofmonth(time, newyork_timezone), 16, 0) : 0
bool is_newyork = newyork_enabled and time >= newyork_start and time < newyork_end
float newyork_high = na
float newyork_low = na

if newyork_enabled
    [h, l] = f_get_range_in_window(newyork_start, newyork_end)
    newyork_high := h
    newyork_low := l

bgcolor(newyork_enabled and is_newyork ? color.new(color.purple, 90) : na, title = "New York Session")
plot(newyork_enabled ? newyork_high : na, "New York Opening Range High", color = color.purple, style = plot.style_linebr)
plot(newyork_enabled ? newyork_low : na, "New York Opening Range Low", color = color.purple, style = plot.style_linebr)

var line session_start_line = na
var label session_start_label = na
var line session_end_line = na
var label session_end_label = na

if next_session_enabled and barstate.islast
    line.delete(session_start_line)
    label.delete(session_start_label)
    line.delete(session_end_line)
    label.delete(session_end_label)
    start_times = array.new<int>(0)
    end_times = array.new<int>(0)
    string start_label_text = na

    if asia_enabled
        if time < asia_start
            array.push(start_times, asia_start)
        if time < asia_end
            array.push(end_times, asia_end)
    
    if london_enabled
        if time < london_start
            array.push(start_times, london_start)
        if time < london_end
            array.push(end_times, london_end)
    
    if newyork_enabled
        if time < newyork_start
            array.push(start_times, newyork_start)
        if time < newyork_end
            array.push(end_times, newyork_end)
    
    if array.size(start_times) > 0
        next_time = array.min(start_times)
        duration = next_time - timenow
        start_label_text := next_time == asia_start ? "Asia" : next_time == london_start ? "London" : "New York"
        session_start_line := line.new(next_time, low, next_time, high, xloc.bar_time, extend.both, color.new(color.white, 50), line.style_dotted)
        session_start_label := label.new(next_time, close, start_label_text + " Begins " + f_formatDurationHMS(duration), xloc.bar_time, style=label.style_label_lower_left, color=color.new(color.black, 100), size=size.small, textcolor=color.new(color.white, 50))
    
    if array.size(end_times) > 0
        next_time = array.min(end_times)
        duration = next_time - timenow
        label_text = next_time == asia_end ? "Asia" : next_time == london_end ? "London" : "New York"

        if label_text != start_label_text
            session_end_line := line.new(next_time, low, next_time, high, xloc.bar_time, extend.both, color.new(color.white, 50), line.style_dotted)
            session_end_label := label.new(next_time, close, label_text + " Ends " + f_formatDurationHMS(duration), xloc.bar_time, style=label.style_label_upper_left, color=color.new(color.black, 100), size=size.small, textcolor=color.new(color.white, 50))

//@version=5
indicator('PumpC Opening Range Breakout (ORB) Stretch Range', shorttitle='PumpC Stretch ORB', overlay=true)

// === ⚙️ ORB_Stretch Setup ===
// Constant
color CLEAR = color.rgb(0, 0, 0, 100)
// === ⚙️ ORB_Stretch Setup ===
//custom_timeframe = input.timeframe("D", "Stretch Timeframe")
// === 🔧 Core Settings
Stretch_length = input.int(10, "Stretch Length")

// === 📂 Timeframes
var GRP1 = "ORB Controls"
daily              = input.string("On", title="Daily View", options=["Off", "On"], group=GRP1)
custom_timeframe   = ("D")

// === 📐 Line + Label Settings
var GRP2 = "Lines + Label Settings"
showOne           = input.bool(false, "Show only 1 previous ORB?", group=GRP1)
showLabels        = input.bool(true,  "Show Labels", group=GRP1)
labelPosition     = input.string("Start", title="Label Position", options=["Start", "End"], group=GRP1)
Orb_Line_Width    = input.int(2,  "ORB Line Width", minval=1, group=GRP1)
Levels_Line_Width = input.int(1,  "Levels Line Width", minval=1, group=GRP1)


// === 📊 Stretch Levels
var group_levels = "Stretch Levels"

// ORB Open Highlight
color_ORB_Open = input.color(color.green, "ORB Open", inline="CurrentOpen", group=group_levels)

// --- Level 1 (Core ORB Stretch Range)
show_level_1       = input.bool(true,  "ORB Stretch Range", inline="lvl1", group=group_levels)
mult_level_1       = 1.0  // fixed, not user-input
color_level_1_plus = input.color(color.black, "+ORB", inline="lvl1", group=group_levels)
color_level_1_minus= input.color(color.black, "-ORB", inline="lvl1", group=group_levels)

// --- Level 2
show_level_2       = input.bool(true, "Level 2", inline="lvl2", group=group_levels)
mult_level_2       = input.float(0.372, "", step=0.01, inline="lvl2", group=group_levels)
color_level_2_plus = input.color(color.red, "+", inline="lvl2", group=group_levels)
color_level_2_minus= input.color(color.red, "-", inline="lvl2", group=group_levels)

// --- Level 3
show_level_3       = input.bool(true, "Level 3", inline="lvl3", group=group_levels)
mult_level_3       = input.float(0.5, "", step=0.01, inline="lvl3", group=group_levels)
color_level_3_plus = input.color(color.gray, "+", inline="lvl3", group=group_levels)
color_level_3_minus= input.color(color.gray, "-", inline="lvl3", group=group_levels)

// --- Level 4
show_level_4       = input.bool(true, "Level 4", inline="lvl4", group=group_levels)
mult_level_4       = input.float(2.0, "", step=0.01, inline="lvl4", group=group_levels)
color_level_4_plus = input.color(color.gray, "+", inline="lvl4", group=group_levels)
color_level_4_minus= input.color(color.gray, "-", inline="lvl4", group=group_levels)

// --- Level 5
show_level_5       = input.bool(true, "Level 5", inline="lvl5", group=group_levels)
mult_level_5       = input.float(3.0, "", step=0.01, inline="lvl5", group=group_levels)
color_level_5_plus = input.color(color.gray, "+", inline="lvl5", group=group_levels)
color_level_5_minus= input.color(color.gray, "-", inline="lvl5", group=group_levels)


// === 📦 Misc
_offset = 1  // keep out of grouped inputs


// Inputs



// FUNCTIONS
t = time(custom_timeframe)
TRANSPARENT = color.new(color.white, 100)

isNewbar = not na(t) and (na(t[1]) or t > t[1])

tfInMinutes(simple string tf = "") =>
    float chartTf =
      timeframe.multiplier * (
      timeframe.isseconds ? 1. / 60             :
      timeframe.isminutes ? 1.                  :
      timeframe.isdaily   ? 60. * 24            :
      timeframe.isweekly  ? 60. * 24 * 7        :
      timeframe.ismonthly ? 60. * 24 * 30.4375  : na)
    float result = tf == "" ? chartTf : request.security(syminfo.tickerid, tf, chartTf)

inTimeframe(_t) => tfInMinutes(_t) > tfInMinutes(timeframe.period)

GetPipSize() =>
    syminfo.mintick * (syminfo.type == "forex" ? 10 : 1)


// ---------- Range ----------
reso(exp, res) => request.security(syminfo.tickerid, res, exp, lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)

getData(_t, _var) =>
    o = reso(open, _t)
    h = reso(high, _t)
    l = reso(low, _t)
    c = reso(close, _t)
    show = _var != "Off" and inTimeframe(_t)
    show_candle = show and str.contains(_var, "Candle")
    _time = time(_t)
    newbar = na(_time[1]) or _time > _time[1]
    hl = _var == 'HL' or _var == 'OHLC' or _var == 'OHLC + Candle'
    oc = _var == 'OC' or _var == 'OHLC' or _var == 'OHLC + Candle'
    [o, h, l, c, show, show_candle, newbar, hl, oc]

labelPos(_tf) =>
    labelPosition == "End" ? time_close(_tf) : time


// ---------- Daily ----------
var line d_o_line = na
var line d_o1_line = na
var line d_o2_line = na
var line d_m1p_line = na
var line d_m1m_line = na
var line d_m2p_line = na
var line d_m2m_line = na
var line d_m3p_line = na
var line d_m3m_line = na
var line d_m4p_line = na
var line d_m4m_line = na
var line d_m5p_line = na
var line d_m5m_line = na

var label d_o_label = na
var label d_o1_label = na
var label d_o2_label = na
var label d_m1p_label = na
var label d_m1m_label = na
var label d_m2p_label = na
var label d_m2m_label = na
var label d_m3p_label = na
var label d_m3m_label = na
var label d_m4p_label = na
var label d_m4m_label = na
var label d_m5p_label = na
var label d_m5m_label = na



[d_o, d_h, d_l, d_c, d_show, d_show_candle, d_newbar, d_hl, d_oc] = getData("D", daily)

stretch_raw = math.min(d_h - d_o, d_o - d_l)
stretch_min_range_raw = ta.sma(stretch_raw, Stretch_length)
var float stretch_min_range = na
is_new_session = ta.change(time(custom_timeframe)) != 0
stretch_min_range := is_new_session ? stretch_min_range_raw : stretch_min_range
// === ORB Levels
Orb_high = d_o + stretch_min_range * mult_level_1
Orb_low = d_o - stretch_min_range * mult_level_1
Orb_Range = Orb_high - Orb_low
Level_two_plus = Orb_low + ( Orb_Range * mult_level_2 )
Level_two_minus = Orb_high - (Orb_Range * mult_level_2)
Level_three_plus = Orb_low + (Orb_Range * mult_level_3)
Level_three_minus = Orb_high - (Orb_Range * mult_level_3)
Level_four_plus = Orb_low + (Orb_Range * mult_level_4)
Level_four_minus = Orb_high - (Orb_Range * mult_level_4)
Level_five_plus = Orb_low + (Orb_Range * mult_level_5)
Level_five_minus = Orb_high - (Orb_Range * mult_level_5)

if d_newbar and d_show
    if showOne
        line.delete(d_o_line)
        line.delete(d_o1_line)
        line.delete(d_o2_line)
        line.delete(d_m1p_line)
        line.delete(d_m1m_line)
        line.delete(d_m2p_line)
        line.delete(d_m2m_line)
        line.delete(d_m3p_line)
        line.delete(d_m3m_line)
        line.delete(d_m4p_line)
        line.delete(d_m4m_line)
        line.delete(d_m5p_line)
        line.delete(d_m5m_line)

        label.delete(d_o_label)
        label.delete(d_o1_label)
        label.delete(d_o2_label)
        label.delete(d_m1p_label)
        label.delete(d_m1m_label)
        label.delete(d_m2p_label)
        label.delete(d_m2m_label)
        label.delete(d_m3p_label)
        label.delete(d_m3m_label)
        label.delete(d_m4p_label)
        label.delete(d_m4m_label)
        label.delete(d_m5p_label)
        label.delete(d_m5m_label)


    d_o_line := line.new(x1=time, y1=d_o, x2=time_close("D"), y2=d_o, xloc=xloc.bar_time, style=line.style_solid, color=color_ORB_Open)
    
    if show_level_1    
        d_o1_line := line.new(x1=time, y1=Orb_high, x2=time_close("D"), y2=Orb_high, xloc=xloc.bar_time, style=line.style_solid, color=color_level_1_plus, width = Orb_Line_Width)
        d_o2_line := line.new(x1=time, y1=Orb_low, x2=time_close("D"), y2=Orb_low, xloc=xloc.bar_time, style=line.style_solid, color=color_level_1_minus, width = Orb_Line_Width)
    if show_level_2 
        d_m2p_line := line.new(x1=time, y1=Level_two_plus, x2=time_close("D"), y2=Level_two_plus, xloc=xloc.bar_time, style=line.style_solid, color=color_level_2_plus, width = Levels_Line_Width)
        d_m2m_line := line.new(x1=time, y1=Level_two_minus, x2=time_close("D"), y2=Level_two_minus, xloc=xloc.bar_time, style=line.style_solid, color=color_level_2_minus, width = Levels_Line_Width)
    if show_level_3 
        d_m3p_line := line.new(x1=time, y1=Level_three_plus, x2=time_close("D"), y2=Level_three_plus, xloc=xloc.bar_time, style=line.style_solid, color=color_level_3_plus, width = Levels_Line_Width)
        d_m3m_line := line.new(x1=time, y1=Level_three_minus, x2=time_close("D"), y2=Level_three_minus, xloc=xloc.bar_time, style=line.style_solid, color=color_level_3_minus, width = Levels_Line_Width)
    if show_level_4 
        d_m4p_line := line.new(x1=time, y1=Level_four_plus, x2=time_close("D"), y2=Level_four_plus, xloc=xloc.bar_time, style=line.style_solid, color=color_level_4_plus, width = Levels_Line_Width)
        d_m4m_line := line.new(x1=time, y1=Level_four_minus, x2=time_close("D"), y2=Level_four_minus, xloc=xloc.bar_time, style=line.style_solid, color=color_level_4_minus, width = Levels_Line_Width)
    if show_level_5 
        d_m5p_line := line.new(x1=time, y1=Level_five_plus, x2=time_close("D"), y2=Level_five_plus, xloc=xloc.bar_time, style=line.style_solid, color=color_level_5_plus, width = Levels_Line_Width)
        d_m5m_line := line.new(x1=time, y1=Level_five_minus, x2=time_close("D"), y2=Level_five_minus, xloc=xloc.bar_time, style=line.style_solid, color=color_level_5_minus, width = Levels_Line_Width)

    if showLabels  and show_level_1  
        d_o1_label := label.new(x=labelPos("D"), y= Orb_high, xloc=xloc.bar_time, text="+OR [" + str.tostring(math.round(Orb_high, 2)) + "]", textcolor=color_level_1_plus, style=label.style_none, size = size.small)
        d_o2_label := label.new(x=labelPos("D"), y= Orb_low, xloc=xloc.bar_time, text="-OR [" + str.tostring(math.round(Orb_low, 2)) + "]", textcolor=color_level_1_minus, style=label.style_none, size = size.small)
    if showLabels and show_level_2
        d_m2p_label := label.new(x=labelPos("D"), y= Level_two_plus, xloc=xloc.bar_time, text="+" + str.tostring(mult_level_2) + " [" + str.tostring(math.round(Level_two_plus, 2)) + "]", textcolor=color_level_2_plus, style=label.style_none, size = size.small)
        d_m2m_label := label.new(x=labelPos("D"), y= Level_two_minus, xloc=xloc.bar_time, text="-" + str.tostring(mult_level_2) + " [" + str.tostring(math.round(Level_two_minus, 2)) + "]", textcolor=color_level_2_minus, style=label.style_none, size = size.small)
    if showLabels and show_level_3
        d_m3p_label := label.new(x=labelPos("D"), y= Level_three_plus, xloc=xloc.bar_time, text="+" + str.tostring(mult_level_3) + " [" + str.tostring(math.round(Level_three_plus, 2)) + "]", textcolor=color_level_3_plus, style=label.style_none, size = size.small)
        d_m3m_label := label.new(x=labelPos("D"), y= Level_three_minus, xloc=xloc.bar_time, text="-" + str.tostring(mult_level_3) + " [" + str.tostring(math.round(Level_three_minus, 2)) + "]", textcolor=color_level_3_minus, style=label.style_none, size = size.small)
    if showLabels and show_level_4
        d_m4p_label := label.new(x=labelPos("D"), y= Level_four_plus, xloc=xloc.bar_time, text="+" + str.tostring(mult_level_4) + " [" + str.tostring(math.round(Level_four_plus, 2)) + "]", textcolor=color_level_4_plus, style=label.style_none, size = size.small)
        d_m4m_label := label.new(x=labelPos("D"), y= Level_four_minus, xloc=xloc.bar_time, text="-" + str.tostring(mult_level_4) + " [" + str.tostring(math.round(Level_four_minus, 2)) + "]", textcolor=color_level_4_minus, style=label.style_none, size = size.small)
    if showLabels and show_level_5
        d_m5p_label := label.new(x=labelPos("D"), y= Level_five_plus, xloc=xloc.bar_time, text="+" + str.tostring(mult_level_5) + " [" + str.tostring(math.round(Level_five_plus, 2)) + "]", textcolor=color_level_5_plus, style=label.style_none, size = size.small)
        d_m5m_label := label.new(x=labelPos("D"), y= Level_five_minus, xloc=xloc.bar_time, text="-" + str.tostring(mult_level_5) + " [" + str.tostring(math.round(Level_five_minus, 2)) + "]", textcolor=color_level_5_minus, style=label.style_none, size = size.small)


// ────────────────────────────────
// Daily Levels Alerts
// ────────────────────────────────
alertcondition(ta.crossover(close, Orb_high), title="Cross Above ORB High", message="{{interval}} Price crossed Above ORB High on {{ticker}}")
alertcondition(ta.crossunder(close, Orb_low), title="Cross Below ORB Low", message="{{interval}} Price crossed Below ORB Low on {{ticker}}")

alertcondition(ta.crossover(close, Level_two_plus), title="Cross Above Level 2 +", message="{{interval}} Price crossed Above Level 2 + on {{ticker}}")
alertcondition(ta.crossunder(close, Level_two_minus), title="Cross Below Level 2 -", message="{{interval}} Price crossed Below Level 2 - on {{ticker}}")

items.source:
// This Pine Script® code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
// © vinitpandya
// @version=6
indicator("Opening Range Breakout", shorttitle="ORB v2025.05.23", overlay=true)

// Input parameters
openingRangeMinutes = input.int(30, "Opening Range Minutes", minval=5, maxval=240, step=5)
lookbackDays = input.int(20, "Lookback Days", minval=1, maxval=50)
maxBarsBack = input.int(1000, "Maximum Bars Back", minval=1, maxval=2000)

// Automatically detect market timezone from the symbol
marketTimezone = syminfo.timezone
rangeColor = input.color(color.new(color.blue, 80), "Range Color")
borderColor = input.color(color.blue, "Border Color")
midlineColor = input.color(color.purple, "Midline Color")
openingBoxColor = input.color(color.new(color.blue, 95), "Opening Range Highlight Color")
showMidline = input.bool(true, "Show Midline")
showLabels = input.bool(true, "Show Range Labels")
lineStyle = input.string("Dashed", "Line Style", options=["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"])
lineWidth = input.int(1, "Line Width", minval=1, maxval=4)
arrowDistance = input.float(0.5, "Arrow Distance (%)", minval=0.1, maxval=2.0, step=0.1)

// Convert line style selection to pine script line style
var line_style = lineStyle == "Solid" ? line.style_solid : lineStyle == "Dashed" ? line.style_dashed : line.style_dotted

// Market session parameters (9:30 AM EST)
marketOpenHour = 9
marketOpenMinute = 30
marketCloseHour = 16
chartTimeframe = timeframe.in_seconds() / 60  // Get actual chart timeframe in minutes

// Calculate number of bars needed for opening range and trading day
barsInOpeningRange = openingRangeMinutes / chartTimeframe
tradingDayMinutes = (marketCloseHour - marketOpenHour) * 60 - marketOpenMinute  // 6.5 hours minus 30 minutes
barsInTradingDay = tradingDayMinutes / chartTimeframe

// Type to store daily range data
type DailyRange
    float high
    float low
    float midpoint
    int startBar
    int endBar
    int dayEndBar
    bool rangeComplete
    line highLine
    line lowLine
    line midLine
    linefill rangeFill
    box openingBox
    label highLabel
    label lowLabel
    label midLabel

// Array to store daily ranges
var array<DailyRange> dailyRanges = array.new<DailyRange>()

// Force refresh by clearing and rebuilding data on each bar to prevent historical buffer issues
if barstate.isconfirmed
    // Clear all existing drawing objects and data
    if array.size(dailyRanges) > 0
        for i = 0 to array.size(dailyRanges) - 1
            oldRange = array.get(dailyRanges, i)
            if not na(oldRange)
                if not na(oldRange.highLine)
                    line.delete(oldRange.highLine)
                if not na(oldRange.lowLine)
                    line.delete(oldRange.lowLine)
                if not na(oldRange.midLine)
                    line.delete(oldRange.midLine)
                if not na(oldRange.rangeFill)
                    linefill.delete(oldRange.rangeFill)
                if not na(oldRange.openingBox)
                    box.delete(oldRange.openingBox)
                if not na(oldRange.highLabel)
                    label.delete(oldRange.highLabel)
                if not na(oldRange.lowLabel)
                    label.delete(oldRange.lowLabel)
                if not na(oldRange.midLabel)
                    label.delete(oldRange.midLabel)
    
    // Clear the array completely
    array.clear(dailyRanges)
    
    // Rebuild all ranges from scratch using a limited lookback
    maxLookback = math.min(lookbackDays * barsInTradingDay, maxBarsBack)  // Limit to prevent buffer overflow
    
    var float currentRangeHigh = na
    var float currentRangeLow = na
    var int currentRangeStart = na
    var bool currentRangeComplete = false
    
    // Process bars from recent history to current
    for i = math.max(0, bar_index - maxLookback) to bar_index
        if i >= 0 and i <= bar_index
            barTime = time[bar_index - i]
            barHour = hour(barTime, marketTimezone)
            barMinute = minute(barTime, marketTimezone)
            barDay = dayofmonth(barTime, marketTimezone)
            
            // Check for new trading day at this bar
            isNewDay = false
            if i == math.max(0, bar_index - maxLookback)
                isNewDay := true  // First bar we're processing
            else if i > 0
                prevBarTime = time[bar_index - (i - 1)]
                prevBarDay = dayofmonth(prevBarTime, marketTimezone)
                if barDay != prevBarDay and barHour >= marketOpenHour
                    isNewDay := true
            
            if isNewDay
                // Complete previous range if it exists
                if not na(currentRangeStart) and not na(currentRangeHigh) and not na(currentRangeLow)
                    // Create the completed range
                    completedRange = DailyRange.new(
                       currentRangeHigh,     // high
                       currentRangeLow,      // low
                       (currentRangeHigh + currentRangeLow) / 2,  // midpoint
                       currentRangeStart,    // startBar
                       currentRangeStart + barsInOpeningRange,  // endBar
                       na,                   // dayEndBar
                       true,                 // rangeComplete
                       na, na, na, na, na, na, na, na  // drawing objects (will be created later)
                       )
                    array.push(dailyRanges, completedRange)
                
                // Start new range
                currentRangeHigh := na
                currentRangeLow := na
                currentRangeStart := i
                currentRangeComplete := false
            
            // Update current range if we're within opening range period
            if not na(currentRangeStart) and not currentRangeComplete
                barsFromStart = i - currentRangeStart
                if barsFromStart < barsInOpeningRange and barsFromStart >= 0
                    barHigh = high[bar_index - i]
                    barLow = low[bar_index - i]
                    
                    if na(currentRangeHigh) or barHigh > currentRangeHigh
                        currentRangeHigh := barHigh
                    if na(currentRangeLow) or barLow < currentRangeLow
                        currentRangeLow := barLow
                else if barsFromStart >= barsInOpeningRange
                    currentRangeComplete := true
    
    // Add current incomplete range if it exists
    if not na(currentRangeStart) and not na(currentRangeHigh) and not na(currentRangeLow)
        currentRange = DailyRange.new(
           currentRangeHigh,     // high
           currentRangeLow,      // low
           (currentRangeHigh + currentRangeLow) / 2,  // midpoint
           currentRangeStart,    // startBar
           currentRangeStart + barsInOpeningRange,  // endBar
           na,                   // dayEndBar
           currentRangeComplete, // rangeComplete
           na, na, na, na, na, na, na, na  // drawing objects
           )
        array.push(dailyRanges, currentRange)
    
    // Now create all drawing objects for completed ranges
    if array.size(dailyRanges) > 0
        for i = 0 to array.size(dailyRanges) - 1
            openingRange = array.get(dailyRanges, i)
            if not na(openingRange) and openingRange.rangeComplete
                // Create lines
                lineEndX = openingRange.startBar + barsInTradingDay
                
                openingRange.highLine := line.new(
                   x1=openingRange.startBar, 
                   y1=openingRange.high, 
                   x2=lineEndX, 
                   y2=openingRange.high, 
                   color=borderColor, 
                   style=line_style, 
                   width=lineWidth
                   )
                
                openingRange.lowLine := line.new(
                   x1=openingRange.startBar, 
                   y1=openingRange.low, 
                   x2=lineEndX, 
                   y2=openingRange.low, 
                   color=borderColor, 
                   style=line_style, 
                   width=lineWidth
                   )
                
                if showMidline
                    openingRange.midLine := line.new(
                       x1=openingRange.startBar, 
                       y1=openingRange.midpoint, 
                       x2=lineEndX, 
                       y2=openingRange.midpoint, 
                       color=midlineColor, 
                       style=line_style, 
                       width=lineWidth
                       )
                
                openingRange.rangeFill := linefill.new(
                   openingRange.highLine, 
                   openingRange.lowLine, 
                   color=rangeColor
                   )
                
                openingRange.openingBox := box.new(
                   left=openingRange.startBar, 
                   top=openingRange.high, 
                   right=openingRange.endBar, 
                   bottom=openingRange.low, 
                   bgcolor=color.new(openingBoxColor, 70), 
                   border_color=color.new(borderColor, 50), 
                   border_width=1
                   )
                
                // Add labels for current day only
                if i == array.size(dailyRanges) - 1 and showLabels and bar_index == last_bar_index
                    openingRange.highLabel := label.new(
                       bar_index + 5, 
                       openingRange.high, 
                       text="OR High: " + str.tostring(openingRange.high, format.mintick), 
                       color=color.new(color.blue, 100), 
                       textcolor=borderColor, 
                       style=label.style_none
                       )
                    
                    openingRange.lowLabel := label.new(
                       bar_index + 5, 
                       openingRange.low, 
                       text="OR Low: " + str.tostring(openingRange.low, format.mintick), 
                       color=color.new(color.blue, 100), 
                       textcolor=borderColor, 
                       style=label.style_none
                       )
                    
                    if showMidline
                        openingRange.midLabel := label.new(
                           bar_index + 5, 
                           openingRange.midpoint, 
                           text="OR Mid: " + str.tostring(openingRange.midpoint, format.mintick), 
                           color=color.new(color.purple, 100), 
                           textcolor=midlineColor, 
                           style=label.style_none
                           )

// Signal detection logic
bullishCloseBreakout = false
bullishWickRejection = false
bearishCloseBreakout = false
bearishWickRejection = false

// Check for signals on completed ranges
if array.size(dailyRanges) > 0
    currentOpeningRange = array.get(dailyRanges, array.size(dailyRanges) - 1)
    if not na(currentOpeningRange) and currentOpeningRange.rangeComplete and 
       not na(currentOpeningRange.high) and not na(currentOpeningRange.low)
        
        // Close breakout signals
        closeAboveRange = close > currentOpeningRange.high
        closeBelowRange = close < currentOpeningRange.low
        
        // Wick rejection signals
        wickAboveRange = high > currentOpeningRange.high and close <= currentOpeningRange.high
        wickBelowRange = low < currentOpeningRange.low and close >= currentOpeningRange.low
        
        // Signal detection with safe historical reference
        if barstate.isconfirmed and bar_index > 0
            prevCloseAboveRange = close[1] > currentOpeningRange.high
            prevCloseBelowRange = close[1] < currentOpeningRange.low
            prevWickAboveRange = high[1] > currentOpeningRange.high and close[1] <= currentOpeningRange.high
            prevWickBelowRange = low[1] < currentOpeningRange.low and close[1] >= currentOpeningRange.low
            
            // Bullish signals
            bullishCloseBreakout := closeAboveRange and not prevCloseAboveRange
            bullishWickRejection := wickBelowRange and not prevWickBelowRange
            
            // Bearish signals
            bearishCloseBreakout := closeBelowRange and not prevCloseBelowRange
            bearishWickRejection := wickAboveRange and not prevWickAboveRange

// Plot arrows using plotchar for better positioning
plotchar(bullishCloseBreakout, char="⬆", location=location.belowbar, size=size.small, title='Bullish Close Breakout', color=color.green)
plotchar(bullishWickRejection, char="⬆", location=location.belowbar, size=size.tiny, title='Bullish Wick Rejection', color=color.green)
plotchar(bearishCloseBreakout, char="⬇", location=location.abovebar, size=size.small, title='Bearish Close Breakout', color=color.red)
plotchar(bearishWickRejection, char="⬇", location=location.abovebar, size=size.tiny, title='Bearish Wick Rejection', color=color.red)

items.name: NY Opening Range Breakout - MA Stop
items.title: NY Opening Range Breakout - MA Stop
items.author: shui2967
items.source:
//@version=5
strategy("NY Opening Range Breakout - MA Stop", overlay=true, max_bars_back=500)

// Input parameters
show_range = input.bool(true, title="Show Opening Range")
cutoff_hour = input.int(12, title="Entry Cutoff Hour (NY time)", minval=10, maxval=16)
cutoff_minute = input.int(0, title="Entry Cutoff Minute", minval=0, maxval=59)

// Trade direction
trade_direction = input.string("Long Only", title="Trade Direction", options=["Long Only", "Short Only", "Both"])

// Take profit options
tp_type = input.string("Fixed Risk Reward", title="Take Profit Type", options=["Fixed Risk Reward", "Moving Average", "Both"])
tp_ratio = input.float(2.5, title="TP Ratio (for Fixed Risk Reward option)", minval=1.0, maxval=5.0)

// Moving average inputs
ma_type = input.string("SMA", title="MA Type", options=["SMA", "EMA", "WMA", "VWMA"])
ma_length = input.int(100, title="MA Length", minval=5, maxval=200)
ma_source = input.source(close, title="MA Source")

// Variables to store range levels and exit prices
var float range_high = na
var float range_low = na
var bool range_set = false
var bool long_breakout_occurred = false
var bool short_breakout_occurred = false
var int range_day = na
var float long_entry_stop_loss = na
var float long_entry_take_profit = na
var float short_entry_stop_loss = na
var float short_entry_take_profit = na

// Calculate moving average
get_ma() =>
    switch ma_type
        "SMA" => ta.sma(ma_source, ma_length)
        "EMA" => ta.ema(ma_source, ma_length)
        "WMA" => ta.wma(ma_source, ma_length)
        "VWMA" => ta.vwma(ma_source, ma_length)
        => ta.ema(ma_source, ma_length)

ma_value = get_ma()

// Calculate take profit levels for plotting
long_tp_level = strategy.position_size > 0 and not na(long_entry_take_profit) ? long_entry_take_profit : na
short_tp_level = strategy.position_size < 0 and not na(short_entry_take_profit) ? short_entry_take_profit : na

// ALL PLOTS MUST BE HERE AT GLOBAL SCOPE
range_high_plot = plot(range_set ? range_high : na, color=color.red, linewidth=2, title="Range High")
range_low_plot = plot(range_set ? range_low : na, color=color.green, linewidth=2, title="Range Low")
fill(range_high_plot, range_low_plot, color=color.new(color.blue, 90), title="Opening Range")
plot(ma_value, color=color.purple, linewidth=2, title="Moving Average")
plot(long_tp_level, color=color.lime, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_line, title="Long Take Profit")
plot(short_tp_level, color=color.red, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_line, title="Short Take Profit")
plot(strategy.position_size > 0 and not na(long_entry_stop_loss) ? long_entry_stop_loss : na, color=color.red, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_line, title="Long Stop Loss")
plot(strategy.position_size < 0 and not na(short_entry_stop_loss) ? short_entry_stop_loss : na, color=color.lime, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_line, title="Short Stop Loss")

// Function to check if we're in NY opening range (9:30-9:45)
in_ny_range() =>
    t = time(timeframe.period, "0930-0945", "America/New_York")
    not na(t)

// Function to check if we're past cutoff time
past_cutoff() =>
    current_time = time(timeframe.period, "0000-2359", "America/New_York")
    hour_now = hour(current_time, "America/New_York")
    minute_now = minute(current_time, "America/New_York")
    
    cutoff_minutes = cutoff_hour * 60 + cutoff_minute
    current_minutes = hour_now * 60 + minute_now
    
    current_minutes >= cutoff_minutes

// Reset daily variables at start of new trading day
new_day = ta.change(time("1D"))
if new_day
    range_high := na
    range_low := na
    range_set := false
    long_breakout_occurred := false
    short_breakout_occurred := false
    range_day := na

// Capture the opening range during 9:30-9:45 NY time
if in_ny_range()
    if na(range_high) or na(range_low) or range_day != dayofmonth
        range_high := high
        range_low := low
        range_day := dayofmonth
        range_set := false
    else
        range_high := math.max(range_high, high)
        range_low := math.min(range_low, low)

// Mark range as complete when we exit the opening range session
if not in_ny_range() and not na(range_high) and not na(range_low) and not range_set and range_day == dayofmonth
    range_set := true

// Entry conditions for LONG
prev_candle_long_breakout = range_set and close[1] > range_high and not long_breakout_occurred and not past_cutoff() and (trade_direction == "Long Only" or trade_direction == "Both")

// Entry conditions for SHORT
prev_candle_short_breakout = range_set and close[1] < range_low and not short_breakout_occurred and not past_cutoff() and (trade_direction == "Short Only" or trade_direction == "Both")

// Mark breakouts occurred
if prev_candle_long_breakout
    long_breakout_occurred := true

if prev_candle_short_breakout
    short_breakout_occurred := true

// MA filters
long_ma_filter_ok = true
short_ma_filter_ok = true

if tp_type == "Moving Average" or tp_type == "Both"
    long_ma_filter_ok := close > ma_value
    short_ma_filter_ok := close < ma_value

// Entry conditions
long_entry_condition = range_set and ta.barssince(prev_candle_long_breakout) == 0 and not past_cutoff() and strategy.position_size == 0 and long_ma_filter_ok
short_entry_condition = range_set and ta.barssince(prev_candle_short_breakout) == 0 and not past_cutoff() and strategy.position_size == 0 and short_ma_filter_ok

// Execute LONG trades
if long_entry_condition
    entry_price = close
    risk_per_share = entry_price - range_low
    calculated_tp = entry_price + (risk_per_share * tp_ratio)
    
    // Store the exit levels
    long_entry_stop_loss := range_low
    long_entry_take_profit := calculated_tp
    
    strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long)
    
    // Set exits based on TP type
    if tp_type == "Fixed Risk Reward"
        strategy.exit("Exit Long", "Long", stop=long_entry_stop_loss, limit=long_entry_take_profit)
    else if tp_type == "Moving Average"
        strategy.exit("Exit Long", "Long", stop=long_entry_stop_loss)
    else if tp_type == "Both"
        strategy.exit("Exit Long", "Long", stop=long_entry_stop_loss, limit=long_entry_take_profit)

// Execute SHORT trades
if short_entry_condition
    entry_price = close
    risk_per_share = range_high - entry_price
    calculated_tp = entry_price - (risk_per_share * tp_ratio)
    
    // Store the exit levels
    short_entry_stop_loss := range_high
    short_entry_take_profit := calculated_tp
    
    strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short)
    
    // Set exits based on TP type
    if tp_type == "Fixed Risk Reward"
        strategy.exit("Exit Short", "Short", stop=short_entry_stop_loss, limit=short_entry_take_profit)
    else if tp_type == "Moving Average"
        strategy.exit("Exit Short", "Short", stop=short_entry_stop_loss)
    else if tp_type == "Both"
        strategy.exit("Exit Short", "Short", stop=short_entry_stop_loss, limit=short_entry_take_profit)

// Manual exit logic for Moving Average TP type (since MA is dynamic)
if strategy.position_size > 0 and (tp_type == "Moving Average" or tp_type == "Both")
    if close < ma_value
        strategy.close("Long", comment="MA Exit")

if strategy.position_size < 0 and (tp_type == "Moving Average" or tp_type == "Both")
    if close > ma_value
        strategy.close("Short", comment="MA Exit")

// Visual indicators
plotshape(prev_candle_long_breakout, style=shape.triangleup, location=location.belowbar, 
          color=color.lime, size=size.small, title="Long Breakout Signal")
plotshape(prev_candle_short_breakout, style=shape.triangledown, location=location.abovebar, 
          color=color.red, size=size.small, title="Short Breakout Signal")
plotshape(long_entry_condition, style=shape.circle, location=location.belowbar, 
          color=color.green, size=size.normal, title="Long Entry Signal")
plotshape(short_entry_condition, style=shape.circle, location=location.abovebar, 
          color=color.maroon, size=size.normal, title="Short Entry Signal")

// Information table
if show_range and range_set
    var table info_table = table.new(position.top_right, 2, 10, bgcolor=color.white, border_width=1)
    table.cell(info_table, 0, 0, "Timeframe", text_color=color.black)
    table.cell(info_table, 1, 0, timeframe.period, text_color=color.blue)
    table.cell(info_table, 0, 1, "Trade Direction", text_color=color.black)
    table.cell(info_table, 1, 1, trade_direction, text_color=color.blue)
    table.cell(info_table, 0, 2, "Range High", text_color=color.black)
    table.cell(info_table, 1, 2, str.tostring(range_high, "#.##"), text_color=color.red)
    table.cell(info_table, 0, 3, "Range Low", text_color=color.black)
    table.cell(info_table, 1, 3, str.tostring(range_low, "#.##"), text_color=color.green)
    table.cell(info_table, 0, 4, "Range Size", text_color=color.black)
    table.cell(info_table, 1, 4, str.tostring(range_high - range_low, "#.##"), text_color=color.blue)
    table.cell(info_table, 0, 5, "TP Type", text_color=color.black)
    table.cell(info_table, 1, 5, tp_type, text_color=color.purple)
    table.cell(info_table, 0, 6, "MA Type", text_color=color.black)
    table.cell(info_table, 1, 6, ma_type + "(" + str.tostring(ma_length) + ")", text_color=color.purple)
    table.cell(info_table, 0, 7, "Current MA", text_color=color.black)
    table.cell(info_table, 1, 7, str.tostring(ma_value, "#.##"), text_color=color.purple)
    table.cell(info_table, 0, 8, "Long MA Filter", text_color=color.black)
    table.cell(info_table, 1, 8, long_ma_filter_ok ? "PASS" : "FAIL", text_color=long_ma_filter_ok ? color.green : color.red)
    table.cell(info_table, 0, 9, "Position", text_color=color.black)
    position_text = strategy.position_size > 0 ? "LONG" : strategy.position_size < 0 ? "SHORT" : "NONE"
    position_color = strategy.position_size > 0 ? color.green : strategy.position_size < 0 ? color.red : color.gray
    table.cell(info_table, 1, 9, position_text, text_color=position_color)

// ║   ORB — Opening Range Breakout                               ║
