//@version=6
indicator("ORB — Opening Range Breakout [LliterH]", overlay = true, max_lines_count = 500, max_labels_count = 500)

// ============================================================
// █ LliterH — Inputs █
// ============================================================
GRP_CORE    = "Core Settings"
GRP_FILTER  = "Breakout Filters"
GRP_DISPLAY = "UX / Interface"
GRP_CLR     = "Color Palette"

string sessionInput    = input.session("0930-0945",        title = "Opening Range Session",                       tooltip = "Time window used to build the ORB high and low.",                                                                                    group = GRP_CORE)
string timezoneInput   = input.string("America/New_York",  title = "Timezone",                                    options = ["America/New_York", "America/Chicago", "America/Los_Angeles", "America/Sao_Paulo", "Europe/London", "Europe/Frankfurt", "Europe/Madrid", "Asia/Tokyo", "Asia/Hong_Kong", "Asia/Dubai", "Australia/Sydney"], tooltip = "Select the exchange or city closest to your market.", group = GRP_CORE)
int    signalWindowMin = input.int(60,                     title = "Signal Window (minutes after ORB close)",     minval = 0, maxval = 480, step = 15,  tooltip = "How many minutes after the ORB session ends the indicator is allowed to fire. Set to 0 to disable.", group = GRP_CORE)
float  minRangePips    = input.float(5.0,                  title = "Minimum ORB Range (points)",                  minval = 0.0, maxval = 10000.0, step = 0.5, tooltip = "Sessions where ORB high minus ORB low is smaller than this value are skipped.",           group = GRP_FILTER)
bool   requireClose    = input.bool(true,                  title = "Require candle close beyond ORB level",       tooltip = "When enabled, a breakout is confirmed only when a candle fully closes above ORB High or below ORB Low.",                               group = GRP_FILTER)
bool   showDashboard   = input.bool(true,                  title = "Show Dashboard",                              tooltip = "Toggle the information panel in the top-right corner.",                                                                               group = GRP_DISPLAY)
color  colorBox        = input.color(color.new(#42A5F5, 90), title = "ORB Box Color",                             tooltip = "Fill color for the Opening Range zone during the session.",                                                                           group = GRP_CLR)
color  colorUp         = input.color(color.new(#26c6da, 0),  title = "Bullish Color (Teal)",                      tooltip = "Color used for buy entries and bullish signals.",                                                                                     group = GRP_CLR)
color  colorDown       = input.color(color.new(#ef5350, 0),  title = "Bearish Color (Red)",                       tooltip = "Color used for sell entries and bearish signals.",                                                                                    group = GRP_CLR)

// ============================================================
// █ LliterH — Core Logic █
// ============================================================

// --- Session & Calendar Detection ---
bool inSession  = not na(time(timeframe.period, sessionInput, timezoneInput))
bool isFirstBar = inSession and not inSession[1]
bool isLastBar  = not inSession and inSession[1]
bool isNewDay   = dayofmonth != dayofmonth[1]

// --- Opening Range Construction ---
var float orHigh       = na
var float orLow        = na
var int   orbCloseTime = na

if isFirstBar
    orHigh       := high
    orLow        := low
    orbCloseTime := na
else if inSession
    orHigh := math.max(orHigh, high)
    orLow  := math.min(orLow, low)

if isLastBar
    orbCloseTime := time

// --- Signal Window ---
float minutesSinceClose = na(orbCloseTime) ? na : (time - orbCloseTime) / 60000.0
bool  withinWindow      = signalWindowMin == 0 ? true : (not na(minutesSinceClose) and minutesSinceClose <= signalWindowMin)

// --- Range Quality ---
float orbRange    = orHigh - orLow
bool  rangeIsWide = orbRange >= minRangePips

// --- State Machine ---
var int signal_state = 0

if isNewDay
    signal_state := 0

bool rawBreakoutUp   = requireClose ? (close[1] > orHigh and not inSession) : (ta.crossover(close, orHigh)  and not inSession)
bool rawBreakoutDown = requireClose ? (close[1] < orLow  and not inSession) : (ta.crossunder(close, orLow)  and not inSession)

bool breakoutUp   = rawBreakoutUp   and signal_state == 0  and rangeIsWide and withinWindow
bool breakoutDown = rawBreakoutDown and signal_state == 0  and rangeIsWide and withinWindow
bool exitLong     = rawBreakoutDown and signal_state == 1  and rangeIsWide and withinWindow
bool exitShort    = rawBreakoutUp   and signal_state == -1 and rangeIsWide and withinWindow

if breakoutUp
    signal_state := 1
if breakoutDown
    signal_state := -1
if exitLong
    signal_state := -1
if exitShort
    signal_state := 1

// ============================================================
// █ LliterH — Visuals █
// ============================================================
p_high = plot(orHigh, color = inSession ? na : color.new(color.gray, 50), style = plot.style_circles, title = "ORB High")
p_low  = plot(orLow,  color = inSession ? na : color.new(color.gray, 50), style = plot.style_circles, title = "ORB Low")

p_boxHigh = plot(inSession ? orHigh : na, color = na, editable = false)
p_boxLow  = plot(inSession ? orLow  : na, color = na, editable = false)
fill(p_boxHigh, p_boxLow, color = colorBox, title = "ORB Zone")

plot(ta.ema(close, 200), color = color.new(color.gray, 40), linewidth = 1, title = "EMA 200")

// Entry labels
plotshape(breakoutUp,   style = shape.labelup,   location = location.belowbar, color = colorUp,                      size = size.small, title = "BUY Entry",  text = "BUY",  textcolor = color.white)
plotshape(breakoutDown, style = shape.labeldown,  location = location.abovebar, color = colorDown,                    size = size.small, title = "SELL Entry", text = "SELL", textcolor = color.white)

// Exit labels — semi-transparent to distinguish from entries
plotshape(exitLong,  style = shape.labeldown, location = location.abovebar, color = color.new(colorDown, 40), size = size.tiny, title = "Exit Long",  text = "EXIT", textcolor = color.white)
plotshape(exitShort, style = shape.labelup,   location = location.belowbar, color = color.new(colorUp,   40), size = size.tiny, title = "Exit Short", text = "EXIT", textcolor = color.white)

// ============================================================
// █ LliterH — Dashboard █
// ============================================================
var table dash = table.new(position.top_right, 2, 4, bgcolor = color.new(color.black, 62), border_width = 1, border_color = color.new(color.gray, 65))

if showDashboard and barstate.islast
    table.cell(dash, 0, 0, "ORB Status",  text_color = color.new(color.gray, 0), text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 1, "Range",        text_color = color.new(color.gray, 0), text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 2, "Window",       text_color = color.new(color.gray, 0), text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 3, "Signal State", text_color = color.new(color.gray, 0), text_size = size.small)

    string orbStatus = inSession ? "FORMING" : close > orHigh ? "ABOVE" : close < orLow ? "BELOW" : "INSIDE"
    color  orbColor  = inSession ? color.yellow : close > orHigh ? colorUp : close < orLow ? colorDown : color.white
    table.cell(dash, 1, 0, orbStatus, text_color = orbColor, text_size = size.small)

    string rangeText  = str.tostring(orbRange, "#.##") + (rangeIsWide ? " OK" : " SKIP")
    color  rangeColor = rangeIsWide ? colorUp : color.gray
    table.cell(dash, 1, 1, rangeText, text_color = rangeColor, text_size = size.small)

    string windowText  = signalWindowMin == 0 ? "unlimited" : withinWindow ? str.tostring(math.round(minutesSinceClose)) + "/" + str.tostring(signalWindowMin) + " min" : "CLOSED"
    color  windowColor = signalWindowMin == 0 ? color.gray : withinWindow ? colorUp : colorDown
    table.cell(dash, 1, 2, windowText, text_color = windowColor, text_size = size.small)

    string stateText  = signal_state ==  1 ? "LONG  active" : signal_state == -1 ? "SHORT active" : "waiting"
    color  stateColor = signal_state ==  1 ? colorUp : signal_state == -1 ? colorDown : color.gray
    table.cell(dash, 1, 3, stateText, text_color = stateColor, text_size = size.small)

// ============================================================
// █ LliterH — Alerts █
// ============================================================
alertcondition(breakoutUp,   title = "LliterH — ORB — BUY Entry",   message = "{{ticker}} | {{interval}} | ORB — BUY entry confirmed. First bullish breakout of the day within signal window. | Price: {{close}}")
alertcondition(breakoutDown, title = "LliterH — ORB — SELL Entry",  message = "{{ticker}} | {{interval}} | ORB — SELL entry confirmed. First bearish breakout of the day within signal window. | Price: {{close}}")
alertcondition(exitLong,     title = "LliterH — ORB — Exit Long",   message = "{{ticker}} | {{interval}} | ORB — Exit LONG. Opposite breakout confirmed. | Price: {{close}}")
alertcondition(exitShort,    title = "LliterH — ORB — Exit Short",  message = "{{ticker}} | {{interval}} | ORB — Exit SHORT. Opposite breakout confirmed. | Price: {{close}}")

items.title: Chews Opening Range Breakout - Fib
items.author: ChewMeHarder
items.source:
//@version=5
indicator('Chews Opening Range Breakout - Fib', shorttitle="Cs fORB ", overlay=true)


loss_factor = input.float(0.5, options=[0, 0.236, 0.328, 0.5, 0.618, 0.786, 1], title="Fib-based Percentage to Risk", group="Details")
do_both = input.bool(true, title="Double-Sided fORB?", group="Details")

wicks = input.bool(true, title="Consider Wicks in Fibonacci?", group="Wicks")
take_candle = input.bool(false, title="Take the Candle w/out Wicks", group="Wicks")

entry_color = input.color(color.white, title="Entry Color", group="Colors")
buy_color = input.color(color.black, title="Take Profit Color", group="Colors")
sell_color = input.color(color.yellow, title="Stoploss Color", group="Colors")

bck_buy = input.color(color.olive, title="Background Color for Profit", group="Background Colors")
bck_buy_transp = input.int(80, title="Background Color Profit Transparency", minval=0, maxval=100, group="Background Colors")
bck_sell = input.color(color.red, title="Background Color for Stoploss", group="Background Colors")
bck_sell_transp = input.int(80, title="Background Color Stoploss Transparency", minval=0, maxval=100, group="Background Colors")

ghost_bars = input.bool(true, title="High/Low Ghost Bars?", group="Ghost Lines")
ghost_high_color = input.color(color.white, title="High Line Color", group="Ghost Lines")
ghost_low_color = input.color(color.white, title="Low Line Color", group="Ghost Lines")

wdth = input.int(2, title="Line Width", minval=0, step=1, group="Line Dimensions")
ghost_wdth = input.int(1, title="Ghost Line Width", minval=0, step=1, group="Line Dimensions")


t = time('1440', session.regular)  // 1440=60*24 is the number of minutes in a whole day. You may use "0930-1600" as second session parameter
is_first = na(t[1]) and not na(t) or t[1] < t

// Setup global variables
var second_index = 0
var high_of_breakout = 0.0
var low_of_breakout = 0.0
var line ghost_high_line = na
var line ghost_low_line = na
var ghost_x2 = 0

isNewDay = time("D") != time("D")[1]
if isNewDay
    second_index := bar_index + 1
    //label.new(bar_index, high, text="First bar", textcolor=entry_color)
    ghost_high_line := line.new(bar_index, high, na, high, color=color.new(ghost_high_color, 50), style=line.style_dashed, width=ghost_wdth)
    ghost_low_line := line.new(bar_index, low, na, low, color=color.new(ghost_low_color, 50), style=line.style_dashed, width=ghost_wdth)


// enter strategy on new 
else if bar_index == second_index  
    // update ghost line levels
    high_of_breakout := high[1]
    low_of_breakout := low[1]
    // setup variables for ORB
    float entry = close[1]
    float fib_retracement_stop = 0
    float profit_wanted = 0
    // configure wick logic
    if wicks
        fib_retracement_stop := math.abs(high[1] - low[1])
    else 
        fib_retracement_stop := math.abs(close[1] - open[1])
    // configure candle logic
    if take_candle
        profit_wanted := math.abs(close[1] - open[1])
    else 
        profit_wanted := math.abs(high[1] - low[1])    
    
    // check if previous bar was green (LONG)
    if close[1] >= open[1] or do_both
        // configure wick variables
        if wicks 
            entry := high[1]
        
        // entry
        entry_line = line.new(second_index - 1, entry, second_index, entry, width=wdth, color=entry_color)
        // exit
        exit_line = line.new(second_index - 1, entry + profit_wanted, second_index, entry + profit_wanted, width=wdth, color=buy_color)
        // stoploss
        stop_line = line.new(second_index - 1, entry - (fib_retracement_stop * (1 - loss_factor)), second_index, entry - (fib_retracement_stop * (1 - loss_factor)), width=wdth, color=sell_color)

        linefill.new(entry_line, exit_line, color.new(bck_buy, bck_buy_transp))
        linefill.new(entry_line, stop_line, color.new(bck_sell, bck_sell_transp))

        //label.new(second_index-3, low[1], text="Entry: " + str.tostring(math.round(entry, 2)) + "\nExit: " + str.tostring(math.round(entry + profit_wanted, 2)) + "\nStoploss: " + str.tostring(math.round(entry - (fib_retracement_stop * (1 - loss_factor)), 2)), style=label.style_label_up, textcolor=entry_color)
        label.new(second_index-2, high[1], text="Entry: " + str.tostring(math.round(entry, 2)) + "\nExit: " + str.tostring(math.round(entry + profit_wanted, 2)) + "\nStoploss: " + str.tostring(math.round(entry - (fib_retracement_stop * (1 - loss_factor)), 2)) + " ", style=label.style_label_right, textcolor=entry_color)

    // check if previous bar was red (SHORT)
    if open[1] >= close[1] or do_both
        // configure wick variables
        if wicks
            entry := low[1]

        // entry
        entry_line = line.new(second_index - 1, entry, second_index, entry, width=wdth, color=entry_color)
        // exit
        exit_line = line.new(second_index - 1, entry - profit_wanted, second_index, entry - profit_wanted, width=wdth, color=buy_color)
        // stoploss
        stop_line = line.new(second_index - 1, entry + (fib_retracement_stop * (1 - loss_factor)), second_index, entry + (fib_retracement_stop * (1 - loss_factor)), width=wdth, color=sell_color)

        linefill.new(entry_line, exit_line, color.new(bck_buy, bck_buy_transp))
        linefill.new(entry_line, stop_line, color.new(bck_sell, bck_sell_transp))

        //label.new(second_index-3, high[1], text="Entry: " + str.tostring(math.round(entry, 2)) + "\nExit: " + str.tostring(math.round(entry - profit_wanted, 2)) + "\nStoploss: " + str.tostring(math.round(entry + (fib_retracement_stop * (1 - loss_factor)), 2)), textcolor=entry_color)
        label.new(second_index-2, low[1], text="Entry: " + str.tostring(math.round(entry, 2)) + "\nExit: " + str.tostring(math.round(entry - profit_wanted, 2)) + "\nStoploss: " + str.tostring(math.round(entry + (fib_retracement_stop * (1 - loss_factor)), 2)) + " ", style=label.style_label_right, textcolor=entry_color)

// Draw Ghost Lines
if ghost_bars
    // keep drawing at the current bar
    line.set_x2(ghost_high_line, bar_index)
    line.set_x2(ghost_low_line, bar_index)

items.source:
// This Pine Script® code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
// © Darkmatter513
//@version=5
indicator("NeuraEdge ORB", overlay=true, max_labels_count=500, max_lines_count=500, max_boxes_count=500, max_bars_back=5000)

//═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// INPUTS
//═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

g_display = "📊 Display"
showSignals    = input.bool(true,  "Show Signals",            group=g_display)
showORBox      = input.bool(true,  "Show Opening Range Box",  group=g_display)
showPastBoxes  = input.bool(true,  "Show Past ORB Boxes",     group=g_display, tooltip="Show historical ORB boxes from previous sessions (up to 5 days back).")
pastBoxCount   = input.int(3,      "Past Boxes to Show",      group=g_display, minval=1, maxval=5)

showDashboard  = input.bool(true,  "Show Dashboard",          group=g_display)

g_orb = "⏰ Opening Range Settings"
sessionTZ    = input.string("America/New_York","Session Timezone", options=["America/New_York","Europe/London","Asia/Kolkata","Etc/UTC"], group=g_orb, tooltip="Timezone used to define the ORB session window + cutoff.")
sessionStart = input.session("0930-0945", "Opening Range Session", group=g_orb, tooltip="Define ORB window in the chosen Session Timezone.")
tradingEnd   = input.int(15, "Stop Trading After (Hour in Session TZ)", minval=0, maxval=23, group=g_orb, tooltip="Stop taking NEW trades after this hour (15 = 3PM).")

g_mode = "🧠 ORB Mode Engine"
orbMode      = input.string("Default ORB (Retest)", "ORB Mode", options=["Auto","Default ORB (Retest)","Inverse ORB (Fade Wide)","Pre-empt ORB (Trend)"], group=g_mode, tooltip="Auto: Wide ORB => Inverse | HTF Trend => Pre-empt | Else => Default retest")
wideORB_ATR  = input.float(1.5, "Wide ORB Threshold (x ATR)", minval=0.3, step=0.1, group=g_mode, tooltip="If OR range > ATR * this value, Auto mode switches to Inverse ORB.")

htfTf          = input.timeframe("60", "HTF Timeframe",   group=g_mode)
emaFastLen     = input.int(21,  "HTF EMA Fast",             group=g_mode)
emaSlowLen     = input.int(50,  "HTF EMA Slow",             group=g_mode)
minTrendSepATR = input.float(0.15, "Min EMA Separation (x ATR)", minval=0.0, step=0.05, group=g_mode, tooltip="Avoid pre-empt in chop: require EMA separation > ATR * value.")

g_entry = "🎯 Entry Settings"
entryType     = input.string("Retest", "Entry Type", options=["Breakout","Retest"], group=g_entry, tooltip="Breakout: Enter immediately on break\nRetest: Wait for pullback to range")
requireVolume = input.bool(true, "Require Volume Confirmation", group=g_entry)

g_inverse = "↩️ Inverse ORB Settings"
fadeBufferATR = input.float(0.10, "Fade Trigger Buffer (x ATR)", minval=0.0, step=0.05, group=g_inverse, tooltip="How close price must get to OR high/low to trigger fade.")
fadeConfirm   = input.string("Reject Close", "Fade Confirmation", options=["None","Reject Close","Wick Reject"], group=g_inverse)

g_preempt = "⚡ Pre-empt ORB Settings"
preemptBufferATR = input.float(0.10, "Pre-empt Entry Buffer (x ATR)", minval=0.0, step=0.05, group=g_preempt)
confirmBarsLimit = input.int(30, "Max Bars to Get Confirmation", minval=5, group=g_preempt, tooltip="After a pre-empt entry, watch for ORB confirmation within N bars.")

g_confluence = "📌 Confluences"
useEMAFilter     = input.bool(true,  "Use EMA Filter",              group=g_confluence)
emaLen           = input.int(20,     "EMA Length",                  group=g_confluence)
useVWAPFilter    = input.bool(true,  "Use VWAP Filter",             group=g_confluence)
useVWAPDevFilter = input.bool(false, "Use VWAP Deviation Band Filter", group=g_confluence)
devLen           = input.int(50,     "VWAP Dev Length",             group=g_confluence)
devMult          = input.float(1.0,  "VWAP Dev Mult", step=0.25,   group=g_confluence)

g_risk = "💰 Risk Management"
slType    = input.string("Opposite Side", "Stop Loss Placement", options=["Opposite Side","Midpoint","ATR Based"], group=g_risk)
rrRatio   = input.float(1.5, "Risk:Reward Ratio", minval=1.0, maxval=5.0, step=0.5, group=g_risk)

//═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// COLORS
//═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

bullColor = #00E676
bearColor = #FF5252
orbColor  = #2196F3

//═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// TIME & SESSION
//═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

sessHour   = hour(time, sessionTZ)
sessMinute = minute(time, sessionTZ)

inOpeningRange = not na(time(timeframe.period, sessionStart, sessionTZ))
max_bars_back(time, 1500)
max_bars_back(inOpeningRange, 1500)
isFirstORBar   = inOpeningRange and not inOpeningRange[1]
orbEnded       = not inOpeningRange and inOpeningRange[1]
inTradingHours = sessHour < tradingEnd and not inOpeningRange

newDay = ta.change(time("D")) != 0

//═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// OPENING RANGE (Current Day)
//═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

var float orHigh     = na
var float orLow      = na
var float orMid      = na
var int   orStartBar = na
var int   orEndBar   = na
var bool  orComplete = false
var bool  brokenUp   = false
var bool  brokenDown = false

if newDay
    orHigh     := na
    orLow      := na
    orMid      := na
    orStartBar := na
    orEndBar   := na
    orComplete := false
    brokenUp   := false
    brokenDown := false

if inOpeningRange
    if isFirstORBar
        orHigh     := high
        orLow      := low
        orStartBar := bar_index
    else
        orHigh := math.max(orHigh, high)
        orLow  := math.min(orLow, low)

if orbEnded and not orComplete
    orComplete := true
    orMid      := (orHigh + orLow) / 2.0
    orEndBar   := bar_index

orRange = orComplete ? (orHigh - orLow) : na
atr     = ta.atr(14)

//═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// PAST ORB BOXES (Historical Sessions)
//═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// Store completed ORB sessions as we go
type ORBSession
    float hi
    float lo
    float mid
    int   startBar
    int   endBar

var array<ORBSession> pastSessions = array.new<ORBSession>()

// When today's OR completes, snapshot it into history
if orComplete and orbEnded
    s = ORBSession.new()
    s.hi       := orHigh
    s.lo       := orLow
    s.mid      := orMid
    s.startBar := orStartBar
    s.endBar   := orEndBar
    // Keep only the last N sessions
    if array.size(pastSessions) >= pastBoxCount
        array.shift(pastSessions)
    array.push(pastSessions, s)

// Draw past session boxes once at barstate.islast to avoid redraw overhead
var array<box>  pastBoxes     = array.new<box>()
var array<line> pastMidLines  = array.new<line>()

if showORBox and showPastBoxes and barstate.islast
    // Clear previous past drawings
    for b in pastBoxes
        box.delete(b)
    array.clear(pastBoxes)
    for l in pastMidLines
        line.delete(l)
    array.clear(pastMidLines)

    sz = array.size(pastSessions)
    if sz > 0
        for i = 0 to sz - 1
            s     = array.get(pastSessions, i)
            // Fade older sessions more
            alpha = 92 + (sz - 1 - i) * 2  // older = more transparent
            alpha := math.min(alpha, 95)
            bClr  = color.new(orbColor, alpha)
            bBdr  = color.new(orbColor, 70)
            b = box.new(s.startBar, s.hi, s.endBar + 5, s.lo,
                 border_color=bBdr, border_width=1,
                 bgcolor=bClr)
            array.push(pastBoxes, b)
            ml = line.new(s.startBar, s.mid, s.endBar + 5, s.mid,
                 color=color.new(color.gray, 60),
                 style=line.style_dotted, width=1)
            array.push(pastMidLines, ml)

//═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// HTF TREND
//═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

htfEmaFast = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, htfTf, ta.ema(close, emaFastLen), barmerge.gaps_off, barmerge.lookahead_off)
htfEmaSlow = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, htfTf, ta.ema(close, emaSlowLen), barmerge.gaps_off, barmerge.lookahead_off)

emaSepOK  = math.abs(htfEmaFast - htfEmaSlow) > atr * minTrendSepATR
trendUp   = (htfEmaFast > htfEmaSlow) and emaSepOK
trendDn   = (htfEmaFast < htfEmaSlow) and emaSepOK

isWideORB = orComplete and (orRange > atr * wideORB_ATR)

modeResolved = orbMode
if orbMode == "Auto"
    modeResolved := isWideORB ? "Inverse ORB (Fade Wide)" : ((trendUp or trendDn) ? "Pre-empt ORB (Trend)" : "Default ORB (Retest)")

//═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// FVG LOGIC — Pretty Box Rendering
//═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// FVG logic only — no visual rendering, used purely for signal confluence bonus
type FVG
    float top
    float bottom
    bool  bullish
    int   bar
    bool  filled

var array<FVG> fvgArray = array.new<FVG>()

// Reset FVG array each new day so only current session FVGs are considered
if newDay
    array.clear(fvgArray)

// Higher threshold to filter noise — only meaningful gaps
minFVGSize = atr * 0.5
bullishFVG = low > high[2] and (low - high[2]) > minFVGSize
bearishFVG = high < low[2] and (low[2] - high) > minFVGSize

if bullishFVG
    fvg         = FVG.new()
    fvg.top     := low
    fvg.bottom  := high[2]
    fvg.bullish := true
    fvg.bar     := bar_index - 1
    fvg.filled  := false
    if array.size(fvgArray) >= 10
        array.shift(fvgArray)
    array.push(fvgArray, fvg)

if bearishFVG
    fvg         = FVG.new()
    fvg.top     := low[2]
    fvg.bottom  := high
    fvg.bullish := false
    fvg.bar     := bar_index - 1
    fvg.filled  := false
    if array.size(fvgArray) >= 10
        array.shift(fvgArray)
    array.push(fvgArray, fvg)

// Mark FVGs as filled when price taps the midpoint
szF = array.size(fvgArray)
if szF > 0
    for i = szF - 1 to 0
        fvg    = array.get(fvgArray, i)
        fvgMid = (fvg.top + fvg.bottom) / 2.0
        if not fvg.filled
            if fvg.bullish and low <= fvgMid
                fvg.filled := true
            if not fvg.bullish and high >= fvgMid
                fvg.filled := true

f_hasFVGConfluence(bool forLong) =>
    hasConfluence = false
    sz = array.size(fvgArray)
    if sz > 0
        for i = sz - 1 to 0
            fvg = array.get(fvgArray, i)
            if not fvg.filled and (bar_index - fvg.bar) < 100
                if forLong and fvg.bullish
                    hasConfluence := true
                    break
                if not forLong and not fvg.bullish
                    hasConfluence := true
                    break
    hasConfluence

bullishFVGPresent = f_hasFVGConfluence(true)
bearishFVGPresent = f_hasFVGConfluence(false)

//═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// CONFLUENCES (EMA / VWAP / VWAP DEV)
//═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

avgVol   = ta.sma(volume, 20)
highVolume = volume > avgVol * 1.2
volumeOK = not requireVolume or highVolume

ema          = ta.ema(close, emaLen)
emaOkLong    = not useEMAFilter or close > ema
emaOkShort   = not useEMAFilter or close < ema

vwap         = ta.vwap(hlc3)
vwapOkLong   = not useVWAPFilter or close > vwap
vwapOkShort  = not useVWAPFilter or close < vwap

dev          = ta.stdev(hlc3 - vwap, devLen)
vwapUp       = vwap + dev * devMult
vwapDn       = vwap - dev * devMult

vwapDevOkLong  = not useVWAPDevFilter or close <= vwapUp
vwapDevOkShort = not useVWAPDevFilter or close >= vwapDn

// Standard confluence (used by Default + Pre-empt modes)
confluenceLongOK  = volumeOK and emaOkLong  and vwapOkLong  and vwapDevOkLong
confluenceShortOK = volumeOK and emaOkShort and vwapOkShort and vwapDevOkShort

// ✅ FIX: Inverse ORB uses ONLY volume confirmation — no EMA/VWAP direction bias
// (Fading the high while price is above EMA/VWAP is contradictory)
inverseConfLongOK  = volumeOK
inverseConfShortOK = volumeOK

//═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// BREAKOUT + RETEST CORE
//═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

breakoutUp   = orComplete and not brokenUp   and close > orHigh and close[1] <= orHigh
breakoutDown = orComplete and not brokenDown and close < orLow  and close[1] >= orLow

if breakoutUp
    brokenUp := true
if breakoutDown
    brokenDown := true

var bool waitingForLongRetest  = false
var bool waitingForShortRetest = false

armRetest = (entryType == "Retest") or (modeResolved == "Default ORB (Retest)")

if breakoutUp and armRetest
    waitingForLongRetest := true
if breakoutDown and armRetest
    waitingForShortRetest := true

longRetest  = waitingForLongRetest  and low <= orHigh and close > orHigh
shortRetest = waitingForShortRetest and high >= orLow  and close < orLow

if longRetest
    waitingForLongRetest := false
if shortRetest
    waitingForShortRetest := false

if waitingForLongRetest  and close < orMid
    waitingForLongRetest := false
if waitingForShortRetest and close > orMid
    waitingForShortRetest := false

//═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// MODE SIGNALS
//═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

var int  lastSignalBar    = 0
var bool tradedLongToday  = false
var bool tradedShortToday = false

if newDay
    tradedLongToday  := false
    tradedShortToday := false

validTiming = inTradingHours and (bar_index - lastSignalBar) >= 5

// 1) DEFAULT ORB (Retest)
defaultLong  = longRetest  and validTiming and not tradedLongToday
defaultShort = shortRetest and validTiming and not tradedShortToday

// User-driven (for Auto / other modes)
userBreakoutLong  = breakoutUp   and validTiming and not tradedLongToday
userBreakoutShort = breakoutDown and validTiming and not tradedShortToday
userRetestLong    = longRetest   and validTiming and not tradedLongToday
userRetestShort   = shortRetest  and validTiming and not tradedShortToday

coreLong  = (entryType == "Breakout") ? userBreakoutLong  : userRetestLong
coreShort = (entryType == "Breakout") ? userBreakoutShort : userRetestShort

// 2) INVERSE ORB (Fade Wide ORB)
useInverse = modeResolved == "Inverse ORB (Fade Wide)"
nearHigh   = orComplete and high >= (orHigh - atr * fadeBufferATR)
nearLow    = orComplete and low  <= (orLow  + atr * fadeBufferATR)

rejectHigh    = close < orHigh and (high > orHigh)
rejectLow     = close > orLow  and (low < orLow)
wickRejectHigh = ((high - math.max(open, close)) > atr * 0.05) and (close < orHigh)
wickRejectLow  = ((math.min(open, close) - low)  > atr * 0.05) and (close > orLow)

fadeShortOK = fadeConfirm == "None"         ? nearHigh :
             (fadeConfirm == "Reject Close" ? (nearHigh and rejectHigh) : (nearHigh and wickRejectHigh))
fadeLongOK  = fadeConfirm == "None"         ? nearLow :
             (fadeConfirm == "Reject Close" ? (nearLow  and rejectLow)  : (nearLow  and wickRejectLow))

inverseLong  = useInverse and isWideORB and fadeLongOK  and validTiming and not tradedLongToday
inverseShort = useInverse and isWideORB and fadeShortOK and validTiming and not tradedShortToday

// 3) PRE-EMPT ORB (Trend)
usePreempt   = modeResolved == "Pre-empt ORB (Trend)"
preLongZone  = orComplete and trendUp and low  <= (orLow  + atr * preemptBufferATR)
preShortZone = orComplete and trendDn and high >= (orHigh - atr * preemptBufferATR)

preemptLong  = usePreempt and preLongZone  and validTiming and not tradedLongToday
preemptShort = usePreempt and preShortZone and validTiming and not tradedShortToday

// FINAL: resolve signals per mode
modeLong =
     (modeResolved == "Default ORB (Retest)")   ? defaultLong  :
     (modeResolved == "Inverse ORB (Fade Wide)") ? inverseLong  :
     (modeResolved == "Pre-empt ORB (Trend)")    ? preemptLong  :
     coreLong

modeShort =
     (modeResolved == "Default ORB (Retest)")   ? defaultShort  :
     (modeResolved == "Inverse ORB (Fade Wide)") ? inverseShort  :
     (modeResolved == "Pre-empt ORB (Trend)")    ? preemptShort  :
     coreShort

// ✅ FIX: Inverse ORB uses its own confluence (volume only, no EMA/VWAP bias)
//         Default + Pre-empt use full confluence with EMA + VWAP
//         FVG is NOT a hard requirement — it's a bonus shown in the label
isInverseMode = modeResolved == "Inverse ORB (Fade Wide)"

longEntry  = modeLong  and (isInverseMode ? inverseConfLongOK  : confluenceLongOK)
shortEntry = modeShort and (isInverseMode ? inverseConfShortOK : confluenceShortOK)

// FVG bonus flags (for label display only — not entry gates)
fvgBonusLong  = bullishFVGPresent
fvgBonusShort = bearishFVGPresent

buySignal  = showSignals and longEntry
sellSignal = showSignals and shortEntry

if buySignal
    lastSignalBar    := bar_index
    tradedLongToday  := true
if sellSignal
    lastSignalBar    := bar_index
    tradedShortToday := true

//═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// PRE-EMPT CONFIRMATION LABELS
//═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

var int  preLongBar    = na
var int  preShortBar   = na
var bool preLongActive = false
var bool preShortActive = false

if newDay
    preLongActive  := false
    preShortActive := false
    preLongBar     := na
    preShortBar    := na

preemptLongTaken  = (modeResolved == "Pre-empt ORB (Trend)") and preemptLong  and confluenceLongOK
preemptShortTaken = (modeResolved == "Pre-empt ORB (Trend)") and preemptShort and confluenceShortOK

if preemptLongTaken
    preLongActive := true
    preLongBar    := bar_index

if preemptShortTaken
    preShortActive := true
    preShortBar    := bar_index

preLongConfirmed  = preLongActive  and (breakoutUp   or longRetest)  and (bar_index - preLongBar)  <= confirmBarsLimit
preShortConfirmed = preShortActive and (breakoutDown or shortRetest) and (bar_index - preShortBar) <= confirmBarsLimit

if preLongConfirmed
    preLongActive := false
if preShortConfirmed
    preShortActive := false

//═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SL / TP
//═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

var float entryPrice = na
var float stopLoss   = na
var float takeProfit = na

if buySignal and orComplete
    entryPrice := close
    if slType == "Opposite Side"
        stopLoss := orLow - atr * 0.1
    else if slType == "Midpoint"
        stopLoss := orMid - atr * 0.1
    else
        stopLoss := close - atr * 1.5
    riskAmt    = entryPrice - stopLoss
    takeProfit := entryPrice + (riskAmt * rrRatio)

if sellSignal and orComplete
    entryPrice := close
    if slType == "Opposite Side"
        stopLoss := orHigh + atr * 0.1
    else if slType == "Midpoint"
        stopLoss := orMid + atr * 0.1
    else
        stopLoss := close + atr * 1.5
    riskAmt    = stopLoss - entryPrice
    takeProfit := entryPrice - (riskAmt * rrRatio)

//═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// PERFORMANCE TRACKING
//═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

type TradeRecord
    float entry
    float sl
    float tp
    bool  isLong
    int   bar
    bool  closed
    bool  won

var array<TradeRecord> trades  = array.new<TradeRecord>()
var array<bool>        results = array.new<bool>()
var float winRate    = 0.0
var int   totalWins  = 0
var int   totalLosses = 0

if buySignal or sellSignal
    t        = TradeRecord.new()
    t.entry  := entryPrice
    t.sl     := stopLoss
    t.tp     := takeProfit
    t.isLong := buySignal
    t.bar    := bar_index
    t.closed := false
    t.won    := false
    if array.size(trades) >= 50
        array.shift(trades)
    array.push(trades, t)

if array.size(trades) > 0
    for i = array.size(trades) - 1 to 0
        t    = array.get(trades, i)
        won  = false
        lost = false

        if not t.closed and bar_index > t.bar
            if t.isLong
                if low <= t.sl
                    lost := true
                else if high >= t.tp
                    won := true
                else if (bar_index - t.bar) > 80
                    won  := close > t.entry
                    lost := not won
            else
                if high >= t.sl
                    lost := true
                else if low <= t.tp
                    won := true
                else if (bar_index - t.bar) > 80
                    won  := close < t.entry
                    lost := not won

            if won or lost
                t.closed := true
                t.won    := won
                if won
                    totalWins += 1
                else
                    totalLosses += 1
                if array.size(results) >= 50
                    array.shift(results)
                array.push(results, won)

if array.size(results) > 0
    wins = 0
    for i = 0 to array.size(results) - 1
        if array.get(results, i)
            wins += 1
    winRate := (wins / array.size(results)) * 100.0

if array.size(trades) > 0
    for i = array.size(trades) - 1 to 0
        t = array.get(trades, i)
        if t.closed
            array.remove(trades, i)

//═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// VISUALS — OR Box + Lines (drawn only at barstate.islast for performance)
//═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

var box   orBox      = na
var line  orHighLine = na
var line  orLowLine  = na
var line  orMidLine  = na

if showORBox and orComplete and not na(orStartBar) and barstate.islast
    box.delete(orBox)
    orBox := box.new(orStartBar, orHigh, bar_index + 20, orLow,
         border_color=orbColor, border_width=2,
         bgcolor=color.new(orbColor, 88))

if orComplete and barstate.islast
    line.delete(orHighLine)
    line.delete(orLowLine)
    line.delete(orMidLine)
    orHighLine := line.new(orEndBar, orHigh, bar_index + 50, orHigh, color=bullColor, style=line.style_solid, width=2)
    orLowLine  := line.new(orEndBar, orLow,  bar_index + 50, orLow,  color=bearColor, style=line.style_solid, width=2)
    orMidLine  := line.new(orEndBar, orMid,  bar_index + 50, orMid,  color=color.gray, style=line.style_dotted, width=1)

//═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SIGNAL LABELS + SL/TP LINES
//═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

if buySignal
    labelText = (modeResolved == "Inverse ORB (Fade Wide)") ? "↩️ LONG\nInverse ORB" :(modeResolved == "Pre-empt ORB (Trend)")    ? "⚡ LONG\nPre-empt ORB" : "🎯 LONG\nORB"
    if fvgBonusLong
        labelText += "\n+FVG ✓"
    label.new(bar_index, low - atr * 0.5, text=labelText,
         style=label.style_label_up, color=color.new(bullColor, 20),
         textcolor=color.white, size=size.normal)
    line.new(bar_index, stopLoss,   bar_index + 30, stopLoss,   color=color.new(bearColor, 50), width=1, style=line.style_dashed)
    line.new(bar_index, takeProfit, bar_index + 30, takeProfit, color=color.new(bullColor, 50), width=1, style=line.style_dashed)

if sellSignal
    labelText = (modeResolved == "Inverse ORB (Fade Wide)") ? "↩️ SHORT\nInverse ORB" :(modeResolved == "Pre-empt ORB (Trend)")    ? "⚡ SHORT\nPre-empt ORB" : "🎯 SHORT\nORB"
    if fvgBonusShort
        labelText += "\n+FVG ✓"
    label.new(bar_index, high + atr * 0.5, text=labelText,
         style=label.style_label_down, color=color.new(bearColor, 20),
         textcolor=color.white, size=size.normal)
    line.new(bar_index, stopLoss,   bar_index + 30, stopLoss,   color=color.new(bearColor, 50), width=1, style=line.style_dashed)
    line.new(bar_index, takeProfit, bar_index + 30, takeProfit, color=color.new(bullColor, 50), width=1, style=line.style_dashed)

if showSignals and preLongConfirmed
    label.new(bar_index, low - atr * 1.1, "✅ Confirmed\nHold Long",
         style=label.style_label_up, color=color.new(color.teal, 0),
         textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)

if showSignals and preShortConfirmed
    label.new(bar_index, high + atr * 1.1, "✅ Confirmed\nHold Short",
         style=label.style_label_down, color=color.new(color.teal, 0),
         textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)

//═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// DASHBOARD
//═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

var table dashboard = table.new(position.top_right, 1, 1, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 85))

if showDashboard and barstate.islast
    orbStatus   = orComplete ? "✅ COMPLETE" : inOpeningRange ? "⏳ FORMING" : "❌ WAITING"
    breakStatus = brokenUp   ? "🟢 LONG"    : brokenDown     ? "🔴 SHORT"   : "⚪ NONE"
    fvgStatus   = bullishFVGPresent ? "🟢 BULL (active)" : bearishFVGPresent ? "🔴 BEAR (active)" : "⚪ NONE"
    volStatus   = highVolume ? "🟢 HIGH" : "⚪ NORMAL"

    rangeText = orComplete ? str.tostring(orRange, "#.##") : "--"
    rangeATR  = (orComplete and not na(atr)) ? (str.tostring(orRange / atr, "#.#") + "x ATR") : "--"
    wideTxt   = isWideORB ? "YES" : "NO"
    trendTxt  = trendUp ? "UP" : (trendDn ? "DOWN" : "NONE")

    dashText  = "═══ NEURAEDGE ORB ═══\n"
    dashText += "TF: "      + timeframe.period + "\n"
    dashText += "TZ: "      + sessionTZ + "\n"
    dashText += "Session: " + sessionStart + "\n"
    dashText += "Mode: "    + modeResolved + "\n"
    dashText += "Wide ORB: " + wideTxt + " | HTF Trend: " + trendTxt + "\n"
    dashText += "──────────────────────\n"
    dashText += "OR Status: " + orbStatus + "\n"

    if orComplete
        dashText += "OR High: " + str.tostring(orHigh, "#.##") + "\n"
        dashText += "OR Low: "  + str.tostring(orLow,  "#.##") + "\n"
        dashText += "Range: "   + rangeText + " (" + rangeATR + ")\n"

    dashText += "──────────────────────\n"
    dashText += "Breakout: " + breakStatus + "\n"
    dashText += "FVG: "      + fvgStatus   + "\n"
    dashText += "Volume: "   + volStatus   + "\n"
    dashText += "──────────────────────\n"
    dashText += "Confluence: EMA "  + (useEMAFilter     ? "ON" : "OFF") +" | VWAP " + (useVWAPFilter ? "ON" : "OFF") + " | Dev "  + (useVWAPDevFilter ? "ON" : "OFF") + "\n"
    dashText += "──────────────────────\n"

    if array.size(results) > 0
        dashText += "📈 Win Rate: " + str.tostring(winRate, "#.#") + "%\n"
        dashText += "W/L: " + str.tostring(totalWins) + "/" + str.tostring(totalLosses) + "\n"
    else
        dashText += "📈 No trades yet\n"

    dashText += "══════════════════════"
    table.cell(dashboard, 0, 0, text=dashText, text_color=color.white, text_size=size.small)

//═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ALERTS
//═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

alertcondition(orComplete and not orComplete[1], title="Opening Range Complete", message="Opening Range Complete! High: {{plot_0}} Low: {{plot_1}}")
alertcondition(buySignal,    title="ORB Long Signal",  message="NEURAEDGE ORB LONG Signal")
alertcondition(sellSignal,   title="ORB Short Signal", message="NEURAEDGE ORB SHORT Signal")
alertcondition(breakoutUp,   title="Breakout Up",      message="Price broke above Opening Range!")
alertcondition(breakoutDown, title="Breakout Down",    message="Price broke below Opening Range!")

plot(orHigh, "OR High", display=display.none)
plot(orLow,  "OR Low",  display=display.none)

items.title: Opening Range + Full-Day High/Low + Prev Day + Premarket + Breakout Arrows
items.author: eguillot
items.source:
//@version=5
indicator("Opening Range + Full-Day High/Low + Prev Day + Premarket + Breakout Arrows", overlay=true)

// === Variables ===
var float orHi = na
var float orLo = na
var float dayHi = na
var float dayLo = na
var float prevDayHi = na
var float prevDayLo = na
var float preHi = na
var float preLo = na
var int preLineDay = na
var bool bullBreakoutDrawn = false
var bool bearBreakoutDrawn = false
var int rangeStart = na
var int rangeEnd = na
var int dayID = na
var box currentBox = na
var line[] allLines = array.new_line()
var box[] allBoxes = array.new_box()

// === Date Logic ===
todayID = year * 10000 + month * 100 + dayofmonth
isNewDay = na(dayID) or todayID != dayID

// === Time Checks ===
inOR  = hour == 9 and minute >= 30 and minute < 45
inRTH = hour >= 9 and hour < 16 or (hour == 16 and minute == 0)
isMarketCloseBar = hour == 16 and minute == 0

// === Reset Daily ===
if isNewDay
    if not na(prevDayHi) and not na(prevDayLo)
        sessionStart = timestamp("America/New_York", year, month, dayofmonth, 9, 30)
        sessionEnd   = timestamp("America/New_York", year, month, dayofmonth, 16, 0)
        line.new(x1=sessionStart, y1=prevDayHi, x2=sessionEnd, y2=prevDayHi, color=color.new(color.green, 80), style=line.style_solid, xloc=xloc.bar_time)
        line.new(x1=sessionStart, y1=prevDayLo, x2=sessionEnd, y2=prevDayLo, color=color.new(color.red, 80), style=line.style_solid, xloc=xloc.bar_time)

    dayID := todayID
    orHi := na
    orLo := na
    dayHi := na
    dayLo := na
    preHi := na
    preLo := na
    preLineDay := na
    rangeStart := na
    rangeEnd := na
    bullBreakoutDrawn := false
    bearBreakoutDrawn := false

// === Track Full Regular Session High/Low ===
if inRTH
    dayHi := na(dayHi) ? high : math.max(dayHi, high)
    dayLo := na(dayLo) ? low  : math.min(dayLo, low)

// === Track Premarket High/Low from 16:00 previous day to 09:30 current day ===
preStart = timestamp("America/New_York", year, month, dayofmonth - 1, 16, 0)
preEnd   = timestamp("America/New_York", year, month, dayofmonth, 9, 30)
inPremarket = time >= preStart and time < preEnd

if inPremarket
    preHi := na(preHi) or preLineDay != todayID ? high : math.max(preHi, high)
    preLo := na(preLo) or preLineDay != todayID ? low  : math.min(preLo, low)
    preLineDay := todayID

if not inPremarket and preLineDay == todayID and time >= preEnd and time[1] < preEnd
    sessionEnd = timestamp("America/New_York", year, month, dayofmonth, 16, 0)
    line.new(x1=preEnd, y1=preHi, x2=sessionEnd, y2=preHi, color=color.aqua, style=line.style_dashed, width=1, xloc=xloc.bar_time)
    line.new(x1=preEnd, y1=preLo, x2=sessionEnd, y2=preLo, color=color.fuchsia, style=line.style_dashed, width=1, xloc=xloc.bar_time)

// === Track Opening Range High/Low ===
if inOR
    orHi := na(orHi) ? high : math.max(orHi, high)
    orLo := na(orLo) ? low  : math.min(orLo, low)
    rangeStart := na(rangeStart) ? time : rangeStart
    rangeEnd := time

// === Draw Opening Range Box and Lines ===
justAfterOR = not inOR and inOR[1] and not na(orHi) and not na(orLo)
if justAfterOR
    sessionStart = timestamp("America/New_York", year, month, dayofmonth, 9, 30)
    sessionEnd   = timestamp("America/New_York", year, month, dayofmonth, 16, 0)

    currentBox := box.new(left=rangeStart, right=rangeEnd, top=orHi, bottom=orLo, border_color=color.orange, bgcolor=color.new(color.orange, 85), xloc=xloc.bar_time)
    array.push(allBoxes, currentBox)

    lineHigh = line.new(x1=sessionStart, y1=orHi, x2=sessionEnd, y2=orHi, color=color.green, style=line.style_solid, xloc=xloc.bar_time)
    lineLow  = line.new(x1=sessionStart, y1=orLo, x2=sessionEnd, y2=orLo, color=color.red, style=line.style_solid, xloc=xloc.bar_time)
    array.push(allLines, lineHigh)
    array.push(allLines, lineLow)

// === At Market Close: Lock In Previous Day Levels ===
if isMarketCloseBar
    prevDayHi := dayHi
    prevDayLo := dayLo

// === Breakout Arrow Logic ===
arrowOffset = syminfo.mintick * 100
isFiveMin = timeframe.isintraday and timeframe.multiplier == 5
isAfterRange = time > rangeEnd and not na(orHi) and not na(orLo)

body = math.abs(close - open)
full = high - low
bodyPct = full != 0 ? body / full : 0

strongBull = close > orHi and bodyPct >= 0.6 and isAfterRange and isFiveMin and not bullBreakoutDrawn
strongBear = close < orLo and bodyPct >= 0.6 and isAfterRange and isFiveMin and not bearBreakoutDrawn

if strongBull
    label.new(x=bar_index, y=high + arrowOffset, text="↑", style=label.style_label_up, size=size.small, color=color.new(color.green, 0), textcolor=color.white)
    bullBreakoutDrawn := true

if strongBear
    label.new(x=bar_index, y=low - arrowOffset, text="↓", style=label.style_label_down, size=size.small, color=color.new(color.red, 0), textcolor=color.white)
    bearBreakoutDrawn := true

items.author: vasireddiramu78
items.source:
//@version=5
indicator("Opening Range Breakout", overlay=true)

// === Inputs ===
inputMax = input.int(15, "ORB Time Limit (minutes)")
sess = input.session("0915-0930", "ORB Session Time")
showBG = input.bool(true, "Show Breakout Background")
showLbl = input.bool(true, "Show Breakout Labels")
showLineLabels = input.bool(true, "Show ORB High/Low Text Labels")

// === Visibility & Session Logic ===
hide = timeframe.isintraday and timeframe.multiplier <= inputMax
in_session = not na(time(timeframe.period, sess + ":1234567"))
is_first = in_session and not in_session[1]

// === ORB High/Low Capture ===
var float orb_high = na, var float orb_low = na
if is_first
    orb_high := high
    orb_low := low
else if in_session
    orb_high := math.max(orb_high, high)
    orb_low := math.min(orb_low, low)

// === Plot ORB Lines ===
plot(hide and not na(orb_high) ? orb_high : na, "ORB High", color=orb_high != orb_high[1] ? na : color.green, linewidth=2)
plot(hide and not na(orb_low) ? orb_low : na, "ORB Low", color=orb_low != orb_low[1] ? na : color.red, linewidth=2)

// === Breakout Conditions ===
breaksAbove = ta.crossover(close, orb_high)
breaksBelow = ta.crossunder(close, orb_low)

// === Background Highlights ===
bgcolor(showBG and breaksAbove ? color.new(color.green, 85) : na)
bgcolor(showBG and breaksBelow ? color.new(color.red, 85) : na)

// === Breakout Labels (Optional) ===
if showLbl and breaksAbove
    label.new(bar_index, high, "Breakout ↑ " + str.tostring(close), style=label.style_label_left, color=color.green, textcolor=color.white, size=size.small)
if showLbl and breaksBelow
    label.new(bar_index, low, "Breakout ↓ " + str.tostring(close), style=label.style_label_left, color=color.red, textcolor=color.white, size=size.small)

// === Live Line-Attached Labels (Right Aligned, 1 per bar) ===
var label orbHighLabel = na, var label orbLowLabel = na
if showLineLabels
    label.delete(orbHighLabel), label.delete(orbLowLabel)
    orbHighLabel := label.new(x=bar_index, y=orb_high, text="ORB High", style=label.style_label_right, textcolor=color.white, color=color.green, size=size.small)
    orbLowLabel := label.new(x=bar_index, y=orb_low, text="ORB Low", style=label.style_label_right, textcolor=color.white, color=color.red, size=size.small)

// === Alerts ===
alertcondition(breaksAbove, title="Breakout Above ORB High", message="🔼 Price broke above ORB High: {{close}}")
alertcondition(breaksBelow, title="Breakout Below ORB Low", message="🔽 Price broke below ORB Low: {{close}}")
