items.author: getthatcashmoney
items.source:
// This source code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
// © amitgandhinz

//@version=5
indicator(title="ORB", overlay=true)
 
 
// Input options
// openingRangeMinutes = input.int(15, title="Opening Range Period (minutes)", options=[5, 15, 30])

// hack the tradingview issue where int combo boxes no longer display correctly (12/21/2022), but string combo boxes still work
sOpeningRangeMinutes = input.string("15", title="Period (minutes)", options=["5", "15", "30", "0"], tooltip="Set to 0 if you want to use International Overrides")
openingRangeMinutes = str.tonumber(sOpeningRangeMinutes)

//session = input.session("0930-0945", title="Opening Range Session Time", options=["0930-0935", "0930-0945", "0930-1000"])
alertBreakoutsOnly = input.bool(false, "Alert only on ORB breakouts (not price ticks)")


showLabels = input.bool(true, "Show ORB labels", group="Display Lines")
showPreviousDayORBs = input.bool(true, "Show ORB ranges on previous days", group="Display Lines")
showEntries = input.bool(true, "Show potential ORB Breakouts and Retests (BRB)", group="Display Lines")
showPriceTargets= input.bool(true, "Show Default Price Targets (50%, 100%)", group="Display Lines")
showPriceTargetsExtended = input.bool(false, "Show Extended Price Targets (150%, 200%)", group="Display Lines")
showMidPoint = input.bool(false, "Show ORB Mid Point", group="Display Lines")

showFibTargets = false//input.bool(false, "Show Fibonacci Targets (21.2%, 61.8%)", group="Display Lines")

boxBorderSize = 2 // input.int(2, title="Box border size", minval=0, group="Style")
showShadedBox = input.bool(true, "Shade the ORB Range", group="ORB Box")
shadeColor = input.color(color.teal, "Shaded ORB Range Color", group="ORB Box")

orb50Color = input.color(color.purple, "ORB 50 Price Target", group="ORB Box")
orb100Color = input.color(color.blue, "ORB 100 Price Target", group="ORB Box")
orbOtherColor = input.color(color.teal, "All Other ORB Price Targets", group="ORB Box")

sORBStartTime = input.string("0930-0945", title="Time Override", tooltip="Set Period to 0 to apply. Format should be 0930-0945", group="Optional International Overrides")
sTimeZone = input.string("America/New_York", title="Timezone", options=["America/New_York", "Europe/Amsterdam", "Europe/Berlin", "Asia/Kolkata", "Asia/Shanghai", "Asia/Tokyo", "Etc/UTC"], group="Optional International Overrides")


session = switch openingRangeMinutes
    5  => "0930-0935"
    15 => "0930-0945"
    30 => "0930-1000"
    0 => sORBStartTime
    => "0930-0945"


    
inputMax = openingRangeMinutes
timeinrange(session) => not na(time(timeframe.period, session + ":23456", sTimeZone)) ? 1 : 0
// t = time(timeframe.period, session + ":23456")
in_session =  timeinrange(session)
hideOpen = timeframe.isintraday and timeframe.multiplier <= inputMax and not in_session


// Create variables
var orbTitle = "ORB" + str.tostring(openingRangeMinutes)
var orbHighPrice = 0.0
var orbLowPrice  = 0.0

var box dailyBox = na
var inBreakout = false

// See if a new calendar day started on the intra-day time frame
newDayStart = dayofmonth != dayofmonth[1] and 
     timeframe.isintraday
     
bool isToday = false
if year(timenow) == year(time) and month(timenow) == month(time) and dayofmonth(timenow) == dayofmonth(time) and session.ismarket
    isToday := true
     
// determine ORB15 levels
is_newbar(res) => ta.change(time(res)) != 0

is_first = in_session and not in_session[1] and session.ismarket


if is_first
    orbHighPrice := high
    orbLowPrice := low
    inBreakout := false
else
    orbHighPrice := orbHighPrice[1]
    orbLowPrice := orbLowPrice[1]
if high > orbHighPrice and in_session
    orbHighPrice := high
if low < orbLowPrice and in_session
    orbLowPrice := low





bool drawOrbs = showPreviousDayORBs or (not showPreviousDayORBs and isToday)

// When a new day start, create a new box for that day.
// Else, during the day, update that day's box.
if ( drawOrbs)
    if (showShadedBox)
        if is_first 
            dailyBox := box.new(left=bar_index, top=orbHighPrice,
                 right=bar_index + 1, bottom=orbLowPrice,
                 border_width=boxBorderSize)
        
            // If we don't want the boxes to join, the previous box shouldn't
            // end on the same bar as the new box starts.
            box.set_right(dailyBox[1], bar_index[1])
            
           
        else
            box.set_top(dailyBox, orbHighPrice)
            box.set_rightbottom(dailyBox, right=bar_index + 1, bottom=orbLowPrice)
    
    
        box.set_bgcolor(dailyBox, color.new(shadeColor, 80))
        box.set_border_color(dailyBox, color.teal)


plot(not in_session and drawOrbs ? orbHighPrice  : na, style=plot.style_linebr, color=orbHighPrice[1] != orbHighPrice ? na : color.green, title="ORB High", linewidth=2)
plot(not in_session and drawOrbs  ? orbLowPrice : na ,  style=plot.style_linebr, color=orbLowPrice[1] != orbLowPrice ? na : color.red, title="ORB Low", linewidth=2)


// plot PT for ORB - 50% retracement

orbRange = orbHighPrice - orbLowPrice
plot(not in_session and showPriceTargets and showMidPoint and drawOrbs ? orbLowPrice + (orbRange * 0.5): na     ,  style=plot.style_linebr, color=orbLowPrice[1] != orbLowPrice ? na : color.gray, title="ORB Mid Point", linewidth=1)




plot(not in_session and showPriceTargets and drawOrbs ? orbHighPrice + (orbRange * 0.5) : na,     style=plot.style_linebr, color=orb50Color, title="ORB High PT 0.5", linewidth=2)
plot(not in_session and showPriceTargets and drawOrbs ? orbHighPrice + (orbRange * 1.0): na ,     style=plot.style_linebr, color=orb100Color, title="ORB High PT 1.0", linewidth=2)
plot(not in_session and showPriceTargets and drawOrbs and showPriceTargetsExtended ? orbHighPrice + (orbRange * 1.5): na ,     style=plot.style_linebr, color=orbOtherColor, title="ORB High PT 1.5", linewidth=2)
plot(not in_session and showPriceTargets and drawOrbs and showPriceTargetsExtended ? orbHighPrice + (orbRange * 2.0): na ,     style=plot.style_linebr, color=orbOtherColor, title="ORB High PT 2.0", linewidth=2)
plot(not in_session and showPriceTargets and drawOrbs and showPriceTargetsExtended ? orbHighPrice + (orbRange * 2.5): na ,     style=plot.style_linebr, color=orbOtherColor, title="ORB High PT 2.5", linewidth=2)
plot(not in_session and showPriceTargets and drawOrbs and showPriceTargetsExtended ? orbHighPrice + (orbRange * 3.0): na ,     style=plot.style_linebr, color=orbOtherColor, title="ORB High PT 3.0", linewidth=2)
plot(not in_session and showPriceTargets and drawOrbs and showPriceTargetsExtended ? orbHighPrice + (orbRange * 3.5): na ,     style=plot.style_linebr, color=orbOtherColor, title="ORB High PT 3.5", linewidth=2)
plot(not in_session and showPriceTargets and drawOrbs and showPriceTargetsExtended ? orbHighPrice + (orbRange * 4.0): na ,     style=plot.style_linebr, color=orbOtherColor, title="ORB High PT 4.0", linewidth=2)
plot(not in_session and showPriceTargets and drawOrbs and showPriceTargetsExtended ? orbHighPrice + (orbRange * 4.5): na ,     style=plot.style_linebr, color=orbOtherColor, title="ORB High PT 4.5", linewidth=2)
plot(not in_session and showPriceTargets and drawOrbs and showPriceTargetsExtended ? orbHighPrice + (orbRange * 5.0): na ,     style=plot.style_linebr, color=orbOtherColor, title="ORB High PT 5.0", linewidth=2)

plot(not in_session and showPriceTargets and drawOrbs ? orbLowPrice + (orbRange * -0.5): na     , style=plot.style_linebr, color=orb50Color, title="ORB Low PT 0.5", linewidth=2)
plot(not in_session and showPriceTargets and drawOrbs ? orbLowPrice + (orbRange * -1.0): na     ,  style=plot.style_linebr, color=orb100Color, title="ORB Low PT 1.0", linewidth=2)
plot(not in_session and showPriceTargets and drawOrbs and showPriceTargetsExtended ? orbLowPrice + (orbRange * -1.5): na     ,  style=plot.style_linebr, color=orbOtherColor, title="ORB Low PT 1.5", linewidth=2)
plot(not in_session and showPriceTargets and drawOrbs and showPriceTargetsExtended ? orbLowPrice + (orbRange * -2.0): na     ,  style=plot.style_linebr, color=orbOtherColor, title="ORB Low PT 2.0", linewidth=2)
plot(not in_session and showPriceTargets and drawOrbs and showPriceTargetsExtended ? orbLowPrice + (orbRange * -2.5): na     ,  style=plot.style_linebr, color=orbOtherColor, title="ORB Low PT 2.5", linewidth=2)
plot(not in_session and showPriceTargets and drawOrbs and showPriceTargetsExtended ? orbLowPrice + (orbRange * -3.0): na     ,  style=plot.style_linebr, color=orbOtherColor, title="ORB Low PT 3.0", linewidth=2)
plot(not in_session and showPriceTargets and drawOrbs and showPriceTargetsExtended ? orbLowPrice + (orbRange * -3.5): na     ,  style=plot.style_linebr, color=orbOtherColor, title="ORB Low PT 3.5", linewidth=2)
plot(not in_session and showPriceTargets and drawOrbs and showPriceTargetsExtended ? orbLowPrice + (orbRange * -4.0): na     ,  style=plot.style_linebr, color=orbOtherColor, title="ORB Low PT 4.0", linewidth=2)
plot(not in_session and showPriceTargets and drawOrbs and showPriceTargetsExtended ? orbLowPrice + (orbRange * -4.5): na     ,  style=plot.style_linebr, color=orbOtherColor, title="ORB Low PT 4.5", linewidth=2)
plot(not in_session and showPriceTargets and drawOrbs and showPriceTargetsExtended ? orbLowPrice + (orbRange * -5.0): na     ,  style=plot.style_linebr, color=orbOtherColor, title="ORB Low PT 5.0", linewidth=2)



// fib levels
plot(not in_session and showFibTargets ? orbHighPrice + (orbRange * 0.272): na     ,  style=plot.style_linebr, color=orb50Color, title="ORB 27.2%", linewidth=2)
plot(not in_session and showFibTargets ? orbHighPrice + (orbRange * 0.618): na     ,  style=plot.style_linebr, color=orb100Color, title="ORB 61.8%", linewidth=2)
plot(not in_session and showFibTargets ? orbLowPrice + (orbRange * -0.272): na     ,  style=plot.style_linebr, color=orb50Color, title="ORB 27.2%", linewidth=2)
plot(not in_session and showFibTargets ? orbLowPrice + (orbRange * -0.618): na     ,  style=plot.style_linebr, color=orb100Color, title="ORB 61.8%", linewidth=2)



drawPriceTargetLabel(fromPrice, level, name, col) => 
    if showLabels
        var pt = label.new(bar_index, fromPrice + (orbRange * level), style=label.style_label_lower_left, text=orbTitle + " " + name, color=col, textcolor=color.white)
        label.set_xy(pt, bar_index + 2, fromPrice + (orbRange * level))



drawPriceTargetLabel(orbHighPrice, 0, "HIGH", color.green)
drawPriceTargetLabel(orbLowPrice, 0, "LOW", color.red)

    
if (not in_session and showPriceTargets and isToday and session.ismarket and drawOrbs )
    drawPriceTargetLabel(orbHighPrice, 0.5, "PT 50%", orb50Color)
    drawPriceTargetLabel(orbHighPrice, 1.0, "PT 100%", orb100Color)

    
    drawPriceTargetLabel(orbLowPrice, -0.5, "PT 50%", orb50Color)
    drawPriceTargetLabel(orbLowPrice, -1.0, "PT 100%", orb100Color)

    
    if showPriceTargetsExtended
        drawPriceTargetLabel(orbHighPrice, 1.5, "PT 150%", orbOtherColor)
        drawPriceTargetLabel(orbHighPrice, 2.0, "PT 200%", orbOtherColor)
        drawPriceTargetLabel(orbHighPrice, 2.5, "PT 250%", orbOtherColor)
        drawPriceTargetLabel(orbHighPrice, 3.0, "PT 300%", orbOtherColor)
        drawPriceTargetLabel(orbHighPrice, 3.5, "PT 350%", orbOtherColor)
        drawPriceTargetLabel(orbHighPrice, 4.0, "PT 400%", orbOtherColor)
        drawPriceTargetLabel(orbHighPrice, 4.5, "PT 450%", orbOtherColor)
        drawPriceTargetLabel(orbHighPrice, 5.0, "PT 500%",orbOtherColor)
        
        drawPriceTargetLabel(orbLowPrice, -1.5, "PT 150%", orbOtherColor)
        drawPriceTargetLabel(orbLowPrice, -2.0, "PT 200%", orbOtherColor) 
        drawPriceTargetLabel(orbLowPrice, -2.5, "PT 250%", orbOtherColor)
        drawPriceTargetLabel(orbLowPrice, -3.0, "PT 300%", orbOtherColor)  
        drawPriceTargetLabel(orbLowPrice, -3.5, "PT 350%", orbOtherColor)
        drawPriceTargetLabel(orbLowPrice, -4.0, "PT 400%", orbOtherColor) 
        drawPriceTargetLabel(orbLowPrice, -4.5, "PT 450%", orbOtherColor) 
        drawPriceTargetLabel(orbLowPrice, -5.0, "PT 500%", orbOtherColor) 
    
    if showMidPoint
        drawPriceTargetLabel(orbLowPrice,  0.5, "MIDPOINT", color.gray)

if (not in_session and showFibTargets and isToday and session.ismarket and drawOrbs )
    drawPriceTargetLabel(orbHighPrice, 0.272, "FIB 27.2%", orb50Color)
    drawPriceTargetLabel(orbHighPrice, 0.618, "FIB 61.8%", orb100Color)
    drawPriceTargetLabel(orbLowPrice, -0.272, "FIB 27.2%", orb50Color)
    drawPriceTargetLabel(orbLowPrice, -0.618, "FIB 61.8%", orb100Color)
 
// candle crossed orb level, next candle stayed above it, current candle also stayed above it, and had volume in there
//volumeSMA = ta.sma(volume, 20)
//bool volumeSpiked = volume[2] > volumeSMA[2] or volume[1] > volumeSMA[1] or volume > volumeSMA
bool highCrossBO = (low[2] < orbHighPrice and close[2] > orbHighPrice and low[1] > orbHighPrice and close[1] > orbHighPrice and close > low[1] and  low > orbHighPrice)  and session.ismarket
bool lowCrossBO =  (high[2] > orbLowPrice and close[2] < orbLowPrice and high[1] < orbLowPrice and close[1] < orbLowPrice   and close < high[1] and high < orbLowPrice)  and session.ismarket

bool highCross = (not alertBreakoutsOnly and ta.cross(close, orbHighPrice)) or (alertBreakoutsOnly and highCrossBO) 
bool lowCross =  (not alertBreakoutsOnly and ta.cross(close, orbLowPrice)) or (alertBreakoutsOnly and lowCrossBO) 


bool isRetestOrbHigh = close[1] > orbHighPrice and low <= orbHighPrice and close >= orbHighPrice
bool isRetestOrbLow  = close[1] < orbLowPrice and high >= orbLowPrice and close <= orbLowPrice
bool failedRetest = inBreakout and ((close[1] > orbHighPrice and close < orbHighPrice) or (close[1] < orbLowPrice and close > orbLowPrice))

// show entries
if (showEntries and session.ismarket)
    if (highCrossBO)
        lbl = label.new(bar_index, na)
        label.set_color(lbl, color.green)
        label.set_textcolor(lbl, color.green)
        label.set_text(lbl, "Breakout\n Wait for Retest")
        label.set_yloc( lbl,yloc.abovebar)
        label.set_style(lbl, label.style_triangledown)
        label.set_size(lbl, size.tiny)
        
        inBreakout := true
        
    if (lowCrossBO)
        lbl = label.new(bar_index, na)
        label.set_color(lbl, color.green)
        label.set_textcolor(lbl, color.green)
        label.set_text(lbl, "Breakout,\n Wait for Retest")
        label.set_yloc( lbl,yloc.belowbar)
        label.set_style(lbl, label.style_triangleup)
        label.set_size(lbl, size.tiny)
        
        inBreakout := true
        
    if inBreakout and (isRetestOrbHigh or isRetestOrbLow)
        // we have our breakout and retest
        lbl = label.new(bar_index, na)
        label.set_color(lbl, color.green)
        label.set_textcolor(lbl, color.white)
        label.set_text(lbl, "Retest")
        label.set_yloc( lbl,yloc.abovebar)
        label.set_style(lbl, label.style_label_down)
        label.set_size(lbl, size.tiny)
        
        inBreakout := false
        
    if inBreakout and failedRetest
        // we have failed the retest
        lbl = label.new(bar_index, na)
        label.set_color(lbl, color.red)
        label.set_textcolor(lbl, color.white)
        label.set_text(lbl, "Failed Retest")
        label.set_yloc( lbl,yloc.abovebar)
        label.set_style(lbl, label.style_label_down)
        label.set_size(lbl, size.tiny)
        
        inBreakout := false
        

// show alerts

alertcondition(not in_session and session.ismarket and (highCross or lowCross), title="ORB Level Cross", message="Price crossing ORB Level")
alertcondition(not in_session and session.ismarket and alertBreakoutsOnly and (highCrossBO or lowCrossBO), title="ORB Breakout", message="Price Breaking out of ORB Level, Look for Retest")

if (not in_session and isToday and session.ismarket)
    if (not alertBreakoutsOnly)
        if highCross
            alert("Price crossing ORB High Level", alert.freq_once_per_bar)
            
        if lowCross
            alert("Price crossing ORB Low Level", alert.freq_once_per_bar)
    
    if (alertBreakoutsOnly)
        if highCrossBO
            alert("Price breaking out of ORB High Level, Look for Retest", alert.freq_once_per_bar)
            
        if lowCrossBO
            alert("Price breaking out of ORB Low Level, Look for Retest", alert.freq_once_per_bar)

//@version=5

indicator("Basic ORB [MOT]", overlay=true, max_lines_count=500)

// === Inputs ===
highColor        = input.color(color.green, "High Line Color")
lowColor         = input.color(color.red, "Low Line Color")
midlineColor     = input.color(color.white, "Midline Color")
linewidth        = input.int(2, "Line Width", minval=1, maxval=4)
showHistory      = input.bool(true, "Show Previous ORBs")
maxSavedOrbs     = input.int(5, "Show previous number of ORBs")
showLabels       = input.bool(true, "Show Price Labels")
labelBgColor     = input.color(color.black, "Label Background Color")
labelTextColor   = input.color(color.white, "Label Text Color")
labelSizeOpt     = input.string("Small", "Label Size", options=["Tiny", "Small", "Normal", "Large", "Huge"])
labelOffset      = input.int(10, "Label X Offset", minval=1, maxval=100)

// Map string to label size enum
labelSize = labelSizeOpt == "Tiny" ? size.tiny :labelSizeOpt == "Small" ? size.small :labelSizeOpt == "Normal" ? size.normal :labelSizeOpt == "Large" ? size.large :size.huge

f_plotLabel(_y, _text) =>
    if showLabels
        label.new(x=bar_index + labelOffset,y=_y,text=_text + " - " + str.tostring(_y, format.mintick),style=label.style_label_left,textcolor=labelTextColor,size=labelSize,color=labelBgColor)

// === Time Logic ===
startTime   = timestamp("America/New_York", year, month, dayofmonth, 9, 30)
endTime     = timestamp("America/New_York", year, month, dayofmonth, 9, 45)
inSession   = time >= startTime and time < endTime

// === Arrays ===
var line[] orbHighLines = array.new_line()
var line[] orbLowLines  = array.new_line()
var line[] orbMidLines  = array.new_line()
var line[] fibLines     = array.new_line()

// === ORB Variables ===
var float sessionHigh   = na
var float sessionLow    = na
var float mid           = na
var int orb_index       = na
var line liveHighLine   = na
var line liveLowLine    = na
var line liveMidLine    = na
var int start_index     = na
var bool sessionFinalized = false
// === Previous Day High/Low Lines ===
var line prevHighLine = na
var line prevLowLine  = na

prevHigh = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "D", high[1])
prevLow  = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "D", low[1])

if dayofmonth!=dayofmonth[1]
    start_index := bar_index

if not inSession[1] and inSession and showHistory
    finalHigh = line.new(x1=orb_index, y1=sessionHigh, x2=bar_index-1, y2=sessionHigh,
                         color=highColor, width=linewidth, style=line.style_solid)
    finalLow  = line.new(x1=orb_index, y1=sessionLow,  x2=bar_index-1, y2=sessionLow,
                         color=lowColor, width=linewidth, style=line.style_solid)
    finalMid  = line.new(x1=orb_index, y1=mid,    x2=bar_index-1, y2=mid,
                         color=midlineColor, width=linewidth, style=line.style_solid)

    // Store lines in arrays
    array.push(orbHighLines, finalHigh)
    array.push(orbLowLines,  finalLow)
    array.push(orbMidLines,  finalMid)

    // Limit to maxSavedOrbs
    if array.size(orbHighLines) > maxSavedOrbs
        line.delete(array.shift(orbHighLines))
        line.delete(array.shift(orbLowLines))
        line.delete(array.shift(orbMidLines))

// === Capture High/Low During ORB Session ===
if not inSession[1] and inSession
    orb_index := bar_index
    sessionHigh := na
    sessionLow := na
    mid:=na
    sessionFinalized := false
    line.delete(liveHighLine)
    line.delete(liveLowLine)
    line.delete(liveMidLine)
    liveHighLine := na
    liveLowLine := na
    liveMidLine := na

if inSession
    sessionHigh := na(sessionHigh) ? high : math.max(sessionHigh, high)
    sessionLow := na(sessionLow) ? low : math.min(sessionLow, low)
    mid:= (sessionHigh + sessionLow) / 2

    line.delete(liveHighLine)
    line.delete(liveLowLine)
    line.delete(liveMidLine)

    // Draw real-time updating lines
    liveHighLine := line.new(x1=orb_index, y1=sessionHigh, x2=bar_index+2, y2=sessionHigh,color=highColor, width=linewidth)
    liveLowLine := line.new(x1=orb_index, y1=sessionLow, x2=bar_index+2, y2=sessionLow,color=lowColor, width=linewidth)
    liveMidLine := line.new(x1=orb_index, y1=mid, x2=bar_index+2, y2=mid,color=midlineColor, width=linewidth)

if not inSession
    line.set_x2(liveHighLine,bar_index+2)
    line.set_x2(liveLowLine,bar_index+2)
    line.set_x2(liveMidLine,bar_index+2)

var label orbHighLabel = na
var label orbLowLabel  = na
var label orbMidLabel  = na
var label prevHighLabel = na
var label prevLowLabel  = na

label.delete(orbHighLabel)
label.delete(orbLowLabel)
label.delete(orbMidLabel)

orbHighLabel := f_plotLabel(sessionHigh, "ORB High")
orbLowLabel  := f_plotLabel(sessionLow, "ORB Low")
orbMidLabel  := f_plotLabel(mid, "ORB Mid")

items.name: QuantCrawler ORB Break & Retest 15m - Opening Range Strategy
items.title: ORB Break & Retest - 15m v1.1
items.author: QuantCrawler
items.source:
//@version=6
indicator("ORB Break & Retest - 15m v1.1", overlay=true)

// === INPUTS ===
breakout_distance = input.float(2.0, "Breakout Distance (Points)", minval=0.0, maxval=1000.0, 
     tooltip="Distance in points/dollars outside OR zone to trigger breakout")

session_timezone = input.string("America/New_York", "Timezone", 
     options=["America/New_York", "Europe/London", "Asia/Tokyo", "Asia/Hong_Kong", "America/Chicago"],
     tooltip="Select your trading session timezone")

or_session = input.session("0800-0815", "Opening Range Time", 
     tooltip="First 15 minutes to capture OR (default: 8:00-8:15 premarket)")

session_end = input.session("1600-1600", "Session End Time",
     tooltip="When to stop monitoring for signals (default: 4:00 PM)")

// === TIME DETECTION ===
bar_hour = hour(time, session_timezone)
bar_minute = minute(time, session_timezone)

// Parse OR session string (format: "HHMM-HHMM")
or_start_str = str.substring(or_session, 0, 2) + str.substring(or_session, 2, 4)
or_start_hour = str.tonumber(str.substring(or_session, 0, 2))
or_start_minute = str.tonumber(str.substring(or_session, 2, 4))
or_end_hour = str.tonumber(str.substring(or_session, 5, 7))
or_end_minute = str.tonumber(str.substring(or_session, 7, 9))

// Parse session end string
session_end_hour = str.tonumber(str.substring(session_end, 0, 2))
session_end_minute = str.tonumber(str.substring(session_end, 2, 4))

// Check if we're at OR capture time (end of OR period)
is_capture_time = bar_hour == or_end_hour and bar_minute == or_end_minute

// Check if we're at OR start time (for line drawing)
is_or_start = bar_hour == or_start_hour and bar_minute == or_start_minute

// Trading hours = after OR ends until session close
is_after_or = (bar_hour > or_end_hour) or (bar_hour == or_end_hour and bar_minute >= or_end_minute)
is_before_close = (bar_hour < session_end_hour) or (bar_hour == session_end_hour and bar_minute < session_end_minute)
is_trading_hours = is_after_or and is_before_close

// === STATE VARIABLES ===
var float or_high = na
var float or_low = na
var float or_mid = na
var bool long_breakout = false
var bool short_breakout = false
var bool long_ready = false
var bool short_ready = false
var int or_start_bar = na  // Track bar index at 9:30

// === ALERT CONDITIONS ===
var bool long_signal = false
var bool short_signal = false

// === LINES ===
var line or_high_line = na
var line or_low_line = na
var line or_mid_line = na

// Reset at new day
if ta.change(dayofmonth) != 0
    line.delete(or_high_line)
    line.delete(or_low_line)
    line.delete(or_mid_line)
    
    or_high := na
    or_low := na
    or_mid := na
    long_breakout := false
    short_breakout := false
    long_ready := false
    short_ready := false
    or_start_bar := na

// Capture bar index at OR start time
if is_or_start and na(or_start_bar)
    or_start_bar := bar_index

// === CAPTURE OR FROM 15M DATA ===
if is_capture_time and na(or_high)
    // Pull the completed 15m candle (9:30-9:45) at 9:45
    [high_15m, low_15m] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "15", [high[1], low[1]], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)
    
    or_high := high_15m
    or_low := low_15m
    or_mid := (or_high + or_low) / 2

// === DRAW OR ZONE ===
if not na(or_high) and not na(or_start_bar)
    if na(or_high_line)
        // Draw lines starting at 9:30 bar
        or_high_line := line.new(or_start_bar, or_high, bar_index, or_high, color=color.green, width=3)
        or_low_line := line.new(or_start_bar, or_low, bar_index, or_low, color=color.red, width=3)
        or_mid_line := line.new(or_start_bar, or_mid, bar_index, or_mid, color=color.orange, width=2, style=line.style_dotted)
    else
        line.set_x2(or_high_line, bar_index)
        line.set_x2(or_low_line, bar_index)
        line.set_x2(or_mid_line, bar_index)

// Reset signal flags each bar
long_signal := false
short_signal := false

// === BREAKOUT LOGIC ===
if not na(or_high) and is_trading_hours
    or_range = or_high - or_low
    
    // Check for breakout (close price beyond zone + fixed distance)
    if not long_breakout and close >= or_high + breakout_distance
        long_breakout := true
    
    if not short_breakout and close <= or_low - breakout_distance
        short_breakout := true
    
    // === LONG ENTRY ===
    if long_breakout
        // Price moved away from midpoint
        if close > or_mid
            long_ready := true
        
        // Price touched midpoint - ENTRY
        if long_ready and low <= or_mid
            label.new(bar_index, low, "🟢 LONG", 
                 color=color.new(color.green, 0), textcolor=color.white, 
                 style=label.style_label_up, size=size.small)
            
            long_signal := true
            
            // RESET flags so we can detect next breakout
            long_breakout := false
            long_ready := false
    
    // === SHORT ENTRY ===
    if short_breakout
        // Price moved away from midpoint
        if close < or_mid
            short_ready := true
        
        // Price touched midpoint - ENTRY
        if short_ready and high >= or_mid
            label.new(bar_index, high, "🔴 SHORT", 
                 color=color.new(color.red, 0), textcolor=color.white, 
                 style=label.style_label_down, size=size.small)
            
            short_signal := true
            
            // RESET flags so we can detect next breakout
            short_breakout := false
            short_ready := false

// === ALERTS ===

// This Pine Script™ code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
// © GorbAlgo

//@version=5
indicator("Opening Range & Prior Day High/Low [Gorb]", shorttitle="ORB & PDH/L [Gorb]", overlay=true)

// Opening Range Break Configuration Settings
// Group: Customize opening range and trading session time to users preferences
_ORB = "Opening Range Break Settings"
ORBrange = input.session(title='Opening Range', defval='0930-0945', group=_ORB)
ORBextend = input.session(title='Extend Range Lines', defval='0930-1600', group=_ORB)

// Opening Range Break Color Style Settings
// Group: Customize opening range colors to meet users needs
_ORBcolors = "Opening Range Colors"
showORB = input(title='Enable Opening Range Box', defval=true, inline='ORB top', group=_ORBcolors)
BorderColor = input.color(color.new(color.purple, 40), 'Border', inline='ORB bottom', group=_ORBcolors)
ShadeColor = input.color(color.new(color.white, 90), 'Background', inline='ORB bottom', group=_ORBcolors)
linesWidth = input.int(1, 'Width', minval=1, maxval=4, inline='ORB bottom', group=_ORBcolors)

// Check if the current time is within the defined sessions
inSession = not na(time(timeframe.period, ORBrange))
inExtend = not na(time(timeframe.period, ORBextend))

// Initialize variables to store indices and price levels for ORB
var int orbRangeStartIndex = na
var int orbExtendEndIndex = na
var float orbExtendEndTime = na
var orb_low = 0.0
var orb_high = 0.0
var box orbBox = na
var bool isOrbBoxCreated = false

// Initialize variables for Previous Day's High/Low lines
var line highLinePreviousDay = na
var line lowLinePreviousDay = na
var float highPreviousDay = na
var float lowPreviousDay = na

// Clear previous session's plots
if (session.isfirstbar)
    if (na(orbBox) == false)
        box.delete(orbBox)
    orbBox := na
    isOrbBoxCreated := false
    orbRangeStartIndex := na
    orbExtendEndIndex := na
    orb_low := 0.0
    orb_high := 0.0

    // Delete previous day's lines
    if (na(highLinePreviousDay) == false)
        line.delete(highLinePreviousDay)
    if (na(lowLinePreviousDay) == false)
        line.delete(lowLinePreviousDay)
    highLinePreviousDay := na
    lowLinePreviousDay := na

// Calculate and draw the ORB box at session start
if showORB and inSession and not inSession[1]
    orbRangeStartIndex := bar_index
    orb_low := low
    orb_high := high

if inExtend
    orbExtendEndIndex := bar_index

// Create the ORB box and set its properties
if showORB and inSession and not inSession[1]
    orbBox := box.new(left=orbRangeStartIndex, top=orb_high, right=orbExtendEndIndex, bottom=orb_low, border_color=BorderColor, border_width=linesWidth)
    box.set_bgcolor(orbBox, ShadeColor)
    isOrbBoxCreated := true

// Update ORB high and low within the session
if inSession
    if high > orb_high
        orb_high := high
        if isOrbBoxCreated
            box.set_top(orbBox, orb_high)
    if low < orb_low
        orb_low := low
        if isOrbBoxCreated
            box.set_bottom(orbBox, orb_low)

// Extend the ORB box to the end of the extend session
if inExtend and isOrbBoxCreated
    // Find the bar index for the end of the ORBextend session
    if na(orbExtendEndIndex) or time > orbExtendEndIndex
        orbExtendEndIndex := bar_index
    if time[1] < orbExtendEndTime and time >= orbExtendEndTime
        orbExtendEndIndex := bar_index

    // Set the right edge of the box to the end index of the ORBextend session
    box.set_right(orbBox, orbExtendEndIndex)
// End of Opening Range Break code

/// Starting Previous Day's High/Low
// Previous Day's High/Low Settings
// Group: Allows users to customize how they want to display the high/low levels from the previous trading day.
_PDHLGrp = "Previous Day High/lows"
showPreviousDayHigh  = input.bool(true, title='Enable PDH', inline='PD top', group= _PDHLGrp)
showPreviousDayLow   = input.bool(true, title='Enable PDL', inline='PD top', group= _PDHLGrp)
colorPDH = input.color(color.new(color.green, 0), title='PDH Color', inline='PD bottom', group= _PDHLGrp)
colorPDL = input.color(color.new(color.red, 0), title='PDL Color', inline='PD bottom', group= _PDHLGrp)

// This block calculates the previous day's high and low by fetching data from the daily timeframe.
highPreviousDay := request.security(syminfo.tickerid, 'D', high[1], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)
lowPreviousDay := request.security(syminfo.tickerid, 'D', low[1], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)

// Adjusting Line Extensions and Creating New Lines
if session.isfirstbar
    line.set_extend(highLinePreviousDay, extend.none)
    line.set_extend(lowLinePreviousDay, extend.none)

    if timeframe.isintraday
        if showPreviousDayHigh
            highLinePreviousDay := line.new(bar_index, highPreviousDay, bar_index, highPreviousDay, color=colorPDH, style=line.style_solid, width=1)
        if showPreviousDayLow
            lowLinePreviousDay := line.new(bar_index, lowPreviousDay, bar_index, lowPreviousDay, color=colorPDL, style=line.style_solid, width=1)

// Setting the End Point of the High and Low Lines
line.set_x2(highLinePreviousDay, bar_index)
line.set_x2(lowLinePreviousDay, bar_index)
// End of indicator script

items.author: VishalSubandh
items.source:
// This Pine Script™ code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
// © YourTradingViewUsername
// Opening Range Breakout with Range Quality Analysis

//@version=5
indicator("ORB Range Breakout [NSE/BSE]", overlay=true, max_lines_count=50, max_labels_count=20)

// ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
// DESCRIPTION:
// This indicator identifies the Opening Range (OR) during a user-defined session
// window and calculates breakout levels with targets based on the range size.
// 
// UNIQUE FEATURE: Range Quality Analysis
// The indicator compares today's OR to the instrument's Average True Range (ATR)
// to classify the range as Narrow, Normal, or Wide. This helps traders:
// - Narrow ranges often lead to stronger breakouts (compression before expansion)
// - Wide ranges may indicate gap days or news events requiring caution
// - Normal ranges provide typical breakout expectations
//
// HOW IT WORKS:
// 1. Captures High and Low during the Opening Range session (default: first 5 min)
// 2. Calculates range size and compares to 14-period ATR
// 3. Draws ORB High/Low levels after session ends
// 4. Projects targets at 1x, 1.5x, and 2x the range on breakout
// 5. Tracks first breakout direction for the day
// ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

// ─── INPUTS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// ORB Settings
grp_orb = "Opening Range Settings"
orbSession      = input.session("0915-0920", "ORB Session Window", tooltip="Define the time window for capturing the Opening Range. Default is first 5 minutes for Indian markets (NSE/BSE).", group=grp_orb)
orbHighColor    = input.color(color.new(#26a69a, 0), "ORB High Color", group=grp_orb)
orbLowColor     = input.color(color.new(#ef5350, 0), "ORB Low Color", group=grp_orb)
showMidline     = input.bool(true, "Show Midline", tooltip="The midline often acts as intraday support/resistance after breakout.", group=grp_orb)
midlineColor    = input.color(color.new(#ff9800, 50), "Midline Color", group=grp_orb)
orbBgColor      = input.color(color.new(color.blue, 92), "ORB Session Background", tooltip="Customize the background color during ORB session", group=grp_orb)

// Target Settings
grp_tgt = "Target Projection"
showTargets     = input.bool(true, "Show Targets on Breakout", group=grp_tgt)
target1x        = input.float(1.0, "Target 1 (x Range)", minval=0.5, maxval=3.0, step=0.1, group=grp_tgt)
target2x        = input.float(1.5, "Target 2 (x Range)", minval=0.5, maxval=5.0, step=0.1, group=grp_tgt)
target3x        = input.float(2.0, "Target 3 (x Range)", minval=1.0, maxval=5.0, step=0.1, group=grp_tgt)
targetColor     = input.color(color.new(#00bcd4, 30), "Target Lines Color", group=grp_tgt)

// Range Quality Analysis
grp_rqa = "Range Quality Analysis"
showRangeQuality = input.bool(true, "Show Range Quality", tooltip="Compares ORB range to ATR to classify as Narrow/Normal/Wide", group=grp_rqa)
atrLength       = input.int(14, "ATR Period for Comparison", minval=5, maxval=50, group=grp_rqa)
narrowThreshold = input.float(0.5, "Narrow Range (< x ATR)", minval=0.2, maxval=0.8, step=0.1, tooltip="Ranges below this ATR multiple are considered narrow (potential for strong breakout)", group=grp_rqa)
wideThreshold   = input.float(1.2, "Wide Range (> x ATR)", minval=1.0, maxval=2.0, step=0.1, tooltip="Ranges above this ATR multiple are considered wide (caution advised)", group=grp_rqa)

// Display
grp_disp = "Display Options"
showLabels      = input.bool(true, "Show Price Labels", group=grp_disp)
labelSize       = input.string("Small", "ORB Label Size", options=["Tiny", "Small", "Normal", "Large", "Huge"], tooltip="Size of ORB High/Mid/Low labels", group=grp_disp)
labelOffset     = input.int(1, "Label Offset (bars)", minval=0, maxval=50, tooltip="Horizontal distance of labels from the latest candle (in bars)", group=grp_disp)
showInfoPanel   = input.bool(true, "Show Info Panel", group=grp_disp)
tableSizeInput  = input.string("Small", "Info Table Size", options=["Auto", "Tiny", "Small", "Normal", "Large", "Huge"], tooltip="Text size in the info panel", group=grp_disp)
themeSelect     = input.string("Dark", "Info Panel Theme", options=["Dark", "Light"], tooltip="Color theme for the info panel", group=grp_disp)

// ─── HELPER FUNCTIONS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Convert label size string to size constant
getLabelSize(sizeStr) =>
    switch sizeStr
        "Tiny" => size.tiny
        "Small" => size.small
        "Normal" => size.normal
        "Large" => size.large
        "Huge" => size.huge
        => size.small

// Convert table size string to size constant
getTableSize(sizeStr) =>
    switch sizeStr
        "Auto" => size.auto
        "Tiny" => size.tiny
        "Small" => size.small
        "Normal" => size.normal
        "Large" => size.large
        "Huge" => size.huge
        => size.small

// Get theme colors
getThemeColors() =>
    if themeSelect == "Light"
        [color.new(color.white, 15), color.black, color.new(#e3e3e3, 30)]
    else
        [color.new(color.black, 85), color.white, color.new(color.blue, 70)]

// ─── CALCULATIONS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Timeframe validation - ORB works best on intraday charts
validTF = timeframe.isintraday

// Session detection
t = time(timeframe.period, orbSession + ":1234567")
inSession = not na(t)
isFirstBar = inSession and not inSession[1]
newDay = ta.change(time("D")) != 0

// ORB Level Tracking
var float orbHigh = na
var float orbLow = na

if isFirstBar
    orbHigh := high
    orbLow := low
else if inSession
    orbHigh := math.max(orbHigh, high)
    orbLow := math.min(orbLow, low)

// Derived values
orbMid = (orbHigh + orbLow) / 2
orbRange = orbHigh - orbLow
orbFormed = not inSession and not na(orbHigh)

// Range Quality Analysis using ATR
atrValue = ta.atr(atrLength)
rangeRatio = orbRange / atrValue

var string rangeQuality = "—"
var color rangeQualityColor = color.gray

if orbFormed and not na(atrValue) and atrValue > 0
    if rangeRatio < narrowThreshold
        rangeQuality := "NARROW"
        rangeQualityColor := color.new(#4caf50, 0)  // Green - potential strong breakout
    else if rangeRatio > wideThreshold
        rangeQuality := "WIDE"
        rangeQualityColor := color.new(#f44336, 0)  // Red - caution
    else
        rangeQuality := "NORMAL"
        rangeQualityColor := color.new(#2196f3, 0)  // Blue - typical

// Breakout Detection
var bool bullBreakout = false
var bool bearBreakout = false
var int breakoutBar = na
var string firstBreakoutDir = "None"

if newDay
    bullBreakout := false
    bearBreakout := false
    breakoutBar := na
    firstBreakoutDir := "None"

// Detect first breakout of the day
bullBreak = orbFormed and close > orbHigh and not bullBreakout
bearBreak = orbFormed and close < orbLow and not bearBreakout

if bullBreak
    bullBreakout := true
    breakoutBar := bar_index
    if firstBreakoutDir == "None"
        firstBreakoutDir := "BULL"

if bearBreak
    bearBreakout := true
    breakoutBar := bar_index
    if firstBreakoutDir == "None"
        firstBreakoutDir := "BEAR"

// Target Levels
t1Long = orbHigh + orbRange * target1x
t2Long = orbHigh + orbRange * target2x
t3Long = orbHigh + orbRange * target3x

t1Short = orbLow - orbRange * target1x
t2Short = orbLow - orbRange * target2x
t3Short = orbLow - orbRange * target3x

// ─── PLOTS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// ORB Levels (only after session ends)
plot(validTF and orbFormed ? orbHigh : na, "ORB High", orbHighColor, 2, plot.style_linebr)
plot(validTF and orbFormed ? orbLow : na, "ORB Low", orbLowColor, 2, plot.style_linebr)
plot(validTF and orbFormed and showMidline ? orbMid : na, "ORB Mid", midlineColor, 1, plot.style_linebr)

// Session highlight with customizable background color
bgcolor(inSession ? orbBgColor : na, title="ORB Session")

// Breakout signals
plotshape(bullBreak, "Bullish Breakout", shape.triangleup, location.belowbar, orbHighColor, size=size.small)
plotshape(bearBreak, "Bearish Breakout", shape.triangledown, location.abovebar, orbLowColor, size=size.small)

// ─── DYNAMIC LINES & LABELS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

var line t1LongLine = na, var line t2LongLine = na, var line t3LongLine = na
var line t1ShortLine = na, var line t2ShortLine = na, var line t3ShortLine = na
var label orbHighLbl = na, var label orbLowLbl = na, var label midLbl = na
var label t1Lbl = na, var label t2Lbl = na, var label t3Lbl = na

if barstate.islast and validTF and orbFormed
    // Clean up previous drawings
    line.delete(t1LongLine), line.delete(t2LongLine), line.delete(t3LongLine)
    line.delete(t1ShortLine), line.delete(t2ShortLine), line.delete(t3ShortLine)
    label.delete(orbHighLbl), label.delete(orbLowLbl), label.delete(midLbl)
    label.delete(t1Lbl), label.delete(t2Lbl), label.delete(t3Lbl)
    
    int startBar = bar_index - 30
    string selectedLabelSize = getLabelSize(labelSize)
    
    // Labels for ORB levels with customizable offset and size
    if showLabels
        orbHighLbl := label.new(bar_index + labelOffset, orbHigh, "ORB H: " + str.tostring(orbHigh, format.mintick), 
             style=label.style_label_left, color=color.new(orbHighColor, 85), textcolor=orbHighColor, size=selectedLabelSize)
        orbLowLbl := label.new(bar_index + labelOffset, orbLow, "ORB L: " + str.tostring(orbLow, format.mintick), 
             style=label.style_label_left, color=color.new(orbLowColor, 85), textcolor=orbLowColor, size=selectedLabelSize)
        if showMidline
            midLbl := label.new(bar_index + labelOffset, orbMid, "Mid: " + str.tostring(orbMid, format.mintick), 
                 style=label.style_label_left, color=color.new(midlineColor, 85), textcolor=midlineColor, size=selectedLabelSize)
    
    // Draw targets on bullish breakout
    if showTargets and bullBreakout
        t1LongLine := line.new(startBar, t1Long, bar_index, t1Long, color=targetColor, style=line.style_dashed)
        t2LongLine := line.new(startBar, t2Long, bar_index, t2Long, color=targetColor, style=line.style_dashed)
        t3LongLine := line.new(startBar, t3Long, bar_index, t3Long, color=targetColor, style=line.style_dashed)
        if showLabels
            t1Lbl := label.new(bar_index + labelOffset, t1Long, "T1: " + str.tostring(t1Long, format.mintick), 
                 style=label.style_label_left, color=color.new(targetColor, 85), textcolor=targetColor, size=size.tiny)
            t2Lbl := label.new(bar_index + labelOffset, t2Long, "T2: " + str.tostring(t2Long, format.mintick), 
                 style=label.style_label_left, color=color.new(targetColor, 85), textcolor=targetColor, size=size.tiny)
            t3Lbl := label.new(bar_index + labelOffset, t3Long, "T3: " + str.tostring(t3Long, format.mintick), 
                 style=label.style_label_left, color=color.new(targetColor, 85), textcolor=targetColor, size=size.tiny)
    
    // Draw targets on bearish breakout
    if showTargets and bearBreakout
        t1ShortLine := line.new(startBar, t1Short, bar_index, t1Short, color=targetColor, style=line.style_dashed)
        t2ShortLine := line.new(startBar, t2Short, bar_index, t2Short, color=targetColor, style=line.style_dashed)
        t3ShortLine := line.new(startBar, t3Short, bar_index, t3Short, color=targetColor, style=line.style_dashed)
        if showLabels
            t1Lbl := label.new(bar_index + labelOffset, t1Short, "T1: " + str.tostring(t1Short, format.mintick), 
                 style=label.style_label_left, color=color.new(targetColor, 85), textcolor=targetColor, size=size.tiny)
            t2Lbl := label.new(bar_index + labelOffset, t2Short, "T2: " + str.tostring(t2Short, format.mintick), 
                 style=label.style_label_left, color=color.new(targetColor, 85), textcolor=targetColor, size=size.tiny)
            t3Lbl := label.new(bar_index + labelOffset, t3Short, "T3: " + str.tostring(t3Short, format.mintick), 
                 style=label.style_label_left, color=color.new(targetColor, 85), textcolor=targetColor, size=size.tiny)

// ─── INFO PANEL ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

var table infoPanel = na

if showInfoPanel and validTF and barstate.islast and orbFormed
    table.delete(infoPanel)
    
    color boColor = firstBreakoutDir == "BULL" ? orbHighColor : firstBreakoutDir == "BEAR" ? orbLowColor : color.gray
    
    // Get theme colors
    [bgColor, textColor, headerBg] = getThemeColors()
    string selectedTableSize = getTableSize(tableSizeInput)
    
    infoPanel := table.new(position.top_right, 2, 5, bgcolor=bgColor, border_width=1, border_color=themeSelect == "Light" ? color.gray : color.new(color.gray, 50))
    
    table.cell(infoPanel, 0, 0, "ORB LEVELS", text_color=themeSelect == "Light" ? color.black : color.white, text_size=selectedTableSize, bgcolor=headerBg)
    table.merge_cells(infoPanel, 0, 0, 1, 0)
    
    table.cell(infoPanel, 0, 1, "Range", text_color=textColor, text_size=selectedTableSize)
    table.cell(infoPanel, 1, 1, str.tostring(orbRange, format.mintick), text_color=textColor, text_size=selectedTableSize)
    
    table.cell(infoPanel, 0, 2, "Quality", text_color=textColor, text_size=selectedTableSize)
    table.cell(infoPanel, 1, 2, showRangeQuality ? rangeQuality : "—", text_color=rangeQualityColor, text_size=selectedTableSize)
    
    table.cell(infoPanel, 0, 3, "Range/ATR", text_color=textColor, text_size=selectedTableSize)
    table.cell(infoPanel, 1, 3, str.tostring(rangeRatio, "#.##") + "x", text_color=textColor, text_size=selectedTableSize)
    
    table.cell(infoPanel, 0, 4, "Breakout", text_color=textColor, text_size=selectedTableSize)
    table.cell(infoPanel, 1, 4, firstBreakoutDir, text_color=boColor, text_size=selectedTableSize)

// ─── ALERTS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

alertcondition(bullBreak, "ORB Bullish Breakout", "Price broke above ORB High")
alertcondition(bearBreak, "ORB Bearish Breakout", "Price broke below ORB Low")

// Target hit alerts
t1Hit = (bullBreakout and ta.crossover(high, t1Long)) or (bearBreakout and ta.crossunder(low, t1Short))
t2Hit = (bullBreakout and ta.crossover(high, t2Long)) or (bearBreakout and ta.crossunder(low, t2Short))

alertcondition(t1Hit, "ORB Target 1 Hit", "Price reached Target 1")
alertcondition(t2Hit, "ORB Target 2 Hit", "Price reached Target 2")

items.source:
//@version=5
strategy('ORB Strategy [LuciTech]',
 overlay=true,
 max_bars_back=500,
 max_lines_count=500,
 max_boxes_count=500,
 initial_capital=100000,
 default_qty_type=strategy.percent_of_equity,
 default_qty_value=100)

//---Strategy Settings---
sltip = 'Defines the stop-loss length based on candles. 0 means 1 candle, 1 means 2 candles, and so on.'
betip = 'Enter the R multiple at which the stop loss moves to breakeven. 0 means breakeven is disabled.'
rrtip = 'The risk-reward ratio determines the relationship between potential reward and risk. For example, 3 means risking 1 unit to gain 3 units.'
risk_percent_tip = 'The percentage of your equity that you are willing to risk per trade.'
sl_type_tip = 'Choose the stop-loss calculation type: ATR-based, Candle-based, or Midline (ORB midpoint).'
ATRlength_tip = 'The number of periods used to calculate the Average True Range (ATR).'
smoothing_tip = 'Choose the smoothing method for ATR: RMA, SMA, EMA, or WMA.'
ATRlines_tip = 'Enable or disable plotting of ATR-based stop-loss lines.'
fillcolour_tip = 'Select the background color to visually indicate the active time filter range on the chart.'
time_filter_tip = 'Enable or disable the time filter. When disabled, trades can occur at any time.'
day_filter_tip = 'Enable or disable the day filter. When enabled, trades only occur on selected days of the week.'

//Time filter inputs
use_time_filter = input.bool(false, title="Use Time Filter", group = 'Time Filter', tooltip=time_filter_tip)
start_hour   = input.int(defval=0,  title='Start Hour (24h)', minval=0, maxval=23, group = 'Time Filter')
start_minute = input.int(defval=59, title='Start Minute',     minval=0, maxval=59, group = 'Time Filter')
end_hour     = input.int(defval=23, title='End Hour (24h)',   minval=0, maxval=23, group = 'Time Filter')
end_minute   = input.int(defval=59, title='End Minute',       minval=0, maxval=59, group = 'Time Filter')
showFill  = input.bool(defval=false, title="Fill Background", inline='colour1', group='Time Filter')
fillColor = input.color(color.rgb(192, 192, 192, 90), title='', inline='colour1', group='Time Filter')

//Day Filter Inputs
use_day_filter = input.bool(false, title="Use Day Filter", group='Day Filter', tooltip=day_filter_tip)
monday    = input.bool(true,  title="Monday",    inline="days1", group='Day Filter')
tuesday   = input.bool(true,  title="Tuesday",   inline="days1", group='Day Filter')
wednesday = input.bool(true,  title="Wednesday", inline="days1", group='Day Filter')
thursday  = input.bool(true,  title="Thursday",  inline="days2", group='Day Filter')
friday    = input.bool(true,  title="Friday",    inline="days2", group='Day Filter')
saturday  = input.bool(false, title="Saturday",  inline="days3", group='Day Filter')
sunday    = input.bool(false, title="Sunday",    inline="days3", group='Day Filter')

//Monthly Filter Inputs
use_month_filter = input.bool(false, title="Use Month Filter", group='Month Filter', tooltip="Enable to restrict trading to specific months")
january   = input.bool(true, title="January",   inline="months1", group='Month Filter')
february  = input.bool(true, title="February",  inline="months1", group='Month Filter')
march     = input.bool(true, title="March",     inline="months1", group='Month Filter')
april     = input.bool(true, title="April",     inline="months2", group='Month Filter')
may       = input.bool(true, title="May",       inline="months2", group='Month Filter')
june      = input.bool(true, title="June",      inline="months2", group='Month Filter')
july      = input.bool(true, title="July",      inline="months3", group='Month Filter')
august    = input.bool(true, title="August",    inline="months3", group='Month Filter')
september = input.bool(true, title="September", inline="months3", group='Month Filter')
october   = input.bool(true, title="October",   inline="months4", group='Month Filter')
november  = input.bool(true, title="November",  inline="months4", group='Month Filter')
december  = input.bool(true, title="December",  inline="months4", group='Month Filter')

//Position Type Filter Inputs
use_position_filter  = input.bool(false, title="Use Position Type Filter", group='Position Type', tooltip="Enable to restrict trading to specific position types")
allow_long  = input.bool(true, title="Allow Long",  inline="positions", group='Position Type')
allow_short = input.bool(true, title="Allow Short", inline="positions", group='Position Type')

//Risk Management Inputs
risk_percent = input.float(2, title="Risk %", minval=0.1, maxval=100, group='Risk Management', tooltip=risk_percent_tip) / 100
Risk_reward  = input.float(defval=2, title='Risk:Reward', minval=1, maxval=10, step=0.1, group='Risk Management', tooltip=rrtip)
breakeven    = input.float(0, title="Breakeven at R", minval=0.0, step=0.1, group='Risk Management', tooltip=betip)
sl_type      = input.string("ATR", title="Stop Loss Type", options=["ATR", "Candle", "Midline"], group='Risk Management', tooltip=sl_type_tip)
SL_length    = input(0, title='Candle Length', group='Risk Management', tooltip=sltip)
ATRlength    = input.int(title='ATR length', defval=14, minval=1, group='Risk Management', tooltip=ATRlength_tip)
smoothing    = input.string(title='ATR Smoothing/ATR Lines', defval='SMA', options=['RMA', 'SMA', 'EMA', 'WMA'], group='Risk Management', tooltip=smoothing_tip)
ATRlines     = input(false, 'Show ATR Lines', group='Risk Management', tooltip=ATRlines_tip)
ATRmulti     = input.float(0, title='ATRMulti', group='Risk Management', tooltip=sltip, step=0.1)

// === Relative Volume Filter ===
use_rvol_filter  = input.bool(false, title="Use RVOL Filter", group='Relative Volume', tooltip="Only allow entries when current bar volume exceeds the average by the set multiplier")
rvol_length      = input.int(20, title="RVOL Lookback (bars)", minval=2, group='Relative Volume', tooltip="Number of bars used to calculate the average volume baseline")
rvol_threshold   = input.float(1.5, title="Minimum RVOL", minval=0.1, step=0.1, group='Relative Volume', tooltip="Entry is only allowed when volume / avg_volume >= this value. e.g. 1.5 = 50% above average")
rvol_show_label  = input.bool(false, title="Show RVOL Value on Signal Bar", group='Relative Volume', tooltip="Displays the RVOL ratio on the chart at each breakout bar for debugging/review")

//Position Colour Inputs
entrypricecolour = input.color(color.rgb(244, 244, 244, 75), title='Entry/SL/TP', group='Style', inline='peb')
stoplosscolour   = input.color(color.rgb(255, 0, 0, 75),     title='',            group='Style', inline='peb')
takeprofitcolour = input.color(color.rgb(0, 255, 0, 75),     title='',            group='Style', inline='peb')

// Alert Settings Group
group_alert = "Alert Settings"
use_webhook_alerts = input.bool(true, "Use Webhook Alerts", group=group_alert, tooltip="Enable to send webhook alerts with trade information in JSON format")
webhook_format     = input.string("Concise Telegram", title="Webhook Format", options=["Standard", "Telegram", "Concise Telegram"], group=group_alert)
telegram_chat_id   = input.string("tele chatid", title="Telegram Chat ID", group=group_alert)

// --- ATR ---
ma_function(source, ATRlength) =>
    if smoothing == 'RMA'
        ta.rma(source, ATRlength)
    else if smoothing == 'SMA'
        ta.sma(source, ATRlength)
    else if smoothing == 'EMA'
        ta.ema(source, ATRlength)
    else
        ta.wma(source, ATRlength)

a  = ma_function(ta.tr(true), ATRlength) * ATRmulti
x  = ma_function(ta.tr(true), ATRlength) * ATRmulti + high
x2 = low - ma_function(ta.tr(true), ATRlength) * ATRmulti
p1 = plot(ATRlines ? x  : na, title='ATR Short Stop Loss', color=stoplosscolour,   trackprice=ATRlines)
p2 = plot(ATRlines ? x2 : na, title='ATR Long Stop Loss',  color=takeprofitcolour, trackprice=ATRlines)

// --- Relative Volume Calculation ---
// avg_volume uses a simple moving average of the previous `rvol_length` bars (excludes current bar)
avg_volume = ta.sma(volume, rvol_length)
rvol       = avg_volume > 0 ? volume / avg_volume : 1.0
rvol_pass  = not use_rvol_filter or rvol >= rvol_threshold

// Time filter
is_within_time_window() =>
    current_time = time('1', 'America/New_York')
    start_time = timestamp(year(current_time), month(current_time), dayofmonth(current_time), start_hour, start_minute, 0)
    end_time   = timestamp(year(current_time), month(current_time), dayofmonth(current_time), end_hour,   end_minute,   0)
    current_time >= start_time and current_time <= end_time

// Day filter
is_valid_trading_day() =>
    current_day = dayofweek(time)
    day_allowed = false
    if current_day == 2 and monday
        day_allowed := true
    else if current_day == 3 and tuesday
        day_allowed := true
    else if current_day == 4 and wednesday
        day_allowed := true
    else if current_day == 5 and thursday
        day_allowed := true
    else if current_day == 6 and friday
        day_allowed := true
    else if current_day == 7 and saturday
        day_allowed := true
    else if current_day == 1 and sunday
        day_allowed := true
    day_allowed

// Month filter
is_valid_trading_month() =>
    current_month = month(time)
    month_allowed = false
    if current_month == 1  and january
        month_allowed := true
    else if current_month == 2  and february
        month_allowed := true
    else if current_month == 3  and march
        month_allowed := true
    else if current_month == 4  and april
        month_allowed := true
    else if current_month == 5  and may
        month_allowed := true
    else if current_month == 6  and june
        month_allowed := true
    else if current_month == 7  and july
        month_allowed := true
    else if current_month == 8  and august
        month_allowed := true
    else if current_month == 9  and september
        month_allowed := true
    else if current_month == 10 and october
        month_allowed := true
    else if current_month == 11 and november
        month_allowed := true
    else if current_month == 12 and december
        month_allowed := true
    month_allowed

// Position type filter
is_valid_position_type(direction) =>
    position_allowed = false
    if direction == "LONG"  and allow_long
        position_allowed := true
    else if direction == "SHORT" and allow_short
        position_allowed := true
    position_allowed

// Combine filters
in_standard_time_range  = not use_time_filter    or is_within_time_window()
in_valid_day            = not use_day_filter      or is_valid_trading_day()
in_valid_month          = not use_month_filter    or is_valid_trading_month()
in_valid_position_long  = not use_position_filter or is_valid_position_type("LONG")
in_valid_position_short = not use_position_filter or is_valid_position_type("SHORT")
inTimeRange = in_standard_time_range and in_valid_day and in_valid_month

var color bgColor = na
bgColor := showFill and use_time_filter and is_within_time_window() ? fillColor : na
bgcolor(bgColor)

// === ORB Inputs ===
highColor    = input.color(color.green, "High Line Color")
lowColor     = input.color(color.red,   "Low Line Color")
midlineColor = input.color(color.white, "Midline Color")
linewidth    = input.int(2, "Line Width", minval=1, maxval=4)
showHistory  = input.bool(true, "Show Previous ORBs")
maxSavedOrbs = input.int(5, "Show previous number of ORBs")

// === ORB Time Logic ===
startTime  = timestamp("America/New_York", year, month, dayofmonth, 9, 30)
endTime    = timestamp("America/New_York", year, month, dayofmonth, 9, 45)
cutoffTime = timestamp("America/New_York", year, month, dayofmonth, 11, 0)
inSession  = time >= startTime and time < endTime
pastCutoff = time >= cutoffTime

// === Arrays ===
var line[] orbHighLines = array.new_line()
var line[] orbLowLines  = array.new_line()
var line[] orbMidLines  = array.new_line()
var line[] fibLines     = array.new_line()

// === ORB Variables ===
var float sessionHigh      = na
var float sessionLow       = na
var float mid              = na
var int   orb_index        = na
var line  liveHighLine     = na
var line  liveLowLine      = na
var line  liveMidLine      = na
var int   start_index      = na
var bool  sessionFinalized = false
var bool  bullFired        = false
var bool  bearFired        = false
var line  prevHighLine     = na
var line  prevLowLine      = na

prevHigh = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "D", high[1])
prevLow  = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "D", low[1])

if dayofmonth != dayofmonth[1]
    start_index := bar_index

if not inSession[1] and inSession
    bullFired := false
    bearFired := false

if not inSession[1] and inSession and showHistory
    finalHigh = line.new(x1=orb_index, y1=sessionHigh, x2=bar_index-1, y2=sessionHigh, color=highColor,    width=linewidth, style=line.style_solid)
    finalLow  = line.new(x1=orb_index, y1=sessionLow,  x2=bar_index-1, y2=sessionLow,  color=lowColor,     width=linewidth, style=line.style_solid)
    finalMid  = line.new(x1=orb_index, y1=mid,          x2=bar_index-1, y2=mid,          color=midlineColor, width=linewidth, style=line.style_solid)
    array.push(orbHighLines, finalHigh)
    array.push(orbLowLines,  finalLow)
    array.push(orbMidLines,  finalMid)
    if array.size(orbHighLines) > maxSavedOrbs
        line.delete(array.shift(orbHighLines))
        line.delete(array.shift(orbLowLines))
        line.delete(array.shift(orbMidLines))

if not inSession[1] and inSession
    orb_index        := bar_index
    sessionHigh      := na
    sessionLow       := na
    mid              := na
    sessionFinalized := false
    line.delete(liveHighLine)
    line.delete(liveLowLine)
    line.delete(liveMidLine)
    liveHighLine := na
    liveLowLine  := na
    liveMidLine  := na

if inSession
    sessionHigh := na(sessionHigh) ? high : math.max(sessionHigh, high)
    sessionLow  := na(sessionLow)  ? low  : math.min(sessionLow,  low)
    mid         := (sessionHigh + sessionLow) / 2
    line.delete(liveHighLine)
    line.delete(liveLowLine)
    line.delete(liveMidLine)
    liveHighLine := line.new(x1=orb_index, y1=sessionHigh, x2=bar_index+2, y2=sessionHigh, color=highColor,    width=linewidth)
    liveLowLine  := line.new(x1=orb_index, y1=sessionLow,  x2=bar_index+2, y2=sessionLow,  color=lowColor,     width=linewidth)
    liveMidLine  := line.new(x1=orb_index, y1=mid,         x2=bar_index+2, y2=mid,          color=midlineColor, width=linewidth)

if not inSession
    line.set_x2(liveHighLine, bar_index+2)
    line.set_x2(liveLowLine,  bar_index+2)
    line.set_x2(liveMidLine,  bar_index+2)

// === Breakout Signals (visuals — RVOL not required for arrows, only for entries) ===
orbLevelsReady = not na(sessionHigh) and not na(sessionLow) and not na(mid) and not inSession and not pastCutoff

bullBreakout = orbLevelsReady and not bullFired and close > sessionHigh and close[1] <= sessionHigh
if bullBreakout
    bullFired := true

bearBreakout = orbLevelsReady and not bearFired and close < sessionLow and close[1] >= sessionLow
if bearBreakout
    bearFired := true

plotshape(bullBreakout, title="Bull ORB Break", style=shape.triangleup,   location=location.belowbar, color=color.green, size=size.small)
plotshape(bearBreakout, title="Bear ORB Break", style=shape.triangledown, location=location.abovebar, color=color.red,   size=size.small)

// Optional RVOL label on signal bars (shows ratio for easy tuning)
if rvol_show_label and (bullBreakout or bearBreakout)
    label.new(bar_index, bullBreakout ? low : high,
     text  = "RVOL: " + str.tostring(rvol, "#.##"),
     style = bullBreakout ? label.style_label_up : label.style_label_down,
     color = rvol_pass ? color.new(color.green, 60) : color.new(color.red, 60),
     textcolor = color.white,
     size  = size.small)

// === Strategy Signal Integration (RVOL gates entries but not arrows) ===
longCondition  = inTimeRange and bullBreakout and in_valid_position_long  and rvol_pass
shortCondition = inTimeRange and bearBreakout and in_valid_position_short and rvol_pass

// === Strategy Position Management ===
var float stop_level         = na
var float target_level       = na
var float entry_price        = na
var float initial_stop       = na
var bool  moved_to_breakeven = false
var box   current_bull_box        = na
var box   current_bear_box        = na
var box   current_second_bull_box = na
var box   current_second_bear_box = na

calculate_position_size(stop_distance) =>
    if stop_distance > 0
        risk_amount   = strategy.equity * risk_percent
        position_size = risk_amount / stop_distance
        math.floor(position_size / syminfo.mintick) * syminfo.mintick
    else
        na

create_alert_message(direction, sl_price, tp_price) =>
    '{"type":"' + direction + '","instrument":"' + syminfo.ticker + '","sl":' + str.tostring(sl_price, "#.#####") + ',"tp":' + str.tostring(tp_price, "#.#####") + '}'

create_telegram_alert_message(direction, sl_price, tp_price) =>
    header = direction == "BUY" ? "🟢BUY SIGNAL" : "🔴SELL SIGNAL"
    y   = str.tostring(year)
    m   = str.tostring(month)
    d   = str.tostring(dayofmonth)
    h   = str.tostring(hour)
    min = str.tostring(minute)
    m   := str.length(m)   == 1 ? "0" + m   : m
    d   := str.length(d)   == 1 ? "0" + d   : d
    h   := str.length(h)   == 1 ? "0" + h   : h
    min := str.length(min) == 1 ? "0" + min : min
    datetime_str = y + "-" + m + "-" + d + " " + h + ":" + min
    '{"chat_id": "' + telegram_chat_id + '", "text": "' + header + '\\n\\n{[' + syminfo.prefix + ']:[' + syminfo.ticker + '], price = [' + str.tostring(close, "#.#####") + ']}\\nDateTime = [' + datetime_str + ']\\nSL: ' + str.tostring(sl_price, "#.#####") + '\\nTP: ' + str.tostring(tp_price, "#.#####") + '"}'

create_concise_telegram_alert_message(direction, sl_price, tp_price) =>
    header = direction == "BUY" ? "🟢BUY " : "🔴SELL "
    '{"chat_id": "' + telegram_chat_id + '", "text": "' + header + syminfo.ticker + '\\nPRICE = ' + str.tostring(close, "#.#####") + '\\nSL: ' + str.tostring(sl_price, "#.#####") + '\\nTP: ' + str.tostring(tp_price, "#.#####") + '"}'

if strategy.position_size == 0
    moved_to_breakeven := false

    if longCondition
        stop_level := switch sl_type
            "ATR"     => x2
            "Candle"  => low[SL_length]
            "Midline" => mid
            => low[SL_length]
        initial_stop  := stop_level
        stop_distance  = close - stop_level
        target_level  := close + (Risk_reward * stop_distance)
        position_size  = calculate_position_size(stop_distance)
        if use_webhook_alerts
            alert_message = switch webhook_format
                "Telegram"         => create_telegram_alert_message("BUY", stop_level, target_level)
                "Concise Telegram" => create_concise_telegram_alert_message("BUY", stop_level, target_level)
                => create_alert_message("BUY", stop_level, target_level)
            alert(alert_message, alert.freq_once_per_bar)
        if not na(position_size) and position_size > 0
            strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long, qty=position_size)
            strategy.exit("Exit Long", "Long", stop=stop_level, limit=target_level)
            entry_price := close

    if shortCondition
        stop_level := switch sl_type
            "ATR"     => x
            "Candle"  => high[SL_length]
            "Midline" => mid
            => high[SL_length]
        initial_stop  := stop_level
        stop_distance  = stop_level - close
        target_level  := close - (Risk_reward * stop_distance)
        position_size  = calculate_position_size(stop_distance)
        if use_webhook_alerts
            alert_message = switch webhook_format
                "Telegram"         => create_telegram_alert_message("SELL", stop_level, target_level)
                "Concise Telegram" => create_concise_telegram_alert_message("SELL", stop_level, target_level)
                => create_alert_message("SELL", stop_level, target_level)
            alert(alert_message, alert.freq_once_per_bar)
        if not na(position_size) and position_size > 0
            strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short, qty=position_size)
            strategy.exit("Exit Short", "Short", stop=stop_level, limit=target_level)
            entry_price := close

// Breakeven logic
if breakeven > 0 and strategy.position_size != 0
    initial_risk = math.abs(entry_price - initial_stop)
    if strategy.position_size > 0
        current_profit = high - entry_price
        if current_profit >= (breakeven * initial_risk) and not moved_to_breakeven
            moved_to_breakeven := true
            strategy.cancel("Exit Long")
            stop_level := entry_price
            strategy.exit("Exit Long", "Long", stop=entry_price, limit=target_level)
    if strategy.position_size < 0
        current_profit = entry_price - low
        if current_profit >= (breakeven * initial_risk) and not moved_to_breakeven
            moved_to_breakeven := true
            strategy.cancel("Exit Short")
            stop_level := entry_price
            strategy.exit("Exit Short", "Short", stop=entry_price, limit=target_level)

// Plotting
plot(strategy.position_size != 0 ? entry_price  : na, title="Entry Price", color=entrypricecolour, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(strategy.position_size != 0 ? stop_level   : na, title="Stop Loss",   color=stoplosscolour,   style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(strategy.position_size != 0 ? target_level : na, title="Take Profit", color=takeprofitcolour, style=plot.style_linebr)

var int fill_extension = 0
plot_entry    = plot(strategy.position_size != 0 ? entry_price : na, "Entry for SL Fill", display=display.none, offset=fill_extension)
plot_sl       = plot(strategy.position_size != 0 ? stop_level  : na, "SL for Fill",       display=display.none)
fill(plot_entry, plot_sl, color=strategy.position_size != 0 ? stoplosscolour : na)

plot_entry_tp = plot(strategy.position_size != 0 ? entry_price  : na, "Entry for TP Fill", display=display.none, offset=fill_extension)
plot_tp       = plot(strategy.position_size != 0 ? target_level : na, "TP for Fill",       display=display.none)
fill(plot_entry_tp, plot_tp, color=strategy.position_size != 0 ? takeprofitcolour : na)

indicator(title='NY Opening Range (Enhanced with LTF)', shorttitle='NY ORB', overlay=true, max_lines_count=500, max_labels_count=500, max_boxes_count=500, max_bars_back=5000)

//-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Inputs - 5-Minute ORB
//-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
var g_5MIN = "━━━━━━━━━ 5-MINUTE ORB ━━━━━━━━━"
show_5min = input.bool(true, "Show 5-Minute ORB", group=g_5MIN)

bullish_fill_5m = input.color(color.rgb(0, 255, 149, 85), "Bullish Fill", inline="5mf", group=g_5MIN)
bearish_fill_5m = input.color(color.rgb(195, 0, 255, 85), "Bearish Fill", inline="5mf", group=g_5MIN)

// 5-min Line Styles

show_midLine_5m = input.bool(true, "Show Midline", inline="5mid", group=g_5MIN)
lineStyle_5m = input.string("Dashed", "Style", options=["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], inline="5mid", group=g_5MIN)
lineWidth_5m = input.int(1, 'Width', 1, 10, inline="5mid", group=g_5MIN)

// 5-min Median Extensions

show_ext_labels_5m = input.bool(true, "Show Extension Labels", group=g_5MIN)

// 5-min LTF Candles
show_ltf_5m = input.bool(true, "Show LTF Candles", group=g_5MIN)
ltf_5m_count = input.int(5, "  └─ Number of Candles", minval=1, maxval=20, group=g_5MIN)
ltf_offset_5m = input.int(5, "  └─ Offset (bars from right)", minval=1, maxval=100, group=g_5MIN)
