    if na(londonHi) or high > londonHi
        londonHi := high
        londonHiBar := bar_index
    if na(londonLo) or low < londonLo
        londonLo := low
        londonLoBar := bar_index

if showLondon and inLondonWindow and not na(londonHi)
    if na(londonHiLiveLine)
        londonHiLiveLine := line.new(londonHiBar, londonHi, bar_index, londonHi, color = londonColor, style = line.style_dotted, width = 1)
        londonLoLiveLine := line.new(londonLoBar, londonLo, bar_index, londonLo, color = londonColor, style = line.style_dotted, width = 1)
        londonHiLiveLabel := label.new(bar_index, londonHi, "London.H", style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(color.black, 100), textcolor = londonColor, size = liqTextSizeVal)
        londonLoLiveLabel := label.new(bar_index, londonLo, "London.L", style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(color.black, 100), textcolor = londonColor, size = liqTextSizeVal)
    line.set_xy1(londonHiLiveLine, londonHiBar, londonHi)
    line.set_xy2(londonHiLiveLine, bar_index, londonHi)
    line.set_xy1(londonLoLiveLine, londonLoBar, londonLo)
    line.set_xy2(londonLoLiveLine, bar_index, londonLo)
    label.set_x(londonHiLiveLabel, bar_index)
    label.set_y(londonHiLiveLabel, londonHi)
    label.set_x(londonLoLiveLabel, bar_index)
    label.set_y(londonLoLiveLabel, londonLo)

if showLondon and not inLondonWindow and not na(londonHiLiveLine)
    line.delete(londonHiLiveLine)
    line.delete(londonLoLiveLine)
    label.delete(londonHiLiveLabel)
    label.delete(londonLoLiveLabel)
    londonHiLiveLine := na
    londonLoLiveLine := na

if showLondon and not inLondonWindow and not londonLocked and not na(londonHi)
    londonLocked := true
    londonHiLine := line.new(londonHiBar, londonHi, bar_index + lineExtendBars, londonHi, color = londonColor, style = line.style_solid, width = 1)
    londonLoLine := line.new(londonLoBar, londonLo, bar_index + lineExtendBars, londonLo, color = londonColor, style = line.style_solid, width = 1)
    londonHiLabel := label.new(bar_index + lineExtendBars, londonHi, "London.H", style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(color.black, 100), textcolor = londonColor, size = liqTextSizeVal)
    londonLoLabel := label.new(bar_index + lineExtendBars, londonLo, "London.L", style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(color.black, 100), textcolor = londonColor, size = liqTextSizeVal)
    array.push(londonHiLineHist, londonHiLine)
    array.push(londonLoLineHist, londonLoLine)
    array.push(londonHiLabelHist, londonHiLabel)
    array.push(londonLoLabelHist, londonLoLabel)
    pruneLines(londonHiLineHist, maxLiqKeep)
    pruneLines(londonLoLineHist, maxLiqKeep)
    pruneLabels(londonHiLabelHist, maxLiqKeep)
    pruneLabels(londonLoLabelHist, maxLiqKeep)

if londonLocked and not londonHiTested and high >= londonHi
    londonHiTested := true
    line.set_color(londonHiLine, color.new(londonColor, testedAlpha))
    label.set_textcolor(londonHiLabel, color.new(londonColor, testedAlpha))

if londonLocked and not londonLoTested and low <= londonLo
    londonLoTested := true
    line.set_color(londonLoLine, color.new(londonColor, testedAlpha))
    label.set_textcolor(londonLoLabel, color.new(londonColor, testedAlpha))

if showLondon
    extendLineHist(londonHiLineHist, bar_index + lineExtendBars)
    extendLineHist(londonLoLineHist, bar_index + lineExtendBars)
    extendLabelHist(londonHiLabelHist, bar_index + lineExtendBars)
    extendLabelHist(londonLoLabelHist, bar_index + lineExtendBars)

if not showLondon and array.size(londonHiLineHist) > 0
    pruneLines(londonHiLineHist, 0)
    pruneLines(londonLoLineHist, 0)
    pruneLabels(londonHiLabelHist, 0)
    pruneLabels(londonLoLabelHist, 0)
    londonHiLine := na
    londonLoLine := na

// --- NY session (previous session's range — today's NY session is the
// active trading window for this indicator itself, so the displayed
// level is always the most recently completed NY session) ---
nyStartMinutes = localToEstMinutes(nyStartHour, nyStartMin)
nyEndMinutes   = localToEstMinutes(nyEndHour, nyEndMin)
inNyWindow = nyStartMinutes > nyEndMinutes ? (estTimeInMinutes >= nyStartMinutes or estTimeInMinutes < nyEndMinutes) : (estTimeInMinutes >= nyStartMinutes and estTimeInMinutes < nyEndMinutes)

var line nyStartVLine = na
var line nyEndVLine = na

var float nyHi = na
var float nyLo = na
var int   nyHiBar = na
var int   nyLoBar = na
var bool  nyLocked = false
var bool  nyHiTested = false
var bool  nyLoTested = false
var line  nyHiLine = na
var line  nyLoLine = na
var label nyHiLabel = na
var label nyLoLabel = na
var array<line>  nyHiLineHist = array.new<line>()
var array<line>  nyLoLineHist = array.new<line>()
var array<label> nyHiLabelHist = array.new<label>()
var array<label> nyLoLabelHist = array.new<label>()
var line  nyHiLiveLine = na
var line  nyLoLiveLine = na
var label nyHiLiveLabel = na
var label nyLoLiveLabel = na

if showNY and showSessionVLines and inNyWindow and not inNyWindow[1]
    line.delete(nyStartVLine)
    line.delete(nyEndVLine)
    nyStartVLine := line.new(bar_index, low, bar_index, high, extend = extend.both, color = nyColor, style = vlineStyleVal, width = vlineWidth)

if showNY and inNyWindow and not inNyWindow[1]
    relabelPrev(nyHiLabelHist, "P.NY.H")
    relabelPrev(nyLoLabelHist, "P.NY.L")
    pruneLines(nyHiLineHist, math.max(maxLiqKeep - 1, 0))
    pruneLines(nyLoLineHist, math.max(maxLiqKeep - 1, 0))
    pruneLabels(nyHiLabelHist, math.max(maxLiqKeep - 1, 0))
    pruneLabels(nyLoLabelHist, math.max(maxLiqKeep - 1, 0))

if showNY and showSessionVLines and not inNyWindow and inNyWindow[1]
    nyEndVLine := line.new(bar_index, low, bar_index, high, extend = extend.both, color = nyColor, style = vlineStyleVal, width = vlineWidth)

if not showSessionVLines and (not na(nyStartVLine) or not na(nyEndVLine))
    line.delete(nyStartVLine)
    line.delete(nyEndVLine)
    nyStartVLine := na
    nyEndVLine := na

if inNyWindow
    if nyLocked
        nyHi := na
        nyLo := na
        nyHiBar := na
        nyLoBar := na
        nyLocked := false
        nyHiTested := false
        nyLoTested := false
    if na(nyHi) or high > nyHi
        nyHi := high
        nyHiBar := bar_index
    if na(nyLo) or low < nyLo
        nyLo := low
        nyLoBar := bar_index

if showNY and inNyWindow and not na(nyHi)
    if na(nyHiLiveLine)
        nyHiLiveLine := line.new(nyHiBar, nyHi, bar_index, nyHi, color = nyColor, style = line.style_dotted, width = 1)
        nyLoLiveLine := line.new(nyLoBar, nyLo, bar_index, nyLo, color = nyColor, style = line.style_dotted, width = 1)
        nyHiLiveLabel := label.new(bar_index, nyHi, "NY.H", style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(color.black, 100), textcolor = nyColor, size = liqTextSizeVal)
        nyLoLiveLabel := label.new(bar_index, nyLo, "NY.L", style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(color.black, 100), textcolor = nyColor, size = liqTextSizeVal)
    line.set_xy1(nyHiLiveLine, nyHiBar, nyHi)
    line.set_xy2(nyHiLiveLine, bar_index, nyHi)
    line.set_xy1(nyLoLiveLine, nyLoBar, nyLo)
    line.set_xy2(nyLoLiveLine, bar_index, nyLo)
    label.set_x(nyHiLiveLabel, bar_index)
    label.set_y(nyHiLiveLabel, nyHi)
    label.set_x(nyLoLiveLabel, bar_index)
    label.set_y(nyLoLiveLabel, nyLo)

if showNY and not inNyWindow and not na(nyHiLiveLine)
    line.delete(nyHiLiveLine)
    line.delete(nyLoLiveLine)
    label.delete(nyHiLiveLabel)
    label.delete(nyLoLiveLabel)
    nyHiLiveLine := na
    nyLoLiveLine := na

if showNY and not inNyWindow and not nyLocked and not na(nyHi)
    nyLocked := true
    nyHiLine := line.new(nyHiBar, nyHi, bar_index + lineExtendBars, nyHi, color = nyColor, style = line.style_solid, width = 1)
    nyLoLine := line.new(nyLoBar, nyLo, bar_index + lineExtendBars, nyLo, color = nyColor, style = line.style_solid, width = 1)
    nyHiLabel := label.new(bar_index + lineExtendBars, nyHi, "NY.H", style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(color.black, 100), textcolor = nyColor, size = liqTextSizeVal)
    nyLoLabel := label.new(bar_index + lineExtendBars, nyLo, "NY.L", style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(color.black, 100), textcolor = nyColor, size = liqTextSizeVal)
    array.push(nyHiLineHist, nyHiLine)
    array.push(nyLoLineHist, nyLoLine)
    array.push(nyHiLabelHist, nyHiLabel)
    array.push(nyLoLabelHist, nyLoLabel)
    pruneLines(nyHiLineHist, maxLiqKeep)
    pruneLines(nyLoLineHist, maxLiqKeep)
    pruneLabels(nyHiLabelHist, maxLiqKeep)
    pruneLabels(nyLoLabelHist, maxLiqKeep)

if nyLocked and not nyHiTested and high >= nyHi
    nyHiTested := true
    line.set_color(nyHiLine, color.new(nyColor, testedAlpha))
    label.set_textcolor(nyHiLabel, color.new(nyColor, testedAlpha))

if nyLocked and not nyLoTested and low <= nyLo
    nyLoTested := true
    line.set_color(nyLoLine, color.new(nyColor, testedAlpha))
    label.set_textcolor(nyLoLabel, color.new(nyColor, testedAlpha))

if showNY
    extendLineHist(nyHiLineHist, bar_index + lineExtendBars)
    extendLineHist(nyLoLineHist, bar_index + lineExtendBars)
    extendLabelHist(nyHiLabelHist, bar_index + lineExtendBars)
    extendLabelHist(nyLoLabelHist, bar_index + lineExtendBars)

if not showNY and array.size(nyHiLineHist) > 0
    pruneLines(nyHiLineHist, 0)
    pruneLines(nyLoLineHist, 0)
    pruneLabels(nyHiLabelHist, 0)
    pruneLabels(nyLoLabelHist, 0)
    nyHiLine := na
    nyLoLine := na

untestedCount = (showAsia and asiaLocked and not asiaHiTested ? 1 : 0) + (showAsia and asiaLocked and not asiaLoTested ? 1 : 0) + (showLondon and londonLocked and not londonHiTested ? 1 : 0) + (showLondon and londonLocked and not londonLoTested ? 1 : 0) + (showNY and nyLocked and not nyHiTested ? 1 : 0) + (showNY and nyLocked and not nyLoTested ? 1 : 0)

// Proximity alert conditions for untested levels
nearAsiaHi = liqProximityAlert and showAsia and asiaLocked and not asiaHiTested and math.abs(close - asiaHi) <= atrVal * liqProximityATR
nearAsiaLo = liqProximityAlert and showAsia and asiaLocked and not asiaLoTested and math.abs(close - asiaLo) <= atrVal * liqProximityATR
nearLondonHi = liqProximityAlert and showLondon and londonLocked and not londonHiTested and math.abs(close - londonHi) <= atrVal * liqProximityATR
nearLondonLo = liqProximityAlert and showLondon and londonLocked and not londonLoTested and math.abs(close - londonLo) <= atrVal * liqProximityATR
nearNyHi = liqProximityAlert and showNY and nyLocked and not nyHiTested and math.abs(close - nyHi) <= atrVal * liqProximityATR
nearNyLo = liqProximityAlert and showNY and nyLocked and not nyLoTested and math.abs(close - nyLo) <= atrVal * liqProximityATR

alertcondition(nearAsiaHi or nearAsiaLo or nearLondonHi or nearLondonLo or nearNyHi or nearNyLo, title = "Near Untested Liquidity Level", message = "ORB Engine: price approaching an untested session liquidity level.")
alertcondition(bullBreakout, title = "Bull Breakout", message = "ORB Engine: confirmed bull breakout above the opening range box.")
alertcondition(bearBreakout, title = "Bear Breakout", message = "ORB Engine: confirmed bear breakout below the opening range box.")
alertcondition(longRetestTrigger, title = "Long Entry Signal", message = "ORB Engine: long entry triggered — retest confirmed, price reclaimed the entry level.")
alertcondition(shortRetestTrigger, title = "Short Entry Signal", message = "ORB Engine: short entry triggered — retest confirmed, price reclaimed the entry level.")
alertcondition(tradeClosed and breakoutDir == "BULL" and not na(slPrice) and low <= slPrice, title = "Long Stop Loss Hit", message = "ORB Engine: long trade stopped out — price hit the stop loss level.")
alertcondition(tradeClosed and breakoutDir == "BEAR" and not na(slPrice) and high >= slPrice, title = "Short Stop Loss Hit", message = "ORB Engine: short trade stopped out — price hit the stop loss level.")
alertcondition(tradeClosed and not na(finalTpPrice) and breakoutDir == "BULL" and high >= finalTpPrice, title = "Long Final TP Hit", message = "ORB Engine: long trade reached the final take profit target.")
alertcondition(tradeClosed and not na(finalTpPrice) and breakoutDir == "BEAR" and low <= finalTpPrice, title = "Short Final TP Hit", message = "ORB Engine: short trade reached the final take profit target.")

score1_boxFormed = boxFormed
score2_volConfirmed = not na(breakoutDir)
liqBiasBull = breakoutDir == "BULL" and ((showAsia and asiaLocked and not asiaHiTested and asiaHi > close) or (showLondon and londonLocked and not londonHiTested and londonHi > close) or (showNY and nyLocked and not nyHiTested and nyHi > close))
liqBiasBear = breakoutDir == "BEAR" and ((showAsia and asiaLocked and not asiaLoTested and asiaLo < close) or (showLondon and londonLocked and not londonLoTested and londonLo < close) or (showNY and nyLocked and not nyLoTested and nyLo < close))
score3_liqBias = liqBiasBull or liqBiasBear
score4_retestInTime = retestStatus == "FIRED"
score5_rrViable = not na(riskDistance) and boxFormed and riskDistance <= (boxHigh - boxLow) * riskSanityMult

confluenceScore = (score1_boxFormed ? 1 : 0) + (score2_volConfirmed ? 1 : 0) + (score3_liqBias ? 1 : 0) + (score4_retestInTime ? 1 : 0) + (score5_rrViable ? 1 : 0)

scoreBarString(n) =>
    string s = ""
    for i = 0 to 4
        s := s + (i < n ? "▰" : "▱")
    s

var table dash = table.new(dashPosition == "Top Left" ? position.top_left : dashPosition == "Top Right" ? position.top_right : dashPosition == "Bottom Left" ? position.bottom_left : position.bottom_right, 2, 14, bgcolor = color.new(C_BG, 10), border_color = color.new(C_BORDER, 20), border_width = 1, frame_color = color.new(C_BORDER, 40), frame_width = 1)

dashSize = dashTextSize == "Tiny" ? size.tiny : dashTextSize == "Normal" ? size.normal : size.small

boxStatusText = boxFormed ? "FORMED" : inBoxWindow ? "FORMING" : "—"
boxRangeText = boxFormed ? str.tostring(boxHigh - boxLow, format.mintick) : "—"
waitMinutesLeft = waitActive ? waitEndMinutes - estTimeInMinutes : 0
waitStatusText = not useWaitPeriod ? "DISABLED" : waitActive ? "WAITING (" + str.tostring(waitMinutesLeft) + "m)" : inActiveWindow ? "ACTIVE" : "—"
breakoutStatusText = breakoutDir == "BULL" ? "BULL" : breakoutDir == "BEAR" ? "BEAR" : "NONE"
retestStatusText = na(retestStatus) ? "—" : retestStatus
entryStatusText = retestStatus == "FIRED" ? (breakoutDir == "BULL" ? "LONG" : "SHORT") : "—"
sessionText = inAsiaWindow ? "ASIA" : inLondonWindow ? "LONDON" : inNyWindow ? "NY" : "—"

cPanel = color.new(C_PANEL, 0)
cMuted = color.new(C_MUTED, 0)
cWhite = color.new(color.white, 0)

if showDashboard and barstate.islast
    table.cell(dash, 0, 0, "ORB Engine", bgcolor = color.new(C_PURP, 70), text_color = color.new(C_GOLD, 0), text_size = dashSize)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 0, "v1.0", bgcolor = color.new(C_PURP, 70), text_color = color.new(C_GOLD, 0), text_size = dashSize)

    table.cell(dash, 0, 1, "Box Status", bgcolor = cPanel, text_color = cMuted, text_size = dashSize)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 1, boxStatusText, bgcolor = cPanel, text_color = cWhite, text_size = dashSize)

    table.cell(dash, 0, 2, "Box Range", bgcolor = cPanel, text_color = cMuted, text_size = dashSize)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 2, boxRangeText, bgcolor = cPanel, text_color = cWhite, text_size = dashSize)

    table.cell(dash, 0, 3, "Wait Status", bgcolor = waitActive ? color.new(C_MUTED, 70) : cPanel, text_color = cMuted, text_size = dashSize)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 3, waitStatusText, bgcolor = waitActive ? color.new(C_MUTED, 70) : cPanel, text_color = waitActive ? cMuted : cWhite, text_size = dashSize)

    table.cell(dash, 0, 4, "Breakout", bgcolor = cPanel, text_color = cMuted, text_size = dashSize)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 4, breakoutStatusText, bgcolor = cPanel, text_color = breakoutDir == "BULL" ? color.new(C_BULL, 0) : breakoutDir == "BEAR" ? color.new(C_BEAR, 0) : cWhite, text_size = dashSize)

    table.cell(dash, 0, 5, "Entry Mode", bgcolor = cPanel, text_color = cMuted, text_size = dashSize)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 5, entryMode, bgcolor = cPanel, text_color = color.new(C_CYAN, 0), text_size = dashSize)

    retestRowLabel = entryMode == "Immediate" ? "Entry Trigger" : entryMode == "Breakout Retest" ? "Breakout Retest" : "Midpoint Retest"
    table.cell(dash, 0, 6, retestRowLabel, bgcolor = cPanel, text_color = cMuted, text_size = dashSize)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 6, retestStatusText, bgcolor = cPanel, text_color = cWhite, text_size = dashSize)

    table.cell(dash, 0, 7, "Entry", bgcolor = cPanel, text_color = cMuted, text_size = dashSize)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 7, entryStatusText, bgcolor = cPanel, text_color = entryStatusText == "LONG" ? color.new(C_BULL, 0) : entryStatusText == "SHORT" ? color.new(C_BEAR, 0) : cWhite, text_size = dashSize)

    table.cell(dash, 0, 8, "Confluence Score", bgcolor = cPanel, text_color = cMuted, text_size = dashSize)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 8, scoreBarString(confluenceScore) + "  " + str.tostring(confluenceScore) + "/5", bgcolor = cPanel, text_color = color.new(C_GOLD, 0), text_size = dashSize)

    tpStatusText = na(tp1Price) ? "—" : (useRR1 ? "1:1 " + str.tostring(tp1Price, format.mintick) : "") + (useRR2 ? "  1:2 " + str.tostring(tp2Price, format.mintick) : "") + (useRR3 ? "  1:3 " + str.tostring(tp3Price, format.mintick) : "")
    table.cell(dash, 0, 9, "TP Levels", bgcolor = cPanel, text_color = cMuted, text_size = dashSize)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 9, tpStatusText, bgcolor = cPanel, text_color = color.new(C_BULL, 0), text_size = dashSize)

    table.cell(dash, 0, 10, "Session / Untested", bgcolor = cPanel, text_color = cMuted, text_size = dashSize)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 10, sessionText + "  (" + str.tostring(untestedCount) + ")", bgcolor = cPanel, text_color = cWhite, text_size = dashSize)

    table.cell(dash, 0, 11, "Now (" + displayTimezone + ")", bgcolor = cPanel, text_color = cMuted, text_size = dashSize)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 11, nowDisplayTime, bgcolor = cPanel, text_color = cWhite, text_size = dashSize)

    table.cell(dash, 0, 12, "Box / Active", bgcolor = cPanel, text_color = cMuted, text_size = dashSize)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 12, boxStartDisplay + "-" + boxEndDisplay + "  →  " + waitEndDisplay, bgcolor = cPanel, text_color = cWhite, text_size = dashSize)

    table.cell(dash, 0, 13, "ANONYCRYPTOUS", bgcolor = color.new(C_PURP, 70), text_color = color.new(C_GOLD, 0), text_size = dashSize, text_halign = text.align_center)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 13, "", bgcolor = color.new(C_PURP, 70))
    table.merge_cells(dash, 0, 13, 1, 13)

// STATUS BACKGROUND (chart-first visual state)
bgcolor(showEntryBg and entryFired ? color.new(entryBgColor, entryBgTransp) : showWaitBg and waitActive ? color.new(waitBgColor, waitBgTransp) : na)

//@version=6  
indicator("ORB Breakouts with alerts", overlay=true)

startHour       = input.int(14, "Start Hour (24h)", minval=0, maxval=23)
startMinute     = input.int(30, "Start Minute", minval=0, maxval=59)
endHour         = input.int(14, "End Hour (24h)", minval=0, maxval=23)
endMinute       = input.int(45, "End Minute", minval=0, maxval=59)
timezoneOffset  = input.int(0, "Timezone Offset (hours from UTC)", minval=-12, maxval=14)

highlightColor   = input.color(color.yellow, "Highlight Color")
boxColor         = input.color(color.new(color.yellow, 85), "Box Fill Color")
lineLength       = input.int(10, "Line Length (Candles)", minval=1)

// --- Middle Line 1 (original)
middleLineColor  = input.color(color.gray, "Middle Line 1 Color (Custom %)")
midlinePercent   = input.float(50, "Mid Line 1 % Between High/Low", minval=0, maxval=100)
midlineStyleOpt  = input.string("Dashed", "Mid Line 1 Style", options=["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"])

// --- Middle Line 2 (new)
middleLineColor2 = input.color(color.silver, "Middle Line 2 Color (Custom %)")
midlinePercent2  = input.float(75, "Mid Line 2 % Between High/Low", minval=0, maxval=100)
midlineStyleOpt2 = input.string("Dotted", "Middle Line 2 Style", options=["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"])

showBufferLines = input.bool(true, "Show Buffer Lines")
bufferLineColor = input.color(color.purple, "Buffer Line Color")
bufferLineStyle = input.string("Dashed", "Buffer Line Style", options=["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"])
bufferPips      = input.int(10, "Buffer Distance (pips)", minval=1)

// ===================== TAKE PROFIT SETTINGS =====================
// --- BUY TP Group
groupBuy = "BUY TP Settings"
showBuyTP1   = input.bool(true, "Show BUY TP1", inline="btp1", group=groupBuy)
buyTP1Pct    = input.float(25, "% Distance", minval=0.1, step=0.1, inline="btp1", group=groupBuy)
buyTP1Color  = input.color(color.green, "Color", inline="btp1c", group=groupBuy)
buyTP1Style  = input.string("Dashed", "Style", options=["Solid","Dashed","Dotted"], inline="btp1c", group=groupBuy)

showBuyTP2   = input.bool(true, "Show BUY TP2", inline="btp2", group=groupBuy)
buyTP2Pct    = input.float(50, "% Distance", minval=0.1, step=0.1, inline="btp2", group=groupBuy)
buyTP2Color  = input.color(color.lime, "Color", inline="btp2c", group=groupBuy)
buyTP2Style  = input.string("Dotted", "Style", options=["Solid","Dashed","Dotted"], inline="btp2c", group=groupBuy)

showBuyTP3   = input.bool(true, "Show BUY TP3", inline="btp3", group=groupBuy)
buyTP3Pct    = input.float(75, "% Distance", minval=0.1, step=0.1, inline="btp3", group=groupBuy)
buyTP3Color  = input.color(color.teal, "Color", inline="btp3c", group=groupBuy)
buyTP3Style  = input.string("Solid", "Style", options=["Solid","Dashed","Dotted"], inline="btp3c", group=groupBuy)

// --- SELL TP Group
groupSell = "SELL TP Settings"
showSellTP1   = input.bool(true, "Show SELL TP1", inline="stp1", group=groupSell)
sellTP1Pct    = input.float(25, "% Distance", minval=0.1, step=0.1, inline="stp1", group=groupSell)
sellTP1Color  = input.color(color.orange, "Color", inline="stp1c", group=groupSell)
sellTP1Style  = input.string("Dashed", "Style", options=["Solid","Dashed","Dotted"], inline="stp1c", group=groupSell)

showSellTP2   = input.bool(true, "Show SELL TP2", inline="stp2", group=groupSell)
sellTP2Pct    = input.float(50, "% Distance", minval=0.1, step=0.1, inline="stp2", group=groupSell)
sellTP2Color  = input.color(color.yellow, "Color", inline="stp2c", group=groupSell)
sellTP2Style  = input.string("Dotted", "Style", options=["Solid","Dashed","Dotted"], inline="stp2c", group=groupSell)

showSellTP3   = input.bool(true, "Show SELL TP3", inline="stp3", group=groupSell)
sellTP3Pct    = input.float(75, "% Distance", minval=0.1, step=0.1, inline="stp3", group=groupSell)
sellTP3Color  = input.color(color.red, "Color", inline="stp3c", group=groupSell)
sellTP3Style  = input.string("Solid", "Style", options=["Solid","Dashed","Dotted"], inline="stp3c", group=groupSell)

// ===================== TP LABEL OPTIONS =====================
showTPLabels     = input.bool(true, "Show TP Labels")
tpLabelSide      = input.string("Right", "TP Label Side", options=["Left","Right"])
tpLabelOffset    = input.int(1, "TP Label Horizontal Offset (bars)", minval=0, maxval=10)
showTPPercent    = input.bool(true, "Show % Distance on TP Labels")

localToUTC(hourLocal, minuteLocal) =>
    total = hourLocal * 60 + minuteLocal - timezoneOffset * 60
    adjusted = total < 0 ? total + 1440 : (total >= 1440 ? total - 1440 : total)
    [math.floor(adjusted / 60), math.floor(adjusted % 60)]

[startHourUTC, startMinuteUTC] = localToUTC(startHour, startMinute)
[endHourUTC, endMinuteUTC]     = localToUTC(endHour, endMinute)

timeToMinutes(h, m) => h * 60 + m

currHour   = hour(time, "UTC")
currMinute = minute(time, "UTC")
currTotal  = timeToMinutes(currHour, currMinute)

startTotal = timeToMinutes(startHourUTC, startMinuteUTC)
endTotal   = timeToMinutes(endHourUTC, endMinuteUTC)

inSession = currTotal >= startTotal and currTotal <= endTotal

var float sessionHigh = na
var float sessionLow = na
var float postSessionHigh = na
var float postSessionLow = na
var int sessionStartBar = na
var int highBar = na
var int lowBar = na
var box sessionBox = na
var line sessionHighLine = na
var line sessionLowLine = na
var label sessionHighLabel = na
var label sessionLowLabel = na

labelStyleHigh = label.style_label_down
labelStyleLow  = label.style_label_up

var int lastAlertDayHigh = na
var int lastAlertDayLow  = na

// ===================== HELPER: drawTP =====================
drawTP(show, pct, isBuy, clr, styleTxt, labelTxt) =>
    if show
        rangeSize = sessionHigh - sessionLow
        tpLevel = isBuy ? sessionHigh + rangeSize * (pct / 100) : sessionLow - rangeSize * (pct / 100)
        tpStyle = styleTxt == "Solid" ? line.style_solid :
                  styleTxt == "Dotted" ? line.style_dotted : line.style_dashed
        xStart = isBuy ? highBar : lowBar
        x1pos = na(xStart) ? bar_index : xStart

        // draw TP line
        line.new(x1=x1pos, y1=tpLevel, x2=x1pos + lineLength, y2=tpLevel,
                 color=clr, width=1, style=tpStyle)

        if showTPLabels
            xLabel = tpLabelSide == "Left" ? x1pos - tpLabelOffset : x1pos + lineLength + tpLabelOffset
            labelStyle = tpLabelSide == "Left" ? label.style_label_left : label.style_label_right
            // label shows TP name + optional % distance
            labelText = showTPPercent ? labelTxt + " (" + str.tostring(pct, "#.##") + "%)" : labelTxt
            label.new(x=xLabel, y=tpLevel, text=labelText,
                      color=color.new(color.black, 100),
                      style=labelStyle, textcolor=clr, size=size.small)

// ===================== SESSION CALCULATION =====================
if inSession
    sessionHigh := na(sessionHigh) ? high : math.max(sessionHigh, high)
    sessionLow := na(sessionLow) ? low : math.min(sessionLow, low)
    sessionStartBar := na(sessionStartBar) ? bar_index : sessionStartBar
    highBar := high >= sessionHigh ? bar_index : highBar
    lowBar := low <= sessionLow ? bar_index : lowBar
else
    drawLines = not na(sessionHigh) and not na(sessionLow) and not na(sessionStartBar) and not na(highBar) and not na(lowBar)
    if drawLines
        sessionBox := box.new(left=sessionStartBar, right=bar_index - 1, top=sessionHigh, bottom=sessionLow, bgcolor=boxColor, border_color=highlightColor)

        sessionHighLine := line.new(x1=highBar, y1=sessionHigh, x2=highBar + lineLength, y2=sessionHigh, color=color.blue, width=2)
        sessionLowLine := line.new(x1=lowBar, y1=sessionLow, x2=lowBar + lineLength, y2=sessionLow, color=color.red, width=2)

        // --- Mid Lines
        percent1 = midlinePercent / 100
        midPrice1 = sessionLow + (sessionHigh - sessionLow) * percent1
        midStyle1 = (midlineStyleOpt == "Solid" ? line.style_solid :
                     midlineStyleOpt == "Dotted" ? line.style_dotted :
                     line.style_dashed)
        line.new(x1=highBar, y1=midPrice1, x2=lowBar + lineLength, y2=midPrice1, color=middleLineColor, width=1, style=midStyle1)

        percent2 = midlinePercent2 / 100
        midPrice2 = sessionLow + (sessionHigh - sessionLow) * percent2
        midStyle2 = (midlineStyleOpt2 == "Solid" ? line.style_solid :
                     midlineStyleOpt2 == "Dotted" ? line.style_dotted :
                     line.style_dashed)
        line.new(x1=highBar, y1=midPrice2, x2=lowBar + lineLength, y2=midPrice2, color=middleLineColor2, width=1, style=midStyle2)

        // --- Buffer Lines
        if showBufferLines
            bufStyle = bufferLineStyle == "Solid" ? line.style_solid :
                       bufferLineStyle == "Dotted" ? line.style_dotted :
                       line.style_dashed
            pip = syminfo.mintick * bufferPips
            line.new(x1=highBar, y1=sessionHigh + pip, x2=highBar + lineLength, y2=sessionHigh + pip, color=bufferLineColor, width=1, style=bufStyle)
            line.new(x1=lowBar, y1=sessionLow - pip, x2=lowBar + lineLength, y2=sessionLow - pip, color=bufferLineColor, width=1, style=bufStyle)

        // --- BUY/SELL Labels
        showBuyLabel  = input.bool(true, "Show BUY Label")
        showSellLabel = input.bool(true, "Show SELL Label")
        buyLabelPosOptions  = input.string("Right", "BUY Label Position", options=["Right", "Left"])
        sellLabelPosOptions = input.string("Right", "SELL Label Position", options=["Right", "Left"])
        buyX = buyLabelPosOptions  == "Left"  ? sessionStartBar : highBar + lineLength
        sellX = sellLabelPosOptions == "Left"  ? sessionStartBar : lowBar + lineLength

        priceRange = sessionHigh - sessionLow
        offsetY = priceRange * 0.05

        if not na(sessionHighLabel)
            label.delete(sessionHighLabel)
        if not na(sessionLowLabel)
            label.delete(sessionLowLabel)

        if showBuyLabel
            sessionHighLabel := label.new(x=buyX, y=sessionHigh + offsetY,
                                          text="BUY", color=color.new(color.blue, 0),
                                          style=labelStyleHigh, textcolor=color.white,
                                          size=size.normal, textalign=text.align_center)
        if showSellLabel
            sessionLowLabel := label.new(x=sellX, y=sessionLow - offsetY,
                                         text="SELL", color=color.new(color.red, 0),
                                         style=labelStyleLow, textcolor=color.white,
                                         size=size.normal, textalign=text.align_center)

        postSessionHigh := sessionHigh
        postSessionLow := sessionLow

        // ===================== TAKE PROFIT LINES =====================
        drawTP(showBuyTP1, buyTP1Pct, true,  buyTP1Color,  buyTP1Style, "TP1")
        drawTP(showBuyTP2, buyTP2Pct, true,  buyTP2Color,  buyTP2Style, "TP2")
        drawTP(showBuyTP3, buyTP3Pct, true,  buyTP3Color,  buyTP3Style, "TP3")

        drawTP(showSellTP1, sellTP1Pct, false, sellTP1Color, sellTP1Style, "TP1")
        drawTP(showSellTP2, sellTP2Pct, false, sellTP2Color, sellTP2Style, "TP2")
        drawTP(showSellTP3, sellTP3Pct, false, sellTP3Color, sellTP3Style, "TP3")

    sessionHigh := na
    sessionLow := na
    sessionStartBar := na
    highBar := na
    lowBar := na

barcolor(inSession ? highlightColor : na)

currentDay = year(time) * 10000 + month(time) * 100 + dayofmonth(time)

breakAboveHigh = not inSession and not na(postSessionHigh) and close > postSessionHigh and close[1] <= postSessionHigh and currentDay != lastAlertDayHigh
breakBelowLow  = not inSession and not na(postSessionLow) and close < postSessionLow and close[1] >= postSessionLow and currentDay != lastAlertDayLow

if breakAboveHigh
    lastAlertDayHigh := currentDay
if breakBelowLow
    lastAlertDayLow := currentDay

alertcondition(breakAboveHigh, title="Breakout Above High", message="Price broke above session HIGH — BUY breakout")
alertcondition(breakBelowLow, title="Breakdown Below Low", message="Price broke below session LOW — SELL breakout")

items.author: Nishann
items.source:
// This Pine Script® code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
// © Darkmatter513
// @version=5
indicator("NTrades [ORBDD Advanced] - Working", overlay=true, max_labels_count=500, max_lines_count=500, max_boxes_count=500)

// This contains Base + R-Labels + EMA + Force Exit Logic + Daily Bias
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// INPUTS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

g_display = "📊 Display"
showSignals = input.bool(true, "Show Signals", group=g_display)
showORBox = input.bool(true, "Show Opening Range Box", group=g_display)
showTrend = input.bool(false, "Show Trend Line", group=g_display)
showFVG = false
showDashboard = input.bool(true, "Show Main Dashboard", group=g_display)
showStatsPanel = input.bool(false, "Show Range Stats Panel", group=g_display)

// --- DATE RANGE SECTION ---
g_date = "📅 Date Range Filter"
useDateFilter = input.bool(true, "Enable Date Filter", group=g_date)
startDate = input.time(timestamp("2025-08-01 00:00"), "Start Date", group=g_date)
endDate = input.time(timestamp("2026-02-10 23:45"), "End Date", group=g_date)

g_orb = "⏰ Opening Range Settings"
orbMinutes = input.int(15, "Opening Range Minutes", minval=5, maxval=60, step=5, group=g_orb)
sessionStart = input.session("0930-0945", "Opening Range Session", group=g_orb)
tradingEnd = input.int(14, "Stop New Entries After (Hour ET)", minval=10, maxval=16, group=g_orb, tooltip="Stop taking NEW trades after this hour (15 = 3PM)")

forceExitHour = input.int(15, "Force Exit All Trades (Hour ET)", minval=0, maxval=23, group=g_orb, tooltip="Set to 0 to DISABLE this feature.\nIf set to 13, 14, etc., all trades close immediately at that hour.")

g_entry = "🎯 Entry Settings"
entryType = input.string("Retest", "Entry Type", options=["Breakout", "Retest"], group=g_entry, tooltip="Breakout: Enter immediately on break\nRetest: Wait for pullback to range")
requireVolume = input.bool(false, "Require Volume Confirmation", group=g_entry)
requireFVG = input.bool(false, "Require FVG Confluence", group=g_entry)

// --- TREND FILTER SECTION ---
g_trend = "🌊 Trend Filter (Reduce Losers)"
useTrendFilter = input.bool(false, "Enable Trend Filter", group=g_trend, tooltip="Only take Longs above EMA and Shorts below EMA.")
trendLen = input.int(50, "EMA Period", minval=10, step=10, group=g_trend, tooltip="50 is good for intermediate trend. 200 is for major trend.")

// --- DAILY DIRECTION FILTER SECTION ---
g_dailyDir = "🧭 Daily Direction Filter"
useDailyDir = input.bool(true, "Enable Strict Daily Direction", group=g_dailyDir, tooltip="Longs: Yesterday closed > day before, OR yesterday swept day before's low and closed back above it.\nShorts: Inverse.")

g_risk = "💰 Risk Management"
slType = input.string("Midpoint", "Stop Loss Placement", options=["Opposite Side", "Midpoint", "ATR Based"], group=g_risk)
rrRatio = input.float(1.4, "Risk:Reward Ratio", minval=1.0, maxval=10.0, step=0.1, group=g_risk)

g_filter = "🔍 Range (Risk) Filter"
useRangeFilter = input.bool(true, "Enable Max Range Filter", group=g_filter)
maxRiskPoints  = input.float(220.0, "Max 1R Size (Price Points)", group=g_filter, tooltip="If the distance between Entry and Stop Loss is greater than this value, the trade is skipped.")

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// COLORS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
bullColor = #00E676
bearColor = #FF5252
orbColor = #2196F3
fvgBullColor = color.new(#00E676, 85)
fvgBearColor = color.new(#FF5252, 85)

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// DATE FILTER LOGIC
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

adjustedEndDate = endDate + 86399999
inDateRange = not useDateFilter or (time >= startDate and time <= adjustedEndDate)

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// TIME & SESSION FUNCTIONS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

nyHour = hour(time, "America/New_York")
nyMinute = minute(time, "America/New_York")

inOpeningRange = inDateRange and (nyHour == 9 and nyMinute >= 30 and nyMinute < 30 + orbMinutes)
isFirstORBar = inOpeningRange and not inOpeningRange[1]
orbEnded = not inOpeningRange and inOpeningRange[1] and inDateRange

forceExitEnabled = forceExitHour != 0
withinExitTime = not forceExitEnabled or nyHour < forceExitHour

inTradingHours = inDateRange and nyHour >= 9 and nyHour < tradingEnd and withinExitTime and not inOpeningRange

newDay = ta.change(time("D")) != 0

isForceExit = forceExitEnabled and nyHour >= forceExitHour
isSessionEnd = nyHour == 15 and nyMinute >= 45

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// OPENING RANGE TRACKING
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

var float orHigh = na
var float orLow = na
var float orMid = na
var int orStartBar = na
var int orEndBar = na
var bool orComplete = false
var bool brokenUp = false
var bool brokenDown = false

if newDay
    orHigh := na
    orLow := na
    orMid := na
    orStartBar := na
    orEndBar := na
    orComplete := false
    brokenUp := false
    brokenDown := false

if inOpeningRange
    if isFirstORBar
        orHigh := high
        orLow := low
        orStartBar := bar_index
    else
        orHigh := math.max(orHigh, high)
        orLow := math.min(orLow, low)

if orbEnded and not orComplete
    orComplete := true
    orMid := (orHigh + orLow) / 2
    orEndBar := bar_index

orRange = orComplete ? orHigh - orLow : na
atr = ta.atr(14)

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// FVG DETECTION
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

type FVG
    float top
    float bottom
    bool bullish
    int bar
    bool filled

var array<FVG> fvgArray = array.new<FVG>()
minFVGSize = atr * 0.3

bullishFVG = inDateRange and low > high[2] and (low - high[2]) > minFVGSize
bearishFVG = inDateRange and high < low[2] and (low[2] - high) > minFVGSize

if bullishFVG
    fvg = FVG.new()
    fvg.top := low
    fvg.bottom := high[2]
    fvg.bullish := true
    fvg.bar := bar_index - 1
    fvg.filled := false
    if array.size(fvgArray) >= 20
        array.shift(fvgArray)
    array.push(fvgArray, fvg)

if bearishFVG
    fvg = FVG.new()
    fvg.top := low[2]
    fvg.bottom := high
    fvg.bullish := false
    fvg.bar := bar_index - 1
    fvg.filled := false
    if array.size(fvgArray) >= 20
        array.shift(fvgArray)
    array.push(fvgArray, fvg)

if array.size(fvgArray) > 0 and inDateRange
    for i = array.size(fvgArray) - 1 to 0
        if i < array.size(fvgArray)
            fvg = array.get(fvgArray, i)
            if not fvg.filled
                fvgMid = (fvg.top + fvg.bottom) / 2
                if fvg.bullish and low <= fvgMid
                    fvg.filled := true
                if not fvg.bullish and high >= fvgMid
                    fvg.filled := true

f_hasFVGConfluence(bool forLong) =>
    hasConfluence = false
    if array.size(fvgArray) > 0
        for i = array.size(fvgArray) - 1 to 0
            if i < array.size(fvgArray)
                fvg = array.get(fvgArray, i)
                if not fvg.filled and bar_index - fvg.bar < 100
                    if forLong and fvg.bullish
                        hasConfluence := true
                        break
                    if not forLong and not fvg.bullish
                        hasConfluence := true
                        break
    hasConfluence

bullishFVGPresent = f_hasFVGConfluence(true)
bearishFVGPresent = f_hasFVGConfluence(false)

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// DAILY DIRECTION LOGIC (c1 = Today, c2 = Yesterday, c3 = Day Before)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// Fetch Daily Data (c2 = [1], c3 = [2])
[d_close1, d_close2, d_low1, d_low2, d_high1, d_high2] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "D", [close[1], close[2], low[1], low[2], high[1], high[2]])

// Bullish Conditions for Today
bullishCondA = d_close1 > d_close2 // c2 closed above c3
bullishCondB = (d_low1 < d_low2) and (d_close1 > d_low2) // c2 swept c3 low, closed above c3 low
isDailyBullish = bullishCondA or bullishCondB

// Bearish Conditions for Today 
bearishCondA = d_close1 < d_close2 // c2 closed below c3
bearishCondB = (d_high1 > d_high2) and (d_close1 < d_high2) // c2 swept c3 high, closed below c3 high
isDailyBearish = bearishCondA or bearishCondB

// Apply to Filter
dailyDirOkLong = not useDailyDir or isDailyBullish
dailyDirOkShort = not useDailyDir or isDailyBearish

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SIGNALS & FILTER LOGIC
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// Trend Logic
trendEMA = ta.ema(close, trendLen)
trendOkLong = not useTrendFilter or close > trendEMA
trendOkShort = not useTrendFilter or close < trendEMA

// Plot Trend
plot(showTrend and useTrendFilter ? trendEMA : na, "Trend EMA", color=color.new(color.gray, 50))

avgVol = ta.sma(volume, 20)
highVolume = volume > avgVol * 1.2
volumeOK = not requireVolume or highVolume

breakoutUp = inDateRange and orComplete and not brokenUp and close > orHigh and close[1] <= orHigh
breakoutDown = inDateRange and orComplete and not brokenDown and close < orLow and close[1] >= orLow

if breakoutUp
    brokenUp := true
if breakoutDown
    brokenDown := true

// Retest Logic
var bool waitingForLongRetest = false
var bool waitingForShortRetest = false

if breakoutUp and entryType == "Retest"
    waitingForLongRetest := true
if breakoutDown and entryType == "Retest"
    waitingForShortRetest := true

longRetest = waitingForLongRetest and low <= orHigh and close > orHigh
shortRetest = waitingForShortRetest and high >= orLow and close < orLow

if longRetest
    waitingForLongRetest := false
if shortRetest
    waitingForShortRetest := false

if waitingForLongRetest and close < orMid
    waitingForLongRetest := false
if waitingForShortRetest and close > orMid
    waitingForShortRetest := false

// HELPER: CALCULATE THEORETICAL STOP LOSS TO CHECK FILTER
f_calcSL(bool isLong, float price) =>
    sl = 0.0
    if isLong
        if slType == "Opposite Side"
            sl := orLow - atr * 0.1
        else if slType == "Midpoint"
            sl := orMid - atr * 0.1
        else
            sl := price - atr * 1.5
    else
        if slType == "Opposite Side"
            sl := orHigh + atr * 0.1
        else if slType == "Midpoint"
            sl := orMid + atr * 0.1
        else
            sl := price + atr * 1.5
    sl

// Generate Signals
var int lastSignalBar = 0
var bool tradedLongToday = false
var bool tradedShortToday = false

if newDay
    tradedLongToday := false
    tradedShortToday := false

fvgOKLong = not requireFVG or bullishFVGPresent
fvgOKShort = not requireFVG or bearishFVGPresent
validTiming = inTradingHours and bar_index - lastSignalBar >= 5

// --- APPLY RANGE FILTER ---
tempSLLong = f_calcSL(true, close)
tempRiskLong = math.abs(close - tempSLLong)
rangeOKLong = not useRangeFilter or (tempRiskLong <= maxRiskPoints)

tempSLShort = f_calcSL(false, close)
tempRiskShort = math.abs(tempSLShort - close)
rangeOKShort = not useRangeFilter or (tempRiskShort <= maxRiskPoints)

// --- COMBINE ALL FILTERS INCLUDING TREND & DAILY DIR ---
longEntry = false
if entryType == "Breakout"
    longEntry := breakoutUp and volumeOK and fvgOKLong and validTiming and not tradedLongToday and rangeOKLong and trendOkLong and dailyDirOkLong
else
    longEntry := longRetest and volumeOK and fvgOKLong and validTiming and not tradedLongToday and rangeOKLong and trendOkLong and dailyDirOkLong

shortEntry = false
if entryType == "Breakout"
    shortEntry := breakoutDown and volumeOK and fvgOKShort and validTiming and not tradedShortToday and rangeOKShort and trendOkShort and dailyDirOkShort
else
    shortEntry := shortRetest and volumeOK and fvgOKShort and validTiming and not tradedShortToday and rangeOKShort and trendOkShort and dailyDirOkShort

buySignal = showSignals and longEntry
sellSignal = showSignals and shortEntry

if buySignal
    lastSignalBar := bar_index
    tradedLongToday := true
if sellSignal
    lastSignalBar := bar_index
    tradedShortToday := true

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// STOP LOSS & TAKE PROFIT CALCULATION
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

var float entryPrice = na
var float stopLoss = na
var float takeProfit = na

if buySignal and orComplete
    entryPrice := close
    stopLoss := f_calcSL(true, entryPrice)
    riskAmt = entryPrice - stopLoss
    takeProfit := entryPrice + (riskAmt * rrRatio)

if sellSignal and orComplete
    entryPrice := close
    stopLoss := f_calcSL(false, entryPrice)
    riskAmt = stopLoss - entryPrice
    takeProfit := entryPrice - (riskAmt * rrRatio)

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// PERFORMANCE & VISUALIZATION
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

type TradeRecord
    float entry
    float sl
    float tp
    bool isLong
    int bar
    bool closed
    bool won
    float riskSize
    label tradeLabel // Store label ID here

var array<TradeRecord> trades = array.new<TradeRecord>()
var array<bool> results = array.new<bool>()
var float winRate = 0.0
var int totalWins = 0
var int totalLosses = 0
var float totalRCaptured = 0.0
var float currentLossStreak = 0.0
var float maxDrawdown = 0.0

var array<float> winRanges = array.new<float>()
var array<float> lossRanges = array.new<float>()

// 1. CREATE TRADE & DRAW LABEL IMMEDIATELY
if buySignal or sellSignal
    
    // --- DRAW VISUALS ---
    label createdLabel = na
    if buySignal
        labelText = "🎯 LONG\nORB Break"
        if requireFVG and bullishFVGPresent
            labelText := labelText + "\n+FVG ✓"
        createdLabel := label.new(bar_index, low - atr * 0.5, text=labelText, style=label.style_label_up, color=color.new(bullColor, 20), textcolor=color.white, size=size.normal)
        line.new(bar_index, stopLoss, bar_index + 30, stopLoss, color=color.new(bearColor, 50), width=1, style=line.style_dashed)
        line.new(bar_index, takeProfit, bar_index + 30, takeProfit, color=color.new(bullColor, 50), width=1, style=line.style_dashed)
    else
        labelText = "🎯 SHORT\nORB Break"
        if requireFVG and bearishFVGPresent
            labelText := labelText + "\n+FVG ✓"
        createdLabel := label.new(bar_index, high + atr * 0.5, text=labelText, style=label.style_label_down, color=color.new(bearColor, 20), textcolor=color.white, size=size.normal)
        line.new(bar_index, stopLoss, bar_index + 30, stopLoss, color=color.new(bearColor, 50), width=1, style=line.style_dashed)
        line.new(bar_index, takeProfit, bar_index + 30, takeProfit, color=color.new(bullColor, 50), width=1, style=line.style_dashed)

    // --- STORE TRADE ---
    t = TradeRecord.new()
    t.entry := entryPrice
    t.sl := stopLoss
    t.tp := takeProfit
    t.isLong := buySignal
    t.bar := bar_index
    t.closed := false
    t.won := false
    t.riskSize := math.abs(entryPrice - stopLoss)
    t.tradeLabel := createdLabel // Save the label to the trade
    
    if array.size(trades) >= 50
        array.shift(trades)
    array.push(trades, t)

// 2. CHECK FOR EXITS & UPDATE LABEL
if array.size(trades) > 0
    for i = array.size(trades) - 1 to 0
        if i < array.size(trades)
            t = array.get(trades, i)
            if not t.closed and bar_index > t.bar
                float currentR = 0.0
                
                if t.isLong
                    risk = t.entry - t.sl
                    if low <= t.sl
                        t.closed := true
                        t.won := false
                        currentR := -1.0
                    else if high >= t.tp
                        t.closed := true
                        t.won := true
                        currentR := rrRatio
                    else if isSessionEnd or isForceExit or (bar_index - t.bar > 80)
                        t.closed := true
                        t.won := close > t.entry
                        currentR := (close - t.entry) / risk
                
                else // SHORT
                    risk = t.sl - t.entry
                    if high >= t.sl
                        t.closed := true
                        t.won := false
                        currentR := -1.0
                    else if low <= t.tp
                        t.closed := true
                        t.won := true
                        currentR := rrRatio
                    else if isSessionEnd or isForceExit or (bar_index - t.bar > 80)
                        t.closed := true
                        t.won := close < t.entry
                        currentR := (t.entry - close) / risk

                if t.closed
                    // --- UPDATE THE LABEL WITH RESULT AND R-MULTIPLE ---
                    rString = str.tostring(currentR, "#.##") + "R"
                    resultText = t.won ? ("\n✅ WIN " + rString) : ("\n❌ LOSS " + rString)
                    
                    if isForceExit
                        resultText := resultText + "\n(TIME EXIT)"

                    currentText = label.get_text(t.tradeLabel)
                    label.set_text(t.tradeLabel, currentText + resultText)
                    label.set_color(t.tradeLabel, t.won ? color.new(bullColor, 0) : color.new(bearColor, 0))

                    totalRCaptured := totalRCaptured + currentR
                    
                    if t.won
                        array.push(winRanges, t.riskSize)
                        totalWins := totalWins + 1
                    else
                        array.push(lossRanges, t.riskSize)
                        totalLosses := totalLosses + 1

                    if currentR < 0
                        currentLossStreak := currentLossStreak + currentR
                    else
                        currentLossStreak := 0.0
                    
                    if currentLossStreak < maxDrawdown
                        maxDrawdown := currentLossStreak
                    
                    if array.size(results) >= 50
                        array.shift(results)
                    array.push(results, t.won)

// Calculate Win Rate
if array.size(results) > 0
    wins = 0
    for i = 0 to array.size(results) - 1
        if array.get(results, i)
            wins := wins + 1
    winRate := (wins / array.size(results)) * 100

if array.size(trades) > 0
    for i = array.size(trades) - 1 to 0
        if i < array.size(trades)
            t = array.get(trades, i)
            if t.closed
                array.remove(trades, i)

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// BOX VISUALIZATION (ORB & FVG)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

var box orBox = na
if showORBox and orComplete and not na(orStartBar) and inDateRange
    box.delete(orBox)
    orBox := box.new(orStartBar, orHigh, bar_index + 20, orLow, border_color=orbColor, border_width=2, bgcolor=color.new(orbColor, 90))

var line orHighLine = na
var line orLowLine = na
var line orMidLine = na

if orComplete and inDateRange
    line.delete(orHighLine)
    line.delete(orLowLine)
    line.delete(orMidLine)
    orHighLine := line.new(orEndBar, orHigh, bar_index + 50, orHigh, color=bullColor, style=line.style_solid, width=2)
    orLowLine := line.new(orEndBar, orLow, bar_index + 50, orLow, color=bearColor, style=line.style_solid, width=2)
    orMidLine := line.new(orEndBar, orMid, bar_index + 50, orMid, color=color.gray, style=line.style_dotted, width=1)

if showFVG and array.size(fvgArray) > 0 and inDateRange
    for i = math.max(0, array.size(fvgArray) - 5) to array.size(fvgArray) - 1
        fvg = array.get(fvgArray, i)
        if not fvg.filled and bar_index - fvg.bar < 50
            fvgCol = fvg.bullish ? fvgBullColor : fvgBearColor
            box.new(fvg.bar, fvg.top, bar_index + 10, fvg.bottom, border_color=na, bgcolor=fvgCol)

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// DASHBOARD 1: GENERAL STATS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

if showDashboard and barstate.islast
    orbStatus = orComplete ? "✅ COMPLETE" : inOpeningRange ? "⏳ FORMING" : "❌ WAITING"
    breakStatus = brokenUp ? "🟢 LONG" : brokenDown ? "🔴 SHORT" : "⚪ NONE"
    fvgStatus = bullishFVGPresent ? "🟢 BULL" : bearishFVGPresent ? "🔴 BEAR" : "⚪ NONE"
    rangeText = orComplete ? str.tostring(orRange, "#.##") : "--"
    
    dashText = "══ NTrades ORB ══\n"
    dashText := dashText + "TF: " + timeframe.period + "\n"
    dashText := dashText + "───────────────────\n"
    if orComplete
        dashText := dashText + "Range: " + rangeText + "\n"
    dashText := dashText + "Breakout: " + breakStatus + "\n"
    dashText := dashText + "FVG: " + fvgStatus + "\n"
    dashText := dashText + "───────────────────\n"
    
    if useDailyDir
        dirStatus = isDailyBullish and isDailyBearish ? "🟡 CHOP" : isDailyBullish ? "🟢 BULL" : isDailyBearish ? "🔴 BEAR" : "⚪ NONE"
        dashText := dashText + "🧭 Daily Bias: " + dirStatus + "\n"
    if useRangeFilter
        dashText := dashText + "🔍 Risk Filter: <" + str.tostring(maxRiskPoints) + "\n"
    if useTrendFilter
        dashText := dashText + "🌊 Trend Filter: ON (" + str.tostring(trendLen) + ")\n"

    if array.size(results) > 0
        dashText := dashText + "📈 Win Rate: " + str.tostring(winRate, "#.#") + "%\n"
        rColor = totalRCaptured >= 0 ? "🟢" : "🔴"
        dashText := dashText + "💰 Total R: " + rColor + " " + str.tostring(totalRCaptured, "#.##") + "R\n"
        dashText := dashText + "📉 Max DD: " + str.tostring(maxDrawdown, "#.##") + "R\n"
        dashText := dashText + "W/L: " + str.tostring(totalWins) + "/" + str.tostring(totalLosses) + "\n"
    else
        dashText := dashText + "📈 No trades in range\n"
    
    dashText := dashText + "═══════════════════"
    var table dashboard = table.new(position.top_right, 1, 1, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 85))
    table.cell(dashboard, 0, 0, text=dashText, text_color=color.black, text_size=size.small)

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// DASHBOARD 2: RISK RANGE ANALYTICS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

if showStatsPanel and barstate.islast
    // Calculate Stats for Winners
    float w_avg = 0.0
    float w_max = 0.0
    float w_min = 999999.0
    
    if array.size(winRanges) > 0
        w_max := array.max(winRanges)
        w_min := array.min(winRanges)
        w_avg := array.avg(winRanges)
    else
        w_min := 0.0

    // Calculate Stats for Losers
    float l_avg = 0.0
    float l_max = 0.0
    float l_min = 999999.0

    if array.size(lossRanges) > 0
        l_max := array.max(lossRanges)
        l_min := array.min(lossRanges)
        l_avg := array.avg(lossRanges)
    else
        l_min := 0.0

    // Build Table
    var table statsTable = table.new(position.bottom_right, 3, 4, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 85), border_width=1, frame_color=color.gray)
    
    // Header
    table.cell(statsTable, 0, 0, "1R Range Stats", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.gray)
    table.cell(statsTable, 1, 0, "Winners 🟢", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.gray)
    table.cell(statsTable, 2, 0, "Losers 🔴", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.gray)
    
    // Average
    table.cell(statsTable, 0, 1, "Avg Range", text_color=color.rgb(0, 0, 0))
    table.cell(statsTable, 1, 1, str.tostring(w_avg, "#.##"), text_color=bullColor)
    table.cell(statsTable, 2, 1, str.tostring(l_avg, "#.##"), text_color=bearColor)
    
    // Max
    table.cell(statsTable, 0, 2, "Max Range", text_color=color.rgb(0, 0, 0))
    table.cell(statsTable, 1, 2, str.tostring(w_max, "#.##"), text_color=bullColor)
    table.cell(statsTable, 2, 2, str.tostring(l_max, "#.##"), text_color=bearColor)

    // Min
    table.cell(statsTable, 0, 3, "Min Range", text_color=color.rgb(0, 0, 0))
    table.cell(statsTable, 1, 3, str.tostring(w_min, "#.##"), text_color=bullColor)
    table.cell(statsTable, 2, 3, str.tostring(l_min, "#.##"), text_color=bearColor)

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ALERTS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

alertcondition(orComplete and not orComplete[1], title="Opening Range Complete", message="ORB Complete")
alertcondition(buySignal, title="ORB Long Signal", message="ORB LONG Breakout Signal!")
alertcondition(sellSignal, title="ORB Short Signal", message="ORB SHORT Breakout Signal!")

items.author: VONKAR
items.source:
//@version=6
// ╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
// ║  ALERT SETUP: Create ONE alert → Order fills only                  ║
// ║  Clear the Message box and paste ONLY this:                        ║
// ║  {{strategy.order.alert_message}}                                  ║
// ║  Add your TradersPost / Ghost webhook URL → Done                   ║
// ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
strategy(
     "ADAPTIVE ORB SESSIONS ",
     overlay                         = true,
     initial_capital                 = 50000,
     currency                        = currency.USD,
     default_qty_type                = strategy.fixed,
     default_qty_value               = 1,
     pyramiding                      = 1,
     commission_type                 = strategy.commission.cash_per_contract,
     commission_value                = 1.2,
     slippage                        = 2,
     margin_long                     = 1,
     margin_short                    = 1,
     calc_on_every_tick              = false,
     calc_on_order_fills             = false,
     use_bar_magnifier               = true,
     process_orders_on_close         = true,
     backtest_fill_limits_assumption = 0,
     fill_orders_on_standard_ohlc    = false,
     max_lines_count                 = 500,
     max_labels_count                = 500,
     max_boxes_count                 = 500
)

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// GLOBAL SETTINGS
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
grpGlobal = "Global Settings"
i_daysToShow  = input.int(10, "Days to Show", minval=1, maxval=50, group=grpGlobal, tooltip="Number of historical days of ORB levels, SL/TP lines, and trade events to display on the chart.")
i_timezone = input.string("America/Los_Angeles", "Timezone", options=["America/New_York", "America/Chicago", "America/Los_Angeles", "Europe/London", "Asia/Tokyo", "Asia/Hong_Kong", "Asia/Singapore", "Australia/Sydney", "UTC"], tooltip="All session times are interpreted in this timezone.", group=grpGlobal)

// ── Helpers ──
f_dayKey(_t, _tz) => year(_t, _tz) * 10000 + month(_t, _tz) * 100 + dayofmonth(_t, _tz)

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ADAPTIVE POSITION SIZING
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
grpAdaptive = "Adaptive Position Sizing"
i_adaptEnable    = input.bool(true, "Enable Adaptive Sizing", group=grpAdaptive, tooltip="When enabled, contract size is calculated dynamically based on ORB range and your max dollar risk per trade. When disabled, uses the fixed Contracts input per session.")
i_adaptMaxRisk   = input.float(500.0, "Max Dollar Risk Per Trade", minval=10.0, step=10.0, group=grpAdaptive, tooltip="Maximum dollar amount you are willing to risk on a single trade. The engine calculates contracts so that (contracts × risk-per-contract) stays at or below this value.")
i_adaptMaxQty    = input.int(9, "Max Contracts", minval=1, maxval=50, group=grpAdaptive, tooltip="Upper limit on contracts regardless of how small the ORB range is.")
i_adaptMinQty    = input.int(1, "Min Contracts", minval=1, maxval=10, group=grpAdaptive, tooltip="Lower limit on contracts. The engine will always trade at least this many, even if the range exceeds your risk budget.")

// ── Adaptive Sizing Engine ──
// Calculates contracts based on actual entry-to-SL risk distance
// Returns clamped qty between min and max
f_adaptiveQty(_riskDistance, _fallbackQty) =>
    if not i_adaptEnable or _riskDistance <= 0
        int(math.max(1, _fallbackQty))
    else
        float _riskPerContract = _riskDistance * syminfo.pointvalue
        int _rawQty = int(math.floor(i_adaptMaxRisk / _riskPerContract))
        int(math.max(i_adaptMinQty, math.min(i_adaptMaxQty, _rawQty)))

// ── Adaptive TP Split ──
// Distributes contracts evenly across active TPs, remainder to earlier TPs
f_adaptiveTpSplit(_totalQty, _tp2RR, _tp3RR, _tp2Enabled, _tp3Enabled) =>
    int total = int(math.max(1, _totalQty))
    bool use2 = _tp2Enabled and _tp2RR > 0
    bool use3 = _tp3Enabled and _tp3RR > 0
    int activeTPs = 1 + (use2 ? 1 : 0) + (use3 ? 1 : 0)
    int base = int(math.floor(total / activeTPs))
    int rem  = total - base * activeTPs
    int q1 = base + (rem > 0 ? 1 : 0)
    int q2 = use2 ? base + (rem > 1 ? 1 : 0) : 0
    int q3 = use3 ? base + (rem > 2 ? 1 : 0) : 0
    // Safety clamp
    if q1 + q2 + q3 != total
        q1 := total - q2 - q3
    [q1, q2, q3]

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ADAPTIVE TAKE PROFIT
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
grpAdaptTP = "Adaptive Take Profit"
i_adaptTPEnable   = input.bool(true, "Enable Adaptive TP", group=grpAdaptTP, tooltip="When enabled, TP R:R multipliers scale based on the current ORB range vs the rolling average range for that session. Wider-than-average range = tighter TPs. Narrower-than-average = wider TPs.")
i_adaptTPLookback = input.int(20, "Lookback Sessions", minval=3, maxval=100, group=grpAdaptTP, tooltip="Number of recent completed ORBs to average for the baseline. Each session (NY/AS/LDN) tracks its own rolling average independently.")
i_adaptTPMin      = input.float(0.4, "TP Compression Min", minval=0.1, maxval=1.0, step=0.05, group=grpAdaptTP, tooltip="Minimum TP multiplier when range is much wider than average. 0.4 means TPs compress to 40% of their set R:R.")
i_adaptTPMax      = input.float(1.8, "TP Stretch Max", minval=1.0, maxval=5.0, step=0.1, group=grpAdaptTP, tooltip="Maximum TP multiplier when range is much tighter than average. 1.8 means TPs stretch to 180% of their set R:R.")

// ── Per-Session Rolling Range Arrays ──
var float[] nyRangeHistory = array.new_float(0)
var float[] asRangeHistory = array.new_float(0)
var float[] lnRangeHistory = array.new_float(0)
var float nyRangeAvg = 0.0
var float asRangeAvg = 0.0
var float lnRangeAvg = 0.0

// ── Helper: update rolling average for a session ──
f_updateRangeAvg(_arr, _newRange, _lookback) =>
    if _newRange > 0
        array.push(_arr, _newRange)
        if array.size(_arr) > _lookback
            array.shift(_arr)
    float _avg = 0.0
    if array.size(_arr) > 0
        float _sum = 0.0
        for i = 0 to array.size(_arr) - 1
            _sum += array.get(_arr, i)
        _avg := _sum / array.size(_arr)
    _avg

// ── Adaptive TP Factor ──
// Uses rolling average as baseline instead of static number
// Wide range → compress TPs (take quick profits)
// Tight range → stretch TPs (let runners ride)
f_adaptTPFactor(_orbRange, _avgRange) =>
    if not i_adaptTPEnable or _orbRange <= 0 or _avgRange <= 0
        1.0
    else
        float _ratio = _orbRange / _avgRange
        float _rawFactor = 1.0 / _ratio
        math.max(i_adaptTPMin, math.min(i_adaptTPMax, _rawFactor))

// Apply adaptive factor to a single R:R value
f_adaptTP(_baseRR, _orbRange, _avgRange) =>
    float _factor = f_adaptTPFactor(_orbRange, _avgRange)
    _baseRR * _factor

// ── TP Quantity Split Helper (prevents 0-qty TPs when trading small size) ──
f_tpQty(_total, _p1, _p2, _p3) =>
    int total = math.max(0, int(math.round(_total)))
    float p1 = math.max(0.0, _p1)
    float p2 = math.max(0.0, _p2)
    float p3 = math.max(0.0, _p3)
    bool a1 = p1 > 0
    bool a2 = p2 > 0
    bool a3 = p3 > 0
    int active = (a1 ? 1 : 0) + (a2 ? 1 : 0) + (a3 ? 1 : 0)
    if total == 0
        [0, 0, 0]
    else if active == 0
        [total, 0, 0]
    else
        // Base allocation (floors)
        int q1 = a1 ? int(math.floor(total * (p1 / 100.0))) : 0
        int q2 = a2 ? int(math.floor(total * (p2 / 100.0))) : 0
        int q3 = a3 ? int(math.floor(total * (p3 / 100.0))) : 0

        // If we have enough contracts to give at least 1 to each active TP, do it.
        if total >= active
            if a1 and q1 == 0
                q1 := 1
            if a2 and q2 == 0
                q2 := 1
            if a3 and q3 == 0
                q3 := 1
        else
            // Not enough contracts to split: prioritize TP1 then TP2 then TP3
            q1 := a1 ? 1 : 0
            q2 := 0
            q3 := 0
            if q1 == 0 and a2
                q2 := 1
            if q1 == 0 and q2 == 0 and a3
                q3 := 1

        int sumQ = q1 + q2 + q3

        // If we over-allocated (can happen after min-1 forcing), trim from later TPs first.
        while sumQ > total
            if q3 > 0
                q3 -= 1
            else if q2 > 0
                q2 -= 1
            else if q1 > 0
                q1 -= 1
            sumQ := q1 + q2 + q3

        // Distribute remainder to earlier TPs by priority and pct weight.
        int rem = total - sumQ
        while rem > 0
            if a1
                q1 += 1
                rem -= 1
            if rem > 0 and a2
                q2 += 1
                rem -= 1
            if rem > 0 and a3
                q3 += 1
                rem -= 1

        [q1, q2, q3]

// ── Shared Trade Settings ──

// ── Day & Time Filters (Global) ──
grpFlat = "Prop Firm Flat Window"
i_flatWindowEnable = input.bool(false, "Enable Flat Window", tooltip="Flatten all positions and block new entries during this time window.", group=grpFlat)
i_flatWindowStart  = input.string("1300", "Flat Start (HHMM)", group=grpFlat, inline="flat", tooltip="Start of the flat window.")
i_flatWindowEnd    = input.string("1500", "Flat End (HHMM)", group=grpFlat, inline="flat", tooltip="End of the flat window.")

// Day filter check
f_dayAllowed(_sun, _mon, _tue, _wed, _thu, _fri, _sat) =>
    int dow = dayofweek(time, i_timezone)
    dow == dayofweek.sunday    ? _sun :
     dow == dayofweek.monday    ? _mon :
     dow == dayofweek.tuesday   ? _tue :
     dow == dayofweek.wednesday ? _wed :
     dow == dayofweek.thursday  ? _thu :
     dow == dayofweek.friday    ? _fri :
     dow == dayofweek.saturday  ? _sat : false

// Prop firm flat window check
_flatStartH = math.floor(str.tonumber(i_flatWindowStart) / 100)
_flatStartM = str.tonumber(i_flatWindowStart) % 100
_flatEndH   = math.floor(str.tonumber(i_flatWindowEnd) / 100)
_flatEndM   = str.tonumber(i_flatWindowEnd) % 100
_curH = hour(time, i_timezone)
_curM = minute(time, i_timezone)
_curTime = _curH * 60 + _curM
_flatStart = _flatStartH * 60 + _flatStartM
_flatEnd   = _flatEndH * 60 + _flatEndM
inFlatWindow = i_flatWindowEnable and (_flatStart < _flatEnd ? (_curTime >= _flatStart and _curTime < _flatEnd) : (_curTime >= _flatStart or _curTime < _flatEnd))
flatWindowJustStarted = inFlatWindow and not inFlatWindow[1]

// ── Trailing Stop Settings ──

// ── Re-Arm Settings ──

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SESSION 1: NEW YORK
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
grpNY = "Session 1: New York ORB"
i_nyEnable     = input.bool(true, "Enable NY Session", group=grpNY, tooltip="Enable trading during the New York session.")
i_nyContracts      = input.int(3, "Contracts", minval=1, maxval=100, group=grpNY, tooltip="Contracts per trade entry.")
i_nyDirection  = input.string("Both", "Direction", options=["Long Only", "Short Only", "Both"], group=grpNY, tooltip="Only take long, short, or both directions for NY session entries.")
i_nyORBStart   = input.string("0630", "ORB Start (HHMM)", group=grpNY, tooltip="Time the Opening Range begins building (24h format, in your selected timezone).")
i_nyORBDur     = input.string("15 Min", "ORB Duration", options=["5 Min", "15 Min", "30 Min", "1 Hour", "Custom"], group=grpNY, tooltip="How long the Opening Range builds before completing. Candles during this window define the high/low of the ORB.")
i_nyORBEnd     = input.string("0645", "ORB Custom End (HHMM)", tooltip="Only used when Duration = Custom", group=grpNY, display=display.none)
i_nySessEnd    = input.string("1300", "Session End (HHMM)", tooltip="Go flat and reset at this time.", group=grpNY)
i_nyFlattenEOD = input.bool(true, "Flatten at Session End", group=grpNY, tooltip="Force close all positions when this session ends using a hard market order (EOS).")
i_nyEntryMode      = input.string("Breakout", "Entry Mode", options=["Breakout", "Retest Zone", "Retest Midpoint"], group=grpNY, tooltip="Breakout: enter on candle close through level.\\nRetest Zone: wait for wick back to broken level.\\nRetest Midpoint: wait for wick back to ORB midpoint.")
i_nyEntryBuffer    = input.int(0, "Entry Buffer (ticks)", minval=0, maxval=50, group=grpNY, tooltip="Ticks beyond ORB level for entry trigger.")
i_nyRetestTimeout  = input.int(20, "Retest Timeout (bars)", minval=3, maxval=100, group=grpNY, display=display.none, tooltip="Bars to wait for retest before signal expires.")
i_nySLMethod   = input.string("Opposite Side", "Stop Loss", options=["Midpoint", "Opposite Side", "Fixed Points"], group=grpNY, tooltip="Where to place the stop loss. Midpoint = ORB mid. Opposite Side = other ORB boundary. Fixed Points = custom distance.")
i_nySLPoints   = input.float(20.0, "SL Fixed Points", minval=0.25, step=0.25, group=grpNY, display=display.none, tooltip="Distance in points for stop loss when using Fixed Points mode.")
i_nyTP1RR      = input.float(1.0, "TP1 R:R", minval=0.1, step=0.1, group=grpNY, inline="nytp1", tooltip="Take Profit 1 as a multiple of the risk (distance to stop loss).")

// ── Helper: check if exit type qualifies for re-arm ──
f_exitQualifies(bool wasSL, string rearmAfter) =>
    (rearmAfter == "Both") or (rearmAfter == "SL Only" and wasSL) or (rearmAfter == "TP Only" and not wasSL)

// ── Helper: check if direction is allowed for re-arm ──
// Returns [allowLong, allowShort]
f_dirAllowed(int lastDir, string rearmDir) =>
    bool aL = true
    bool aS = true
    if rearmDir == "Same Direction"
        aL := lastDir == 1
        aS := lastDir == -1
    else if rearmDir == "Opposite Direction"
        aL := lastDir == -1
        aS := lastDir == 1
    [aL, aS]

calcEndTime(simple string startTime, simple string duration) =>
    startHour = math.floor(str.tonumber(str.substring(startTime, 0, 2)))
    startMin = math.floor(str.tonumber(str.substring(startTime, 2, 4)))
    addMins = switch duration
        "5 Min" => 5
        "15 Min" => 15
        "30 Min" => 30
        "1 Hour" => 60
        => 0
    totalMins = startMin + addMins
    endHour = (startHour + math.floor(totalMins / 60)) % 24
    endMin = totalMins % 60

calcTrail(int dir, float curTrail, float entry, float tp1, float tp2, float tp3, float origSL, bool trailEnabled) =>
    float newTrail = curTrail
    if trailEnabled and dir != 0
        if dir == 1  // long — staircase: TP hit moves SL to previous level
            if not na(tp3) and high >= tp3
                newTrail := math.max(newTrail, tp2)
            else if not na(tp2) and high >= tp2
                newTrail := math.max(newTrail, tp1)
            else if not na(tp1) and high >= tp1
                newTrail := math.max(newTrail, entry)
        else  // short — staircase
            if not na(tp3) and low <= tp3
                newTrail := math.min(newTrail, tp2)
            else if not na(tp2) and low <= tp2
                newTrail := math.min(newTrail, tp1)
            else if not na(tp1) and low <= tp1
                newTrail := math.min(newTrail, entry)
    newTrail
