        strategy.order("EOS", strategy.short, qty=_flatQty, alert_message=_jsonExit)
    else
        strategy.order("EOS", strategy.long, qty=_flatQty, alert_message=_jsonExit)
    nySessionJustEnded := true
    activeSession := 0
    nySigDir := 0
if i_asEnable and i_asFlattenEOD and not inAsTrade and activeSession == 2 and strategy.position_size != 0
    strategy.cancel_all()
    if strategy.position_size > 0
        strategy.order("EOS", strategy.short, qty=_flatQty, alert_message=_jsonExit)
    else
        strategy.order("EOS", strategy.long, qty=_flatQty, alert_message=_jsonExit)
    asSessionJustEnded := true
    activeSession := 0
    asSigDir := 0
if i_lnEnable and i_lnFlattenEOD and not inLnTrade and activeSession == 3 and strategy.position_size != 0
    strategy.cancel_all()
    if strategy.position_size > 0
        strategy.order("EOS", strategy.short, qty=_flatQty, alert_message=_jsonExit)
    else
        strategy.order("EOS", strategy.long, qty=_flatQty, alert_message=_jsonExit)
    nySessionJustEnded := true
    activeSession := 0
    lnSigDir := 0
if strategy.position_size != 0 and not inNYTrade and not inAsTrade and not inLnTrade
    strategy.cancel_all()
    if strategy.position_size > 0
        strategy.order("EOS", strategy.short, qty=_flatQty, alert_message=_jsonExit)
    else
        strategy.order("EOS", strategy.long, qty=_flatQty, alert_message=_jsonExit)
    nySessionJustEnded := true
    activeSession := 0
    nySigDir := 0
    asSigDir := 0
    lnSigDir := 0

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SESSION P&L TRACKING
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ── P&L Dashboard Settings ──
grpPnlDash = "P&L Dashboard"
showPnlDash = input.bool(true, "Show P&L Dashboard", group=grpPnlDash, tooltip="Display the session P&L dashboard on the chart.")
pnlDashPosition = input.string("Bottom Right", "P&L Position", options=["Top Right", "Top Left", "Bottom Right", "Bottom Left"], group=grpPnlDash, display=display.none, tooltip="Corner of the chart to place the P&L dashboard.")
pnlDashMode = input.string("Today", "P&L Mode", options=["Today", "All Time"], group=grpPnlDash, display=display.none, tooltip="Today: reset each trading day. All Time: cumulative since strategy start.")

// ── Today's date tracking ──
var int _todayKey = 0
_currentKey = f_dayKey(time, i_timezone)
_newDay = _currentKey != _todayKey
if _newDay
    _todayKey := _currentKey

// ── Per-session P&L (All Time) ──
f_sessionPnL(_prefix) =>
    float _total = 0.0
    int _wins = 0
    int _count = 0
    int _numTrades = strategy.closedtrades
    if _numTrades > 0
        for i = 0 to _numTrades - 1
            string _id = strategy.closedtrades.entry_id(i)
            if str.startswith(_id, _prefix)
                _total += strategy.closedtrades.profit(i) + strategy.closedtrades.commission(i)
                _count += 1
                if strategy.closedtrades.profit(i) > 0
                    _wins += 1
    [_total, _count, _wins]

// ── Per-session P&L (Today) ──
f_sessionPnLToday(_prefix, _dayKey) =>
    float _total = 0.0
    int _wins = 0
    int _count = 0
    int _numTrades = strategy.closedtrades
    if _numTrades > 0
        for i = 0 to _numTrades - 1
            string _id = strategy.closedtrades.entry_id(i)
            if str.startswith(_id, _prefix)
                int _exitTime = strategy.closedtrades.exit_time(i)
                int _exitDay = f_dayKey(_exitTime, i_timezone)
                if _exitDay == _dayKey
                    _total += strategy.closedtrades.profit(i) + strategy.closedtrades.commission(i)
                    _count += 1
                    if strategy.closedtrades.profit(i) > 0
                        _wins += 1
    [_total, _count, _wins]

// ── Previous day key tracking ──
var int _prevDayKey = 0
if _newDay
    _prevDayKey := nz(_todayKey[1], 0)

// All Time
[nyPnL, nyCount, nyWins] = f_sessionPnL("NY")
[asPnL, asCount, asWins] = f_sessionPnL("AS")
[lnPnL, lnCount, lnWins] = f_sessionPnL("LDN")

// Today
[nyPnLT, nyCountT, nyWinsT] = f_sessionPnLToday("NY", _todayKey)
[asPnLT, asCountT, asWinsT] = f_sessionPnLToday("AS", _todayKey)
[lnPnLT, lnCountT, lnWinsT] = f_sessionPnLToday("LDN", _todayKey)

// Yesterday
[nyPnLY, nyCountY, nyWinsY] = f_sessionPnLToday("NY", _prevDayKey)
[asPnLY, asCountY, asWinsY] = f_sessionPnLToday("AS", _prevDayKey)
[lnPnLY, lnCountY, lnWinsY] = f_sessionPnLToday("LDN", _prevDayKey)

// Select based on mode
bool _isToday = pnlDashMode == "Today"
float _nyP = _isToday ? nyPnLT : nyPnL
int _nyC = _isToday ? nyCountT : nyCount
int _nyW = _isToday ? nyWinsT : nyWins
float _asP = _isToday ? asPnLT : asPnL
int _asC = _isToday ? asCountT : asCount
int _asW = _isToday ? asWinsT : asWins
float _lnP = _isToday ? lnPnLT : lnPnL
int _lnC = _isToday ? lnCountT : lnCount
int _lnW = _isToday ? lnWinsT : lnWins
float _totalP = _nyP + _asP + _lnP
int _totalC = _nyC + _asC + _lnC
int _totalW = _nyW + _asW + _lnW

// Yesterday totals
float _nyPY = nyPnLY
float _asPY = asPnLY
float _lnPY = lnPnLY
float _totalPY = _nyPY + _asPY + _lnPY

// Open trade unrealized P&L
float _openPnL = strategy.openprofit

f_pnlStr(_val) =>
    string _sign = _val >= 0 ? "+" : ""
    _sign + str.tostring(_val, "#,##0.00")

f_wrStr(_wins, _count) =>
    _count > 0 ? str.tostring(math.round(_wins / _count * 100)) + "%" : "—"

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// DASHBOARD 2: SESSION P&L
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
if showPnlDash
    pnlPos = switch pnlDashPosition
        "Top Right" => position.top_right
        "Top Left" => position.top_left
        "Bottom Right" => position.bottom_right
        => position.bottom_left
    var table pnlDash = table.new(pnlPos, 3, 7, bgcolor=dashBgColor, border_width=1, border_color=dashBorderColor)
    if barstate.islast
        string _modeLabel = _isToday ? "TODAY" : "ALL TIME"
        // Header
        pnlDash.cell(0, 0, "", text_color=dashHeaderText, text_size=getDashSize(), bgcolor=dashHeaderBg)
        pnlDash.cell(1, 0, _modeLabel, text_color=dashHeaderText, text_size=getDashSize(), bgcolor=dashHeaderBg)
        pnlDash.cell(2, 0, "PREV DAY", text_color=dashHeaderText, text_size=getDashSize(), bgcolor=dashHeaderBg)
        // NY
        pnlDash.cell(0, 1, "NY", text_color=i_nyHighColor, text_size=getDashSize())
        pnlDash.cell(1, 1, f_pnlStr(_nyP), text_color=_nyP >= 0 ? dashBullColor : dashBearColor, text_size=getDashSize())
        pnlDash.cell(2, 1, f_pnlStr(_nyPY), text_color=_nyPY >= 0 ? dashBullColor : dashBearColor, text_size=getDashSize())
        // Asia
        pnlDash.cell(0, 2, "ASIA", text_color=i_asHighColor, text_size=getDashSize())
        pnlDash.cell(1, 2, f_pnlStr(_asP), text_color=_asP >= 0 ? dashBullColor : dashBearColor, text_size=getDashSize())
        pnlDash.cell(2, 2, f_pnlStr(_asPY), text_color=_asPY >= 0 ? dashBullColor : dashBearColor, text_size=getDashSize())
        // LDN
        pnlDash.cell(0, 3, "LDN", text_color=i_lnHighColor, text_size=getDashSize())
        pnlDash.cell(1, 3, f_pnlStr(_lnP), text_color=_lnP >= 0 ? dashBullColor : dashBearColor, text_size=getDashSize())
        pnlDash.cell(2, 3, f_pnlStr(_lnPY), text_color=_lnPY >= 0 ? dashBullColor : dashBearColor, text_size=getDashSize())
        // Open P&L
        pnlDash.cell(0, 4, "OPEN", text_color=dashLabelColor, text_size=getDashSize())
        pnlDash.cell(1, 4, f_pnlStr(_openPnL), text_color=_openPnL >= 0 ? dashBullColor : dashBearColor, text_size=getDashSize())
        pnlDash.cell(2, 4, "", text_size=getDashSize())
        // Realized total
        pnlDash.cell(0, 5, "REALIZED", text_color=dashLabelColor, text_size=getDashSize(), bgcolor=dashHeaderBg)
        pnlDash.cell(1, 5, f_pnlStr(_totalP), text_color=_totalP >= 0 ? dashBullColor : dashBearColor, text_size=getDashSize(), bgcolor=dashHeaderBg)
        pnlDash.cell(2, 5, f_pnlStr(_totalPY), text_color=_totalPY >= 0 ? dashBullColor : dashBearColor, text_size=getDashSize(), bgcolor=dashHeaderBg)
        // Net (realized + open)
        float _netAll = _totalP + _openPnL
        pnlDash.cell(0, 6, "NET", text_color=dashLabelColor, text_size=getDashSize(), bgcolor=dashHeaderBg)
        pnlDash.cell(1, 6, f_pnlStr(_netAll), text_color=_netAll >= 0 ? dashBullColor : dashBearColor, text_size=getDashSize(), bgcolor=dashHeaderBg)
        pnlDash.cell(2, 6, "", text_size=getDashSize(), bgcolor=dashHeaderBg)

items.author: rupatil
items.source:
//@version=5
indicator("RV - Breakout and Pullback (ORB) Pro V1.2", "RV - Breakout & Pullback (ORB) Pro v1.2", overlay=true, max_lines_count=500, max_labels_count=500)

string GRP4             = "══════════════ Shows Indicators ═════════════"
// Add checkboxes for toggling indicators
showORB = input.bool(true, title="Show Opening Range Breakout (ORB)", group = GRP4)
showPull = input.bool(true, title="Show Strong Pullback", group = GRP4)
showPull1 = input.bool(false, title="Show Pullback", group = GRP4)
showVWAP = input.bool(true, title="Show Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP)", group = GRP4)
showST = input.bool(true, title="Show Supertrend", group = GRP4)
showATHL = input.bool(true, title="Show ATH/ATL & 52WH/L with Candle Coloring", group = GRP4)
showPivotHTF = input.bool(true, title="Show Pivot Point HTF", group = GRP4)
showPivotLTF = input.bool(true, title="Show Pivot Point LTF", group = GRP4)
showEMA1 = input.bool(true, title="Show EMA1", group = GRP4)
showEMA2 = input.bool(true, title="Show EMA2", group = GRP4)
showEMA3 = input.bool(false, title="Show EMA3", group = GRP4)

// ================== EMA ====================
string GRP1             = "══════════ Exponential Moving Average1 ═══════════"
len4 = input.int(9, minval=1, title="Length1", group = GRP1)
src4 = input(close, title="Source1",group = GRP1)
out1 = ta.ema(src4, len4)
plot(showEMA1? out1 : na, title="MA1", color=color.rgb(243, 33, 191),linewidth = 2)


string GRP2             = "══════════ Exponential Moving Average2 ═══════════"
len2 = input.int(21, minval=1, title="Length2", group = GRP2)
src2 = input(close, title="Source2",group = GRP2)
out2 = ta.ema(src2, len2)
plot(showEMA2? out2 : na, title="MA2", color=color.rgb(33, 219, 243))

string GRP3             = "══════════ Exponential Moving Average3 ═══════════"
len3 = input.int(50, minval=1, title="Length3", group = GRP3)
src3 = input(close, title="Source3",group = GRP3)
out3 = ta.ema(src3, len3)
plot(showEMA3? out3 :na, title="MA3", color=color.rgb(33, 243, 44))

//---------------------"Opening Range Breakout (ORB)"-----------------------------------
string GRP5 = "════════ Opening Range Breakout (ORB) ═══════════"
// User Inputs

UpORB = input(true, title='Show Opening Range High', group=GRP5)
DownORB = input(true, title='Show Opening Range Low', group=GRP5)
show_percentage_move = input(true, title="Show Percentage Move Between High and Low", group=GRP5)
timeframe_option = input.string('15', title='Select Opening Range Candle (in minutes)', options=['5', '15', '30', '45', '60', '120'], group=GRP5)
days_to_average = input.int(20, title="Average of no of Day's ORB Candle Range", minval=1, maxval=30, group=GRP5)

// Convert string option to integer
var int selected_timeframe = 0
if (timeframe_option == '5')
    selected_timeframe := 5
else if (timeframe_option == '15')
    selected_timeframe := 15
else if (timeframe_option == '30')
    selected_timeframe := 30
else if (timeframe_option == '45')
    selected_timeframe := 45
else if (timeframe_option == '60')
    selected_timeframe := 60
else
    selected_timeframe := 120

// Helper Functions
is_newbar(res) => ta.change(time(res)) != 0
adopt(r, s) => request.security(syminfo.tickerid, r, s)

// Variables
high_range = ta.valuewhen(is_newbar('D'), high, 0)
low_range = ta.valuewhen(is_newbar('D'), low, 0)
FH = UpORB ? adopt(str.tostring(selected_timeframe), high_range) : na
FL = DownORB ? adopt(str.tostring(selected_timeframe), low_range) : na

// Calculate AORB for the past user-defined number of days
var float AORB = na
if (not na(FH) and not na(FL))
    AORB := (FH - FL) * 100 / FH

// Calculate the average AORB over the past N days excluding today
AORB_series = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "D", ta.valuewhen(not na(AORB), AORB, 1))
AORB_avg = ta.sma(AORB_series, days_to_average)

// Variables to store previous day and week high and low
var float prevDayHigh = na
var float prevDayLow = na
var float dayHigh = na
var float dayLow = na

var float prevWeekHigh = na
var float prevWeekLow = na
var float weekHigh = na
var float weekLow = na

// Update daily high and low
if ta.change(time('D'))
    prevDayHigh := dayHigh
    prevDayLow := dayLow
    dayHigh := high
    dayLow := low
else
    dayHigh := math.max(nz(dayHigh, high), high)
    dayLow := math.min(nz(dayLow, low), low)

// Update weekly high and low
if ta.change(time('W'))
    prevWeekHigh := weekHigh
    prevWeekLow := weekLow
    weekHigh := high
    weekLow := low
else
    weekHigh := math.max(nz(weekHigh, high), high)
    weekLow := math.min(nz(weekLow, low), low)

// Plotting
FHP = plot(showORB and UpORB ? FH : na, color=color.rgb(76, 175, 80), style=plot.style_circles, title="First Bar High")
FLP = plot(showORB and DownORB ? FL : na, color=color.red, style=plot.style_circles, title="First Bar Low")
fill(FHP, FLP, color=(showORB and UpORB and DownORB) ? color.new(#aacfff, 70) : na, display=display.none, title="First Bar H-L Fill")

// Plot the previous day's high and low levels on today's chart
pdh = plot(showORB ? prevDayHigh : na, display=display.none, color=color.green, title="Previous Day High")
pdl = plot(showORB ? prevDayLow : na, display=display.none, color=color.red, title="Previous Day Low")
fill(pdh, pdl, color=showORB ? color.new(#fca0a0, 70) : na, title="Previous Day H-L Fill")

// Plot the previous week's high and low levels on today's chart
pwh = plot(showORB ? prevWeekHigh : na, display=display.none, color=color.green, title="Previous Week High")
pwl = plot(showORB ? prevWeekLow : na, display=display.none, color=color.red, title="Previous Week Low")
fill(pwh, pwl, color=showORB ? color.new(#96faab, 70) : na, display=display.none, title="Previous Week H-L Fill")


// -----------------------LABEL------------------------
if showORB
    // User Inputs for Label Customization
    label_bg_color = input.color(color.new(color.black, 0), title="Label Background Color")
    label_text_color = input.color(color.white, title="Label Text Color")
    label_size = input.string('normal', title="Label Size", options=['tiny', 'small', 'normal', 'large'])
    label_style_option = input.string('label_left', title="Label Style", options=['label_down', 'label_up', 'label_left', 'label_right'])
    label_position_option = input.string('auto', title="Label Position", options=['FH', 'FL', 'center', 'auto'])

    // Determine the label style
    var string label_style = 'label_down'
    if label_style_option == 'label_up'
        label_style := 'label_up'
    else if label_style_option == 'label_left'
        label_style := 'label_left'
    else if label_style_option == 'label_right'
        label_style := 'label_right'

    // Calculate the percentage move between the first high and low for the current day
    var label lbl_0 = na
    if (not na(FH) and not na(FL))
        AORB = (FH - FL) * 100 / FH
        var float label_y = na
        if label_position_option == 'auto'
            label_y := close > FH ? FH : close < FL ? FL : (FH + FL) / 2
        else if label_position_option == 'FH'
            label_y := FH
        else if label_position_option == 'FL'
            label_y := FL
        else
            label_y := (FH + FL) / 2

        if show_percentage_move
            label_text = str.tostring(AORB, '#.##') + '% (' + timeframe_option + ' Min)\n' + str.tostring(AORB_avg, '#.##') + '% (Last '  + str.tostring(days_to_average) + ' D Avg)'
            lbl_0 := label.new(bar_index, label_y, xloc=xloc.bar_index, text=label_text, color=label_bg_color, style=label_style == 'label_down' ? label.style_label_down : label_style == 'label_up' ? label.style_label_up : label_style == 'label_left' ? label.style_label_left : label.style_label_right, textcolor=label_text_color, size=label_size == 'tiny' ? size.tiny : label_size == 'small' ? size.small : label_size == 'normal' ? size.normal : size.large, textalign=text.align_center)

            // Delete the previous label to avoid overlapping
            if (not na(lbl_0[1]))
                label.delete(lbl_0[1])



//---------------------"Volume Weighted Average Price"-----------------------------------
string GRP12             = "═══════ Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP) ═══════"
hideonDWM = input(false, title="Hide VWAP on 1D or Above", group=GRP12, display = display.data_window)
var anchor = input.string(defval = "Session", title="Anchor Period",
 options=["Session", "Week", "Month", "Quarter", "Year", "Decade", "Century", "Earnings", "Dividends", "Splits"], group=GRP12)
src = input(title = "Source", defval = hlc3, group=GRP12, display = display.data_window)
offset = input.int(0, title="Offset", group=GRP12, minval=0, display = display.data_window)

if barstate.islast and ta.cum(volume) == 0
    runtime.error("No volume is provided by the data vendor.")

new_earnings = request.earnings(syminfo.tickerid, earnings.actual, barmerge.gaps_on, barmerge.lookahead_on, ignore_invalid_symbol=true)
new_dividends = request.dividends(syminfo.tickerid, dividends.gross, barmerge.gaps_on, barmerge.lookahead_on, ignore_invalid_symbol=true)
new_split = request.splits(syminfo.tickerid, splits.denominator, barmerge.gaps_on, barmerge.lookahead_on, ignore_invalid_symbol=true)

isNewPeriod = switch anchor
	"Earnings"  => not na(new_earnings)
	"Dividends" => not na(new_dividends)
	"Splits"    => not na(new_split)
	"Session"   => timeframe.change("D")
	"Week"      => timeframe.change("W")
	"Month"     => timeframe.change("M")
	"Quarter"   => timeframe.change("3M")
	"Year"      => timeframe.change("12M")
	"Decade"    => timeframe.change("12M") and year % 10 == 0
	"Century"   => timeframe.change("12M") and year % 100 == 0
	=> false

isEsdAnchor = anchor == "Earnings" or anchor == "Dividends" or anchor == "Splits"
if na(src[1]) and not isEsdAnchor
	isNewPeriod := true

float vwapValue = na
if not (hideonDWM and timeframe.isdwm)
    [_vwap, _stdevUpper, _] = ta.vwap(src, isNewPeriod, 1)
	vwapValue := _vwap
    stdevAbs = _stdevUpper - _vwap

plot(showVWAP ? vwapValue : na, title="VWAP", color=#000207, offset=offset, style = plot.style_cross)

//---------------------"Supertrend"-----------------------------------

string GRP6             = "═══════════════ Supertrend ════════════════"
// Checkbox to show the percentage move calculation
show_percentage_DistST = input(false, title="Show Diff from Price to ST", group=GRP6)

atrPeriod = input.int(10,    "ATR Length", minval = 1, group = GRP6)
factor =    input.float(2.0, "Factor",     minval = 0.01, step = 0.01, group = GRP6)
//offsetPercentage = input.float(0.05, "ST Offset Percentage", minval=0.0, step=0.1, group = GRP6) / 100

[supertrend, direction] = ta.supertrend(factor, atrPeriod)

// Ensure supertrend has a value after the first bar
supertrend := barstate.isfirst ? na : supertrend

supertrend := barstate.isfirst ? na : supertrend
upTrend =    plot(showST ? direction < 0 ? supertrend : na :na, "ST Up Trend",   color = #17f303, style = plot.style_linebr)
downTrend =  plot(showST? direction < 0 ? na : supertrend :na, "ST Down Trend", color = color.rgb(251, 147, 44),   style = plot.style_linebr)
bodyMiddle = plot(showST ? barstate.isfirst ? na : na: (open + close) / 2, "ST Body Middle",display = display.none)

fill(bodyMiddle, upTrend,   color= showST ? color.new(color.green, 90) :na,display = display.none, fillgaps = false)
fill(bodyMiddle, downTrend, color= showST? color.new(color.red,   90): na,display = display.none, fillgaps = false)

// Calculate the offset value
//offsetValue = supertrend * offsetPercentage

// Check if the current candle's low is within the offset range of the Supertrend and the previous 2-3 candles were above the Supertrend
//isUpPullback = (low <= supertrend + offsetValue) and (close >= supertrend) and (close[1] > supertrend[1]) and (close[2] > supertrend[2]) and (close[3] > supertrend[3])
//isDownPullback = (high >= supertrend - offsetValue) and (close <= supertrend) and (close[1] < supertrend[1]) and (close[2] < supertrend[2]) and (close[3] < supertrend[3])

// Mark the pullback on the chart with a circle
//plotshape(showST? isUpPullback :na, title="ST Up Pullback", location=location.belowbar, color=color.green, style=shape.labelup, size=size.small)
//plotshape(showST? isDownPullback :na, title="ST Down Pullback", location=location.abovebar, color=color.red, style=shape.labeldown, size=size.small)

//alertcondition(direction[1] > direction, title='Downtrend to Uptrend', message='The Supertrend value switched from Downtrend to Uptrend ')
//alertcondition(direction[1] < direction, title='Uptrend to Downtrend', message='The Supertrend value switched from Uptrend to Downtrend')
//alertcondition(direction[1] != direction, title='Trend Change', message='The Supertrend value switched from Uptrend to Downtrend or vice versa')

// -----------------------LABEL------------------------

if showST
    if show_percentage_DistST
        DST = (close - supertrend) * 100 / close
        label lbl_1 = label.new(bar_index, supertrend, xloc=xloc.bar_index, text=str.tostring(DST, '#.#') + '%', color=close >= supertrend ? color.green : color.red, style=label.style_label_left, textcolor=color.white, size=size.normal, textalign=text.align_left)
        label.set_x(lbl_1, bar_index[0])
        label.delete(lbl_1[1])

//---------------------------------------------------------//
//'RV- ATH/ATL & 52WH/L with Candle Coloring'- ATH (All-Time High) and ATL (All-Time Low) & 52-Week High and Low (WH/L) with Candle Coloring
string GRP9             = "══════ ATH/ATL & 52WH/L with Candle Coloring ═══════"

// Default values for percentage levels
defaultWhHighLevel = 10
defaultWlLowLevel = 50

// Input parameters for the user to customize levels

plot(showPivotHTF? islastHTF and fibONHTF and fR1HTF > 0 ? ta.change(fR1HTF) != 0 ? na : fR1HTF : na : na, title='HTF-R1', color=colFib_R, linewidth=pwidthHTF, style=linestyleHTF)
plot(showPivotHTF? islastHTF and fibONHTF and fR2HTF > 0 ? ta.change(fR2HTF) != 0 ? na : fR2HTF : na : na, title='HTF-R2', color=colFib_R, linewidth=pwidthHTF, style=linestyleHTF)
plot(showPivotHTF? islastHTF and fibONHTF and fR3HTF > 0 ? ta.change(fR3HTF) != 0 ? na : fR3HTF : na : na, title='HTF-R3', color=colFib_R, linewidth=pwidthHTF, style=linestyleHTF)
plot(showPivotHTF? islastHTF and fibONHTF and fR4HTF > 0 ? ta.change(fR4HTF) != 0 ? na : fR4HTF : na : na, title='HTF-R4', color=colFib_R, linewidth=pwidthHTF, style=linestyleHTF)
plot(showPivotHTF? islastHTF and fibONHTF and fR5HTF > 0 ? ta.change(fR5HTF) != 0 ? na : fR5HTF : na : na, title='HTF-R5', color=colFib_R, linewidth=pwidthHTF, style=linestyleHTF)
plot(showPivotHTF? islastHTF and fibONHTF and fS1HTF > 0 ? ta.change(fS1HTF) != 0 ? na : fS1HTF : na : na, title='HTF-S1', color=colFib_S, linewidth=pwidthHTF, style=linestyleHTF)
plot(showPivotHTF? islastHTF and fibONHTF and fS2HTF > 0 ? ta.change(fS2HTF) != 0 ? na : fS2HTF : na : na , title='HTF-S2', color=colFib_S, linewidth=pwidthHTF, style=linestyleHTF)
plot(showPivotHTF? islastHTF and fibONHTF and fS3HTF > 0 ? ta.change(fS3HTF) != 0 ? na : fS3HTF : na : na, title='HTF-S3', color=colFib_S, linewidth=pwidthHTF, style=linestyleHTF)
plot(showPivotHTF? islastHTF and fibONHTF and fS4HTF > 0 ? ta.change(fS4HTF) != 0 ? na : fS4HTF : na : na, title='HTF-S4', color=colFib_S, linewidth=pwidthHTF, style=linestyleHTF)
plot(showPivotHTF? islastHTF and fibONHTF and fS5HTF > 0 ? ta.change(fS5HTF) != 0 ? na : fS5HTF : na : na, title='HTF-S5', color=colFib_S, linewidth=pwidthHTF, style=linestyleHTF)

items.source:
//@version=6
indicator("STRONG NQ ORB BREAKOUTS", overlay = true,
     max_lines_count = 500, max_boxes_count = 500, max_labels_count = 500, max_bars_back = 1500)

gS = "01 · Session / Opening Range"
orMode = input.string("Auto (session open)", "Range Anchor", options = ["Auto (session open)", "Custom session"], group = gS, tooltip = "AUTO = range starts at this symbol's own daily session open (first bar of the day). Matches the NAS100 feed opening 01:00 server time. CUSTOM = your own window below.")
orMin  = input.int(60, "Opening Range Minutes", minval = 5, maxval = 240, step = 5, group = gS, tooltip = "Length of the opening range. Validated: 60 (default), 45 (punchier).")
tzIn   = input.string("Exchange", "Timezone (Custom)", options = ["Exchange", "America/New_York", "Europe/London", "UTC", "Asia/Tokyo"], group = gS)
orSess = input.session("0100-0200", "Opening Range Window (Custom)", group = gS)
twSess = input.session("0200-2355", "Trade Window (Custom)", group = gS)

gT = "02 · Trade Model (R-based)"
slMode  = input.string("ATR", "Stop Basis", options = ["ATR", "Opposite OR Edge", "OR Mid"], group = gT, tooltip = "Where risk (R) is measured. ATR×1.0 was strongest on NAS100 M5.")
atrLen  = input.int(14, "ATR Length", minval = 1, group = gT)
slAtr   = input.float(1.0, "ATR Stop Distance (×ATR)", minval = 0.2, maxval = 6.0, step = 0.1, group = gT)
minRAtr = input.float(0.25, "Min Risk (×ATR) floor", minval = 0.1, maxval = 5.0, step = 0.05, group = gT)
maxRAtr = input.float(6.0, "Max Risk (×ATR) cap", minval = 0.5, maxval = 12.0, step = 0.5, group = gT)
tp1R    = input.float(1.0, "TP1 (R)", minval = 0.25, maxval = 20, step = 0.25, group = gT)
tp2R    = input.float(2.0, "TP2 (R)", minval = 0.25, maxval = 20, step = 0.25, group = gT)
tp3R    = input.float(3.0, "TP3 (R)", minval = 0.25, maxval = 20, step = 0.25, group = gT)
beAfter1= input.bool(true, "Break-Even after TP1", group = gT, tooltip = "After the first ⅓ banks at TP1, the remaining ⅔ ride with the stop at entry.")
breakMode = input.string("Close", "Breakout Trigger", options = ["Close", "Wick"], group = gT, tooltip = "Close = candle must CLOSE beyond the OR edge (validated). Wick = any touch.")
oneTrade  = input.bool(true, "Max One Trade Per Day", group = gT)

gFlt = "03 · Optional Filters (off by default — no day-skipping)"
useAdrGate= input.bool(false, "Range-vs-ADR Gate (skips days)", group = gFlt, tooltip = "OFF by default so no days are skipped. When ON, skips days whose opening range is abnormally tight/wide vs the ADR.")
adrDays   = input.int(14, "ADR Lookback (days)", minval = 3, maxval = 60, group = gFlt)
minOrPct  = input.float(10.0, "Min OR (% of ADR)", minval = 0, maxval = 100, step = 1, group = gFlt)
maxOrPct  = input.float(50.0, "Max OR (% of ADR)", minval = 5, maxval = 200, step = 1, group = gFlt)
minStr    = input.float(0.0, "Min Strength to Trade (0-10)", minval = 0, maxval = 10, step = 0.5, group = gFlt, tooltip = "Filtering to 'strong only' REDUCED win rate on the test data — stars are best used as context. Defaults to 0.")
useHtf    = input.bool(false, "Require HTF EMA Alignment", group = gFlt)
htfTf     = input.timeframe("60", "HTF Timeframe", group = gFlt)
htfLen    = input.int(50, "HTF EMA Length", minval = 5, maxval = 400, group = gFlt)

gLiq = "04 · Liquidity Magnet"
pivotLen   = input.int(8, "Liquidity Pivot Length", minval = 2, maxval = 50, group = gLiq, tooltip = "Bars each side to confirm a swing pivot pool. Larger = only major resting liquidity.")
showPools  = input.bool(true, "Show Liquidity Pools", group = gLiq)
useMagnet  = input.bool(true, "Show Opposing-Liquidity Magnet", group = gLiq, tooltip = "Projects the nearest opposing unswept liquidity pool — the target the breakout is drawn toward.")

gVis = "05 · Visuals"
theme      = input.string("Midnight", "Color Theme", options = ["Midnight", "Emerald", "Ice Blue", "Gold Black", "Aqua Violet"], group = gVis)
showOR     = input.bool(true, "Show OR Box / Lines", group = gVis)
showProj   = input.bool(true, "Show OR Projection", group = gVis)
showLines  = input.bool(true, "Show SL / TP Lines", group = gVis)
showBoxes  = input.bool(true, "Show SL / TP Zones", group = gVis)
showLevelLbl= input.bool(true, "Label Level Prices", group = gVis)
showExitLbl= input.bool(true, "Show Trade Result Labels", group = gVis)
showSignal = input.bool(true, "Show Signal Labels (★ + prob)", group = gVis)
showStars  = input.bool(true, "Show ★ Tier On Labels", group = gVis)
levelLen   = input.int(14, "Level Shelf (bars)", minval = 2, maxval = 500, group = gVis, tooltip = "Forward shelf length for live SL/TP labels. On close the ticket snaps back to the exit bar so labels never float away.")
lblSizeOpt = input.string("Small", "Label Size", options = ["Tiny", "Small", "Normal", "Large"], group = gVis)
maxHist    = input.int(25, "Max Historical Trades (visual)", minval = 1, maxval = 80, group = gVis, tooltip = "Visual cap only. Statistics always count every closed trade.")

gDash = "06 · Dashboard"
showDash   = input.bool(true, "Show Dashboard", group = gDash)
dashPosOpt = input.string("Top Right", "Position", options = ["Top Right", "Top Left", "Bottom Right", "Bottom Left", "Middle Right"], group = gDash)
dashSizeOpt= input.string("Normal", "Text Size", options = ["Tiny", "Small", "Normal"], group = gDash)
showMeter  = input.bool(true, "Show Strength / Prob Meter Rows", group = gDash)
showHeatRow= input.bool(true, "Show Per-Target Breakdown", group = gDash)
ptMult     = input.int(1, "Point = mintick ×", minval = 1, maxval = 100, group = gDash)

longCol = theme == "Ice Blue" ? color.rgb(0, 190, 255) : theme == "Gold Black" ? color.rgb(255, 196, 48) : theme == "Aqua Violet" ? color.rgb(0, 230, 200) : theme == "Emerald" ? color.rgb(0, 200, 120) : color.rgb(33, 211, 168)
shortCol= theme == "Ice Blue" ? color.rgb(255, 120, 70) : theme == "Gold Black" ? color.rgb(255, 78, 60) : theme == "Aqua Violet" ? color.rgb(180, 110, 255) : theme == "Emerald" ? color.rgb(235, 64, 64) : color.rgb(255, 77, 109)
tpFill  = theme == "Ice Blue" ? color.rgb(0, 90, 130) : theme == "Gold Black" ? color.rgb(96, 74, 0) : theme == "Aqua Violet" ? color.rgb(0, 95, 90) : theme == "Emerald" ? color.rgb(0, 96, 60) : color.rgb(0, 96, 76)
slFill  = theme == "Ice Blue" ? color.rgb(150, 30, 70) : theme == "Gold Black" ? color.rgb(150, 40, 18) : theme == "Aqua Violet" ? color.rgb(110, 30, 120) : theme == "Emerald" ? color.rgb(150, 22, 30) : color.rgb(128, 24, 48)
accentHi= theme == "Ice Blue" ? color.rgb(127, 233, 255) : theme == "Gold Black" ? color.rgb(255, 226, 122) : theme == "Aqua Violet" ? color.rgb(179, 136, 255) : theme == "Emerald" ? color.rgb(120, 240, 170) : color.rgb(255, 210, 63)

color panelBg     = #0a0c12
color panelBgAlt  = #0f131c
color panelHdr    = #161b27
color panelBorder = #2c3342
color txtHi       = #ebeef5
color txtLo       = #8791a2
color neutralCol  = #69748a
color goodCol     = #21c87a
color warnCol     = #e6be46
color badCol      = #e6435a

f_size(string s) =>
    switch s
        "Tiny"   => size.tiny
        "Small"  => size.small
        "Normal" => size.normal
        "Large"  => size.large
        => size.small
f_pos(string p) =>
    switch p
        "Top Left"     => position.top_left
        "Top Right"    => position.top_right
        "Bottom Left"  => position.bottom_left
        "Bottom Right" => position.bottom_right
        "Middle Right" => position.middle_right
        => position.top_right
clamp(v, lo, hi) => math.min(math.max(v, lo), hi)
f_stars(float sc) => sc >= 8.5 ? "★★★★★" : sc >= 7 ? "★★★★" : sc >= 5.5 ? "★★★" : sc >= 4 ? "★★" : sc >= 2.5 ? "★" : "·"
f_tier(float sc)  => sc >= 8.5 ? "ELITE" : sc >= 7 ? "VERY STRONG" : sc >= 5.5 ? "STRONG" : sc >= 4 ? "MODERATE" : sc >= 2.5 ? "WEAK" : "FORMING"
f_signedR(float v) => (v >= 0 ? "+" : "") + str.tostring(v, "#.##") + "R"
f_gauge(float v) =>
    int fill = int(math.round(clamp(v, 0, 100) / 10.0))
    str.repeat("█", fill) + str.repeat("░", 10 - fill)

string tzUse = tzIn == "Exchange" ? syminfo.timezone : tzIn
float ptSize = syminfo.mintick * ptMult
f_pts(float d) => ptSize > 0 ? str.tostring(math.abs(d) / ptSize, "#.#") : "—"
f_px(float p) => str.tostring(p, format.mintick)

atr      = ta.atr(atrLen)
safeAtr  = math.max(nz(atr, high - low), syminfo.mintick)
rsi      = ta.rsi(close, 14)
volSma   = ta.sma(volume, 20)
volRatio = volSma > 0 ? volume / volSma : 1.0
rng      = high - low
bodyR    = rng > 0 ? math.abs(close - open) / rng : 0.5
atrRatio = atr > 0 ? rng / atr : 0.0
mom3     = close - close[3]
mom5     = close - close[5]
htfEma   = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, htfTf, ta.ema(close, htfLen)[1], lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_off)
adr      = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "D", ta.sma(high - low, adrDays)[1], lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_off)

bool autoM  = orMode == "Auto (session open)"
dayStart    = time("D")
inORauto    = not na(dayStart) and (time - dayStart) < orMin * 60000
inORcust    = not na(time(timeframe.period, orSess, tzUse))
inTWcust    = not na(time(timeframe.period, twSess, tzUse))
bool inOR   = autoM ? inORauto : inORcust
bool inTW   = autoM ? true : inTWcust
bool newDay = ta.change(time("D")) != 0

var float orH = na
var float orL = na
var float orMid = na
var float orRange = na
var float dayOpen = na
var bool  orReady = false
var int   orStartBar = na
var int   tradesToday = 0
var float adrAtOpen = na

orOpen  = inOR and not inOR[1]
orClose = not inOR and inOR[1]
twClose = autoM ? newDay : (not inTW and inTW[1])

if orOpen
    orH := high
    orL := low
    orStartBar := bar_index
    orReady := false
    dayOpen := open
    adrAtOpen := adr
if inOR and not orOpen and not na(orH)
    orH := math.max(orH, high)
    orL := math.min(orL, low)
if newDay
    tradesToday := 0

bool justFormed = false
if orClose and not na(orH) and not na(orL)
    orMid := (orH + orL) / 2
    orRange := orH - orL
    orReady := true
    justFormed := true

ph = ta.pivothigh(high, pivotLen, pivotLen)
pl = ta.pivotlow(low, pivotLen, pivotLen)
var array<float> poolHighVal  = array.new<float>(0)
var array<bool>  poolHighSwept= array.new<bool>(0)
var array<float> poolLowVal   = array.new<float>(0)
var array<bool>  poolLowSwept = array.new<bool>(0)
var array<line>  poolLines    = array.new<line>(0)

if not na(ph)
    array.push(poolHighVal, ph)
    array.push(poolHighSwept, false)
    if showPools
        array.push(poolLines, line.new(bar_index - pivotLen, ph, bar_index, ph, color = color.new(shortCol, 62), style = line.style_dotted, width = 1))
if not na(pl)
    array.push(poolLowVal, pl)
    array.push(poolLowSwept, false)
    if showPools
        array.push(poolLines, line.new(bar_index - pivotLen, pl, bar_index, pl, color = color.new(longCol, 62), style = line.style_dotted, width = 1))
if array.size(poolHighVal) > 120
    array.shift(poolHighVal)
    array.shift(poolHighSwept)
if array.size(poolLowVal) > 120
    array.shift(poolLowVal)
    array.shift(poolLowSwept)
if array.size(poolLines) > 80
    line.delete(array.shift(poolLines))
if array.size(poolHighVal) > 0
    for i = 0 to array.size(poolHighVal) - 1
        if not array.get(poolHighSwept, i) and high > array.get(poolHighVal, i)
            array.set(poolHighSwept, i, true)
if array.size(poolLowVal) > 0
    for i = 0 to array.size(poolLowVal) - 1
        if not array.get(poolLowSwept, i) and low < array.get(poolLowVal, i)
            array.set(poolLowSwept, i, true)

f_magnetUp() =>
    float best = na
    if array.size(poolHighVal) > 0
        for i = array.size(poolHighVal) - 1 to 0
            if not array.get(poolHighSwept, i) and array.get(poolHighVal, i) > close
                best := array.get(poolHighVal, i)
                break
    best
f_magnetDn() =>
    float best = na
    if array.size(poolLowVal) > 0
        for i = array.size(poolLowVal) - 1 to 0
            if not array.get(poolLowSwept, i) and array.get(poolLowVal, i) < close
                best := array.get(poolLowVal, i)
                break
    best

f_strength(bool isLong, float pen, float bdy, float atrR, float volR, float m3, float m5, float rsiv, bool htfOk, bool biasOk) =>
    s = 0.0
    s += bdy >= 0.85 ? 1.5 : bdy >= 0.70 ? 1.1 : bdy >= 0.55 ? 0.6 : 0.2
    s += atrR >= 2.0 ? 1.5 : atrR >= 1.4 ? 1.0 : atrR >= 1.0 ? 0.6 : 0.2
    s += volR >= 2.0 ? 1.5 : volR >= 1.5 ? 1.0 : volR >= 1.2 ? 0.5 : 0.0
    m3ok = (isLong and m3 > 0) or (not isLong and m3 < 0)
    m5ok = (isLong and m5 > 0) or (not isLong and m5 < 0)
    s += m3ok and m5ok ? 1.5 : m3ok or m5ok ? 0.7 : -0.4
    s += pen >= 0.5 ? 1.0 : pen >= 0.25 ? 0.6 : pen >= 0.1 ? 0.3 : 0.0
    rsiOk = (isLong and rsiv > 52) or (not isLong and rsiv < 48)
    s += rsiOk ? 0.5 : 0.0
    s += htfOk ? 1.0 : 0.0
    s += biasOk ? 0.5 : 0.0
    s += 1.0
    math.max(0.0, math.min(10.0, math.round(s * 10) / 10))

f_bullProb(float penUp, float penDn, float m3, float m5, float rsiv, float px, float dOpen, float htf) =>
    float bull = 0.0
    float bear = 0.0
    bull += penUp > 0 ? math.min(penUp, 1.0) * 30.0 : 0.0
    bear += penDn > 0 ? math.min(penDn, 1.0) * 30.0 : 0.0
    float ml = clamp((m3 + m5) / (safeAtr * 2.0), -1.0, 1.0)
    bull += (ml > 0 ? ml : 0.0) * 25.0
    bear += (ml < 0 ? -ml : 0.0) * 25.0
    float rl = clamp((rsiv - 50.0) / 25.0, -1.0, 1.0)
    bull += (rl > 0 ? rl : 0.0) * 20.0
    bear += (rl < 0 ? -rl : 0.0) * 20.0
    bull += not na(dOpen) and px > dOpen ? 15.0 : 0.0
    bear += not na(dOpen) and px < dOpen ? 15.0 : 0.0
    bull += px > htf ? 10.0 : 0.0
    bear += px < htf ? 10.0 : 0.0
    float t = bull + bear
    t > 0 ? math.round(bull / t * 100.0) : 50.0

var bool tActive = false
bool flat = not tActive
bool canBreak = orReady and inTW and flat and (not oneTrade or tradesToday == 0)

float penUp = atr > 0 ? (close - orH) / atr : 0.0
float penDn = atr > 0 ? (orL - close) / atr : 0.0
bool htfOkUp = not useHtf or close > htfEma
bool htfOkDn = not useHtf or close < htfEma
bool biasUp  = not na(dayOpen) and close > dayOpen
bool biasDn  = not na(dayOpen) and close < dayOpen

bool rawUp = breakMode == "Close" ? close > orH : high > orH
bool rawDn = breakMode == "Close" ? close < orL : low  < orL
bool longBrk  = canBreak and rawUp and not rawDn
bool shortBrk = canBreak and rawDn and not rawUp

float coilPct = not na(adrAtOpen) and adrAtOpen > 0 and not na(orRange) ? orRange / adrAtOpen * 100.0 : na
bool adrOk = not useAdrGate or (not na(coilPct) and coilPct >= minOrPct and coilPct <= maxOrPct)

float scUp = longBrk  ? f_strength(true,  penUp, bodyR, atrRatio, volRatio, mom3, mom5, rsi, htfOkUp, biasUp) : 0.0
float scDn = shortBrk ? f_strength(false, penDn, bodyR, atrRatio, volRatio, mom3, mom5, rsi, htfOkDn, biasDn) : 0.0

bool fireLong  = longBrk  and htfOkUp and adrOk and scUp >= minStr and not na(atr)
bool fireShort = shortBrk and htfOkDn and adrOk and scDn >= minStr and not na(atr)

type ticket
    line  e  = na
    line  s  = na
    line  t1 = na
    line  t2 = na
    line  t3 = na
    line  mg = na
    box   tb = na
    box   sb = na
    label sg = na
    label le = na
    label ls = na
    label l1 = na
    label l2 = na
    label l3 = na
    label ex = na
var array<ticket> history = array.new<ticket>(0)

var int   tSide = 0
var int   tBar = na
var float tEntry = na
var float tStop = na
var float tT1 = na
var float tT2 = na
var float tT3 = na
var float tRisk = na
var float tScore = na
var float tProb = na
var int   bestStage = 0
var bool  beMoved = false
var int   lastSide = 0
var float lastScore = na
var float lastProb = na

var line  aE = na
var line  aS = na
var line  a1 = na
var line  a2 = na
var line  a3 = na
var line  aM = na
var box   aTB = na
var box   aSB = na
var label aSG = na
var label lE = na
var label lS = na
var label l1 = na
var label l2 = na
var label l3 = na

var int   sClosed = 0
var int   sWins = 0
var float sRsum = 0.0
var float sGW = 0.0
var float sGL = 0.0
var int   sLong = 0
var int   sLongW = 0
var int   sShort = 0
var int   sShortW = 0
var int   sTp1 = 0
var int   sTp2 = 0
var int   sTp3 = 0
var int   sSl = 0
var int   sEod = 0
var int   sStrongT = 0
var int   sStrongW = 0
var int   sCurW = 0
var int   sCurL = 0
var int   sMaxW = 0
var int   sMaxL = 0
var int   sStreak = 0

aRight = tActive and not na(tBar) ? math.max(bar_index, tBar + levelLen) : na
if tActive
    if not na(aE)
        line.set_x2(aE, aRight)
    if not na(aS)
        line.set_x2(aS, aRight)
    if not na(a1)
        line.set_x2(a1, aRight)
    if not na(a2)
        line.set_x2(a2, aRight)
    if not na(a3)
        line.set_x2(a3, aRight)
    if not na(aM)
        line.set_x2(aM, aRight)
    if not na(aTB)
        box.set_right(aTB, aRight)
    if not na(aSB)
        box.set_right(aSB, aRight)
    if not na(lE)
        label.set_x(lE, aRight)
    if not na(lS)
        label.set_x(lS, aRight)
    if not na(l1)
        label.set_x(l1, aRight)
    if not na(l2)
        label.set_x(l2, aRight)
    if not na(l3)
        label.set_x(l3, aRight)

bool closedTp3 = false
bool closedSl  = false
bool closedTp  = false
bool closedEod = false

if tActive and bar_index > tBar
    isL = tSide == 1
    bool tp1Hit = isL ? high >= tT1 : low <= tT1
    bool tp2Hit = isL ? high >= tT2 : low <= tT2
    bool tp3Hit = isL ? high >= tT3 : low <= tT3
    bool slHit  = isL ? low  <= tStop : high >= tStop

    if beAfter1 and not beMoved and tp1Hit and not slHit
        tStop := tEntry
        beMoved := true

    int stage = tp3Hit ? 3 : tp2Hit ? 2 : tp1Hit ? 1 : 0
    bool sameBarSl = slHit and stage > 0
    if stage > bestStage and not sameBarSl
        bestStage := stage
    bool finalTp3 = not sameBarSl and bestStage == 3
    bool finalSl  = slHit and (bestStage == 0 or (sameBarSl and not beMoved))
    bool finalTp  = slHit and not finalSl and bestStage > 0 and bestStage < 3
    bool finalEod = twClose and not (finalTp3 or finalSl or finalTp)

    if finalTp3 or finalSl or finalTp or finalEod
        float r1 = bestStage >= 1 ? tp1R : -1.0
        float r2 = bestStage >= 2 ? tp2R : (beMoved ? 0.0 : (finalSl ? -1.0 : (isL ? (close - tEntry) / tRisk : (tEntry - close) / tRisk)))
        float r3 = bestStage >= 3 ? tp3R : (beMoved ? 0.0 : (finalSl ? -1.0 : (isL ? (close - tEntry) / tRisk : (tEntry - close) / tRisk)))
        if finalSl and bestStage == 0
            r1 := -1.0
            r2 := -1.0
            r3 := -1.0
        float resR = (r1 + r2 + r3) / 3.0
        bool isWin = resR > 0
        closedTp3 := finalTp3
        closedSl  := finalSl and bestStage == 0
        closedTp  := finalTp or (finalSl and bestStage > 0)
        closedEod := finalEod

        sClosed += 1
        sRsum += resR
        if isWin
            sWins += 1
            sGW += resR
            sCurW += 1
            sCurL := 0
            sMaxW := math.max(sMaxW, sCurW)
            sStreak := sCurW
            if tScore >= 7
                sStrongW += 1
        else
            sGL += math.abs(resR)
            sCurL += 1
            sCurW := 0
            sMaxL := math.max(sMaxL, sCurL)
            sStreak := -sCurL
        if isL
            sLong += 1
            sLongW += isWin ? 1 : 0
        else
            sShort += 1
            sShortW += isWin ? 1 : 0
        int stageDash = finalTp3 ? 3 : bestStage
        if finalSl and bestStage == 0
            sSl += 1
        else if finalEod and bestStage == 0
            sEod += 1
        else if stageDash >= 3
            sTp3 += 1
        else if stageDash == 2
            sTp2 += 1
        else
            sTp1 += 1

        int closeEdge = math.max(bar_index, tBar + 3)
        if not na(aE)
            line.set_x2(aE, closeEdge)
        if not na(aS)
            line.set_x2(aS, closeEdge)
        if not na(a1)
            line.set_x2(a1, closeEdge)
        if not na(a2)
            line.set_x2(a2, closeEdge)
        if not na(a3)
            line.set_x2(a3, closeEdge)
        if not na(aM)
            line.set_x2(aM, closeEdge)
        if not na(aTB)
            box.set_right(aTB, closeEdge)
        if not na(aSB)
            box.set_right(aSB, closeEdge)
        if not na(lE)
            label.set_x(lE, closeEdge)
        if not na(lS)
            label.set_x(lS, closeEdge)
        if not na(l1)
            label.set_x(l1, closeEdge)
        if not na(l2)
            label.set_x(l2, closeEdge)
        if not na(l3)
            label.set_x(l3, closeEdge)

        label exLbl = na
        if showExitLbl
            float resPx = finalTp3 ? tT3 : stageDash == 2 ? tT2 : stageDash == 1 ? tT1 : (finalSl ? tStop : close)
            string exTxt = closedSl ? "SL ✘ " + f_signedR(resR) : closedEod and bestStage == 0 ? "EOD ⏱ " + f_signedR(resR) : "TP" + str.tostring(math.max(stageDash, 1)) + " ✔ " + f_signedR(resR)
            color exCol = isWin ? goodCol : badCol
            bool up = isL == isWin
            exLbl := label.new(closeEdge, resPx, exTxt, style = up ? label.style_label_down : label.style_label_up, color = color.new(exCol, 6), textcolor = color.white, size = f_size(lblSizeOpt))

        array.push(history, ticket.new(aE, aS, a1, a2, a3, aM, aTB, aSB, aSG, lE, lS, l1, l2, l3, exLbl))
        while array.size(history) > maxHist
            ticket old = array.shift(history)
            line.delete(old.e)
            line.delete(old.s)
            line.delete(old.t1)
            line.delete(old.t2)
            line.delete(old.t3)
            line.delete(old.mg)
            box.delete(old.tb)
            box.delete(old.sb)
            label.delete(old.sg)
            label.delete(old.le)
            label.delete(old.ls)
            label.delete(old.l1)
            label.delete(old.l2)
            label.delete(old.l3)
            label.delete(old.ex)

        aE := na
        aS := na
        a1 := na
        a2 := na
        a3 := na
        aM := na
        aTB := na
        aSB := na
        aSG := na
        lE := na
        lS := na
        l1 := na
        l2 := na
        l3 := na
        tActive := false
        tSide := 0
        tBar := na
        bestStage := 0
        beMoved := false

if (fireLong or fireShort) and not tActive
    isL = fireLong
    side = isL ? 1 : -1
    sc = isL ? scUp : scDn
    prob = f_bullProb(penUp, penDn, mom3, mom5, rsi, close, dayOpen, htfEma)
    ent = close
    rawStop = slMode == "ATR" ? (isL ? ent - atr * slAtr : ent + atr * slAtr) : slMode == "OR Mid" ? orMid : (isL ? orL : orH)
    risk0 = math.abs(ent - rawStop)
    risk = math.min(math.max(risk0, minRAtr * atr), maxRAtr * atr)
    if risk > 0
        stp = isL ? ent - risk : ent + risk
        t1  = isL ? ent + risk * tp1R : ent - risk * tp1R
        t2  = isL ? ent + risk * tp2R : ent - risk * tp2R
        t3  = isL ? ent + risk * tp3R : ent - risk * tp3R
        tActive := true
        tSide := side
        tBar := bar_index
        tEntry := ent
        tStop := stp
        tT1 := t1
        tT2 := t2
        tT3 := t3
        tRisk := risk
        tScore := sc
        tProb := prob
        bestStage := 0
        beMoved := false
        lastSide := side
        lastScore := sc
        lastProb := prob
        tradesToday += 1
        if sc >= 7
            sStrongT += 1

        col = isL ? longCol : shortCol
        xr = bar_index + levelLen
        if showBoxes
            aTB := box.new(bar_index, isL ? t3 : ent, xr, isL ? ent : t3, xloc = xloc.bar_index, bgcolor = color.new(tpFill, 80), border_color = color.new(col, 40), border_width = 1)
            aSB := box.new(bar_index, isL ? ent : stp, xr, isL ? stp : ent, xloc = xloc.bar_index, bgcolor = color.new(slFill, 80), border_color = color.new(shortCol, 50), border_width = 1)
        if showLines
            aE := line.new(bar_index, ent, xr, ent, xloc = xloc.bar_index, color = color.new(col, 0), width = 2)
            aS := line.new(bar_index, stp, xr, stp, xloc = xloc.bar_index, color = color.new(badCol, 5), width = 1, style = line.style_dashed)
            a1 := line.new(bar_index, t1, xr, t1, xloc = xloc.bar_index, color = color.new(col, 15), width = 1)
            a2 := line.new(bar_index, t2, xr, t2, xloc = xloc.bar_index, color = color.new(col, 32), width = 1)
            a3 := line.new(bar_index, t3, xr, t3, xloc = xloc.bar_index, color = color.new(col, 48), width = 1)
            if useMagnet
                mg = isL ? f_magnetUp() : f_magnetDn()
                if not na(mg)
                    aM := line.new(bar_index, mg, xr, mg, xloc = xloc.bar_index, color = color.new(accentHi, 25), width = 1, style = line.style_dotted)
        if showSignal
            probTxt = (prob >= 50 ? "▲" : "▼") + str.tostring(prob >= 50 ? prob : 100 - prob, "#") + "%"
            sgTxt = (isL ? "NQ ORB LONG" : "NQ ORB SHORT") + (showStars ? "  " + f_stars(sc) + " " + str.tostring(sc, "#.#") : "") + "  " + probTxt
            aSG := label.new(bar_index, isL ? low : high, sgTxt, style = isL ? label.style_label_up : label.style_label_down, color = color.new(col, 8), textcolor = color.white, size = f_size(lblSizeOpt))
        if showLevelLbl
            dw = (isL ? "LONG " : "SHORT ") + f_stars(sc) + " " + str.tostring(sc, "#.#")
            lE := label.new(xr, ent, dw + " @ " + f_px(ent), xloc = xloc.bar_index, style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(col, 0), textcolor = color.white, size = f_size(lblSizeOpt))
            lS := label.new(xr, stp, "SL @ " + f_px(stp), xloc = xloc.bar_index, style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(badCol, 5), textcolor = color.white, size = f_size(lblSizeOpt))
            l1 := label.new(xr, t1, "TP1 " + str.tostring(tp1R, "#.#") + "R @ " + f_px(t1), xloc = xloc.bar_index, style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(col, 12), textcolor = color.white, size = f_size(lblSizeOpt))
            l2 := label.new(xr, t2, "TP2 " + str.tostring(tp2R, "#.#") + "R @ " + f_px(t2), xloc = xloc.bar_index, style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(col, 28), textcolor = color.white, size = f_size(lblSizeOpt))
            l3 := label.new(xr, t3, "TP3 " + str.tostring(tp3R, "#.#") + "R @ " + f_px(t3), xloc = xloc.bar_index, style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(col, 44), textcolor = color.white, size = f_size(lblSizeOpt))

var box  orBox = na
var line orHL = na
var line orLL = na
var line orML = na
var line orHP = na
var line orLP = na
var array<box> orBoxHist = array.new<box>(0)
var array<line> orLineHist = array.new<line>(0)

if justFormed and showOR and not na(orH)
    orEndBar = bar_index - 1
    xrO = orStartBar + levelLen * 4
    orBox := box.new(orStartBar, orH, orEndBar, orL, bgcolor = color.new(accentHi, 90), border_color = color.new(accentHi, 45), border_width = 1)
    orHL := line.new(orStartBar, orH, orEndBar, orH, color = color.new(accentHi, 0), width = 2)
    orLL := line.new(orStartBar, orL, orEndBar, orL, color = color.new(accentHi, 0), width = 2)
    orML := line.new(orStartBar, orMid, orEndBar, orMid, color = color.new(accentHi, 55), width = 1, style = line.style_dotted)
    if showProj
        orHP := line.new(orEndBar, orH, xrO, orH, color = color.new(accentHi, 30), width = 1, style = line.style_dashed)
        orLP := line.new(orEndBar, orL, xrO, orL, color = color.new(accentHi, 30), width = 1, style = line.style_dashed)
    array.push(orBoxHist, orBox)
    array.push(orLineHist, orHL)
    array.push(orLineHist, orLL)
    array.push(orLineHist, orML)
    if not na(orHP)
        array.push(orLineHist, orHP)
    if not na(orLP)
        array.push(orLineHist, orLP)
    while array.size(orBoxHist) > maxHist
        box.delete(array.shift(orBoxHist))
    while array.size(orLineHist) > maxHist * 5
        line.delete(array.shift(orLineHist))

if showOR and orReady and not na(orHP) and (autoM or inTW)
    line.set_x2(orHP, bar_index)
    line.set_x2(orLP, bar_index)

bgcolor(inOR ? color.new(accentHi, 93) : na, title = "OR Window")
plotshape(fireLong,  "Long Signal",  shape.triangleup,   location.belowbar, longCol,  size = size.tiny)
plotshape(fireShort, "Short Signal", shape.triangledown, location.abovebar, shortCol, size = size.tiny)

winRate = sClosed > 0 ? sWins / sClosed * 100.0 : 0.0
avgR    = sClosed > 0 ? sRsum / sClosed : 0.0
pf      = sGL > 0 ? sGW / sGL : sGW > 0 ? 999.0 : 0.0
longWR  = sLong  > 0 ? sLongW  / sLong  * 100.0 : 0.0
shortWR = sShort > 0 ? sShortW / sShort * 100.0 : 0.0
tp1Rate = sClosed > 0 ? (sTp1 + sTp2 + sTp3) / sClosed * 100.0 : 0.0
tp2Rate = sClosed > 0 ? (sTp2 + sTp3) / sClosed * 100.0 : 0.0
tp3Rate = sClosed > 0 ? sTp3 / sClosed * 100.0 : 0.0
slRate  = sClosed > 0 ? sSl / sClosed * 100.0 : 0.0

statusTxt = tActive ? "TRADE ACTIVE" : orReady ? (inTW ? "ARMED" : "RANGE SET") : inOR ? "FORMING OR" : "WAITING"
statusC   = tActive ? accentHi : orReady ? goodCol : inOR ? warnCol : neutralCol
domBias = tActive ? (tSide == 1 ? "LONG ACTIVE" : "SHORT ACTIVE") : orReady and inTW ? "ARMED ▲▼" : "— IDLE —"
domCol  = tActive ? (tSide == 1 ? longCol : shortCol) : orReady ? txtHi : neutralCol
lastRank = na(lastScore) ? "—" : f_stars(lastScore) + " " + str.tostring(lastScore, "#.#")
orTxt = na(orRange) ? "—" : f_pts(orRange) + "pt" + (na(coilPct) ? "" : "  " + str.tostring(coilPct, "#") + "%ADR")
magUp = f_magnetUp()
magDn = f_magnetDn()
distTxt = (not na(magUp) ? str.tostring(math.round((magUp - close) / safeAtr * 10) / 10, "#.#") : "—") + "↑ / " + (not na(magDn) ? str.tostring(math.round((close - magDn) / safeAtr * 10) / 10, "#.#") : "—") + "↓"
bestDir = sLong == 0 and sShort == 0 ? "—" : longWR > shortWR ? "LONG" : shortWR > longWR ? "SHORT" : "EVEN"
streakTxt = sStreak > 0 ? "W" + str.tostring(sStreak) : sStreak < 0 ? "L" + str.tostring(math.abs(sStreak)) : "—"
pfTxt = pf >= 999 ? "INF" : str.tostring(pf, "#.##")
liveScore = tActive ? tScore : lastScore
liveProb  = tActive ? tProb : lastProb
color wrC = winRate >= 55 ? goodCol : winRate >= 45 ? warnCol : badCol
color pfC = pf >= 1.5 ? goodCol : pf >= 1.0 ? warnCol : badCol

var int meterRows = showMeter ? 4 : 0
var int baseRows  = 11
var int dashRows  = baseRows + meterRows + (showHeatRow ? 1 : 0)
var table dash = table.new(f_pos(dashPosOpt), 2, dashRows, frame_color = color.new(panelBorder, 0), frame_width = 1, border_color = color.new(panelBorder, 30), border_width = 1)

f_row(int r, string k, string v, color vc, color bg) =>
    ps = f_size(dashSizeOpt)
    table.cell(dash, 0, r, k, text_color = txtLo, text_size = ps, text_halign = text.align_left,   bgcolor = bg)
    table.cell(dash, 1, r, v, text_color = vc,    text_size = ps, text_halign = text.align_center, bgcolor = bg)

if barstate.islast and showDash
    ps = f_size(dashSizeOpt)
    table.clear(dash, 0, 0, 1, dashRows - 1)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 0, "◈ STRONG NQ ORB", text_color = txtHi, text_size = ps, text_halign = text.align_left, bgcolor = panelHdr)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 0, "BREAKOUTS", text_color = accentHi, text_size = ps, text_halign = text.align_center, bgcolor = panelHdr)

    int r = 1
    f_row(r, "Bias", domBias, domCol, panelBg)
    r += 1
    f_row(r, "Status", statusTxt, statusC, panelBgAlt)
    r += 1
    if showMeter
        f_row(r, "Signal Strength", na(liveScore) ? "—" : f_gauge(liveScore * 10) + " " + str.tostring(liveScore, "#.#"), na(liveScore) ? txtLo : liveScore >= 7 ? accentHi : liveScore >= 5.5 ? goodCol : warnCol, panelBg)
        r += 1
        f_row(r, "Direction Prob", na(liveProb) ? "—" : f_gauge(liveProb >= 50 ? liveProb : 100 - liveProb) + " " + (liveProb >= 50 ? "▲" : "▼") + str.tostring(liveProb >= 50 ? liveProb : 100 - liveProb, "#") + "%", na(liveProb) ? txtLo : liveProb >= 50 ? longCol : shortCol, panelBgAlt)
        r += 1
        f_row(r, "OR Range", orTxt, txtHi, panelBg)
        r += 1
        f_row(r, "Magnet Dist (ATR)", distTxt, txtHi, panelBgAlt)
        r += 1
    f_row(r, "Active Trade", tActive ? (tSide == 1 ? "LONG OPEN" : "SHORT OPEN") : "FLAT", tActive ? domCol : neutralCol, panelBg)
    r += 1
    f_row(r, "Win Rate", sClosed > 0 ? str.tostring(winRate, "#.#") + "%  (" + str.tostring(sWins) + "/" + str.tostring(sClosed) + ")" : "—", sClosed > 0 ? wrC : neutralCol, panelBgAlt)
    r += 1
    f_row(r, "Profit Factor", sClosed > 0 ? pfTxt : "—", sClosed > 0 ? pfC : neutralCol, panelBg)
    r += 1
    f_row(r, "Avg R / Trade", sClosed > 0 ? f_signedR(avgR) : "—", sClosed > 0 ? (avgR >= 0 ? goodCol : badCol) : neutralCol, panelBgAlt)
    r += 1
    f_row(r, "Total R", sClosed > 0 ? f_signedR(sRsum) : "—", sRsum >= 0 ? goodCol : badCol, panelBg)
    r += 1
    f_row(r, "Best Direction", bestDir, bestDir == "LONG" ? longCol : bestDir == "SHORT" ? shortCol : neutralCol, panelBgAlt)
    r += 1
    f_row(r, "L / S Win%", sClosed > 0 ? str.tostring(longWR, "#") + " / " + str.tostring(shortWR, "#") : "—", txtHi, panelBg)
    r += 1
    f_row(r, "Streak", streakTxt + "  (max W" + str.tostring(sMaxW) + "/L" + str.tostring(sMaxL) + ")", sStreak >= 0 ? goodCol : badCol, panelBgAlt)
    r += 1
    if showHeatRow
        table.cell(dash, 0, r, "TP1/2/3 · SL", text_color = txtLo, text_size = ps, text_halign = text.align_left, bgcolor = panelHdr)
        table.cell(dash, 1, r, str.tostring(tp1Rate, "#") + "/" + str.tostring(tp2Rate, "#") + "/" + str.tostring(tp3Rate, "#") + " · " + str.tostring(slRate, "#") + "%", text_color = txtHi, text_size = ps, text_halign = text.align_center, bgcolor = panelHdr)

alertcondition(fireLong,  "ORB Long",  "STRONG NQ ORB: LONG breakout on {{ticker}} {{interval}}")
alertcondition(fireShort, "ORB Short", "STRONG NQ ORB: SHORT breakout on {{ticker}} {{interval}}")
alertcondition(closedTp3, "TP3 Hit",   "STRONG NQ ORB: TP3 reached on {{ticker}} {{interval}}")
alertcondition(closedTp,  "Partial TP","STRONG NQ ORB: protected TP exit on {{ticker}} {{interval}}")
alertcondition(closedSl,  "SL Hit",    "STRONG NQ ORB: stop-loss on {{ticker}} {{interval}}")
