items.source:
// This Pine Script® code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
// © officialjackofalltrades
//@version=6

indicator("ORB & Session Liquidity Model [JOAT]", "ORB Liquidity [JOAT]", overlay = true, max_boxes_count = 500, max_lines_count = 500, max_labels_count = 500)

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//  PALETTE  (near-black · neon cyan / magenta / electric purple)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CYAN    = #00E5FF
CYAN_HI = #8CF6FF
MAG     = #FF2E9A
MAG_HI  = #FF86C6
PURP    = #A64BFF
PURP_HI = #C99BFF
LIME    = #7CFF5A
AMBER   = #FFC24B
RED     = #FF3D5A
RED_HI  = #FF8199
GRN     = #16C784
GRN_HI  = #5CF0B0
INK     = #05070E
INKHI   = #EAF2FF
MUTE    = #5A6B8C

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//  INPUTS
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
gSes    = "Sessions"
orbSession = input.session("0930-1000", "Opening Range window", group = gSes, tooltip = "The session window whose high/low form the Opening Range. Locks when the window closes.")
tradeSession = input.session("1000-1600", "Trade session (signals only here)", group = gSes, tooltip = "Breakout signals are only allowed inside this window.")
tz         = input.string("America/New_York", "Timezone", options = ["America/New_York", "America/Chicago", "America/Los_Angeles", "Europe/London", "Europe/Berlin", "Asia/Tokyo", "Asia/Shanghai", "Asia/Kolkata", "Australia/Sydney", "UTC"], group = gSes)

gBrk    = "Breakout Logic"
atrLenT = input.int(14, "ATR length", minval = 1, group = gBrk)
bufMult = input.float(0.10, "Breakout buffer = ATR ×", minval = 0.0, step = 0.05, group = gBrk, tooltip = "Small ATR cushion beyond ORH/ORL to reduce false pokes.")
maxTrades = input.int(2, "Max trades per side / day", minval = 1, maxval = 10, group = gBrk)

gRisk   = "Risk / Targets"
useAtrSL = input.bool(false, "SL from ATR (else opposite OR level)", group = gRisk, tooltip = "On: SL = entry ± ATR×mult. Off: SL = the opposite OR level.")
slMult  = input.float(1.0, "ATR SL multiplier", minval = 0.1, step = 0.1, group = gRisk)
tp1R    = input.float(1.0, "TP1 (R)", step = 0.5, group = gRisk)
tp2R    = input.float(2.0, "TP2 (R)", step = 0.5, group = gRisk)
tp3R    = input.float(3.0, "TP3 (R)", step = 0.5, group = gRisk)
boxW    = input.int(24, "TP/SL box width (bars)", minval = 5, group = gRisk)

gLad    = "Liquidity Ladder"
showLadder = input.bool(true, "Show OR extension ladder", group = gLad)
e1 = input.float(0.5, "Extension 1 ×", minval = 0.1, step = 0.1, group = gLad)
e2 = input.float(1.0, "Extension 2 ×", minval = 0.1, step = 0.1, group = gLad)
e3 = input.float(1.5, "Extension 3 ×", minval = 0.1, step = 0.1, group = gLad)
e4 = input.float(2.0, "Extension 4 ×", minval = 0.1, step = 0.1, group = gLad)

gViz    = "Visuals"
showBox = input.bool(true, "OR box", group = gViz)
showTradeBox = input.bool(true, "Trade risk/reward boxes", group = gViz)
showBg  = input.bool(true, "Session background tint", group = gViz)
glowLevels = input.bool(true, "Glow ORH / ORL", group = gViz)

gP      = "Dashboard"
showHUD = input.bool(true, "Show dashboard", group = gP)
hudPos  = input.string("Top Right", "Position", options = ["Top Right", "Top Left", "Bottom Right", "Bottom Left", "Middle Right"], group = gP)
hudBg   = input.color(#06090F, "Background", group = gP)

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//  HELPERS  (declared before first use)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
f_pos(string s) =>
    switch s
        "Top Right"    => position.top_right
        "Top Left"     => position.top_left
        "Bottom Right" => position.bottom_right
        "Bottom Left"  => position.bottom_left
        => position.middle_right

f_meter(float pct01) =>
    fill = math.round(math.max(0.0, math.min(1.0, pct01)) * 10)
    out = ""
    for i = 1 to 10
        out := out + (i <= fill ? "▰" : "▱")
    out

f_num(float v) =>
    str.tostring(v, format.mintick)

// pip conviction meter — filled ⬤ vs empty ◯ dots (session-console glyph)
f_pips(float pct01) =>
    fill = math.round(math.max(0.0, math.min(1.0, pct01)) * 10)
    out = ""
    for i = 1 to 10
        out := out + (i <= fill ? "⬤" : "◯")
    out

// position a horizontal ladder line + its label
f_tline(line ln, label lb, int x1, float y, color c, string txt) =>
    line.set_xy1(ln, x1, y)
    line.set_xy2(ln, x1 + 5, y)
    line.set_color(ln, c)
    label.set_xy(lb, x1, y)
    label.set_text(lb, txt)
    label.set_textcolor(lb, c)

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//  SESSION / DAY STATE
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
atr    = ta.atr(atrLenT)
inORB  = not na(time(timeframe.period, orbSession, tz))
inTrade= not na(time(timeframe.period, tradeSession, tz))
newDay = timeframe.change("D")

orbStart = inORB and not inORB[1]      // first bar of the OR window
orbEnd   = not inORB and inORB[1]      // OR window just closed → lock

var float orH        = na
var float orL        = na
var int   orStartBar = na
var bool  orLocked   = false
var bool  dayHasOR   = false
var int   buysToday  = 0
var int   sellsToday = 0

if newDay
    buysToday  := 0
    sellsToday := 0

// build / extend the range inside the window
if orbStart
    orH        := high
    orL        := low
    orStartBar := bar_index
    orLocked   := false
else if inORB
    orH := math.max(nz(orH, high), high)
    orL := math.min(nz(orL, low), low)

if orbEnd
    orLocked := true
    dayHasOR := true

orRange = (orLocked and not na(orH) and not na(orL)) ? orH - orL : na
orMid   = na(orRange) ? na : (orH + orL) / 2.0

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//  OR BOX + ORH/ORL LINES + LIQUIDITY LADDER  (single set, redrawn per day)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
var box   orBox  = na
var line  lnH    = na
var line  lnL    = na
var label lbH    = na
var label lbL    = na
var line  uL1 = na, var line uL2 = na, var line uL3 = na, var line uL4 = na
var line  dL1 = na, var line dL2 = na, var line dL3 = na, var line dL4 = na
var label uT1 = na, var label uT2 = na, var label uT3 = na, var label uT4 = na
var label dT1 = na, var label dT2 = na, var label dT3 = na, var label dT4 = na

// Objects are created ONCE at global scope (Pine functions cannot create/assign
// globals). We lazily create each group the first time its toggle needs it.
if orbEnd and showBox
    if na(orBox)
        orBox := box.new(bar_index, close, bar_index, close, border_color = color.new(PURP, 30), bgcolor = color.new(PURP, 92), border_width = 1)
    box.set_left(orBox, orStartBar)
    box.set_top(orBox, orH)
    box.set_right(orBox, bar_index)
    box.set_bottom(orBox, orL)

if orbEnd and showLadder
    if na(lnH)
        bi = bar_index
        px = close
        lnH := line.new(bi, px, bi + 1, px, color = CYAN, width = 2, extend = extend.right)
        lnL := line.new(bi, px, bi + 1, px, color = MAG,  width = 2, extend = extend.right)
        lbH := label.new(bi, px, "", style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(INK, 100), size = size.small)
        lbL := label.new(bi, px, "", style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(INK, 100), size = size.small)
        uL1 := line.new(bi, px, bi + 1, px, color = CYAN, style = line.style_dotted, extend = extend.right)
        uL2 := line.new(bi, px, bi + 1, px, color = CYAN, style = line.style_dotted, extend = extend.right)
        uL3 := line.new(bi, px, bi + 1, px, color = CYAN, style = line.style_dotted, extend = extend.right)
        uL4 := line.new(bi, px, bi + 1, px, color = CYAN, style = line.style_dotted, extend = extend.right)
        dL1 := line.new(bi, px, bi + 1, px, color = MAG, style = line.style_dotted, extend = extend.right)
        dL2 := line.new(bi, px, bi + 1, px, color = MAG, style = line.style_dotted, extend = extend.right)
        dL3 := line.new(bi, px, bi + 1, px, color = MAG, style = line.style_dotted, extend = extend.right)
        dL4 := line.new(bi, px, bi + 1, px, color = MAG, style = line.style_dotted, extend = extend.right)
        uT1 := label.new(bi, px, "", style = label.style_none, textcolor = CYAN, size = size.tiny)
        uT2 := label.new(bi, px, "", style = label.style_none, textcolor = CYAN, size = size.tiny)
        uT3 := label.new(bi, px, "", style = label.style_none, textcolor = CYAN, size = size.tiny)
        uT4 := label.new(bi, px, "", style = label.style_none, textcolor = CYAN, size = size.tiny)
        dT1 := label.new(bi, px, "", style = label.style_none, textcolor = MAG, size = size.tiny)
        dT2 := label.new(bi, px, "", style = label.style_none, textcolor = MAG, size = size.tiny)
        dT3 := label.new(bi, px, "", style = label.style_none, textcolor = MAG, size = size.tiny)
        dT4 := label.new(bi, px, "", style = label.style_none, textcolor = MAG, size = size.tiny)
    x1 = bar_index
    f_tline(lnH, lbH, orStartBar, orH, CYAN, " ORH " + f_num(orH))
    f_tline(lnL, lbL, orStartBar, orL, MAG,  " ORL " + f_num(orL))
    f_tline(uL1, uT1, x1, orH + orRange * e1, CYAN,    " +" + str.tostring(e1, "#.#") + "R")
    f_tline(uL2, uT2, x1, orH + orRange * e2, CYAN,    " +" + str.tostring(e2, "#.#") + "R")
    f_tline(uL3, uT3, x1, orH + orRange * e3, CYAN_HI, " +" + str.tostring(e3, "#.#") + "R")
    f_tline(uL4, uT4, x1, orH + orRange * e4, CYAN_HI, " +" + str.tostring(e4, "#.#") + "R")
    f_tline(dL1, dT1, x1, orL - orRange * e1, MAG,     " -" + str.tostring(e1, "#.#") + "R")
    f_tline(dL2, dT2, x1, orL - orRange * e2, MAG,     " -" + str.tostring(e2, "#.#") + "R")
    f_tline(dL3, dT3, x1, orL - orRange * e3, MAG_HI,  " -" + str.tostring(e3, "#.#") + "R")
    f_tline(dL4, dT4, x1, orL - orRange * e4, MAG_HI,  " -" + str.tostring(e4, "#.#") + "R")

// keep the OR box growing across the trade session on the confirmed last bar
if showBox and not na(orBox) and orLocked and barstate.islast
    box.set_right(orBox, bar_index + 2)

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//  BREAKOUT SIGNALS  (trade session only · capped per side · confirmed close)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
buffer   = atr * bufMult
canTrade = orLocked and inTrade and not na(orRange)

buy  = canTrade and ta.crossover(close, orH + buffer)  and buysToday  < maxTrades
sell = canTrade and ta.crossunder(close, orL - buffer) and sellsToday < maxTrades

if buy
    buysToday += 1
if sell
    sellsToday += 1
sig = buy or sell

// directional bias relative to the range
bias = na(orRange) ? 0 : close > orH ? 1 : close < orL ? -1 : 0

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//  CONVICTION 0..100  (breakout extension · session · volatility expansion)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
extBeyond = na(orRange) or orRange == 0 ? 0.0 : bias == 1 ? (close - orH) / orRange : bias == -1 ? (orL - close) / orRange : 0.0
extComp   = math.min(1.0, math.abs(extBeyond))
sesComp   = inTrade ? 1.0 : 0.0
expComp   = atr > 0 ? math.min(1.0, math.abs(close - open) / atr) : 0.0
conv = math.round(100 * (0.5 * extComp + 0.3 * sesComp + 0.2 * expComp))

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//  LIVE WIN-RATE TRACKER  (TP1 before SL · no lookahead)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
var float sEntry = na
var float sSL    = na
var float sT1    = na
var int   sDir   = 0
var bool  sOpen  = false
var int   wins   = 0
var int   losses = 0

if sOpen
    if sDir == 1
        if high >= sT1
            wins += 1
            sOpen := false
        else if low <= sSL
            losses += 1
            sOpen := false
    else
        if low <= sT1
            wins += 1
            sOpen := false
        else if high >= sSL
            losses += 1
            sOpen := false

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//  TRADE RISK / REWARD BOXES  (red = risk entry→SL, green = reward entry→TP3)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
var box   slBox = na          // red RISK box (entry → SL)
var box   tpBox = na          // green REWARD box (entry → TP3)
var line  lnEntry = na        // solid entry line
var line  lnSL    = na        // dashed SL line
var line  lnTP1   = na        // thin TP1 divider
var line  lnTP2   = na        // thin TP2 divider
var label lbE = na            // ENTRY
var label lbS = na            // SL
var label lb1 = na            // TP1 · 1R
var label lb2 = na            // TP2 · 2R
var label lb3 = na            // TP3 · 3R

f_computeSL(bool isBuy, float entry) =>
    float sl = na
    if useAtrSL
        sl := isBuy ? entry - atr * slMult : entry + atr * slMult
    else
        sl := isBuy ? orL : orH
    sl

if sig
    isBuy = buy
    entry = close
    sl    = f_computeSL(isBuy, entry)
    risk  = math.abs(entry - sl)
    // guard: degenerate risk falls back to ATR
    if risk <= 0 or na(risk)
        risk := atr * slMult
        sl   := isBuy ? entry - risk : entry + risk
    tp1 = isBuy ? entry + risk * tp1R : entry - risk * tp1R
    tp2 = isBuy ? entry + risk * tp2R : entry - risk * tp2R
    tp3 = isBuy ? entry + risk * tp3R : entry - risk * tp3R

    // register the trade for the win-rate tracker
    if sOpen
        losses += 1
        sOpen  := false
    sDir   := isBuy ? 1 : -1
    sEntry := entry
    sSL    := sl
    sT1    := tp1
    sOpen  := true

    if showTradeBox
        rEdge = bar_index + boxW
        // BOTH filled boxes: red risk (entry→SL) and green reward (entry→TP3).
        // Recreate boxes each signal; lines/labels are created ONCE then repositioned.
        box.delete(slBox)
        box.delete(tpBox)
        slBox := box.new(bar_index, entry, rEdge, sl,  border_color = color.new(RED, 35), bgcolor = color.new(RED, 82), border_width = 1)
        tpBox := box.new(bar_index, entry, rEdge, tp3, border_color = color.new(GRN, 35), bgcolor = color.new(GRN, 85), border_width = 1)
        if na(lnEntry)
            lnEntry := line.new(bar_index, entry, rEdge, entry, color = AMBER, width = 1)
            lnSL    := line.new(bar_index, sl,    rEdge, sl,    color = RED,   width = 1, style = line.style_dashed)
            lnTP1   := line.new(bar_index, tp1,   rEdge, tp1,   color = color.new(GRN, 30), width = 1, style = line.style_dotted)
            lnTP2   := line.new(bar_index, tp2,   rEdge, tp2,   color = color.new(GRN, 30), width = 1, style = line.style_dotted)
            lbE := label.new(rEdge, entry, "", style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(INK, 100), size = size.small)
            lbS := label.new(rEdge, sl,    "", style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(INK, 100), size = size.small)
            lb1 := label.new(rEdge, tp1,   "", style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(INK, 100), size = size.small)
            lb2 := label.new(rEdge, tp2,   "", style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(INK, 100), size = size.small)
            lb3 := label.new(rEdge, tp3,   "", style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(INK, 100), size = size.small)
        // reposition the divider / edge lines
        line.set_xy1(lnEntry, bar_index, entry)
        line.set_xy2(lnEntry, rEdge, entry)
        line.set_xy1(lnSL, bar_index, sl)
        line.set_xy2(lnSL, rEdge, sl)
        line.set_xy1(lnTP1, bar_index, tp1)
        line.set_xy2(lnTP1, rEdge, tp1)
        line.set_xy1(lnTP2, bar_index, tp2)
        line.set_xy2(lnTP2, rEdge, tp2)
        // one right-edge label per level (ENTRY / SL / TP1·1R / TP2·2R / TP3·3R)
        label.set_xy(lbE, rEdge, entry)
        label.set_text(lbE, (isBuy ? "▲ " : "▼ ") + "ENTRY " + f_num(entry))
        label.set_textcolor(lbE, AMBER)
        label.set_xy(lbS, rEdge, sl)
        label.set_text(lbS, "SL " + f_num(sl))
        label.set_textcolor(lbS, RED_HI)
        label.set_xy(lb1, rEdge, tp1)
        label.set_text(lb1, "TP1 · " + str.tostring(tp1R, "#.#") + "R " + f_num(tp1))
        label.set_textcolor(lb1, GRN)
        label.set_xy(lb2, rEdge, tp2)
        label.set_text(lb2, "TP2 · " + str.tostring(tp2R, "#.#") + "R " + f_num(tp2))
        label.set_textcolor(lb2, GRN_HI)
        label.set_xy(lb3, rEdge, tp3)
        label.set_text(lb3, "TP3 · " + str.tostring(tp3R, "#.#") + "R " + f_num(tp3))
        label.set_textcolor(lb3, GRN_HI)

// extend the active trade graphic to the right while the trade is live
if showTradeBox and sOpen and not na(slBox) and barstate.islast
    rE = bar_index + boxW
    box.set_right(slBox, rE)
    box.set_right(tpBox, rE)
    line.set_x2(lnEntry, rE)
    line.set_x2(lnSL, rE)
    line.set_x2(lnTP1, rE)
    line.set_x2(lnTP2, rE)
    label.set_x(lbE, rE)
    label.set_x(lbS, rE)
    label.set_x(lb1, rE)
    label.set_x(lb2, rE)
    label.set_x(lb3, rE)

resolved = wins + losses
winRate  = resolved > 0 ? wins / resolved * 100.0 : na

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//  PLOTS  (glow ORH/ORL · session tint · signals)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
orHplot = (orLocked and dayHasOR) ? orH : na
orLplot = (orLocked and dayHasOR) ? orL : na
plot(glowLevels ? orHplot : na, "ORH glow", color = color.new(CYAN, 72), linewidth = 5, style = plot.style_linebr)
plot(glowLevels ? orLplot : na, "ORL glow", color = color.new(MAG, 72),  linewidth = 5, style = plot.style_linebr)

// session background tint — cyan while OR is forming, purple while trading
sesCol = inORB ? color.new(CYAN, 90) : inTrade ? color.new(PURP, 93) : na
bgcolor(showBg ? sesCol : na, title = "Session tint")

// bias-graded candles
biasCol = bias == 1 ? color.from_gradient(conv, 0, 100, CYAN, CYAN_HI) : bias == -1 ? color.from_gradient(conv, 0, 100, MAG, MAG_HI) : color.new(MUTE, 40)
barcolor(color.new(biasCol, 30), title = "Bias candles")

plotshape(buy,  "BUY",  style = shape.labelup,   location = location.belowbar, color = CYAN, textcolor = INK,   text = "BUY",  size = size.small)
plotshape(sell, "SELL", style = shape.labeldown, location = location.abovebar, color = MAG,  textcolor = INKHI, text = "SELL", size = size.small)

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//  DASHBOARD  (cyberpunk HUD)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// dashboard is fully adjustable — reposition (hudPos) and resize text (hudSize)
hudSize = input.string("Normal", "Dashboard text size", options = ["Tiny", "Small", "Normal", "Large"], group = "Dashboard")
hudTS = hudSize == "Tiny" ? size.tiny : hudSize == "Small" ? size.small : hudSize == "Large" ? size.large : size.normal
var table hud = na
if showHUD and barstate.islast
    if not na(hud)
        table.delete(hud)
    hud := table.new(f_pos(hudPos), 2, 9, bgcolor = color.new(hudBg, 0), frame_color = color.new(PURP, 40), frame_width = 1, border_width = 0)
    SURF  = color.new(hudBg, 0)
    HEADR = color.new(color.from_gradient(0.5, 0, 1, hudBg, #241246), 0)

    // ── SESSION PHASE → big coloured badge headline ──
    phaseT = inORB ? "◉ IN OR" : (not dayHasOR ? "◷ PRE-OR" : inTrade ? "▶ TRADING" : "■ CLOSED")
    phaseC = inORB ? CYAN : (not dayHasOR ? PURP : inTrade ? MAG : MUTE)   // accent per phase
    badgeBg = color.new(phaseC, 20)

    rngTxt = na(orRange) ? "—" : f_num(orRange)
    rngC   = na(orRange) ? MUTE : CYAN_HI

    biasT  = bias == 1 ? "LONG ▲" : bias == -1 ? "SHORT ▼" : "Inside"
    biasC  = bias == 1 ? CYAN_HI : bias == -1 ? MAG_HI : MUTE

    convC  = conv >= 66 ? CYAN_HI : conv >= 33 ? PURP_HI : MUTE

    sigT   = buy ? "BUY BREAKOUT ▲" : sell ? "SELL BREAKOUT ▼" : canTrade ? "Armed" : "Standby"
    sigC   = buy ? CYAN_HI : sell ? MAG_HI : canTrade ? PURP_HI : MUTE

    trTxt  = "L " + str.tostring(buysToday) + " / S " + str.tostring(sellsToday) + " · max " + str.tostring(maxTrades)
    trCap  = (buysToday >= maxTrades or sellsToday >= maxTrades)
    trC    = trCap ? AMBER : INKHI
    trBg   = color.new(PURP, 78)

    statTxt = na(winRate) ? "—" : str.tostring(math.round(winRate)) + "% (" + str.tostring(resolved) + ")"
    statC   = na(winRate) ? MUTE : winRate >= 55 ? GRN_HI : winRate <= 45 ? RED_HI : AMBER

    // row 0 — session-phase badge headline spanning both columns
    table.cell(hud, 0, 0, phaseT + "  ", text_color = INK, text_halign = text.align_left, bgcolor = badgeBg, text_size = hudTS)
    table.cell(hud, 1, 0, "ORB · JOAT  ", text_color = INK, text_halign = text.align_right, bgcolor = badgeBg, text_size = hudTS)
    // row 1 — trades today, given its own accented row (prominent)
    table.cell(hud, 0, 1, "  TRADES TODAY", text_color = PURP_HI, text_halign = text.align_left, bgcolor = trBg, text_size = hudTS)
    table.cell(hud, 1, 1, trTxt + "  ", text_color = trC, text_halign = text.align_right, bgcolor = trBg, text_size = hudTS)
    // row 2 — conviction pip meter
    table.cell(hud, 0, 2, "  Conviction", text_color = MUTE, text_halign = text.align_left, bgcolor = SURF, text_size = hudTS)
    table.cell(hud, 1, 2, f_pips(conv / 100.0) + " " + str.tostring(conv) + "  ", text_color = convC, text_halign = text.align_right, bgcolor = SURF, text_size = hudTS)
    // row 3 — signal
    table.cell(hud, 0, 3, "  Signal", text_color = MUTE, text_halign = text.align_left, bgcolor = SURF, text_size = hudTS)
    table.cell(hud, 1, 3, sigT + "  ", text_color = sigC, text_halign = text.align_right, bgcolor = SURF, text_size = hudTS)
    // row 4 — bias
    table.cell(hud, 0, 4, "  Bias", text_color = MUTE, text_halign = text.align_left, bgcolor = SURF, text_size = hudTS)
    table.cell(hud, 1, 4, biasT + "  ", text_color = biasC, text_halign = text.align_right, bgcolor = SURF, text_size = hudTS)
    // row 5 — OR range
    table.cell(hud, 0, 5, "  OR range", text_color = MUTE, text_halign = text.align_left, bgcolor = SURF, text_size = hudTS)
    table.cell(hud, 1, 5, rngTxt + "  ", text_color = rngC, text_halign = text.align_right, bgcolor = SURF, text_size = hudTS)
    // row 6 — ORH / ORL
    table.cell(hud, 0, 6, "  ORH / ORL", text_color = MUTE, text_halign = text.align_left, bgcolor = SURF, text_size = hudTS)
    table.cell(hud, 1, 6, (na(orH) ? "—" : f_num(orH)) + " / " + (na(orL) ? "—" : f_num(orL)) + "  ", text_color = INKHI, text_halign = text.align_right, bgcolor = SURF, text_size = hudTS)
    // row 7 — divider label
    table.cell(hud, 0, 7, "  ── stats ──", text_color = MUTE, text_halign = text.align_left, bgcolor = SURF, text_size = hudTS)
    table.cell(hud, 1, 7, "", bgcolor = SURF, text_size = hudTS)
    // row 8 — live win-rate
    table.cell(hud, 0, 8, "  Win (TP1)", text_color = MUTE, text_halign = text.align_left, bgcolor = HEADR, text_size = hudTS)
    table.cell(hud, 1, 8, statTxt + "  ", text_color = statC, text_halign = text.align_right, bgcolor = HEADR, text_size = hudTS)

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//  ALERTS
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
alertcondition(buy,    "Buy",       "ORB Liquidity: close broke above the Opening Range high inside the trade session")
alertcondition(sell,   "Sell",      "ORB Liquidity: close broke below the Opening Range low inside the trade session")
alertcondition(orbEnd, "OR formed", "ORB Liquidity: Opening Range locked for the day")

// This source code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
// © marketmindset

//@version=6
indicator(
		 'MTF Opening Range │ MarketMindset', 
		 'MarketMindset │ MTF ORB', 
		 true, 
		 max_lines_count = 500,
		 max_boxes_count = 500,
         max_bars_back = 5000
		 )

//━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

anc = input.string('Auto', 'Anchor Period', ['Auto', 'Daily', 'Weekly', 'Monthly', 'Quarterly', 'Yearly'])

otf = input.timeframe('', 'ORB Timeframe')

gO = 'ORB Settings'
s = input.string('━━━ ', 'ORB Style', options = ['━━━ ', '- - - - ', ' · · · · '], display = display.data_window, group = gO)
w = input.int(1, 'ORB Width', [1,2,3,4], display = display.data_window, group = gO)
css = input.color(color.new(color.aqua, 50), 'ORB Colors   ', inline = 'css', group = gO)
fcss = input.color(color.new(color.aqua, 80), '', inline = 'css', group = gO)

gM = 'MidLine Settings'
mid = input.bool(true, 'Show ORB Middle', group = gM)
ms = input.string('- - - - ', 'Mid Style', options = ['━━━ ', '- - - - ', ' · · · · '], display = display.data_window, group = gM, active = mid)
mw = input.int(1, 'Mid Width', [1,2,3,4], display = display.data_window, group = gM, active = mid)
mcss = input.color(color.yellow, 'Mid Color', group = gM, active = mid)

gL = 'Labels Settings'
hist = input.bool(false, 'Keep Label History', group = gL)
ls = input.int(11, 'Font Size', 1,  display = display.data_window, group = gL)

if isNP

    box.new( x1, H, x2, L, css, w, s.sty(), xloc = xloc.bar_time, bgcolor = fcss, force_overlay = true)

         , label.style_label_left, color.rgb(color.r(css), color.g(css), color.b(css)), ls

    label.new( x2, L, 'L : ' + str.tostring(L, format.mintick), xloc.bar_time, yloc.price, color(na)

items.name: ORB Retest Entry
items.title: ORB Break-Return-Cross Entry
items.author: Trend_MyFrend
items.source:
//@version=6
indicator("ORB Break-Return-Cross Entry", "ORB_BRC", true, max_labels_count = 500, max_lines_count = 500, max_boxes_count = 500)

// --- Inputs ---
tf            = input.timeframe("15", "ORB Timeframe",inline="Time")
lastentryTime = input.string("12:15", "Entry Valid Time (HH:mm)",inline="Time")
maxTrades     = input.int(2, "Max Retest Trades", minval = 1,inline="His")
ishist        = input(true, "",inline="His")
hist          = input.int(10, "History Signals Show", minval = 1,inline="His")

rrInput       = input.float(2, "Set Risk-Reward Ratio", step = 0.1,inline="Risk")
bfrRange      = input.float(0.00, "ORB buffer %", step=0.01,inline="Risk") / 100
// --- Global State ---
var float hv = na
var float lv = na
var bool activeRange = true
var int tradeCount = 0
var bool buySignalShown = false
var bool sellSignalShown = false

// --- State Machine for "Break-Return-Cross" ---
var bool hasBrokenOutUpper = false
var bool hasReturnedToUpper = false
var bool hasBrokenOutLower = false
var bool hasReturnedToLower = false

if session.isfirstbar
    tradeCount := 0
    activeRange := true
    buySignalShown := false
    sellSignalShown := false
    hasBrokenOutUpper := false
    hasReturnedToUpper := false
    hasBrokenOutLower := false
    hasReturnedToLower := false

if timeframe.change(tf) and (not session.isfirstbar)
    activeRange := false

var HighArray = array.new<float>()
var LowArray = array.new<float>()

if session.isfirstbar
    HighArray.clear()
    LowArray.clear()

if activeRange
    array.push(HighArray, high)
    array.push(LowArray, low)

startLine = (activeRange[1]) and (not activeRange)
// --- Helper function to convert "HH:mm" to total minutes ---
toMinutes(timeStr) =>
    parts = str.split(timeStr, ":")
    if array.size(parts) == 2
        int(str.tonumber(array.get(parts, 0))) * 60 + int(str.tonumber(array.get(parts, 1)))
    else
        0
// --- Time Check Logic ---
// Convert current bar time to minutes from midnight
currentMinutes = hour(time, syminfo.timezone) * 60 + minute(time, syminfo.timezone)
// Convert input string to minutes from midnight
lastEntryMinutes = toMinutes(lastentryTime)
// Now you can safely use the comparison operator
bool isWithinEntryTime = currentMinutes <= lastEntryMinutes// --- Types & Orders ---
type LL
    line Line
    label Label
type order
    LL entry
    LL sl
    LL tg
    float slPrice
    float tpPrice
    bool active      
    bool isBuy       

var order orderBuy = na
var order orderSell = na
var orderHistory = array.new<order>()
var signalLabels = array.new<label>()

drawLL(y, clr, txt) =>
    Line = line.new(bar_index, y, bar_index, y, color = clr, width = 2)
    Label = label.new(bar_index, y, text = txt, color = clr, style = label.style_label_left)
    LL.new(Line, Label)

orderList(ev, sv, tv, isBuy) =>
    E = drawLL(ev, color.blue, "Entry : " + str.tostring(ev, format.mintick))
    S = drawLL(sv, color.red, "SL : " + str.tostring(sv, format.mintick))
    T = drawLL(tv, color.green, "TP : " + str.tostring(tv, format.mintick))
    newOrder = order.new(E, S, T, sv, tv, true, isBuy)
    array.push(orderHistory, newOrder)
    newOrder

deleteOrder(_this) =>
    if not na(_this)
        line.delete(_this.entry.Line)
        label.delete(_this.entry.Label)
        line.delete(_this.sl.Line)
        label.delete(_this.sl.Label)
        line.delete(_this.tg.Line)
        label.delete(_this.tg.Label)
// --- ORB Box ---
var box orbBox = na   
if session.isfirstbar
    orbBox := box.new(left=bar_index, top=high, right=bar_index, bottom=low, border_width=1, bgcolor=color.new(color.blue, 90), border_color=color.new(color.blue, 90))

if startLine
    hv := array.max(HighArray) * (1 + bfrRange)
    lv := array.min(LowArray) * (1 - bfrRange)
    if not na(orbBox)
        box.set_top(orbBox, hv)
        box.set_bottom(orbBox, lv)

if not na(orbBox)
    box.set_right(orbBox, bar_index)

// --- Break-Return-Cross Logic ---
if not activeRange and not startLine
    // BUY Sequence: 1. Break HV -> 2. Touch/Dip below HV -> 3. Cross back above HV
    if not hasBrokenOutUpper and high > hv
        hasBrokenOutUpper := true
    
    if hasBrokenOutUpper and not hasReturnedToUpper and low <= hv
        hasReturnedToUpper := true
    
    // SELL Sequence: 1. Break LV -> 2. Touch/Rise above LV -> 3. Cross back below LV
    if not hasBrokenOutLower and low < lv
        hasBrokenOutLower := true
        
    if hasBrokenOutLower and not hasReturnedToLower and high >= lv
        hasReturnedToLower := true

// Entry Conditions: Must be in the "Returned" state and then price crosses the level again
bool buyEntryPending  =  hasReturnedToUpper and high > hv and isWithinEntryTime
bool sellEntryPending =  hasReturnedToLower and low < lv and isWithinEntryTime

float rangeHalf = (hv - lv) / 2

// Execution
if buyEntryPending and not buySignalShown and tradeCount < maxTrades
    entryPrice = hv
    slPrice = entryPrice - rangeHalf
    tpPrice = entryPrice + (rangeHalf * rrInput)
    tradeCount += 1 
    array.push(signalLabels, label.new(bar_index, low, "Buy Retest", style=label.style_label_up, color=color.blue, textcolor=color.white))
    orderBuy := orderList(entryPrice, slPrice, tpPrice, true)
    buySignalShown := true
    // Reset sequence flags
    hasBrokenOutUpper := false 
    hasReturnedToUpper := false

if sellEntryPending and not sellSignalShown and tradeCount < maxTrades
    entryPrice = lv
    slPrice = entryPrice + rangeHalf
    tpPrice = entryPrice - (rangeHalf * rrInput)
    tradeCount += 1
    array.push(signalLabels, label.new(bar_index, high, "Sell Retest", style=label.style_label_down, color=#811212, textcolor=color.white))
    orderSell := orderList(entryPrice, slPrice, tpPrice, false)
    sellSignalShown := true
    // Reset sequence flags
    hasBrokenOutLower := false
    hasReturnedToLower := false
// --- Exit & Reset Logic ---
checkExit(order chk, bool currentShownFlag) =>
    bool updatedFlag = currentShownFlag
    if not na(chk) and chk.active
        line.set_x2(chk.entry.Line, bar_index)
        label.set_x(chk.entry.Label, bar_index)
        line.set_x2(chk.sl.Line, bar_index)
        label.set_x(chk.sl.Label, bar_index)
        line.set_x2(chk.tg.Line, bar_index)
        label.set_x(chk.tg.Label, bar_index)

        if chk.isBuy
            if low <= chk.slPrice 
                chk.active := false
                updatedFlag := false 
                label.set_text(chk.sl.Label, "SL Hit")
                label.set_color(chk.sl.Label, color.maroon)
            else if high >= chk.tpPrice
                chk.active := false
                label.set_text(chk.tg.Label, "TP Hit")
        else 
            if high >= chk.slPrice
                chk.active := false
                updatedFlag := false 
                label.set_text(chk.sl.Label, "SL Hit")
                label.set_color(chk.sl.Label, color.maroon)
            else if low <= chk.tpPrice
                chk.active := false
                label.set_text(chk.tg.Label, "TP Hit")
    updatedFlag

buySignalShown  := checkExit(orderBuy, buySignalShown)
sellSignalShown := checkExit(orderSell, sellSignalShown)
// --- History & Visibility Control (FIXED) ---
if not ishist
    // Clear history arrays only
    if array.size(orderHistory) > 0
        for i = array.size(orderHistory) - 1 to 0
            order item = array.get(orderHistory, i)
            // Check if the current item is the active Buy or Sell order
            bool isCurrentBuy  = not na(orderBuy)  and item.entry.Line == orderBuy.entry.Line
            bool isCurrentSell = not na(orderSell) and item.entry.Line == orderSell.entry.Line
        
            // If it's NOT a current active order, delete it
            if not isCurrentBuy and not isCurrentSell
                deleteOrder(item)
                array.remove(orderHistory, i)
    // Manage signal labels
    if array.size(signalLabels) > 1
        for i = array.size(signalLabels) - 2 to 0
            label.delete(array.remove(signalLabels, i))
else
    if array.size(orderHistory) > hist
        deleteOrder(array.shift(orderHistory))
    if array.size(signalLabels) > hist
        label.delete(array.shift(signalLabels))

items.source:
// @version=5
// Open-Range-Breakout strategy
// No license. Free and Open Source.    

strategy('Strategy: ORB', shorttitle="ORB", overlay=true , currency=currency.NONE, initial_capital=100000)

// Inputs
period = input.int(defval=15, title="TimeRange", tooltip="The range in minutes (default: 15m)")
sessionInput = input.session(defval="0915-0930", title="Time Range", group="ORB settings", tooltip='What is the timeperiod (default 9:15AM to 9:30AM, exchange timezone')
hide = input.bool(defval = false, title="Hide ORB Range", group="ORB setting", tooltip = 'Hide the ORB range drawing')

// SL Related
slAtrLen = input.int(defval=14, title="ATR Period for placing SL", group="StopLoss settings")
showSLLines = input.bool(defval=false, title="Show SL lines in chart", tooltip="Show SL lines also as dotted lines in chart. Note: chart may look untidy.", group="StopLoss settings")

// Further Filtering
ignoreMementumVolume = input.bool(defval=false, title="Ignore Momentum & Volume", tooltip="Ignore Momentum & Volume to find out trades", group="Strengh Settings")
rsiLen = input.int(defval=14, title="Momentum Period", group="Strengh Settings", tooltip = 'To determine the momentum, RSI period is set default to 100')
rsiBullish = input.int(defval=50, step=1, title="Bullish Momentum", group="Strengh Settings", tooltip = 'Bullish Momentum, default set to RSI as 50')
rsiBearish = input.int(defval=50, step=1, title="Bearish Momentum", group="Strengh Settings", tooltip = 'Bearish Momentum, default set to RSI as 50')
volAvg = input.int(defval=20, step=1, title="Volume Average Period", group="Strengh Settings", tooltip = 'To calculate average volume, how many historical bars are considered. Default: 20.')
volThreshold = input.float(defval=1, step=0.1, title="Volume Strengh", group="Strengh Settings", tooltip = 'Multiplier: How big the current bar volume compared to average of last 20')

trendPeriod = input.int(defval=200, step=1, title="Trend Period", group="Trend Settings", tooltip = 'To calculate trend, what period is considered. Default: 200.')
hideTrend = input.bool(defval = false, title="Hide the trend line", group="Trend Settings", tooltip = 'Hide the trend')

hidePDHCL = input.bool(defval = false, title="Hide the PDHCL (prev day High Close Low range) & VWAP", tooltip = 'Hide the Previous Day High, Close, Low lines, including VWAP')

hideTable = input.bool(defval = false, title="Hide the Summary Table", tooltip = 'Hide the summary table.')

// Trade related
rrRatio = input.float(title='Risk:Reward', step=0.1, defval=2.0, group="Trade settings")
endOfDay = input.int(defval=1500, title="Close all trades, default is 3:00 PM, 1500 hours (integer)", group="Trade settings")
mktAlwaysOn = input.bool(defval=true, title="Markets that never closed (Crypto, Forex, Commodity)", tooltip="Some markers never closes. For those cases, make this checked.", group="Trade settings")
lotSize = input.int(title='Lot Size', step=1, defval=1, group="Trade settings")

// Util method

is_newbar(res) => 
	timeframe.change(time(res)) != 0


annotatePlots(txt, val, hide) => 
    if (not hide)
        var l1 = label.new(bar_index, hidePDHCL ? na : val, txt, style=label.style_label_left, size = size.tiny, textcolor = color.white, tooltip = txt)
        label.set_xy(l1, bar_index, hidePDHCL ? na : val)

// print table
printTable(txt) =>
    var table t = table.new(position.bottom_right, 1, 1)
    table.cell(t, 0, 0, txt, text_halign = text.align_left, bgcolor = color.lime)
	
// globals
t = time(timeframe.period, sessionInput + ":1234567") // everyday
in_session = not na(t)
is_first = in_session and not in_session[1]
is_end_session = in_session[1] and not in_session
green(open, close) => close > open ? true : false
red(open, close) => close < open ? true : false

var float orb_high = na
var float orb_low = na
if is_first
    orb_high := high
    orb_low := low
else
    orb_high := orb_high[1]
    orb_low := orb_low[1]
if high > orb_high and in_session
    orb_high := high
if low < orb_low and in_session
    orb_low := low

plot(hide ? na : orb_high, style=plot.style_line, color=orb_high[1] != orb_high ? na : color.green, title="ORB High", linewidth=2)
annotatePlots('ORB-H', orb_high, hide)
plot(hide ? na : orb_low, style=plot.style_line, color=orb_low[1] != orb_low ? na : color.red, title="ORB Low", linewidth=2)
annotatePlots('ORB-L', orb_low, hide)


// PDHCL (Previous Day High Close Low)
[dh,dl,dc] = request.security(syminfo.ticker, "D", [high[1],low[1], close[1]], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)
plot(hidePDHCL ? na : dh, title="Prev High",  color=color.red,  linewidth=2, trackprice=true, show_last = 1)
annotatePlots('PDH', dh, hidePDHCL)
plot(hidePDHCL ? na : dl, title="Prev Low",  color=color.green,  linewidth=2, trackprice=true, show_last = 1)
annotatePlots('PDL', dl, hidePDHCL)
plot(hidePDHCL ? na : dc, title="Prev Close",  color=color.black,  linewidth=2, trackprice=true, show_last = 1)
annotatePlots('PDC', dc, hidePDHCL)
plot(hidePDHCL ? na : ta.vwap(close), title="VWAP",  color=color.fuchsia,  linewidth=2, trackprice=true, show_last = 1)
annotatePlots('VWAP', ta.vwap(close), hidePDHCL)


// For SL calculation
atr = ta.atr(slAtrLen)	
highestHigh = ta.highest(high, 7)
lowestLow = ta.lowest(low, 7)
longStop = showSLLines ? lowestLow - (atr * 1) : na
shortStop = showSLLines ? highestHigh + (atr * 1) : na
plot(longStop, title="Buy SL", color=color.green, style=plot.style_cross)
plot(shortStop, title="Sell SL", color=color.red, style=plot.style_cross)
annotatePlots('SL-Long', longStop, showSLLines)
annotatePlots('SL-Short', shortStop, showSLLines)

// Momentum: rsi
rsi = ta.rsi(close, rsiLen)

// trend: EMA200
ema = ta.ema(close, trendPeriod)
plot(hideTrend ? na : ema, "EMA Trend", color=close > ema ? color.green : color.red, linewidth = 1)
annotatePlots('Trendline', ema, hideTrend)

// Volume-Weighed Moving Average calculation
vwmaAvg = ta.vwma(close, volAvg)
vwma_latest = volume
// plotshape((barstate.isconfirmed and (vwma_latest > (vwmaAvg * volThreshold))), title='VolumeData', text='', location=location.abovebar, style=shape.diamond, color=color.gray, textcolor=color.gray, size=size.tiny)

// Trade signals

longCond = barstate.isconfirmed and (ta.crossover(close, orb_high) or ta.crossover(close, dh)) and green(open, close) and (ignoreMementumVolume ? true : rsi > rsiBullish and (vwma_latest > (vwmaAvg * volThreshold)))
shortCond = barstate.isconfirmed and (ta.crossunder(close, orb_low) or ta.crossunder(close, dl)) and red(open, close) and (ignoreMementumVolume ? true : rsi < rsiBearish and (vwma_latest > (vwmaAvg * volThreshold)))

plotshape(longCond, title='Breakout', text='BO', location=location.belowbar, style=shape.triangleup, color=color.green, textcolor=color.green)
plotshape(shortCond, title='Breakout', text='BD', location=location.abovebar, style=shape.triangledown, color=color.red, textcolor=color.red)


// Trade execute
h = hour(time('1'), syminfo.timezone)
m = minute(time('1'), syminfo.timezone)
hourVal = h * 100 + m
totalTrades = strategy.opentrades + strategy.closedtrades
if (mktAlwaysOn or (hourVal < endOfDay))
    // Entry
    var float sl = na
    var float target = na
    if (longCond)
        strategy.entry("enter long", strategy.long, lotSize, limit=na, stop=na, comment="Enter Long")
        sl := longStop
        target := close + ((close - longStop) * rrRatio)
        alert('Buy:' + syminfo.ticker + ' ,SL:' + str.tostring(math.floor(sl)) + ', Target:' + str.tostring(target), alert.freq_once_per_bar)
    if (shortCond)
        strategy.entry("enter short", strategy.short, lotSize, limit=na, stop=na, comment="Enter Short")
        sl := shortStop
        target := close - ((shortStop - close) * rrRatio)
        alert('Sell:' + syminfo.ticker + ' ,SL:' + str.tostring(math.floor(sl)) + ', Target:' + str.tostring(target), alert.freq_once_per_bar)

    // Exit: target or SL
    if ((close >= target) or (close <= sl))
        strategy.close("enter long", comment=close < sl ? "Long SL hit" : "Long target hit")
    if ((close <= target) or (close >= sl))
        strategy.close("enter short", comment=close > sl ? "Short SL hit" : "Short target hit")
else if (not mktAlwaysOn)
    // Close all open position at the end if Day
    strategy.close_all(comment = "Close all entries at end of day.")


// Plotting table
if (not hideTable and is_end_session)
    message =  syminfo.ticker + " :\n\nORB Upper: " + str.tostring(math.round(orb_high)) + "\nORB Lower: " + str.tostring(math.round(orb_low)) + "\nPDH: " + str.tostring(math.round(dh)) + "\nPDC: " + str.tostring(math.round(dc)) + "\nPDL: " + str.tostring(math.round(dl)) + "\nVWAP: " + str.tostring(math.round(ta.vwap(close)))   
    printTable(message)
    alert(message, alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)

//@version=2
study(title='[RS]Open Range Breakout V0', shorttitle='ORB', overlay=true)
//  Request for DCC
tf = input(title='Timeframe for open range:', type=string, defval='60', confirm=false)
f_is_new_day() => change(time('D'))!=0

ND_open = f_is_new_day() ? security(tickerid, tf, open) : ND_open[1]
ND_high = f_is_new_day() ? security(tickerid, tf, high) : ND_high[1]
ND_low = f_is_new_day() ? security(tickerid, tf, low) : ND_low[1]

ND_stretch = na(ND_stretch[1]) ? 0 : f_is_new_day() ? (ND_stretch[1]*9 + security(tickerid, tf, (high-open)>=(open-low)?high-open:open-low)) / 10 : ND_stretch[1]

filter_high = f_is_new_day() ? na : ND_high
filter_low = f_is_new_day() ? na : ND_low

filter_high_stretch = f_is_new_day() ? na : ND_high+ND_stretch
filter_low_stretch = f_is_new_day() ? na : ND_low-ND_stretch

fh = plot(title='TR', series=filter_high, style=linebr, color=black)
fl = plot(title='BR', series=filter_low, style=linebr, color=black)
fhs = plot(title='TS', series=filter_high_stretch, style=linebr, color=green)
fls = plot(title='BS', series=filter_low_stretch, style=linebr, color=maroon)
fill(title='Positive Stretch', plot1=fh, plot2=fhs, color=green, transp=50)
fill(title='Negative Stretch', plot1=fl, plot2=fls, color=maroon, transp=50)

items.title: ORB 5:6
items.author: POWER_TRADES
items.source:
//@version=5
indicator('ORB 5:6', overlay=true)

inputMax = input(5, title='ORB total time (minutes)')
sess = input.session('0915-0920', title='Session Time')
t = time(timeframe.period, sess + ':1234567')
hide = timeframe.isintraday and timeframe.multiplier <= inputMax

is_newbar(res) =>
    ta.change(time(res)) != 0
in_session = not na(t)
is_first = in_session and not in_session[1]

orb_high = float(na)
orb_low = float(na)
orb_open = float(na)
orb_close = float(na)
if is_first
    orb_high := high
    orb_low := low
    orb_open := open
    orb_close := close
    orb_close
else
    orb_high := orb_high[1]
    orb_low := orb_low[1]
    orb_open := orb_open[1]
    orb_close := orb_close[1]
    orb_close
if high > orb_high and in_session
    orb_high := high
    orb_high
if low < orb_low and in_session
    orb_low := low
    orb_low
if close < orb_close and in_session
    orb_close := close
    orb_close
if open < orb_open and in_session
    orb_open := open
    orb_open
gh = (orb_high + orb_low) / 2
fs = gh - 0.00118 * gh
fs1 = gh + 0.00118 * gh
hh = orb_close > orb_open ? fs : fs1
//plot(hide ? orb_high : na , style=plot.style_line, color=orb_high[1] != orb_high ? na : color.green, title="ORB High", linewidth=2)
//plot(hide ? orb_low : na , style=plot.style_line, color=orb_low[1] != orb_low ? na : color.red, title="ORB Low", linewidth=2)
plot(gh, style=plot.style_line, color=gh[1] != gh ? na : color.black, title='50change', linewidth=2)

plot(hh, style=plot.style_line, color=hh[1] != hh ? na : color.black, title='gold Low', linewidth=2)

items.source:
// This source code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
// © sskcharts
//@version=5
indicator(title='ORB-PreDay_PerM_Levels', shorttitle='ORB-PreDay_PerM_Levels', overlay=true)

//User Input
showORB = input(true, title='Show ORB', inline='1')
showORBExt = input(true, title='Show ORB Extension (Select Ext Below)', inline='1')
showExt1 = input(true, title='', inline='2')
valueExt1 = input.float(161.8, "%", inline='2', options = [127.2, 161.8, 200, 261.8])
showExt2 = input(true, "", inline='2')
valueExt2 = input.float(261.8, "%", inline='2', options = [127.2, 161.8, 200, 261.8])
showExt3 = input(true, "", inline='2')
valueExt3 = input.float(200, "%", inline='2', options = [127.2, 161.8, 200, 261.8])
showPMHL = input(true, title='Show Pre-Market H/L', inline='3') 
aftermarket = input(title='Include After-Market', defval=false, inline='3')
showPrevDayHighLow = input(true, title='Show previous day\'s High & Low')
showPrev2DayHighLow = input(false, title='Show previous 2+ days High & Low')
showPrevDayClose = input(true, title='Show previous day\'s Close')
orbTimeFrame = input.timeframe("15", title='ORB timeframe')
sessSpec = input.session('0930-1600', title='Session time')
ORBHColor = input.color(title='ORBH Color', defval=color.new(#0bd68a, 30), inline='10')
ORBLColor = input.color(title='ORBL Color', defval=color.new(#d3396d, 30), inline='10')
PDHColor = input.color(title='PDH Color', defval=color.new(#81c784, 70), inline='11')
PDLColor = input.color(title='PDL Color', defval=color.new(#f06292, 75), inline='11')
PDCColor = input.color(title='PDC Color', defval=color.new(#2196f3, 20), inline='12')
ORBExtColor = input.color(title='ORBExt Color', defval=color.new(#5d606b, 50), inline='13')
PMHLColor = input.color(title='PMHL Color', defval=color.new(#ff9800, 10), inline='14')

plotSignals = input(false, title='Show Buy/Sell Signal', inline='15')

ORBWidth = input.int(title='', defval=1, minval=1, inline='10')
PDHLWidth = input.int(title='', defval=3, minval=1, inline='11')
PDCWidth = input.int(title='', defval=1, minval=1, inline='12')
ORBExtWidth = input.int(title='', defval=2, minval=1, inline='13')
PMHLWidth = input.int(title='', defval=1, minval=1, inline='14')
ORBOption = input.string(title='', options=['solid', 'dotted', 'dashed'], defval='solid', inline='10')
PDHLOption = input.string(title='', options=['solid', 'dotted', 'dashed'], defval='solid', inline='11')
PDCOption = input.string(title='', options=['solid', 'dotted', 'dashed'], defval='dashed', inline='12')
ORBExtOption = input.string(title='', options=['solid', 'dotted', 'dashed'], defval='solid', inline='13')
PMHLOption = input.string(title='', options=['solid', 'dotted', 'dashed'], defval='dashed', inline='14')
ORBStyle = ORBOption == 'dotted' ? line.style_dotted : ORBOption == 'dashed' ? line.style_dashed : line.style_solid
PDHLStyle = PDHLOption == 'dotted' ? line.style_dotted : PDHLOption == 'dashed' ? line.style_dashed : line.style_solid
PDCStyle = PDCOption == 'dotted' ? line.style_dotted : PDCOption == 'dashed' ? line.style_dashed : line.style_solid
ORBExtStyle = ORBExtOption == 'dotted' ? line.style_dotted : ORBExtOption == 'dashed' ? line.style_dashed : line.style_solid
PMHLStyle = PMHLOption == 'dotted' ? line.style_dotted : PMHLOption == 'dashed' ? line.style_dashed : line.style_solid


// Get ORB
t = ticker.new(syminfo.prefix, syminfo.ticker)
getSeries(_e, _timeFrame) =>
    request.security(t, _timeFrame, _e, lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)

is_newbar(res, sess) =>
    t1 = time(res, sess)
    na(t1[1]) and not na(t1) or t1[1] < t1

newbar = is_newbar('1440', sessSpec)

var float orbH = na
var float orbL = na
if newbar
    orbH := getSeries(high[0], orbTimeFrame)
    orbH
    orbL := getSeries(low[0], orbTimeFrame)
    orbL

// Get ORB Extension

ORWidth = orbH-orbL
orb_ext_up1 = orbH + ORWidth*((valueExt1/100)-1)
orb_ext_down1 = orbL - ORWidth*((valueExt1/100)-1)
orb_ext_up2= orbH + ORWidth*((valueExt2/100)-1)
orb_ext_down2 = orbL - ORWidth*((valueExt2/100)-1)
orb_ext_up3= orbH + ORWidth*((valueExt3/100)-1)
orb_ext_down3 = orbL - ORWidth*((valueExt3/100)-1)

//Previous  Days High Low
PrevDayHigh = getSeries(high[1], 'D')
PrevDayLow = getSeries(low[1], 'D')
PrevDayOpen = getSeries(open[1], 'D')
PrevDayClose = getSeries(close[1], 'D')

//Previous 2 Days High Low
PrevDayHigh1 = getSeries(high[2], 'D') > PrevDayHigh ? getSeries(high[2], 'D') : getSeries(high[3], 'D') > PrevDayHigh ? getSeries(high[3], 'D') : na
PrevDayLow1 = getSeries(low[2], 'D') < PrevDayLow ? getSeries(low[2], 'D') : getSeries(low[3], 'D') < PrevDayLow ? getSeries(low[3], 'D') : na
PrevDayHigh2 = PrevDayHigh1 == getSeries(high[2], 'D') ? getSeries(high[3], 'D') > getSeries(high[2], 'D') ? getSeries(high[3], 'D') : getSeries(high[4], 'D') > getSeries(high[3], 'D') ? getSeries(high[4], 'D') : na : na
PrevDayLow2 = PrevDayLow1 == getSeries(low[2], 'D') ? getSeries(low[3], 'D') < getSeries(low[2], 'D') ? getSeries(low[3], 'D') : getSeries(low[4], 'D') < getSeries(low[3], 'D') ? getSeries(low[4], 'D') : na : na


//PM High Low
ending_hour = 9
ending_minute = 30
// LastOnly = input(title="Last only", type=input.bool, defval=false)

pmt = aftermarket == false ? time('1440', '0000-1530:23456') : time('1440', '1600-0000:23456')  
is_first = na(pmt[1]) and not na(pmt) or pmt[1] < pmt

pm_high = float(na)
pm_low = float(na)
k = int(na)

if is_first and barstate.isnew and (hour < ending_hour or hour >= 16 or hour == ending_hour and minute < ending_minute)
    pm_high := high
    pm_low := low
    pm_low
else
    pm_high := pm_high[1]
    pm_low := pm_low[1]
    pm_low

if high > pm_high and (hour < ending_hour or hour >= 16 or hour == ending_hour and minute < ending_minute)
    pm_high := high
    pm_high

if low < pm_low and (hour < ending_hour or hour >= 16 or hour == ending_hour and minute < ending_minute)
    pm_low := low
    pm_low
    
    
// Today's Session Start timestamp
y = year(timenow)
m = month(timenow)
d = dayofmonth(timenow)
d1 = d - 4

// Start & End time for Today
start = timestamp(y, m, d, 09, 00)
pmstart = timestamp(y, m, d, 04, 00)
start1 = timestamp(y, m, d1, 09, 30)
end = start + 86400000
pmend = start + 36000000
daysLeft = 0

_MilliSec_In_Day = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
if (60*hour(timenow)+minute(timenow)) < (60*hour(time)+minute(time))
    daysLeft := math.floor((timenow - time) / _MilliSec_In_Day)+1
else
    daysLeft := math.floor((timenow - time) / _MilliSec_In_Day)

//if daysLeft == 0
//    daysLeft := daysLeft+1
    
orbstart = timestamp(y, m, d, 09, 00)
orbend = orbstart + 25200000

if time < timestamp(y, m, d, 09, 30)
    orbstart := timestamp(y, m, d-daysLeft, 09, 00)
    orbend := orbstart + 25200000
else
    orbstart := timestamp(y, m, d, 09, 00)
    orbend := orbstart + 25200000

if time < timestamp(y, m, d, 04, 00)
    pmstart := timestamp(y, m, d-daysLeft, 04, 00)
    pmend := pmstart + 43200000
else
    pmstart := timestamp(y, m, d, 04, 00)
    pmend := pmstart + 43200000

// Plot only if session started
isToday = timenow > start

// Plot selected timeframe's High, Low & Avg
// Plot lines
if isToday
    if showORB
        _h = line.new(orbstart, orbH, orbend, orbH, xloc.bar_time, color=ORBHColor, style=ORBStyle, width=ORBWidth)
        line.delete(_h[1])
        _l = line.new(orbstart, orbL, orbend, orbL, xloc.bar_time, color=ORBLColor, style=ORBStyle, width=ORBWidth)
        line.delete(_l[1])
    if showORBExt 
        if showExt1
            _orb_ext_up1 = line.new(orbstart, orb_ext_up1, orbend, orb_ext_up1, xloc.bar_time, color=ORBExtColor, style=ORBExtStyle, width=ORBExtWidth)
            line.delete(_orb_ext_up1[1])
            _orb_ext_down1 = line.new(orbstart, orb_ext_down1, orbend, orb_ext_down1, xloc.bar_time, color=ORBExtColor, style=ORBExtStyle, width=ORBExtWidth)
            line.delete(_orb_ext_down1[1])
        if showExt2
            _orb_ext_up2 = line.new(orbstart, orb_ext_up2, orbend, orb_ext_up2, xloc.bar_time, color=ORBExtColor, style=ORBExtStyle, width=ORBExtWidth)
            line.delete(_orb_ext_up2[1])
            _orb_ext_down2 = line.new(orbstart, orb_ext_down2, orbend, orb_ext_down2, xloc.bar_time, color=ORBExtColor, style=ORBExtStyle, width=ORBExtWidth)
            line.delete(_orb_ext_down2[1])
        if showExt3
            _orb_ext_up3 = line.new(orbstart, orb_ext_up3, orbend, orb_ext_up3, xloc.bar_time, color=ORBExtColor, style=ORBExtStyle, width=ORBExtWidth)
            line.delete(_orb_ext_up3[1])
            _orb_ext_down3 = line.new(orbstart, orb_ext_down3, orbend, orb_ext_down3, xloc.bar_time, color=ORBExtColor, style=ORBExtStyle, width=ORBExtWidth)
            line.delete(_orb_ext_down3[1])
        
    if showPrevDayHighLow
        _pdh = line.new(start1, PrevDayHigh, end, PrevDayHigh, xloc.bar_time, color=PDHColor, style=PDHLStyle, width=PDHLWidth)
        line.delete(_pdh[1])
        _pdl = line.new(start1, PrevDayLow, end, PrevDayLow, xloc.bar_time, color=PDLColor, style=PDHLStyle, width=PDHLWidth)
        line.delete(_pdl[1])
    if showPrevDayClose
        _pdc = line.new(orbstart, PrevDayClose, orbend, PrevDayClose, xloc.bar_time, color=PDCColor, style=PDCStyle, width=PDCWidth)
        line.delete(_pdc[1])

    if showPrev2DayHighLow
        _p2dh1 = line.new(start1, PrevDayHigh1, end, PrevDayHigh1, xloc.bar_time, color=PDHColor, style=PDHLStyle, width=PDHLWidth)
        line.delete(_p2dh1[1])
    if showPrev2DayHighLow
        _p2dl1 = line.new(start1, PrevDayLow1, end, PrevDayLow1, xloc.bar_time, color=PDLColor, style=PDHLStyle, width=PDHLWidth)
        line.delete(_p2dl1[1])
    if showPrev2DayHighLow
        _p2dh2 = line.new(start1, PrevDayHigh2, end, PrevDayHigh2, xloc.bar_time, color=PDHColor, style=PDHLStyle, width=PDHLWidth)
        line.delete(_p2dh2[1])
    if showPrev2DayHighLow
        _p2dl2 = line.new(start1, PrevDayLow2, end, PrevDayLow2, xloc.bar_time, color=PDLColor, style=PDHLStyle, width=PDHLWidth)
        line.delete(_p2dl2[1])

if timenow > pmstart 
    if showPMHL
        _pmh = line.new(pmstart, pm_high, pmend, pm_high, xloc.bar_time, color=PMHLColor, style=PMHLStyle, width=PMHLWidth)
        line.delete(_pmh[1])
        _pml = line.new(pmstart, pm_low, pmend, pm_low, xloc.bar_time, color=PMHLColor, style=PMHLStyle, width=PMHLWidth)
        line.delete(_pml[1])

// Plot labels
ShowLabel = input(true, title='Show Label')

if isToday and ShowLabel
    if showORB
        l_h = label.new(orbstart, orbH, text="ORB_H", xloc=xloc.bar_time, textcolor=ORBHColor, style=label.style_none)
        label.delete(l_h[1])
        l_l = label.new(orbstart, orbL, text="ORB_L", xloc=xloc.bar_time, textcolor=ORBLColor, style=label.style_none)
        label.delete(l_l[1]) 
    if showPrevDayHighLow
        l_pdh = label.new(start1, PrevDayHigh, text="PDH", xloc=xloc.bar_time, textcolor=PDHColor, style=label.style_none)
        label.delete(l_pdh[1])
        l_pdl = label.new(start1, PrevDayLow, text="PDL", xloc=xloc.bar_time, textcolor=PDLColor, style=label.style_none)
        label.delete(l_pdl[1])
    if showPrevDayClose
        l_pdc = label.new(start1, PrevDayClose, text="PDC", xloc=xloc.bar_time, textcolor=PDCColor, style=label.style_none)
        label.delete(l_pdc[1])

if (timenow > pmstart) and ShowLabel
    if showPMHL
        l_pmh = label.new(pmstart, pm_high, text="PMH", xloc=xloc.bar_time, textcolor=PMHLColor, style=label.style_none)
        label.delete(l_pmh[1])
        l_pml = label.new(pmstart, pm_low, text="PML", xloc=xloc.bar_time, textcolor=PMHLColor, style=label.style_none)
        label.delete(l_pml[1])
        
plotshape(plotSignals ? ta.crossover(close, orbH) : na, style=shape.triangleup, location=location.belowbar, color=color.new(color.blue, 0), text='Buy', textcolor=color.new(color.blue, 0))
plotshape(plotSignals ? ta.crossover(orbL, close) : na, style=shape.triangledown, location=location.abovebar, color=color.new(color.blue, 0), text='Sell', textcolor=color.new(color.blue, 0))

f_orb_strength(bool isLong, float pen, float bdy, float atrR, float volR, float m3, float m5, float rsiv, bool htfOk, bool biasOk, bool firstOfDay, float orR, float adrV) =>
    s = 0.0
    s += bdy >= 0.85 ? 1.5 : bdy >= 0.70 ? 1.1 : bdy >= 0.55 ? 0.6 : 0.2
    s += atrR >= 2.0 ? 1.5 : atrR >= 1.4 ? 1.0 : atrR >= 1.0 ? 0.6 : 0.2
    s += volR >= 2.0 ? 1.5 : volR >= 1.5 ? 1.0 : volR >= 1.2 ? 0.5 : 0.0
    m3ok = (isLong and m3 > 0) or (not isLong and m3 < 0)
    m5ok = (isLong and m5 > 0) or (not isLong and m5 < 0)
    s += m3ok and m5ok ? 1.5 : m3ok or m5ok ? 0.7 : -0.4
    s += pen >= 0.5 ? 1.0 : pen >= 0.25 ? 0.6 : pen >= 0.1 ? 0.3 : 0.0
    rsiOk = (isLong and rsiv > 52) or (not isLong and rsiv < 48)
    s += rsiOk ? 0.5 : 0.0
    s += htfOk ? 1.0 : 0.0
    s += biasOk ? 0.5 : 0.0
    s += firstOfDay ? 1.0 : 0.0
    coil = adrV > 0 ? orR / adrV : 0.0
    s += coil >= 0.12 and coil <= 0.45 ? 0.5 : 0.0
    math.max(0.0, math.min(10.0, math.round(s * 10) / 10))

closedSl  = false
closedTp  = false

if tradeActive
    bool tp1Hit = tradeSide == 1 ? high >= tTp1 : low <= tTp1
    bool tp2Hit = tradeSide == 1 ? high >= tTp2 : low <= tTp2
    bool tp3Hit = tradeSide == 1 ? high >= tTp3 : low <= tTp3
    bool slHit  = tradeSide == 1 ? low  <= tStop : high >= tStop

    int stage = tp3Hit ? 3 : tp2Hit ? 2 : tp1Hit ? 1 : 0
    bool sameBarSl = slHit and stage > 0
    if stage > bestStage and not sameBarSl
        bestStage := stage

    bool finalTp3 = not sameBarSl and bestStage == 3
    bool finalSl  = slHit and (bestStage == 0 or sameBarSl)
    bool finalTp  = slHit and not sameBarSl and bestStage > 0 and bestStage < 3
    bool finalEod = trClose and not (finalTp3 or finalSl or finalTp)

    if finalTp3 or finalSl or finalTp or finalEod
        float markR = tRisk > 0 ? (tradeSide == 1 ? (close - tEntry) / tRisk : (tEntry - close) / tRisk) : 0.0
        float eodR  = math.max(-1.0, math.min(tp3R, markR))
        float resR  = finalTp3 ? tp3R : finalTp and bestStage == 2 ? tp2R : finalTp and bestStage == 1 ? tp1R : finalSl ? -1.0 : eodR
        bool isWin = resR > 0

        closedTp3 := finalTp3
        closedSl  := finalSl
        closedTp  := finalTp
        closedEod := finalEod

        sClosed += 1
        sR += resR
        if isWin
            sWins += 1
            sGW += resR
            sCurW += 1
            sCurL := 0
            sMaxW := math.max(sMaxW, sCurW)
            sStreak := sCurW
        else
            sGL += math.abs(resR)
            sCurL += 1
            sCurW := 0
            sMaxL := math.max(sMaxL, sCurL)
            sStreak := -sCurL
        if tradeSide == 1
            sLong += 1
            sLongW += isWin ? 1 : 0
        else
            sShort += 1
            sShortW += isWin ? 1 : 0
        if finalTp3
            sTp3 += 1
        else if finalTp and bestStage == 2
            sTp2 += 1
        else if finalTp and bestStage == 1
            sTp1 += 1
        else if finalSl
            sSl += 1
        else
            sEod += 1

        int closeEdge = na(tradeBar) ? bar_index : math.max(tradeBar + 3, bar_index)
        if showLines
            if not na(aEn)
                line.set_x2(aEn, closeEdge)
            if not na(aSl)
                line.set_x2(aSl, closeEdge)
            if not na(aT1)
                line.set_x2(aT1, closeEdge)
            if not na(aT2)
                line.set_x2(aT2, closeEdge)
            if not na(aT3)
                line.set_x2(aT3, closeEdge)
        if showBoxes

        if showLevel

            if not na(aL1)

            if not na(aL2)
                label.set_x(aL2, closeEdge)
            if not na(aL3)
                label.set_x(aL3, closeEdge)

        float resPrice = finalTp3 ? tTp3 : finalTp and bestStage == 2 ? tTp2 : finalTp and bestStage == 1 ? tTp1 : finalSl ? tStop : close
        string resTxt = finalTp3 ? "TP3 ✔ " + f_signedR(resR) : finalTp ? "TP" + str.tostring(bestStage) + " ✔ " + f_signedR(resR) : finalSl ? "SL ✘ -1R" : "EOD ⏱ " + f_signedR(resR)
        color resCol = resR >= 0 ? longCol : shortCol
        string resStyle0 = tradeSide == 1 ? (resR >= 0 ? "down" : "up") : (resR >= 0 ? "up" : "down")
        if showExit
            aEx := label.new(closeEdge, resPrice, resTxt, style = resStyle0 == "down" ? label.style_label_down : label.style_label_up, color = color.new(resCol, 0), textcolor = color.white, size = f_size(lblSizeOpt))

        tViz tv = tViz.new(aEn, aSl, aT1, aT2, aT3, aTb, aSb, aSg, aLe, aLs, aL1, aL2, aL3, aEx)
        array.push(trHist, tv)
        while array.size(trHist) > maxHist
            tViz old = array.shift(trHist)
            if not na(old.en)
                line.delete(old.en)
            if not na(old.sl)
                line.delete(old.sl)
            if not na(old.t1)
                line.delete(old.t1)
            if not na(old.t2)
                line.delete(old.t2)
            if not na(old.t3)
                line.delete(old.t3)
            if not na(old.tb)
                box.delete(old.tb)
            if not na(old.sb)
                box.delete(old.sb)
            if not na(old.sg)
                label.delete(old.sg)
            if not na(old.le)
                label.delete(old.le)
            if not na(old.ls)
                label.delete(old.ls)
            if not na(old.l1)
                label.delete(old.l1)
            if not na(old.l2)
                label.delete(old.l2)
            if not na(old.l3)
                label.delete(old.l3)
            if not na(old.ex)
                label.delete(old.ex)

        aEn := na
        aSl := na
        aT1 := na
        aT2 := na
        aT3 := na
        aTb := na
        aSb := na
        aSg := na
        aLe := na
        aLs := na
        aL1 := na
        aL2 := na

        tradeActive := false

        tradeBar := na

        tStop := na
        tTp1 := na
        tTp2 := na
        tTp3 := na
        tRisk := na

bool crossUp = orFormed and inTrade and not na(orH) and close > orH and close[1] <= orH
bool crossDn = orFormed and inTrade and not na(orL) and close < orL and close[1] >= orL

float penUp = atr > 0 ? (close - orH) / atr : 0.0
float penDn = atr > 0 ? (orL - close) / atr : 0.0

bool bufOkUp = not retestReq or (close - orH) >= breakBuf * atr
bool bufOkDn = not retestReq or (orL - close) >= breakBuf * atr

bool htfOkUp = not useHtf or close > htfEma
bool htfOkDn = not useHtf or close < htfEma

float coilPct = adrAtOpen > 0 ? orRange / adrAtOpen * 100.0 : na
bool adrOkUp = not useAdrGate or (not na(coilPct) and coilPct >= minOrPct and coilPct <= maxOrPct)
bool adrOkDn = adrOkUp

bool biasUp = not na(dayOpen) and close > dayOpen
bool biasDn = not na(dayOpen) and close < dayOpen
bool firstUp = tradesToday == 0
bool firstDn = tradesToday == 0

float scDn = crossDn ? f_orb_strength(false, penDn, bodyRatio, atrRatio, volRatio, mom3, mom5, rsi, htfOkDn, biasDn, firstDn, orRange, adrAtOpen) : 0.0

bool dirAllowedUp = dirToday == 0 or maxPerDay > 1
bool dirAllowedDn = dirToday == 0 or maxPerDay > 1

bool sigLong  = crossUp and bufOkUp and htfOkUp and adrOkUp and dirAllowedUp and scUp >= minStr and (not onlyStrong or scUp >= strongThr)
bool sigShort = crossDn and bufOkDn and htfOkDn and adrOkDn and dirAllowedDn and scDn >= minStr and (not onlyStrong or scDn >= strongThr)
sigShort := sigShort and not sigLong

bool gateDay = tradesToday < maxPerDay and not tradeActive
bool closedAny = closedTp3 or closedSl or closedTp or closedEod
bool takeLong  = sigLong  and gateDay and not closedAny and not na(atr)
bool takeShort = sigShort and gateDay and not closedAny and not na(atr)

if takeLong or takeShort
    bool isLong = takeLong
    int side = isLong ? 1 : -1
    float sc = isLong ? scUp : scDn
    float entv = close
    float rawStop = slMode == "ATR" ? (isLong ? entv - atr * slAtrMult : entv + atr * slAtrMult) : slMode == "OR Mid" ? (isLong ? orMid - atr * slBufAtr : orMid + atr * slBufAtr) : (isLong ? orL - atr * slBufAtr : orH + atr * slBufAtr)
    float risk0 = math.abs(entv - rawStop)
    float maxR = atr * maxRiskAtr
    float minR = atr * minRiskAtr
    float risk = math.min(math.max(risk0, minR), maxR)
    float stopv = isLong ? entv - risk : entv + risk
    float t1 = isLong ? entv + risk * tp1R : entv - risk * tp1R
    float t2 = isLong ? entv + risk * tp2R : entv - risk * tp2R

        aSl := line.new(bar_index, stopv, xr, stopv, xloc = xloc.bar_index, color = color.new(shortCol, 10), width = 1, style = line.style_dashed)

    hl0 := line.new(orStartBar, orH, orEndBar, orH, xloc = xloc.bar_index, color = color.new(cz, 0), width = 2, style = line.style_solid)
    ll0 := line.new(orStartBar, orL, orEndBar, orL, xloc = xloc.bar_index, color = color.new(cz, 0), width = 2, style = line.style_solid)
    if showORExt
        hp0 := line.new(orEndBar, orH, xr, orH, xloc = xloc.bar_index, color = color.new(cz, 25), width = 1, style = line.style_dashed)
        lp0 := line.new(orEndBar, orL, xr, orL, xloc = xloc.bar_index, color = color.new(cz, 25), width = 1, style = line.style_dashed)
    if showMid
        ml0 := line.new(orStartBar, orMid, xr, orMid, xloc = xloc.bar_index, color = color.new(amberLo, 30), width = 1, style = line.style_dotted)
    string rngTxt = "  (" + f_pips(orRange) + "p)"
    hlb0 := label.new(xr, orH, "ORH " + str.tostring(orH, format.mintick) + rngTxt, xloc = xloc.bar_index, style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(cz, 80), textcolor = cz, size = f_size(lblSizeOpt))
    llb0 := label.new(xr, orL, "ORL " + str.tostring(orL, format.mintick), xloc = xloc.bar_index, style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(cz, 80), textcolor = cz, size = f_size(lblSizeOpt))
    if showMid

    if showTargets
        float u1 = orH + orRange * 1.0
        float u2 = orH + orRange * 2.0
        float d1 = orL - orRange * 1.0
        float d2 = orL - orRange * 2.0
        u10 := line.new(orEndBar, u1, xr, u1, xloc = xloc.bar_index, color = color.new(longCol, 55), width = 1, style = line.style_dotted)
        u20 := line.new(orEndBar, u2, xr, u2, xloc = xloc.bar_index, color = color.new(longCol, 65), width = 1, style = line.style_dotted)
        d10 := line.new(orEndBar, d1, xr, d1, xloc = xloc.bar_index, color = color.new(shortCol, 55), width = 1, style = line.style_dotted)
        d20 := line.new(orEndBar, d2, xr, d2, xloc = xloc.bar_index, color = color.new(shortCol, 65), width = 1, style = line.style_dotted)
        u1b0 := label.new(xr, u1, "MM ×1", xloc = xloc.bar_index, style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(longCol, 88), textcolor = longCol, size = size.tiny)
        u2b0 := label.new(xr, u2, "MM ×2", xloc = xloc.bar_index, style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(longCol, 88), textcolor = longCol, size = size.tiny)
        d1b0 := label.new(xr, d1, "MM ×1", xloc = xloc.bar_index, style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(shortCol, 88), textcolor = shortCol, size = size.tiny)
        d2b0 := label.new(xr, d2, "MM ×2", xloc = xloc.bar_index, style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(shortCol, 88), textcolor = shortCol, size = size.tiny)

    oViz ov = oViz.new(bx0, hl0, ll0, hp0, lp0, ml0, u10, u20, d10, d20, hlb0, llb0, mlb0, u1b0, u2b0, d1b0, d2b0)
    array.push(orHist, ov)
    while array.size(orHist) > orDays
        oViz od = array.shift(orHist)
        if not na(od.bx)
            box.delete(od.bx)
        if not na(od.hl)
            line.delete(od.hl)
        if not na(od.ll)
            line.delete(od.ll)
        if not na(od.hp)
            line.delete(od.hp)
        if not na(od.lp)
            line.delete(od.lp)
        if not na(od.ml)
            line.delete(od.ml)
        if not na(od.u1)
            line.delete(od.u1)
        if not na(od.u2)
            line.delete(od.u2)
        if not na(od.d1)
            line.delete(od.d1)
        if not na(od.d2)
            line.delete(od.d2)
        if not na(od.hlb)
            label.delete(od.hlb)
        if not na(od.llb)
            label.delete(od.llb)
        if not na(od.mlb)
            label.delete(od.mlb)
        if not na(od.u1b)
            label.delete(od.u1b)
        if not na(od.u2b)
            label.delete(od.u2b)
        if not na(od.d1b)
            label.delete(od.d1b)
        if not na(od.d2b)
            label.delete(od.d2b)

    if showHeat
