//@version=6
indicator("ORB [ASÜ]", overlay=true, max_boxes_count=500, max_lines_count=500, max_labels_count=500)

//==============================================================================
// INPUTS
//==============================================================================

// Timezone Settings
string i_timezone = input.string("America/New_York", "Timezone", options=[
     "America/New_York",
     "UTC",
     "GMT-12 (Baker Island)",
     "GMT-11 (Pago Pago)",
     "GMT-10 (Honolulu)",
     "GMT-9 (Anchorage)",
     "GMT-8 (Los Angeles)",
     "GMT-7 (Denver)",
     "GMT-6 (Chicago)",
     "GMT-5 (New York)",
     "GMT-4 (Santiago)",
     "GMT-3 (São Paulo)",
     "GMT-2 (South Georgia)",
     "GMT-1 (Azores)",
     "GMT+0 (London)",
     "GMT+1 (Paris)",
     "GMT+2 (Berlin)",
     "GMT+3 (Moscow)",
     "GMT+4 (Dubai)",
     "GMT+5 (Karachi)",
     "GMT+5:30 (Mumbai)",
     "GMT+6 (Dhaka)",
     "GMT+7 (Bangkok)",
     "GMT+8 (Singapore)",
     "GMT+9 (Tokyo)",
     "GMT+10 (Sydney)",
     "GMT+11 (Solomon Islands)",
     "GMT+12 (Auckland)",
     "GMT+13 (Samoa)",
     "GMT+14 (Kiritimati)"
     ], group="Timezone", tooltip="America/New_York auto-adjusts for DST (EST/EDT). GMT offsets are fixed.")

// ORB Time Settings
int i_orbStartHour = input.int(8, "ORB Start Hour", minval=0, maxval=23, group="ORB Time Settings")
int i_orbStartMin = input.int(0, "ORB Start Minute", minval=0, maxval=59, group="ORB Time Settings")
int i_orbDuration = input.int(15, "ORB Duration (Minutes)", minval=1, maxval=240, group="ORB Time Settings")
int i_extendHour = input.int(11, "Extend To Hour", minval=0, maxval=23, group="ORB Time Settings")
int i_extendMinute = input.int(0, "Extend To Minute", minval=0, maxval=59, group="ORB Time Settings")
int i_maxExtensionBars = input.int(500, "Max Extension Bars", minval=10, maxval=1000, group="ORB Time Settings", tooltip="Safety limit: Maximum number of bars the ORB can extend. Prevents infinite extension during holidays/gaps.")

// Color Settings
color i_borderColor = input.color(#ffffff, "Top/Bottom Line Color", group="Colors")
color i_midlineColor = input.color(#ff0000, "Midline Color", group="Colors")
color i_bgColor = input.color(color.new(#2962FF, 100), "Background Color", group="Colors")
int i_borderWidth = input.int(2, "Border Width", minval=1, maxval=5, group="Colors")
int i_midlineWidth = input.int(2, "Midline Width", minval=1, maxval=5, group="Colors")
string i_midlineStyle = input.string("dotted", "Midline Style", options=["solid", "dashed", "dotted"], group="Colors")

// Vertical Line Settings
bool i_showVertLine = input.bool(false, "Show Vertical Line", group="Vertical Line")
int i_vertLineHour = input.int(9, "Vertical Line Hour", minval=0, maxval=23, group="Vertical Line")
int i_vertLineMinute = input.int(30, "Vertical Line Minute", minval=0, maxval=59, group="Vertical Line")
color i_vertLineColor = input.color(color.red, "Vertical Line Color", group="Vertical Line")
string i_vertLineStyle = input.string("dashed", "Vertical Line Style", options=["solid", "dashed", "dotted"], group="Vertical Line")
int i_vertLineWidth = input.int(1, "Vertical Line Width", minval=1, maxval=5, group="Vertical Line")

// Display Settings
bool i_showHistorical = input.bool(true, "Show Historical ORBs", group="Display")
string i_maxTimeframe = input.string("15m", "Max Timeframe", options=["1m", "3m", "5m", "15m", "30m", "1H", "2H", "4H"], group="Display")
bool i_showSizeLabel = input.bool(true, "Show ORB Size Label", group="Display")
string i_sizeLabelSize = input.string("normal", "ORB Size Label Size", options=["tiny", "small", "normal", "large", "huge"], group="Display")

// ORB Size Thresholds
float i_maxThreshold = input.float(19.5, "Max Size Warning (Points)", minval=0, step=0.5, group="ORB Size Settings", tooltip="ORB larger than this = Too Big (Red)")
float i_minThreshold = input.float(3.0, "Min Size Warning (Points)", minval=0, step=0.5, group="ORB Size Settings", tooltip="ORB smaller than this = Too Small (Orange)")

//==============================================================================
// TIMEZONE CONVERSION
//==============================================================================

getTimezone() =>
    switch i_timezone
        "America/New_York" => "America/New_York"
        "UTC" => "UTC"
        "GMT-12 (Baker Island)" => "Etc/GMT+12"
        "GMT-11 (Pago Pago)" => "Etc/GMT+11"
        "GMT-10 (Honolulu)" => "Pacific/Honolulu"
        "GMT-9 (Anchorage)" => "America/Anchorage"
        "GMT-8 (Los Angeles)" => "America/Los_Angeles"
        "GMT-7 (Denver)" => "America/Denver"
        "GMT-6 (Chicago)" => "America/Chicago"
        "GMT-5 (New York)" => "America/New_York"
        "GMT-4 (Santiago)" => "America/Santiago"
        "GMT-3 (São Paulo)" => "America/Sao_Paulo"
        "GMT-2 (South Georgia)" => "Etc/GMT+2"
        "GMT-1 (Azores)" => "Atlantic/Azores"
        "GMT+0 (London)" => "Europe/London"
        "GMT+1 (Paris)" => "Europe/Paris"
        "GMT+2 (Berlin)" => "Europe/Berlin"
        "GMT+3 (Moscow)" => "Europe/Moscow"
        "GMT+4 (Dubai)" => "Asia/Dubai"
        "GMT+5 (Karachi)" => "Asia/Karachi"
        "GMT+5:30 (Mumbai)" => "Asia/Kolkata"
        "GMT+6 (Dhaka)" => "Asia/Dhaka"
        "GMT+7 (Bangkok)" => "Asia/Bangkok"
        "GMT+8 (Singapore)" => "Asia/Singapore"
        "GMT+9 (Tokyo)" => "Asia/Tokyo"
        "GMT+10 (Sydney)" => "Australia/Sydney"
        "GMT+11 (Solomon Islands)" => "Etc/GMT-11"
        "GMT+12 (Auckland)" => "Pacific/Auckland"
        "GMT+13 (Samoa)" => "Pacific/Apia"
        "GMT+14 (Kiritimati)" => "Etc/GMT-14"
        => "America/New_York"

string tz = getTimezone()

//==============================================================================
// TIMEFRAME VALIDATION
//==============================================================================

int maxTfMins = switch i_maxTimeframe
    "1m" => 1
    "3m" => 3
    "5m" => 5
    "15m" => 15
    "30m" => 30
    "1H" => 60
    "2H" => 120
    "4H" => 240
    => 15

int currTfMins = timeframe.isintraday ? timeframe.multiplier : 1440
bool isValidTf = currTfMins <= maxTfMins

//==============================================================================
// LINE STYLE FUNCTIONS
//==============================================================================

getMidlineStyle() =>
    switch i_midlineStyle
        "solid" => line.style_solid
        "dashed" => line.style_dashed
        "dotted" => line.style_dotted
        => line.style_dashed

getVertLineStyle() =>
    switch i_vertLineStyle
        "solid" => line.style_solid
        "dashed" => line.style_dashed
        "dotted" => line.style_dotted
        => line.style_dashed

//==============================================================================
// TIME FUNCTIONS
//==============================================================================

currHour = hour(time, tz)
currMinute = minute(time, tz)

// Check if bar is within ORB formation period
isOrbTime() =>
    h = hour(time, tz)
    m = minute(time, tz)
    totalMins = h * 60 + m
    startMins = i_orbStartHour * 60 + i_orbStartMin
    endMins = startMins + i_orbDuration
    totalMins >= startMins and totalMins < endMins

// Check if this is first bar of new ORB session
isNewOrbSession() =>
    h = hour(time, tz)
    m = minute(time, tz)
    h_prev = hour(time[1], tz)
    m_prev = minute(time[1], tz)
    
    totalMins = h * 60 + m
    prevTotalMins = h_prev * 60 + m_prev
    startMins = i_orbStartHour * 60 + i_orbStartMin
    endMins = startMins + i_orbDuration
    
    currentInOrb = totalMins >= startMins and totalMins < endMins
    prevInOrb = prevTotalMins >= startMins and prevTotalMins < endMins
    
    // Also check for day change to handle gaps properly
    dayChanged = dayofmonth(time, tz) != dayofmonth(time[1], tz)
    
    (currentInOrb and not prevInOrb) or (currentInOrb and dayChanged)

// Check if ORB just ended
orbJustEnded() =>
    h = hour(time, tz)
    m = minute(time, tz)
    h_prev = hour(time[1], tz)
    m_prev = minute(time[1], tz)
    
    totalMins = h * 60 + m
    prevTotalMins = h_prev * 60 + m_prev
    startMins = i_orbStartHour * 60 + i_orbStartMin
    endMins = startMins + i_orbDuration
    
    currentInOrb = totalMins >= startMins and totalMins < endMins
    prevInOrb = prevTotalMins >= startMins and prevTotalMins < endMins
    
    not currentInOrb and prevInOrb

// Check if we're past the extend time for TODAY
isPastExtendTimeToday() =>
    h = hour(time, tz)
    m = minute(time, tz)
    totalMins = h * 60 + m
    extendMins = i_extendHour * 60 + i_extendMinute
    totalMins > extendMins

// Check if we JUST passed the extend time (same day only)
justPassedExtendTime(int orbDayVal) =>
    h = hour(time, tz)
    m = minute(time, tz)
    h_prev = hour(time[1], tz)
    m_prev = minute(time[1], tz)
    
    totalMins = h * 60 + m
    prevTotalMins = h_prev * 60 + m_prev
    extendMins = i_extendHour * 60 + i_extendMinute
    
    // Must be same day as ORB was created
    sameDay = dayofmonth(time, tz) == orbDayVal
    
    sameDay and prevTotalMins <= extendMins and totalMins > extendMins

// Check if current bar is on a different calendar day than the ORB day
isDifferentDay(int orbDayVal) =>
    dayofmonth(time, tz) != orbDayVal

// Calculate the timestamp for vertical line time based on ORB start time
getVertLineTimestamp(int orbStart) =>
    int vertMins = i_vertLineHour * 60 + i_vertLineMinute
    int orbStartMins = i_orbStartHour * 60 + i_orbStartMin
    int minsFromOrbStart = vertMins - orbStartMins
    orbStart + (minsFromOrbStart * 60 * 1000)

//==============================================================================
// ORB TRACKING
//==============================================================================

var float orbHigh = na
var float orbLow = na
var int orbStartTime = na
var int orbEndTime = na
var int orbDay = na
var int orbMonth = na
var int orbYear = na
var bool orbLocked = false
var bool extensionEnded = false
var int barsSinceOrbStart = 0

newSession = isNewOrbSession()

// Reset for new ORB session
if newSession and isValidTf
    orbHigh := high
    orbLow := low
    orbStartTime := time
    orbDay := dayofmonth(time, tz)
    orbMonth := month(time, tz)
    orbYear := year(time, tz)
    orbLocked := false
    extensionEnded := false
    orbEndTime := na
    barsSinceOrbStart := 0

// Increment bar counter when we have an active ORB
if not na(orbStartTime) and not extensionEnded
    barsSinceOrbStart := barsSinceOrbStart + 1

// Continue building ORB during formation period
if isOrbTime() and not newSession and isValidTf and not na(orbHigh) and dayofmonth(time, tz) == orbDay and month(time, tz) == orbMonth and year(time, tz) == orbYear
    orbHigh := math.max(orbHigh, high)
    orbLow := math.min(orbLow, low)

// Lock ORB when formation period ends
if orbJustEnded() and not orbLocked and dayofmonth(time, tz) == orbDay and month(time, tz) == orbMonth and year(time, tz) == orbYear
    orbLocked := true

// SAFETY CHECK 1: If we're on a different day and ORB hasn't ended, force end it
// This handles the bank holiday scenario where extend time was never reached
if not extensionEnded and not na(orbDay) and orbLocked
    currentDay = dayofmonth(time, tz)
    currentMonth = month(time, tz)
    currentYear = year(time, tz)
    
    // Check if it's a different calendar day
    differentDay = (currentDay != orbDay) or (currentMonth != orbMonth) or (currentYear != orbYear)
    
    if differentDay
        extensionEnded := true
        // Set end time to the last bar of the ORB day (use previous bar time if we just changed days)
        if na(orbEndTime)
            orbEndTime := time[1]

// SAFETY CHECK 2: Maximum bar extension limit
// If ORB has been extending for too many bars, force end it
if not extensionEnded and orbLocked and barsSinceOrbStart > i_maxExtensionBars
    extensionEnded := true
    if na(orbEndTime)
        orbEndTime := time[1]

// Mark extension as ended when we pass the extend time (same day only)
if justPassedExtendTime(orbDay) and not extensionEnded and orbLocked
    extensionEnded := true
    orbEndTime := time[1]

//==============================================================================
// ORB CALCULATIONS
//==============================================================================

float orbSize = (not na(orbHigh) and not na(orbLow)) ? (orbHigh - orbLow) : na
float orbMid = (not na(orbHigh) and not na(orbLow)) ? (orbHigh + orbLow) / 2 : na

bool isOversized = not na(orbSize) and orbSize > i_maxThreshold
bool isUndersized = not na(orbSize) and orbSize <= i_minThreshold

//==============================================================================
// HELPER FUNCTIONS
//==============================================================================

getLabelSize() =>
    switch i_sizeLabelSize
        "tiny" => size.tiny
        "small" => size.small
        "normal" => size.normal
        "large" => size.large
        "huge" => size.huge
        => size.small

getLabelColor() =>
    if isOversized
        color.red
    else if isUndersized
        color.orange
    else
        color.green

//==============================================================================
// DRAWING VARIABLES
//==============================================================================

var box currentBox = na
var line currentMidline = na
var label currentSizeLabel = na
var line currentVertLine = na
var bool vertLineDrawn = false

int futureTime = time + 86400000

//==============================================================================
// DRAW ORB
//==============================================================================

if isValidTf and not na(orbHigh) and not na(orbLow) and not na(orbStartTime)
    
    int rightTime = futureTime
    if extensionEnded and not na(orbEndTime)
        rightTime := orbEndTime
    
    if newSession and not i_showHistorical
        if not na(currentBox)
            box.delete(currentBox)
        if not na(currentMidline)
            line.delete(currentMidline)
        if not na(currentSizeLabel)
            label.delete(currentSizeLabel)
        if not na(currentVertLine)
            line.delete(currentVertLine)
        
        currentBox := na
        currentMidline := na
        currentSizeLabel := na
        currentVertLine := na
        vertLineDrawn := false
    
    if newSession
        vertLineDrawn := false
    
    if newSession or na(currentBox)
        currentBox := box.new(
             left=orbStartTime, 
             top=orbHigh, 
             right=rightTime, 
             bottom=orbLow,
             bgcolor=i_bgColor, 
             border_color=i_borderColor, 
             border_width=i_borderWidth,
             xloc=xloc.bar_time
             )
        
        currentMidline := line.new(
             x1=orbStartTime, 
             y1=orbMid, 
             x2=rightTime, 
             y2=orbMid,
             color=i_midlineColor, 
             width=i_midlineWidth, 
             style=getMidlineStyle(),
             xloc=xloc.bar_time
             )
        
        if i_showSizeLabel
            string labelText = str.tostring(orbSize, "#.##") + " pts"
            if isUndersized or isOversized
                labelText := labelText + " ⚠"
            
            currentSizeLabel := label.new(
                 x=orbStartTime, 
                 y=orbHigh,
                 text=labelText,
                 style=label.style_label_down,
                 color=getLabelColor(),
                 textcolor=color.white,
                 size=getLabelSize(),
                 xloc=xloc.bar_time
                 )
    
    else if not na(currentBox)
        box.set_top(currentBox, orbHigh)
        box.set_bottom(currentBox, orbLow)
        box.set_right(currentBox, rightTime)
        
        if not na(currentMidline)
            line.set_y1(currentMidline, orbMid)
            line.set_y2(currentMidline, orbMid)
            line.set_x2(currentMidline, rightTime)
        
        if not na(currentSizeLabel) and i_showSizeLabel
            string labelText = str.tostring(orbSize, "#.##") + " pts"
            if isUndersized or isOversized
                labelText := labelText + " ⚠"
            
            label.set_text(currentSizeLabel, labelText)
            label.set_y(currentSizeLabel, orbHigh)
            label.set_color(currentSizeLabel, getLabelColor())

//==============================================================================
// VERTICAL LINE
//==============================================================================

if isValidTf and i_showVertLine and orbLocked and not extensionEnded and not vertLineDrawn and not na(orbHigh) and not na(orbLow) and not na(orbStartTime) and dayofmonth(time, tz) == orbDay and month(time, tz) == orbMonth and year(time, tz) == orbYear
    if not i_showHistorical and not na(currentVertLine)
        line.delete(currentVertLine)
    
    int vertLineTime = getVertLineTimestamp(orbStartTime)
    
    currentVertLine := line.new(
         x1=vertLineTime, 
         y1=orbLow, 
         x2=vertLineTime, 
         y2=orbHigh,
         color=i_vertLineColor, 
         width=i_vertLineWidth, 
         style=getVertLineStyle(),
         xloc=xloc.bar_time
         )
    
    vertLineDrawn := true

if not na(currentVertLine) and orbLocked and not extensionEnded
    line.set_y1(currentVertLine, orbLow)
    line.set_y2(currentVertLine, orbHigh)

//==============================================================================
// DEBUG PLOTS (Data Window Only)
//==============================================================================

plot(orbHigh, "ORB High", display=display.data_window)
plot(orbLow, "ORB Low", display=display.data_window)
plot(orbMid, "ORB Mid", display=display.data_window)
plot(orbSize, "ORB Size", display=display.data_window)
plot(isOrbTime() ? 1 : 0, "Is ORB Time", display=display.data_window)
plot(extensionEnded ? 1 : 0, "Extension Ended", display=display.data_window)
plot(orbLocked ? 1 : 0, "ORB Locked", display=display.data_window)
plot(currHour, "Current Hour (TZ)", display=display.data_window)
plot(currMinute, "Current Minute", display=display.data_window)
plot(barsSinceOrbStart, "Bars Since ORB Start", display=display.data_window)
plot(orbDay, "ORB Day", display=display.data_window)

items.name: 15-Min ORB Indicator with Breakout Targets
items.title: 15-Min ORB Indicator with Breakout Targets
items.author: JWinters318
items.source:
//@version=6
indicator(title="15-Min ORB Indicator with Breakout Targets", shorttitle="15-Min ORB", overlay=true)

// === Inputs ===
enable15Min    = input.bool(true,  "Display 15-Minute Range", group="15-Minute Range")
label15Min     = input.bool(true,  "Show 15-Minute Labels",   group="15-Minute Range")
sessStartHour  = input.int(9,      "Range Start Hour",         minval=0, maxval=23, group="15-Minute Range")
sessStartMin   = input.int(30,     "Range Start Minute",       minval=0, maxval=59, group="15-Minute Range")
rangeColor     = input.color(color.purple, "15-Minute Range Color",  group="15-Minute Range")
rangeStyleOpt  = input.string("Solid","15-Minute Range Style", options=["Solid","Dashed","Dotted"], group="15-Minute Range")
rangeStyle     = rangeStyleOpt == "Dashed" ? line.style_dashed : (rangeStyleOpt == "Dotted" ? line.style_dotted : line.style_solid)

// TP expansion multiples
r1             = input.float(1.0,  "TP1 Expansion-Multiple", step=0.25, group="Targets")
r2             = input.float(2.0,  "TP2 Expansion-Multiple", step=0.25, group="Targets")
enableTP1Line  = input.bool(true,  "Show TP1 Level",          group="Targets")
enableTP2Line  = input.bool(true,  "Show TP2 Level",          group="Targets")
enableTP1Label = input.bool(true,  "Show TP1 Label",          group="Targets")
enableTP2Label = input.bool(true,  "Show TP2 Label",          group="Targets")
labelColorTP   = input.color(color.green, "TP Label Color",        group="Targets")
TPStyleOpt  = input.string("Solid","TP Style", options=["Solid","Dashed","Dotted"], group="")
TPStyle     = rangeStyleOpt == "Dashed" ? line.style_dashed : (rangeStyleOpt == "Dotted" ? line.style_dotted : line.style_solid)


// Label Horizontal Position
dlabelPos      = input.string("Right", "Labels Position", options=["Left","Right"], group="Labels")
labelXCoord    = dlabelPos == "Left" ? bar_index[2] : bar_index

// === State Variables ===
var float h15       = na
var float l15       = na
var line  lHigh     = na
var line  lLow      = na
var line  lTP1      = na
var line  lTP2      = na
var label lblHigh   = na
var label lblLow    = na
var label lblTP1    = na
var label lblTP2    = na
var bool  longTrig  = false
var bool  shortTrig = false
var float entryP    = na
var float distOut   = na
var float tp1       = na
var float tp2       = na

// === 15-Minute Range Calculation ===
inRange = hour == sessStartHour and minute >= sessStartMin and minute < sessStartMin + 15
if inRange and enable15Min
    h15 := na(h15) ? high : math.max(h15, high)
    l15 := na(l15) ? low  : math.min(l15, low)
    // delete previous range drawings
    line.delete(lHigh)
    line.delete(lLow)
    label.delete(lblHigh)
    label.delete(lblLow)
    // draw range high/low
    lHigh := line.new(bar_index[2], h15, bar_index,    h15, color=rangeColor, width=2, style=rangeStyle, extend=extend.right)
    lLow  := line.new(bar_index[2], l15, bar_index,    l15, color=rangeColor, width=2, style=rangeStyle, extend=extend.right)
    if label15Min
        lblHigh := label.new(labelXCoord, h15, text="15m High: " + str.tostring(h15, format.mintick), xloc=xloc.bar_index, yloc=yloc.price, style=label.style_label_down, color=rangeColor, textcolor=color.white)
        lblLow  := label.new(labelXCoord, l15, text="15m Low:  " + str.tostring(l15, format.mintick), xloc=xloc.bar_index, yloc=yloc.price, style=label.style_label_up,   color=rangeColor, textcolor=color.white)

// === Reset at Midnight ===
if hour == 0 and minute == 0
    h15 := na
    l15 := na
    longTrig  := false
    shortTrig := false
    // delete all drawings
    line.delete(lHigh)
    line.delete(lLow)
    line.delete(lTP1)
    line.delete(lTP2)
    label.delete(lblHigh)
    label.delete(lblLow)
    label.delete(lblTP1)
    label.delete(lblTP2)

// === Breakout Conditions ===
longBrk  = not longTrig  and close > h15
shortBrk = not shortTrig and close < l15

// === Entry & TP Plotting ===
if longBrk
    longTrig := true
    entryP   := close
    distOut  := entryP - l15
    tp1      := entryP + r1 * distOut
    tp2      := entryP + r2 * distOut
    // clear previous targets
    line.delete(lTP1)
    line.delete(lTP2)
    label.delete(lblTP1)
    label.delete(lblTP2)
    // draw TP1 & TP2 lines
    if enableTP1Line
        lTP1 := line.new(bar_index, tp1, bar_index + 1, tp1, color=color.green, style=line.style_solid, width=2, extend=extend.right)
    if enableTP2Line
        lTP2 := line.new(bar_index, tp2, bar_index + 1, tp2, color=color.green, style=line.style_solid, width=2, extend=extend.right)
    // draw TP labels
    if enableTP1Label and enableTP1Line
        lblTP1 := label.new(labelXCoord, tp1, text="TP1: " + str.tostring(tp1, format.mintick), xloc=xloc.bar_index, yloc=yloc.price, style=label.style_label_down, color=labelColorTP, textcolor=color.white)
    if enableTP2Label and enableTP2Line
        lblTP2 := label.new(labelXCoord, tp2, text="TP2: " + str.tostring(tp2, format.mintick), xloc=xloc.bar_index, yloc=yloc.price, style=label.style_label_down, color=labelColorTP, textcolor=color.white)

if shortBrk
    shortTrig := true
    entryP   := close
    distOut  := h15 - entryP
    tp1      := entryP - r1 * distOut
    tp2      := entryP - r2 * distOut
    // clear previous targets
    line.delete(lTP1)
    line.delete(lTP2)
    label.delete(lblTP1)
    label.delete(lblTP2)
    // draw TP1 & TP2 lines
    if enableTP1Line
        lTP1 := line.new(bar_index, tp1, bar_index + 1, tp1, color=color.green, style=line.style_solid, width=2, extend=extend.right)
    if enableTP2Line
        lTP2 := line.new(bar_index, tp2, bar_index + 1, tp2, color=color.green, style=line.style_solid, width=2, extend=extend.right)
    // draw TP labels
    if enableTP1Label and enableTP1Line
        lblTP1 := label.new(labelXCoord, tp1, text="TP1: " + str.tostring(tp1, format.mintick), xloc=xloc.bar_index, yloc=yloc.price, style=label.style_label_up, color=labelColorTP, textcolor=color.white)
    if enableTP2Label and enableTP2Line
        lblTP2 := label.new(labelXCoord, tp2, text="TP2: " + str.tostring(tp2, format.mintick), xloc=xloc.bar_index, yloc=yloc.price, style=label.style_label_up, color=labelColorTP, textcolor=color.white)

// === Alerts ===
alertcondition(ta.cross(close, h15) and close > h15, title="Closed Above 15m High", message="Price closed above 15-Minute High")
alertcondition(ta.cross(close, l15) and close < l15, title="Closed Below 15m Low",  message="Price closed below 15-Minute Low")

items.name: ORB Pro | Session Breakout Scalper
items.title: ORB Breakout - Scalping Strategy
items.author: blitz_locked
items.source:
// This Pine Script® code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
// © blitz_locked

//@version=6
strategy("ORB Breakout - Scalping Strategy", overlay=true,
          fill_orders_on_standard_ohlc = true,
          max_lines_count = 500,
          max_boxes_count = 500,
          max_labels_count = 500,
          commission_type = strategy.commission.percent,
          commission_value = 0.05,
          slippage = 2)
//Inputs
openingRangeGrp = "Opening Range"
orMins = input.int(15, "Opening Range Length (Mins)", group = openingRangeGrp)
startHour   = input.int(9,  "Session Start Hour (24h)", minval=0, maxval=23, group = openingRangeGrp)
startMinute = input.int(30, "Session Start Minute", minval=0, maxval=59, group = openingRangeGrp)
endHour     = input.int(16, "Session End Hour (24h)", minval=0, maxval=23, group = openingRangeGrp)
endMinute   = input.int(0,  "Session End Minute", minval=0, maxval=59, group = openingRangeGrp)
sessionTZ   = input.string("America/New_York", "Session Timezone", group = openingRangeGrp)

filterGrp = "Filters"
useRangeSize = input.bool(true, "Require range size filter", group = filterGrp)
useVWAP = input.bool(true, "Require VWAP filter", group = filterGrp)
useVolume = input.bool(true, "Require volume confirm", group = filterGrp)
volMult = input.float(1.5, "Volume must exceed X * avg vol", minval=0.1, group = filterGrp)
volLookback = input.int(20, "Volume average lookback", minval=1, group = filterGrp)
useFalseBO = input.bool(true, "Require close beyond range", group = filterGrp)
confirmBars = input.int(1, "Bars close must hold beyond range", minval=1, group = filterGrp)
minRangeATRMult = input.float(0.25, "Min OR size (x ATR) to allow trading", minval=0, group = filterGrp)
maxRangeATRMult = input.float(3.0, "MAX OR size (x ATR) to allow trading", minval=0.1, group = filterGrp)
atrLen = input.int(14, "ATR length for filters", minval=1, group = filterGrp)

riskGrp = "Risk Management"
stopMode = input.string("Range", "Stop loss method", options = ["Range","ATR"], group = riskGrp)
atrStopMult = input.float(1.0, "ATR stop multiplier", minval=0.1, group = riskGrp)
targetRR = input.float(1.5, "Take profit (R multiple)", minval=0.1, group = riskGrp)
partialAtr = input.float(1.0, "Take partial profit at R multiple", minval=0.1, group = riskGrp)
partialPct = input.int(50, "Partial exit size (%)", minval=1, maxval=99, group = riskGrp)
moveToBreakeven = input.bool(true, "Move stop to breakeven after partial", group = riskGrp)
maxTradesPerDay = input.int(2, "Max trades per day", minval=1, group = riskGrp)

sizingGrp = "Position Sizing"
useRiskSizing   = input.bool(true, "Size position by % risk (unchecked = % of equity)", group = sizingGrp)
riskPctPerTrade = input.float(1.0, "Risk per trade (% of equity, stop-based)", minval=0.1, maxval=10, step=0.1, group = sizingGrp)
maxPositionPct  = input.float(25.0, "Max position size (% of equity, caps leverage)", minval=1, maxval=100, group = sizingGrp)
flatEquityPct   = input.float(10.0, "Flat position size (% of equity, used if risk sizing off)", minval=1, maxval=100, step=1, group = sizingGrp)

visualGrp = "Visuals"
showORBox    = input.bool(true,  "Show opening range box",       group = visualGrp)
showSessSep  = input.bool(true,  "Show session separators",      group = visualGrp)
showVWAP     = input.bool(true,  "Show session VWAP",            group = visualGrp)
showFailedBO = input.bool(true,  "Show failed breakout markers", group = visualGrp)
showORLabel  = input.bool(true,  "Show OR size label",           group = visualGrp)
useGradientBox = input.bool(true, "Gradient box by OR/ATR size", group = visualGrp)

orBoxBorderColor = input.color(color.new(color.gray, 40),   "OR Box Border", group = visualGrp)
rangeHighColor   = input.color(color.new(color.green, 0),   "Range High Line", group = visualGrp)
rangeLowColor    = input.color(color.new(color.red, 0),     "Range Low Line",  group = visualGrp)
vwapColor        = input.color(color.new(color.purple, 0),  "VWAP Line",       group = visualGrp)
sepColor         = input.color(color.new(color.gray, 60),   "Session Separator", group = visualGrp)
failedBOColor    = input.color(color.new(color.red, 0),     "Failed Breakout Marker", group = visualGrp)

// ============================================================================
// TIMEFRAME GUARD — the opening-range logic requires multiple bars within
// the OR window to function. On Daily/Weekly/Monthly charts, a single bar
// covers the whole session, so rangeLocked can never flip and the strategy
// silently does nothing. Fail loudly instead.
// ============================================================================
if not timeframe.isintraday
    runtime.error("This ORB strategy requires an intraday chart timeframe (e.g. 1–15 min). It cannot function on Daily/Weekly/Monthly bars.")


// ============================================================================
// SESSION LOGIC — timestamp-based, works identically for stocks, futures,
// and 24/7 assets like crypto.
// ============================================================================

todayStart = timestamp(sessionTZ, year(time, sessionTZ), month(time, sessionTZ), dayofmonth(time, sessionTZ), startHour, startMinute)
todayEnd   = timestamp(sessionTZ, year(time, sessionTZ), month(time, sessionTZ), dayofmonth(time, sessionTZ), endHour, endMinute)

// Session crosses midnight (e.g. 18:00 start, 02:00 end) — push the end
// timestamp to the next calendar day so inSession spans correctly instead
// of always evaluating false.
crossesMidnight = (endHour < startHour) or (endHour == startHour and endMinute <= startMinute)
todayEnd := crossesMidnight ? todayEnd + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000 : todayEnd

orEndTime  = todayStart + orMins * 60 * 1000
inSession  = time >= todayStart and time < todayEnd
inORWindow = inSession and time < orEndTime

newDay     = dayofmonth(time, sessionTZ) != dayofmonth(time[1], sessionTZ)
newSession = inORWindow and (not inORWindow[1] or newDay)

//Opening range calculations
var float rangeHigh = na
var float rangeLow = na
var bool rangeLocked = false
var int tradesToday = 0
var box orBox = na

if newSession
    rangeHigh:=high
    rangeLow:=low
    rangeLocked:=false
    tradesToday:=0

if inORWindow and not rangeLocked
    rangeHigh := math.max(rangeHigh,high)
    rangeLow := math.min(rangeLow,low)

//Lock range if in session, after OR window
if inSession and not inORWindow and not rangeLocked and not na(rangeHigh)
    rangeLocked:=true

rangeSize = rangeHigh-rangeLow

// ============================================================================
// SUPPORTING INDICATORS
// ============================================================================

// Manual, session-anchored VWAP — built entirely off our own `newSession`
// flag rather than ta.vwap()'s internal reset behavior, which is anchored
// to Pine's own notion of "new day" for the symbol and can misalign badly
// on 24/7 assets like crypto.
var float cumPV = na
var float cumVol = na

if newSession
    cumPV := 0.0
    cumVol := 0.0

if inSession
    cumPV += (high + low + close) / 3 * volume
    cumVol += volume

sessionVwap = cumVol > 0 ? cumPV / cumVol : na

atrVal = ta.atr(atrLen)
avgVol = ta.sma(volume,volLookback)

//Filters
rangeSizeOK = not useRangeSize or (rangeLocked and not na(atrVal) and rangeSize >= atrVal*minRangeATRMult and rangeSize<=atrVal*maxRangeATRMult)

volumeOK = not useVolume or (volume>=avgVol*volMult)

vwapOKLong = not useVWAP or (not na(sessionVwap) and close>sessionVwap)
vwapOKShort = not useVWAP or (not na(sessionVwap) and close<sessionVwap)

barsAboveRange = ta.barssince(close<=rangeHigh)
barsBelowRange = ta.barssince(close>=rangeLow)
confirmedLong = not useFalseBO or (barsAboveRange>=confirmBars)
confirmedShort = not useFalseBO or (barsBelowRange>=confirmBars)

tradesLeft = tradesToday < maxTradesPerDay

//Entry
longCondition = rangeLocked and rangeSizeOK and volumeOK and vwapOKLong and confirmedLong and inSession and tradesLeft and close>rangeHigh
shortCondition = rangeLocked and rangeSizeOK and volumeOK and vwapOKShort and confirmedShort and inSession and tradesLeft and close<rangeLow

doLong = longCondition and tradesLeft
doShort = shortCondition and not tradesLeft

//Target calculations
longStop = stopMode == "Range" ? rangeLow: close - atrVal * atrStopMult
shortStop = stopMode == "Range" ? rangeHigh: close + atrVal * atrStopMult

longRisk = close - longStop
shortRisk = shortStop - close

longTarget = close + longRisk * targetRR
shortTarget = close - shortRisk * targetRR

longPartialPrice = close + longRisk * partialAtr
shortPartialPrice = close - shortRisk * partialAtr

// ============================================================================
// POSITION SIZING
// ============================================================================
riskAmount = strategy.equity * (riskPctPerTrade / 100)
maxPositionValue = strategy.equity * (maxPositionPct / 100)
flatPositionValue = strategy.equity * (flatEquityPct / 100)

longQtyByRisk  = (not na(longRisk)  and longRisk  > 0) ? riskAmount / longRisk  : na
shortQtyByRisk = (not na(shortRisk) and shortRisk > 0) ? riskAmount / shortRisk : na

longQtyCap  = (not na(close) and close > 0) ? maxPositionValue / close : na
shortQtyCap = (not na(close) and close > 0) ? maxPositionValue / close : na

longQtyFlat  = (not na(close) and close > 0) ? flatPositionValue / close : na
shortQtyFlat = (not na(close) and close > 0) ? flatPositionValue / close : na

longQtyRaw  = useRiskSizing ? math.min(longQtyByRisk, longQtyCap)   : longQtyFlat
shortQtyRaw = useRiskSizing ? math.min(shortQtyByRisk, shortQtyCap) : shortQtyFlat

longQty  = na(longQtyRaw)  or longQtyRaw  <= 0 ? 0 : math.floor(longQtyRaw)
shortQty = na(shortQtyRaw) or shortQtyRaw <= 0 ? 0 : math.floor(shortQtyRaw)

//Execution orders
if doLong and longQty > 0
    strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long, qty=longQty)
    
    tradesToday+=1

if doShort and shortQty > 0
    strategy.entry("Short",strategy.short, qty=shortQty)
    
    tradesToday+=1

//Partial exit and breakeven (long)
var float longEntryPrice = na
var bool longPartialDone = false

if strategy.position_size>0 and strategy.position_size[1]<=0
    longEntryPrice:=close
    longPartialDone:=false

if strategy.position_size>0 and not longPartialDone and high>= longPartialPrice
    strategy.close("Long",qty_percent = partialPct)
    longPartialDone:=true

longActiveStop = (moveToBreakeven and longPartialDone) ? longEntryPrice : longStop
if strategy.position_size > 0
    strategy.exit("Long exit", "Long", stop = longActiveStop, limit = longTarget)

//Partial exit and breakeven (short)
var float shortEntryPrice = na
var bool  shortPartialDone = false
if strategy.position_size < 0 and strategy.position_size[1] >= 0
    shortEntryPrice := close
    shortPartialDone := false

if strategy.position_size < 0 and not shortPartialDone and low <= shortPartialPrice
    strategy.close("Short", qty_percent=partialPct)
    shortPartialDone := true

shortActiveStop = (moveToBreakeven and shortPartialDone) ? shortEntryPrice : shortStop
if strategy.position_size < 0
    strategy.exit("Short exit", from_entry="Short", stop=shortActiveStop, limit=shortTarget)

// Flat close at end of session (avoid holding scalps overnight)
if not inSession and inSession[1]
    strategy.close_all(comment="Session End")

// ============================================================================
// VISUALS (refined)
// ============================================================================
if newSession
    orBox := box.new(bar_index, na, bar_index, na, border_color = orBoxBorderColor,
                      bgcolor = color.new(color.blue, 85), extend = extend.none)

if inORWindow and not na(orBox)
    sizeRatio = na(atrVal) or atrVal == 0 ? 0 : math.min(rangeSize / (atrVal * 2), 1)
    gradColor = useGradientBox ? color.from_gradient(sizeRatio, 0, 1, color.new(color.teal, 85), color.new(color.orange, 60)) : color.new(color.blue, 85)
    box.set_top(orBox, rangeHigh)
    box.set_bottom(orBox, rangeLow)
    box.set_right(orBox, bar_index)
    box.set_bgcolor(orBox, gradColor)

if showORLabel and rangeLocked and not rangeLocked[1] and not na(atrVal) and atrVal > 0
    label.new(bar_index, rangeHigh, str.tostring(rangeSize / atrVal, "#.##") + "x ATR",
               style = label.style_label_down, color = color.new(color.black, 70),
               textcolor = color.white, size = size.tiny)


plot(rangeLocked ? rangeHigh : na, title = "OR High", color = rangeHighColor, style = plot.style_linebr, linewidth = 2)
plot(rangeLocked ? rangeLow  : na, title = "OR Low",  color = rangeLowColor,  style = plot.style_linebr, linewidth = 2)

plot(showVWAP and inSession ? sessionVwap : na, title = "Session VWAP", color = vwapColor, linewidth = 1)

if showSessSep and newSession and not na(atrVal)
    line.new(bar_index, low - atrVal, bar_index, high + atrVal, color = sepColor,
              style = line.style_dotted, extend = extend.both)

failedLong  = showFailedBO and rangeLocked and close[1] > rangeHigh and close < rangeHigh
failedShort = showFailedBO and rangeLocked and close[1] < rangeLow  and close > rangeLow
plotshape(failedLong,  title = "Failed Long Breakout",  style = shape.xcross,
           location = location.abovebar, color = failedBOColor, size = size.tiny)
plotshape(failedShort, title = "Failed Short Breakout", style = shape.xcross,
           location = location.belowbar, color = failedBOColor, size = size.tiny)

items.title: _CM_Opening-Range_Asia_Europe Sessions
items.author: ChrisMoody
items.source:
//Created by ChrisMoody on 9/03/2014
//Requested by rayhug1 to use ENTIRE Asia Range From 5pm Est to 2am Est To Plot Opening Range of Entire 9 hour session...uses 540 minutes (5pm to 2am Est) to calculate the Range...then breakouts trigger after 2am
//Ability to change Start and End Times to use any entire session.  Defaults to 540 minutes (9 hours)  but Opening Range Calculation can be changed to 1 hour etc. in inputs tab
study("_CM_Opening-Range_Asia_Europe Sessions", overlay=true)

sessNum = input(1, minval=0, maxval=2, title="Session to use (0 = 24 Hours, Other Numbers Listed Below)")
desc = input(false, title="Below---Line Plot Start Times and End Times---1 = Asian Session, 2 = Europe Session")
asian_session = input('1700-1659', type=session, title="1 - Asia Session")
europe_session = input('0200-0159', type=session, title="2 - Europe Session")
//us_session = input('0800-0759', type=session, title="3 - U.S. Session")
pt1 = input(5, minval=1, maxval=15, title="Profit Target 1 - Multiple of Opening Range *.1, 5 = .5, 7 = .7, 10 = 1, 15 = 1.5 etc.")
pt2 = input(10, minval=1, maxval=30, title="Profit Target 2 - Multiple of Opening Range *.1, 10 = 1, 15 = 1.5, 18 = 1.8, etc.")
res = input('540', type=resolution, title="Length Of Opening Range-Defaults to 540 Minutes (9 Hours) Select Drop Down Box To Change?")
snp = input(true, title="Plot 1 and 2 When 1st and 2nd Profit Target are Achieved?")

//Session Selection Rules
sessToUse = sessNum == 1 ? asian_session : sessNum == 2 ? europe_session : '0000-0000'

//Session Rules
bartimeSess = (sessNum == 0 ? time('D') : time('D', sessToUse))
fr2to17 = (sessNum == 0 ? time(period) : time(period, sessToUse)) 
newbarSess = bartimeSess != bartimeSess[1]
high_range = valuewhen(newbarSess,high,0)
low_range = valuewhen(newbarSess,low,0)
adopt(r, s) => security(tickerid, r, s)

//Formula For Opening Range
highRes = adopt(res, high_range)
lowRes = adopt(res, low_range)
range = highRes - lowRes

//Highlighting Line Rules For Opening Range
highColor = high > highRes ? lime : yellow
lowColor = low < lowRes ? red : yellow

//Plot Statements For Opening Range Lines
openRangeHigh = plot(fr2to17 > 0 ? highRes : na, color=highColor, style=circles, linewidth=4)
openRangeLow = plot(fr2to17 > 0 ? lowRes : na, color=lowColor, style=circles, linewidth=4)
bgcolor(fr2to17 > 0 ? silver : na, transp=85)
fill(openRangeHigh, openRangeLow, color=silver, transp=70, title="Opening Range Fill")

//Formula For Profit Target 1
pft1 = pt1*.1
highRes2 = highRes+range*pft1
lowRes2 = lowRes-range*pft1

//Highlighting Line rules for Profit Target 1
highColor2 = high > highRes2 ? lime : fuchsia
lowColor2 = low < lowRes2 ? lime : fuchsia

//Plots For Profit Target 1
p1=plot(fr2to17 > 0 ? highRes2 : na, color=highColor2, style=circles, linewidth=4)
p2=plot(fr2to17 > 0 ? lowRes2 : na, color=lowColor2, style=circles, linewidth=4)

//Formula For Profit Target 2
pft2 = pt2*.1
highRes3 = highRes+range*pft2
lowRes3 = lowRes-range*pft2

//Highlighting Line rules for Profit Target 2
highColor3 = high > highRes3 ? lime : aqua
lowColor3 = low < lowRes3 ? lime : aqua

//Plots For Profit Targe 2
plot(fr2to17 > 0 ? highRes3 : na, color=highColor3, style=circles, linewidth=4)
plot(fr2to17 > 0 ? lowRes3 : na, color=lowColor3, style=circles, linewidth=4)

//Rules for when to plot Numbers 1 or 2 When Profit Target 1 or 2 is Reached
pt1UHit = (high >= highRes2  and high[1] < highRes2 and high[2] < highRes2 and high[3] < highRes2 and high[4] < highRes2 and high[5] < highRes2) and fr2to17 > 0 
pt1LHit = (low <= lowRes2  and low[1] > lowRes2 and low[2] > lowRes2 and low[3] > lowRes2 and low[4] > lowRes2 and low[5] > lowRes2) and low > lowRes3 and fr2to17 > 0
pt2UHit = (high >= highRes3  and high[1] < highRes3 and high[2] < highRes3 and high[3] < highRes3 and high[4] < highRes3 and high[5] < highRes3) and fr2to17 > 0 
pt2LHit = (low <= lowRes3  and low[1] > lowRes3 and low[2] > lowRes3 and low[3] > lowRes3 and low[4] > lowRes3 and low[5] > lowRes3) and fr2to17 > 0

//Rules for plotting 1 or 2 When Profit Target 1 or 2 is Reached
plotchar(snp and pt1UHit ? pt1UHit : na, title='UpSide Profit Target 1 Achieved', char='1', location=location.abovebar, color=white, transp=0, offset=0)
plotchar(snp and pt1LHit ? pt1LHit : na, title='DownSide Profit Target 1 Achieved', char='1', location=location.belowbar, color=white, transp=0, offset=0)
plotchar(snp and pt2UHit ? pt2UHit : na, title='UpSide Profit Target 2 Achieved', char='2', location=location.abovebar, color=white, transp=0, offset=0)
plotchar(snp and pt2LHit ? pt2LHit : na, title='DownSide Profit Target 2 Achieved', char='2', location=location.belowbar, color=white, transp=0, offset=0)

items.source:
//@version=4
study("Michigandolf's 30min Opening Range", shorttitle="Michigandolf's OR", overlay = true)

input_or = input("0930-1000", type=input.session, title="Opening Range Time (EST)", tooltip="The duration of the opening range to be drawn.")

// Inputs
input_rth = input("0930-1600", type=input.session, title="Regular Session Time (EST)", tooltip="If you want to get full session (including overnight) high/low values, then change the regular session interval.  For example, on a 5-mninute chart, 1800-1655 will provide the high and low for the full daily session.")
or_session = time(timeframe.period,str.format("{0}:1234567", input_or), "America/New_York")
rth_session = time("1440",str.format("{0}:23456", input_rth), "America/New_York")

// Opening Range
var or_high = 0.0
var or_low = 0.0


if or_session
    if not or_session[1]
        or_low := low
        or_high := high
    else
        or_low := min(low, or_low)
        or_high := max(high, or_high)
        
        
or_mid = or_low + ((or_high - or_low) / 2)



// RTH High/Low

var float rth_high = na
var float rth_low = na 
var float prior_rth_high = na
var float prior_rth_low = na

if rth_session
    if not rth_session[1]
        rth_low := low
        rth_high := high
    else
        rth_low := min(low, rth_low)
        rth_high := max(high, rth_high)
else 
    prior_rth_low := rth_low
    prior_rth_high := rth_high


// Plots

or_high_plot = plot(not or_session ? or_high : na, title="ORH", color=#268FFF, linewidth=2, style=plot.style_linebr)
or_low_plot = plot(not or_session ? or_low : na, title="ORL", color=#FF217E, linewidth=2, style=plot.style_linebr)


plot(not or_session ? or_mid : na, title="ORM", color=#FFFFFF, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)

fill(or_high_plot, or_low_plot, title="OR Fill", color=color.new(color.white, 97))


plot(not rth_session ? rth_high : prior_rth_high, title="RTH", color=#1BE091, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_line)
plot(not rth_session ? rth_low : prior_rth_low, title="RTL", color=#E02B16, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_line)
