items.source:
// Original Code:  © asenski at gmail dot com
// Modded DeuceDavis (TheTradingHawk)
//@version=5
indicator("Opening Range with Fibs", "OR Fibs", overlay=true)

orSpec = input.session("0930-1000", "Opening Range with Fib Extensions")
refsym = input.symbol("SPX500USD", "Reference for time range (So that it is in EST)")

tradeEntrySession = input.session("1000-1130", "Trade Entry Times")
showPrior = input.bool(true, "Show Prior Boxes")

rgColor = input.color(color.rgb(255, 255, 0), "Range color")
L1Color = input.color(color.rgb(0, 0, 255), "L1 color")
L2Color = input.color(color.rgb(255, 115, 40), "L2 color")
L3Color = input.color(color.rgb(255, 0, 255), "L3 color")

L1 = input.float(1.272, "L1")
L2 = input.float(1.618, "L2")
L3 = input.float(2.618, "L3")

t = request.security(refsym, timeframe.period, time(timeframe.period, orSpec), gaps=barmerge.gaps_on)
z = request.security(refsym, timeframe.period, time(timeframe.period, tradeEntrySession), gaps=barmerge.gaps_on)

var float orh = na
var float orl = na
var int orbars = 0

var float extL1up = na
var float extL2up = na
var float extL3up = na
var float extL1dn = na
var float extL2dn = na
var float extL3dn = na
var float midPoint = na
var float tpValue = na
var float slValue = na
var bool longTrigger = false
var bool shortTrigger = false
var float entryValue = na
var float exitValue = na
var int longStops = 0
var int shortStops = 0
var int longWins = 0
var int shortWins = 0
var bool noTradeYet = true
var float maxProfit = 0.00


newSession = na(t[1]) and not na(t)
inSession = not na(t[1]) and not na(t)
endSession = not na(t[1]) and na(t)

inSessionToEnterTrade = not na(z[1]) and not na(z)

if newSession
    orh := high
    orl := low
    orbars := 0
    extL1up := na
    extL2up := na
    extL3up := na
    extL1dn := na
    extL2dn := na
    extL3dn := na
    midPoint := na
    tpValue := na
    slValue := na
    entryValue := na
    maxProfit := 0.0
    longTrigger := false
    shortTrigger := false
    noTradeYet := true

if inSession
    orh := math.max(high, orh)
    orl := math.min(low, orl)
    orbars += 1

var float vwapsum = na
var float volumesum = na

if endSession
    extL1up := orl + (orh - orl) * L1
    extL2up := orl + (orh - orl) * L2
    extL3up := orl + (orh - orl) * L3

    extL1dn := orh - (orh - orl) * L1
    extL2dn := orh - (orh - orl) * L2
    extL3dn := orh - (orh - orl) * L3

    tpValue := (extL1up + extL1dn)/2

    b1 = box.new(bar_index - orbars - 1, orh, bar_index - 1, orl, border_color = rgColor, bgcolor = color.new(color.gray, 50))
    b2 = box.new(bar_index - orbars - 1, extL1up, bar_index - 1, extL2up, border_color = rgColor, bgcolor = color.new(color.red, 50))
    b3 = box.new(bar_index - orbars - 1, extL1dn, bar_index - 1, extL2dn, border_color = rgColor, bgcolor = color.new(color.green, 50))
    if barstate.islast
        box.delete(b1[1])
        box.delete(b2[1])
        box.delete(b3[1])

if (not inSession) and (not longTrigger) and not (shortTrigger) and inSessionToEnterTrade and noTradeYet
    longTrigger := low <= extL1dn
    slValue := extL1dn - (extL1up - tpValue)
    entryValue := extL1dn

if (not inSession) and (not shortTrigger) and (not longTrigger) and inSessionToEnterTrade and noTradeYet
    shortTrigger := high >= extL1up
    slValue := extL1up + (extL1up - tpValue)
    entryValue := extL1up

if longTrigger
    longTrigger := high >= tpValue ? false :
         low <= slValue ? false : true
    exitValue := high >= tpValue ? tpValue :
         low <= slValue ? slValue : close
    var stoppedOut = false
    var profitOut = false
    stoppedOut := low <= slValue
    profitOut := high >= tpValue
    longWins := profitOut ? longWins + 1 : longWins
    longStops := stoppedOut ? longStops + 1 : longStops
    noTradeYet := false



if shortTrigger
    shortTrigger := low <= tpValue ? false :
         high >= slValue ? false : true
    exitValue := low <= tpValue ? tpValue :
         high >= slValue ? slValue : close
    var stoppedOut = false
    var profitOut = false
    stoppedOut := high >= slValue
    profitOut := low <= tpValue
    shortWins := profitOut ? shortWins + 1 : shortWins
    shortStops := stoppedOut ? shortStops + 1 : shortStops
    noTradeYet := false


profitTrigger = (shortWins + longWins) > (shortWins[1] + longWins[1])
stopTrigger = (shortStops + longStops) > (shortStops[1] + longStops[1])      
colorForExit = profitTrigger ? color.new(color.green, 50) :
     stopTrigger ? color.new(color.red, 50) : na

//bgcolor(colorForExit)

plot((not inSession) and longTrigger ? slValue : na, "Stop Loss", color=color.red, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot((not inSession) and longTrigger ? tpValue : na, "Take Profit", color=color.green, style=plot.style_linebr)

plot((not inSession) and shortTrigger ? slValue : na, "Stop Loss", color=color.red, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot((not inSession) and shortTrigger ? tpValue : na, "Take Profit", color=color.green, style=plot.style_linebr)

plot((not inSession) and (shortTrigger or longTrigger) ? exitValue : na, "Exit Value", color=color.yellow, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot((not inSession) and (shortTrigger or longTrigger) ? entryValue : na, "Entry Value", color=color.purple, style=plot.style_linebr)


inTrade = (not inSession) and (shortTrigger or longTrigger) 

var float minLowSinceTrade = na
var float maxHiSinceTrade = na
var float closeSinceTrade = na
if not inTrade
    minLowSinceTrade := na
    maxHiSinceTrade := na
    closeSinceTrade := na

if inTrade
    minLowSinceTrade := na(minLowSinceTrade) ? low : math.min(minLowSinceTrade, low)
    maxHiSinceTrade := na(maxHiSinceTrade) ? high : math.max(maxHiSinceTrade, high)
    closeSinceTrade := close

plot(minLowSinceTrade, "Lowest Low Since Trade", color=color.new(color.blue, 100))
plot(maxHiSinceTrade, "Highest High Since Trade", color=color.new(color.blue, 100))
plot(closeSinceTrade, "Close Since Trade", color=color.new(color.blue, 100))

//plot(newSession ? na : orh, "OR high", color=rgColor,style=plot.style_linebr)
//plot(newSession ? na : orl, "OR low", color=rgColor,style=plot.style_linebr)
highExt3 = plot(newSession ? na : extL3up, "L3 above", color=L3Color, style=plot.style_linebr)
highExt2 = plot(newSession ? na : extL2up, "L2 above", color=L2Color, style=plot.style_linebr)
highExt1 = plot(newSession ? na : extL1up, "L1 above", color=L1Color, style=plot.style_linebr)

orhPlot = plot(newSession ? na : orh, "ORH", color=color.red, style=plot.style_linebr)

plot(tpValue, title="OR Midpoint (Target)", color=color.new(color.purple, 0), style=plot.style_cross, linewidth=1)
orlPlot = plot(newSession ? na : orl, "ORL", color=color.green, style=plot.style_linebr)
lowExt1 = plot(newSession ? na : extL1dn, "L1 below", color=L1Color, style=plot.style_linebr)
lowExt2 = plot(newSession ? na : extL2dn, "L2 below", color=L2Color, style=plot.style_linebr)
lowExt3 = plot(newSession ? na : extL3dn, "L3 below", color=L3Color, style=plot.style_linebr)
//plot(newSession ? na : extL3dn, "L3 below", color=L3Color, style=plot.style_linebr)

fill(highExt1, highExt2, color=inSessionToEnterTrade ? color.new(color.red, 50) : na, title="Put Zone")
fill(lowExt1, lowExt2, color=inSessionToEnterTrade ? color.new(color.green, 50) : na, title="Call Zone")


//alerts
extL1upTouched = ta.crossover(high, extL1up) and inSessionToEnterTrade
extL2upTouched = ta.crossover(high, extL2up) and inSessionToEnterTrade
extL3upTouched = ta.crossover(high, extL3up) and inSessionToEnterTrade

extL1dnTouched = ta.crossunder(low, extL1dn) and inSessionToEnterTrade
extL2dnTouched = ta.crossunder(low, extL2dn) and inSessionToEnterTrade
extL3dnTouched = ta.crossunder(low, extL3dn) and inSessionToEnterTrade

if extL1upTouched
    alert("Opening Range Upper Fib 1 Touched - Short Opportunity 1 " + syminfo.ticker, alert.freq_once_per_bar)
if extL2upTouched
    alert("Opening Range Upper Fib 2 Touched - Short Opportunity 2 " + syminfo.ticker, alert.freq_once_per_bar)
if extL3upTouched
    alert("Opening Range Upper Fib 3 Touched - Short Opportunity 3 " + syminfo.ticker, alert.freq_once_per_bar)
if extL1dnTouched
    alert("Opening Range Lower Fib 1 Touched - Long Opportunity 1 " + syminfo.ticker, alert.freq_once_per_bar)
if extL2dnTouched
    alert("Opening Range Lower Fib 2 Touched - Long Opportunity 2 " + syminfo.ticker, alert.freq_once_per_bar)
if extL3dnTouched
    alert("Opening Range Lower Fib 3 Touched - Long Opportunity 3 " + syminfo.ticker, alert.freq_once_per_bar)

plot(show_mid and timeframe.isintraday ? IB_mid : na, style=plot.style_cross, color= IB_in_session[1] or IB_in_session ? na : IB_line_col(IB_mid), title='IB Low', linewidth=1)

plotshape(timeframe.isintraday ? IB_h : na,style=shape.labelup, location=location.absolute, color=na, textcolor=IB_in_session[1] or IB_in_session ? na : IB_line_col(IB_h),text="IB High", offset = IB_pos, show_last = 1)
plotshape(timeframe.isintraday ? IB_l : na,style=shape.labelup, location=location.absolute, color=na, textcolor=IB_in_session[1] or IB_in_session ? na : IB_line_col(IB_l),text="IB Low", offset = IB_pos, show_last = 1)
plotshape(show_mid and timeframe.isintraday ? IB_mid : na,style=shape.labelup, location=location.absolute, color=na, textcolor=IB_in_session[1] or IB_in_session ? na : IB_line_col(IB_mid),text="IB Mid", offset = IB_pos, show_last = 1)

     options=["New York RTH (9.30am - 4pm)", "New York Futures (8am - 5pm)",

lineWidth   = input.int(1, ' / Width ', 1, 10, inline="Line", group="Opening bar format")

// MODIFICATION 2: Bullish/Bearish Colors
bullish_color = input.color(color.rgb(0, 255, 149), "Bullish Color : ", inline="Color", group="Opening bar format")
bearish_color = input.color(color.rgb(195, 0, 255), "Bearish Color : ", inline="Color2", group="Opening bar format")
bullish_fill = input.color(color.rgb(0, 255, 149, 85), "Bullish Fill : ", inline="Fill", group="Opening bar format")
bearish_fill = input.color(color.rgb(195, 0, 255, 85), "Bearish Fill : ", inline="Fill2", group="Opening bar format")

// Inputs for statistical levels
lookback        = input.int(60, "Lookback Periods for Stats", minval=1, group="Statistical Levels")
show_stats      = input.bool(false, "Show Statistical Levels", group="Statistical Levels")
show_stats_labels = input.bool(false, "Show Statistical Labels", group="Statistical Levels")
std_mult1       = input.float(1.0, "Std Dev Multiplier 1", minval=0, step=0.5, group="Statistical Levels")
std_mult2       = input.float(2.0, "Std Dev Multiplier 2", minval=0, step=0.5, group="Statistical Levels")
stats_line_color = input.color(color.purple, "Stats Line Color", group="Statistical Levels")
stats_line_width = input.int(1, "Stats Line Width", minval=1, maxval=10, group="Statistical Levels")
stats_label_color = input.color(color.purple, "Stats Label Color", group="Statistical Levels")
stats_label_size = input.string("Normal", "Stats Label Size", options=["Tiny", "Small", "Normal", "Large", "Huge"], group="Statistical Levels")

// MODIFICATION 3: Range Extensions (replacing Fibonacci)
show_range_ext      = input.bool(false, title="Show Range Extensions", group="Range Extensions")
range_multiplier    = input.float(1.0, title="Range Multiplier", minval=0.1, step=0.1, group="Range Extensions", tooltip="Multiplier for range extensions (e.g., 1.0 = full range, 0.5 = half range)")
num_levels          = input.int(5, title="Number of Levels", minval=1, maxval=20, group="Range Extensions", tooltip="Number of extension levels above and below the range")
show_range_labels   = input.bool(false, title="Show Range Extension Labels", group="Range Extensions")
range_line_color    = input.color(color.teal, "Range Line Color", group="Range Extensions")
range_line_width    = input.int(1, "Range Line Width", minval=1, maxval=10, group="Range Extensions")
range_label_color   = input.color(color.teal, "Range Label Color", group="Range Extensions")
range_label_size    = input.string("Normal", "Range Label Size", options=["Tiny", "Small", "Normal", "Large", "Huge"], group="Range Extensions")

// Inputs for OR Rotations
show_rotations      = input.bool(true, title="Show OR Rotations", group="OR Rotations")
rotation_increment  = input.float(65.0, title="Rotation Increment (Points)", minval=0.01, step=0.25, group="OR Rotations", tooltip="Point increment for each rotation level (e.g., 65 for NQ, 15 for ES)")
show_rotation_labels = input.bool(true, title="Show Rotation Labels", group="OR Rotations")
rotation_line_color = input.color(color.gray, "Rotation Line Color", group="OR Rotations")
rotation_line_style = input.string("Dotted", "Line Style", options=["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], group="OR Rotations")
rotation_line_width = input.int(1, "Rotation Line Width", minval=1, maxval=10, group="OR Rotations")
rotation_label_color = input.color(color.gray, "Rotation Label Color", group="OR Rotations")
rotation_label_size = input.string("Small", "Rotation Label Size", options=["Tiny", "Small", "Normal", "Large", "Huge"], group="OR Rotations")

//-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Functions / Calculations
//-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
get_style(style) =>
    switch style
        "──────"        => line.style_solid
        "─ ─ ─ ─"       => line.style_dashed
        "· · · · · ·"   => line.style_dotted
        "Solid"         => line.style_solid
        "Dashed"        => line.style_dashed
        "Dotted"        => line.style_dotted

get_label_size(size) =>
    switch size
        "Tiny"   => size.tiny
        "Small"  => size.small
        "Normal" => size.normal
        "Large"  => size.large
        "Huge"   => size.huge

// Determine session time based on selection
var string session_time = ""
switch session_choice
    "New York RTH (9.30am - 4pm)" =>
        session_time := "0930-1600"
    "New York Futures (8am - 5pm)" =>
        session_time := "0800-1700"
    "London (2am - 8am)" =>
        session_time := "0200-0800"
    "Asia (7pm - 2am)" =>
        session_time := "1900-0200"
    "Midnight to 5pm" =>
        session_time := "0000-1700"
    "ZB/Gold/Silver OR (8.20am - 4pm)" =>
        session_time := "0820-1600"
    "CL OR (9am - 4pm)" =>
        session_time := "0900-1600"
    "Custom" =>
        session_time := custom_session_start + "-" + custom_session_end

// Session Detection
is_in_session = not na(time(timeframe.period, session_time, time_zone))
is_session_start = is_in_session and not is_in_session[1]

// Get high, low, mid from the selected timeframe  
[H, L, M] = request.security(ticker.standard(syminfo.tickerid), timeframe, [high, low, hl2], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)

// MODIFICATION 2: Get open and close for bullish/bearish determination
[O, C] = request.security(ticker.standard(syminfo.tickerid), timeframe, [open, close], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)

_style = pos == "Left" ? label.style_label_right : label.style_label_left

// Arrays to store drawing objects for better management
var line_array = array.new<line>()
var label_array = array.new<label>()
var linefill_array = array.new<linefill>()

// Store current session's drawing objects
var line current_top_line = na
var line current_bot_line = na
var line current_mid_line = na
var linefill current_fill = na
var label current_high_label = na
var label current_low_label = na
var label current_mid_label = na

// Store opening range values for current session
var float session_or_high = na
var float session_or_low = na
var float session_or_mid = na
var float session_or_open = na
var float session_or_close = na
var int session_start_bar = na
var bool or_captured = false

// Store current session's stat lines
var line current_stat1_up = na
var line current_stat1_dn = na
var line current_stat2_up = na
var line current_stat2_dn = na
var label current_stat1_up_label = na
var label current_stat1_dn_label = na
var label current_stat2_up_label = na
var label current_stat2_dn_label = na

// MODIFICATION 3: Store range extension lines dynamically
var array<line> current_range_lines_up = array.new<line>()
var array<line> current_range_lines_dn = array.new<line>()
var array<label> current_range_labels_up = array.new<label>()
var array<label> current_range_labels_dn = array.new<label>()

// Store current session's rotation lines
var line current_rot1_up = na
var line current_rot2_up = na
var line current_rot3_up = na
var line current_rot4_up = na
var line current_rot5_up = na
var line current_rot1_dn = na
var line current_rot2_dn = na
var line current_rot3_dn = na
var line current_rot4_dn = na
var line current_rot5_dn = na
var label current_rot1_up_label = na
var label current_rot2_up_label = na
var label current_rot3_up_label = na
var label current_rot4_up_label = na
var label current_rot5_up_label = na
var label current_rot1_dn_label = na
var label current_rot2_dn_label = na
var label current_rot3_dn_label = na
var label current_rot4_dn_label = na
var label current_rot5_dn_label = na

// Calculate statistical levels based on past ranges
var float[] range_array = array.new_float(0)

// Function to manage array size
manage_array_size(arr, max_size) =>
    while array.size(arr) > max_size
        old_element = array.shift(arr)
        line.delete(old_element)

manage_label_array_size(arr, max_size) =>
    while array.size(arr) > max_size
        old_element = array.shift(arr)
        label.delete(old_element)

manage_linefill_array_size(arr, max_size) =>
    while array.size(arr) > max_size
        old_element = array.shift(arr)
        linefill.delete(old_element)

//-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Outputs
//-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Mark session start and capture OR values immediately
if is_session_start and not na(H) and not na(L)
    session_start_bar := bar_index
    or_captured := false
    session_or_high := H
    session_or_low := L
    session_or_mid := M
    session_or_open := O
    session_or_close := C
    or_captured := true
    // Reset drawing objects for new session
    current_top_line := na
    current_bot_line := na
    current_mid_line := na
    current_fill := na
    current_high_label := na
    current_low_label := na
    current_mid_label := na

// Draw elements once opening range is captured
if or_captured and not na(session_or_high) and not na(session_or_low) and na(current_top_line)
    // MODIFICATION 2: Determine if bullish or bearish
    is_bullish = session_or_close >= session_or_open
    _color = is_bullish ? bullish_color : bearish_color
    _fillcolor = is_bullish ? bullish_fill : bearish_fill
    
    // Store the range from first bar for statistics
    array.push(range_array, session_or_high - session_or_low)
    if array.size(range_array) > lookback
        array.shift(range_array)
    
    // Calculate statistical levels
    avg_range = array.avg(range_array)
    std_dev = array.stdev(range_array)
    stat_level1_up = session_or_high + avg_range + std_dev * std_mult1
    stat_level1_dn = session_or_low - (avg_range + std_dev * std_mult1)
    stat_level2_up = session_or_high + avg_range + std_dev * std_mult2
    stat_level2_dn = session_or_low - (avg_range + std_dev * std_mult2)
    
    // MODIFICATION 3: Calculate Range Extension levels
    _range = session_or_high - session_or_low
    range_increment = _range * range_multiplier
    
    // Calculate rotation levels (fixed point increments)
    rot1_up = session_or_high + rotation_increment
    rot2_up = session_or_high + (rotation_increment * 2)
    rot3_up = session_or_high + (rotation_increment * 3)
    rot4_up = session_or_high + (rotation_increment * 4)
    rot5_up = session_or_high + (rotation_increment * 5)
    rot1_dn = session_or_low - rotation_increment
    rot2_dn = session_or_low - (rotation_increment * 2)
    rot3_dn = session_or_low - (rotation_increment * 3)
    rot4_dn = session_or_low - (rotation_increment * 4)
    rot5_dn = session_or_low - (rotation_increment * 5)
    
    // Calculate how many objects we'll create per session
    rotation_count = show_rotations ? 10 : 0
    rotation_label_count = (show_rotations and show_rotation_labels) ? 10 : 0
    range_ext_count = show_range_ext ? (num_levels * 2) : 0
    range_ext_label_count = (show_range_ext and show_range_labels) ? (num_levels * 2) : 0
    
    objects_per_session = 2 + (midLine ? 1 : 0) + (show_stats ? 4 : 0) + range_ext_count + rotation_count
    labels_per_session = (showL ? (2 + (midLine ? 1 : 0)) : 0) + (show_stats_labels ? 4 : 0) + range_ext_label_count + rotation_label_count
    
    // Adjust max_history based on object count to stay within limits
    adjusted_max_history = math.max(1, math.min(max_history, math.floor(450 / math.max(objects_per_session, 1))))
    adjusted_max_labels = math.max(1, math.min(max_history, math.floor(450 / math.max(labels_per_session, 1))))
    
    // Draw high, low, and midline - start at session start
    current_top_line := line.new(session_start_bar, session_or_high, session_start_bar + projection_offset, session_or_high, color=_color, style=get_style(boxStyle), width=borderWidth)
    current_bot_line := line.new(session_start_bar, session_or_low, session_start_bar + projection_offset, session_or_low, color=_color, style=get_style(boxStyle), width=borderWidth)
    current_fill := linefill.new(current_top_line, current_bot_line, _fillcolor)
    
    array.push(line_array, current_top_line)
    array.push(line_array, current_bot_line)
    array.push(linefill_array, current_fill)
    
    if midLine
        current_mid_line := line.new(session_start_bar, session_or_mid, session_start_bar + projection_offset, session_or_mid, color=_color, style=get_style(lineStyle), width=lineWidth)
        array.push(line_array, current_mid_line)
    
    x = pos == "Left" ? session_start_bar : session_start_bar + projection_offset
    
    if showL
        current_high_label := label.new(x, session_or_high, "High" + (showP ? " (" + str.tostring(session_or_high, format.mintick) + ")" : ""), style=_style, color=color.new(_color, 100), textcolor=_color, size=get_label_size("Normal"))
        current_low_label := label.new(x, session_or_low, "Low" + (showP ? " (" + str.tostring(session_or_low, format.mintick) + ")" : ""), style=_style, color=color.new(_color, 100), textcolor=_color, size=get_label_size("Normal"))
        array.push(label_array, current_high_label)
        array.push(label_array, current_low_label)
        if midLine
            current_mid_label := label.new(x, session_or_mid, "Mid" + (showP ? " (" + str.tostring(session_or_mid, format.mintick) + ")" : ""), style=_style, color=color.new(_color, 100), textcolor=_color, size=get_label_size("Normal"))
            array.push(label_array, current_mid_label)
    
    // MODIFICATION 3: Draw Range Extensions dynamically
    if show_range_ext and range_increment > 0
        // Clear previous session's range extension arrays
        array.clear(current_range_lines_up)
        array.clear(current_range_lines_dn)
        array.clear(current_range_labels_up)
        array.clear(current_range_labels_dn)
        
        // Create range extension lines above
        for i = 1 to num_levels
            level_price = session_or_high + (range_increment * i)
            new_line = line.new(session_start_bar, level_price, session_start_bar + projection_offset, level_price, color=range_line_color, width=range_line_width)
            array.push(current_range_lines_up, new_line)
            array.push(line_array, new_line)
            
            if show_range_labels
                label_text = "R+" + str.tostring(i) + " (" + str.tostring(range_increment * i, format.mintick) + ")"
                new_label = label.new(x, level_price, label_text, style=_style, color=color.new(range_label_color, 100), textcolor=range_label_color, size=get_label_size(range_label_size))
                array.push(current_range_labels_up, new_label)
                array.push(label_array, new_label)
        
        // Create range extension lines below
        for i = 1 to num_levels
            level_price = session_or_low - (range_increment * i)
            new_line = line.new(session_start_bar, level_price, session_start_bar + projection_offset, level_price, color=range_line_color, width=range_line_width)
            array.push(current_range_lines_dn, new_line)
            array.push(line_array, new_line)
            
            if show_range_labels
                label_text = "R-" + str.tostring(i) + " (" + str.tostring(range_increment * i, format.mintick) + ")"
                new_label = label.new(x, level_price, label_text, style=_style, color=color.new(range_label_color, 100), textcolor=range_label_color, size=get_label_size(range_label_size))
                array.push(current_range_labels_dn, new_label)
                array.push(label_array, new_label)
    
    // Draw statistical levels
    if show_stats and not na(avg_range) and not na(std_dev)
        current_stat1_up := line.new(session_start_bar, stat_level1_up, session_start_bar + projection_offset, stat_level1_up, color=stats_line_color, style=line.style_dashed, width=stats_line_width)
        current_stat1_dn := line.new(session_start_bar, stat_level1_dn, session_start_bar + projection_offset, stat_level1_dn, color=stats_line_color, style=line.style_dashed, width=stats_line_width)
        current_stat2_up := line.new(session_start_bar, stat_level2_up, session_start_bar + projection_offset, stat_level2_up, color=stats_line_color, style=line.style_dotted, width=stats_line_width)
        current_stat2_dn := line.new(session_start_bar, stat_level2_dn, session_start_bar + projection_offset, stat_level2_dn, color=stats_line_color, style=line.style_dotted, width=stats_line_width)
        
        array.push(line_array, current_stat1_up)
        array.push(line_array, current_stat1_dn)
        array.push(line_array, current_stat2_up)
        array.push(line_array, current_stat2_dn)
        
        if show_stats_labels
            current_stat1_up_label := label.new(x, stat_level1_up, "+" + str.tostring(std_mult1) + "σ", style=_style, color=color.new(stats_label_color, 100), textcolor=stats_label_color, size=get_label_size(stats_label_size))
            current_stat1_dn_label := label.new(x, stat_level1_dn, "-" + str.tostring(std_mult1) + "σ", style=_style, color=color.new(stats_label_color, 100), textcolor=stats_label_color, size=get_label_size(stats_label_size))
            current_stat2_up_label := label.new(x, stat_level2_up, "+" + str.tostring(std_mult2) + "σ", style=_style, color=color.new(stats_label_color, 100), textcolor=stats_label_color, size=get_label_size(stats_label_size))
            current_stat2_dn_label := label.new(x, stat_level2_dn, "-" + str.tostring(std_mult2) + "σ", style=_style, color=color.new(stats_label_color, 100), textcolor=stats_label_color, size=get_label_size(stats_label_size))
            
            array.push(label_array, current_stat1_up_label)
            array.push(label_array, current_stat1_dn_label)
            array.push(label_array, current_stat2_up_label)
            array.push(label_array, current_stat2_dn_label)
    
    // Draw OR Rotation levels
    if show_rotations and rotation_increment > 0
        current_rot1_up := line.new(session_start_bar, rot1_up, session_start_bar + projection_offset, rot1_up, color=rotation_line_color, style=get_style(rotation_line_style), width=rotation_line_width)
        current_rot2_up := line.new(session_start_bar, rot2_up, session_start_bar + projection_offset, rot2_up, color=rotation_line_color, style=get_style(rotation_line_style), width=rotation_line_width)
        current_rot3_up := line.new(session_start_bar, rot3_up, session_start_bar + projection_offset, rot3_up, color=rotation_line_color, style=get_style(rotation_line_style), width=rotation_line_width)
        current_rot4_up := line.new(session_start_bar, rot4_up, session_start_bar + projection_offset, rot4_up, color=rotation_line_color, style=get_style(rotation_line_style), width=rotation_line_width)
        current_rot5_up := line.new(session_start_bar, rot5_up, session_start_bar + projection_offset, rot5_up, color=rotation_line_color, style=get_style(rotation_line_style), width=rotation_line_width)
        current_rot1_dn := line.new(session_start_bar, rot1_dn, session_start_bar + projection_offset, rot1_dn, color=rotation_line_color, style=get_style(rotation_line_style), width=rotation_line_width)
        current_rot2_dn := line.new(session_start_bar, rot2_dn, session_start_bar + projection_offset, rot2_dn, color=rotation_line_color, style=get_style(rotation_line_style), width=rotation_line_width)
        current_rot3_dn := line.new(session_start_bar, rot3_dn, session_start_bar + projection_offset, rot3_dn, color=rotation_line_color, style=get_style(rotation_line_style), width=rotation_line_width)
        current_rot4_dn := line.new(session_start_bar, rot4_dn, session_start_bar + projection_offset, rot4_dn, color=rotation_line_color, style=get_style(rotation_line_style), width=rotation_line_width)
        current_rot5_dn := line.new(session_start_bar, rot5_dn, session_start_bar + projection_offset, rot5_dn, color=rotation_line_color, style=get_style(rotation_line_style), width=rotation_line_width)
        
        array.push(line_array, current_rot1_up)
        array.push(line_array, current_rot2_up)
        array.push(line_array, current_rot3_up)
        array.push(line_array, current_rot4_up)
        array.push(line_array, current_rot5_up)
        array.push(line_array, current_rot1_dn)
        array.push(line_array, current_rot2_dn)
        array.push(line_array, current_rot3_dn)
        array.push(line_array, current_rot4_dn)
        array.push(line_array, current_rot5_dn)
        
        if show_rotation_labels
            current_rot1_up_label := label.new(x, rot1_up, "R+1 (" + str.tostring(rotation_increment, "#.##") + ")", style=_style, color=color.new(rotation_label_color, 100), textcolor=rotation_label_color, size=get_label_size(rotation_label_size))
            current_rot2_up_label := label.new(x, rot2_up, "R+2 (" + str.tostring(rotation_increment * 2, "#.##") + ")", style=_style, color=color.new(rotation_label_color, 100), textcolor=rotation_label_color, size=get_label_size(rotation_label_size))
            current_rot3_up_label := label.new(x, rot3_up, "R+3 (" + str.tostring(rotation_increment * 3, "#.##") + ")", style=_style, color=color.new(rotation_label_color, 100), textcolor=rotation_label_color, size=get_label_size(rotation_label_size))
            current_rot4_up_label := label.new(x, rot4_up, "R+4 (" + str.tostring(rotation_increment * 4, "#.##") + ")", style=_style, color=color.new(rotation_label_color, 100), textcolor=rotation_label_color, size=get_label_size(rotation_label_size))
            current_rot5_up_label := label.new(x, rot5_up, "R+5 (" + str.tostring(rotation_increment * 5, "#.##") + ")", style=_style, color=color.new(rotation_label_color, 100), textcolor=rotation_label_color, size=get_label_size(rotation_label_size))
            current_rot1_dn_label := label.new(x, rot1_dn, "R-1 (" + str.tostring(rotation_increment, "#.##") + ")", style=_style, color=color.new(rotation_label_color, 100), textcolor=rotation_label_color, size=get_label_size(rotation_label_size))
            current_rot2_dn_label := label.new(x, rot2_dn, "R-2 (" + str.tostring(rotation_increment * 2, "#.##") + ")", style=_style, color=color.new(rotation_label_color, 100), textcolor=rotation_label_color, size=get_label_size(rotation_label_size))
            current_rot3_dn_label := label.new(x, rot3_dn, "R-3 (" + str.tostring(rotation_increment * 3, "#.##") + ")", style=_style, color=color.new(rotation_label_color, 100), textcolor=rotation_label_color, size=get_label_size(rotation_label_size))
            current_rot4_dn_label := label.new(x, rot4_dn, "R-4 (" + str.tostring(rotation_increment * 4, "#.##") + ")", style=_style, color=color.new(rotation_label_color, 100), textcolor=rotation_label_color, size=get_label_size(rotation_label_size))
            current_rot5_dn_label := label.new(x, rot5_dn, "R-5 (" + str.tostring(rotation_increment * 5, "#.##") + ")", style=_style, color=color.new(rotation_label_color, 100), textcolor=rotation_label_color, size=get_label_size(rotation_label_size))
            
            array.push(label_array, current_rot1_up_label)
            array.push(label_array, current_rot2_up_label)
            array.push(label_array, current_rot3_up_label)
            array.push(label_array, current_rot4_up_label)
            array.push(label_array, current_rot5_up_label)
            array.push(label_array, current_rot1_dn_label)
            array.push(label_array, current_rot2_dn_label)
            array.push(label_array, current_rot3_dn_label)
            array.push(label_array, current_rot4_dn_label)
            array.push(label_array, current_rot5_dn_label)
    
    // Manage array sizes to prevent hitting limits
    if not hist or array.size(line_array) > adjusted_max_history * objects_per_session
        manage_array_size(line_array, adjusted_max_history * objects_per_session)
    
    if not hist or array.size(label_array) > adjusted_max_labels * labels_per_session
        manage_label_array_size(label_array, adjusted_max_labels * labels_per_session)
    
    if not hist or array.size(linefill_array) > adjusted_max_history
        manage_linefill_array_size(linefill_array, adjusted_max_history)

// Extend lines as new bars form (only after OR is captured)
if is_in_session and or_captured and not na(current_top_line)
    if not na(current_top_line)
        line.set_x2(current_top_line, bar_index + projection_offset)
    if not na(current_bot_line)
        line.set_x2(current_bot_line, bar_index + projection_offset)
    if not na(current_mid_line) and midLine

        for i = 0 to array.size(current_range_lines_dn) - 1

    // Extend statistical lines

        if show_stats_labels and pos == "Right"

            if not na(current_stat1_dn_label)

            if not na(current_stat2_up_label)

            if not na(current_stat2_dn_label)
                label.set_x(current_stat2_dn_label, bar_index + projection_offset)
    
    // Extend rotation lines
    if show_rotations and rotation_increment > 0
        if not na(current_rot1_up)
            line.set_x2(current_rot1_up, bar_index + projection_offset)
        if not na(current_rot2_up)
            line.set_x2(current_rot2_up, bar_index + projection_offset)
        if not na(current_rot3_up)
            line.set_x2(current_rot3_up, bar_index + projection_offset)
        if not na(current_rot4_up)

        if not na(current_rot5_up)

        if not na(current_rot1_dn)

//@version=6
indicator('RTH Opening Range with Extensions', overlay = true, max_boxes_count = 500, max_lines_count = 500)

// ==================== INPUTS ====================

// Opening Range Settings
orDuration = input.int(5, 'Opening Range Duration (minutes)', options = [1, 5, 15, 30])
rangeColor = input.color(color.gray, 'Range Line Color', group = 'Opening Range')
rangeFillColor = input.color(color.new(color.gray, 85), 'Range Fill Color', group = 'Opening Range')
rangeStyle = input.string('Solid', 'Range Line Style', options = ['Solid', 'Dashed', 'Dotted'], group = 'Opening Range')
rangeWidth = input.int(2, 'Range Line Width', minval = 1, maxval = 4, group = 'Opening Range')

// Midline Settings
showMidline = input.bool(true, 'Show Midline', group = 'Midline')
midColor = input.color(color.green, 'Midline Color', group = 'Midline')
midStyle = input.string('Solid', 'Midline Style', options = ['Solid', 'Dashed', 'Dotted'], group = 'Midline')
midWidth = input.int(2, 'Midline Width', minval = 1, maxval = 4, group = 'Midline')

// Extension 1 Settings
showExt1 = input.bool(true, 'Show Extension 1', group = 'Extension 1')
ext1Mult = input.float(1.0, 'Extension 1 Multiplier', minval = 0.1, step = 0.1, group = 'Extension 1')
ext1Color = input.color(color.green, 'Extension 1 Color', group = 'Extension 1')
ext1Style = input.string('Solid', 'Extension 1 Style', options = ['Solid', 'Dashed', 'Dotted'], group = 'Extension 1')
ext1Width = input.int(1, 'Extension 1 Width', minval = 1, maxval = 4, group = 'Extension 1')

// Extension 2 Settings
showExt2 = input.bool(false, 'Show Extension 2', group = 'Extension 2')
ext2Mult = input.float(2.0, 'Extension 2 Multiplier', minval = 0.1, step = 0.1, group = 'Extension 2')
ext2Color = input.color(color.blue, 'Extension 2 Color', group = 'Extension 2')
ext2Style = input.string('Dotted', 'Extension 2 Style', options = ['Solid', 'Dashed', 'Dotted'], group = 'Extension 2')
ext2Width = input.int(1, 'Extension 2 Width', minval = 1, maxval = 4, group = 'Extension 2')

// ==================== FUNCTIONS ====================

getLineStyle(style) =>
    switch style
        'Solid' => line.style_solid
        'Dashed' => line.style_dashed
        'Dotted' => line.style_dotted

// ==================== TIME CALCULATIONS ====================

rth_start = timestamp('America/New_York', year, month, dayofmonth, 9, 30)
rth_end = timestamp('America/New_York', year, month, dayofmonth, 9, 30 + orDuration)
rth_close = timestamp('America/New_York', year, month, dayofmonth, 16, 0)

// ==================== VARIABLES ====================

var float orHigh = na
var float orLow = na
var bool rangeDrawn = false

// ==================== LOGIC ====================

newDay = ta.change(time('D'))
if bool(newDay)
    orHigh := na
    orLow := na
    rangeDrawn := false

inOpeningRange = time >= rth_start and time < rth_end
if inOpeningRange
    orHigh := na(orHigh) ? high : math.max(orHigh, high)
    orLow := na(orLow) ? low : math.min(orLow, low)

if not inOpeningRange and not rangeDrawn and not na(orHigh) and not na(orLow)
    orRange = orHigh - orLow
    mid = (orHigh + orLow) / 2
    ext1High = orHigh + ext1Mult * orRange
    ext1Low = orLow - ext1Mult * orRange
    ext2High = orHigh + ext2Mult * orRange
    ext2Low = orLow - ext2Mult * orRange

    // Draw shaded range box (backpainted to 9:30)
    box.new(left = rth_start, top = orHigh, right = rth_close, bottom = orLow, xloc = xloc.bar_time, bgcolor = rangeFillColor, border_color = color.new(color.white, 100))

    // Draw range lines (backpainted to 9:30)
    line.new(x1 = rth_start, y1 = orHigh, x2 = rth_close, y2 = orHigh, xloc = xloc.bar_time, color = rangeColor, style = getLineStyle(rangeStyle), width = rangeWidth)
    line.new(x1 = rth_start, y1 = orLow, x2 = rth_close, y2 = orLow, xloc = xloc.bar_time, color = rangeColor, style = getLineStyle(rangeStyle), width = rangeWidth)

    // Draw midline (backpainted to 9:30)
    if showMidline
        line.new(x1 = rth_start, y1 = mid, x2 = rth_close, y2 = mid, xloc = xloc.bar_time, color = midColor, style = getLineStyle(midStyle), width = midWidth)

    // Draw Extension 1 (backpainted to 9:30)
    if showExt1
        line.new(x1 = rth_start, y1 = ext1High, x2 = rth_close, y2 = ext1High, xloc = xloc.bar_time, color = ext1Color, style = getLineStyle(ext1Style), width = ext1Width)
        line.new(x1 = rth_start, y1 = ext1Low, x2 = rth_close, y2 = ext1Low, xloc = xloc.bar_time, color = ext1Color, style = getLineStyle(ext1Style), width = ext1Width)

    // Draw Extension 2 (backpainted to 9:30)
    if showExt2
        line.new(x1 = rth_start, y1 = ext2High, x2 = rth_close, y2 = ext2High, xloc = xloc.bar_time, color = ext2Color, style = getLineStyle(ext2Style), width = ext2Width)
        line.new(x1 = rth_start, y1 = ext2Low, x2 = rth_close, y2 = ext2Low, xloc = xloc.bar_time, color = ext2Color, style = getLineStyle(ext2Style), width = ext2Width)

    rangeDrawn := true

// This Pine Script™ code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
// © Trades-Dont-Lie

//@version=5
// Midnight Opening Ranges (w/ Std Dev) [TDL] v2.3
// Plots rectangles showing the price range during 00:00-00:30 EST
// Displays both current and historical ranges with customizable lookback period
// Supports both standard time (GMT-5) and daylight saving time (GMT-4)
// Properly handles day transitions with separate current/historical colors
// Shows opening price level (12am) for current session
// Features standard deviation levels based on range size with up to 10 customizable levels
// Supports individual or master color control for SD levels
indicator("Midnight Opening Ranges[TDL]", overlay=true)

// General Settings
lookbackDays = input.int(5, "Number of Previous Days", minval=1, maxval=50, group="General Settings")
futureOffset = input.int(20, "Future Bars Extension", minval=0, tooltip="Number of bars to extend into the future", group="General Settings")
useDST = input.bool(true, "Use Daylight Saving Time", tooltip="Enable for EDT (GMT-4), disable for EST (GMT-5)", group="General Settings")
timeZoneStr = useDST ? "GMT-4" : "GMT-5"

// Current Session Settings
var currentGroup = "Current Session"
currentBoxFillColor = input.color(color.new(color.blue, 80), "Box Fill", inline="current_box", group=currentGroup)
currentBoxBorderColor = input.color(color.blue, "Border", inline="current_box", group=currentGroup)
currentMidlineColor = input.color(color.yellow, "Midline", inline="current_mid", group=currentGroup)
currentMidlineStyle = input.string("Dashed", "Style", options=["Solid", "Dotted", "Dashed"], inline="current_mid", group=currentGroup)

// Opening Price Settings
var openGroup = "Opening Price (12am)"
showOpenLabel = input.bool(true, "Show Opening Price", inline="open_main", group=openGroup)
openPriceColor = input.color(color.new(color.red, 0), "Color", inline="open_main", group=openGroup)
openPriceStyle = input.string("Dotted", "Style", options=["Solid", "Dotted", "Dashed"], inline="open_main", group=openGroup)

// Replace the custom opening prices section with this more organized version
var customOpenGroup = "Custom Opening Lines"
// Custom Line 1
showCustomOpen1 = input.bool(true, "Line 1", inline="custom_open1_main", group=customOpenGroup)
customOpen1Hour = input.int(9, "Hour", inline="custom_open1_time", minval=0, maxval=23, group=customOpenGroup)
customOpen1Min = input.int(30, "Min", inline="custom_open1_time", minval=0, maxval=59, group=customOpenGroup)
customOpen1Text = input.string("NY Open", "Label", inline="custom_open1_time", group=customOpenGroup)

customOpen1Color = input.color(color.new(color.green, 0), "Color", inline="custom_open1_style", group=customOpenGroup)
customOpen1Style = input.string("Dotted", "Style", options=["Solid", "Dotted", "Dashed"], inline="custom_open1_style", group=customOpenGroup)
customOpen1LineWidth = input.int(1, "Width", inline="custom_open1_style", minval=1, maxval=4, group=customOpenGroup)
customOpen1TextSize = input.string("Small", "Text Size", options=["Tiny", "Small", "Normal", "Large"], inline="custom_open1_style", group=customOpenGroup)

// Custom Line 2
showCustomOpen2 = input.bool(false, "Line 2", inline="custom_open2_main", group=customOpenGroup)
customOpen2Hour = input.int(10, "Hour", inline="custom_open2_time", minval=0, maxval=23, group=customOpenGroup)
customOpen2Min = input.int(0, "Min", inline="custom_open2_time", minval=0, maxval=59, group=customOpenGroup)
customOpen2Text = input.string("London Close", "Label", inline="custom_open2_time", group=customOpenGroup)

customOpen2Color = input.color(color.new(color.purple, 0), "Color", inline="custom_open2_style", group=customOpenGroup)
customOpen2Style = input.string("Dotted", "Style", options=["Solid", "Dotted", "Dashed"], inline="custom_open2_style", group=customOpenGroup)
customOpen2LineWidth = input.int(1, "Width", inline="custom_open2_style", minval=1, maxval=4, group=customOpenGroup)
customOpen2TextSize = input.string("Small", "Text Size", options=["Tiny", "Small", "Normal", "Large"], inline="custom_open2_style", group=customOpenGroup)

// Historical Session Settings
var historyGroup = "Historical Sessions"
historyBoxFillColor = input.color(color.new(color.gray, 80), "Box Fill", inline="history_box", group=historyGroup)
historyBoxBorderColor = input.color(color.gray, "Border", inline="history_box", group=historyGroup)
historyMidlineColor = input.color(color.white, "Midline", inline="history_mid", group=historyGroup)
historyMidlineStyle = input.string("Dashed", "Style", options=["Solid", "Dotted", "Dashed"], inline="history_mid", group=historyGroup)
showDateLabels = input.bool(true, "Show Date Labels", group=historyGroup)

// Standard Deviation Settings
var sdGroup = "Standard Deviations"
showSD = input.bool(true, "Enable Standard Deviations", group=sdGroup, inline="sd_main")
showHistorySD = input.bool(true, "Show Historical", group=sdGroup, inline="sd_main")
sdStyle = input.string("Dashed", "Style", options=["Solid", "Dotted", "Dashed"], group=sdGroup, inline="sd_main")
showSDLabels = input.bool(true, "Show Labels", group=sdGroup, inline="sd_main")

// Add master color settings
useMasterColor = input.bool(false, "Use Master Color", inline="master_color", group=sdGroup)
masterSDColor = input.color(color.new(color.white, 0), "", inline="master_color", group=sdGroup)

// SD Level Settings
var sdLevelsGroup = "SD Levels Configuration"
// Level 1-10 settings
show_sd1 = input.bool(true, "Level 1", inline="sd1", group=sdLevelsGroup)
sd1_value = input.float(0.5, "", inline="sd1", group=sdLevelsGroup, step=0.25)
sd1_color = input.color(color.new(color.white, 0), "", inline="sd1", group=sdLevelsGroup)

show_sd2 = input.bool(true, "Level 2", inline="sd2", group=sdLevelsGroup)
sd2_value = input.float(1.0, "", inline="sd2", group=sdLevelsGroup, step=0.25)
sd2_color = input.color(color.new(color.white, 0), "", inline="sd2", group=sdLevelsGroup)

show_sd3 = input.bool(true, "Level 3", inline="sd3", group=sdLevelsGroup)
sd3_value = input.float(1.5, "", inline="sd3", group=sdLevelsGroup, step=0.25)
sd3_color = input.color(color.new(color.white, 0), "", inline="sd3", group=sdLevelsGroup)

show_sd4 = input.bool(true, "Level 4", inline="sd4", group=sdLevelsGroup)
sd4_value = input.float(2.0, "", inline="sd4", group=sdLevelsGroup, step=0.25)
sd4_color = input.color(color.new(color.white, 0), "", inline="sd4", group=sdLevelsGroup)

show_sd5 = input.bool(false, "Level 5", inline="sd5", group=sdLevelsGroup)
sd5_value = input.float(2.5, "", inline="sd5", group=sdLevelsGroup, step=0.25)
sd5_color = input.color(color.new(color.white, 0), "", inline="sd5", group=sdLevelsGroup)

show_sd6 = input.bool(false, "Level 6", inline="sd6", group=sdLevelsGroup)
sd6_value = input.float(3.0, "", inline="sd6", group=sdLevelsGroup, step=0.25)
sd6_color = input.color(color.new(color.white, 0), "", inline="sd6", group=sdLevelsGroup)

show_sd7 = input.bool(false, "Level 7", inline="sd7", group=sdLevelsGroup)
sd7_value = input.float(3.5, "", inline="sd7", group=sdLevelsGroup, step=0.25)
sd7_color = input.color(color.new(color.white, 0), "", inline="sd7", group=sdLevelsGroup)

show_sd8 = input.bool(false, "Level 8", inline="sd8", group=sdLevelsGroup)
sd8_value = input.float(4.0, "", inline="sd8", group=sdLevelsGroup, step=0.25)
sd8_color = input.color(color.new(color.white, 0), "", inline="sd8", group=sdLevelsGroup)

show_sd9 = input.bool(false, "Level 9", inline="sd9", group=sdLevelsGroup)
sd9_value = input.float(4.5, "", inline="sd9", group=sdLevelsGroup, step=0.25)
sd9_color = input.color(color.new(color.white, 0), "", inline="sd9", group=sdLevelsGroup)

show_sd10 = input.bool(false, "Level 10", inline="sd10", group=sdLevelsGroup)
sd10_value = input.float(5.0, "", inline="sd10", group=sdLevelsGroup, step=0.25)
sd10_color = input.color(color.new(color.white, 0), "", inline="sd10", group=sdLevelsGroup)

// Add this with the other variable declarations
var label[] dateLabels = array.new_label()

// Move these variable declarations to the top with other variables
var float sessionHigh = na
var float sessionLow = na
var int sessionStartTime = na
var int currentDay = dayofmonth(time, timeZoneStr)
var float openPrice = na

// Add these with other variable declarations
var float[] customOpen1Prices = array.new_float()
var int[] customOpen1Times = array.new_int()
var float[] customOpen2Prices = array.new_float()
var int[] customOpen2Times = array.new_int()
var line[] customOpen1Lines = array.new_line()
var label[] customOpen1Labels = array.new_label()
var line[] customOpen2Lines = array.new_line()
var label[] customOpen2Labels = array.new_label()
var line customOpen1Line = na
var line customOpen2Line = na
var label customOpen1Label = na
var label customOpen2Label = na

// Replace the first custom open variables and logic with:
var float customOpen1Price = na
var int customOpen1StartTime = na
var float customOpen2Price = na
var int customOpen2StartTime = na

// Replace both capture sections with:
if (hour(time, timeZoneStr) == customOpen1Hour) and (minute(time, timeZoneStr) == customOpen1Min) and (second(time, timeZoneStr) == 0)
    customOpen1Price := open
    customOpen1StartTime := time

if (hour(time, timeZoneStr) == customOpen2Hour) and (minute(time, timeZoneStr) == customOpen2Min) and (second(time, timeZoneStr) == 0)
    customOpen2Price := open
    customOpen2StartTime := time

// Define session times
isInTimeWindow = (hour(time, timeZoneStr) == 0 and minute(time, timeZoneStr) >= 0 and minute(time, timeZoneStr) < 30)
newDay = dayofmonth(time, timeZoneStr) != dayofmonth(time[1], timeZoneStr)

// Arrays to store historical data
var float[] historyHighs = array.new_float()
var float[] historyLows = array.new_float()
var int[] historyTimes = array.new_int()

// Add these variables after the other variable declarations
var box[] historyBoxes = array.new_box()
var line[] historyLines = array.new_line()
var box currentBox = na
var line currentMidline = na
var line openPriceLine = na
var label openPriceLabel = na
var line[] sdLines = array.new_line()
var label[] sdLabels = array.new_label()

// Handle new day
if newDay
    if not na(sessionHigh)
        array.push(historyHighs, sessionHigh)
        array.push(historyLows, sessionLow)
        array.push(historyTimes, sessionStartTime)
        
        if array.size(historyHighs) > lookbackDays
            array.shift(historyHighs)
            array.shift(historyLows)
            array.shift(historyTimes)
    
    sessionHigh := na
    sessionLow := na
    sessionStartTime := na
    currentDay := dayofmonth(time, timeZoneStr)

// Reset values at the start of new session
if isInTimeWindow and not isInTimeWindow[1]
    sessionHigh := high
    sessionLow := low
    sessionStartTime := time
    openPrice := open

// Update high and low during session
if isInTimeWindow
    sessionHigh := math.max(sessionHigh, high)
    sessionLow := math.min(sessionLow, low)

// Plot boxes and midlines
if barstate.islast
    // Clear previous drawings
    for b in historyBoxes
        box.delete(b)
    array.clear(historyBoxes)
    
    // Keep historical midlines and date labels separate from SD cleanup
    for l in historyLines
        line.delete(l)
    array.clear(historyLines)
    
    for l in dateLabels
        label.delete(l)
    array.clear(dateLabels)
    
    // Clean up SD lines and labels unconditionally
    for l in sdLines
        line.delete(l)
    array.clear(sdLines)
    
    for l in sdLabels
        label.delete(l)
    array.clear(sdLabels)

    if not na(currentBox)
        box.delete(currentBox)
    if not na(currentMidline)
        line.delete(currentMidline)
    if not na(openPriceLine)
        line.delete(openPriceLine)
    if not na(openPriceLabel)
        label.delete(openPriceLabel)

    if not na(customOpen1Line)
        line.delete(customOpen1Line)
    if not na(customOpen1Label)
        label.delete(customOpen1Label)
    if not na(customOpen2Line)
        line.delete(customOpen2Line)
    if not na(customOpen2Label)
        label.delete(customOpen2Label)

    // Clean up custom open lines and labels
    for l in customOpen1Lines
        line.delete(l)
    array.clear(customOpen1Lines)
    
    for l in customOpen1Labels
        label.delete(l)
    array.clear(customOpen1Labels)
    
    for l in customOpen2Lines
        line.delete(l)
    array.clear(customOpen2Lines)
    
    for l in customOpen2Labels
        label.delete(l)
    array.clear(customOpen2Labels)

    // Plot historical boxes and midlines
    for i = 0 to array.size(historyHighs) - 1
        float midPrice = (array.get(historyHighs, i) + array.get(historyLows, i)) / 2
        int historyTime = array.get(historyTimes, i)
        float historyHigh = array.get(historyHighs, i)
        float historyLow = array.get(historyLows, i)
        
        // Calculate next day's start time (only for SD lines)
        int nextDayTime = historyTime + 86400000  // Add 24 hours in milliseconds
        
        box b = box.new(
             left=historyTime, 
             right=time + (futureOffset * timeframe.multiplier * 60000),  // Modified
             top=historyHigh,
             bottom=historyLow,
             bgcolor=historyBoxFillColor,
             border_color=historyBoxBorderColor,
             xloc=xloc.bar_time)
        array.push(historyBoxes, b)
        
        line l = line.new(
             x1=historyTime,
             y1=midPrice,
             x2=time + (futureOffset * timeframe.multiplier * 60000),  // Modified
             y2=midPrice,
             color=historyMidlineColor,
             style=historyMidlineStyle == "Solid" ? line.style_solid : 
                  historyMidlineStyle == "Dotted" ? line.style_dotted : 
                  line.style_dashed,
             xloc=xloc.bar_time)
        array.push(historyLines, l)
        
        // Add date label at midpoint
        if showDateLabels
            label dateLabel = label.new(

items.name: Opening Range with Infinite Price Targets
items.title: Opening Range with Infinite Price Targets
items.author: SamRecio
items.source:
// This source code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
// © SamRecio

//@version=5
indicator("Opening Range with Infinite Price Targets",shorttitle = "|OR|", overlay = true, max_labels_count = 500, max_lines_count = 500, max_bars_back = 5000)

tog_hist = input.bool(false,"Display Historical Data?", inline = "1", group = "Settings")
start_hour = input.int(9,minval = 0,maxval = 23, group = "Range Time", title ="Start Time:", inline = "1")
start_min = input.int(30,minval = 0,maxval = 59, group = "Range Time", title ="", inline = "1")
end_hour = input.int(9,minval = 0,maxval = 23, group = "Range Time", title = "End Time:  ", inline = "2")
end_min = input.int(45,minval = 0,maxval = 59, group = "Range Time", title ="", inline = "2")
target_p = input.float(50,title = "                      Price Target %", minval = 0, tooltip = "Percent(%) of Range to use for Price Targets.")*0.01

color1 = input.color(#0c3299, title = "High", group = "Colors", inline = "1")
color2 = input.color(#0c3299, title = "Low", group = "Colors", inline = "1")
color3 = input.color(#3179f5, title = "Mean", group = "Colors", inline = "1")
colorf = input.color(color.new(#3179f5,95), title = "Fill", group = "Colors", inline = "1")
colorg = color.rgb(0,255,0)
colorr = color.rgb(255,0,0)
color4 = input.color(#bbd9fb, title = "Targets", group = "Colors", inline = "2")


start_time = start_hour + (start_min*0.01)
end_time = end_hour + (end_min*0.01)

    
t_time = hour + (minute*0.01)
get_or(_start_time,_end_time) =>
    var float or_hi = na
    var float or_lo = na
    or_t = (t_time >= start_time and t_time < end_time)
    or_f = or_t == false
    or_o = or_t and not or_t[1]
    if or_o
        or_hi := high
        or_lo := low
    if or_t and high > or_hi
        or_hi := high
    if or_t and low < or_lo
        or_lo := low
    [or_hi,or_lo,or_t,or_f,or_o]

[or_high,or_low,or_true,or_false,or_open] = get_or(start_time,end_time)

or_range = or_high - or_low
or_mean = math.avg(or_high,or_low)
or_end = or_false and (or_false[1] == false)
eod = (ta.valuewhen(or_open,bar_index,0) - ta.valuewhen(or_end,bar_index,1)) - 1
ba_or = ta.valuewhen(or_end,bar_index,0) 

var long_count = 0
var short_count = 0
if or_open
    long_count := 0
    short_count := 0

pt_step = or_range*target_p
pt_1 = or_high + pt_step
pt_1b = or_low - pt_step
pt_2 = or_high + pt_step*2
pt_2b = or_low - pt_step*2

var float pt_x1 = na
var float pt_x2 = na
var int scount = na
var int lcount = na
var line l1 = na
var line l2 = na
var line l3 = na
var line l4 = na
var line l5 = na
var line l6 = na
var line l7 = na
var line lx = na
var label lab1 = na
var label lab2 = na
var label pt1 = na
var label pt2 = na
var label pt3 = na
var label pt4 = na
var label ptx = na
if or_true
    scount := 1
    lcount := 1
if or_end
    pt_x1 := or_high + pt_step
    pt_x2 := or_low - pt_step
    if tog_hist == false
        a_allLines = line.all
        if array.size(a_allLines) > 0
            for i = 0 to array.size(a_allLines) - 1
                line.delete(array.get(a_allLines, i))
        a_allLabels = label.all
        if array.size(a_allLabels) > 0
            for i = 0 to array.size(a_allLabels) - 1
                label.delete(array.get(a_allLabels, i))
    l1 := line.new(ba_or,or_high,ba_or + eod, or_high, color = color1, width = 2)
    l2 := line.new(ba_or,or_low,ba_or + eod, or_low, color = color2, width = 2)
    l3 := line.new(ba_or,or_mean,ba_or + eod, or_mean, color = color3)
    l4 := line.new(ba_or,pt_x1,ba_or + eod, pt_x1, color = color4, style = line.style_dotted)
    pt1 := label.new(ba_or + eod + 1, pt_x1, style = label.style_label_left, text = "PT1", tooltip = str.tostring(str.format("{0, number, currency}",math.round(pt_x1,2))), textcolor = color4, color = color.new(color4,100), size = size.tiny)
    l5 := line.new(ba_or,pt_x2,ba_or + eod, pt_x2, color = color4, style = line.style_dotted)   
    pt2 := label.new(ba_or + eod + 1, pt_x2, style = label.style_label_left, text = "PT1", tooltip = str.tostring(str.format("{0, number, currency}",math.round(pt_x2,2))), textcolor = color4, color = color.new(color4,100), size = size.tiny)
linefill.new(l1, l2,colorf)
//One a Day Alerts
alertcondition(close > or_high and close[1] <= or_high and or_false and long_count == 0,title = "First Break Above Range")
alertcondition(close < or_low and close[1] >= or_low and or_false and short_count == 0, title = "First Break Below Range")
//Breakout Alerts
alertcondition(close > or_high and close[1] <= or_high and or_false,title = "Break Above Range")
alertcondition(close < or_low and close[1] >= or_low and or_false, title = "Break Below Range")
//BREAKOUT LABELS///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

if close > or_high and close[1] <= or_high and or_false and long_count == 0
    lab1 := label.new(bar_index,or_high, style = label.style_triangleup, size = size.auto, color = colorg, yloc = yloc.abovebar)
    long_count := 1

if close < or_low and close[1] >= or_low and or_false and short_count == 0
    lab2 := label.new(bar_index,or_low, style = label.style_triangledown, size = size.auto, color = colorr, yloc = yloc.belowbar)
    short_count := 1
////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
//To infinity and beyond!//////////////////////////////////////////////////////

alertcondition(close > pt_x1 and or_false, title = "New Long PT Hit")    
if close > pt_x1 and or_false 
    lcount := math.floor((close - or_high)/pt_step) + 1
    for i = (lcount[1] + 1) to lcount
        pt_x1 := or_high + (i*pt_step)
        lx := line.new(bar_index,pt_x1,ba_or + eod, pt_x1, color = color4) 
        ptx := label.new(ba_or + eod + 1,pt_x1, style = label.style_label_left, text = "PT" + str.tostring(i), tooltip = str.tostring(str.format("{0, number, currency}",math.round(pt_x1,2))), textcolor = color4, color = color.new(color4,100), size = size.tiny)

alertcondition(close < pt_x2 and or_false, title = "New Short PT Hit")
if close < pt_x2 and or_false
    scount := math.floor((or_low - close)/pt_step) + 1
    for i = (scount[1] + 1) to scount
        pt_x2  := or_low - (i*pt_step)
        lx := line.new(bar_index,pt_x2, ba_or + eod, pt_x2, color = color4)   
        ptx := label.new(ba_or + eod + 1,pt_x2, style = label.style_label_left, text = "PT" + str.tostring(i), tooltip = str.tostring(str.format("{0, number, currency}",math.round(pt_x2,2))), textcolor = color4, color = color.new(color4,100), size = size.tiny)


plot(or_high, title = "OR High", display  = display.none, editable = false)
plot(or_mean, title = "OR Mean", display  = display.none, editable = false)
plot(or_low, title = "OR Low", display  = display.none, editable = false)

//@version=5
strategy('Negroni Opening Range Strategy', shorttitle='Negroni OR Strat', pyramiding=1, overlay=true, initial_capital = 100000, slippage = 2, default_qty_type=strategy.fixed, default_qty_value=10)

thumbsUp = "👍"
yawningEmoji = "😴"
excitedEmoji = "🤩"
thinkingEmoji = "🤔"
sarcasticEmoji = "🙄"

/////////////////////////// Maximum number of trades per day ////////////////////////////////////////////

maxTradesPerDay = input.int(3, title="Max Trades Per Day", minval=1, group="Your Trading Session (make backtesting reflect YOUR trading hours) " + thumbsUp)
direction = input.string("Long/Short", title="Long only, Short only, Long/Short", options=["Long only", "Short only", "Long/Short"], group="Your Trading Session (make backtesting reflect YOUR trading hours) " + thumbsUp, tooltip='CAREFUL: "Long/Short" can open trades that can effectively close-out existing ones, for better and worse!')
var int tradesToday = 0  
currentYear = year(time)
currentMonth = month(time)
currentDay = dayofmonth(time)
currentDate = currentYear * 10000 + currentMonth * 100 + currentDay
var int lastDate = na

if (na(lastDate) or currentDate != lastDate)
    tradesToday := 0  
    lastDate := currentDate 

/////////////////////////// Time window condition, to make backtesting reflect YOUR trading hours. //////////////////////////////////

timezone = input.string("Europe/Berlin", title="Timezone", group="Your Trading Session (make backtesting reflect YOUR trading hours) " + thumbsUp, options=["America/New_York", "Europe/London", "Europe/Berlin", "Asia/Tokyo"])

// Session Inputs
sessionStartHour = input.int(9, title="Start hour to OPEN Trades", minval=0, maxval=23, group="Your Trading Session (make backtesting reflect YOUR trading hours) " + thumbsUp, tooltip='Strategy will only open trades after this time.')
sessionStartMinute = input.int(30, title="Start minute to OPEN Trades", minval=0, maxval=59, group="Your Trading Session (make backtesting reflect YOUR trading hours) " + thumbsUp)

plot(longScalpTP_level, title = 'Scalp long TP', color=color.rgb(242, 212, 180, 100), style=plot.style_linebr, linewidth=2)
plot(shortScalpSL_level, title = 'Scalp short SL', color=color.rgb(155, 17, 30, 100), style=plot.style_linebr, linewidth=2)
plot(shortScalpTP_level, title = 'Scalp short TP', color=color.rgb(155, 17, 30, 100) , style=plot.style_linebr, linewidth=2)

// Full PMKT multiplier SL
plot(strategy.position_size > 0 ? orlongSL : na, title = 'PMKT mult long SL', color=color.rgb(242, 212, 180, 60), style=plot.style_linebr, linewidth=2)
plot(strategy.position_size < 0 ? orshortSL : na, title = 'PMKT mult short SL', color=color.rgb(155, 17, 30, 40), style=plot.style_linebr, linewidth=2)


///////////////////////////////////////////////// OPENING TRADES ///////////////////////////////////////////////////

// OR Trigger Parameters// 
longTrigger1 = ta.crossover(close, lastSessionHigh1)
shortTrigger1 = ta.crossunder(close, lastSessionLow1)
longTrigger2 = ta.crossover(close, lastSessionHigh2)
shortTrigger2 = ta.crossunder(close, lastSessionLow2)

longCondition1 = not na(lastSessionHigh1) and longTrigger1 
shortCondition1 = not na(lastSessionLow1) and shortTrigger1 
longCondition2 = not na(lastSessionHigh2) and longTrigger2 
shortCondition2 = not na(lastSessionLow2) and shortTrigger2 

if (tradesToday < maxTradesPerDay)
    if (or_option == true and isTradeTime)
        if (longCondition2) and (direction == "Long only" or direction == "Long/Short") 
            strategy.order("Long", strategy.long)
            tradesToday += 1 
        if (shortCondition2) and (direction == "Short only" or direction == "Long/Short") 
            strategy.order("Short", strategy.short)
            tradesToday += 1 
    if (or_option == false and isTradeTime)
        if (longCondition1) and (direction == "Long only" or direction == "Long/Short") 
            strategy.order("Long", strategy.long)
            tradesToday += 1 
        if (shortCondition1) and (direction == "Short only" or direction == "Long/Short") 
            strategy.order("Short", strategy.short)
            tradesToday += 1 


///////////////////////////////////////////// CLOSING TRADES /////////////////////////////////////////

// Full ATR 
if tp_option == '1) Full TP: ATR Multiplier' and not is_end_of_session
    strategy.exit("Long: Full TP/SL", "Long", stop=longv3stoploss_level, limit=longv3takeprofit_level)
    strategy.exit("Short: Full TP/SL", "Short", stop=shortv3stoploss_level, limit=shortv3takeprofit_level)

if tp_option == '1) Full TP: ATR Multiplier' and is_end_of_session
    strategy.close("Long", comment="End of Day")
    strategy.close("Short", comment="End of Day")


// Partials ATR 
if (tp_option) == '2) Take Partials: ATR Multiplier' and not is_end_of_session
    strategy.exit("Long: Partial TP1/SL", "Long", stop=longv3stoploss_level,  qty_percent = percent_option1, limit=longv2takeprofit1_level)
    strategy.exit("Short: Partial TP1/SL", "Short", stop=shortv3stoploss_level, qty_percent = percent_option1, limit=shortv2takeprofit1_level)

    strategy.exit("Long: Partial TP2/SL", "Long", stop=longv3stoploss_level, qty_percent = percent_option2, limit=longv2takeprofit2_level)
    strategy.exit("Short: Partial TP2/SL", "Short", stop=shortv3stoploss_level, qty_percent = percent_option2, limit=shortv2takeprofit2_level)

    strategy.exit("Long: Partial TP3/SL", "Long", stop=longv3stoploss_level, limit=longv3takeprofit_level)
    strategy.exit("Short: Partial TP3/SL", "Short", stop=shortv3stoploss_level, limit=shortv3takeprofit_level)

if tp_option == '2) Take Partials: ATR Multiplier' and is_end_of_session
    strategy.close("Long", comment="End of Day")
    strategy.close("Short", comment="End of Day")


// Trailing Stop
var float long_trail_stop_level = na
var float short_trail_stop_level = na
var float plot_long_trail_stop = na
var float plot_short_trail_stop = na

if (tp_option) == '3) Full TP: Trailing Stop' and not is_end_of_session
    strategy.exit("Long: Trailing TP", "Long", trail_price=na, trail_points=trailStop, trail_offset=na)  
    strategy.exit("Long: Trailing SL", "Long", trail_price=trailStop, trail_points=na, trail_offset=trailStop)
    if (strategy.position_size > 0)
        long_trail_stop_level := na(long_trail_stop_level) ? strategy.position_avg_price - (trailStop) : math.max(long_trail_stop_level, strategy.position_avg_price - (trailStop))
    else
        long_trail_stop_level := na
    plot_long_trail_stop := strategy.position_size > 0 ? long_trail_stop_level : na

if (tp_option) == '3) Full TP: Trailing Stop' and not is_end_of_session    
    strategy.exit("Short: Trailing TP", "Short", trail_price=na, trail_points=trailStop, trail_offset=na)
    strategy.exit("Short: Trail SL", "Short", stop=shortTrailSL_level)
    if (strategy.position_size < 0)
        short_trail_stop_level := na(short_trail_stop_level) ? strategy.position_avg_price + (trailStop) : math.min(short_trail_stop_level, strategy.position_avg_price + (trailStop))
    else
        short_trail_stop_level := na
    plot_short_trail_stop := strategy.position_size < 0 ? short_trail_stop_level : na

plot(not short_trail_stop_level ? plot_long_trail_stop : na, color=strategy.position_size > 0 ? color.yellow : color.new(color.blue, 100), title="Long Trailing Stop", linewidth=2, style=plot.style_line)
plot(not long_trail_stop_level ? plot_short_trail_stop : na, color=strategy.position_size < 0 ? color.blue : color.new(color.blue, 100), title="Short Trailing Stop", linewidth=2, style=plot.style_line)


if tp_option == '3) Full TP: Trailing Stop' and is_end_of_session
    strategy.close("Long", comment="End of Day")
    strategy.close("Short", comment="End of Day")


// MA
if (tp_option) == '4) Full TP: MA crossover/under' and not is_end_of_session
    strategy.exit("Long: MA TP/SL", "Long", loss=longv3stoploss_level, stop=trendMA)
    strategy.exit("Short: MA TP/SL", "Short", loss=shortv3stoploss_level, stop=trendMA)

if tp_option == '4) Full TP: MA crossover/under' and is_end_of_session
    strategy.close("Long", comment="End of Day")
    strategy.close("Short", comment="End of Day")


// Scalp
if (tp_option) == '5) Scalp: Points' and not is_end_of_session
    strategy.exit("Long: Scalp TP/SL", "Long", stop=longScalpSL_level, limit=longScalpTP_level)
    strategy.exit("Short: Scalp TP/SL", "Short", stop=shortScalpSL_level, limit=shortScalpTP_level)

if tp_option == '5) Scalp: Points' and is_end_of_session
    strategy.close("Long", comment="End of Day")
    strategy.close("Short", comment="End of Day")


// Full PMKT multiplier 
if tp_option == '6) Full TP: PMKT Multiplier' and not is_end_of_session
    strategy.exit("Long: Full PMKT Multiplier TP/SL", "Long", stop=orlongSL, limit=longv3takeprofit_level)
    strategy.exit("Short: Full PMKT Multiplier TP/SL", "Short", stop=orshortSL, limit=shortv3takeprofit_level)

if tp_option == '6) Full TP: PMKT Multiplier' and is_end_of_session
    strategy.close("Long", comment="End of Day")
    strategy.close("Short", comment="End of Day")

//@version=5
indicator('Opening Range & Daily and Weekly Pivots', shorttitle='ORB + Pivots', overlay=true)

YesterdayHigh = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, 'D', high[1], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)
YesterdayLow = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, 'D', low[1], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)

LastWeekHigh = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, 'W', high[1], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)
LastWeekLow = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, 'W', low[1], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)

today = year == year(timenow) and month == month(timenow) and dayofmonth == dayofmonth(timenow)

plot(today ? YesterdayHigh : na, style=plot.style_circles, color=color.new(color.green, 0), linewidth=2)
plot(today ? YesterdayLow : na, style=plot.style_circles, color=color.new(color.red, 0), linewidth=2)
plot(dayofweek==dayofweek(timenow) ? LastWeekHigh : na, style=plot.style_circles, color=color.new(#3912e7, 0), linewidth=2)
plot(dayofweek==dayofweek(timenow) ? LastWeekLow : na, style=plot.style_circles, color=color.new(color.purple, 0), linewidth=2)

alertcondition(close > YesterdayHigh, title='Breakout Above Yesterday High', message='We are now trading higher than the previous daily high.')
alertcondition(close < YesterdayLow, title='Breakdown Below Yesterday Low', message='We are now trading lower than the previous daily low.')
alertcondition(close > LastWeekHigh, title='Breakout Above Last Week High', message='We are now trading higher than the last week high.')
alertcondition(close < LastWeekLow, title='Breakdown Below Last Week Low', message='We are now trading lower than the last week low.')

inputMax = input(30, title= "ORB total time (minutes)")
sessionInput = input.session("0930-1000", title="ORB Timeframe")

t = time(timeframe.period, sessionInput)
hide = (timeframe.isintraday and timeframe.multiplier <= inputMax)

in_session = not na(t)
is_first = in_session and not in_session[1]

var float orb_high = 0.0
var float orb_low = 0.0

if is_first
    orb_high := high
    orb_low := low
else
    orb_high := orb_high[1]
    orb_low := orb_low[1]
if high > orb_high and in_session
    orb_high := high
if low < orb_low and in_session
    orb_low := low

plot(hide ? orb_high : na, style=plot.style_circles, color = close > orb_high ? color.rgb(168, 255, 17) : color.blue, title = "ORB High", linewidth = 1)
plot(hide ? orb_low : na, style=plot.style_circles, color = close < orb_low ? color.rgb(199, 55, 125) : color.white, title = "ORB Low", linewidth = 1)

alertcondition(close > orb_high, title='Breakout Above ORB High', message='Price has broken above the opening range.')
alertcondition(close < orb_low, title='Breakdown Below ORB Low', message='Price has broken below the opening range.')

hourOffSet = input.int(title="Hour offset for eastern time", defval=1, minval=0, maxval=24,tooltip="This value is subtracted from the input HH tmes to run for eastern time.")

// subtr
lineTimeHH_1 := lineTimeHH_1 - hourOffSet
lineTimeHH_2 := lineTimeHH_2 - hourOffSet
lineTimeHH_3 := lineTimeHH_3 - hourOffSet


var int bar_index_8am = 0 
var int bar_index_930am = 0 
var int bar_index_1030am = 0 

var float low8To930 = na
var float high8To930 = na

var float low930To1030 = na
var float high930To1030 = na

var float dt430pm = time

if (hour == 6)
	low8To930 := 999999
	high8To930 := 0 
	low930To1030 := 999999
	high930To1030 := 0

// get low and high values


// High Low between line and and line 2
if (hour == lineTimeHH_1 and minute >= lineTimeMM_1) or (hour==lineTimeHH_2 and minute <= (lineTimeMM_2-1)) 
	if close < low8To930 
		low8To930 := low
	if close > high8To930 
		high8To930 := high

if (hour == lineTimeHH_2 and minute >= lineTimeMM_2 ) or (hour==lineTimeHH_3 and minute <= (lineTimeMM_3)) 
	if close < low930To1030 
		low930To1030 := low
	if close > high930To1030 
		high930To1030 := high		

		
// Draw verticle lines 		
if (hour == lineTimeHH_1 and minute == lineTimeMM_1)
    Line8am = line.new(bar_index, close, bar_index, close * 1.01, extend = extend.both, color=color.green) // verticle line 1
    bar_index_8am := bar_index
   
if (hour == lineTimeHH_2 and minute == lineTimeMM_2)
    bar_index_930am := bar_index
    Line930am = line.new(bar_index, close, bar_index, close * 1.01 , extend = extend.both, color=color.green) // verticle line 2

    // Add lines for high/low between second set of verticle lines and extent to 4:30pm

	// Add  a lable to the line

if (hour==lineTimeHH_3 and minute==lineTimeMM_3)
    bar_index_1030am := bar_index
    Line1030am = line.new(bar_index, close, bar_index, close * 1.01, extend = extend.both, color=color.green) // Verticle line 3
    
    Bars930To1030 = bar_index - bar_index_930am 
    
    // Add lines for high/low between second set of verticle lines and extent to 4:30pm	
	line.new(timestamp(year, month, dayofmonth, lineTimeHH_2, lineTimeMM_2) , low930To1030, timestamp(year, month, dayofmonth, 16, 30) , low930To1030,  xloc = xloc.bar_time, color=color.white,width=1)  
	line.new(timestamp(year, month, dayofmonth, lineTimeHH_2, lineTimeMM_2) , high930To1030, timestamp(year, month, dayofmonth, 16, 30) , high930To1030,  xloc = xloc.bar_time, color=color.white,width=1)    
	
	label.new( timestamp(year, month, dayofmonth, 16, 30), low930To1030, 'OR - Low: '+str.tostring(low930To1030), xloc = xloc.bar_time,color = color.white,size =size.small,  textalign=text.align_right)	
	label.new( timestamp(year, month, dayofmonth, 16, 30), high930To1030, 'OR - High: '+str.tostring(high930To1030), xloc = xloc.bar_time,color = color.white,size =size.small,  textalign=text.align_right)	
    
sma5Plot=plot(ta.sma(close,5), title="MA5", color=color.white,  linewidth=2)

// @version=6
// @author Tristan Lee (tristanlee85)
// @license MPL-2.0
// @description Opening Range Projections — Visualizes ICT's 30-minute session range, projections, quadrant, and octant levels.
indicator("ICT Opening Range Projections (tristanlee85)", shorttitle="ICT ORP", overlay=true,
  max_lines_count=500, max_labels_count=500, max_boxes_count=500)

import tristanlee85/helpers/6 as lib

const string DATE_FORMAT          = "MM-dd (E)"
const string TIME_FORMAT          = "HH:mm"
const string NUMBER_FORMAT        = "#.0000"
const string TZ                   = "America/New_York"
const string MIDNIGHT_NAME        = "Midnight"
const string LONDON_NAME          = "London"
const string NY_AM_NAME           = "NY AM"
const string NY_AM_KZ_NAME        = "NY AM (KZ)"
const string NY_PM_NAME           = "NY PM"
const string ASIA_NAME            = "Asia"
const string USER_SESS1_NAME      = "User Session 1"
const string USER_SESS2_NAME      = "User Session 2"
const string USER_SESS3_NAME      = "User Session 3"
const string VALID_PERIOD_SECONDS = "1,5,15,30,60,300,600,900"
// Bracket settings
const int    BRACKET_WIDTH        = 2          // horizontal offset (bars)
const int    BRACKET_GAP          = 1          // horizontal offset (bars)
// How much vertical space to keep between wick and bracket.
// Pct of ATR keeps the gap proportional to instrument volatility.
// MIN = 2 ticks, MAX = 25% of ATR so it doesn't explode on very volatile symbols.
const float  BRACKET_GAP_ATR_PCT  = 0.01       // 1% of ATR
const string MIN_RANGE_TIP        = "Show the range high/low.\n\nThe minimum size, in ticks, required of a range in order to plot its levels.\n" + 
                                      "  0 to disable (default) - all range levels plotted regardless of size\n" + 
                                      "≥ 1 - range levels plotted ONLY if the size exceeds the minimum\n\n" +
                                      "If a range size is below the minimum, the below levels will still be plotted if enabed.\n" + 
                                      "NOTE: you must also have an option enabled in its section below or it will not plot below the minimum."

// @enum Projection label options
enum ProjectionLabelType
    stdev = "STDEV (e.g., 2.0 )"
    price = "Price (e.g., 12,345.00 )"
    both  = "Both  (e.g., 2.0 (12,345.00) )"

// @enum Range label options
enum RangeLabel
    HIGH    = "High"
    LOW     = "Low"
    CE      = "C.E."
    QUAD_25 = "25%"
    QUAD_75 = "75%"
    OCT_125 = "12.5%"
    OCT_375 = "37.5%"
    OCT_625 = "62.5%"
    OCT_875 = "87.5%"


// Inputs for Opening Range Sessions
string                session0000                = input.session("0000-0030"                    , title=""                                   , group="Opening Range Sessions", inline="sess1")
bool                  session0000Toggle          = input.bool(true                              , title="Midnight"                           , group="Opening Range Sessions", inline="sess1")
