bool                  session0130Toggle          = input.bool(false                             , title="London"                             , group="Opening Range Sessions", inline="sess2")
string                session0700                = input.session("0700-0730"                    , title=""                                   , group="Opening Range Sessions", inline="sess3")
bool                  session0700Toggle          = input.bool(false                             , title="NY AM KZ"                           , group="Opening Range Sessions", inline="sess3")
string                session0930                = input.session("0930-1000"                    , title=""                                   , group="Opening Range Sessions", inline="sess4")
bool                  session0930Toggle          = input.bool(true                              , title="NY AM"                              , group="Opening Range Sessions", inline="sess4")
string                session1330                = input.session("1330-1400"                    , title=""                                   , group="Opening Range Sessions", inline="sess5")
bool                  session1330Toggle          = input.bool(true                              , title="NY PM"                              , group="Opening Range Sessions", inline="sess5")
string                session2000                = input.session("2000-2030"                    , title=""                                   , group="Opening Range Sessions", inline="sess6")
bool                  session2000Toggle          = input.bool(false                             , title="Asia"                               , group="Opening Range Sessions", inline="sess6")
string                userSession1               = input.session(""                             , title=""                                   , group="Opening Range Sessions", inline="sess7")
bool                  userSession1Toggle         = input.bool(false                             , title="User Session 1"                     , group="Opening Range Sessions", inline="sess7")
string                userSession2               = input.session(""                             , title=""                                   , group="Opening Range Sessions", inline="sess8")
bool                  userSession2Toggle         = input.bool(false                             , title="User Session 2"                     , group="Opening Range Sessions", inline="sess8")
string                userSession3               = input.session(""                             , title=""                                   , group="Opening Range Sessions", inline="sess9") 
bool                  userSession3Toggle         = input.bool(false                             , title="User Session 3"                     , group="Opening Range Sessions", inline="sess9")
int                   numPrevSessions            = input.int(5                                  , title="Number Of Previous Sessions To Plot", group="Opening Range Sessions"                           , tooltip="Plotting too many sessions may result in lines not displaying due to charting limitations.")
// Inputs for Sessions
bool                  sessionsToggle             = input.bool(true                              , title="Enable"                             , group="Sessions"                                         , tooltip="Show session lines.")
color                 sessionsColor              = input.color(color.new(color.black, 50)     , title=""                                   , group="Sessions"              , inline="sessions"        )
lib.LineStyleType     sessionsStyle              = input.enum(lib.LineStyleType.SOLID           , title=""                                   , group="Sessions"              , inline="sessions"        )
int                   sessionsWidth              = input.int(1                                  , title="Width"                              , group="Sessions"              , inline="sessions"        , minval=1, maxval=5)
bool                  sessionsLabelToggle        = input.bool(true                              , title="Show Labels"                        , group="Sessions"              )
// Inputs for Opening Price
bool                  openingPriceToggle         = input.bool(true                              , title="Enable"                             , group="Opening Price"                                    , tooltip="Show opening price of the range.")
color                 openingPriceColor          = input.color(color.blue                     , title=""                                   , group="Opening Price"         , inline="opening_price"   )
lib.LineStyleType     openingPriceStyle          = input.enum(lib.LineStyleType.SOLID           , title=""                                   , group="Opening Price"         , inline="opening_price"   )
int                   openingPriceWidth          = input.int(1                                  , title="Width"                              , group="Opening Price"         , inline="opening_price"   , minval=1, maxval=5)
bool                  openingPriceLabelToggle    = input.bool(true                              , title="Show Labels"                        , group="Opening Price"         )
// Inputs for Range Levels
bool                  rangeLevelsToggle          = input.bool(true                              , title="Enable"                             , group="Range"                 , inline="range"           , tooltip=MIN_RANGE_TIP)
int                   minRangeTicks              = input.int(0                                  , title="Minimum Ticks For Range"            , group="Range"                 , inline="minTick"         )
color                 minRangeColor              = input.color(color.red                      , title=""                                   , group="Range"                 , inline="minTick"         , tooltip="Color of range bracket when below minimum")
bool                  minRangeOP                 = input.bool(true                              , title="Opening Price"                      , group="Range"                 , inline="min_range_opts")
bool                  minRangeRL                 = input.bool(true                              , title="Range H/L"                          , group="Range"                 , inline="min_range_opts")
bool                  minRangeCE                 = input.bool(true                              , title="C.E."                               , group="Range"                 , inline="min_range_opts")
bool                  minRangeQL                 = input.bool(true                              , title="Quadrants"                          , group="Range"                 , inline="min_range_opts")
bool                  minRangeOL                 = input.bool(false                             , title="Octants"                            , group="Range"                 , inline="min_range_opts")
bool                  minRangePR                 = input.bool(false                             , title="Projections"                        , group="Range"                 , inline="min_range_opts")

bool                  rangeLevelsFromSwingToggle = input.bool(false                             , title="Use Swing Points"                   , group="Range Levels"          , inline="range"           , tooltip="Enable to determine range from swing high/low; Disable to use absolute high/low")
color                 rangeLevelsColor           = input.color(color.new(color.purple, 0)     , title=""                                   , group="Range Levels"          , inline="range_style"     )
lib.LineStyleType     rangeLevelsStyle           = input.enum(lib.LineStyleType.SOLID           , title=""                                   , group="Range Levels"          , inline="range_style"     )

//@function Returns the appropriate style for a projection level based on its STDEV tier.
//@param    stdevAbs  Absolute STDEV value of the projection level.
//@returns  [color, lineStyle, width]
getProjectionStyle(float stdevAbs) =>
    color             c = projectionsColor
    lib.LineStyleType s = projectionsStyle
    int               w = projectionsWidth

    if projectionsUseTierStyle
        int stdevInt = int(math.round(stdevAbs * 1000))
        if (stdevInt % 500) != 0
            if (stdevInt % 250) == 0
                c := quadLevelsColor
                s := quadLevelsStyle
                w := quadLevelsWidth
            else
                c := octLevelsColor
                s := octLevelsStyle
                w := octLevelsWidth

    [c, s, w]

//@function Returns the vertical bracket gap in price units
getBracketGapY() =>
    float atr      = ta.atr(14)
    float barRange = high - low
    float tick     = syminfo.mintick

    // Convert % inputs to fractions
    float atrComponentPct  = bracketGapAtrPct / 100.0
    float barComponentPct  = bracketGapBarPct / 100.0
    float maxGapAtrPct     = bracketGapMaxAtrPct / 100.0

    // Core components
    float gapFromAtr = atr      * atrComponentPct
    float gapFromBar = barRange * barComponentPct

    // Start with whichever is larger
    float baseGap = math.max(gapFromAtr, gapFromBar)

    // Bar "visual density": large body in ticks ⇒ scale the gap up
    float barTicks = barRange / tick
    float densityFactor =
         barTicks > 0
             ? math.min(
                 bracketGapDensityMax,
                 math.max(1.0, barTicks / bracketGapDensityTicks)
               )
             : 1.0

    float gap = baseGap * densityFactor

    // Enforce minimum gap in ticks
    float minGap = tick * bracketGapMinTicks
    gap := math.max(gap, minGap)

    // Cap gap relative to ATR
    if atr > 0
        float maxGap = atr * maxGapAtrPct
        gap := math.min(gap, maxGap)

    gap

type GroupLine
    float top            = na
    float bottom         = na
    int   barIndex       = na
    line  topEar         = na
    line  bottomEar      = na
    line  topVertLine    = na
    line  bottomVertLine = na

method getVertLinesCoords(GroupLine this, int barIndex) =>
    // The vertical lines of the bracket need to account for the candle so as to not
    // overlap the wicks and make the candle range indistinguishable. Determine the
    // high/low of the candle and gap the lines accordingly.
    float topHigh    = na
    float topLow     = na
    float bottomHigh = na
    float bottomLow  = na

    // Calculated gap between vertical lines and candle wicks
    float gapY = getBracketGapY()

    // An offset of >=0 means the bracket will be positioned on top of a candle (current or historical).
    // Otherwise, it's to be positioned ahead of the current candle and therefore the line can be fully
    // drawn without overlapping a candle.
    int   barIndexOffset = bar_index - barIndex
    float _high          = this.top 
    float _low           = this.bottom

    // Bracket to be positioned on a candle
    if barIndexOffset >= 0
        _high := high[barIndexOffset]
        _low  := low[barIndexOffset]

        topHigh    := this.top
        topLow     := math.min(this.top, _high + gapY)
        bottomHigh := math.max(this.bottom, _low - gapY)
        bottomLow  := this.bottom

        
        // These checks ensure that vertical lines are not drawn beyond the range
        // when the bar's high/low is outside of the range.
        if topLow < this.bottom
            topLow := this.bottom

        if bottomHigh > this.top
            bottomHigh := this.top
    
    // Bracket positioned ahead of the candle
    else
        topHigh    := this.top // top of the range
        topLow     := this.top - (this.top - this.bottom) / 2 // range midpoint
        bottomHigh := topLow // range midpoint
        bottomLow  := this.bottom // bottom of the range

    [topHigh, topLow, bottomHigh, bottomLow]

method init(GroupLine this, float top, float bottom, int barIndex, color lineColor) =>
    // x1 (barIndex) refers to where the vertical group line is drawn.
    // x2 refers to where the bracket "ear" terminates, and will always be less than x1
    //      ──┐
    // (x2) ^ │
    //        │
    //        │
    //        │
    //      ──┘
    //        ^ (x1)


    int x1 = barIndex
    int x2 = barIndex - BRACKET_WIDTH
    color c = bracketColor

    if not na(lineColor)
        c := lineColor
    
    this.barIndex := barIndex
    this.top := top
    this.topEar := line.new(x1, top, x2, top, xloc=xloc.bar_index, color=c)
    this.bottom := bottom
    this.bottomEar := line.new(x1, bottom, x2, bottom, xloc=xloc.bar_index, color=c)

    [y1T, y2T, y1B, y2B] = this.getVertLinesCoords(barIndex)
    this.topVertLine := line.new(x1, y1T, x1, y2T, xloc=xloc.bar_index, color=c)
    this.bottomVertLine := line.new(x1, y1B, x1, y2B, xloc=xloc.bar_index, color=c)

method updateRange(GroupLine this, float top = na, float bottom = na, int barIndex = na) =>
    if not na(top)
        this.top := top
        this.topEar.set_y1(top)
        this.topEar.set_y2(top)
        this.topVertLine.set_y1(top)
    
    if not na(bottom)
        this.bottom := bottom
        this.bottomEar.set_y1(bottom)
        this.bottomEar.set_y2(bottom)
        this.topVertLine.set_y2(bottom)

    if not na(barIndex)
        int x1 = barIndex
        int x2 = barIndex - BRACKET_WIDTH
        [y1T, y2T, y1B, y2B] = this.getVertLinesCoords(barIndex)

        this.topEar.set_x1(x1)
        this.topEar.set_x2(x2)
        this.bottomEar.set_x1(x1)
        this.bottomEar.set_x2(x2)
        this.topVertLine.set_xy1(x1, y1T)
        this.topVertLine.set_xy2(x1, y2T)
        this.bottomVertLine.set_xy1(x1, y1B)
        this.bottomVertLine.set_xy2(x1, y2B)

method destroy(GroupLine this) =>
    this.topEar.delete()
    this.bottomEar.delete()
    this.topVertLine.delete()
    this.bottomVertLine.delete()

//@type Represents an opening range session
type OpeningRange
    // `true` for the very first bar update at the start of the session; `false` otherwise
    bool isNew = true
    // `true` once the session has ended and the bar state is confirmed (closed)
    bool isConfirmed = false
    // `true` once all drawings have been completed for the session and no further updates will be applied
    bool isFinal = false
    // bar_index of the start of the session
    int startIndex = na
    // time of the start of the session
    int startTime = na
    // bar_index of the end of the session
    int endIndex = na
    // time of the end of the session
    int endTime = na
    // opening price of the session
    float open_price = na
    // closing price of the session
    float close_price = na
    // lowest price within the range
    float range_low = na
    // highest price within the range
    float range_high = na
    // lowest swing low within the range
    float range_swing_low = na
    // highest swing high within the range
    float range_swing_high = na
    float dynamicLow = na
    float dynamicHigh = na
    float effectiveStep = na
    bool qualified = true
    array<line> sessionLines = na
    array<lib.LineLabel> lines
    array<lib.LineLabel> subLevelProjections
    GroupLine group = na

//@method       Gets the range size
//@param this   (OpeningRange)
method rangeSize(OpeningRange this) => 
    rangeLevelsFromSwingToggle and not na(this.range_swing_high) and not na(this.range_swing_low)
      ? this.range_swing_high - this.range_swing_low
      : this.range_high - this.range_low

method canShowOption(OpeningRange this, bool optionToggle, bool minToggle) =>
    optionToggle and (
      minRangeTicks == 0 or // min ticks disabled
      this.rangeSize() >= minRangeTicks or  // range size satisfies limit
      (this.rangeSize() < minRangeTicks) and (optionToggle == minToggle) // range size below limit but option is set to display anyway
      )

//@method       Removes all drawn lines and labels for the range
//@param this   (OpeningRange)
method destroy(OpeningRange this) =>
    for l in this.lines
        l.destroy()
    
    if not na(this.group)
        this.group.destroy()

// Validations

// Chart data is based on the 1m timeframe which we can calculate up to 15m, but anything beyond that

var array<string> tfs = str.split(VALID_PERIOD_SECONDS, ",")

if not isValidProjectionValue

// -- MAIN EXECUTION -- //

// Determine active session on *every* update based on time
isNewSessionBar := false

lib.Session active = na

// Find which session (if any) is currently active at `time`
for [_, sess] in sessions
    if sess.enabled and sess.isActive(time)
        active := sess
        break

if not na(active)
    // New session if start timestamp changed
    if na(currentSession) or currentSession.start != active.start
        // Remember previous session (copy so it's not mutated later)
        if not na(currentSession)
            lastSession := currentSession.copy()
        // Track new session
        currentSession := active.copy()
        isNewSessionBar := true
else
    // No configured session active on this bar
    currentSession := na

// Get the bar data for 1m
[_open, _high, _low, _close, _time, _bar, _isNewBar, _isConfirmedBar] = request.security_lower_tf(
  syminfo.tickerid,  
  timeframe.in_seconds(timeframe.period) > 60 ? "1" : "", 
  [open, high, low, close, time, bar_index, barstate.isnew, barstate.isconfirmed])

debugger.group("main")
for [i, val] in _time
    debugger.log("Getting security values ", lib.kv("_time size", _time.size()))
    __open = _open.get(i)
    __high = _high.get(i)
    __low = _low.get(i)
    __close = _close.get(i)
    __time = _time.get(i)
    __bar_index = _bar.get(i)
    __isConfirmedBar = _isConfirmedBar.get(i)

    // This lower-TF bar starts a new session if:
    //  - we just detected a new active session on the chart (`isNewSessionBar`)
    //  - AND this 1m bar's time equals the session's start timestamp.
    bool isNewSession = false
    if isNewSessionBar and not na(currentSession)
        isNewSession := __time == currentSession.start

    // Create a new range if it is a new session, removing the oldest range if necessary
    if isNewSession
        debugger.log("New opening range")

        // Strip sub-0.5 projection lines from all previous ranges
        if projectionsSubLevelsCurrentOnly
            for [_, _r] in ranges
                if not na(_r) and not na(_r.subLevelProjections) and _r.subLevelProjections.size() > 0
                    for sl in _r.subLevelProjections
                        sl.destroy()
                    _r.subLevelProjections.clear()

        r := OpeningRange.new(startIndex=bar_index, startTime=currentSession.start, endTime=currentSession.end, open_price=__open)
        r.lines := array.new<lib.LineLabel>()
        r.subLevelProjections := array.new<lib.LineLabel>()
        r.sessionLines := array.new<line>()
        
        // Remove old range
        if (array.size(ranges) >= numPrevSessions)
            OpeningRange _r = array.pop(ranges)

            if not na(_r)
                _r.destroy()

        // Add new range
        array.unshift(ranges, r)

    // Determine if a range has yet been established. The will only be false until the first instance, then always
    // true. This condition's only purpose is to avoid the runtime error when the first bar is painted.
    debugger.log("Current range", str.tostring(not na(r)))
    if not na(r)
        bool extendLines     = false
        bool showOpenPrice   = r.canShowOption(openingPriceToggle, minRangeOP)
        bool showRangeHL     = r.canShowOption(rangeLevelsToggle, minRangeRL)
        bool showRangeCE     = r.canShowOption(ceLevelsToggle, minRangeCE)
        bool showRangeQuads  = r.canShowOption(quadLevelsToggle, minRangeQL)
        bool showRangeOcts   = r.canShowOption(octLevelsToggle, minRangeOL)
        bool showProjections = r.canShowOption(projectionsToggle, minRangePR)
        bool showBracket     = showRangeHL or showProjections

        // Current 1m bar’s relationship to the OR session
        bool inSessionBar   = __time < r.endTime
        bool atOrAfterEnd   = __time >= r.endTime
        bool shouldFinalize = atOrAfterEnd and __isConfirmedBar and not r.isFinal

        var lib.LineLabel latestOpeningPriceLine = na
        float rangeSize = r.rangeSize()

        r.isNew := isNewSession
        sT = r.startTime
        sI = r.startIndex
        eT = r.endTime
        eI = r.endIndex
        rH = not na(r.range_swing_high) ? r.range_swing_high : r.range_high
        rL = not na(r.range_swing_low) ? r.range_swing_low : r.range_low

        // [NEW] Start of a new opening range session
        if r.isNew
            // Draw vertical session lines
            if sessionsToggle
                debugger.log("Drawing session lines")
                r.sessionLines.push(line.new(
                  x1=sT, y1=__open, x2=sT, y2=__open+1, extend=extend.both, xloc=xloc.bar_time,
                  color=sessionsColor, style=lib.style_getLineStyleFromType(sessionsStyle), width=sessionsWidth
                  ))
                r.sessionLines.push(line.new(
                  x1=eT, y1=__open, x2=eT, y2=__open+1, extend=extend.both, xloc=xloc.bar_time,
                  color=sessionsColor, style=lib.style_getLineStyleFromType(sessionsStyle), width=sessionsWidth
                  ))
                    
            // Draw opening price line. This line draws as soon as the session opens since it is static for the range,
            // unlike the other render options which require the full range to be established before rendering.
            // We can disable this line at the end of the session if the min range size was not met.
            debugger.log("Drawing opening price")
            latestOpeningPriceLine := lib.LineLabel.new(
              x=sI, y=__open, 
              color=openingPriceColor, lineStyle=openingPriceStyle, width=openingPriceWidth,
              label=lib.format_timeToString(sT), showLabel=openingPriceLabelToggle
              ).draw()
            r.lines.push(latestOpeningPriceLine)

        // [UPDATE] Bar state is confirmed and still active within the session
        if __isConfirmedBar and inSessionBar
            debugger.group("range")

            // Update the current range properties while the session is still forming
            if not r.isConfirmed
                debugger.log("Updating current properties")
                r.endIndex    := bar_index
                r.close_price := __close
                r.range_low   := math.min(nz(r.range_low, __low), __low)
                r.range_high  := math.max(nz(r.range_high, __low), __high)

                // Determine range high/low from swing points
                if rangeLevelsFromSwingToggle and __bar_index[2] >= r.startIndex
                    // swing high
                    if __high < __high[1] and __high[2] < __high[1] and __high[1] > nz(r.range_swing_high, __low[1])
                        r.range_swing_high := __high[1]

                    // swing low
                    if __low > __low[1] and __low[2] > __low[1] and __low[1] < nz(r.range_swing_low, __high[1])
                        r.range_swing_low := __low[1]

            debugger.groupEnd("range")

        // [END] Session has ended and the range should be finalized
        if shouldFinalize
            debugger.group("range")

            // Mark range as confirmed the first time we go past the end
            r.isConfirmed := true
            // Ending of the session/range
            if not r.isFinal
                debugger.log("Opening range ended")
                r.isFinal    := true
                r.qualified  := r.rangeSize() >= minRangeTicks

                // Create the bracket if there is a visible range or projections
                if showBracket
                    r.group := GroupLine.new()
                    r.group.init(top=rH, bottom=rL, barIndex=eI, lineColor=r.qualified ? bracketColor : minRangeColor)

                // Opening Price (remove if not qualified)
                if not showOpenPrice and not na(latestOpeningPriceLine)
                    latestOpeningPriceLine.destroy()

                // Range H/L Levels
                if showRangeHL
                    debugger.log("Drawing range low/high", lib.kv("low", rL), lib.kv("high", rH))
                    // Range low
                    r.lines.push(lib.LineLabel.new(
                      x=sI, y=rL, 
                      color=rangeLevelsColor, lineStyle=rangeLevelsStyle, width=rangeLevelsWidth,
                      label=str.tostring(RangeLabel.LOW), showLabel=rangeLevelsLabelToggle
                      ).draw())
                    // Range high
                    r.lines.push(lib.LineLabel.new(
                      x=sI, y=rH,
                      color=rangeLevelsColor, lineStyle=rangeLevelsStyle, width=rangeLevelsWidth,
                      label=str.tostring(RangeLabel.HIGH), showLabel=rangeLevelsLabelToggle
                      ).draw())
                
                // Consequent Encroachment (50% midpoint)
                if showRangeCE
                    float priceCE = rL + (0.50 * (rH - rL))
                    debugger.log("Drawing C.E.", lib.kv("50%", priceCE))

                    r.lines.push(lib.LineLabel.new(
                      x=sI, y=priceCE,
                      color=ceLevelsColor, lineStyle=ceLevelsStyle, width=ceLevelsWidth,
                      label=str.tostring(RangeLabel.CE), showLabel=ceLabelToggle
                      ).draw())

                // Range Quadrants (25%, 75%)
                if showRangeQuads
                    float diff = rH - rL
                    float price25 = rL + (0.25 * diff)
                    float price75 = rL + (0.75 * diff)

                    debugger.log("Drawing quadrants", lib.kv("75%", price75), lib.kv("25%", price25))

                    // 25%
                    r.lines.push(lib.LineLabel.new(
                      x=sI, y=price25, 
                      color=quadLevelsColor, lineStyle=quadLevelsStyle, width=quadLevelsWidth,
                      label=str.tostring(RangeLabel.QUAD_25), showLabel=quadLabelToggle
                      ).draw())
                    // 75%
                    r.lines.push(lib.LineLabel.new(
                      x=sI, y=price75, 
                      color=quadLevelsColor, lineStyle=quadLevelsStyle, width=quadLevelsWidth,
                      label=str.tostring(RangeLabel.QUAD_75), showLabel=quadLabelToggle
                      ).draw())

                // Range Octants
                if showRangeOcts
                    float diff = rH - rL
                    float price125 = rL + (0.125 * diff)
                    float price375 = rL + (0.375 * diff)
                    float price625 = rL + (0.625 * diff)
                    float price875 = rL + (0.875 * diff)

                    debugger.log("Drawing octants",
                      lib.kv("87.5%", price875), lib.kv("62.5%", price625),
                      lib.kv("37.5%", price375), lib.kv("12.5%", price125))

                    // 12.5%
                    r.lines.push(lib.LineLabel.new(
                      x=sI, y=price125,
                      color=octLevelsColor, lineStyle=octLevelsStyle, width=octLevelsWidth,
                      label=str.tostring(RangeLabel.OCT_125), showLabel=octLabelToggle
                      ).draw())
                    // 37.5%
                    r.lines.push(lib.LineLabel.new(
                      x=sI, y=price375,
                      color=octLevelsColor, lineStyle=octLevelsStyle, width=octLevelsWidth,
                      label=str.tostring(RangeLabel.OCT_375), showLabel=octLabelToggle
                      ).draw())
                    // 62.5%
                    r.lines.push(lib.LineLabel.new(
                      x=sI, y=price625,
                      color=octLevelsColor, lineStyle=octLevelsStyle, width=octLevelsWidth,
                      label=str.tostring(RangeLabel.OCT_625), showLabel=octLabelToggle
                      ).draw())
                    // 87.5%
                    r.lines.push(lib.LineLabel.new(
                      x=sI, y=price875,
                      color=octLevelsColor, lineStyle=octLevelsStyle, width=octLevelsWidth,
                      label=str.tostring(RangeLabel.OCT_875), showLabel=octLabelToggle
                      ).draw())
                
                // Compute effective step (ATR-relative suppression clamps sub-0.5 levels)
                float atr14 = ta.atr(14)
                r.effectiveStep := projectionsStep
                if projectionsMinRangeATR > 0 and not na(atr14) and atr14 > 0
                    if (rangeSize / atr14 * 100) < projectionsMinRangeATR
                        r.effectiveStep := math.max(r.effectiveStep, 0.5)

                // Projections
                debugger.group("projections")
                debugger.log("Can show projections", lib.kv("showProjections", showProjections),
                  lib.kv("effectiveStep", r.effectiveStep))
                if showProjections
                    float priceLow = na
                    float priceHigh = na

                    if not projectionsDynamic
                        float maxStd = math.max(r.effectiveStep, projectionsSTD)
                        for lvl = 1 to int(maxStd / r.effectiveStep)
                            float stdevValue = lvl * r.effectiveStep
                            priceLow  := rL - (stdevValue * rangeSize)
                            priceHigh := rH + (stdevValue * rangeSize)
                            [pColor, pStyle, pWidth] = getProjectionStyle(stdevValue)
                            debugger.log("Drawing fixed projection",
                              lib.kv(str.format("{0}", -stdevValue), priceLow),
                              lib.kv(str.format("{0}", stdevValue), priceHigh))

                            lib.LineLabel lowLine = lib.LineLabel.new(
                              x=sI, y=priceLow,
                              color=pColor, lineStyle=pStyle, width=pWidth,
                              label=formatProjectionLabel(-stdevValue, priceLow), showLabel=projectionLabelToggle
                              ).draw()
                            lib.LineLabel highLine = lib.LineLabel.new(
                              x=sI, y=priceHigh,
                              color=pColor, lineStyle=pStyle, width=pWidth,
                              label=formatProjectionLabel(stdevValue, priceHigh), showLabel=projectionLabelToggle
                              ).draw()
                            r.lines.push(lowLine)
                            r.lines.push(highLine)

                            // Track sub-0.5 projections for potential cleanup
                            int stdevInt = int(math.round(stdevValue * 1000))
                            if (stdevInt % 500) != 0
                                r.subLevelProjections.push(lowLine)
                                r.subLevelProjections.push(highLine)

                            r.group.updateRange(top=priceHigh, bottom=priceLow)
                            debugger.log("Extending fixed group line", lib.kv("top", priceHigh), lib.kv("bottom", priceLow))
                    
                    // Set the initial dynamic level extremes
                    else
                        debugger.log("Setting initial dynamic high/low", lib.kv("high", rH), lib.kv("low", rL))
                        r.dynamicLow := rL
                        r.dynamicHigh := rH
                debugger.groupEnd("projections")
            debugger.groupEnd("range")                

        debugger.group("projections_dynamic")
        debugger.log("Dynamic projections enabled?", lib.kv("", showProjections and projectionsDynamic))
        if showProjections and projectionsDynamic
            float rangeSize      = r.rangeSize()
            float dynStep        = nz(r.effectiveStep, projectionsStep)
            float triggerStep    = math.max(dynStep, 0.5)
            int   subLevels      = int(triggerStep / dynStep)
            float triggerDelta   = triggerStep * rangeSize

            if rangeSize > 0
                // Price at or below the lowest level — fire trigger and draw sub-levels
                debugger.log("Is current low <= dynamic low", str.tostring(__low <= r.dynamicLow), lib.kv("low", __low), lib.kv("dynamic", r.dynamicLow))
                while __low <= r.dynamicLow
                    float basePriceLow = r.dynamicLow
                    r.dynamicLow := basePriceLow - triggerDelta
                    debugger.log("Dynamic low trigger", lib.kv("base", basePriceLow), lib.kv("newDynamic", r.dynamicLow))

                    bool anyDrawn = false
                    for subLvl = 1 to subLevels
                        float levelPrice = basePriceLow - subLvl * dynStep * rangeSize
                        float levelStdev = -(r.range_low - levelPrice) / rangeSize

                        if projectionsSTD != 0 and math.abs(levelStdev) > projectionsSTD
                            continue

                        anyDrawn := true
                        [pColor, pStyle, pWidth] = getProjectionStyle(math.abs(levelStdev))
                        debugger.log("Creating dynamic low projection", lib.kv("stdev", levelStdev), lib.kv("price", levelPrice))
                        lib.LineLabel dynLine = lib.LineLabel.new(
                          x=r.startIndex, y=levelPrice,
                          color=pColor, lineStyle=pStyle, width=pWidth,
                          label=formatProjectionLabel(levelStdev, levelPrice), showLabel=projectionLabelToggle
                          ).draw()
                        r.lines.push(dynLine)

                        int stdevInt = int(math.round(math.abs(levelStdev) * 1000))
                        if (stdevInt % 500) != 0
                            r.subLevelProjections.push(dynLine)

                        r.group.updateRange(bottom=levelPrice)

                    // All sub-levels exceeded the STDEV ceiling; future triggers will too
                    if projectionsSTD != 0 and not anyDrawn
                        break

                // Price at or above the highest level — fire trigger and draw sub-levels
                debugger.log("Is current high >= dynamic high", str.tostring(__high >= r.dynamicHigh), lib.kv("high", __high), lib.kv("dynamic", r.dynamicHigh))
                while __high >= r.dynamicHigh
                    float basePriceHigh = r.dynamicHigh
                    r.dynamicHigh := basePriceHigh + triggerDelta
                    debugger.log("Dynamic high trigger", lib.kv("base", basePriceHigh), lib.kv("newDynamic", r.dynamicHigh))

                    bool anyDrawn = false
                    for subLvl = 1 to subLevels
                        float levelPrice = basePriceHigh + subLvl * dynStep * rangeSize
                        float levelStdev = (levelPrice - r.range_high) / rangeSize

                        if projectionsSTD != 0 and math.abs(levelStdev) > projectionsSTD
                            continue

                        anyDrawn := true
                        [pColor, pStyle, pWidth] = getProjectionStyle(math.abs(levelStdev))
                        debugger.log("Creating dynamic high projection", lib.kv("stdev", levelStdev), lib.kv("price", levelPrice))
                        lib.LineLabel dynLine = lib.LineLabel.new(
                          x=r.startIndex, y=levelPrice,
                          color=pColor, lineStyle=pStyle, width=pWidth,
                          label=formatProjectionLabel(levelStdev, levelPrice), showLabel=projectionLabelToggle
                          ).draw()
                        r.lines.push(dynLine)

                        int stdevInt = int(math.round(math.abs(levelStdev) * 1000))
                        if (stdevInt % 500) != 0
                            r.subLevelProjections.push(dynLine)

                        r.group.updateRange(top=levelPrice)

                    // All sub-levels exceeded the STDEV ceiling; future triggers will too
                    if projectionsSTD != 0 and not anyDrawn
                        break
        debugger.groupEnd("projections_dynamic")

        // Extend the levels for the range
        // Range lines need to factor in the gap between the bracket if applicable
        //                      ⌄  (offset bar index)
        // (high) ─────────────── ──┐
        //                 (gap) ^  │
        //                          │
        // (c.e.) ---------------   │
        //                          │
        //                          │
        // (low)  ─────────────── ──┘
        //                        ^ ^
        //                      (width)
               
        debugger.group("extend_lines")

        // baseIndex = logical anchoring point for this range (end of session / current bar)
        [baseIndex, done] = switch lineExtension
            lib.SessionExtendType.CURRENT_SESSION => [r.endIndex, __time > r.endTime]
            lib.SessionExtendType.NEXT_SESSION    => [bar_index, false]
            lib.SessionExtendType.CURRENT_BAR     => [bar_index, false]

        // Apply user-configured extension offset so that bracket + lines
        // can extend ahead of the current bar.
        int BRACKET_OFFSET = BRACKET_GAP + BRACKET_WIDTH
        int bracketIndex   = baseIndex + bracketOffset          // where the vertical bracket line lives
        int offsetBarIndex = bracketIndex - BRACKET_OFFSET     // where the horizontal lines terminate

        debugger.log(
          "Extend levels",
          lib.kv("type", str.tostring(lineExtension)),
          lib.kv("baseIndex", baseIndex),
          lib.kv("bracketIndex", bracketIndex),
          lib.kv("offsetBarIndex", offsetBarIndex),
          lib.kv("done", done)
          )

        // Extend all range lines to the desired index
        for l in r.lines
            l.extend(offsetBarIndex)

        // Move the bracket to the same extension point
        if not na(r.group)
            r.group.updateRange(barIndex=bracketIndex)

        // Handle extending all previous ranges levels. We'll stack each range so they can be more easily distinguished.
        if lineExtension == lib.SessionExtendType.CURRENT_BAR
            // Iterate in reverse so the lines are stacked from oldest to newest
            int groupOffset = 5
            int length      = ranges.size()
            for int rI = length - 1 to 0
                OpeningRange _r = ranges.get(rI)
                int stackOffset = rI * groupOffset

                debugger.log(
                  "Extending previous range lines",
                  lib.kv("rI", rI),
                  lib.kv("range na?", na(_r)),
                  lib.kv("stackOffset", stackOffset)
                  )

                if not na(_r)
                    int prevBracketIndex   = baseIndex + bracketOffset - stackOffset
                    int prevOffsetBarIndex = prevBracketIndex - BRACKET_OFFSET

                    for l in _r.lines
                        l.extend(prevOffsetBarIndex)

                    if not na(_r.group)
                        _r.group.updateRange(barIndex=prevBracketIndex)
        
        // Lines are extended up to the start of the next session
        else if lineExtension == lib.SessionExtendType.NEXT_SESSION
            // At the start of a new range, do the final extend for the previous range
            if r.isNew and array.size(ranges) > 1
                OpeningRange prev = array.get(ranges, 1)

                if not na(prev)
                    debugger.log("Terminate previous range levels", lib.kv("BRACKET_OFFSET", BRACKET_OFFSET))
                    for l in prev.lines
                        l.extend(r.startIndex - BRACKET_OFFSET - BRACKET_GAP)
                    
                    if not na(prev.group)
                        prev.group.updateRange(barIndex=r.startIndex - 1)
        
        debugger.groupEnd("extend_lines")
debugger.groupEnd("main")

// Plot session labels
const string OPENING_RANGE_TITLE = "Opening Range\n"
int plotOffset = (30 / (timeframe.in_seconds(timeframe.period) / 60)) / 2 // Default to 30 mins
bool canPlotRangeLabels = false

if not na(currentSession)
    canPlotRangeLabels := sessionsToggle and sessionsLabelToggle and barstate.isnew and time == currentSession.start


plotchar(canPlotRangeLabels and currentSession.start == SESS_1.start
   , text=OPENING_RANGE_TITLE + MIDNIGHT_NAME  , location=location.top, color=color(na)
   , textcolor=sessionsColor, offset=plotOffset, display=display.none)
plotchar(canPlotRangeLabels and currentSession.start == SESS_2.start
   , text=OPENING_RANGE_TITLE + LONDON_NAME    , location=location.top, color=color(na)
   , textcolor=sessionsColor, offset=plotOffset, display=display.none)
plotchar(canPlotRangeLabels and currentSession.start == SESS_3.start
   , text=OPENING_RANGE_TITLE + NY_AM_KZ_NAME  , location=location.top, color=color(na)
   , textcolor=sessionsColor, offset=plotOffset, display=display.none)
plotchar(canPlotRangeLabels and currentSession.start == SESS_4.start
   , text=OPENING_RANGE_TITLE + NY_AM_NAME     , location=location.top, color=color(na)
   , textcolor=sessionsColor, offset=plotOffset, display=display.none)
plotchar(canPlotRangeLabels and currentSession.start == SESS_5.start
   , text=OPENING_RANGE_TITLE + NY_PM_NAME     , location=location.top, color=color(na)
   , textcolor=sessionsColor, offset=plotOffset, display=display.none)
plotchar(canPlotRangeLabels and currentSession.start == SESS_6.start
   , text=OPENING_RANGE_TITLE + ASIA_NAME      , location=location.top, color=color(na)
   , textcolor=sessionsColor, offset=plotOffset, display=display.none)
plotchar(canPlotRangeLabels and currentSession.start == SESS_7.start
   , text=OPENING_RANGE_TITLE + USER_SESS1_NAME, location=location.top, color=color(na)
   , textcolor=sessionsColor, offset=plotOffset, display=display.none)
plotchar(canPlotRangeLabels and currentSession.start == SESS_8.start
   , text=OPENING_RANGE_TITLE + USER_SESS2_NAME, location=location.top, color=color(na)
   , textcolor=sessionsColor, offset=plotOffset, display=display.none)
plotchar(canPlotRangeLabels and currentSession.start == SESS_9.start

items.name: Michigandolf's 30min Opening Range (w/Extensions)
items.title: Michigandolf's 30min Opening Range (w/Extensions)
items.author: Michigandolf
items.source:
//@version=4
study("Michigandolf's 30min Opening Range (w/Extensions)", shorttitle="Michigandolf's OR Extensions", overlay = true)

input_or = input("0930-1000", type=input.session, title="Opening Range Time (EST)", tooltip="The duration of the opening range to be drawn.")

// Inputs
input_rth = input("0930-1600", type=input.session, title="Regular Session Time (EST)", tooltip="If you want to get full session (including overnight) high/low values, then change the regular session interval.  For example, on a 5-mninute chart, 1800-1655 will provide the high and low for the full daily session.")
or_session = time(timeframe.period,str.format("{0}:1234567", input_or), "America/New_York")
rth_session = time("1440",str.format("{0}:23456", input_rth), "America/New_York")

// Opening Range
var or_high = 0.0
var or_low = 0.0


if or_session
    if not or_session[1]
        or_low := low
        or_high := high
    else
        or_low := min(low, or_low)
        or_high := max(high, or_high)
        
        
or_mid = or_low + ((or_high - or_low) / 2)
or_ext1A = or_high - or_mid
or_ext1 = or_high + or_ext1A
or_ext2 = or_high + (or_ext1A*2)
or_ext3 = or_high + (or_ext1A*3)
or_ext4 = or_high + (or_ext1A*4)

or_ext1B = or_low - or_ext1A
or_ext2B = or_low - (or_ext1A*2)
or_ext3B = or_low - (or_ext1A*3)
or_ext4B = or_low - (or_ext1A*4)


// RTH High/Low

var float rth_high = na
var float rth_low = na 
var float prior_rth_high = na
var float prior_rth_low = na

if rth_session
    if not rth_session[1]
        rth_low := low
        rth_high := high
    else
        rth_low := min(low, rth_low)
        rth_high := max(high, rth_high)
else 
    prior_rth_low := rth_low
    prior_rth_high := rth_high


// Plots

or_high_plot = plot(not or_session ? or_high : na, title="ORH", color=#268FFF, linewidth=2, style=plot.style_linebr)
or_low_plot = plot(not or_session ? or_low : na, title="ORL", color=#FF217E, linewidth=2, style=plot.style_linebr)
or_1A = plot(not or_session ? or_ext1 : na, title="1A", color=#B2B5BE, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
or_2A = plot(not or_session ? or_ext2 : na, title="2A", color=#B2B5BE, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
or_3A = plot(not or_session ? or_ext3 : na, title="3A", color=#B2B5BE, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
or_4A = plot(not or_session ? or_ext4 : na, title="4A", color=#B2B5BE, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)

or_1B = plot(not or_session ? or_ext1B : na, title="1B", color=#B2B5BE, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
or_2B = plot(not or_session ? or_ext2B : na, title="2B", color=#B2B5BE, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
or_3B = plot(not or_session ? or_ext3B : na, title="3B", color=#B2B5BE, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
or_4B = plot(not or_session ? or_ext4B : na, title="4B", color=#B2B5BE, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)


plot(not or_session ? or_mid : na, title="ORM", color=#FFFFFF, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)

fill(or_high_plot, or_low_plot, title="OR Fill", color=color.new(color.white, 97))


plot(not rth_session ? rth_high : prior_rth_high, title="RTH", color=#1BE091, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_line)
plot(not rth_session ? rth_low : prior_rth_low, title="RTL", color=#E02B16, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_line)

items.name: ChartMojo Opening 1 min. range -V1
items.title: ChartMojo Opening 1 min. range -V1
items.author: chartmojo
items.source:
study(title="ChartMojo Opening 1 min. range -V1", shorttitle="ChartMojo_Open1min", overlay=true)

up30on = input(false, title="30 Minute Opening Range High")
down30on = input(false, title="30 Minute Opening Range Low")
up1on = input(true, title="1 Minute Opening Range High")
down1on = input(true, title="1 Minute Opening Range Low")
is_newbar(res) => change(time(res)) != 0 
adopt(r, s) => security(tickerid, r, s) 

high_range = valuewhen(is_newbar('D'),high,0)
low_range = valuewhen(is_newbar('D'),low,0)

high_rangeL = valuewhen(is_newbar('D'),high,0) 
low_rangeL = valuewhen(is_newbar('D'),low,0) 

up = plot(up1on ? adopt('1', high_range):na, color = lime, style=circles, linewidth=4)
down = plot(down1on ? adopt('1', low_range): na, color = #DC143C, style=circles, linewidth=4) 

trans30 = up30on ?  75 : 100
fill(up, down, color = white, transp=trans30)

up30 = plot(up30on ? adopt('30', high_rangeL): na, color = #7FFF00, style=circles, linewidth=2) 
down30 = plot(down30on ? adopt('30', low_rangeL): na, color = red, style=circles, linewidth=2)

// This source code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
// © Bhangerang with help by @RexDogActual as well as permission to publish

//@version=5
indicator("RD Opening Range", "RD-OR", overlay=true, max_bars_back=5000)

// inputs
show_table = input.bool(true, "Display Data Panel", group = "options")
opening_session = input.session("0830-0930", "Opening Raing Session Time", group = "time")
timeZone = input.string("CST6CDT", title="Time Zone", group = "time")
main_color = input.color(color.gray, "Main Color", group = "line settings")
sub_color = input.color(color.new(color.gray,40), "Mid/50% Line Color", group = "line settings")

// © asenski at gmail dot com
//@version=6
indicator("Opening Range with Fibs", "OR", overlay=true, max_boxes_count=500)

orSpec = input.session("0930-1000", "Opening Range with Fib Extensions")
refsym = input.symbol("SPX500USD", "Reference for time range (So that it is in EST)")

rgColor = input.color(color.rgb(255, 255, 0), "Range color")
// L1Color = input.color(color.rgb(0, 0, 255), "L1 color")
// L2Color = input.color(color.rgb(255, 115, 40), "L2 color")
// L3Color = input.color(color.rgb(255, 0, 255), "L3 color")

L1 = input.float(1.272, "L1")
L2 = input.float(1.618, "L2")
// L3 = input.float(2.618, "L3")

t = request.security(refsym, timeframe.period, time(timeframe.period, orSpec), gaps=barmerge.gaps_on)

var float orh = na
var float orl = na
var int orbars = 0

var float extL1up = na
var float extL2up = na
var float extL3up = na
var float extL1dn = na
var float extL2dn = na
var float extL3dn = na

newSession = na(t[1]) and not na(t)
inSession = not na(t[1]) and not na(t)
endSession = not na(t[1]) and na(t)

if newSession
    orh := high
    orl := low
    orbars := 0
    extL1up := na
    extL2up := na
    extL3up := na
    extL1dn := na
    extL2dn := na
    extL3dn := na

if inSession
    orh := math.max(high, orh)
    orl := math.min(low, orl)
    orbars += 1

var float vwapsum = na
var float volumesum = na

if endSession
    extL1up := orl + (orh - orl) * L1
    extL2up := orl + (orh - orl) * L2
    // extL3up := orl + (orh - orl) * L3

    extL1dn := orh - (orh - orl) * L1
    extL2dn := orh - (orh - orl) * L2
    // extL3dn := orh - (orh - orl) * L3

    b1 = box.new(bar_index - orbars - 1, orh, bar_index - 1, orl, border_color = rgColor, bgcolor = na)
    b2 = box.new(bar_index - orbars - 1, extL1up, bar_index - 1, extL2up, border_color = rgColor, bgcolor = na)
    b3 = box.new(bar_index - orbars - 1, extL1dn, bar_index - 1, extL2dn, border_color = rgColor, bgcolor = na)
    if barstate.islast
        box.delete(b1[1])
        box.delete(b2[1])
        box.delete(b3[1])

//plot(newSession ? na : orl, "OR low", color=rgColor,style=plot.style_linebr)

//plot(newSession ? na : extL1dn, "L1 below", color=L1Color, style=plot.style_linebr)

// SESSION TIME CALCULATION
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
calcEndTime(simple string startTime, simple string duration) =>
    startHour = math.floor(str.tonumber(str.substring(startTime, 0, 2)))
    startMin = math.floor(str.tonumber(str.substring(startTime, 2, 4)))

    addMins = switch duration
        "5 Min" => 5
        "15 Min" => 15
        "30 Min" => 30
        "1 Hour" => 60
        => 0

    totalMins = startMin + addMins
    endHour = startHour + math.floor(totalMins / 60)
    endMin = totalMins % 60

    endHourStr = endHour < 10 ? "0" + str.tostring(endHour) : str.tostring(endHour)
    endMinStr = endMin < 10 ? "0" + str.tostring(endMin) : str.tostring(endMin)

    endHourStr + endMinStr

// Build session strings based on mode
orbEndTime = orbDuration == "Custom" ? orbCustomEnd : calcEndTime(orbStartTime, orbDuration)
orbSession = orbStartTime + "-" + orbEndTime

pdSession = pdSource == "RTH Only" ? rthStart + "-" + rthEnd : fullSessionStart + "-" + fullSessionEnd

asianSession = sessionMode == "Kill Zones" ? asianStartKZ + "-" + asianEndKZ : asianStartFull + "-" + asianEndFull
londonSession = sessionMode == "Kill Zones" ? londonStartKZ + "-" + londonEndKZ : londonStartFull + "-" + londonEndFull

asianEnd = sessionMode == "Kill Zones" ? asianEndKZ : asianEndFull
londonEnd = sessionMode == "Kill Zones" ? londonEndKZ : londonEndFull
asianExtendSession = asianEnd + "-" + asianExtendUntil
londonExtendSession = londonEnd + "-" + londonExtendUntil

orbDisplayTime = orbDuration == "Custom" ? orbStartTime + "-" + orbCustomEnd : orbStartTime + " " + orbDuration

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// TIME HELPERS

newDay = dayofweek != dayofweek[1]
inORBSession = not na(time(timeframe.period, orbSession, "America/New_York"))
