// ╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
// ║      8AM ORB MASTER STRATEGY — Pine Script v6            ║
// ║  Logic Enhanced: 1 Trade/Day | Trend & Volume Filters    ║
// ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
//@version=6
indicator("8AM ORB Master Strategy", overlay=true, max_lines_count=500, max_labels_count=500, max_boxes_count=10)

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ░░  INPUTS (Visuals Unchanged)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
var string G1 = "⚙️  Strategy"
newsOff    = input.bool(false, "🚫  News Filter — Disable All Signals", group=G1)
midZonePct = input.float(0.25, "Bounce Zone (% of ORB range)", minval=0.05, maxval=0.5, step=0.05, group=G1)

var string G2 = "📊  Display"
showTP1   = input.bool(true, "Show TP1  (1:1 R)",       group=G2)
showTP2   = input.bool(true, "Show TP2  (1:2 R)",       group=G2)
showTP3   = input.bool(true, "Show TP3  (1:3 R)",       group=G2)
showBox   = input.bool(true, "Show ORB Build Box",      group=G2)
showPanel = input.bool(true, "Show Checklist Panel",    group=G2)
extLen    = input.int(50,    "Level Line Length (bars)", minval=10, maxval=300, group=G2)

var string G3 = "🎨  Colors"
cLong  = input.color(#00c853, "Long",       group=G3)
cShort = input.color(#d50000, "Short",      group=G3)
cORB   = input.color(#ff9800, "ORB Levels", group=G3)
cSL    = input.color(#ef5350, "Stop Loss",  group=G3)
cTP1c  = input.color(#81c784, "TP1",        group=G3)
cTP2c  = input.color(#43a047, "TP2",        group=G3)
cTP3c  = input.color(#1b5e20, "TP3",        group=G3)

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ░░  BEHIND-THE-SCENES FILTERS (PRO LOGIC)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ema200 = ta.ema(close, 200)
vSMA   = ta.sma(volume, 20)
volOK  = volume > (vSMA * 1.2) // Must have 20% more volume than average

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ░░  ORB RANGE — TRUE 8:00–8:15 AM NEW YORK TIME (FIXED)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// Get New York time (handles DST automatically)
tNY = time(timeframe.period, "America/New_York")
hourNY = hour(tNY)
minuteNY = minute(tNY)

// Define ORB window
isInORB  = (hourNY == 8 and minuteNY >= 0 and minuteNY < 15)
endORB   = (hourNY == 8 and minuteNY == 15)

var float orbH     = na
var float orbL     = na
var float orbMid   = na
var bool  orbReady = false
var bool  drawn    = false
var int   tradesToday = 0

// Reset daily
if ta.change(dayofmonth) != 0
    orbH        := na
    orbL        := na
    orbMid      := na
    orbReady    := false
    drawn       := false
    tradesToday := 0

// Build ONLY during 8:00–8:15 and ONLY once
if isInORB and not orbReady
    orbH := na(orbH) ? high : math.max(orbH, high)
    orbL := na(orbL) ? low  : math.min(orbL, low)

// Lock ORB EXACTLY at 8:15
if endORB and not orbReady
    orbMid   := (orbH + orbL) / 2
    orbReady := true

float orbRange = na(orbH) or na(orbL) ? na : orbH - orbL
float bZone    = na(orbRange) ? 0.0 : orbRange * midZonePct

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ░░  DRAW ORB LEVELS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
if orbReady and not drawn
    drawn := true
    if showBox
        box.new(bar_index - 3, orbH, bar_index, orbL, bgcolor=color.new(cORB, 88), border_color=color.new(cORB, 45), border_width=1)

    line.new(bar_index, orbH,   bar_index + extLen, orbH,   color=cORB, width=1, style=line.style_dashed)
    line.new(bar_index, orbL,   bar_index + extLen, orbL,   color=cORB, width=1, style=line.style_dashed)
    line.new(bar_index, orbMid, bar_index + extLen, orbMid, color=color.new(cORB, 35), width=2, style=line.style_dotted)

    label.new(bar_index, orbH,   "ORB High  " + str.tostring(orbH,   format.mintick), color=color.new(cORB, 55), textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_left, size=size.small)
    label.new(bar_index, orbMid, "Midpoint  " + str.tostring(orbMid, format.mintick), color=color.new(cORB, 68), textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_left, size=size.small)
    label.new(bar_index, orbL,   "ORB Low   " + str.tostring(orbL,   format.mintick), color=color.new(cORB, 55), textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_left, size=size.small)

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ░░  SIGNAL LOGIC — IMPROVED BEHIND THE SCENES
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
canTrade    = orbReady and not newsOff and not isInORB and tradesToday == 0
prevNearMid = not na(orbMid) and ((low[1] <= orbMid and high[1] >= orbMid) or math.abs(low[1] - orbMid) <= bZone or math.abs(high[1] - orbMid) <= bZone)

// RP'S LOGIC: Signal only fires if Trend + Volume agree
longSig     = canTrade and prevNearMid and close > orbMid and close > open and close > ema200 and volOK
shortSig    = canTrade and prevNearMid and close < orbMid and close < open and close < ema200 and volOK

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ░░  MARK ENTRIES, SL, TP LEVELS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
if longSig
    tradesToday := 1 // Lock the script for the day
    en   = close
    sl   = orbL
    risk = en - sl
    tp1  = en + risk
    tp2  = en + risk * 2.0
    tp3  = en + risk * 3.0
    pad  = na(orbRange) ? syminfo.mintick * 3 : orbRange * 0.04

    label.new(bar_index, low - pad, "▲  LONG\n" + str.tostring(en, format.mintick), color=cLong, textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_up, size=size.normal)
    line.new(bar_index, sl, bar_index + extLen, sl, color=cSL, width=1, style=line.style_dashed)
    label.new(bar_index + extLen, sl, "SL  " + str.tostring(sl, format.mintick), color=cSL, textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_left, size=size.small)

    if showTP1
        line.new(bar_index, tp1, bar_index + extLen, tp1, color=cTP1c, width=1, style=line.style_dashed)
        label.new(bar_index + extLen, tp1, "TP1  " + str.tostring(tp1, format.mintick), color=cTP1c, textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_left, size=size.small)
    if showTP2
        line.new(bar_index, tp2, bar_index + extLen, tp2, color=cTP2c, width=1, style=line.style_dashed)
        label.new(bar_index + extLen, tp2, "TP2  " + str.tostring(tp2, format.mintick), color=cTP2c, textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_left, size=size.small)
    if showTP3
        line.new(bar_index, tp3, bar_index + extLen, tp3, color=cTP3c, width=1, style=line.style_dashed)
        label.new(bar_index + extLen, tp3, "TP3  " + str.tostring(tp3, format.mintick), color=cTP3c, textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_left, size=size.small)

if shortSig
    tradesToday := 1 // Lock the script for the day
    en   = close
    sl   = orbH
    risk = sl - en
    tp1  = en - risk
    tp2  = en - risk * 2.0
    tp3  = en - risk * 3.0
    pad  = na(orbRange) ? syminfo.mintick * 3 : orbRange * 0.04

    label.new(bar_index, high + pad, "▼  SHORT\n" + str.tostring(en, format.mintick), color=cShort, textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_down, size=size.normal)
    line.new(bar_index, sl, bar_index + extLen, sl, color=cSL, width=1, style=line.style_dashed)
    label.new(bar_index + extLen, sl, "SL  " + str.tostring(sl, format.mintick), color=cSL, textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_left, size=size.small)

    if showTP1
        line.new(bar_index, tp1, bar_index + extLen, tp1, color=cTP1c, width=1, style=line.style_dashed)
        label.new(bar_index + extLen, tp1, "TP1  " + str.tostring(tp1, format.mintick), color=cTP1c, textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_left, size=size.small)
    if showTP2
        line.new(bar_index, tp2, bar_index + extLen, tp2, color=cTP2c, width=1, style=line.style_dashed)
        label.new(bar_index + extLen, tp2, "TP2  " + str.tostring(tp2, format.mintick), color=cTP2c, textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_left, size=size.small)
    if showTP3
        line.new(bar_index, tp3, bar_index + extLen, tp3, color=cTP3c, width=1, style=line.style_dashed)
        label.new(bar_index + extLen, tp3, "TP3  " + str.tostring(tp3, format.mintick), color=cTP3c, textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_left, size=size.small)


alertcondition(longSig,  "ORB Long Signal",  "8AM ORB ▲ LONG signal fired")
alertcondition(shortSig, "ORB Short Signal", "8AM ORB ▼ SHORT signal fired")

f_chk(b) => b ? "✅" : "❌"
f_col(b) => b ? color.new(#00c853, 0) : color.new(#ef5350, 0)

var table T = table.new(position.top_right, 3, 10, bgcolor=color.new(#0f172a, 60), border_width=1, border_color=color.new(#334155, 55), frame_width=1, frame_color=#334155)

if showPanel and barstate.islast
    hasSig  = longSig or shortSig
    dirOK   = (longSig and close > orbMid) or (shortSig and close < orbMid)
    allGood = orbReady and not newsOff and prevNearMid and hasSig and dirOK

    sigText = longSig ? "▲   LONG" : shortSig ? "▼   SHORT" : "—   NO TRADE"
    sigBg   = longSig ? color.new(#00c853, 68) : shortSig ? color.new(#d50000, 68) : color.new(#1e293b, 55)
    sigCol  = longSig ? color.new(#00c853, 0)  : shortSig ? color.new(#ef5350, 0)  : color.new(#9e9e9e, 0)

    cBg    = color.new(#1e293b, 50)
    cBgAlt = color.new(#1e293b, 65)
    cHead  = color.new(#1e3a5f, 15)
    cMuted = color.new(color.white, 45)

    table.cell(T, 0, 0, "  8AM ORB — ENTRY CHECKLIST  ", text_color=color.white, text_size=size.small, bgcolor=cHead, text_halign=text.align_center)
    table.merge_cells(T, 0, 0, 2, 0)

    table.cell(T, 0, 1, "📡  SIGNAL", text_color=color.new(color.white, 15), text_size=size.small, bgcolor=sigBg)
    table.cell(T, 1, 1, sigText, text_color=sigCol, text_size=size.small, bgcolor=sigBg, text_halign=text.align_center)
    table.cell(T, 2, 1, "", bgcolor=sigBg)

    orbInfo = orbReady ? str.tostring(orbH, format.mintick) + " / " + str.tostring(orbL, format.mintick) : "Waiting 8:00–8:15..."
    table.cell(T, 0, 2, "  ORB Built",     text_color=color.white, text_size=size.small, bgcolor=cBg)
    table.cell(T, 1, 2, f_chk(orbReady),   text_color=f_col(orbReady), text_size=size.small, bgcolor=cBg, text_halign=text.align_center)
    table.cell(T, 2, 2, orbInfo,           text_color=cMuted, text_size=size.tiny, bgcolor=cBg)

    noNews   = not newsOff
    newsInfo = noNews ? "Clear" : "⚠️ FILTER ON"
    newsCol  = noNews ? color.new(#00c853, 0) : color.new(#ffd600, 0)
    table.cell(T, 0, 3, "  No News Event", text_color=color.white, text_size=size.small, bgcolor=cBgAlt)
    table.cell(T, 1, 3, f_chk(noNews),     text_color=f_col(noNews), text_size=size.small, bgcolor=cBgAlt, text_halign=text.align_center)
    table.cell(T, 2, 3, newsInfo,          text_color=newsCol, text_size=size.tiny, bgcolor=cBgAlt)

    midInfo = orbReady ? "Mid: " + str.tostring(orbMid, format.mintick) : "–"
    table.cell(T, 0, 4, "  Bounce @ Mid",  text_color=color.white, text_size=size.small, bgcolor=cBg)
    table.cell(T, 1, 4, f_chk(prevNearMid), text_color=f_col(prevNearMid), text_size=size.small, bgcolor=cBg, text_halign=text.align_center)
    table.cell(T, 2, 4, midInfo,           text_color=cMuted, text_size=size.tiny, bgcolor=cBg)

    revInfo = hasSig ? (longSig ? "Bullish close ↑" : "Bearish close ↓") : "Watching..."
    table.cell(T, 0, 5, "  Reversal Candle", text_color=color.white, text_size=size.small, bgcolor=cBgAlt)
    table.cell(T, 1, 5, f_chk(hasSig),       text_color=f_col(hasSig), text_size=size.small, bgcolor=cBgAlt, text_halign=text.align_center)
    table.cell(T, 2, 5, revInfo,             text_color=cMuted, text_size=size.tiny, bgcolor=cBgAlt)

    dirInfo = dirOK ? (longSig ? "Above mid ↑" : "Below mid ↓") : "–"
    table.cell(T, 0, 6, "  Direction Clear", text_color=color.white, text_size=size.small, bgcolor=cBg)
    table.cell(T, 1, 6, f_chk(dirOK),        text_color=f_col(dirOK), text_size=size.small, bgcolor=cBg, text_halign=text.align_center)
    table.cell(T, 2, 6, dirInfo,             text_color=cMuted, text_size=size.tiny, bgcolor=cBg)

    table.cell(T, 0, 7, "  1min & 3min Agree", text_color=color.white, text_size=size.small, bgcolor=cBgAlt)
    table.cell(T, 1, 7, "👁", text_color=color.new(#ffd600, 0), text_size=size.small, bgcolor=cBgAlt, text_halign=text.align_center)
    table.cell(T, 2, 7, "Manual check", text_color=cMuted, text_size=size.tiny, bgcolor=cBgAlt)

    hml = orbReady ? str.tostring(orbH, format.mintick) + "  |  " + str.tostring(orbMid, format.mintick) + "  |  " + str.tostring(orbL, format.mintick) : "Building..."
    table.cell(T, 0, 8, "  H | Mid | L", text_color=color.new(cORB, 0), text_size=size.tiny, bgcolor=color.new(#0f172a, 50))
    table.cell(T, 1, 8, hml, text_color=color.white, text_size=size.tiny, bgcolor=color.new(#0f172a, 50), text_halign=text.align_center)
    table.cell(T, 2, 8, "", bgcolor=color.new(#0f172a, 50))

    footTxt = newsOff ? "⚠️  News filter ON — signals disabled" : allGood ? "✅  All checks passed — confirm 1min/3min" : "ℹ️  Waiting for setup..."
    footCol = newsOff ? color.new(#ffd600, 0) : allGood ? color.new(#00c853, 0) : color.new(#9e9e9e, 0)
    table.cell(T, 0, 9, footTxt, text_color=footCol, text_size=size.tiny, bgcolor=color.new(#0f172a, 50), text_halign=text.align_center)
    table.merge_cells(T, 0, 9, 2, 9)

items.name: 15-Min ORB Strategy with TP/SL
items.title: 15-Min ORB Strategy with TP/SL
items.author: davidmdan
items.source:
//@version=5
indicator("15-Min ORB Strategy with TP/SL", overlay=true)

// === User Inputs ===
tpMultiplier = input.float(1.5, title="Take Profit Multiplier")
slMultiplier = input.float(1.0, title="Stop Loss Multiplier")
sessionStart = input.time(timestamp("2025-01-01 09:30 +0000"), title="Session Start")
sessionEnd = input.time(timestamp("2025-01-01 09:45 +0000"), title="Session End")

// === ORB Calculation ===
var float orbHigh = na
var float orbLow = na
var bool orbSet = false

if (time >= sessionStart and time < sessionEnd)
    orbHigh := na
    orbLow := na
    orbSet := false

if (time >= sessionEnd and not orbSet)
    orbHigh := ta.highest(high, 15)
    orbLow := ta.lowest(low, 15)
    orbSet := true

orbRange = orbHigh - orbLow

// === Breakout Conditions ===
breakoutUp = close > orbHigh and close[1] <= orbHigh
breakoutDown = close < orbLow and close[1] >= orbLow

// === Entry State ===
var float entryPrice = na
var float takeProfit = na
var float stopLoss = na
var bool inPosition = false
var bool isLong = false

// === Entry Logic ===
if breakoutUp and not inPosition
    entryPrice := close
    takeProfit := entryPrice + orbRange * tpMultiplier
    stopLoss := entryPrice - orbRange * slMultiplier
    inPosition := true
    isLong := true

if breakoutDown and not inPosition
    entryPrice := close
    takeProfit := entryPrice - orbRange * tpMultiplier
    stopLoss := entryPrice + orbRange * slMultiplier
    inPosition := true
    isLong := false

// === Exit Logic ===
exitLong = isLong and (close >= takeProfit or close <= stopLoss)
exitShort = not isLong and (close <= takeProfit or close >= stopLoss)
shouldExit = inPosition and (exitLong or exitShort)

if shouldExit
    entryPrice := na
    takeProfit := na
    stopLoss := na
    inPosition := false
    isLong := false

// === Plots ===
plot(orbHigh, "ORB High", color=color.green)
plot(orbLow, "ORB Low", color=color.red)
plotshape(breakoutUp, title="Buy Signal", location=location.belowbar, color=color.green, style=shape.labelup, text="BUY")
plotshape(breakoutDown, title="Sell Signal", location=location.abovebar, color=color.red, style=shape.labeldown, text="SELL")
plot(inPosition ? takeProfit : na, "Take Profit", color=color.blue, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(inPosition ? stopLoss : na, "Stop Loss", color=color.orange, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)

items.name: 15-Min ORB Strategy for NQ
items.title: 15-Min ORB Strategy for NQ - TP3 Runner
items.author: Dryeye2006
items.source:
//@version=5
strategy("15-Min ORB Strategy for NQ - TP3 Runner", overlay=true, default_qty_type=strategy.fixed, default_qty_value=1, pyramiding=0, margin_long=100, margin_short=100)

// ────────────────────────────────────────
// Inputs
// ────────────────────────────────────────
qty        = input.int(3, "Total Contracts Qty", minval=1, group="Position Sizing", tooltip="Total contracts to split between TP1, TP2, and TP3.")
tp1Percent = input.int(33, "TP1 %", minval=0, maxval=100, group="Exits")
tp2Percent = input.int(33, "TP2 %", minval=0, maxval=100, group="Exits")
tp3Percent = input.int(34, "TP3 %", minval=0, maxval=100, group="Exits")

rr1        = input.float(1.0, "TP1 (RR)", minval=0.1, step=0.1, group="Exits")
rr2        = input.float(2.0, "TP2 (RR)", minval=0.1, step=0.1, group="Exits")
rr3        = input.float(4.0, "TP3 (RR)", minval=0.1, step=0.1, group="Exits")
slBuffer   = input.float(0.0, "SL Buffer (Points)", step=0.25, group="Exits")

// Breakeven Settings
useBE      = input.bool(true, "Move SL to Breakeven after TP1?", group="Exits")
beOffset   = input.float(0.0, "BE Offset (Points)", minval=0, group="Exits")

// Trailing Settings
useTrail   = input.bool(false, "Activate Trailing SL after TP1?", group="Trailing Stop (Post-TP1)")
trailPts   = input.float(10.0, "Trailing Distance (Points)", minval=0.25, group="Trailing Stop (Post-TP1)")
showTrailLine = input.bool(true, "Show Red Trailing Line?", group="Trailing Stop (Post-TP1)")

// ────────────────────────────────────────
// State Tracking
// ────────────────────────────────────────
var float orHigh = na
var float orLow  = na
var bool entryTaken = false
var bool tp1Hit     = false
var float trailPrice = na

// Reset at start of day
if ta.change(time("D", "America/New_York")) != 0
    entryTaken := false
    tp1Hit     := false
    orHigh     := na
    orLow      := na

// Detect TP1 Fill (if current position is less than original qty)
if strategy.position_size != 0 and math.abs(strategy.position_size) < qty
    tp1Hit := true

// ────────────────────────────────────────
// Time & Session
// ────────────────────────────────────────
inORB = not na(time(timeframe.period, "0930-0945:1234567", "America/New_York"))
isEOD = session.islastbar_regular or (hour(time, "America/New_York") == 15 and minute(time, "America/New_York") >= 55)

if inORB
    orHigh := na(orHigh) ? high : math.max(orHigh, high)
    orLow  := na(orLow)  ? low  : math.min(orLow, low)

// Breakout Logic
breakoutUp   = not inORB and not entryTaken and not na(orHigh) and close > orHigh
breakoutDown = not inORB and not entryTaken and not na(orLow)  and close < orLow

// ────────────────────────────────────────
// Entries
// ────────────────────────────────────────
if breakoutUp
    strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long, qty=qty)
    entryTaken := true
    tp1Hit     := false
    trailPrice := na

if breakoutDown
    strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short, qty=qty)
    entryTaken := true
    tp1Hit     := false
    trailPrice := na

// ────────────────────────────────────────
// Exit Calculations
// ────────────────────────────────────────

// LONG EXIT LOGIC
if strategy.position_size > 0
    riskLong = strategy.position_avg_price - (orLow - slBuffer)
    tp1Price = strategy.position_avg_price + (riskLong * rr1)
    tp2Price = strategy.position_avg_price + (riskLong * rr2)
    tp3Price = strategy.position_avg_price + (riskLong * rr3)
    
    float slLevel = orLow - slBuffer
    
    if useBE and tp1Hit
        slLevel := strategy.position_avg_price + beOffset
    
    if useTrail and tp1Hit
        trailPrice := na(trailPrice) ? high - trailPts : math.max(trailPrice, high - trailPts)
        slLevel := math.max(slLevel, trailPrice)
    
    strategy.exit("L-TP1", "Long", qty_percent=tp1Percent, limit=tp1Price, stop=slLevel, comment_profit="TP1", comment_loss="SL")
    strategy.exit("L-TP2", "Long", qty_percent=tp2Percent, limit=tp2Price, stop=slLevel, comment_profit="TP2", comment_loss="SL")
    strategy.exit("L-TP3", "Long", qty_percent=tp3Percent, limit=tp3Price, stop=slLevel, comment_profit="TP3", comment_loss=tp1Hit ? "Trail/BE" : "SL")
    
    if isEOD
        strategy.close("Long", comment="EOD Close")

// SHORT EXIT LOGIC
if strategy.position_size < 0
    riskShort = (orHigh + slBuffer) - strategy.position_avg_price
    tp1PriceS = strategy.position_avg_price - (riskShort * rr1)
    tp2PriceS = strategy.position_avg_price - (riskShort * rr2)
    tp3PriceS = strategy.position_avg_price - (riskShort * rr3)
    
    float slLevelS = orHigh + slBuffer
    
    if useBE and tp1Hit
        slLevelS := strategy.position_avg_price - beOffset
        
    if useTrail and tp1Hit
        trailPrice := na(trailPrice) ? low + trailPts : math.min(trailPrice, low + trailPts)
        slLevelS := math.min(slLevelS, trailPrice)

    strategy.exit("S-TP1", "Short", qty_percent=tp1Percent, limit=tp1PriceS, stop=slLevelS, comment_profit="TP1", comment_loss="SL")
    strategy.exit("S-TP2", "Short", qty_percent=tp2Percent, limit=tp2PriceS, stop=slLevelS, comment_profit="TP2", comment_loss="SL")
    strategy.exit("S-TP3", "Short", qty_percent=tp3Percent, limit=tp3PriceS, stop=slLevelS, comment_profit="TP3", comment_loss=tp1Hit ? "Trail/BE" : "SL")

    if isEOD
        strategy.close("Short", comment="EOD Close")

if strategy.position_size == 0
    trailPrice := na

// ────────────────────────────────────────
// Plots
// ────────────────────────────────────────
plot(orHigh, title="OR High", color=color.new(color.red, 30), linewidth=2, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(orLow,  title="OR Low",  color=color.new(color.green, 30), linewidth=2, style=plot.style_linebr)
bgcolor(inORB ? color.new(color.yellow, 92) : na, title="ORB Period")

plot(showTrailLine and strategy.position_size != 0 and tp1Hit and useTrail ? trailPrice : na, "Trail SL Level", color=color.red, style=plot.style_linebr, linewidth=2)

// Dashboard (Expanded for TP3)
if barstate.islast
    var table dashboard = table.new(position.top_right, columns=2, rows=8, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 60), border_width=1, border_color=color.new(color.gray, 50), frame_width=1, frame_color=color.new(color.gray, 30))
    table.cell(dashboard, 0, 0, "ORB TP3 Runner", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=#0d47a1)
    table.cell(dashboard, 1, 0, "", bgcolor=#0d47a1)
    table.cell(dashboard, 0, 1, "OR High", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.red, 70))
    table.cell(dashboard, 1, 1, str.tostring(orHigh, "#.##"), text_color=color.red)
    table.cell(dashboard, 0, 2, "OR Low", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.green, 70))
    table.cell(dashboard, 1, 2, str.tostring(orLow, "#.##"), text_color=color.green)
    table.cell(dashboard, 0, 3, "Contracts", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.blue, 70))
    table.cell(dashboard, 1, 3, str.tostring(qty), text_color=color.blue)
    table.cell(dashboard, 0, 4, "TP1 RR", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.orange, 70))
    table.cell(dashboard, 1, 4, str.tostring(rr1), text_color=color.orange)
    table.cell(dashboard, 0, 5, "TP2 RR", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.purple, 70))
    table.cell(dashboard, 1, 5, str.tostring(rr2), text_color=color.purple)
    table.cell(dashboard, 0, 6, "TP3 RR", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.teal, 70))
    table.cell(dashboard, 1, 6, str.tostring(rr3), text_color=color.teal)
    table.cell(dashboard, 0, 7, "Entry Taken", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.gray, 70))
    table.cell(dashboard, 1, 7, entryTaken ? "Yes" : "No", text_color=entryTaken ? color.red : color.lime)

//@version=5
strategy("ORB + Key Session Levels (Backtest v1.2)",
     overlay=true,
     max_boxes_count=500, max_lines_count=500, max_labels_count=500,
     pyramiding=0,
     initial_capital=10000,
     commission_type=strategy.commission.percent,
     commission_value=0.0,
     slippage=0,
     calc_on_order_fills=true,
     calc_on_every_tick=false)

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// INPUTS  (same as your indicator)
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
grpORB = "Opening Range"
showORB = input.bool(true, "Show ORB", group=grpORB)
orbStartTime = input.string("0930", "Start Time (HHMM ET)", tooltip="Enter time in 24hr format. Examples: 0800, 0930, 1400", group=grpORB, display=display.none)
orbDuration = input.string("15 Min", "Duration", options=["5 Min", "15 Min", "30 Min", "1 Hour", "Custom"], group=grpORB, display=display.none)
orbCustomEnd = input.string("0945", "Custom End (HHMM ET)", tooltip="Only used when Duration is 'Custom'", group=grpORB, display=display.none)
showMidline = input.bool(true, "Show Midline", group=grpORB, display=display.none)
orbHistory = input.int(1, "Days to Show", minval=1, maxval=20, group=grpORB, display=display.none)
orbLineWidth = input.int(3, "Line Thickness", minval=1, maxval=5, group=grpORB, display=display.none)
orbHighColor = input.color(color.new(#00d4ff, 0), "High Color", group=grpORB, display=display.none)
orbLowColor = input.color(color.new(#00d4ff, 0), "Low Color", group=grpORB, display=display.none)
orbMidColor = input.color(color.new(#00d4ff, 50), "Midline Color", group=grpORB, display=display.none)
i_alertORB = input.bool(false, "Alert on Break", tooltip="Fire alertcondition when price breaks ORB High/Low/Mid. Uncheck to see levels without alerts.", group=grpORB, display=display.none)

// ── ORB TRADE SIGNALS ──
grpSignals = "ORB Trade Signals"
i_enableSignals  = input.bool(true, "Enable Trade Signals", tooltip="Backtest trades on ORB break.", group=grpSignals)
i_orbEntryMode   = input.string("Breakout", "Entry Mode", options=["Breakout", "Retest Zone", "Retest Midpoint"], tooltip="Breakout: enter on candle close through level.\nRetest Zone: wait for candle to wick back to the broken level and close outside.\nRetest Midpoint: wait for candle to wick back to ORB midpoint and close outside.", group=grpSignals)
i_orbRetestTimeout = input.int(20, "Retest Timeout (bars)", minval=3, maxval=100, tooltip="Max bars to wait for retest after breakout. Resets if no retest. Only used in Retest modes.", group=grpSignals, display=display.none)
i_orbSLMethod    = input.string("Midpoint", "Stop Loss", options=["Midpoint", "Opposite Side", "Fixed Points"], tooltip="Midpoint: SL at middle of ORB range.\nOpposite Side: SL at ORB low (long) / ORB high (short).\nFixed Points: user-defined distance from entry.", group=grpSignals)
i_orbSLPoints   = input.float(20.0, "SL Fixed Points", minval=0.25, step=0.25, tooltip="Only used when SL = Fixed Points.", group=grpSignals, display=display.none)
i_orbContracts  = input.int(1, "Contracts", minval=1, maxval=100, tooltip="Total number of contracts/lots for the entry order.", group=grpSignals)
i_orbTP1RR      = input.float(1.0, "TP1 R:R", minval=0.1, step=0.1, group=grpSignals, inline="tp1")
i_orbTP1Qty     = input.int(1, "Close Qty", minval=1, maxval=100, tooltip="Contracts to close at TP1.", group=grpSignals, inline="tp1")
i_orbTP2RR      = input.float(2.0, "TP2 R:R", minval=0.1, step=0.1, group=grpSignals, inline="tp2")
i_orbTP2Qty     = input.int(0, "Close Qty", minval=0, maxval=100, tooltip="Contracts to close at TP2. Set 0 to skip.", group=grpSignals, inline="tp2")
i_orbTP3RR      = input.float(3.0, "TP3 R:R", minval=0.1, step=0.1, group=grpSignals, inline="tp3")
i_orbTP3Qty     = input.int(0, "Close Qty", minval=0, maxval=100, tooltip="Contracts to close at TP3. Set 0 to close all remaining.", group=grpSignals, inline="tp3")
i_orbShowSLTP   = input.bool(true, "Show SL/TP Lines", group=grpSignals)
i_orbShowEntry  = input.bool(true, "Show Entry Arrows", group=grpSignals)

grpSessions = "Session Mode"
sessionMode = input.string("Full Sessions", "Mode", options=["Kill Zones", "Full Sessions"], tooltip="Kill Zones: Non-overlapping high-activity windows\nFull Sessions: Traditional full session times", group=grpSessions, display=display.none)

grpPD = "Previous Day"
showPDHL = input.bool(true, "Show PDH/PDL", group=grpPD)
pdSource = input.string("RTH Only", "PDH/PDL Source", options=["RTH Only", "Full Session (Futures)"], tooltip="RTH Only: 9:30 AM - 4:00 PM ET (cash market hours)\nFull Session: 6:00 PM - 5:00 PM ET (futures 23hr session)", group=grpPD, display=display.none)
rthStart = input.string("0930", "RTH Start (HHMM ET)", tooltip="Regular Trading Hours start - used when Source = RTH Only", group=grpPD, display=display.none)
rthEnd = input.string("1600", "RTH End (HHMM ET)", tooltip="Regular Trading Hours end - used when Source = RTH Only", group=grpPD, display=display.none)
fullSessionStart = input.string("1800", "Full Session Start (HHMM ET)", tooltip="Futures session start (previous day 6pm) - used when Source = Full Session", group=grpPD, display=display.none)
fullSessionEnd = input.string("1700", "Full Session End (HHMM ET)", tooltip="Futures session end (5pm) - used when Source = Full Session", group=grpPD, display=display.none)
pdHistory = input.int(1, "Days to Show", minval=0, maxval=10, group=grpPD, display=display.none)
pdLineWidth = input.int(1, "Line Thickness", minval=1, maxval=5, group=grpPD, display=display.none)
pdhColor = input.color(color.new(color.yellow, 0), "Color", group=grpPD, display=display.none)
i_alertPD = input.bool(false, "Alert on Break", tooltip="Fire alertcondition when price breaks PDH/PDL. Uncheck to see levels without alerts.", group=grpPD, display=display.none)

grpAsian = "Asian Session"
showAsian = input.bool(true, "Show Asian H/L", group=grpAsian, display=display.none)
showAsianBox = input.bool(false, "Show Session Box", tooltip="Draw a box around the Asian session range", group=grpAsian, display=display.none)
showAsianMid = input.bool(false, "Show Midline", group=grpAsian, display=display.none)
extendAsianLines = input.bool(true, "Extend Lines", tooltip="Extend Asian H/L lines beyond session end", group=grpAsian, display=display.none)
asianExtendUntil = input.string("1130", "Extend Until (HHMM ET)", tooltip="Time to extend lines until when 'Extend Lines' is enabled", group=grpAsian, display=display.none)
asianStartKZ = input.string("2000", "Kill Zone Start (HHMM ET)", group=grpAsian, display=display.none)
asianEndKZ = input.string("0000", "Kill Zone End (HHMM ET)", group=grpAsian, display=display.none)
asianStartFull = input.string("1800", "Full Session Start (HHMM ET)", group=grpAsian, display=display.none)
asianEndFull = input.string("0300", "Full Session End (HHMM ET)", group=grpAsian, display=display.none)
asianHistory = input.int(1, "Days to Show", minval=0, maxval=10, group=grpAsian, display=display.none)
asianLineWidth = input.int(1, "Line Thickness", minval=1, maxval=5, group=grpAsian, display=display.none)
asianColor = input.color(color.new(color.purple, 0), "Color", group=grpAsian, display=display.none)
asianBoxColor = input.color(color.new(color.purple, 90), "Box Fill Color", group=grpAsian, display=display.none)
i_alertAsian = input.bool(false, "Alert on Break", tooltip="Fire alertcondition when price breaks Asian H/L. Uncheck to see levels without alerts.", group=grpAsian, display=display.none)

grpLondon = "London Session"
showLondon = input.bool(true, "Show London H/L", group=grpLondon, display=display.none)
showLondonBox = input.bool(false, "Show Session Box", tooltip="Draw a box around the London session range", group=grpLondon, display=display.none)
showLondonMid = input.bool(false, "Show Midline", group=grpLondon, display=display.none)
extendLondonLines = input.bool(true, "Extend Lines", tooltip="Extend London H/L lines beyond session end", group=grpLondon, display=display.none)
londonExtendUntil = input.string("1130", "Extend Until (HHMM ET)", tooltip="Time to extend lines until when 'Extend Lines' is enabled", group=grpLondon, display=display.none)
londonStartKZ = input.string("0200", "Kill Zone Start (HHMM ET)", group=grpLondon, display=display.none)
londonEndKZ = input.string("0500", "Kill Zone End (HHMM ET)", group=grpLondon, display=display.none)
londonStartFull = input.string("0300", "Full Session Start (HHMM ET)", group=grpLondon, display=display.none)
londonEndFull = input.string("0930", "Full Session End (HHMM ET)", tooltip="Ends when NY opens to avoid overlap", group=grpLondon, display=display.none)
londonHistory = input.int(1, "Days to Show", minval=0, maxval=10, group=grpLondon, display=display.none)
londonLineWidth = input.int(1, "Line Thickness", minval=1, maxval=5, group=grpLondon, display=display.none)
londonColor = input.color(color.new(color.orange, 0), "Color", group=grpLondon, display=display.none)
londonBoxColor = input.color(color.new(color.orange, 90), "Box Fill Color", group=grpLondon, display=display.none)
i_alertLondon = input.bool(false, "Alert on Break", tooltip="Fire alertcondition when price breaks London H/L. Uncheck to see levels without alerts.", group=grpLondon, display=display.none)

grpNYAM = "NY AM Session"
showNYAM = input.bool(false, "Show NY AM H/L", group=grpNYAM, display=display.none)
showNYAMBox = input.bool(false, "Show Session Box", group=grpNYAM, display=display.none)
showNYAMMid = input.bool(false, "Show Midline", group=grpNYAM, display=display.none)
nyamStartKZ = input.string("0830", "Kill Zone Start (HHMM ET)", group=grpNYAM, display=display.none)
nyamEndKZ = input.string("1100", "Kill Zone End (HHMM ET)", group=grpNYAM, display=display.none)
nyamStartFull = input.string("0930", "Full Session Start (HHMM ET)", group=grpNYAM, display=display.none)
nyamEndFull = input.string("1200", "Full Session End (HHMM ET)", group=grpNYAM, display=display.none)
nyamHistory = input.int(1, "Days to Show", minval=0, maxval=10, group=grpNYAM, display=display.none)
nyamLineWidth = input.int(1, "Line Thickness", minval=1, maxval=5, group=grpNYAM, display=display.none)
nyamColor = input.color(color.new(color.blue, 0), "Color", group=grpNYAM, display=display.none)
nyamBoxColor = input.color(color.new(color.blue, 90), "Box Fill Color", group=grpNYAM, display=display.none)
i_alertNYAM = input.bool(false, "Alert on Break", tooltip="Fire alertcondition when price breaks NY AM H/L. Uncheck to see levels without alerts.", group=grpNYAM, display=display.none)

grpNYPM = "NY PM Session"
showNYPM = input.bool(false, "Show NY PM H/L", group=grpNYPM, display=display.none)
showNYPMBox = input.bool(false, "Show Session Box", group=grpNYPM, display=display.none)
showNYPMMid = input.bool(false, "Show Midline", group=grpNYPM, display=display.none)
nypmStartKZ = input.string("1330", "Kill Zone Start (HHMM ET)", group=grpNYPM, display=display.none)
nypmEndKZ = input.string("1600", "Kill Zone End (HHMM ET)", group=grpNYPM, display=display.none)
nypmStartFull = input.string("1200", "Full Session Start (HHMM ET)", group=grpNYPM, display=display.none)
nypmEndFull = input.string("1600", "Full Session End (HHMM ET)", group=grpNYPM, display=display.none)
nypmHistory = input.int(1, "Days to Show", minval=0, maxval=10, group=grpNYPM, display=display.none)
nypmLineWidth = input.int(1, "Line Thickness", minval=1, maxval=5, group=grpNYPM, display=display.none)
nypmColor = input.color(color.new(color.teal, 0), "Color", group=grpNYPM, display=display.none)
nypmBoxColor = input.color(color.new(color.teal, 90), "Box Fill Color", group=grpNYPM, display=display.none)
i_alertNYPM = input.bool(false, "Alert on Break", tooltip="Fire alertcondition when price breaks NY PM H/L. Uncheck to see levels without alerts.", group=grpNYPM, display=display.none)

grpFVG = "Fair Value Gaps"
showFVG = input.bool(true, "Show FVGs", group=grpFVG, display=display.none)
fvgThreshold = input.float(0, "Threshold %", minval=0, maxval=5, step=0.1, group=grpFVG, display=display.none)
autoThreshold = input.bool(true, "Auto Threshold", group=grpFVG, display=display.none)
fvgExtend = input.int(50, "Extend Bars", minval=10, maxval=200, group=grpFVG, display=display.none)
fvgMitigation = input.bool(true, "Remove When Mitigated", group=grpFVG, display=display.none)
bullFVGColor = input.color(color.new(#089981, 70), "Bullish FVG", group=grpFVG, display=display.none)
bearFVGColor = input.color(color.new(#f23645, 70), "Bearish FVG", group=grpFVG, display=display.none)
i_alertFVG = input.bool(false, "Alert on FVG", tooltip="Fire alertcondition when FVGs form or get mitigated. Uncheck to see FVGs without alerts.", group=grpFVG, display=display.none)

grpHTF = "Higher Timeframe Bias"
showDashboard = input.bool(true, "Show Dashboard", group=grpHTF, display=display.none)
htf1 = input.timeframe("240", "Timeframe 1", group=grpHTF, display=display.none)
htf2 = input.timeframe("60", "Timeframe 2", group=grpHTF, display=display.none)
swingLookback = input.int(10, "Swing Lookback", minval=3, maxval=50, group=grpHTF, display=display.none)
dashPosition = input.string("Top Right", "Dashboard Position", options=["Top Right", "Top Left", "Bottom Right", "Bottom Left"], group=grpHTF, display=display.none)
dashSize = input.string("Tiny", "Dashboard Size", options=["Tiny", "Small", "Normal"], group=grpHTF, display=display.none)
i_alertHTF = input.bool(false, "Alert on Bias Change", tooltip="Fire alertcondition when HTF bias changes. Uncheck to see dashboard without alerts.", group=grpHTF, display=display.none)

grpDashColors = "Dashboard Colors"
dashBgColor = input.color(color.new(#0d1117, 10), "Background", group=grpDashColors, display=display.none)
dashBorderColor = input.color(color.new(color.gray, 70), "Border", group=grpDashColors, display=display.none)
dashHeaderBg = input.color(color.new(#2962ff, 70), "Header Background", group=grpDashColors, display=display.none)
dashHeaderText = input.color(color.white, "Header Text", group=grpDashColors, display=display.none)
dashLabelColor = input.color(color.gray, "Labels", group=grpDashColors, display=display.none)
dashBullColor = input.color(color.green, "Bullish", group=grpDashColors, display=display.none)
dashBearColor = input.color(color.red, "Bearish", group=grpDashColors, display=display.none)
dashNeutralColor = input.color(color.gray, "Neutral", group=grpDashColors, display=display.none)

grpStyle = "Style"
lineStyle = input.string("Solid", "Line Style", options=["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], group=grpStyle, display=display.none)
showLabels = input.bool(true, "Show Labels", group=grpStyle, display=display.none)
labelSize = input.string("Tiny", "Label Size", options=["Tiny", "Small", "Normal"], group=grpStyle, display=display.none)

// ---------- Backtest helpers ----------
f_clampQty(_q) =>
    math.max(0, int(math.floor(_q)))

f_buildTp3Qty(_contracts, _tp1, _tp2, _tp3) =>
    _tp3 == 0 ? math.max(0, _contracts - _tp1 - _tp2) : _tp3

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SESSION TIME CALCULATION
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
calcEndTime(simple string startTime, simple string duration) =>
    startHour = math.floor(str.tonumber(str.substring(startTime, 0, 2)))
    startMin = math.floor(str.tonumber(str.substring(startTime, 2, 4)))

    addMins = switch duration
        "5 Min" => 5
        "15 Min" => 15
        "30 Min" => 30
        "1 Hour" => 60
        => 0

    totalMins = startMin + addMins
    endHour = startHour + math.floor(totalMins / 60)
    endMin = totalMins % 60

    endHourStr = endHour < 10 ? "0" + str.tostring(endHour) : str.tostring(endHour)
    endMinStr = endMin < 10 ? "0" + str.tostring(endMin) : str.tostring(endMin)

    endHourStr + endMinStr

orbEndTime = orbDuration == "Custom" ? orbCustomEnd : calcEndTime(orbStartTime, orbDuration)
orbSession = orbStartTime + "-" + orbEndTime

pdSession = pdSource == "RTH Only" ? rthStart + "-" + rthEnd : fullSessionStart + "-" + fullSessionEnd

asianSession = sessionMode == "Kill Zones" ? asianStartKZ + "-" + asianEndKZ : asianStartFull + "-" + asianEndFull
londonSession = sessionMode == "Kill Zones" ? londonStartKZ + "-" + londonEndKZ : londonStartFull + "-" + londonEndFull
nyamSession = sessionMode == "Kill Zones" ? nyamStartKZ + "-" + nyamEndKZ : nyamStartFull + "-" + nyamEndFull
nypmSession = sessionMode == "Kill Zones" ? nypmStartKZ + "-" + nypmEndKZ : nypmStartFull + "-" + nypmEndFull

asianEnd = sessionMode == "Kill Zones" ? asianEndKZ : asianEndFull
londonEnd = sessionMode == "Kill Zones" ? londonEndKZ : londonEndFull
asianExtendSession = asianEnd + "-" + asianExtendUntil
londonExtendSession = londonEnd + "-" + londonExtendUntil

orbDisplayTime = orbDuration == "Custom" ? orbStartTime + "-" + orbCustomEnd : orbStartTime + " " + orbDuration

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// HELPERS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
getLineStyle() =>
    switch lineStyle
        "Solid" => line.style_solid
        "Dashed" => line.style_dashed
        "Dotted" => line.style_dotted

getLabelSize() =>
    switch labelSize
        "Tiny" => size.tiny
        "Small" => size.small
        "Normal" => size.normal

getDashSize() =>
    switch dashSize
        "Tiny" => size.tiny
        "Small" => size.small
        "Normal" => size.normal

formatTF(simple string tf) =>
    switch tf
        "1" => "1m"
        "3" => "3m"
        "5" => "5m"
        "15" => "15m"
        "30" => "30m"
        "45" => "45m"
        "60" => "1H"
        "120" => "2H"
        "180" => "3H"
        "240" => "4H"
        "D" => "1D"
        "W" => "1W"
        => tf

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// TYPES
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
type orbData
    float hi
    float lo
    float mid
    int startBar
    int hiBar
    int loBar
    line hiLine
    line loLine
    line midLine
    label hiLabel
    label loLabel
    label midLabel

type levelData
    float hi
    float lo
    float mid
    int startBar
    int hiBar
    int loBar
    line hiLine
    line loLine
    line midLine
    label hiLabel
    label loLabel
    label midLabel
    box sessionBox

type fvgData
    float top
    float bottom
    bool isBull
    int barIdx
    box area

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// VARIABLES
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
var orbData[] orbArray = array.new<orbData>(0)
var levelData[] pdArray = array.new<levelData>(0)
var levelData[] asianArray = array.new<levelData>(0)
var levelData[] londonArray = array.new<levelData>(0)
var levelData[] nyamArray = array.new<levelData>(0)
var levelData[] nypmArray = array.new<levelData>(0)
var fvgData[] fvgArray = array.new<fvgData>(0)

var float currentORBHigh = na
var float currentORBLow = na
var float currentORBMid = na
var int orbStartBar = na
var int orbHighBar = na
var int orbLowBar = na
var bool orbBuilding = false
var bool orbComplete = false

var bool  orbSignalFired     = false
var bool  orbBreakoutPending = false
var int   orbBreakoutDir     = 0
var int   orbBreakoutBar     = 0
var float orbSignalEntry     = na
var float orbSignalSL    = na
var float orbSignalTP1   = na
var float orbSignalTP2   = na
var float orbSignalTP3   = na
var int   orbSignalDir   = 0
var bool  orbTP1Hit      = false
var bool  orbTP2Hit      = false
var bool  orbTP3Hit      = false
var bool  orbSLHit       = false
var line  orbSLLine      = na
var line  orbTP1Line     = na
var line  orbTP2Line     = na
var line  orbTP3Line     = na
var label orbSLLabel     = na
var label orbTP1Label    = na
var label orbTP2Label    = na
var label orbTP3Label    = na

var float pdTrackHigh = na
var float pdTrackLow = na
var float currentPDH = na
var float currentPDL = na

var float asianHigh = na
var float asianLow = na
var int asianHighBar = na
var int asianLowBar = na
var int asianStartBar = na
var bool asianBuilding = false
var float currentAsianHigh = na
var float currentAsianLow = na
var float currentAsianMid = na
var box currentAsianBox = na

var float londonHigh = na
var float londonLow = na
var int londonHighBar = na
var int londonLowBar = na
var int londonStartBar = na
var bool londonBuilding = false
var float currentLondonHigh = na
var float currentLondonLow = na
var float currentLondonMid = na
var box currentLondonBox = na

var float nyamHigh = na
var float nyamLow = na
var int nyamHighBar = na
var int nyamLowBar = na
var int nyamStartBar = na
var bool nyamBuilding = false
var float currentNYAMHigh = na
var float currentNYAMLow = na
var float currentNYAMMid = na
var box currentNYAMBox = na

var float nypmHigh = na
var float nypmLow = na
var int nypmHighBar = na
var int nypmLowBar = na
var int nypmStartBar = na
var bool nypmBuilding = false
var float currentNYPMHigh = na
var float currentNYPMLow = na
var float currentNYPMMid = na
var box currentNYPMBox = na

var string htf1PrevBias = ""
var string htf2PrevBias = ""

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// TIME HELPERS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
newDay = dayofweek != dayofweek[1]
inORBSession = not na(time(timeframe.period, orbSession, "America/New_York"))
inPDSession = not na(time(timeframe.period, pdSession, "America/New_York"))
inAsianSession = not na(time(timeframe.period, asianSession, "America/New_York"))
inLondonSession = not na(time(timeframe.period, londonSession, "America/New_York"))
inNYAMSession = not na(time(timeframe.period, nyamSession, "America/New_York"))
inNYPMSession = not na(time(timeframe.period, nypmSession, "America/New_York"))

inAsianExtend = extendAsianLines and not na(time(timeframe.period, asianExtendSession, "America/New_York"))
inLondonExtend = extendLondonLines and not na(time(timeframe.period, londonExtendSession, "America/New_York"))

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// HTF BIAS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
[htf1High, htf1Low] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, htf1, [high, low])
htf1SwingHigh = ta.pivothigh(htf1High, swingLookback, swingLookback)
htf1SwingLow = ta.pivotlow(htf1Low, swingLookback, swingLookback)

var float htf1LastHigh = na
var float htf1PrevHigh = na
var float htf1LastLow = na
var float htf1PrevLow = na

if not na(htf1SwingHigh)
    htf1PrevHigh := htf1LastHigh
    htf1LastHigh := htf1SwingHigh

if not na(htf1SwingLow)
    htf1PrevLow := htf1LastLow
    htf1LastLow := htf1SwingLow

htf1HigherHigh = not na(htf1LastHigh) and not na(htf1PrevHigh) and htf1LastHigh > htf1PrevHigh
htf1LowerHigh = not na(htf1LastHigh) and not na(htf1PrevHigh) and htf1LastHigh < htf1PrevHigh
htf1HigherLow = not na(htf1LastLow) and not na(htf1PrevLow) and htf1LastLow > htf1PrevLow
htf1LowerLow = not na(htf1LastLow) and not na(htf1PrevLow) and htf1LastLow < htf1PrevLow

htf1Bullish = htf1HigherHigh and htf1HigherLow
htf1Bearish = htf1LowerHigh and htf1LowerLow

htf1BiasText = htf1Bullish ? "BULLISH" : htf1Bearish ? "BEARISH" : "NEUTRAL"
htf1BiasColor = htf1Bullish ? dashBullColor : htf1Bearish ? dashBearColor : dashNeutralColor
htf1StructureText = (htf1HigherHigh ? "HH" : htf1LowerHigh ? "LH" : "-") + " / " + (htf1HigherLow ? "HL" : htf1LowerLow ? "LL" : "-")

htf1BiasChanged = htf1BiasText != htf1PrevBias and htf1PrevBias != ""
htf1PrevBias := htf1BiasText

[htf2High, htf2Low] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, htf2, [high, low])
htf2SwingHigh = ta.pivothigh(htf2High, swingLookback, swingLookback)
htf2SwingLow = ta.pivotlow(htf2Low, swingLookback, swingLookback)

var float htf2LastHigh = na
var float htf2PrevHigh = na
var float htf2LastLow = na
var float htf2PrevLow = na

if not na(htf2SwingHigh)
    htf2PrevHigh := htf2LastHigh
    htf2LastHigh := htf2SwingHigh

if not na(htf2SwingLow)
    htf2PrevLow := htf2LastLow
    htf2LastLow := htf2SwingLow

htf2HigherHigh = not na(htf2LastHigh) and not na(htf2PrevHigh) and htf2LastHigh > htf2PrevHigh
htf2LowerHigh = not na(htf2LastHigh) and not na(htf2PrevHigh) and htf2LastHigh < htf2PrevHigh
htf2HigherLow = not na(htf2LastLow) and not na(htf2PrevLow) and htf2LastLow > htf2PrevLow
htf2LowerLow = not na(htf2LastLow) and not na(htf2PrevLow) and htf2LastLow < htf2PrevLow

htf2Bullish = htf2HigherHigh and htf2HigherLow
htf2Bearish = htf2LowerHigh and htf2LowerLow

htf2BiasText = htf2Bullish ? "BULLISH" : htf2Bearish ? "BEARISH" : "NEUTRAL"
htf2BiasColor = htf2Bullish ? dashBullColor : htf2Bearish ? dashBearColor : dashNeutralColor
htf2StructureText = (htf2HigherHigh ? "HH" : htf2LowerHigh ? "LH" : "-") + " / " + (htf2HigherLow ? "HL" : htf2LowerLow ? "LL" : "-")

htf2BiasChanged = htf2BiasText != htf2PrevBias and htf2PrevBias != ""
htf2PrevBias := htf2BiasText

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ORB TRACKING
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
if newDay
    currentORBHigh := na
    currentORBLow := na
    currentORBMid := na
    orbBuilding := false
    orbComplete := false
    orbStartBar := na
    orbHighBar := na
    orbLowBar := na
    orbSignalFired     := false
    orbBreakoutPending := false
    orbBreakoutDir     := 0
    orbBreakoutBar     := 0
    orbSignalDir       := 0
    orbTP1Hit          := false
    orbTP2Hit      := false
    orbTP3Hit      := false
    orbSLHit       := false
    orbSignalEntry := na
    orbSignalSL   := na
    orbSignalTP1  := na
    orbSignalTP2  := na
    orbSignalTP3  := na
    line.delete(orbSLLine)
    line.delete(orbTP1Line)
    line.delete(orbTP2Line)
    line.delete(orbTP3Line)
    label.delete(orbSLLabel)
    label.delete(orbTP1Label)
    label.delete(orbTP2Label)
    label.delete(orbTP3Label)

if inORBSession and not orbComplete
    if not orbBuilding
        orbStartBar := bar_index
        orbBuilding := true
    if na(currentORBHigh) or high > currentORBHigh
        currentORBHigh := high
        orbHighBar := bar_index
    if na(currentORBLow) or low < currentORBLow
        currentORBLow := low
        orbLowBar := bar_index

if not inORBSession and orbBuilding and not orbComplete and not na(currentORBHigh)
    orbComplete := true
    currentORBMid := (currentORBHigh + currentORBLow) / 2

    if showORB
        hiLine = line.new(orbHighBar, currentORBHigh, bar_index + 100, currentORBHigh, color=orbHighColor, style=getLineStyle(), width=orbLineWidth)
        loLine = line.new(orbLowBar, currentORBLow, bar_index + 100, currentORBLow, color=orbLowColor, style=getLineStyle(), width=orbLineWidth)
        midLine = showMidline ? line.new(orbStartBar, currentORBMid, bar_index + 100, currentORBMid, color=orbMidColor, style=line.style_dotted, width=math.max(1, orbLineWidth - 1)) : na

        hiLabel = showLabels ? label.new(bar_index + 102, currentORBHigh, "ORB H", style=label.style_none, textcolor=orbHighColor, size=getLabelSize()) : na
        loLabel = showLabels ? label.new(bar_index + 102, currentORBLow, "ORB L", style=label.style_none, textcolor=orbLowColor, size=getLabelSize()) : na
        midLabel = showLabels and showMidline ? label.new(bar_index + 102, currentORBMid, "ORB M", style=label.style_none, textcolor=orbMidColor, size=getLabelSize()) : na

        newOrb = orbData.new(currentORBHigh, currentORBLow, currentORBMid, orbStartBar, orbHighBar, orbLowBar, hiLine, loLine, midLine, hiLabel, loLabel, midLabel)
        array.unshift(orbArray, newOrb)

        if array.size(orbArray) > orbHistory
            old = array.pop(orbArray)
            line.delete(old.hiLine)
            line.delete(old.loLine)
            line.delete(old.midLine)
            label.delete(old.hiLabel)
            label.delete(old.loLabel)
            label.delete(old.midLabel)

if orbComplete and array.size(orbArray) > 0
    current = array.get(orbArray, 0)
    line.set_x2(current.hiLine, bar_index + 20)
    line.set_x2(current.loLine, bar_index + 20)
    if showMidline and not na(current.midLine)
        line.set_x2(current.midLine, bar_index + 20)
    if showLabels
        label.set_x(current.hiLabel, bar_index + 22)
        label.set_x(current.loLabel, bar_index + 22)
        if showMidline and not na(current.midLabel)
            label.set_x(current.midLabel, bar_index + 22)

orbHighBreak = orbComplete and ta.crossover(close, currentORBHigh)
orbLowBreak = orbComplete and ta.crossunder(close, currentORBLow)
orbMidCrossUp = orbComplete and showMidline and ta.crossover(close, currentORBMid)
orbMidCrossDown = orbComplete and showMidline and ta.crossunder(close, currentORBMid)

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ORB TRADE SIGNALS — Breakout / Retest Zone / Retest Midpoint
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
bool orbLongSignal  = false
bool orbShortSignal = false

if i_enableSignals and orbBreakoutPending and bar_index > orbBreakoutBar and not orbSignalFired
    _retestLvl = i_orbEntryMode == "Retest Midpoint" ? currentORBMid : (orbBreakoutDir == 1 ? currentORBHigh : currentORBLow)
    if orbBreakoutDir == 1
        if low <= _retestLvl and close > currentORBHigh
            orbLongSignal      := true
            orbBreakoutPending := false
        else if close <= currentORBHigh
            orbBreakoutPending := false
    else if orbBreakoutDir == -1
        if high >= _retestLvl and close < currentORBLow
            orbShortSignal     := true
            orbBreakoutPending := false
        else if close >= currentORBLow
            orbBreakoutPending := false
    if orbBreakoutPending and bar_index - orbBreakoutBar >= i_orbRetestTimeout
        orbBreakoutPending := false

if i_enableSignals and orbComplete and not orbSignalFired
    if i_orbEntryMode == "Breakout"
        if barstate.isconfirmed and orbHighBreak
            orbLongSignal := true
        else if barstate.isconfirmed and orbLowBreak
            orbShortSignal := true
    else
        if orbHighBreak and not orbBreakoutPending
            orbBreakoutPending := true
            orbBreakoutDir     := 1
            orbBreakoutBar     := bar_index
        else if orbLowBreak and not orbBreakoutPending
            orbBreakoutPending := true
            orbBreakoutDir     := -1
            orbBreakoutBar     := bar_index

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// STRATEGY ORDERS (Backtest)
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
if orbLongSignal
    orbSignalFired := true
    orbSignalEntry := close
    orbSignalDir   := 1

    if i_orbSLMethod == "Midpoint"
        orbSignalSL := currentORBMid
    else if i_orbSLMethod == "Opposite Side"
        orbSignalSL := currentORBLow
    else
        orbSignalSL := close - i_orbSLPoints

    _risk = math.abs(orbSignalEntry - orbSignalSL)
    if _risk > 0
        orbSignalTP1 := orbSignalEntry + _risk * i_orbTP1RR
        orbSignalTP2 := orbSignalEntry + _risk * i_orbTP2RR
        orbSignalTP3 := orbSignalEntry + _risk * i_orbTP3RR

    _contracts = f_clampQty(i_orbContracts)
    _tp1Qty = f_clampQty(i_orbTP1Qty)
    _tp2Qty = f_clampQty(i_orbTP2Qty)
    _tp3Qty = f_clampQty(f_buildTp3Qty(_contracts, _tp1Qty, _tp2Qty, i_orbTP3Qty))

    if _contracts > 0
        strategy.entry("ORB Long", strategy.long, qty=_contracts)

        if _tp1Qty > 0
            strategy.exit("L-TP1", from_entry="ORB Long", qty=_tp1Qty, stop=orbSignalSL, limit=orbSignalTP1)
        if _tp2Qty > 0
            strategy.exit("L-TP2", from_entry="ORB Long", qty=_tp2Qty, stop=orbSignalSL, limit=orbSignalTP2)
        if _tp3Qty > 0
            strategy.exit("L-TP3", from_entry="ORB Long", qty=_tp3Qty, stop=orbSignalSL, limit=orbSignalTP3)

if orbShortSignal
    orbSignalFired := true
    orbSignalEntry := close
    orbSignalDir   := -1

    if i_orbSLMethod == "Midpoint"
        orbSignalSL := currentORBMid
    else if i_orbSLMethod == "Opposite Side"
        orbSignalSL := currentORBHigh
    else
        orbSignalSL := close + i_orbSLPoints

    _risk = math.abs(orbSignalSL - orbSignalEntry)
    if _risk > 0
        orbSignalTP1 := orbSignalEntry - _risk * i_orbTP1RR
        orbSignalTP2 := orbSignalEntry - _risk * i_orbTP2RR
        orbSignalTP3 := orbSignalEntry - _risk * i_orbTP3RR

    _contracts = f_clampQty(i_orbContracts)
    _tp1Qty = f_clampQty(i_orbTP1Qty)
    _tp2Qty = f_clampQty(i_orbTP2Qty)
    _tp3Qty = f_clampQty(f_buildTp3Qty(_contracts, _tp1Qty, _tp2Qty, i_orbTP3Qty))

    if _contracts > 0
        strategy.entry("ORB Short", strategy.short, qty=_contracts)

        if _tp1Qty > 0
            strategy.exit("S-TP1", from_entry="ORB Short", qty=_tp1Qty, stop=orbSignalSL, limit=orbSignalTP1)
        if _tp2Qty > 0
            strategy.exit("S-TP2", from_entry="ORB Short", qty=_tp2Qty, stop=orbSignalSL, limit=orbSignalTP2)
        if _tp3Qty > 0
            strategy.exit("S-TP3", from_entry="ORB Short", qty=_tp3Qty, stop=orbSignalSL, limit=orbSignalTP3)

// Extend SL/TP lines forward each bar (visuals)
if orbSignalDir != 0 and i_orbShowSLTP
    if not na(orbSLLine)
        line.set_x2(orbSLLine, bar_index + 20)
        line.set_x2(orbTP1Line, bar_index + 20)
        line.set_x2(orbTP2Line, bar_index + 20)
        line.set_x2(orbTP3Line, bar_index + 20)
    if showLabels and not na(orbSLLabel)
        label.set_x(orbSLLabel, bar_index + 22)
        label.set_x(orbTP1Label, bar_index + 22)
        label.set_x(orbTP2Label, bar_index + 22)
        label.set_x(orbTP3Label, bar_index + 22)

// Entry arrows
plotshape(i_orbShowEntry and orbLongSignal,  title="ORB Long",  style=shape.triangleup,   location=location.belowbar, color=color.green, size=size.small, text="ORB LONG")
plotshape(i_orbShowEntry and orbShortSignal, title="ORB Short", style=shape.triangledown, location=location.abovebar, color=color.red,   size=size.small, text="ORB SHORT")

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// NOTE:
// Your original script continues with PDH/PDL, Sessions, FVG, Dashboard, Alerts.
// Paste the REST of your original code BELOW this line unchanged.
// (Everything after your ORB section can remain identical.)
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

items.name: ORB + Fib Breakout Signals (Strategy)
items.title: ORB + Fib Breakout Signals
items.author: chadsingh
items.source:
//@version=6
// ORB + Fib Breakout — STRATEGY v3 (risk-managed)
// Signal logic unchanged. Added: real costs, ATR/R risk model, breakeven, daily guards.
// NOTE: commission/slippage below are sane MNQ defaults — override in Properties for your broker.
strategy("ORB + Fib Breakout Signals", overlay=true, initial_capital=100000, default_qty_type=strategy.fixed, default_qty_value=1, pyramiding=0, calc_on_every_tick=false, process_orders_on_close=true, commission_type=strategy.commission.cash_per_contract, commission_value=0.62, slippage=2)

// ---------- INPUTS: OPENING RANGE ----------
g1 = "Opening Range"
orbChoice  = input.string("15 min", "Opening Range Length", options=["15 min","30 min","1 hour"], group=g1)
startHour  = input.int(8,  "Session Start Hour (exchange tz)", minval=0, maxval=23, group=g1)
startMin   = input.int(30, "Session Start Minute", minval=0, maxval=59, group=g1)
tzInput    = input.string("America/Chicago", "Timezone", tooltip="e.g. America/Chicago, America/New_York", group=g1)
signalSess = input.session("0830-1500", "Active Session (levels + signals)", group=g1)

// ---------- INPUTS: SIGNALS ----------
g2 = "Signals"
breakChoice = input.string("Close", "Breakout Trigger", options=["Close","Wick (High/Low)"], group=g2)
oncePerDay  = input.bool(true, "One signal per direction per day", group=g2)

// ---------- INPUTS: FIBONACCI ----------
g3 = "Fibonacci"
showInner = input.bool(true, "Show inner fibs (.236/.382/.5/.618/.786)", group=g3)
showExt   = input.bool(true, "Show extension targets (1.272 / 1.618)", group=g3)

// ---------- INPUTS: VISUALS ----------
g4 = "Visuals"
shadeORB = input.bool(true, "Shade opening-range window", group=g4)

// ---------- BUILD ORB SESSION STRING ----------
orbMins    = orbChoice == "15 min" ? 15 : orbChoice == "30 min" ? 30 : 60
startTotal = startHour * 60 + startMin
endTotal   = startTotal + orbMins
endH       = int(math.floor(endTotal / 60)) % 24
endM       = endTotal % 60
f_pad(x) => (x < 10 ? "0" : "") + str.tostring(x)
orbSession = f_pad(startHour) + f_pad(startMin) + "-" + f_pad(endH) + f_pad(endM)

// ---------- SESSION DETECTION ----------
inORB     = not na(time(timeframe.period, orbSession, tzInput))
inSession = not na(time(timeframe.period, signalSess, tzInput))
newORB    = inORB and not inORB[1]
orbEnded  = not inORB and inORB[1]
newSess   = inSession and not inSession[1]
sessEnded = not inSession and inSession[1]

// ---------- BUILD / LOCK THE OPENING RANGE ----------
var float orbHigh   = na
var float orbLow    = na
var bool  orbReady  = false
var bool  buyFired  = false
var bool  sellFired = false

if newORB
    orbHigh   := high
    orbLow    := low
    orbReady  := false
    buyFired  := false
    sellFired := false
else if inORB
    orbHigh := math.max(nz(orbHigh, high), high)
    orbLow  := math.min(nz(orbLow, low), low)

if orbEnded
    orbReady := true

// ---------- FIB LEVELS ----------
rng    = orbHigh - orbLow
fib236 = orbLow + rng * 0.236
fib382 = orbLow + rng * 0.382
fib500 = orbLow + rng * 0.500
fib618 = orbLow + rng * 0.618
fib786 = orbLow + rng * 0.786
extUp1 = orbHigh + rng * 0.272
extUp2 = orbHigh + rng * 0.618
extDn1 = orbLow  - rng * 0.272
extDn2 = orbLow  - rng * 0.618

showRange = inSession and (inORB or orbReady)
disp      = inSession and orbReady

// ---------- SIGNALS (ORB breakout only) ----------
useClose = breakChoice == "Close"
upSrc = useClose ? close : high
dnSrc = useClose ? close : low

rawBuy  = disp and ta.crossover(upSrc, orbHigh)
rawSell = disp and ta.crossunder(dnSrc, orbLow)
buySignal  = rawBuy  and (not oncePerDay or not buyFired)
sellSignal = rawSell and (not oncePerDay or not sellFired)
if buySignal
    buyFired := true
if sellSignal
    sellFired := true

// ---------- PLOTS ----------
plot(showRange ? orbHigh : na, "ORB High", color=color.new(color.teal, 0),   linewidth=2, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(showRange ? orbLow  : na, "ORB Low",  color=color.new(color.maroon, 0), linewidth=2, style=plot.style_linebr)

plot(disp and showInner ? fib500 : na, "Fib 0.5",   color=color.new(color.gray, 20), style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(disp and showInner ? fib236 : na, "Fib 0.236", color=color.new(color.blue, 50), style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(disp and showInner ? fib382 : na, "Fib 0.382", color=color.new(color.blue, 50), style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(disp and showInner ? fib618 : na, "Fib 0.618", color=color.new(color.blue, 50), style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(disp and showInner ? fib786 : na, "Fib 0.786", color=color.new(color.blue, 50), style=plot.style_linebr)

plot(disp and showExt ? extUp1 : na, "Ext 1.272 Up", color=color.new(color.green, 30), style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(disp and showExt ? extUp2 : na, "Ext 1.618 Up", color=color.new(color.green, 30), style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(disp and showExt ? extDn1 : na, "Ext 1.272 Dn", color=color.new(color.red, 30),   style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(disp and showExt ? extDn2 : na, "Ext 1.618 Dn", color=color.new(color.red, 30),   style=plot.style_linebr)

bgcolor(shadeORB and inORB and inSession ? color.new(color.blue, 90) : na, title="ORB Window")

plotshape(buySignal,  "BUY",  shape.labelup,   location.belowbar, color.new(color.green, 0), text="BUY",  textcolor=color.white, size=size.small)
plotshape(sellSignal, "SELL", shape.labeldown, location.abovebar, color.new(color.red, 0),   text="SELL", textcolor=color.white, size=size.small)

// ---------- ALERTS ----------
alertcondition(buySignal,  "ORB Breakout BUY",   "ORB breakout long")
alertcondition(sellSignal, "ORB Breakdown SELL", "ORB breakout short")

// ============================================================
// STRATEGY EXECUTION v3 (risk-managed — everything above unchanged)
// ============================================================
gR = "Risk Model"
qty        = input.float(1, "Contracts / Qty", minval=0.000001, group=gR)
stopMode   = input.string("ATR", "Stop placement", options=["ATR","Fib 0.5","ORB opposite","Fixed ticks"], group=gR)
atrMult    = input.float(1.5, "ATR stop multiple", minval=0.1, step=0.1, group=gR)
fixedTicks = input.int(40, "Fixed stop (ticks)", minval=1, group=gR)
slBufTicks = input.int(2, "Stop buffer (ticks)", minval=0, group=gR)
tgtMode    = input.string("R multiple", "Target", options=["R multiple","Ext 1.272","Ext 1.618"], group=gR)
rMult      = input.float(2.0, "Target R multiple", minval=0.1, step=0.1, group=gR)
useBE      = input.bool(true, "Move stop to breakeven at 1R", group=gR)
beBufTicks = input.int(2, "Breakeven buffer (ticks)", minval=0, group=gR)

gD = "Daily Guards (prop-firm)"
maxTrades   = input.int(4, "Max entries per day", minval=1, group=gD)
useDayLoss  = input.bool(true, "Use daily loss limit", group=gD)
dayLossUsd  = input.float(500, "Daily loss limit ($)", minval=1, group=gD)
useDayTgt   = input.bool(false, "Lock in at daily profit target", group=gD)
dayTgtUsd   = input.float(900, "Daily profit target ($)", minval=1, group=gD)
closeEod    = input.bool(true, "Flat at session close", group=gD)

atr  = ta.atr(14)
mt   = syminfo.mintick
buf  = mt * slBufTicks
beB  = mt * beBufTicks

// --- daily counters ---
var int   tradesToday = 0
var float dayAnchor   = 0.0
var bool  blockedDay  = false
if newSess
    tradesToday := 0
    dayAnchor   := strategy.netprofit
    blockedDay  := false
dayPnL = strategy.netprofit - dayAnchor + strategy.openprofit
if useDayLoss and dayPnL <= -dayLossUsd
    blockedDay := true
if useDayTgt and dayPnL >= dayTgtUsd
    blockedDay := true

// --- position bookkeeping ---
var float entryPx = na
var float curStop = na
var float tgtPx   = na
var float riskU   = na

f_stopLong(float px) =>
    raw = stopMode == "ATR"          ? px - atr * atrMult :
          stopMode == "Fib 0.5"      ? fib500 :
          stopMode == "ORB opposite" ? orbLow :
                                       px - fixedTicks * mt
    raw - buf

f_stopShort(float px) =>
    raw = stopMode == "ATR"          ? px + atr * atrMult :
          stopMode == "Fib 0.5"      ? fib500 :
          stopMode == "ORB opposite" ? orbHigh :
                                       px + fixedTicks * mt
    raw + buf

canTrade = not blockedDay and tradesToday < maxTrades

if buySignal and canTrade
    px   = close
    st   = math.min(f_stopLong(px), px - mt)   // ensure stop is below entry
    rk   = px - st
    entryPx := px
    curStop := st
    riskU   := rk
    tgtPx   := tgtMode == "R multiple" ? px + rMult * rk : tgtMode == "Ext 1.272" ? extUp1 : extUp2
    strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long, qty=qty)
    tradesToday += 1

if sellSignal and canTrade
    px   = close
    st   = math.max(f_stopShort(px), px + mt)  // ensure stop is above entry
    rk   = st - px
    entryPx := px
    curStop := st
    riskU   := rk
    tgtPx   := tgtMode == "R multiple" ? px - rMult * rk : tgtMode == "Ext 1.272" ? extDn1 : extDn2
    strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short, qty=qty)
    tradesToday += 1

// --- manage open position: breakeven + bracket ---
if strategy.position_size > 0
    if useBE and high >= entryPx + riskU
        curStop := math.max(curStop, entryPx + beB)
    strategy.exit("Long X", from_entry="Long", stop=curStop, limit=tgtPx)
if strategy.position_size < 0
    if useBE and low <= entryPx - riskU
        curStop := math.min(curStop, entryPx - beB)
    strategy.exit("Short X", from_entry="Short", stop=curStop, limit=tgtPx)

// --- forced flats ---
if blockedDay and strategy.position_size != 0
    strategy.close_all(comment="Day limit")
if closeEod and sessEnded
    strategy.close_all(comment="EOD")
