items.title: ORB Small Range Breakout Strategy v1.4
items.author: danielbutcher72
items.source:
//@version=6
strategy("ORB Small Range Breakout Strategy v1.4", overlay=true, max_lines_count=500, max_boxes_count=500, max_labels_count=500, pyramiding=0)

// Automatically resolves to the loaded symbol's own exchange timezone
// (Europe/London for LSE, Africa/Johannesburg for JSE, etc.)
tz = syminfo.timezone

// Inputs
smallThreshold = input.float(0.50, "Small ORB threshold %")
largeThreshold = input.float(1.00, "Large ORB threshold %")

orbStartHour   = input.int(8, "Opening Range Start Hour", minval=0, maxval=23, group="Opening Range")
orbStartMinute = input.int(0, "Opening Range Start Minute", minval=0, maxval=59, group="Opening Range")
orbEndHour     = input.int(8, "Opening Range End Hour", minval=0, maxval=23, group="Opening Range")
orbEndMinute   = input.int(25, "Opening Range End Minute", minval=0, maxval=59, group="Opening Range")

cutoffHour     = input.int(11, "Entry Cutoff Hour", minval=0, maxval=23, group="Entry Window")
cutoffMinute   = input.int(0, "Entry Cutoff Minute", minval=0, maxval=59, group="Entry Window")

tpMode = input.string("R Multiple", "Take Profit Mode", options=["R Multiple", "ORB Projection", "No TP"])
rMultiple = input.float(2.0, "R Multiple TP", step=0.25)
orbProjectionMult = input.float(2.0, "ORB Projection Multiplier", step=0.25)

useSessionExit = input.bool(true, "Close open trade at session time?")
exitHour = input.int(16, "Exit Hour (exchange local time)", minval=0, maxval=23)
exitMinute = input.int(0, "Exit Minute", minval=0, maxval=59)

// Exchange-local time, via syminfo.timezone
h = hour(time, tz)
m = minute(time, tz)

// --- Build TradingView session strings from the hour/minute inputs, e.g. "0800-0825" ---
pad2(n) =>
    n < 10 ? "0" + str.tostring(n) : str.tostring(n)

orbSessionStr    = pad2(orbStartHour) + pad2(orbStartMinute) + "-" + pad2(orbEndHour) + pad2(orbEndMinute)
entrySessionStr  = pad2(orbEndHour) + pad2(orbEndMinute) + "-" + pad2(cutoffHour) + pad2(cutoffMinute)

// time(...) returns the bar's timestamp when it falls inside the session, na otherwise.
// This is TradingView's own session engine, so it correctly handles any timeframe
// and doesn't rely on a bar landing on an exact minute.
isOrbBar   = not na(time(timeframe.period, orbSessionStr, tz))
isEntryBar = not na(time(timeframe.period, entrySessionStr, tz))

isFirstOrbBar = isOrbBar and not isOrbBar[1]   // transition INTO the ORB window
isDrawBar     = isOrbBar[1] and not isOrbBar   // transition OUT of the ORB window (ORB just finished)

// ORB state
var float orbHigh = na
var float orbLow = na
var float openingPrice = na
var int   orbStartBar = na
var bool  drawn = false
var bool  breakoutDone = false
var bool  orbIsSmall = false
var bool  orbIsTradeable = false
var float orbPercent = na
var bool  exitedToday = false

if isFirstOrbBar
    orbHigh := high
    orbLow := low
    openingPrice := open
    orbStartBar := bar_index
    drawn := false
    breakoutDone := false
    orbIsSmall := false
    orbIsTradeable := false
    orbPercent := na
    exitedToday := false

if isOrbBar
    orbHigh := math.max(orbHigh, high)
    orbLow := math.min(orbLow, low)

bgcolor(isOrbBar ? color.new(color.yellow, 85) : na)

// Draw/classify ORB
if isDrawBar and not na(orbHigh) and not na(orbLow)
    rangeSize = orbHigh - orbLow
    orbPercent := rangeSize / openingPrice * 100

    orbIsSmall := orbPercent < smallThreshold
    isLarge = orbPercent >= largeThreshold

    // SMALL and MEDIUM are tradeable, LARGE is rejected
    orbIsTradeable := not isLarge

    classification = orbIsSmall ? "SMALL" : isLarge ? "LARGE" : "MEDIUM"

    boxColour = orbIsSmall ? color.new(color.green, 70) : isLarge ? color.new(color.red, 70) : color.new(color.orange, 70)
    labelColour = orbIsSmall ? color.green : isLarge ? color.red : color.orange

    // Cosmetic estimate of how far to extend the ORB lines/box across the entry window
    entryDurationMinutes = (cutoffHour * 60 + cutoffMinute) - (orbEndHour * 60 + orbEndMinute)
    barsForEntryWindow = math.max(1, math.round(entryDurationMinutes / (timeframe.in_seconds() / 60)))
    orbLineEndBar = bar_index + barsForEntryWindow

    box.new(orbStartBar, orbHigh, bar_index, orbLow, bgcolor=boxColour, border_color=color.blue)
    line.new(orbStartBar, orbHigh, orbLineEndBar, orbHigh, width=2, color=color.blue)
    line.new(orbStartBar, orbLow, orbLineEndBar, orbLow, width=2, color=color.blue)

    labelText = "ORB"
    labelText += "\n" + str.tostring(orbPercent, "#.##") + "%"
    labelText += "\n" + classification
    labelText += "\nH " + str.tostring(orbHigh)
    labelText += "\nL " + str.tostring(orbLow)

    label.new(bar_index, orbHigh, labelText, style=label.style_label_down, color=labelColour, textcolor=color.white)

    drawn := true

// Entry conditions — inEntryWindow now comes directly from the configurable session
longBreakout  = drawn and orbIsTradeable and not breakoutDone and isEntryBar and close > orbHigh
shortBreakout = drawn and orbIsTradeable and not breakoutDone and isEntryBar and close < orbLow

orbRange = orbHigh - orbLow

if longBreakout
    longEntry = close
    longStop = orbLow
    longRisk = longEntry - longStop

    longTP = switch tpMode
        "R Multiple" => longEntry + longRisk * rMultiple
        "ORB Projection" => orbHigh + orbRange * orbProjectionMult
        => na

    strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long)

    if tpMode == "No TP"
        strategy.exit("Long Exit", "Long", stop=longStop)
    else
        strategy.exit("Long Exit", "Long", stop=longStop, limit=longTP)

    label.new(bar_index, low, "LONG\n" + str.tostring(close), style=label.style_label_up, color=color.green, textcolor=color.white)

    breakoutDone := true

if shortBreakout
    shortEntry = close
    shortStop = orbHigh
    shortRisk = shortStop - shortEntry

    shortTP = switch tpMode
        "R Multiple" => shortEntry - shortRisk * rMultiple
        "ORB Projection" => orbLow - orbRange * orbProjectionMult
        => na

    strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short)

    if tpMode == "No TP"
        strategy.exit("Short Exit", "Short", stop=shortStop)
    else
        strategy.exit("Short Exit", "Short", stop=shortStop, limit=shortTP)

    label.new(bar_index, high, "SHORT\n" + str.tostring(close), style=label.style_label_down, color=color.red, textcolor=color.white)

    breakoutDone := true

// Session exit — fires on/after the target time rather than only on an exact
// minute match, and only once per day, so it can't get skipped by a data gap
sessionExit = useSessionExit and not exitedToday and (h > exitHour or (h == exitHour and m >= exitMinute))

if sessionExit
    strategy.close_all(comment="Session Exit")
    exitedToday := true

// Visuals
plotshape(longBreakout, title="Long Breakout", style=shape.triangleup, location=location.belowbar, color=color.green, size=size.tiny)
plotshape(shortBreakout, title="Short Breakout", style=shape.triangledown, location=location.abovebar, color=color.red, size=size.tiny)

items.name: NASDAQ ORB Strategy - Strict Exec (RRR 2.0) Fixed
items.title: NASDAQ ORB Strategy - Strict Exec (RRR 2.0) Fixed
items.author: drakkhon
items.source:
//@version=5
strategy("NASDAQ ORB Strategy - Strict Exec (RRR 2.0) Fixed", overlay=true, initial_capital=10000, default_qty_type=strategy.fixed, default_qty_value=1, process_orders_on_close=true)

// --- INPUTS ---
float rvol_threshold = input.float(1.5, title="Minimálne RVOL pre vstup", step=0.1)
float rrr             = input.float(2.0, title="Risk Reward Ratio (RRR)", step=0.1) // ZMENENÉ: Predvolené RRR nastavené na 2.0

// --- Time Extraction (Vždy vynútený New York čas) ---
ny_hour   = hour(time, "America/New_York")
ny_minute = minute(time, "America/New_York")

// Definícia obchodných okien (NY čas)
is_orb_window   = (ny_hour == 9 and ny_minute >= 30 and ny_minute < 45)
is_trade_window = (ny_hour == 9 and ny_minute >= 45) or (ny_hour > 9 and ny_hour < 16)

// --- STATE VARIABLES ---
var float orb_high = na
var float orb_low = na
var float orb_mid = na
var bool orb_locked = false
var bool trade_taken_today = false

// UI a grafické prvky
var box profit_box = na
var box risk_box = na
var table rvol_table = table.new(position.top_right, 1, 1)

// Per-trade persistence variables for boxes
var float current_tp = na
var float current_sl = na
var float current_entry = na

// Reset hladín presne o 09:30 AM NY času
if ny_hour == 9 and ny_minute == 30
    orb_high := high
    orb_low := low
    orb_mid := na
    orb_locked := false
    trade_taken_today := false
else if is_orb_window
    orb_high := math.max(high, orb_high)
    orb_low := math.min(low, orb_low)

// Uzamknutie pásma o 09:45 AM NY času
if ny_hour == 9 and ny_minute == 45 and not orb_locked
    orb_mid := (orb_high + orb_low) / 2
    orb_locked := true

// --- STABILNÝ RVOL VÝPOČET ---
vol_sma = ta.sma(volume, 20)
rvol = not na(vol_sma) and vol_sma > 0 ? volume / vol_sma : 1.0

// --- UI DASHBOARD ---
color cell_color = rvol >= rvol_threshold ? color.new(color.green, 20) : color.new(color.red, 20)
if barstate.islast
    table.cell(rvol_table, 0, 0, text="RVOL: " + str.tostring(rvol, "#.##"), text_color=color.white, bgcolor=cell_color, text_size=size.normal)

// --- PLOTTING ---
plot(orb_locked and is_trade_window ? orb_high : na, title="ORB High", color=color.white, linewidth=2, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(orb_locked and is_trade_window ? orb_low : na, title="ORB Low", color=color.white, linewidth=2, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(orb_locked and is_trade_window ? orb_mid : na, title="ORB Mid (SL)", color=color.yellow, linewidth=2, style=plot.style_linebr)

// --- EXECUTION ENGINE ---
can_trade = is_trade_window and orb_locked and not trade_taken_today and strategy.position_size == 0

// Striktné kríženie hladín na uzatvorení sviečke
is_breaking_high = ta.crossover(close, orb_high)
is_breaking_low  = ta.crossunder(close, orb_low)

if can_trade
    // STRATÉGIA: LONG
    if is_breaking_high
        if rvol >= rvol_threshold
            long_sl = orb_mid
            long_risk = close - long_sl
            long_tp = close + (long_risk * rrr)
            
            current_entry := close
            current_sl := long_sl
            current_tp := long_tp
            
            strategy.entry("Long ORB", strategy.long)
            strategy.exit("Exit Long", "Long ORB", stop=long_sl, limit=long_tp)
            
            alert('{"action": "buy", "symbol": "NQ", "sl": ' + str.tostring(long_sl) + ', "tp": ' + str.tostring(long_tp) + '}', alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)

            profit_box := box.new(left=bar_index, top=long_tp, right=bar_index, bottom=close, bgcolor=color.new(color.blue, 85), border_color=color.blue)
            risk_box := box.new(left=bar_index, top=close, right=bar_index, bottom=long_sl, bgcolor=color.new(color.purple, 85), border_color=color.purple)
            
            trade_taken_today := true

    // STRATÉGIA: SHORT
    else if is_breaking_low
        if rvol >= rvol_threshold
            short_sl = orb_mid
            short_risk = short_sl - close
            short_tp = close - (short_risk * rrr)
            
            current_entry := close
            current_sl := short_sl
            current_tp := short_tp
            
            strategy.entry("Short ORB", strategy.short)
            strategy.exit("Exit Short", "Short ORB", stop=short_sl, limit=short_tp)
            
            alert('{"action": "sell", "symbol": "NQ", "sl": ' + str.tostring(short_sl) + ', "tp": ' + str.tostring(short_tp) + '}', alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)

            profit_box := box.new(left=bar_index, top=close, right=bar_index, bottom=short_tp, bgcolor=color.new(color.blue, 85), border_color=color.blue)
            risk_box := box.new(left=bar_index, top=short_sl, right=bar_index, bottom=close, bgcolor=color.new(color.purple, 85), border_color=color.purple)
            
            trade_taken_today := true

// Aktualizácia vizuálnych boxov počas obchodu
if strategy.position_size != 0
    box.set_right(profit_box, bar_index)
    box.set_right(risk_box, bar_index)
    if strategy.position_size > 0
        box.set_top(profit_box, current_tp)
        box.set_bottom(profit_box, current_entry)
        box.set_top(risk_box, current_entry)
        box.set_bottom(risk_box, current_sl)
    else if strategy.position_size < 0
        box.set_top(profit_box, current_entry)
        box.set_bottom(profit_box, current_tp)
        box.set_top(risk_box, current_sl)
        box.set_bottom(risk_box, current_entry)

// Nútené uzavretie všetkých pozícií na konci dňa (16:00 NY času)
if ny_hour == 16 and ny_minute == 0
    strategy.close_all("EOD Close")

items.name: MNQ 15m NY Open ORB Strategy
items.title: MNQ 15m NY Open ORB Strategy
items.author: Nils123456
items.source:
//@version=6
//@strategy_alert_message {{strategy.order.alert_message}}
strategy("MNQ 15m NY Open ORB Strategy",
     overlay = true,
     initial_capital = 25000,
     currency = currency.USD,
     default_qty_type = strategy.fixed,
     default_qty_value = 1,
     commission_type = strategy.commission.cash_per_contract,
     commission_value = 1.20,
     slippage = 2,
     pyramiding = 0,
     calc_on_every_tick = false,
     calc_on_order_fills = false,
     process_orders_on_close = true,
     margin_long = 1,
     margin_short = 1)

// === INPUTS ===
string tz = input.string("America/New_York", "Zeitzone")
string orbSession = input.session("0930-0945", "ORB Session")
string tradeSession = input.session("0945-1600", "Trade Session")

bool useCloseBreak = input.bool(true, "Breakout nur per Kerzenschluss")
bool oneTradePerDay = input.bool(true, "Max. 1 Trade pro Tag")
bool allowLong = input.bool(true, "Long erlauben")
bool allowShort = input.bool(true, "Short erlauben")
bool closeEod = input.bool(true, "Position zum Session-Ende schliessen")

string tradovateSymbol = input.string("MNQM6", "Tradovate Symbol")

// ✅ FIXE CONTRACTS (Prop Firm Style)
int fixedContracts = input.int(8, "Feste Kontraktanzahl", minval = 1)

// === RISK PARAMETER ===
float pointsPerPricePoint = input.float(10.0, "Umrechnung: 10 Punkte = 1 Preis-Punkt", minval = 1.0)
float takeProfitPts = input.float(200.0, "Take Profit in Punkten", minval = 1.0)
float stopLossPts = input.float(200.0, "Stop Loss in Punkten", minval = 1.0)
float trailStopPts = input.float(10.0, "Trailing Stop Loss in Punkten", minval = 1.0)
float trailActivationPts = input.float(15.0, "Profit vor Trailing-Aktivierung", minval = 1.0)

// === BERECHNUNGEN ===
float takeProfitDistance = takeProfitPts / pointsPerPricePoint
float stopLossDistance = stopLossPts / pointsPerPricePoint
float trailStopDistance = trailStopPts / pointsPerPricePoint
float trailActivationDistance = trailActivationPts / pointsPerPricePoint

int takeProfitTicks = int(math.max(1, math.round(takeProfitDistance / syminfo.mintick)))
int stopLossTicks = int(math.max(1, math.round(stopLossDistance / syminfo.mintick)))
int trailStopTicks = int(math.max(1, math.round(trailStopDistance / syminfo.mintick)))
int trailActivationTicks = int(math.max(1, math.round(trailActivationDistance / syminfo.mintick)))

float autoTrailFrequency = syminfo.mintick

// === ALERTS ===
string exitAlertMsg = '{"event":"backtest_exit","ignore":true}'

string longAlertMsg = '{"event":"entry","broker":"tradovate","strategy":"MNQ_NY_ORB","symbol":"' + tradovateSymbol + '","action":"Buy","qty":' + str.tostring(fixedContracts) + ',"orderType":"Market","takeProfitPoints":' + str.tostring(takeProfitDistance, format.mintick) + ',"stopLossPoints":' + str.tostring(stopLossDistance, format.mintick) + ',"autoTrail":{"triggerPoints":' + str.tostring(trailActivationDistance, format.mintick) + ',"stopLossPoints":' + str.tostring(trailStopDistance, format.mintick) + ',"frequencyPoints":' + str.tostring(autoTrailFrequency, format.mintick) + '}}'

string shortAlertMsg = '{"event":"entry","broker":"tradovate","strategy":"MNQ_NY_ORB","symbol":"' + tradovateSymbol + '","action":"Sell","qty":' + str.tostring(fixedContracts) + ',"orderType":"Market","takeProfitPoints":' + str.tostring(takeProfitDistance, format.mintick) + ',"stopLossPoints":' + str.tostring(stopLossDistance, format.mintick) + ',"autoTrail":{"triggerPoints":' + str.tostring(trailActivationDistance, format.mintick) + ',"stopLossPoints":' + str.tostring(trailStopDistance, format.mintick) + ',"frequencyPoints":' + str.tostring(autoTrailFrequency, format.mintick) + '}}'

// === SESSION LOGIK ===
bool inOrb = not na(time(timeframe.period, orbSession, tz))
bool inTradeSession = not na(time(timeframe.period, tradeSession, tz))
bool newNyDay = ta.change(time("D", "0000-2359", tz)) != 0

var float orbHigh = na
var float orbLow = na
var bool orbLocked = false
var bool tradedToday = false

if newNyDay
    orbHigh := na
    orbLow := na
    orbLocked := false
    tradedToday := false

if inOrb
    orbHigh := na(orbHigh) ? high : math.max(orbHigh, high)
    orbLow := na(orbLow) ? low : math.min(orbLow, low)

if not inOrb and inOrb[1] and not na(orbHigh) and not na(orbLow)
    orbLocked := true

bool confirmedBar = barstate.isconfirmed
bool canTrade = confirmedBar and orbLocked and inTradeSession and strategy.position_size == 0 and (not oneTradePerDay or not tradedToday)

bool longBreak = useCloseBreak ? close > orbHigh : high > orbHigh
bool shortBreak = useCloseBreak ? close < orbLow : low < orbLow

// === ENTRIES + EXITS (zusammen, kein doppelter Block) ===
if canTrade and allowLong and longBreak
    strategy.entry("ORB Long", strategy.long, qty = fixedContracts, alert_message = longAlertMsg)
    strategy.exit("L Exit", "ORB Long", profit = takeProfitTicks, loss = stopLossTicks, trail_points = trailActivationTicks, trail_offset = trailStopTicks, alert_message = exitAlertMsg)
    tradedToday := true

else if canTrade and allowShort and shortBreak
    strategy.entry("ORB Short", strategy.short, qty = fixedContracts, alert_message = shortAlertMsg)
    strategy.exit("S Exit", "ORB Short", profit = takeProfitTicks, loss = stopLossTicks, trail_points = trailActivationTicks, trail_offset = trailStopTicks, alert_message = exitAlertMsg)
    tradedToday := true

// === EOD CLOSE ===
if closeEod and not inTradeSession and inTradeSession[1]
    strategy.close_all("NY Session Close")

// === PLOTS ===
plot(orbHigh, "ORB High", color = color.new(color.lime, 0), linewidth = 2, style = plot.style_linebr)
plot(orbLow, "ORB Low", color = color.new(color.red, 0), linewidth = 2, style = plot.style_linebr)

bgcolor(inOrb ? color.new(color.yellow, 85) : na)

plotshape(canTrade and allowLong and longBreak, title = "Long", style = shape.triangleup, location = location.belowbar, color = color.lime, size = size.tiny)
plotshape(canTrade and allowShort and shortBreak, title = "Short", style = shape.triangledown, location = location.abovebar, color = color.red, size = size.tiny)

items.name: MNQ ORB Strategy - VWAP + Bias
items.title: MNQ ORB Strategy - VWAP + Bias
items.author: dbmeyers
items.source:
//@version=5
strategy("MNQ ORB Strategy - VWAP + Bias", overlay=true,
         default_qty_type=strategy.fixed,
         default_qty_value=2,
         pyramiding=0,
         calc_on_order_fills=true,
         process_orders_on_close=false)

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// INPUTS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
orbMinutes      = input.int(10,    "ORB Window (minutes)",           minval=1,  step=5,   group="ORB Settings")
bufferTicks     = input.int(4,     "Buffer Above/Below ORB (ticks)", minval=0,  step=1,   group="ORB Settings")
numContracts    = input.int(2,     "Number of Contracts",            minval=1,  step=1,   group="Position Sizing")
tpTicks         = input.int(120,   "Take Profit (ticks)",            minval=4,  step=4,   group="Risk Management")
slTicks         = input.int(60,    "Stop Loss (ticks)",              minval=4,  step=4,   group="Risk Management")
useTrailingStop = input.bool(false,"Use Trailing Stop",              group="Risk Management")
trailTicks      = input.float(60,  "Trailing Stop (ticks)",          minval=4,  step=4,   group="Risk Management")
useATRFilter    = input.bool(true,  "Use ATR Range Filter",          group="Filters")
atrMultiplier   = input.float(1.5,  "Max ORB Range (x Daily ATR)",   minval=0.5, step=0.1, group="Filters")
useVWAPFilter   = input.bool(true,  "Use VWAP Filter",               group="Filters")
useVWAPExit     = input.bool(true,  "Exit on VWAP Cross",            group="Filters")
biasMode        = input.string("Both", "Trade Direction",
                  options=["Both", "Long Only", "Short Only"],       group="Bias Settings")
entryEnd        = input.int(11,    "Entry Window End (hour ET)",     minval=10, step=1,   group="Session Settings")
showLevels      = input.bool(true,  "Show ORB Levels",               group="Display")
showVWAP        = input.bool(true,  "Show VWAP",                     group="Display")
showInfo        = input.bool(true,  "Show Info Panel",               group="Display")

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// TICK MATH
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
tickSize     = syminfo.mintick
pointValue   = syminfo.pointvalue
tickValue    = tickSize * pointValue

tpPoints     = tpTicks    * tickSize
slPoints     = slTicks    * tickSize
trailPoints  = trailTicks * tickSize
bufferPoints = bufferTicks * tickSize

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// VWAP
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
vwap = ta.vwap(hlc3)
plot(showVWAP ? vwap : na, "VWAP", color=color.new(color.purple, 0), linewidth=2)

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ATR FILTER
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
dailyATR = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "D", ta.atr(14), lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_off)

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SESSION & ORB WINDOW LOGIC
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
nyHour   = hour(time,   "America/New_York")
nyMinute = minute(time, "America/New_York")
nyMins   = nyHour * 60 + nyMinute

marketOpen    = 9 * 60 + 30
orbEnd        = marketOpen + orbMinutes
entryClose    = entryEnd * 60

isNewDay      = ta.change(time("D")) != 0
isInORB       = nyMins >= marketOpen and nyMins < orbEnd
isPostORB     = nyMins >= orbEnd
isEntryWindow = nyMins >= orbEnd and nyMins <= entryClose

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// STATE VARIABLES
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
var float orbHigh              = na
var float orbLow               = na
var bool  orbSet               = false
var bool  signalFiredToday     = false
var bool  atrPassedToday       = false
var float trailActivationPrice = na
var bool  trailActivated       = false
var bool  orbBrokenLong        = false
var bool  orbBrokenShort       = false
var bool  longEntryMissed      = false
var bool  shortEntryMissed     = false

if isNewDay
    orbHigh              := na
    orbLow               := na
    orbSet               := false
    signalFiredToday     := false
    atrPassedToday       := false
    trailActivationPrice := na
    trailActivated       := false
    orbBrokenLong        := false
    orbBrokenShort       := false
    longEntryMissed      := false
    shortEntryMissed     := false

// ── Track ORB high/low ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if isInORB
    orbHigh := na(orbHigh) ? high : math.max(orbHigh, high)
    orbLow  := na(orbLow)  ? low  : math.min(orbLow,  low)

if isPostORB and not orbSet and not na(orbHigh)
    orbSet         := true
    orbRange       = orbHigh - orbLow
    atrPassedToday := not useATRFilter or (orbRange <= atrMultiplier * dailyATR)

buyLevel  = na(orbHigh) ? na : orbHigh + bufferPoints
sellLevel = na(orbLow)  ? na : orbLow  - bufferPoints

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// TRACK BREAKOUTS AND MISSED ENTRIES
// Key fix: if ORB breaks but VWAP blocks the entry, mark it as missed
// No further entry allowed in that direction for the rest of the day
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
longBreakBar  = orbSet and isPostORB and not na(buyLevel)  and high > buyLevel  and not orbBrokenLong
shortBreakBar = orbSet and isPostORB and not na(sellLevel) and low  < sellLevel and not orbBrokenShort

if longBreakBar
    orbBrokenLong := true
    if useVWAPFilter and close < vwap
        longEntryMissed := true

if shortBreakBar
    orbBrokenShort := true
    if useVWAPFilter and close > vwap
        shortEntryMissed := true

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// VWAP FILTER
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
aboveVWAP = close > vwap
belowVWAP = close < vwap

vwapLongOK  = not useVWAPFilter or aboveVWAP
vwapShortOK = not useVWAPFilter or belowVWAP

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ENTRY SIGNALS
// Entry only allowed on the exact breakout bar
// If VWAP blocked the breakout bar, entry is missed for the day
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
longSignal  = longBreakBar and not signalFiredToday
              and not orbBrokenShort and atrPassedToday
              and isEntryWindow and vwapLongOK
              and not longEntryMissed
              and (biasMode == "Both" or biasMode == "Long Only")

shortSignal = shortBreakBar and not signalFiredToday
              and not orbBrokenLong and atrPassedToday
              and isEntryWindow and vwapShortOK
              and not shortEntryMissed
              and (biasMode == "Both" or biasMode == "Short Only")

if longSignal
    strategy.entry("ORB Long", strategy.long, qty=numContracts, stop=buyLevel)
    signalFiredToday := true

if shortSignal
    strategy.entry("ORB Short", strategy.short, qty=numContracts, stop=sellLevel)
    signalFiredToday := true

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// EXITS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
if strategy.position_size > 0
    if useVWAPExit and ta.crossunder(close, vwap)
        strategy.close("ORB Long", comment="VWAP Cross Exit")

    if useTrailingStop
        if barstate.isconfirmed
            if na(trailActivationPrice)
                trailActivationPrice := strategy.position_avg_price + trailPoints
            if high >= trailActivationPrice
                trailActivated := true

        strategy.exit("TP", from_entry="ORB Long",
                      limit = strategy.position_avg_price + tpPoints)

        if trailActivated
            strategy.exit("Trail", from_entry="ORB Long",
                          trail_price  = trailActivationPrice,
                          trail_offset = math.round(trailPoints / tickSize),
                          stop         = strategy.position_avg_price - slPoints)
        else
            strategy.exit("Trail", from_entry="ORB Long",
                          stop = strategy.position_avg_price - slPoints)
    else
        strategy.exit("TP/SL", from_entry="ORB Long",
                      limit = strategy.position_avg_price + tpPoints,
                      stop  = strategy.position_avg_price - slPoints)

if strategy.position_size < 0
    if useVWAPExit and ta.crossover(close, vwap)
        strategy.close("ORB Short", comment="VWAP Cross Exit")

    if useTrailingStop
        if barstate.isconfirmed
            if na(trailActivationPrice)
                trailActivationPrice := strategy.position_avg_price - trailPoints
            if low <= trailActivationPrice
                trailActivated := true

        strategy.exit("TP", from_entry="ORB Short",
                      limit = strategy.position_avg_price - tpPoints)

        if trailActivated
            strategy.exit("Trail", from_entry="ORB Short",
                          trail_price  = trailActivationPrice,
                          trail_offset = math.round(trailPoints / tickSize),
                          stop         = strategy.position_avg_price + slPoints)
        else
            strategy.exit("Trail", from_entry="ORB Short",
                          stop = strategy.position_avg_price + slPoints)
    else
        strategy.exit("TP/SL", from_entry="ORB Short",
                      limit = strategy.position_avg_price - tpPoints,
                      stop  = strategy.position_avg_price + slPoints)

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// VISUALS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
plot(showLevels ? orbHigh   : na, "ORB High",   color=color.blue,   linewidth=1)
plot(showLevels ? orbLow    : na, "ORB Low",    color=color.red,    linewidth=1)
plot(showLevels ? buyLevel  : na, "Buy Level",  color=color.lime,   linewidth=2)
plot(showLevels ? sellLevel : na, "Sell Level", color=color.orange, linewidth=2)

plotshape(longSignal,  title="Long Signal",  style=shape.triangleup,
          location=location.belowbar, color=color.green, size=size.large, text="ORB L")
plotshape(shortSignal, title="Short Signal", style=shape.triangledown,
          location=location.abovebar, color=color.red,   size=size.large, text="ORB S")

// Missed entry markers — shows where VWAP blocked a breakout
plotshape(longBreakBar  and longEntryMissed,  title="Long Missed",  style=shape.xcross,
          location=location.belowbar, color=color.yellow, size=size.small, text="missed")
plotshape(shortBreakBar and shortEntryMissed, title="Short Missed", style=shape.xcross,
          location=location.abovebar, color=color.yellow, size=size.small, text="missed")

vwapColor = close > vwap ? color.new(color.green, 80) : color.new(color.red, 80)
bgcolor(showVWAP ? vwapColor : na, title="VWAP Background")

// ── Info panel ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if showInfo and barstate.islast
    tpDollars = tpTicks * tickValue * numContracts
    slDollars = slTicks * tickValue * numContracts
    orbRange  = na(orbHigh) or na(orbLow) ? 0.0 : orbHigh - orbLow
    orbTicks  = math.round(orbRange / tickSize)
    vwapSide  = close > vwap ? "ABOVE" : "BELOW"

    info  = "MNQ ORB — VWAP + Bias\n"
    info += "Bias       : " + biasMode + "\n"
    info += "Contracts  : " + str.tostring(numContracts) + "\n"
    info += "TP         : " + str.tostring(tpTicks) + " ticks ($" + str.tostring(tpDollars, "#") + ")\n"
    info += "SL         : " + str.tostring(slTicks) + " ticks ($" + str.tostring(slDollars, "#") + ")\n"
    info += "ORB Range  : " + str.tostring(orbTicks) + " ticks\n"
    info += "ATR Filter : " + (atrPassedToday ? "PASS" : "FAIL") + "\n"
    info += "VWAP       : Price " + vwapSide + "\n"
    info += "Long missed: " + (longEntryMissed  ? "YES — no re-entry" : "NO") + "\n"
    info += "Short missed: " + (shortEntryMissed ? "YES — no re-entry" : "NO") + "\n"
    info += "Entry OK   : " + (isEntryWindow ? "YES" : "NO")

    var label infoLabel = na
    label.delete(infoLabel)
    infoLabel := label.new(bar_index, high,
                  text=info,
                  style=label.style_label_left,
                  color=color.new(color.navy, 20),
                  textcolor=color.white,
                  size=size.normal)

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// TRADERSPOST ALERT
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
if longSignal
    jsonMsg = '{"ticker":"MNQ1!",'   +
              '"action":"buy",'       +
              '"orderType":"market",' +
              '"quantity":'           + str.tostring(numContracts) + '}'
    alert(jsonMsg, alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)

if shortSignal
    jsonMsg = '{"ticker":"MNQ1!",'   +
              '"action":"sell",'      +
              '"orderType":"market",' +
              '"quantity":'           + str.tostring(numContracts) + '}'
    alert(jsonMsg, alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)

if strategy.position_size[1] > 0 and strategy.position_size == 0
    alert('{"ticker":"MNQ1!","action":"exit"}', alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)

if strategy.position_size[1] < 0 and strategy.position_size == 0
    alert('{"ticker":"MNQ1!","action":"exit"}', alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)

items.name: ORB Retest Strategy (15m ORB + 5m Entry)
items.title: ORB Retest Strategy (15m ORB + 5m Entry)
items.author: Gioharper
items.source:
//@version=5
indicator("ORB Retest Strategy (15m ORB + 5m Entry)", overlay=true, max_boxes_count=50, max_lines_count=100, max_labels_count=100)

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  OPENING RANGE BREAKOUT — RETEST ENTRY STRATEGY
//  • Timeframe: 15-min to define ORB, 5-min for entry
//  • 8:30 AM Houston (CT) = 9:30 AM ET — first candle
//  • Mark the high/low of that candle, wait for breakout
//  • Enter on retest of the broken ORB level (5-min)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ── Inputs ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
// NOTE: Times are in ET. 8:30 AM Houston CT = 09:30 ET
//                         8:45 AM Houston CT = 09:45 ET
string orbStartTime   = input.string("09:30", "ORB Start (ET) — 8:30 AM Houston", tooltip="9:30 ET = 8:30 AM Houston/Central Time")
string orbEndTime     = input.string("09:45", "ORB End (ET) — 8:45 AM Houston", tooltip="9:45 ET = 8:45 AM Houston/Central Time")
string sessEndTime    = input.string("16:00", "Session End (ET)", tooltip="Stop trading after this time")
float  rrRatio        = input.float(2, "Risk:Reward Ratio", minval=1.0, step=0.5)
bool   showOrbBox     = input.bool(true, "Show ORB Box")
bool   showEntryArrow = input.bool(true, "Show Entry Arrows")
bool   showTpSl       = input.bool(true, "Show TP/SL Lines")
float  retestBuffer   = input.float(0.10, "Retest Buffer (%)", minval=0.0, step=0.05, tooltip="How close price must come to ORB level to count as retest") / 100

// ── Time Logic ──────────────────────────────────────────────
inORB(startStr, endStr) =>
    start = timestamp("America/New_York", year, month, dayofmonth, int(str.tonumber(str.substring(startStr, 0, 2))), int(str.tonumber(str.substring(startStr, 3, 5))), 0)
    end   = timestamp("America/New_York", year, month, dayofmonth, int(str.tonumber(str.substring(endStr, 0, 2))), int(str.tonumber(str.substring(endStr, 3, 5))), 0)
    time >= start and time < end

isORBWindow    = inORB(orbStartTime, orbEndTime)
isSessionActive = inORB(orbStartTime, sessEndTime)

// ── Track ORB High & Low ────────────────────────────────────
var float orbHigh   = na
var float orbLow    = na
var bool  orbLocked = false
var int   orbDay    = na

newDay = dayofmonth != dayofmonth[1]

if newDay
    orbHigh   := na
    orbLow    := na
    orbLocked := false
    orbDay    := dayofmonth

if isORBWindow and not orbLocked
    orbHigh := na(orbHigh) ? high : math.max(orbHigh, high)
    orbLow  := na(orbLow)  ? low  : math.min(orbLow, low)

if not isORBWindow and not na(orbHigh) and not orbLocked
    orbLocked := true

// ── Draw ORB Box ────────────────────────────────────────────
var box  orbBox   = na
var line orbHighLine = na
var line orbLowLine  = na

if orbLocked and showOrbBox
    if na(orbBox) or newDay
        orbBox := box.new(bar_index - 1, orbHigh, bar_index, orbLow, border_color=color.new(color.white, 70), bgcolor=color.new(color.white, 92))
    else
        box.set_right(orbBox, bar_index)

// ── Extend ORB levels across session ────────────────────────
if orbLocked
    if na(orbHighLine) or newDay
        orbHighLine := line.new(bar_index, orbHigh, bar_index, orbHigh, color=color.new(#22c55e, 30), style=line.style_dashed, width=1)
        orbLowLine  := line.new(bar_index, orbLow, bar_index, orbLow, color=color.new(#ef4444, 30), style=line.style_dashed, width=1)
    else
        line.set_x2(orbHighLine, bar_index)
        line.set_x2(orbLowLine, bar_index)

// ── Breakout Detection (use on 15-min context) ─────────────
var int breakoutDir = 0  // 0 = none, 1 = bullish, -1 = bearish

if orbLocked and isSessionActive
    if breakoutDir == 0
        if close > orbHigh
            breakoutDir := 1
        else if close < orbLow
            breakoutDir := -1

if newDay
    breakoutDir := 0

// ── Retest Detection (use on 5-min for precise entry) ──────
var bool  retestTriggered = false
var float entryPrice      = na
var float slPrice         = na
var float tpPrice         = na

if newDay
    retestTriggered := false
    entryPrice      := na
    slPrice         := na
    tpPrice         := na

bufferAmt = syminfo.mintick > 0 ? close * retestBuffer : 0.0

// Bullish retest: price pulls back to ORB high from above
bullishRetest = breakoutDir == 1 and not retestTriggered and isSessionActive and low <= (orbHigh + bufferAmt) and close > orbHigh

// Bearish retest: price pulls back to ORB low from below
bearishRetest = breakoutDir == -1 and not retestTriggered and isSessionActive and high >= (orbLow - bufferAmt) and close < orbLow

orbRange = orbHigh - orbLow

if bullishRetest
    retestTriggered := true
    entryPrice      := close
    slPrice         := orbLow
    tpPrice         := close + (orbRange * rrRatio)

if bearishRetest
    retestTriggered := true
    entryPrice      := close
    slPrice         := orbHigh
    tpPrice         := close - (orbRange * rrRatio)

// ── Visuals: Entry Arrows ───────────────────────────────────
if showEntryArrow and bullishRetest
    label.new(bar_index, low, "▲ LONG", color=color.new(#22c55e, 10), textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_up, size=size.small)

if showEntryArrow and bearishRetest
    label.new(bar_index, high, "▼ SHORT", color=color.new(#ef4444, 10), textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_down, size=size.small)

// ── Visuals: TP & SL Lines ─────────────────────────────────
if showTpSl and retestTriggered and (bullishRetest or bearishRetest)
    line.new(bar_index, tpPrice, bar_index + 20, tpPrice, color=color.new(#22c55e, 20), style=line.style_dotted, width=2)
    line.new(bar_index, slPrice, bar_index + 20, slPrice, color=color.new(#ef4444, 20), style=line.style_dotted, width=2)
    line.new(bar_index, entryPrice, bar_index + 20, entryPrice, color=color.new(color.white, 40), style=line.style_solid, width=1)

// ── Background Coloring ─────────────────────────────────────
bgcolor(isORBWindow ? color.new(color.orange, 93) : na, title="ORB Window")
bgcolor(breakoutDir == 1 and isSessionActive ? color.new(#22c55e, 96) : na, title="Bullish Bias")
bgcolor(breakoutDir == -1 and isSessionActive ? color.new(#ef4444, 96) : na, title="Bearish Bias")

// ── Plot ORB Levels ─────────────────────────────────────────
plot(orbLocked ? orbHigh : na, "ORB High", color=color.new(#22c55e, 40), linewidth=2, style=plot.style_stepline)
plot(orbLocked ? orbLow : na, "ORB Low", color=color.new(#ef4444, 40), linewidth=2, style=plot.style_stepline)

// ── Alerts ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
alertcondition(breakoutDir == 1 and breakoutDir[1] == 0, "Bullish Breakout", "Price broke above ORB High!")
alertcondition(breakoutDir == -1 and breakoutDir[1] == 0, "Bearish Breakout", "Price broke below ORB Low!")
alertcondition(bullishRetest, "Bullish Retest Entry", "Price retested ORB High — Long Entry!")
alertcondition(bearishRetest, "Bearish Retest Entry", "Price retested ORB Low — Short Entry!")

// ── Info Table ──────────────────────────────────────────────
var table infoTable = table.new(position.top_right, 2, 5, border_width=1)

if barstate.islast and orbLocked
    table.cell(infoTable, 0, 0, "ORB HIGH", text_color=color.gray, text_size=size.tiny, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 30))
    table.cell(infoTable, 1, 0, str.tostring(orbHigh, format.mintick), text_color=#22c55e, text_size=size.tiny, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 30))
    table.cell(infoTable, 0, 1, "ORB LOW", text_color=color.gray, text_size=size.tiny, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 30))
    table.cell(infoTable, 1, 1, str.tostring(orbLow, format.mintick), text_color=#ef4444, text_size=size.tiny, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 30))
    table.cell(infoTable, 0, 2, "RANGE", text_color=color.gray, text_size=size.tiny, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 30))
    table.cell(infoTable, 1, 2, str.tostring(orbRange, format.mintick), text_color=color.white, text_size=size.tiny, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 30))
    table.cell(infoTable, 0, 3, "BIAS", text_color=color.gray, text_size=size.tiny, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 30))
    table.cell(infoTable, 1, 3, breakoutDir == 1 ? "BULLISH ▲" : breakoutDir == -1 ? "BEARISH ▼" : "NEUTRAL —", text_color=breakoutDir == 1 ? #22c55e : breakoutDir == -1 ? #ef4444 : color.gray, text_size=size.tiny, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 30))
    table.cell(infoTable, 0, 4, "R:R", text_color=color.gray, text_size=size.tiny, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 30))
    table.cell(infoTable, 1, 4, "1 : " + str.tostring(rrRatio, "#.#"), text_color=color.white, text_size=size.tiny, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 30))

items.name: ORB Trailing Strategy
items.title: ORB Trailing Strategy
items.author: IvoS82
items.source:
// This Pine Script(TM) code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
// ORB Trailing Strategy - Open Range Breakout with Trailing Stop (v2 Rewrite)

//@version=6
strategy("ORB Trailing Strategy", overlay=true,
     process_orders_on_close=true, calc_on_every_tick=false,
     initial_capital=25000, default_qty_type=strategy.fixed,
     default_qty_value=1, commission_type=strategy.commission.cash_per_contract,
     commission_value=3.10, currency=currency.USD,
     margin_long=4, margin_short=4)

// ============================================================================
// INPUTS
// ============================================================================
i_sessionMode     = input.string("Both", "Session Mode", options=["London", "New York", "Both"])
i_asiaFilter      = input.bool(false, "Asia Range Filter")
i_minBreakout     = input.float(2.0, "Min Breakout Points Beyond Range", minval=0.0, step=0.5)
i_riskPct         = input.float(0.5, "Risk % of Account", minval=0.1, step=0.1)
i_dollarPerPoint  = input.float(20.0, "Dollar Per Point", minval=0.1, step=0.5)
i_emaFilter       = input.bool(false, "EMA Filter (200 EMA 15-min)")
i_emaPeriod       = input.int(200, "EMA Period (15-min)")
i_showRangeBoxes  = input.bool(true, "Show ORB Range Boxes")
i_showAsiaRange   = input.bool(true, "Show Asia Range")
i_showRLevels     = input.bool(false, "Show R-Level Lines")
i_showEMA         = input.bool(false, "Show 15-min EMA")
i_beOffset        = input.float(4.0, "BE Offset Points", minval=0.0, step=0.5)
i_londonClose     = input.bool(true, "Close London Trades at 6:00 AM")
i_nyClose         = input.bool(true, "Close NY Trades at 3:00 PM")

// ============================================================================
// TIME CONDITIONS (EST/New York timezone)
// ============================================================================
tz = "America/New_York"
barMins = hour(time, tz) * 60 + minute(time, tz)

// London ORB: 3:00-3:15, Entry: 3:15-6:00, Close: 6:00
londonORBActive = barMins >= 180 and barMins < 195
londonEntryTime = barMins >= 195 and barMins < 360
londonCloseTime = barMins >= 360 and barMins < 365

// New York ORB: 9:30-9:45, Entry: 9:45-15:00, Close: 15:00
nyORBActive     = barMins >= 570 and barMins < 585
nyEntryTime     = barMins >= 585 and barMins < 900
nyCloseTime     = barMins >= 900 and barMins < 905

// First bar of each ORB window
londonORBStart  = londonORBActive and not londonORBActive[1]
nyORBStart      = nyORBActive and not nyORBActive[1]

// Asia Range: 18:00-00:00 EST
asiaRangeTime   = barMins >= 1080

// ============================================================================
// ASIA RANGE TRACKING
// ============================================================================
var float asiaHigh      = na
var float asiaLow       = na
var bool  asiaComplete  = false
var bool  asiaBroken    = false
var box   asiaBox       = na

// Reset Asia range at 18:00 EST
if asiaRangeTime and not asiaRangeTime[1]
    asiaHigh     := high
    asiaLow      := low
    asiaComplete := false
    asiaBroken   := false

// Build Asia range 18:00-00:00
if asiaRangeTime
    asiaHigh := math.max(nz(asiaHigh, high), high)
    asiaLow  := math.min(nz(asiaLow, low), low)

// Mark Asia range complete at midnight
if barMins < 180 and barMins >= 0 and not asiaComplete and not na(asiaHigh)
    asiaComplete := true
    if i_showAsiaRange and i_asiaFilter
        asiaBox := box.new(bar_index - 1, asiaHigh, bar_index, asiaLow,
             border_color=color.new(color.purple, 50), bgcolor=color.new(color.purple, 90))

// Check if Asia range is broken before London ORB forms
if asiaComplete and not asiaBroken and barMins < 180
    if high > asiaHigh or low < asiaLow
        asiaBroken := true

// Extend Asia box
if not na(asiaBox) and barMins < 195
    box.set_right(asiaBox, bar_index)

// ============================================================================
// OPENING RANGE DETECTION
// ============================================================================
var float londonRangeHigh = na
var float londonRangeLow  = na
var bool  londonRangeSet  = false
var int   londonBarCount  = 0
var box   londonBox       = na
var int   londonBoxStart  = na

var float nyRangeHigh     = na
var float nyRangeLow      = na
var bool  nyRangeSet      = false
var int   nyBarCount      = 0
var box   nyBox           = na
var int   nyBoxStart      = na

// London ORB
if londonORBStart
    londonRangeHigh := high
    londonRangeLow  := low
    londonRangeSet  := false
    londonBarCount  := 1
    londonBoxStart  := bar_index
else if londonORBActive and not londonRangeSet
    londonRangeHigh := math.max(londonRangeHigh, high)
    londonRangeLow  := math.min(londonRangeLow, low)
    londonBarCount  += 1

if londonBarCount >= 3 and not londonRangeSet
    londonRangeSet := true
    if i_showRangeBoxes and (i_sessionMode == "London" or i_sessionMode == "Both")
        londonBox := box.new(londonBoxStart, londonRangeHigh, bar_index, londonRangeLow,
             border_color=color.new(color.blue, 30), bgcolor=color.new(color.blue, 90),
             border_width=2)

// NY ORB
if nyORBStart
    nyRangeHigh := high
    nyRangeLow  := low
    nyRangeSet  := false
    nyBarCount  := 1
    nyBoxStart  := bar_index
else if nyORBActive and not nyRangeSet
    nyRangeHigh := math.max(nyRangeHigh, high)
    nyRangeLow  := math.min(nyRangeLow, low)
    nyBarCount  += 1

if nyBarCount >= 3 and not nyRangeSet
    nyRangeSet := true
    if i_showRangeBoxes and (i_sessionMode == "New York" or i_sessionMode == "Both")
        nyBox := box.new(nyBoxStart, nyRangeHigh, bar_index, nyRangeLow,
             border_color=color.new(color.orange, 30), bgcolor=color.new(color.orange, 90),
             border_width=2)

// Extend range boxes through session
if not na(londonBox) and londonEntryTime
    box.set_right(londonBox, bar_index)
if not na(nyBox) and nyEntryTime
    box.set_right(nyBox, bar_index)

// ============================================================================
// TRADE TRACKING PER SESSION PER DAY
// ============================================================================
var int   londonTradeCount  = 0
var bool  londonHadWinner   = false
var int   nyTradeCount      = 0
var bool  nyHadWinner       = false
var bool  londonReverted    = true
var bool  nyReverted        = true

// Reset trade counts at ORB start
if londonORBStart
    londonTradeCount := 0
    londonHadWinner  := false
    londonReverted   := true

if nyORBStart
    nyTradeCount := 0
    nyHadWinner  := false
    nyReverted   := true

// ============================================================================
// ACTIVE TRADE STATE
// ============================================================================
var float entryPrice      = na
var float stopPrice       = na
var float oneR            = na
var int   tradeDir        = 0     // 1 = long, -1 = short, 0 = flat
var int   currentRLevel   = 0
var string tradeSession   = ""    // "london" or "ny"

// ============================================================================
// HELPER: Can we trade this session?
// ============================================================================
canTradeLondon() =>
    (i_sessionMode == "London" or i_sessionMode == "Both") and
     londonRangeSet and
     londonTradeCount < 2 and
     not londonHadWinner and
     londonReverted and
     (not i_asiaFilter or asiaBroken)

canTradeNY() =>
    (i_sessionMode == "New York" or i_sessionMode == "Both") and
     nyRangeSet and
     nyTradeCount < 2 and
     not nyHadWinner and
     nyReverted and
     (not i_asiaFilter or asiaBroken)

// ============================================================================
// SESSION CLOSE LOGIC - Force close positions (single-bar window)
// ============================================================================
if i_londonClose and tradeSession == "london" and londonCloseTime and tradeDir != 0
    strategy.close_all(comment="London Close")
    tradeDir     := 0
    tradeSession := ""

if i_nyClose and tradeSession == "ny" and nyCloseTime and tradeDir != 0
    strategy.close_all(comment="NY Close")
    tradeDir     := 0
    tradeSession := ""

// ============================================================================
// DETECT CLOSED TRADES (for win tracking)
// Must come AFTER session close so tradeSession is still set when stop-outs
// are detected mid-session
// ============================================================================
if strategy.position_size[1] != 0 and strategy.position_size == 0 and tradeDir != 0
    if currentRLevel >= 2
        if tradeSession == "london"
            londonHadWinner := true
        if tradeSession == "ny"
            nyHadWinner := true
    // Mark reversion needed for re-entry after stop-out
    if tradeSession == "london"
        londonReverted := false
    if tradeSession == "ny"
        nyReverted := false
    tradeDir     := 0
    tradeSession := ""

// ============================================================================
// ENTRY LOGIC
// ============================================================================
// Sync tradeDir with actual position (handles unfilled entries)
if tradeDir != 0 and strategy.position_size == 0 and strategy.position_size[1] == 0
    tradeDir     := 0
    tradeSession := ""

// Reversion check: price must return inside range before re-entry
if londonEntryTime and not londonReverted and londonRangeSet
    if close < londonRangeHigh and close > londonRangeLow
        londonReverted := true

if nyEntryTime and not nyReverted and nyRangeSet
    if close < nyRangeHigh and close > nyRangeLow
        nyReverted := true

isFlatNow = strategy.position_size == 0 and tradeDir == 0

// 200 EMA on 15-min (for trend filter)
ema15 = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "15", ta.ema(close, i_emaPeriod))
emaLongOk  = not i_emaFilter or close > ema15
emaShortOk = not i_emaFilter or close < ema15

// London entries
if londonEntryTime and isFlatNow and canTradeLondon()
    // Long breakout
    if close >= londonRangeHigh + i_minBreakout and emaLongOk
        entryPrice := close
        stopPrice  := low
        oneR       := close - low
        if oneR > 0
            tradeDir      := 1
            tradeSession  := "london"
            currentRLevel := 0
            londonTradeCount += 1
            riskAmt  = strategy.equity * i_riskPct / 100
            qty      = math.max(1, math.floor(riskAmt / (oneR * i_dollarPerPoint)))
            strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long, qty=qty, comment="L-ORB Long")
            strategy.exit("SL", "Long", stop=low)

    // Short breakout
    else if close <= londonRangeLow - i_minBreakout and emaShortOk
        entryPrice := close
        stopPrice  := high
        oneR       := high - close
        if oneR > 0
            tradeDir      := -1
            tradeSession  := "london"
            currentRLevel := 0
            londonTradeCount += 1
            riskAmt  = strategy.equity * i_riskPct / 100
            qty      = math.max(1, math.floor(riskAmt / (oneR * i_dollarPerPoint)))
            strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short, qty=qty, comment="L-ORB Short")
            strategy.exit("SL", "Short", stop=high)

// New York entries
if nyEntryTime and isFlatNow and canTradeNY()
    // Long breakout
    if close >= nyRangeHigh + i_minBreakout and emaLongOk
        entryPrice := close
        stopPrice  := low
        oneR       := close - low
        if oneR > 0
            tradeDir      := 1
            tradeSession  := "ny"
            currentRLevel := 0
            nyTradeCount += 1
            riskAmt  = strategy.equity * i_riskPct / 100
            qty      = math.max(1, math.floor(riskAmt / (oneR * i_dollarPerPoint)))
            strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long, qty=qty, comment="NY-ORB Long")
            strategy.exit("SL", "Long", stop=low)

    // Short breakout
    else if close <= nyRangeLow - i_minBreakout and emaShortOk
        entryPrice := close
        stopPrice  := high
        oneR       := high - close
        if oneR > 0
            tradeDir      := -1
            tradeSession  := "ny"
            currentRLevel := 0
            nyTradeCount += 1
            riskAmt  = strategy.equity * i_riskPct / 100
            qty      = math.max(1, math.floor(riskAmt / (oneR * i_dollarPerPoint)))
            strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short, qty=qty, comment="NY-ORB Short")
            strategy.exit("SL", "Short", stop=high)

// ============================================================================
// TRAILING STOP LOGIC (only when position exists)
// ============================================================================
if strategy.position_size != 0 and tradeDir != 0 and not na(oneR) and oneR > 0
    // Calculate how many R price has reached
    float maxRReached = 0.0

    if tradeDir == 1
        maxRReached := (high - entryPrice) / oneR
    else
        maxRReached := (entryPrice - low) / oneR

    // Update R level (integer floor)
    int newRLevel = math.max(currentRLevel, int(math.floor(maxRReached)))

    if newRLevel > currentRLevel
        currentRLevel := newRLevel

    // Calculate trailing stop based on R level
    if currentRLevel >= 1
        float newStop = na
        if tradeDir == 1
            newStop := currentRLevel == 1 ? entryPrice + i_beOffset : entryPrice + (currentRLevel - 1) * oneR
        else
            newStop := currentRLevel == 1 ? entryPrice - i_beOffset : entryPrice - (currentRLevel - 1) * oneR
        stopPrice := newStop

    // Update the exit with current stop
    if tradeDir == 1
        strategy.exit("SL", "Long", stop=stopPrice, comment="Stop " + str.tostring(currentRLevel) + "R")
    else
        strategy.exit("SL", "Short", stop=stopPrice, comment="Stop " + str.tostring(currentRLevel) + "R")

// ============================================================================
// EMA
// ============================================================================
plot(i_showEMA ? ema15 : na, "15-min EMA", color=color.new(color.yellow, 30), linewidth=2)

// ============================================================================
// R-LEVEL LINES (visual, off by default)
// ============================================================================
var line[] rLines = array.new<line>()

if tradeDir != 0 and tradeDir[1] == 0 and i_showRLevels and not na(oneR) and oneR > 0
    // Clear previous lines safely
    for i = 0 to 9
        if array.size(rLines) > 0
            line.delete(array.pop(rLines))

    // Draw R levels 1-10
    for r = 1 to 10
        float rPrice = tradeDir == 1 ? entryPrice + r * oneR : entryPrice - r * oneR
        color rCol = r == 1 ? color.green : color.new(color.green, 30 + r * 5)
        l = line.new(bar_index, rPrice, bar_index + 50, rPrice,
             color=rCol, style=line.style_dotted, width=1)
        array.push(rLines, l)

// ============================================================================
// INFO TABLE
// ============================================================================
var table infoTable = table.new(position.top_right, 2, 8, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 80),
     border_color=color.gray, border_width=1)

if barstate.islastconfirmedhistory or barstate.isrealtime
    table.cell(infoTable, 0, 0, "ORB Strategy", text_color=color.white, text_size=size.normal)
    table.cell(infoTable, 1, 0, i_sessionMode, text_color=color.yellow, text_size=size.normal)

    table.cell(infoTable, 0, 1, "Asia Filter", text_color=color.white, text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(infoTable, 1, 1, i_asiaFilter ? (asiaBroken ? "ON (Broken)" : "ON (Not Broken)") : "OFF",
         text_color=i_asiaFilter ? (asiaBroken ? color.green : color.red) : color.gray, text_size=size.small)

    table.cell(infoTable, 0, 2, "London Range", text_color=color.white, text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(infoTable, 1, 2, londonRangeSet ? str.tostring(londonRangeHigh, "#.##") + " / " + str.tostring(londonRangeLow, "#.##") : "N/A",
         text_color=color.aqua, text_size=size.small)

    table.cell(infoTable, 0, 3, "NY Range", text_color=color.white, text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(infoTable, 1, 3, nyRangeSet ? str.tostring(nyRangeHigh, "#.##") + " / " + str.tostring(nyRangeLow, "#.##") : "N/A",
         text_color=color.orange, text_size=size.small)

    table.cell(infoTable, 0, 4, "London Trades", text_color=color.white, text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(infoTable, 1, 4, str.tostring(londonTradeCount) + "/2" + (londonHadWinner ? " (Winner)" : ""),
         text_color=color.aqua, text_size=size.small)

    table.cell(infoTable, 0, 5, "NY Trades", text_color=color.white, text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(infoTable, 1, 5, str.tostring(nyTradeCount) + "/2" + (nyHadWinner ? " (Winner)" : ""),
         text_color=color.orange, text_size=size.small)

    table.cell(infoTable, 0, 6, "Active Trade", text_color=color.white, text_size=size.small)
    tradeInfo = tradeDir == 1 ? "LONG" : tradeDir == -1 ? "SHORT" : "FLAT"
    tradeCol  = tradeDir == 1 ? color.green : tradeDir == -1 ? color.red : color.gray
    table.cell(infoTable, 1, 6, tradeInfo + (tradeDir != 0 ? " " + str.tostring(currentRLevel) + "R" : ""),
         text_color=tradeCol, text_size=size.small)

    table.cell(infoTable, 0, 7, "Stop", text_color=color.white, text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(infoTable, 1, 7, tradeDir != 0 ? str.tostring(stopPrice, "#.##") : "N/A",
         text_color=color.red, text_size=size.small)

// ============================================================================
// PLOT STOP LEVEL
// ============================================================================
plot(tradeDir != 0 ? stopPrice : na, "Trailing Stop", color=color.red, style=plot.style_steplinebr, linewidth=2)

// ============================================================================
// BACKGROUND COLORING FOR SESSIONS
// ============================================================================
bgcolor(londonORBActive and (i_sessionMode == "London" or i_sessionMode == "Both") ? color.new(color.blue, 92) : na)
bgcolor(londonEntryTime and (i_sessionMode == "London" or i_sessionMode == "Both") ? color.new(color.blue, 97) : na)
bgcolor(nyORBActive and (i_sessionMode == "New York" or i_sessionMode == "Both") ? color.new(color.orange, 92) : na)
bgcolor(nyEntryTime and (i_sessionMode == "New York" or i_sessionMode == "Both") ? color.new(color.orange, 97) : na)
