items.source:
//@version=6
indicator("Orange 30M ORB Indicator", overlay=true, max_boxes_count=500, max_lines_count=500, max_labels_count=500)

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// General Inputs
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
grpGeneral = "General"
showBoxes         = input.bool(true, "Show opening range boxes", group=grpGeneral)
showMidline       = input.bool(true, "Show midline", group=grpGeneral)
showLabels        = input.bool(true, "Show session labels", group=grpGeneral)
showRetestLabels  = input.bool(true, "Show retest labels", group=grpGeneral)
historicalSession = input.bool(true, "Keep historical session drawings", group=grpGeneral)
breakoutByClose   = input.bool(true, "Breakout uses candle close", group=grpGeneral)

nyTZ = "America/New_York"

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Retest Inputs
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
grpRetest = "Retest Settings"
retestChartTF      = input.string("15", "Retest chart timeframe", options=["1", "5", "15"], group=grpRetest)
restrictRetestTF   = input.bool(true, "Restrict retest to selected chart timeframe", group=grpRetest)
maxRetestBars      = input.int(20, "Maximum bars from breakout to retest", minval=1, group=grpRetest)
wickIntoRangeMax   = input.float(10.0, "Max wick penetration into range (points)", minval=0.0, step=0.25, group=grpRetest)
closeIntoRangeMax  = input.float(5.0, "Max close penetration into range (points)", minval=0.0, step=0.25, group=grpRetest)

retestMode         = input.string("Touch or Within Distance", "Retest Qualification Mode", options=["Touch Only", "Touch or Within Distance"], group=grpRetest)
retestDistance     = input.float(5.0, "Retest distance from breakout level (points)", minval=0.0, step=0.25, group=grpRetest)

retestCandleColor  = input.color(color.purple, "Retest Candle Color", group=grpRetest)
nextCandleColor    = input.color(color.orange, "Next Candle After Retest Color", group=grpRetest)

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Session Inputs
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
grp1 = "Session 1"
s1Enabled = input.bool(true, "Enable Session 1", group=grp1)
s1Name    = input.string("New York", "Session Label", group=grp1)
s1Session = input.session("0930-1600", "Session Time (NY Local)", group=grp1)
s1ORMin   = input.int(30, "Opening Range Minutes", minval=1, group=grp1)
s1Color   = input.color(color.blue, "Session Color", group=grp1)

grp2 = "Session 2"
s2Enabled = input.bool(false, "Enable Session 2", group=grp2)
s2Name    = input.string("London", "Session Label", group=grp2)
s2Session = input.session("0300-1100", "Session Time (NY Local)", group=grp2)
s2ORMin   = input.int(30, "Opening Range Minutes", minval=1, group=grp2)
s2Color   = input.color(color.orange, "Session Color", group=grp2)

grp3 = "Session 3"
s3Enabled = input.bool(false, "Enable Session 3", group=grp3)
s3Name    = input.string("Asia", "Session Label", group=grp3)
s3Session = input.session("2000-0300", "Session Time (NY Local)", group=grp3)
s3ORMin   = input.int(30, "Opening Range Minutes", minval=1, group=grp3)
s3Color   = input.color(color.purple, "Session Color", group=grp3)

bg1 = color.new(s1Color, 88)
bg2 = color.new(s2Color, 88)
bg3 = color.new(s3Color, 88)

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Helpers
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
selectedTFMinutes = str.tonumber(retestChartTF)
isAllowedRetestTF = timeframe.isintraday and timeframe.multiplier == selectedTFMinutes
allowRetestNow    = restrictRetestTF ? isAllowedRetestTF : true
useDistanceMode   = retestMode == "Touch or Within Distance"

extendBoxToCurrentSession(_box) =>
    if not na(_box)
        box.set_right(_box, time_close)

bullCloseOk(level) =>
    close >= level - closeIntoRangeMax

bearCloseOk(level) =>
    close <= level + closeIntoRangeMax

bullRetestZoneOk(level) =>
    useDistanceMode ?
         (low >= (level - wickIntoRangeMax) and low <= (level + retestDistance)) :
         (low >= (level - wickIntoRangeMax) and low <= level)

bearRetestZoneOk(level) =>
    useDistanceMode ?
         (high <= (level + wickIntoRangeMax) and high >= (level - retestDistance)) :
         (high <= (level + wickIntoRangeMax) and high >= level)

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Session detection
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
inS1 = s1Enabled and not na(time(timeframe.period, s1Session, nyTZ))
inS2 = s2Enabled and not na(time(timeframe.period, s2Session, nyTZ))
inS3 = s3Enabled and not na(time(timeframe.period, s3Session, nyTZ))

newS1 = inS1 and not inS1[1]
newS2 = inS2 and not inS2[1]
newS3 = inS3 and not inS3[1]

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Session 1 state
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
var float s1High = na
var float s1Low = na
var float s1Mid = na
var int   s1StartTime = na
var bool  s1Finalized = false
var bool  s1BullBroken = false
var bool  s1BearBroken = false
var int   s1BullBreakBar = na
var int   s1BearBreakBar = na
var box   s1Box = na
var line  s1MidLine = na
var label s1Label = na

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Session 2 state
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
var float s2High = na
var float s2Low = na
var float s2Mid = na
var int   s2StartTime = na
var bool  s2Finalized = false
var bool  s2BullBroken = false
var bool  s2BearBroken = false
var int   s2BullBreakBar = na
var int   s2BearBreakBar = na
var box   s2Box = na
var line  s2MidLine = na
var label s2Label = na

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Session 3 state
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
var float s3High = na
var float s3Low = na
var float s3Mid = na
var int   s3StartTime = na
var bool  s3Finalized = false
var bool  s3BullBroken = false
var bool  s3BearBroken = false
var int   s3BullBreakBar = na
var int   s3BearBreakBar = na
var box   s3Box = na
var line  s3MidLine = na
var label s3Label = na

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Cleanup helper
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
clearObjects(_box, _midLine, _label) =>
    if not historicalSession
        if not na(_box)
            box.delete(_box)
        if not na(_midLine)
            line.delete(_midLine)
        if not na(_label)
            label.delete(_label)

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SESSION 1
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if newS1
    clearObjects(s1Box, s1MidLine, s1Label)
    s1High := high
    s1Low := low
    s1Mid := (s1High + s1Low) / 2.0
    s1StartTime := time
    s1Finalized := false
    s1BullBroken := false
    s1BearBroken := false
    s1BullBreakBar := na
    s1BearBreakBar := na

    if showBoxes
        s1Box := box.new(left=time, top=high, right=time_close, bottom=low, xloc=xloc.bar_time, bgcolor=bg1, border_color=s1Color)
    if showMidline
        s1MidLine := line.new(x1=time, y1=s1Mid, x2=time_close, y2=s1Mid, xloc=xloc.bar_time, extend=extend.none, color=s1Color, style=line.style_dashed)
    if showLabels
        s1Label := label.new(x=time, y=high, text=s1Name, xloc=xloc.bar_time, style=label.style_label_down, textcolor=color.white, color=s1Color)

s1OREnd = na(s1StartTime) ? na : s1StartTime + s1ORMin * 60 * 1000

if inS1 and not na(s1StartTime)
    if not s1Finalized
        if time < s1OREnd
            s1High := math.max(s1High, high)
            s1Low := math.min(s1Low, low)
            s1Mid := (s1High + s1Low) / 2.0

            if showBoxes and not na(s1Box)
                box.set_top(s1Box, s1High)
                box.set_bottom(s1Box, s1Low)
                box.set_right(s1Box, time_close)

            if showMidline and not na(s1MidLine)
                line.set_y1(s1MidLine, s1Mid)
                line.set_y2(s1MidLine, s1Mid)
                line.set_x2(s1MidLine, time_close)

            if showLabels and not na(s1Label)
                label.set_x(s1Label, time)
                label.set_y(s1Label, s1High)
        else
            s1Finalized := true

    if s1Finalized
        if showBoxes
            extendBoxToCurrentSession(s1Box)
        if showMidline and not na(s1MidLine)
            line.set_x2(s1MidLine, time_close)

s1BreakUpSrc = breakoutByClose ? close > s1High : high > s1High
s1BreakDnSrc = breakoutByClose ? close < s1Low : low < s1Low

s1BullBreak = inS1 and s1Finalized and not s1BullBroken and s1BreakUpSrc
s1BearBreak = inS1 and s1Finalized and not s1BearBroken and s1BreakDnSrc

if s1BullBreak
    s1BullBroken := true
    s1BullBreakBar := bar_index

if s1BearBreak
    s1BearBroken := true
    s1BearBreakBar := bar_index

s1BullRetestZone = bullRetestZoneOk(s1High)
s1BullCloseValid = bullCloseOk(s1High)

s1BearRetestZone = bearRetestZoneOk(s1Low)
s1BearCloseValid = bearCloseOk(s1Low)

s1BullRetest = inS1 and allowRetestNow and s1BullBroken and not na(s1BullBreakBar) and bar_index > s1BullBreakBar and (bar_index - s1BullBreakBar <= maxRetestBars) and s1BullRetestZone and s1BullCloseValid
s1BearRetest = inS1 and allowRetestNow and s1BearBroken and not na(s1BearBreakBar) and bar_index > s1BearBreakBar and (bar_index - s1BearBreakBar <= maxRetestBars) and s1BearRetestZone and s1BearCloseValid

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SESSION 2
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if newS2
    clearObjects(s2Box, s2MidLine, s2Label)
    s2High := high
    s2Low := low
    s2Mid := (s2High + s2Low) / 2.0
    s2StartTime := time
    s2Finalized := false
    s2BullBroken := false
    s2BearBroken := false
    s2BullBreakBar := na
    s2BearBreakBar := na

    if showBoxes
        s2Box := box.new(left=time, top=high, right=time_close, bottom=low, xloc=xloc.bar_time, bgcolor=bg2, border_color=s2Color)
    if showMidline
        s2MidLine := line.new(x1=time, y1=s2Mid, x2=time_close, y2=s2Mid, xloc=xloc.bar_time, extend=extend.none, color=s2Color, style=line.style_dashed)
    if showLabels
        s2Label := label.new(x=time, y=high, text=s2Name, xloc=xloc.bar_time, style=label.style_label_down, textcolor=color.white, color=s2Color)

s2OREnd = na(s2StartTime) ? na : s2StartTime + s2ORMin * 60 * 1000

if inS2 and not na(s2StartTime)
    if not s2Finalized
        if time < s2OREnd
            s2High := math.max(s2High, high)
            s2Low := math.min(s2Low, low)
            s2Mid := (s2High + s2Low) / 2.0

            if showBoxes and not na(s2Box)
                box.set_top(s2Box, s2High)
                box.set_bottom(s2Box, s2Low)
                box.set_right(s2Box, time_close)

            if showMidline and not na(s2MidLine)
                line.set_y1(s2MidLine, s2Mid)
                line.set_y2(s2MidLine, s2Mid)
                line.set_x2(s2MidLine, time_close)

            if showLabels and not na(s2Label)
                label.set_x(s2Label, time)
                label.set_y(s2Label, s2High)
        else
            s2Finalized := true

    if s2Finalized
        if showBoxes
            extendBoxToCurrentSession(s2Box)
        if showMidline and not na(s2MidLine)
            line.set_x2(s2MidLine, time_close)

s2BreakUpSrc = breakoutByClose ? close > s2High : high > s2High
s2BreakDnSrc = breakoutByClose ? close < s2Low : low < s2Low

s2BullBreak = inS2 and s2Finalized and not s2BullBroken and s2BreakUpSrc
s2BearBreak = inS2 and s2Finalized and not s2BearBroken and s2BreakDnSrc

if s2BullBreak
    s2BullBroken := true
    s2BullBreakBar := bar_index

if s2BearBreak
    s2BearBroken := true
    s2BearBreakBar := bar_index

s2BullRetestZone = bullRetestZoneOk(s2High)
s2BullCloseValid = bullCloseOk(s2High)

s2BearRetestZone = bearRetestZoneOk(s2Low)
s2BearCloseValid = bearCloseOk(s2Low)

s2BullRetest = inS2 and allowRetestNow and s2BullBroken and not na(s2BullBreakBar) and bar_index > s2BullBreakBar and (bar_index - s2BullBreakBar <= maxRetestBars) and s2BullRetestZone and s2BullCloseValid
s2BearRetest = inS2 and allowRetestNow and s2BearBroken and not na(s2BearBreakBar) and bar_index > s2BearBreakBar and (bar_index - s2BearBreakBar <= maxRetestBars) and s2BearRetestZone and s2BearCloseValid

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SESSION 3
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if newS3
    clearObjects(s3Box, s3MidLine, s3Label)
    s3High := high
    s3Low := low
    s3Mid := (s3High + s3Low) / 2.0
    s3StartTime := time
    s3Finalized := false
    s3BullBroken := false
    s3BearBroken := false
    s3BullBreakBar := na
    s3BearBreakBar := na

    if showBoxes
        s3Box := box.new(left=time, top=high, right=time_close, bottom=low, xloc=xloc.bar_time, bgcolor=bg3, border_color=s3Color)
    if showMidline
        s3MidLine := line.new(x1=time, y1=s3Mid, x2=time_close, y2=s3Mid, xloc=xloc.bar_time, extend=extend.none, color=s3Color, style=line.style_dashed)
    if showLabels
        s3Label := label.new(x=time, y=high, text=s3Name, xloc=xloc.bar_time, style=label.style_label_down, textcolor=color.white, color=s3Color)

s3OREnd = na(s3StartTime) ? na : s3StartTime + s3ORMin * 60 * 1000

if inS3 and not na(s3StartTime)
    if not s3Finalized
        if time < s3OREnd
            s3High := math.max(s3High, high)
            s3Low := math.min(s3Low, low)
            s3Mid := (s3High + s3Low) / 2.0

            if showBoxes and not na(s3Box)
                box.set_top(s3Box, s3High)
                box.set_bottom(s3Box, s3Low)
                box.set_right(s3Box, time_close)

            if showMidline and not na(s3MidLine)
                line.set_y1(s3MidLine, s3Mid)
                line.set_y2(s3MidLine, s3Mid)
                line.set_x2(s3MidLine, time_close)

            if showLabels and not na(s3Label)
                label.set_x(s3Label, time)
                label.set_y(s3Label, s3High)
        else
            s3Finalized := true

    if s3Finalized
        if showBoxes
            extendBoxToCurrentSession(s3Box)
        if showMidline and not na(s3MidLine)
            line.set_x2(s3MidLine, time_close)

s3BreakUpSrc = breakoutByClose ? close > s3High : high > s3High
s3BreakDnSrc = breakoutByClose ? close < s3Low : low < s3Low

s3BullBreak = inS3 and s3Finalized and not s3BullBroken and s3BreakUpSrc
s3BearBreak = inS3 and s3Finalized and not s3BearBroken and s3BreakDnSrc

if s3BullBreak
    s3BullBroken := true
    s3BullBreakBar := bar_index

if s3BearBreak
    s3BearBroken := true
    s3BearBreakBar := bar_index

s3BullRetestZone = bullRetestZoneOk(s3High)
s3BullCloseValid = bullCloseOk(s3High)

s3BearRetestZone = bearRetestZoneOk(s3Low)
s3BearCloseValid = bearCloseOk(s3Low)

s3BullRetest = inS3 and allowRetestNow and s3BullBroken and not na(s3BullBreakBar) and bar_index > s3BullBreakBar and (bar_index - s3BullBreakBar <= maxRetestBars) and s3BullRetestZone and s3BullCloseValid
s3BearRetest = inS3 and allowRetestNow and s3BearBroken and not na(s3BearBreakBar) and bar_index > s3BearBreakBar and (bar_index - s3BearBreakBar <= maxRetestBars) and s3BearRetestZone and s3BearCloseValid

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Combined retest states
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
anyBullRetest = s1BullRetest or s2BullRetest or s3BullRetest
anyBearRetest = s1BearRetest or s2BearRetest or s3BearRetest
anyRetest     = anyBullRetest or anyBearRetest

paintNextBull = anyBullRetest[1]
paintNextBear = anyBearRetest[1]
paintNext     = paintNextBull or paintNextBear

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Visual markers
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plotshape(showRetestLabels and s1BullRetest, title="S1 Bull Retest", location=location.abovebar, style=shape.circle, size=size.tiny, color=s1Color, text="S1 RT")
plotshape(showRetestLabels and s1BearRetest, title="S1 Bear Retest", location=location.belowbar, style=shape.circle, size=size.tiny, color=s1Color, text="S1 RT")

plotshape(showRetestLabels and s2BullRetest, title="S2 Bull Retest", location=location.abovebar, style=shape.circle, size=size.tiny, color=s2Color, text="S2 RT")
plotshape(showRetestLabels and s2BearRetest, title="S2 Bear Retest", location=location.belowbar, style=shape.circle, size=size.tiny, color=s2Color, text="S2 RT")

plotshape(showRetestLabels and s3BullRetest, title="S3 Bull Retest", location=location.abovebar, style=shape.circle, size=size.tiny, color=s3Color, text="S3 RT")
plotshape(showRetestLabels and s3BearRetest, title="S3 Bear Retest", location=location.belowbar, style=shape.circle, size=size.tiny, color=s3Color, text="S3 RT")

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Candle coloring
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
candlePaint = anyRetest ? retestCandleColor : paintNext ? nextCandleColor : na

barcolor(candlePaint)
plotcandle(open, high, low, close, color=candlePaint, wickcolor=candlePaint, bordercolor=candlePaint)

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Alerts
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
alertcondition(s1BullRetest, title="Session 1 Bull Retest", message="Session 1 bullish retest")
alertcondition(s1BearRetest, title="Session 1 Bear Retest", message="Session 1 bearish retest")
alertcondition(s2BullRetest, title="Session 2 Bull Retest", message="Session 2 bullish retest")
alertcondition(s2BearRetest, title="Session 2 Bear Retest", message="Session 2 bearish retest")
alertcondition(s3BullRetest, title="Session 3 Bull Retest", message="Session 3 bullish retest")
alertcondition(s3BearRetest, title="Session 3 Bear Retest", message="Session 3 bearish retest")

alertcondition(paintNextBull, title="Bullish Next Candle After Retest", message="Immediate next candle after bullish retest")
alertcondition(paintNextBear, title="Bearish Next Candle After Retest", message="Immediate next candle after bearish retest")

items.source:
//@version=6
indicator("15-Min ORB Indicator (Hitz2kk)", overlay=true, max_boxes_count=500, max_labels_count=500)

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// INPUTS
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
groupGen = "General"
tz       = input.string("America/New_York", "Timezone", group=groupGen)
orbMins  = input.int(15, "Opening Range Minutes", minval=1, maxval=60, group=groupGen)

groupMode = "Box Mode"
boxMode   = input.string("Full Session", "Draw Mode", options=["Full Session", "ORB Only"], group=groupMode)

groupSess = "Sessions"

showAsia   = input.bool(true,  "Show Asia Session", group=groupSess)
asiaSH     = input.int(20, "Asia Start Hour", minval=0, maxval=23, group=groupSess)
asiaSM     = input.int(0,  "Asia Start Minute", minval=0, maxval=59, group=groupSess)
asiaEH     = input.int(0,  "Asia End Hour", minval=0, maxval=23, group=groupSess)
asiaEM     = input.int(0,  "Asia End Minute", minval=0, maxval=59, group=groupSess)

showLondon = input.bool(true,  "Show London Session", group=groupSess)
lonSH      = input.int(2,  "London Start Hour", minval=0, maxval=23, group=groupSess)
lonSM      = input.int(0,  "London Start Minute", minval=0, maxval=59, group=groupSess)
lonEH      = input.int(6,  "London End Hour", minval=0, maxval=23, group=groupSess)
lonEM      = input.int(0,  "London End Minute", minval=0, maxval=59, group=groupSess)

showNYAM   = input.bool(true,  "Show NY AM Session", group=groupSess)
nyAmSH     = input.int(9,  "NY AM Start Hour", minval=0, maxval=23, group=groupSess)
nyAmSM     = input.int(30, "NY AM Start Minute", minval=0, maxval=59, group=groupSess)
nyAmEH     = input.int(11, "NY AM End Hour", minval=0, maxval=23, group=groupSess)
nyAmEM     = input.int(0,  "NY AM End Minute", minval=0, maxval=59, group=groupSess)

showNYPM   = input.bool(true,  "Show NY PM Session", group=groupSess)
nyPmSH     = input.int(13, "NY PM Start Hour", minval=0, maxval=23, group=groupSess)
nyPmSM     = input.int(0,  "NY PM Start Minute", minval=0, maxval=59, group=groupSess)
nyPmEH     = input.int(16, "NY PM End Hour", minval=0, maxval=23, group=groupSess)
nyPmEM     = input.int(0,  "NY PM End Minute", minval=0, maxval=59, group=groupSess)

groupStyle = "Style"
fillOpacity = input.int(85, "Box Fill Opacity", minval=0, maxval=100, group=groupStyle)
showLabels  = input.bool(true, "Show Labels", group=groupStyle)
labelOffset = input.int(5, "Label Offset (Minutes)", minval=0, maxval=240, group=groupStyle)

asiaColor   = input.color(color.purple,  "Asia Colour", group=groupStyle)
londonColor = input.color(color.orange,  "London Colour", group=groupStyle)
nyAmColor   = input.color(color.aqua,    "NY AM Colour", group=groupStyle)
nyPmColor   = input.color(color.fuchsia, "NY PM Colour", group=groupStyle)

groupWM = "Hallmark"
showWatermark = input.bool(true, "Show Bottom-Right Hallmark", group=groupWM)

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// HELPERS
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
orbMs         = orbMins * 60 * 1000
labelOffsetMs = labelOffset * 60 * 1000
lblSize       = size.small

f_sessionBounds(_t, _sh, _sm, _eh, _em) =>
    y  = year(_t, tz)
    mo = month(_t, tz)
    d  = dayofmonth(_t, tz)

    startToday = timestamp(tz, y, mo, d, _sh, _sm)
    endToday   = timestamp(tz, y, mo, d, _eh, _em)

    startMin = _sh * 60 + _sm
    endMin   = _eh * 60 + _em
    crossMid = endMin <= startMin

    startTs = startToday
    endTs   = endToday

    if crossMid
        if _t < endToday
            startTs := startToday - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
            endTs   := endToday
        else
            startTs := startToday
            endTs   := endToday + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000

    [startTs, endTs]

f_orb_1m(_enabled, _sh, _sm, _eh, _em) =>
    var float hi = na
    var float lo = na
    var bool locked = false

    [sessStart, sessEnd] = f_sessionBounds(time, _sh, _sm, _eh, _em)

    inSess  = _enabled and time >= sessStart and time < sessEnd
    newSess = inSess and not inSess[1]
    orbEnd  = sessStart + orbMs
    inOrb   = inSess and time >= sessStart and time < orbEnd

    if newSess
        hi := na
        lo := na
        locked := false

    if inOrb
        hi := na(hi) ? high : math.max(hi, high)
        lo := na(lo) ? low : math.min(lo, low)

    if inSess and not locked and time >= orbEnd and not na(hi) and not na(lo)
        locked := true

    if not inSess and time >= sessEnd
        locked := false

    [hi, lo, sessStart, sessEnd, orbEnd, inSess, inOrb, newSess, locked]

f_get_orb(_enabled, _sh, _sm, _eh, _em) =>
    request.security(
        syminfo.tickerid,
        "1",
        f_orb_1m(_enabled, _sh, _sm, _eh, _em),
        barmerge.gaps_off,
        barmerge.lookahead_off
    )

f_rightEdge(_sessEnd, _orbEnd) =>
    boxMode == "ORB Only" ? _orbEnd : _sessEnd

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SESSION DATA
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[asiaHi, asiaLo, asiaStart, asiaEnd, asiaOrbEnd, asiaInSess, asiaInOrb, asiaNew, asiaLocked] = f_get_orb(showAsia, asiaSH, asiaSM, asiaEH, asiaEM)
[lonHi, lonLo, lonStart, lonEnd, lonOrbEnd, lonInSess, lonInOrb, lonNew, lonLocked] = f_get_orb(showLondon, lonSH, lonSM, lonEH, lonEM)
[nyAmHi, nyAmLo, nyAmStart, nyAmEnd, nyAmOrbEnd, nyAmInSess, nyAmInOrb, nyAmNew, nyAmLocked] = f_get_orb(showNYAM, nyAmSH, nyAmSM, nyAmEH, nyAmEM)
[nyPmHi, nyPmLo, nyPmStart, nyPmEnd, nyPmOrbEnd, nyPmInSess, nyPmInOrb, nyPmNew, nyPmLocked] = f_get_orb(showNYPM, nyPmSH, nyPmSM, nyPmEH, nyPmEM)

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// OBJECTS
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
var box asiaBox = na
var label asiaLbl = na

var box londonBox = na
var label londonLbl = na

var box nyAmBox = na
var label nyAmLbl = na

var box nyPmBox = na
var label nyPmLbl = na

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// ASIA
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
asiaShowNow = showAsia and not na(asiaHi) and not na(asiaLo) and (asiaInSess or asiaLocked)
asiaRight   = f_rightEdge(asiaEnd, asiaOrbEnd)

if asiaNew
    asiaBox := na
    asiaLbl := na

if asiaShowNow
    if na(asiaBox)
        asiaBox := box.new(asiaStart, asiaHi, asiaRight, asiaLo, xloc=xloc.bar_time, border_color=asiaColor, bgcolor=color.new(asiaColor, fillOpacity))
    else
        box.set_left(asiaBox, asiaStart)
        box.set_right(asiaBox, asiaRight)
        if asiaInOrb
            box.set_top(asiaBox, asiaHi)
            box.set_bottom(asiaBox, asiaLo)

    if showLabels
        lx = asiaRight + labelOffsetMs
        ly = asiaHi
        if na(asiaLbl)
            asiaLbl := label.new(lx, ly, "15M ORB", xloc=xloc.bar_time, yloc=yloc.price, style=label.style_label_left, color=color.new(asiaColor, 0), textcolor=color.black, size=lblSize)
        else
            label.set_x(asiaLbl, lx)
            label.set_y(asiaLbl, ly)
            label.set_text(asiaLbl, "15M ORB")
            label.set_color(asiaLbl, color.new(asiaColor, 0))
            label.set_textcolor(asiaLbl, color.black)
            label.set_size(asiaLbl, lblSize)
else
    if not na(asiaLbl)
        label.delete(asiaLbl)
        asiaLbl := na

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// LONDON
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
londonShowNow = showLondon and not na(lonHi) and not na(lonLo) and (lonInSess or lonLocked)
londonRight   = f_rightEdge(lonEnd, lonOrbEnd)

if lonNew
    londonBox := na
    londonLbl := na

if londonShowNow
    if na(londonBox)
        londonBox := box.new(lonStart, lonHi, londonRight, lonLo, xloc=xloc.bar_time, border_color=londonColor, bgcolor=color.new(londonColor, fillOpacity))
    else
        box.set_left(londonBox, lonStart)
        box.set_right(londonBox, londonRight)
        if lonInOrb
            box.set_top(londonBox, lonHi)
            box.set_bottom(londonBox, lonLo)

    if showLabels
        lx = londonRight + labelOffsetMs
        ly = lonHi
        if na(londonLbl)
            londonLbl := label.new(lx, ly, "15M ORB", xloc=xloc.bar_time, yloc=yloc.price, style=label.style_label_left, color=color.new(londonColor, 0), textcolor=color.black, size=lblSize)
        else
            label.set_x(londonLbl, lx)
            label.set_y(londonLbl, ly)
            label.set_text(londonLbl, "15M ORB")
            label.set_color(londonLbl, color.new(londonColor, 0))
            label.set_textcolor(londonLbl, color.black)
            label.set_size(londonLbl, lblSize)
else
    if not na(londonLbl)
        label.delete(londonLbl)
        londonLbl := na

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// NY AM
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
nyAmShowNow = showNYAM and not na(nyAmHi) and not na(nyAmLo) and (nyAmInSess or nyAmLocked)
nyAmRight   = f_rightEdge(nyAmEnd, nyAmOrbEnd)

if nyAmNew
    nyAmBox := na
    nyAmLbl := na

if nyAmShowNow
    if na(nyAmBox)
        nyAmBox := box.new(nyAmStart, nyAmHi, nyAmRight, nyAmLo, xloc=xloc.bar_time, border_color=nyAmColor, bgcolor=color.new(nyAmColor, fillOpacity))
    else
        box.set_left(nyAmBox, nyAmStart)
        box.set_right(nyAmBox, nyAmRight)
        if nyAmInOrb
            box.set_top(nyAmBox, nyAmHi)
            box.set_bottom(nyAmBox, nyAmLo)

    if showLabels
        lx = nyAmRight + labelOffsetMs
        ly = nyAmHi
        if na(nyAmLbl)
            nyAmLbl := label.new(lx, ly, "15M ORB", xloc=xloc.bar_time, yloc=yloc.price, style=label.style_label_left, color=color.new(nyAmColor, 0), textcolor=color.black, size=lblSize)
        else
            label.set_x(nyAmLbl, lx)
            label.set_y(nyAmLbl, ly)
            label.set_text(nyAmLbl, "15M ORB")
            label.set_color(nyAmLbl, color.new(nyAmColor, 0))
            label.set_textcolor(nyAmLbl, color.black)
            label.set_size(nyAmLbl, lblSize)
else
    if not na(nyAmLbl)
        label.delete(nyAmLbl)
        nyAmLbl := na

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// NY PM
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
nyPmShowNow = showNYPM and not na(nyPmHi) and not na(nyPmLo) and (nyPmInSess or nyPmLocked)
nyPmRight   = f_rightEdge(nyPmEnd, nyPmOrbEnd)

if nyPmNew
    nyPmBox := na
    nyPmLbl := na

if nyPmShowNow
    if na(nyPmBox)
        nyPmBox := box.new(nyPmStart, nyPmHi, nyPmRight, nyPmLo, xloc=xloc.bar_time, border_color=nyPmColor, bgcolor=color.new(nyPmColor, fillOpacity))
    else
        box.set_left(nyPmBox, nyPmStart)
        box.set_right(nyPmBox, nyPmRight)
        if nyPmInOrb
            box.set_top(nyPmBox, nyPmHi)
            box.set_bottom(nyPmBox, nyPmLo)

    if showLabels
        lx = nyPmRight + labelOffsetMs
        ly = nyPmHi
        if na(nyPmLbl)
            nyPmLbl := label.new(lx, ly, "15M ORB", xloc=xloc.bar_time, yloc=yloc.price, style=label.style_label_left, color=color.new(nyPmColor, 0), textcolor=color.black, size=lblSize)
        else
            label.set_x(nyPmLbl, lx)
            label.set_y(nyPmLbl, ly)
            label.set_text(nyPmLbl, "15M ORB")
            label.set_color(nyPmLbl, color.new(nyPmColor, 0))
            label.set_textcolor(nyPmLbl, color.black)
            label.set_size(nyPmLbl, lblSize)
else
    if not na(nyPmLbl)
        label.delete(nyPmLbl)
        nyPmLbl := na

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// FIXED HALLMARK

items.author: pbloem
items.source:
//@version=6
indicator("FX Session First 15min Candle Marker", shorttitle="SessionMrk", overlay=true, max_lines_count=500)

// Input settings
show_sydney = input.bool(true, "Show Sydney Session", group="Sessions")
show_tokyo = input.bool(true, "Show Tokyo Session", group="Sessions")
show_london = input.bool(true, "Show London Session", group="Sessions")
show_newyork = input.bool(true, "Show New York Session", group="Sessions")

// Line styling inputs
sydney_color = input.color(color.yellow, "Sydney Color", group="Colors")
tokyo_color = input.color(color.red, "Tokyo Color", group="Colors")
london_color = input.color(color.blue, "London Color", group="Colors")
newyork_color = input.color(color.green, "New York Color", group="Colors")

line_width = input.int(2, "Line Width", minval=1, maxval=5, group="Styling")
line_style_input = input.string("Solid", "Line Style", options=["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], group="Styling")

// Convert line style
line_style = line_style_input == "Solid" ? line.style_solid : line_style_input == "Dashed" ? line.style_dashed : line.style_dotted

// Session time definitions (in UTC)
sydney_start = "21:00"
sydney_end = "06:00"
tokyo_start = "00:00" 
tokyo_end = "09:00"
london_start = "07:00"
london_end = "16:00"
newyork_start = "12:00"
newyork_end = "21:00"

// Function to check if we're in a session
in_session(session_start, session_end) =>
    current_hour = hour(time, "UTC")
    current_minute = minute(time, "UTC")
    current_time = current_hour * 100 + current_minute
    
    start_parts = str.split(session_start, ":")
    start_time = str.tonumber(array.get(start_parts, 0)) * 100 + str.tonumber(array.get(start_parts, 1))
    
    end_parts = str.split(session_end, ":")
    end_time = str.tonumber(array.get(end_parts, 0)) * 100 + str.tonumber(array.get(end_parts, 1))
    
    if start_time > end_time  // Session crosses midnight
        current_time >= start_time or current_time <= end_time
    else
        current_time >= start_time and current_time <= end_time

// Variables to track session states and lines
var bool sydney_session_started = false
var bool tokyo_session_started = false
var bool london_session_started = false
var bool newyork_session_started = false

var bool sydney_first_candle_marked = false
var bool tokyo_first_candle_marked = false
var bool london_first_candle_marked = false
var bool newyork_first_candle_marked = false

// Variables to store line objects
var line sydney_high_line = na
var line sydney_low_line = na
var line tokyo_high_line = na
var line tokyo_low_line = na
var line london_high_line = na
var line london_low_line = na
var line newyork_high_line = na
var line newyork_low_line = na

// Variables to store label objects
var label sydney_label = na
var label tokyo_label = na
var label london_label = na
var label newyork_label = na

// Check if we're on a 15-minute timeframe or higher
is_15min_or_higher = timeframe.in_seconds() >= 900

// Function to draw session lines that last only during the session
draw_session_lines(session_name, color_input, high_price, low_price) =>
    bars_in_session = 50
    high_line = line.new(bar_index, high_price, bar_index + bars_in_session, high_price, color=color_input, width=line_width, style=line_style, extend=extend.right)
    low_line = line.new(bar_index, low_price, bar_index + bars_in_session, low_price, color=color_input, width=line_width, style=line_style, extend=extend.right)
    session_label = label.new(bar_index, high_price, session_name, color=color.new(color_input, 80), textcolor=color_input, style=label.style_label_down, size=size.small)
    [high_line, low_line, session_label]

// Function to clean up session lines and labels
cleanup_session(high_line_ref, low_line_ref, label_ref) =>
    if not na(high_line_ref)
        line.delete(high_line_ref)
    if not na(low_line_ref)
        line.delete(low_line_ref)
    if not na(label_ref)
        label.delete(label_ref)

// Sydney Session Logic
sydney_in_session = in_session(sydney_start, sydney_end)
if sydney_in_session and not sydney_session_started
    sydney_session_started := true
    sydney_first_candle_marked := false

if not sydney_in_session and sydney_session_started
    sydney_session_started := false
    // Clean up Sydney session lines when session ends
    cleanup_session(sydney_high_line, sydney_low_line, sydney_label)
    sydney_high_line := na
    sydney_low_line := na
    sydney_label := na

if sydney_session_started and not sydney_first_candle_marked and is_15min_or_higher and show_sydney
    if barstate.isconfirmed or barstate.islast
        [high_line, low_line, session_label] = draw_session_lines("Sydney", sydney_color, high, low)
        sydney_high_line := high_line
        sydney_low_line := low_line
        sydney_label := session_label
        sydney_first_candle_marked := true

// Tokyo Session Logic
tokyo_in_session = in_session(tokyo_start, tokyo_end)
if tokyo_in_session and not tokyo_session_started
    tokyo_session_started := true
    tokyo_first_candle_marked := false

if not tokyo_in_session and tokyo_session_started
    tokyo_session_started := false
    // Clean up Tokyo session lines when session ends
    cleanup_session(tokyo_high_line, tokyo_low_line, tokyo_label)
    tokyo_high_line := na
    tokyo_low_line := na
    tokyo_label := na

if tokyo_session_started and not tokyo_first_candle_marked and is_15min_or_higher and show_tokyo
    if barstate.isconfirmed or barstate.islast
        [high_line, low_line, session_label] = draw_session_lines("Tokyo", tokyo_color, high, low)
        tokyo_high_line := high_line
        tokyo_low_line := low_line
        tokyo_label := session_label
        tokyo_first_candle_marked := true

// London Session Logic  
london_in_session = in_session(london_start, london_end)
if london_in_session and not london_session_started
    london_session_started := true
    london_first_candle_marked := false

if not london_in_session and london_session_started
    london_session_started := false
    // Clean up London session lines when session ends
    cleanup_session(london_high_line, london_low_line, london_label)
    london_high_line := na
    london_low_line := na
    london_label := na

// Mark London session - allow both confirmed and current bar for real-time detection
if london_session_started and not london_first_candle_marked and is_15min_or_higher and show_london
    if barstate.isconfirmed or barstate.islast
        [high_line, low_line, session_label] = draw_session_lines("London", london_color, high, low)
        london_high_line := high_line
        london_low_line := low_line
        london_label := session_label
        london_first_candle_marked := true

// New York Session Logic
newyork_in_session = in_session(newyork_start, newyork_end)
if newyork_in_session and not newyork_session_started
    newyork_session_started := true
    newyork_first_candle_marked := false

if not newyork_in_session and newyork_session_started
    newyork_session_started := false
    // Clean up New York session lines when session ends
    cleanup_session(newyork_high_line, newyork_low_line, newyork_label)
    newyork_high_line := na
    newyork_low_line := na
    newyork_label := na

if newyork_session_started and not newyork_first_candle_marked and is_15min_or_higher and show_newyork
    if barstate.isconfirmed or barstate.islast
        [high_line, low_line, session_label] = draw_session_lines("New York", newyork_color, high, low)
        newyork_high_line := high_line
        newyork_low_line := low_line
        newyork_label := session_label
        newyork_first_candle_marked := true

// Background coloring for active sessions (optional)
bgcolor_sydney = sydney_in_session and show_sydney ? color.new(sydney_color, 95) : na
bgcolor_tokyo = tokyo_in_session and show_tokyo ? color.new(tokyo_color, 95) : na  
bgcolor_london = london_in_session and show_london ? color.new(london_color, 95) : na
bgcolor_newyork = newyork_in_session and show_newyork ? color.new(newyork_color, 95) : na

items.name: ORB Indicator + Full Visuals (PROFITABLE V4.1)
items.title: ORB Indicator + Full Visuals (PROFITABLE V4.1)
items.author: musenexus
items.source:
//@version=6
indicator('ORB Indicator + Full Visuals (PROFITABLE V4.1)', overlay = true, max_labels_count = 100)

// ===== INPUTS =====
sess = input.session('0930-0945', 'ORB Window')
tz = input.string('America/New_York', 'Timezone')
mode = input.string('Breakout', 'Logic', options = ['Breakout', 'MeanReversion'])
fastLen = input.int(9, 'Fast EMA (blue)')
slowLen = input.int(20, 'Slow EMA (orange)')
midLen = input.int(50, 'Mid SMA (white)')
tradeStart = input.session('0930-1130', 'Trading Hours')
showBands = input.bool(true, 'VWAP σ Bands')

// --- Fixed Multi-Target Scaling Inputs ---
atrLen = input.int(14, 'ATR Length')
tp1AtrMult = input.float(1.5, 'Target 1 ATR Multiplier')
tp2AtrMult = input.float(3.0, 'Target 2 ATR Multiplier')
maxTrades = input.int(2, 'Max Daily Trades')

tickSz = syminfo.mintick

// ===== ORB =====
inORB = not na(time(timeframe.period, sess, tz))
newDay = ta.change(time('D')) != 0

var float orbH = na
var float orbL = na
var bool orbDone = false
if newDay
    orbH := na
    orbL := na
    orbDone := false
    orbDone
if inORB
    orbH := na(orbH) ? high : math.max(orbH, high)
    orbL := na(orbL) ? low : math.min(orbL, low)
    orbL
else if not na(orbH)
    orbDone := true
    orbDone

// ===== PRIOR DAY =====
pdh = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, 'D', high[1], lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)
pdl = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, 'D', low[1], lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)

// ===== MAs & ATR =====
emaFast = ta.ema(close, fastLen)
emaSlow = ta.ema(close, slowLen)
smaMid = ta.sma(close, midLen)
atr = ta.atr(atrLen)

plot(emaFast, 'Fast EMA', color.new(color.blue, 0), 2)
plot(emaSlow, 'Slow EMA', color.new(color.orange, 0), 2)
plot(smaMid, 'Mid SMA', color.new(color.white, 0), 2)

// ===== VWAP + BANDS =====
vw = ta.vwap(hlc3)
var float ss = 0.0
var float sv = 0.0
if newDay
    ss := 0.0
    sv := 0.0
    sv
ss := ss + volume * math.pow(hlc3 - vw, 2)
sv := sv + volume
dev = sv > 0 ? math.sqrt(ss / sv) : 0.0
cb = color.new(color.teal, 60)
plot(vw, 'VWAP', color.new(color.white, 0), 2)
plot(showBands ? vw + dev : na, '+1σ', cb)
plot(showBands ? vw + 2 * dev : na, '+2σ', cb)
plot(showBands ? vw + 3 * dev : na, '+3σ', cb)
plot(showBands ? vw - dev : na, '-1σ', cb)
plot(showBands ? vw - 2 * dev : na, '-2σ', cb)
plot(showBands ? vw - 2 * dev : na, '-2σ', cb)
plot(showBands ? vw - 3 * dev : na, '-3σ', cb)

// ===== LEVEL LINES =====
plot(orbDone ? orbH : na, 'ORB High', color.yellow, 2, plot.style_linebr)
plot(orbDone ? orbL : na, 'ORB Low', color.yellow, 2, plot.style_linebr)
plot(pdh, 'PDH', color.orange, 1, plot.style_linebr)
plot(pdl, 'PDL', color.orange, 1, plot.style_linebr)

// ===== RIGHT-EDGE LABELS =====
var label lOrbH = na
var label lOrbL = na
var label lPdh = na
var label lPdl = na
var label lVw = na
if barstate.islast
    label.delete(lOrbH)
    label.delete(lOrbL)
    label.delete(lPdh)
    label.delete(lPdl)
    label.delete(lVw)
    x = bar_index + 3
    if orbDone
        lOrbH := label.new(x, orbH, 'ORB High', style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(color.yellow, 80), textcolor = color.yellow, size = size.small)
        lOrbL := label.new(x, orbL, 'ORB Low', style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(color.yellow, 80), textcolor = color.yellow, size = size.small)
        lOrbL
    lPdh := label.new(x, pdh, 'PDH', style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(color.orange, 80), textcolor = color.orange, size = size.small)
    lPdl := label.new(x, pdl, 'PDL', style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(color.orange, 80), textcolor = color.orange, size = size.small)
    lVw := label.new(x, vw, 'VWAP', style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(color.white, 80), textcolor = color.white, size = size.small)
    lVw

// ===== INFO TABLE =====
var table t = table.new(position.top_right, 2, 6, bgcolor = color.new(color.black, 20), border_width = 1)
if barstate.islast
    pos = close > vw + dev ? 'ABOVE +1σ' : close < vw - dev ? 'BELOW -1σ' : 'INSIDE BANDS'
    table.cell(t, 0, 0, 'Distance', text_color = color.gray, text_size = size.tiny)
    table.cell(t, 1, 0, str.tostring((close - vw) / vw * 100, '#.##') + '%', text_color = color.white, text_size = size.tiny)
    table.cell(t, 0, 1, 'Position', text_color = color.gray, text_size = size.tiny)
    table.cell(t, 1, 1, pos, text_color = color.teal, text_size = size.tiny)
    table.cell(t, 0, 2, 'ORB High', text_color = color.gray, text_size = size.tiny)
    table.cell(t, 1, 2, orbDone ? str.tostring(orbH) : 'Building...', text_color = color.yellow, text_size = size.tiny)
    table.cell(t, 0, 3, 'ORB Low', text_color = color.gray, text_size = size.tiny)
    table.cell(t, 1, 3, orbDone ? str.tostring(orbL) : 'Building...', text_color = color.yellow, text_size = size.tiny)
    table.cell(t, 0, 4, 'Prev High', text_color = color.gray, text_size = size.tiny)
    table.cell(t, 1, 4, str.tostring(pdh), text_color = color.orange, text_size = size.tiny)
    table.cell(t, 0, 5, 'Prev Low', text_color = color.gray, text_size = size.tiny)
    table.cell(t, 1, 5, str.tostring(pdl), text_color = color.orange, text_size = size.tiny)

canTrade = not na(time(timeframe.period, tradeStart, tz))
risk = orbH - orbL

// ===== INTRADAY TRADE TRACKING STATE ENGINE =====
var int dailyTradesCount = 0
var int state = 0 // 0 = Flat, 1 = Long (Both Targets Active), 2 = Long (Target 1 Hit, Breakeven Stop Active), -1 = Short (Both Targets Active), -2 = Short (Target 1 Hit, Breakeven Stop Active)
var float entryPrice = na
var float initialStop = na
var float bp1 = na
var float bp2 = na

if newDay
    dailyTradesCount := 0
    state := 0
    entryPrice := na
    initialStop := na
    bp1 := na
    bp2 := na
    bp2

allowedByCap = dailyTradesCount < maxTrades

// ===== RAW CONDITIONS =====
longCondRaw = false
shortCondRaw = false
if mode == 'Breakout'
    longCondRaw := orbDone and canTrade and allowedByCap and ta.crossover(close, orbH) and emaFast > emaSlow and close > smaMid
    shortCondRaw := orbDone and canTrade and allowedByCap and ta.crossunder(close, orbL) and emaFast < emaSlow and close < smaMid
    shortCondRaw
else
    longCondRaw := orbDone and canTrade and allowedByCap and close < vw - 2 * dev and ta.crossover(close, low[1]) and close > smaMid
    shortCondRaw := orbDone and canTrade and allowedByCap and close > vw + 2 * dev and ta.crossunder(close, high[1]) and close < smaMid
    shortCondRaw

// Only trigger entry signals if the engine is completely flat
longCond = longCondRaw and state == 0
shortCond = shortCondRaw and state == 0

// ===== STATE MANAGEMENT ENGINE =====
if longCond
    state := 1
    dailyTradesCount := dailyTradesCount + 1
    entryPrice := close
    initialStop := mode == 'Breakout' ? orbL : entryPrice - risk
    bp1 := entryPrice + atr * tp1AtrMult
    bp2 := entryPrice + atr * tp2AtrMult
    bp2

if shortCond
    state := -1
    dailyTradesCount := dailyTradesCount + 1
    entryPrice := close
    initialStop := mode == 'Breakout' ? orbH : entryPrice + risk
    bp1 := entryPrice - atr * tp1AtrMult
    bp2 := entryPrice - atr * tp2AtrMult
    bp2

// --- Active Trade Simulation Management ---
bool longExitedTp1 = false
bool longExitedTp2 = false
bool longExitedStop = false

bool shortExitedTp1 = false
bool shortExitedTp2 = false
bool shortExitedStop = false

// Long Management Loops
if state == 1
    if high >= bp1
        state := 2 // Target 1 Achieved -> Trail stop to Breakeven
        longExitedTp1 := true
        longExitedTp1
    if low <= initialStop
        state := 0 // Stopped out completely
        longExitedStop := true
        longExitedStop

if state == 2
    if high >= bp2
        state := 0 // Target 2 Achieved -> Trade Finished Successfully
        longExitedTp2 := true
        longExitedTp2
    if low <= entryPrice
        state := 0 // Stopped out at Breakeven
        longExitedStop := true
        longExitedStop

// Short Management Loops
if state == -1
    if low <= bp1
        state := -2 // Target 1 Achieved -> Trail stop to Breakeven
        shortExitedTp1 := true
        shortExitedTp1
    if high >= initialStop
        state := 0 // Stopped out completely
        shortExitedStop := true
        shortExitedStop

if state == -2
    if low <= bp2
        state := 0 // Target 2 Achieved -> Trade Finished Successfully
        shortExitedTp2 := true
        shortExitedTp2
    if high >= entryPrice
        state := 0 // Stopped out at Breakeven
        shortExitedStop := true
        shortExitedStop

// End of Day force-flush optimization
if newDay and state != 0
    state := 0
    state

// ===== PLOTS, SHAPES & ALERTS =====
plotshape(longCond, 'LONG ENTRY', shape.triangleup, location.belowbar, color.new(color.green, 0), size = size.small, text = 'LONG')
plotshape(shortCond, 'SHORT ENTRY', shape.triangledown, location.abovebar, color.new(color.red, 0), size = size.small, text = 'SHORT')

// Exit tracking plots for charting precision
plotshape(longExitedTp1, 'LONG TP1 HIT', shape.xcross, location.abovebar, color.new(color.green, 30), size = size.tiny, text = 'TP1')
plotshape(longExitedTp2, 'LONG TP2 HIT', shape.xcross, location.abovebar, color.new(color.green, 0), size = size.small, text = 'TP2 TARGET')
plotshape(longExitedStop, 'LONG STOPPED', shape.xcross, location.belowbar, color.new(color.red, 0), size = size.small, text = 'STOP')

plotshape(shortExitedTp1, 'SHORT TP1 HIT', shape.xcross, location.belowbar, color.new(color.red, 30), size = size.tiny, text = 'TP1')
plotshape(shortExitedTp2, 'SHORT TP2 HIT', shape.xcross, location.belowbar, color.new(color.red, 0), size = size.small, text = 'TP2 TARGET')
plotshape(shortExitedStop, 'SHORT STOPPED', shape.xcross, location.abovebar, color.new(color.red, 0), size = size.small, text = 'STOP')

// Native Conditional Alert Triggers
alertcondition(longCond, title = 'Long Entry Alert', message = 'ORB Indicator: Long Breakout Entry Triggered.')
alertcondition(shortCond, title = 'Short Entry Alert', message = 'ORB Indicator: Short Breakout Entry Triggered.')
alertcondition(longExitedTp1 or shortExitedTp1, title = 'Scale Target 1 Alert', message = 'ORB Indicator: Target 1 Scaling achieved. Stop adjusted to Breakeven.')
alertcondition(longExitedTp2 or shortExitedTp2, title = 'Target 2 Profit Complete Alert', message = 'ORB Indicator: Target 2 completely filled. Trade finished.')
alertcondition(longExitedStop or shortExitedStop, title = 'Stop-Loss Hit Alert', message = 'ORB Indicator: Stop-loss executed. Protection closed position.')

//@version=6
indicator("Orange 30M ORB Indicator", overlay=true, max_boxes_count=500, max_lines_count=500, max_labels_count=500)

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// General Inputs
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
grpGeneral = "General"
showBoxes         = input.bool(true, "Show opening range boxes", group=grpGeneral)
showMidline       = input.bool(true, "Show midline", group=grpGeneral)
showLabels        = input.bool(true, "Show session labels", group=grpGeneral)
showRetestLabels  = input.bool(true, "Show retest labels", group=grpGeneral)
historicalSession = input.bool(true, "Keep historical session drawings", group=grpGeneral)
breakoutByClose   = input.bool(true, "Breakout uses candle close", group=grpGeneral)

nyTZ = "America/New_York"

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Retest Inputs
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
grpRetest = "Retest Settings"
retestChartTF      = input.string("15", "Retest chart timeframe", options=["1", "5", "15"], group=grpRetest)
restrictRetestTF   = input.bool(true, "Restrict retest to selected chart timeframe", group=grpRetest)
maxRetestBars      = input.int(20, "Maximum bars from breakout to retest", minval=1, group=grpRetest)
wickIntoRangeMax   = input.float(10.0, "Max wick penetration into range (points)", minval=0.0, step=0.25, group=grpRetest)
closeIntoRangeMax  = input.float(5.0, "Max close penetration into range (points)", minval=0.0, step=0.25, group=grpRetest)

retestMode         = input.string("Touch or Within Distance", "Retest Qualification Mode", options=["Touch Only", "Touch or Within Distance"], group=grpRetest)
retestDistance     = input.float(5.0, "Retest distance from breakout level (points)", minval=0.0, step=0.25, group=grpRetest)

retestCandleColor  = input.color(color.purple, "Retest Candle Color", group=grpRetest)
nextCandleColor    = input.color(color.orange, "Next Candle After Retest Color", group=grpRetest)

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Session Inputs
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
grp1 = "Session 1"
s1Enabled = input.bool(true, "Enable Session 1", group=grp1)
s1Name    = input.string("New York", "Session Label", group=grp1)
s1Session = input.session("0930-1600", "Session Time (NY Local)", group=grp1)
s1ORMin   = input.int(30, "Opening Range Minutes", minval=1, group=grp1)
s1Color   = input.color(color.blue, "Session Color", group=grp1)

grp2 = "Session 2"

s2Name    = input.string("London", "Session Label", group=grp2)
s2Session = input.session("0300-1100", "Session Time (NY Local)", group=grp2)
s2ORMin   = input.int(30, "Opening Range Minutes", minval=1, group=grp2)
s2Color   = input.color(color.orange, "Session Color", group=grp2)

grp3 = "Session 3"
s3Enabled = input.bool(false, "Enable Session 3", group=grp3)
s3Name    = input.string("Asia", "Session Label", group=grp3)
s3Session = input.session("2000-0300", "Session Time (NY Local)", group=grp3)
s3ORMin   = input.int(30, "Opening Range Minutes", minval=1, group=grp3)
s3Color   = input.color(color.purple, "Session Color", group=grp3)

bg1 = color.new(s1Color, 88)
bg2 = color.new(s2Color, 88)
bg3 = color.new(s3Color, 88)

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Helpers
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
selectedTFMinutes = str.tonumber(retestChartTF)
isAllowedRetestTF = timeframe.isintraday and timeframe.multiplier == selectedTFMinutes
allowRetestNow    = restrictRetestTF ? isAllowedRetestTF : true
useDistanceMode   = retestMode == "Touch or Within Distance"

extendBoxToCurrentSession(_box) =>
    if not na(_box)
        box.set_right(_box, time_close)

bullCloseOk(level) =>
    close >= level - closeIntoRangeMax

bearCloseOk(level) =>
    close <= level + closeIntoRangeMax

bullRetestZoneOk(level) =>
    useDistanceMode ?
         (low >= (level - wickIntoRangeMax) and low <= (level + retestDistance)) :
         (low >= (level - wickIntoRangeMax) and low <= level)

bearRetestZoneOk(level) =>
    useDistanceMode ?
         (high <= (level + wickIntoRangeMax) and high >= (level - retestDistance)) :
         (high <= (level + wickIntoRangeMax) and high >= level)

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Session detection
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
inS1 = s1Enabled and not na(time(timeframe.period, s1Session, nyTZ))
inS2 = s2Enabled and not na(time(timeframe.period, s2Session, nyTZ))
inS3 = s3Enabled and not na(time(timeframe.period, s3Session, nyTZ))

newS1 = inS1 and not inS1[1]
newS2 = inS2 and not inS2[1]
newS3 = inS3 and not inS3[1]

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Session 1 state
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
var float s1High = na
var float s1Low = na
var float s1Mid = na
var int   s1StartTime = na
var bool  s1Finalized = false
var bool  s1BullBroken = false
var bool  s1BearBroken = false
var int   s1BullBreakBar = na
var int   s1BearBreakBar = na
var box   s1Box = na
var line  s1MidLine = na
var label s1Label = na

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Session 2 state
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
var float s2High = na
var float s2Low = na
var float s2Mid = na
var int   s2StartTime = na
var bool  s2Finalized = false
var bool  s2BullBroken = false
var bool  s2BearBroken = false
var int   s2BullBreakBar = na
var int   s2BearBreakBar = na
var box   s2Box = na
var line  s2MidLine = na
var label s2Label = na

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Session 3 state
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
var float s3High = na
var float s3Low = na
var float s3Mid = na
var int   s3StartTime = na
var bool  s3Finalized = false
var bool  s3BullBroken = false
var bool  s3BearBroken = false
var int   s3BullBreakBar = na
var int   s3BearBreakBar = na
var box   s3Box = na
var line  s3MidLine = na
var label s3Label = na

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Cleanup helper
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
clearObjects(_box, _midLine, _label) =>
    if not historicalSession
        if not na(_box)
            box.delete(_box)
        if not na(_midLine)
            line.delete(_midLine)
        if not na(_label)
            label.delete(_label)

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SESSION 1
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if newS1
    clearObjects(s1Box, s1MidLine, s1Label)
    s1High := high
    s1Low := low
    s1Mid := (s1High + s1Low) / 2.0
    s1StartTime := time
    s1Finalized := false
    s1BullBroken := false
    s1BearBroken := false
    s1BullBreakBar := na
    s1BearBreakBar := na

    if showBoxes
        s1Box := box.new(left=time, top=high, right=time_close, bottom=low, xloc=xloc.bar_time, bgcolor=bg1, border_color=s1Color)
    if showMidline
        s1MidLine := line.new(x1=time, y1=s1Mid, x2=time_close, y2=s1Mid, xloc=xloc.bar_time, extend=extend.none, color=s1Color, style=line.style_dashed)
    if showLabels
        s1Label := label.new(x=time, y=high, text=s1Name, xloc=xloc.bar_time, style=label.style_label_down, textcolor=color.white, color=s1Color)

s1OREnd = na(s1StartTime) ? na : s1StartTime + s1ORMin * 60 * 1000

if inS1 and not na(s1StartTime)
    if not s1Finalized
        if time < s1OREnd
            s1High := math.max(s1High, high)
            s1Low := math.min(s1Low, low)
            s1Mid := (s1High + s1Low) / 2.0

            if showBoxes and not na(s1Box)
                box.set_top(s1Box, s1High)
                box.set_bottom(s1Box, s1Low)
                box.set_right(s1Box, time_close)

            if showMidline and not na(s1MidLine)
                line.set_y1(s1MidLine, s1Mid)
                line.set_y2(s1MidLine, s1Mid)
                line.set_x2(s1MidLine, time_close)

            if showLabels and not na(s1Label)
                label.set_x(s1Label, time)
                label.set_y(s1Label, s1High)
        else
            s1Finalized := true

    if s1Finalized
        if showBoxes
            extendBoxToCurrentSession(s1Box)
        if showMidline and not na(s1MidLine)
            line.set_x2(s1MidLine, time_close)

s1BreakUpSrc = breakoutByClose ? close > s1High : high > s1High
s1BreakDnSrc = breakoutByClose ? close < s1Low : low < s1Low

s1BullBreak = inS1 and s1Finalized and not s1BullBroken and s1BreakUpSrc
s1BearBreak = inS1 and s1Finalized and not s1BearBroken and s1BreakDnSrc

if s1BullBreak
    s1BullBroken := true
    s1BullBreakBar := bar_index

if s1BearBreak
    s1BearBroken := true
    s1BearBreakBar := bar_index

s1BullRetestZone = bullRetestZoneOk(s1High)
s1BullCloseValid = bullCloseOk(s1High)

s1BearRetestZone = bearRetestZoneOk(s1Low)
s1BearCloseValid = bearCloseOk(s1Low)

s1BullRetest = inS1 and allowRetestNow and s1BullBroken and not na(s1BullBreakBar) and bar_index > s1BullBreakBar and (bar_index - s1BullBreakBar <= maxRetestBars) and s1BullRetestZone and s1BullCloseValid
s1BearRetest = inS1 and allowRetestNow and s1BearBroken and not na(s1BearBreakBar) and bar_index > s1BearBreakBar and (bar_index - s1BearBreakBar <= maxRetestBars) and s1BearRetestZone and s1BearCloseValid

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SESSION 2
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if newS2
    clearObjects(s2Box, s2MidLine, s2Label)
    s2High := high
    s2Low := low
    s2Mid := (s2High + s2Low) / 2.0
    s2StartTime := time
    s2Finalized := false
    s2BullBroken := false
    s2BearBroken := false
    s2BullBreakBar := na
    s2BearBreakBar := na

    if showBoxes
        s2Box := box.new(left=time, top=high, right=time_close, bottom=low, xloc=xloc.bar_time, bgcolor=bg2, border_color=s2Color)
    if showMidline
        s2MidLine := line.new(x1=time, y1=s2Mid, x2=time_close, y2=s2Mid, xloc=xloc.bar_time, extend=extend.none, color=s2Color, style=line.style_dashed)
    if showLabels
        s2Label := label.new(x=time, y=high, text=s2Name, xloc=xloc.bar_time, style=label.style_label_down, textcolor=color.white, color=s2Color)

s2OREnd = na(s2StartTime) ? na : s2StartTime + s2ORMin * 60 * 1000

if inS2 and not na(s2StartTime)
    if not s2Finalized
        if time < s2OREnd
            s2High := math.max(s2High, high)
            s2Low := math.min(s2Low, low)
            s2Mid := (s2High + s2Low) / 2.0

            if showBoxes and not na(s2Box)
                box.set_top(s2Box, s2High)
                box.set_bottom(s2Box, s2Low)
                box.set_right(s2Box, time_close)

            if showMidline and not na(s2MidLine)
                line.set_y1(s2MidLine, s2Mid)
                line.set_y2(s2MidLine, s2Mid)
                line.set_x2(s2MidLine, time_close)

            if showLabels and not na(s2Label)
                label.set_x(s2Label, time)
                label.set_y(s2Label, s2High)
        else
            s2Finalized := true

    if s2Finalized
        if showBoxes
            extendBoxToCurrentSession(s2Box)
        if showMidline and not na(s2MidLine)
            line.set_x2(s2MidLine, time_close)

s2BreakUpSrc = breakoutByClose ? close > s2High : high > s2High
s2BreakDnSrc = breakoutByClose ? close < s2Low : low < s2Low

s2BullBreak = inS2 and s2Finalized and not s2BullBroken and s2BreakUpSrc
s2BearBreak = inS2 and s2Finalized and not s2BearBroken and s2BreakDnSrc

if s2BullBreak
    s2BullBroken := true
    s2BullBreakBar := bar_index

if s2BearBreak
    s2BearBroken := true
    s2BearBreakBar := bar_index

s2BullRetestZone = bullRetestZoneOk(s2High)
s2BullCloseValid = bullCloseOk(s2High)

s2BearRetestZone = bearRetestZoneOk(s2Low)
s2BearCloseValid = bearCloseOk(s2Low)

s2BullRetest = inS2 and allowRetestNow and s2BullBroken and not na(s2BullBreakBar) and bar_index > s2BullBreakBar and (bar_index - s2BullBreakBar <= maxRetestBars) and s2BullRetestZone and s2BullCloseValid
s2BearRetest = inS2 and allowRetestNow and s2BearBroken and not na(s2BearBreakBar) and bar_index > s2BearBreakBar and (bar_index - s2BearBreakBar <= maxRetestBars) and s2BearRetestZone and s2BearCloseValid

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SESSION 3
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if newS3
    clearObjects(s3Box, s3MidLine, s3Label)
    s3High := high
    s3Low := low
    s3Mid := (s3High + s3Low) / 2.0
    s3StartTime := time
    s3Finalized := false
    s3BullBroken := false
    s3BearBroken := false
    s3BullBreakBar := na
    s3BearBreakBar := na

    if showBoxes
        s3Box := box.new(left=time, top=high, right=time_close, bottom=low, xloc=xloc.bar_time, bgcolor=bg3, border_color=s3Color)
    if showMidline
        s3MidLine := line.new(x1=time, y1=s3Mid, x2=time_close, y2=s3Mid, xloc=xloc.bar_time, extend=extend.none, color=s3Color, style=line.style_dashed)
    if showLabels
        s3Label := label.new(x=time, y=high, text=s3Name, xloc=xloc.bar_time, style=label.style_label_down, textcolor=color.white, color=s3Color)

s3OREnd = na(s3StartTime) ? na : s3StartTime + s3ORMin * 60 * 1000

if inS3 and not na(s3StartTime)
    if not s3Finalized
        if time < s3OREnd
            s3High := math.max(s3High, high)
            s3Low := math.min(s3Low, low)
            s3Mid := (s3High + s3Low) / 2.0

            if showBoxes and not na(s3Box)
                box.set_top(s3Box, s3High)
                box.set_bottom(s3Box, s3Low)
                box.set_right(s3Box, time_close)

            if showMidline and not na(s3MidLine)
                line.set_y1(s3MidLine, s3Mid)
                line.set_y2(s3MidLine, s3Mid)
                line.set_x2(s3MidLine, time_close)

            if showLabels and not na(s3Label)
                label.set_x(s3Label, time)
                label.set_y(s3Label, s3High)
        else
            s3Finalized := true

    if s3Finalized
        if showBoxes
            extendBoxToCurrentSession(s3Box)
        if showMidline and not na(s3MidLine)
            line.set_x2(s3MidLine, time_close)

s3BreakUpSrc = breakoutByClose ? close > s3High : high > s3High
s3BreakDnSrc = breakoutByClose ? close < s3Low : low < s3Low

s3BullBreak = inS3 and s3Finalized and not s3BullBroken and s3BreakUpSrc
s3BearBreak = inS3 and s3Finalized and not s3BearBroken and s3BreakDnSrc

if s3BullBreak
    s3BullBroken := true
    s3BullBreakBar := bar_index

if s3BearBreak
    s3BearBroken := true
    s3BearBreakBar := bar_index

s3BullRetestZone = bullRetestZoneOk(s3High)
s3BullCloseValid = bullCloseOk(s3High)

s3BearRetestZone = bearRetestZoneOk(s3Low)
s3BearCloseValid = bearCloseOk(s3Low)

s3BullRetest = inS3 and allowRetestNow and s3BullBroken and not na(s3BullBreakBar) and bar_index > s3BullBreakBar and (bar_index - s3BullBreakBar <= maxRetestBars) and s3BullRetestZone and s3BullCloseValid
s3BearRetest = inS3 and allowRetestNow and s3BearBroken and not na(s3BearBreakBar) and bar_index > s3BearBreakBar and (bar_index - s3BearBreakBar <= maxRetestBars) and s3BearRetestZone and s3BearCloseValid

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Combined retest states
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
anyBullRetest = s1BullRetest or s2BullRetest or s3BullRetest
anyBearRetest = s1BearRetest or s2BearRetest or s3BearRetest
anyRetest     = anyBullRetest or anyBearRetest

paintNextBull = anyBullRetest[1]
paintNextBear = anyBearRetest[1]
paintNext     = paintNextBull or paintNextBear

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Visual markers
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plotshape(showRetestLabels and s1BullRetest, title="S1 Bull Retest", location=location.abovebar, style=shape.circle, size=size.tiny, color=s1Color, text="S1 RT")
plotshape(showRetestLabels and s1BearRetest, title="S1 Bear Retest", location=location.belowbar, style=shape.circle, size=size.tiny, color=s1Color, text="S1 RT")

plotshape(showRetestLabels and s2BullRetest, title="S2 Bull Retest", location=location.abovebar, style=shape.circle, size=size.tiny, color=s2Color, text="S2 RT")
plotshape(showRetestLabels and s2BearRetest, title="S2 Bear Retest", location=location.belowbar, style=shape.circle, size=size.tiny, color=s2Color, text="S2 RT")

plotshape(showRetestLabels and s3BullRetest, title="S3 Bull Retest", location=location.abovebar, style=shape.circle, size=size.tiny, color=s3Color, text="S3 RT")
plotshape(showRetestLabels and s3BearRetest, title="S3 Bear Retest", location=location.belowbar, style=shape.circle, size=size.tiny, color=s3Color, text="S3 RT")

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Candle coloring
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
candlePaint = anyRetest ? retestCandleColor : paintNext ? nextCandleColor : na

barcolor(candlePaint)
plotcandle(open, high, low, close, color=candlePaint, wickcolor=candlePaint, bordercolor=candlePaint)

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Alerts
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
alertcondition(s1BullRetest, title="Session 1 Bull Retest", message="Session 1 bullish retest")
alertcondition(s1BearRetest, title="Session 1 Bear Retest", message="Session 1 bearish retest")
alertcondition(s2BullRetest, title="Session 2 Bull Retest", message="Session 2 bullish retest")
alertcondition(s2BearRetest, title="Session 2 Bear Retest", message="Session 2 bearish retest")
alertcondition(s3BullRetest, title="Session 3 Bull Retest", message="Session 3 bullish retest")
alertcondition(s3BearRetest, title="Session 3 Bear Retest", message="Session 3 bearish retest")

alertcondition(paintNextBull, title="Bullish Next Candle After Retest", message="Immediate next candle after bullish retest")
alertcondition(paintNextBear, title="Bearish Next Candle After Retest", message="Immediate next candle after bearish retest")

items.name: ORBITAL ORB Indicator
items.title: ORBITAL30100 - ORB Indicator
items.author: brettcarlsonltd
items.source:
// (c) NovaIQ
// ORBITAL30100 - Opening Range Breakout Indicator v4.00
// ORB window: 8:30-9:30 AM New York time
// Shows ORB box, breakout levels, TP/SL/BE lines, signals, dashboard

//@version=6
indicator("ORBITAL30100 - ORB Indicator", shorttitle="ORBITAL30100", overlay=true,
     max_boxes_count=500, max_lines_count=500, max_labels_count=500)

// ===================================================================
// INPUTS
// ===================================================================
i_orbStart  = input.session("0830-0930",       "ORB Window",       group="Session")
i_timezone  = input.string("America/New_York",  "Timezone",         group="Session",
              options=["America/New_York","Europe/London","Asia/Tokyo","America/Chicago"])

i_useFilter = input.bool(true,   "Enable range filter",             group="Range Filter")
i_minRange  = input.float(50.0,  "Min range (pts)",                 group="Range Filter", minval=0)
i_maxRange  = input.float(400.0, "Max range (pts)",                 group="Range Filter", minval=0)

i_showBox   = input.bool(true,  "Show ORB box",                    group="Display")
i_showTP    = input.bool(true,  "Show take profit levels",          group="Display")
i_showBE    = input.bool(true,  "Show breakeven levels",            group="Display")
i_showMid   = input.bool(true,  "Show midpoint / SL line",          group="Display")
i_showSig   = input.bool(true,  "Show signal labels",               group="Display")
i_tablePos  = input.string("top_right", "Table position",           group="Display",
              options=["top_right","top_left","bottom_right","bottom_left"])

i_bullColor = input.color(color.new(#26a69a, 0),     "Bullish",      group="Colors")
i_bearColor = input.color(color.new(#ef5350, 0),     "Bearish",      group="Colors")
i_boxColor  = input.color(color.new(color.blue, 88), "Box fill",     group="Colors")
i_midColor  = input.color(color.new(color.gray, 40), "Midpoint/SL",  group="Colors")
i_tpColor   = input.color(color.orange,              "Take profit",  group="Colors")

// ===================================================================
// STATE
// ===================================================================
var float orbHigh    = na
var float orbLow     = na
var float orbMid     = na
var float orbRange   = na
var bool  orbFormed  = false
var bool  orbSkipped = false
var bool  bullBreak  = false
var bool  bearBreak  = false

// ===================================================================
// DAY RESET
// ===================================================================
newDay = timeframe.change("D")

if newDay
    orbHigh    := na
    orbLow     := na
    orbMid     := na
    orbRange   := na
    orbFormed  := false
    orbSkipped := false
    bullBreak  := false
    bearBreak  := false

// ===================================================================
// BUILD ORB
// ===================================================================
inSess = not na(time(timeframe.period, i_orbStart, i_timezone))

if inSess
    orbHigh := na(orbHigh) ? high : math.max(orbHigh, high)
    orbLow  := na(orbLow)  ? low  : math.min(orbLow,  low)

sessEnd = not inSess and inSess[1] and not orbFormed and not newDay

if sessEnd and not na(orbHigh) and not na(orbLow)
    rng = orbHigh - orbLow
    pts = rng / syminfo.mintick
    if i_useFilter and (pts < i_minRange or pts > i_maxRange)
        orbSkipped := true
    else
        orbRange  := rng
        orbMid    := orbLow + rng * 0.5
        orbFormed := true

// ===================================================================
// DRAW LEVELS
// ===================================================================
ext = bar_index + 60

if orbFormed and not orbFormed[1]
    if i_showBox
        box.new(bar_index, orbHigh, ext, orbLow,
            border_color=color.new(i_bullColor, 50),
            border_width=1, bgcolor=i_boxColor)

    line.new(bar_index, orbHigh, ext, orbHigh,
        color=i_bullColor, width=2, style=line.style_solid)
    line.new(bar_index, orbLow,  ext, orbLow,
        color=i_bearColor, width=2, style=line.style_solid)

    if i_showMid
        line.new(bar_index, orbMid, ext, orbMid,
            color=i_midColor, width=1, style=line.style_dashed)

    if i_showTP
        line.new(bar_index, orbHigh + orbRange, ext, orbHigh + orbRange,
            color=i_tpColor, width=1, style=line.style_dotted)
        line.new(bar_index, orbLow  - orbRange, ext, orbLow  - orbRange,
            color=i_tpColor, width=1, style=line.style_dotted)

    if i_showBE
        line.new(bar_index, orbHigh + orbRange * 0.5, ext, orbHigh + orbRange * 0.5,
            color=color.new(i_bullColor, 65), width=1, style=line.style_dotted)
        line.new(bar_index, orbLow  - orbRange * 0.5, ext, orbLow  - orbRange * 0.5,
            color=color.new(i_bearColor, 65), width=1, style=line.style_dotted)

// ===================================================================
// SIGNALS
// ===================================================================
bullSig = orbFormed and not orbSkipped and not bullBreak and close > orbHigh and close[1] <= orbHigh
bearSig = orbFormed and not orbSkipped and not bearBreak and close < orbLow  and close[1] >= orbLow

if bullSig
    bullBreak := true
    if i_showSig
        label.new(bar_index, low, "ORB BULL",
            style=label.style_label_up,
            color=i_bullColor, textcolor=color.white, size=size.small)

if bearSig
    bearBreak := true
    if i_showSig
        label.new(bar_index, high, "ORB BEAR",
            style=label.style_label_down,
            color=i_bearColor, textcolor=color.white, size=size.small)

if orbSkipped and not orbSkipped[1]
    label.new(bar_index, high, "SKIP - range filter",
        style=label.style_label_down,
        color=color.gray, textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)

// ===================================================================
// PLOTS
// ===================================================================
plotshape(bullSig, "Bull", shape.triangleup,   location.belowbar, i_bullColor, size=size.small)
plotshape(bearSig, "Bear", shape.triangledown, location.abovebar, i_bearColor, size=size.small)
bgcolor(inSess ? color.new(color.blue, 92) : na, title="ORB window")

// ===================================================================
// DASHBOARD
// ===================================================================
// Helper: format a float as string or dash if na - must be at top level
f(v, fmt) => na(v) ? "-" : str.tostring(v, fmt)

tPos = i_tablePos == "top_right"    ? position.top_right    :
       i_tablePos == "top_left"     ? position.top_left     :
       i_tablePos == "bottom_right" ? position.bottom_right :
       position.bottom_left

var table t = table.new(tPos, 2, 9,
    border_color=chart.fg_color, border_width=1,
    frame_color=chart.fg_color, frame_width=1)

if barstate.islast
    C0 = color.new(chart.bg_color, 0)
    C1 = color.new(chart.bg_color, 15)
    FG = chart.fg_color
    GR = color.gray

    table.cell(t, 0, 0, "ORBITAL30100  v4.00",
        text_color=FG, bgcolor=C0,
        text_size=size.small, text_halign=text.align_center)
    table.merge_cells(t, 0, 0, 1, 0)

    table.cell(t, 0, 1, "ORB High",    text_color=GR, bgcolor=C1, text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(t, 1, 1, f(orbHigh, format.mintick),
        text_color=i_bullColor, bgcolor=C1, text_size=size.tiny)

    table.cell(t, 0, 2, "ORB Low",     text_color=GR, bgcolor=C1, text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(t, 1, 2, f(orbLow, format.mintick),
        text_color=i_bearColor, bgcolor=C1, text_size=size.tiny)

    table.cell(t, 0, 3, "Range pts",   text_color=GR, bgcolor=C1, text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(t, 1, 3, na(orbRange) ? "-" : str.tostring(math.round(orbRange / syminfo.mintick)),
        text_color=FG, bgcolor=C1, text_size=size.tiny)

    table.cell(t, 0, 4, "Mid / SL",    text_color=GR, bgcolor=C1, text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(t, 1, 4, f(orbMid, format.mintick),
        text_color=i_midColor, bgcolor=C1, text_size=size.tiny)

    table.cell(t, 0, 5, "Bull TP",     text_color=GR, bgcolor=C1, text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(t, 1, 5, na(orbHigh) ? "-" : str.tostring(orbHigh + orbRange, format.mintick),
        text_color=i_tpColor, bgcolor=C1, text_size=size.tiny)

    table.cell(t, 0, 6, "Bear TP",     text_color=GR, bgcolor=C1, text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(t, 1, 6, na(orbLow) ? "-" : str.tostring(orbLow - orbRange, format.mintick),
        text_color=i_tpColor, bgcolor=C1, text_size=size.tiny)

    sStr = orbSkipped        ? "SKIPPED"    :
           not orbFormed and inSess ? "BUILDING"   :
           not orbFormed     ? "WAITING"    :
           bullBreak         ? "BULL BREAK" :
           bearBreak         ? "BEAR BREAK" : "WATCHING"

    sClr = orbSkipped   ? GR          :
           bullBreak    ? i_bullColor  :
           bearBreak    ? i_bearColor  :
           orbFormed    ? color.orange : GR

    table.cell(t, 0, 7, "Status",      text_color=GR,   bgcolor=C1, text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(t, 1, 7, sStr,          text_color=sClr, bgcolor=C1, text_size=size.tiny)

    table.cell(t, 0, 8, "(c) NovaIQ",
        text_color=color.new(GR, 50), bgcolor=C0,
        text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_center)
    table.merge_cells(t, 0, 8, 1, 8)
