items.author: lathaml3819
items.source:
//@version=5
indicator("ORB Indicator", overlay=true, max_boxes_count=200, max_labels_count=200, max_lines_count=200)

//====================================================
// Inputs
//====================================================
groupSetup = "Setup Logic"
sweepLen        = input.int(10, "Liquidity Sweep Lookback", minval=2, group=groupSetup)
bosLen          = input.int(10, "BOS Lookback", minval=2, group=groupSetup)
fvgMaxWaitBars  = input.int(5, "Max Bars After Sweep To Create FVG", minval=1, group=groupSetup)
bosMaxWaitBars  = input.int(10, "Max Bars After FVG For BOS", minval=1, group=groupSetup)
bigCandleATR    = input.float(1.0, "Big Candle Size ATR Multiplier", step=0.1, group=groupSetup)
atrLen          = input.int(14, "ATR Length", minval=1, group=groupSetup)

groupTrade = "Entry / Stop Display"
entryLevelMode  = input.string("Top of FVG", "Entry Level", options=["Top of FVG", "Middle of FVG", "Bottom of FVG"], group=groupTrade)
stopBufferTicks = input.int(2, "Stop Buffer Ticks Outside FVG", minval=0, group=groupTrade)
extendBars      = input.int(30, "Extend Entry/SL Lines", minval=1, maxval=300, group=groupTrade)

groupVisual = "Visuals"
showFVGBox      = input.bool(true, "Show FVG Box", group=groupVisual)
showEntrySL     = input.bool(true, "Show Entry and SL Lines", group=groupVisual)
showLabels      = input.bool(true, "Show Setup Labels", group=groupVisual)
bullFvgColor    = input.color(color.new(color.lime, 82), "Bullish FVG Color", group=groupVisual)
bearFvgColor    = input.color(color.new(color.red, 82), "Bearish FVG Color", group=groupVisual)
entryColor      = input.color(color.new(color.yellow, 0), "Entry Line Color", group=groupVisual)
stopColor       = input.color(color.new(color.red, 0), "Stop Line Color", group=groupVisual)
bosColor        = input.color(color.new(color.aqua, 0), "BOS Label Color", group=groupVisual)

//====================================================
// Base Calculations
//====================================================
atr = ta.atr(atrLen)
tick = syminfo.mintick
stopBuffer = stopBufferTicks * tick

bigBullCandle = close > open and (high - low) >= atr * bigCandleATR
bigBearCandle = close < open and (high - low) >= atr * bigCandleATR

//====================================================
// Liquidity Sweep
// Bullish sweep: takes prior lows, closes back above.
// Bearish sweep: takes prior highs, closes back below.
//====================================================
priorLow  = ta.lowest(low[1], sweepLen)
priorHigh = ta.highest(high[1], sweepLen)

bullSweep = low < priorLow and close > priorLow
bearSweep = high > priorHigh and close < priorHigh

//====================================================
// FVG Detection
// Bullish FVG: low > high[2]
// Bearish FVG: high < low[2]
//====================================================
bullFVG = low > high[2]
bearFVG = high < low[2]

bullFvgTop = low
bullFvgBot = high[2]

bearFvgTop = low[2]
bearFvgBot = high

//====================================================
// BOS Detection
// Bullish BOS: big candle closes above prior high.
// Bearish BOS: big candle closes below prior low.
//====================================================
bosHigh = ta.highest(high[1], bosLen)
bosLow  = ta.lowest(low[1], bosLen)

bullBOS = bigBullCandle and close > bosHigh
bearBOS = bigBearCandle and close < bosLow

//====================================================
// State Machine For Bullish Setup
// 1. Liquidity sweep
// 2. Creates FVG
// 3. FVG remains untested before BOS
// 4. Big BOS candle
//====================================================
var int bullState = 0
var int bullSweepBar = na
var int bullFvgBar = na
var float bullZoneTop = na
var float bullZoneBot = na
var bool bullFvgTested = false

if bullSweep
    bullState := 1
    bullSweepBar := bar_index
    bullFvgBar := na
    bullZoneTop := na
    bullZoneBot := na
    bullFvgTested := false

if bullState == 1
    if bar_index - bullSweepBar > fvgMaxWaitBars
        bullState := 0
    else if bullFVG
        bullState := 2
        bullFvgBar := bar_index
        bullZoneTop := bullFvgTop
        bullZoneBot := bullFvgBot
        bullFvgTested := false

if bullState == 2
    if bar_index > bullFvgBar and low <= bullZoneTop
        bullFvgTested := true

    if bar_index - bullFvgBar > bosMaxWaitBars
        bullState := 0

// Bullish valid setup requires:
// - FVG created after sweep
// - price did NOT retrace into the FVG before BOS
// - big bullish BOS candle
bullSetup = bullState == 2 and not bullFvgTested and bullBOS

//====================================================
// State Machine For Bearish Setup
//====================================================
var int bearState = 0
var int bearSweepBar = na
var int bearFvgBar = na
var float bearZoneTop = na
var float bearZoneBot = na
var bool bearFvgTested = false

if bearSweep
    bearState := 1
    bearSweepBar := bar_index
    bearFvgBar := na
    bearZoneTop := na
    bearZoneBot := na
    bearFvgTested := false

if bearState == 1
    if bar_index - bearSweepBar > fvgMaxWaitBars
        bearState := 0
    else if bearFVG
        bearState := 2
        bearFvgBar := bar_index
        bearZoneTop := bearFvgTop
        bearZoneBot := bearFvgBot
        bearFvgTested := false

if bearState == 2
    if bar_index > bearFvgBar and high >= bearZoneBot
        bearFvgTested := true

    if bar_index - bearFvgBar > bosMaxWaitBars
        bearState := 0

bearSetup = bearState == 2 and not bearFvgTested and bearBOS

//====================================================
// Entry / Stop Level Helpers
//====================================================
f_entryPrice(_top, _bot, _isBull) =>
    entryLevelMode == "Middle of FVG" ? (_top + _bot) / 2.0 :
     entryLevelMode == "Bottom of FVG" ? _bot :
     _top

bullEntry = f_entryPrice(bullZoneTop, bullZoneBot, true)
bullStop  = bullZoneBot - stopBuffer

bearEntry = f_entryPrice(bearZoneTop, bearZoneBot, false)
bearStop  = bearZoneTop + stopBuffer

//====================================================
// Draw Bullish Setup
//====================================================
if bullSetup
    if showFVGBox
        box.new(
             left=bullFvgBar - 2,
             top=bullZoneTop,
             right=bar_index + extendBars,
             bottom=bullZoneBot,
             xloc=xloc.bar_index,
             bgcolor=bullFvgColor,
             border_color=color.new(color.lime, 10))

    if showEntrySL
        line.new(
             x1=bar_index,
             y1=bullEntry,
             x2=bar_index + extendBars,
             y2=bullEntry,
             xloc=xloc.bar_index,
             extend=extend.none,
             color=entryColor,
             width=2)

        line.new(
             x1=bar_index,
             y1=bullStop,
             x2=bar_index + extendBars,
             y2=bullStop,
             xloc=xloc.bar_index,
             extend=extend.none,
             color=stopColor,
             width=2)

    if showLabels
        label.new(
             bar_index,
             low,
             "BUY OB\nSweep + FVG + Untested + BOS\nEntry: FVG\nSL: Below FVG",
             style=label.style_label_up,
             color=color.new(color.lime, 0),
             textcolor=color.white,
             size=size.small)

        label.new(
             bar_index,
             high,
             "BOS",
             style=label.style_label_down,
             color=bosColor,
             textcolor=color.white,
             size=size.tiny)

    bullState := 0

//====================================================
// Draw Bearish Setup
//====================================================
if bearSetup
    if showFVGBox
        box.new(
             left=bearFvgBar - 2,
             top=bearZoneTop,
             right=bar_index + extendBars,
             bottom=bearZoneBot,
             xloc=xloc.bar_index,
             bgcolor=bearFvgColor,
             border_color=color.new(color.red, 10))

    if showEntrySL
        line.new(
             x1=bar_index,
             y1=bearEntry,
             x2=bar_index + extendBars,
             y2=bearEntry,
             xloc=xloc.bar_index,
             extend=extend.none,
             color=entryColor,
             width=2)

        line.new(
             x1=bar_index,
             y1=bearStop,
             x2=bar_index + extendBars,
             y2=bearStop,
             xloc=xloc.bar_index,
             extend=extend.none,
             color=stopColor,
             width=2)

    if showLabels
        label.new(
             bar_index,
             high,
             "SELL OB\nSweep + FVG + Untested + BOS\nEntry: FVG\nSL: Above FVG",
             style=label.style_label_down,
             color=color.new(color.red, 0),
             textcolor=color.white,
             size=size.small)

        label.new(
             bar_index,
             low,
             "BOS",
             style=label.style_label_up,
             color=bosColor,
             textcolor=color.white,
             size=size.tiny)

    bearState := 0

//====================================================
// Alerts
//====================================================
alertcondition(bullSetup, "Bullish OB Setup", "Bullish OB setup: Sweep + FVG + Untested + BOS")
alertcondition(bearSetup, "Bearish OB Setup", "Bearish OB setup: Sweep + FVG + Untested + BOS")

items.source:
//@version=5
indicator("US30 ORB Indicator v2", overlay=true)

// ─── Inputs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
tz          = input.string("America/Los_Angeles", "Time Zone")
orbSession  = input.session("0630-0645", "Opening Range Session")
emaLen      = input.int(200,  "EMA Length")
bbLen       = input.int(20,   "BB Length")
bbMult      = input.float(2.0,"BB Std Dev")
atrLen      = input.int(14,   "ATR Length")
minAtrMult  = input.float(0.5,"Min Breakout ATR Mult",  tooltip="Bar must close X ATRs above/below ORB line")
volMult     = input.float(1.2,"Min Volume Multiplier",   tooltip="Bar volume must exceed X × 20-bar avg volume")
rsiLen      = input.int(14,   "RSI Length")
rsiOB       = input.int(70,   "RSI Overbought (blocks buys)")
rsiOS       = input.int(30,   "RSI Oversold (blocks sells)")
maxSignals  = input.int(2,    "Max Signals Per Day",     tooltip="Stop signaling after N trades per session")
useClose    = input.bool(true, "Require 2 Closes Beyond ORB", tooltip="Waits for confirmation bar")

// ─── Core Indicators ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
ema200   = ta.ema(close, emaLen)
vwapVal  = ta.vwap(hlc3)
bbBasis  = ta.sma(close, bbLen)
bbDev    = bbMult * ta.stdev(close, bbLen)
bbUpper  = bbBasis + bbDev
bbLower  = bbBasis - bbDev
atrVal   = ta.atr(atrLen)
rsiVal   = ta.rsi(close, rsiLen)
volAvg   = ta.sma(volume, 20)

plot(ema200,  color=color.orange,              linewidth=2)
plot(vwapVal, color=color.purple,              linewidth=2)
plot(bbUpper, color=color.new(color.blue, 70))
plot(bbLower, color=color.new(color.blue, 70))

// ─── Opening Range ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
inORB  = not na(time(timeframe.period, orbSession, tz))
newDay = dayofmonth(time, tz) != dayofmonth(time[1], tz)

var float orbHigh    = na
var float orbLow     = na
var bool  orbReady   = false
var int   sigCount   = 0

if newDay
    orbHigh  := na
    orbLow   := na
    orbReady := false
    sigCount := 0

if inORB
    orbHigh := na(orbHigh) ? high : math.max(orbHigh, high)
    orbLow  := na(orbLow)  ? low  : math.min(orbLow,  low)

if not inORB and inORB[1]
    orbReady := true

// ─── Breakout Filters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
// 1. Confirmed close(s) beyond ORB
aboveORB = close > orbHigh
belowORB = close < orbLow
confirmed_up   = useClose ? (aboveORB and aboveORB[1]) : aboveORB
confirmed_down = useClose ? (belowORB and belowORB[1]) : belowORB

// 2. Sufficient ATR-based breakout magnitude
atrBreakoutUp   = (close - orbHigh) >= (minAtrMult * atrVal)
atrBreakoutDown = (orbLow  - close) >= (minAtrMult * atrVal)

// 3. Volume confirmation
volOK = volume >= (volMult * volAvg)

// 4. Bollinger Band position (buy only when above midline, sell when below)
bbBuyOK  = close > bbBasis
bbSellOK = close < bbBasis

// 5. RSI not extended in wrong direction
rsiBuyOK  = rsiVal < rsiOB
rsiSellOK = rsiVal > rsiOS

// 6. Trend alignment (EMA + VWAP)
trendUp   = close > ema200 and close > vwapVal
trendDown = close < ema200 and close < vwapVal

// 7. No re-entry in same direction after first signal
var bool hadBuy  = false
var bool hadSell = false
if newDay
    hadBuy  := false
    hadSell := false

// ─── Signal Logic ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
buySignal  = orbReady
           and confirmed_up
           and atrBreakoutUp
           and volOK
           and trendUp
           and bbBuyOK
           and rsiBuyOK
           and not hadBuy
           and sigCount < maxSignals

sellSignal = orbReady
           and confirmed_down
           and atrBreakoutDown
           and volOK
           and trendDown
           and bbSellOK
           and rsiSellOK
           and not hadSell
           and sigCount < maxSignals

if buySignal
    hadBuy  := true
    sigCount := sigCount + 1

if sellSignal
    hadSell  := true
    sigCount := sigCount + 1

// ─── Plot ORB Levels ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
plot(orbHigh, color=color.green, style=plot.style_linebr, linewidth=2)
plot(orbLow,  color=color.red,   style=plot.style_linebr, linewidth=2)

// ─── Signal Labels ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plotshape(buySignal,  title="BUY",  text="BUY",  style=shape.labelup,   location=location.belowbar, color=color.green, textcolor=color.white)
plotshape(sellSignal, title="SELL", text="SELL", style=shape.labeldown, location=location.abovebar, color=color.red,   textcolor=color.white)

// ─── Alerts ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
alertcondition(buySignal,  title="BUY ALERT",  message="US30 ORB BUY — Price confirmed above ORB high")
alertcondition(sellSignal, title="SELL ALERT", message="US30 ORB SELL — Price confirmed below ORB low")

//@version=5
indicator("Orange 30M ORB Indicator", overlay=true, max_boxes_count=500, max_lines_count=500, max_labels_count=500)

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// General Inputs
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
grpGeneral = "General"
showBoxes         = input.bool(true, "Show opening range boxes", group=grpGeneral)
showMidline       = input.bool(true, "Show midline", group=grpGeneral)
showLabels        = input.bool(true, "Show session labels", group=grpGeneral)
showRetestLabels  = input.bool(true, "Show retest labels", group=grpGeneral)
historicalSession = input.bool(true, "Keep historical session drawings", group=grpGeneral)
breakoutByClose   = input.bool(true, "Breakout uses candle close", group=grpGeneral)

nyTZ = "America/New_York"

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Retest Inputs
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
grpRetest = "Retest Settings"
retestChartTF      = input.string("15", "Retest chart timeframe", options=["1", "5", "15"], group=grpRetest)
restrictRetestTF   = input.bool(true, "Restrict retest to selected chart timeframe", group=grpRetest)
maxRetestBars      = input.int(500, "Maximum bars from breakout to retest", minval=1, group=grpRetest)
wickIntoRangeMax   = input.float(10.0, "Max wick penetration into range points", minval=0.0, step=0.25, group=grpRetest)
closeIntoRangeMax  = input.float(5.0, "Max close penetration into range points", minval=0.0, step=0.25, group=grpRetest)

retestMode         = input.string("Touch or Within Distance", "Retest Qualification Mode", options=["Touch Only", "Touch or Within Distance"], group=grpRetest)
retestDistance     = input.float(5.0, "Retest distance from breakout level points", minval=0.0, step=0.25, group=grpRetest)

retestCandleColor  = input.color(color.purple, "Retest Candle Color", group=grpRetest)
nextCandleColor    = input.color(color.orange, "Next Candle After Retest Color", group=grpRetest)

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Session Inputs
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
grp1 = "Session 1"
s1Enabled = input.bool(true, "Enable Session 1", group=grp1)
s1Name    = input.string("New York", "Session Label", group=grp1)
s1Session = input.session("0930-1600", "Session Time NY Local", group=grp1)
s1ORMin   = input.int(30, "Opening Range Minutes", minval=1, group=grp1)
s1Color   = input.color(color.blue, "Session Color", group=grp1)

grp2 = "Session 2"
s2Enabled = input.bool(false, "Enable Session 2", group=grp2)
s2Name    = input.string("London", "Session Label", group=grp2)
s2Session = input.session("0300-1100", "Session Time NY Local", group=grp2)
s2ORMin   = input.int(30, "Opening Range Minutes", minval=1, group=grp2)
s2Color   = input.color(color.orange, "Session Color", group=grp2)

grp3 = "Session 3"
s3Enabled = input.bool(false, "Enable Session 3", group=grp3)
s3Name    = input.string("Asia", "Session Label", group=grp3)
s3Session = input.session("2000-0300", "Session Time NY Local", group=grp3)
s3ORMin   = input.int(30, "Opening Range Minutes", minval=1, group=grp3)
s3Color   = input.color(color.purple, "Session Color", group=grp3)

bg1 = color.new(s1Color, 88)
bg2 = color.new(s2Color, 88)
bg3 = color.new(s3Color, 88)

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Helpers
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
selectedTFMinutes = str.tonumber(retestChartTF)
isAllowedRetestTF = timeframe.isintraday and timeframe.multiplier == selectedTFMinutes
allowRetestNow    = restrictRetestTF ? isAllowedRetestTF : true
useDistanceMode   = retestMode == "Touch or Within Distance"

extendBoxToCurrentBar(_box) =>
    if not na(_box)
        box.set_right(_box, time_close)

bullCloseOk(level) =>
    close >= level - closeIntoRangeMax

bearCloseOk(level) =>
    close <= level + closeIntoRangeMax

bullRetestZoneOk(level) =>
    useDistanceMode ? low >= level - wickIntoRangeMax and low <= level + retestDistance : low >= level - wickIntoRangeMax and low <= level

bearRetestZoneOk(level) =>
    useDistanceMode ? high <= level + wickIntoRangeMax and high >= level - retestDistance : high <= level + wickIntoRangeMax and high >= level

clearObjects(_box, _midLine, _label) =>
    if not historicalSession
        if not na(_box)
            box.delete(_box)
        if not na(_midLine)
            line.delete(_midLine)
        if not na(_label)
            label.delete(_label)

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Session Detection
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
inS1 = s1Enabled and not na(time(timeframe.period, s1Session, nyTZ))
inS2 = s2Enabled and not na(time(timeframe.period, s2Session, nyTZ))
inS3 = s3Enabled and not na(time(timeframe.period, s3Session, nyTZ))

newS1 = inS1 and not inS1[1]
newS2 = inS2 and not inS2[1]
newS3 = inS3 and not inS3[1]

// This is the master reset point.
// When the new 9:30 AM New York ORB session begins, old ranges stop being valid.
ny930Start = not na(time(timeframe.period, "0930-0931", nyTZ))
newNY930   = ny930Start and not ny930Start[1]

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Session 1 State
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
var float s1High = na
var float s1Low = na
var float s1Mid = na
var int   s1StartTime = na
var bool  s1Finalized = false
var bool  s1BullBroken = false
var bool  s1BearBroken = false
var int   s1BullBreakBar = na
var int   s1BearBreakBar = na
var bool  s1ActiveRetestRange = false
var box   s1Box = na
var line  s1MidLine = na
var label s1Label = na

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Session 2 State
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
var float s2High = na
var float s2Low = na
var float s2Mid = na
var int   s2StartTime = na
var bool  s2Finalized = false
var bool  s2BullBroken = false
var bool  s2BearBroken = false
var int   s2BullBreakBar = na
var int   s2BearBreakBar = na
var bool  s2ActiveRetestRange = false
var box   s2Box = na
var line  s2MidLine = na
var label s2Label = na

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Session 3 State
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
var float s3High = na
var float s3Low = na
var float s3Mid = na
var int   s3StartTime = na
var bool  s3Finalized = false
var bool  s3BullBroken = false
var bool  s3BearBroken = false
var int   s3BullBreakBar = na
var int   s3BearBreakBar = na
var bool  s3ActiveRetestRange = false
var box   s3Box = na
var line  s3MidLine = na
var label s3Label = na

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Reset old active retest ranges at the new 9:30 AM ORB session
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if newNY930
    s1ActiveRetestRange := false
    s2ActiveRetestRange := false
    s3ActiveRetestRange := false
    s1BullBroken := false
    s1BearBroken := false
    s2BullBroken := false
    s2BearBroken := false
    s3BullBroken := false
    s3BearBroken := false
    s1BullBreakBar := na
    s1BearBreakBar := na
    s2BullBreakBar := na

    s3BearBreakBar := na

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SESSION 1
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if newS1
    clearObjects(s1Box, s1MidLine, s1Label)
    s1High := high
    s1Low := low
    s1Mid := (s1High + s1Low) / 2.0
    s1StartTime := time
    s1Finalized := false
    s1BullBroken := false
    s1BearBroken := false
    s1BullBreakBar := na
    s1BearBreakBar := na
    s1ActiveRetestRange := false

    if showBoxes
        s1Box := box.new(left=time, top=high, right=time_close, bottom=low, xloc=xloc.bar_time, bgcolor=bg1, border_color=s1Color)
    if showMidline

    if showLabels
        s1Label := label.new(x=time, y=high, text=s1Name, xloc=xloc.bar_time, style=label.style_label_down, textcolor=color.white, color=s1Color)

s1OREnd = na(s1StartTime) ? na : s1StartTime + s1ORMin * 60 * 1000

if inS1 and not na(s1StartTime)
    if not s1Finalized
        if time < s1OREnd
            s1High := math.max(s1High, high)
            s1Low := math.min(s1Low, low)
            s1Mid := (s1High + s1Low) / 2.0

            if showBoxes and not na(s1Box)

                line.set_y2(s1MidLine, s1Mid)
                line.set_x2(s1MidLine, time_close)

            if showLabels and not na(s1Label)
                label.set_x(s1Label, time)
                label.set_y(s1Label, s1High)
        else
            s1Finalized := true
            s1ActiveRetestRange := true

if s1Finalized and s1ActiveRetestRange
    if showBoxes
        extendBoxToCurrentBar(s1Box)
    if showMidline and not na(s1MidLine)
        line.set_x2(s1MidLine, time_close)

s1BreakUpSrc = breakoutByClose ? close > s1High : high > s1High
s1BreakDnSrc = breakoutByClose ? close < s1Low : low < s1Low

s1BullBreak = s1ActiveRetestRange and s1Finalized and not s1BullBroken and s1BreakUpSrc
s1BearBreak = s1ActiveRetestRange and s1Finalized and not s1BearBroken and s1BreakDnSrc

s1BullCloseValid = bullCloseOk(s1High)
s1BearRetestZone = bearRetestZoneOk(s1Low)
s1BearCloseValid = bearCloseOk(s1Low)

s1BullRetest = s1ActiveRetestRange and allowRetestNow and s1BullBroken and not na(s1BullBreakBar) and bar_index > s1BullBreakBar and bar_index - s1BullBreakBar <= maxRetestBars and s1BullRetestZone and s1BullCloseValid

    if showLabels
        s2Label := label.new(x=time, y=high, text=s2Name, xloc=xloc.bar_time, style=label.style_label_down, textcolor=color.white, color=s2Color)

s2OREnd = na(s2StartTime) ? na : s2StartTime + s2ORMin * 60 * 1000

if inS2 and not na(s2StartTime)
    if not s2Finalized
        if time < s2OREnd
            s2High := math.max(s2High, high)
            s2Low := math.min(s2Low, low)
            s2Mid := (s2High + s2Low) / 2.0

            if showBoxes and not na(s2Box)
                box.set_top(s2Box, s2High)
                box.set_bottom(s2Box, s2Low)
                box.set_right(s2Box, time_close)

            if showMidline and not na(s2MidLine)
                line.set_y1(s2MidLine, s2Mid)
                line.set_y2(s2MidLine, s2Mid)
                line.set_x2(s2MidLine, time_close)

        else

if s2Finalized and s2ActiveRetestRange
    if showBoxes
        extendBoxToCurrentBar(s2Box)
    if showMidline and not na(s2MidLine)
        line.set_x2(s2MidLine, time_close)

s2BreakUpSrc = breakoutByClose ? close > s2High : high > s2High
s2BreakDnSrc = breakoutByClose ? close < s2Low : low < s2Low

s2BullBreak = s2ActiveRetestRange and s2Finalized and not s2BullBroken and s2BreakUpSrc
s2BearBreak = s2ActiveRetestRange and s2Finalized and not s2BearBroken and s2BreakDnSrc

if s2BullBreak
    s2BullBroken := true
    s2BullBreakBar := bar_index

if s2BearBreak
    s2BearBroken := true
    s2BearBreakBar := bar_index

s2BullRetestZone = bullRetestZoneOk(s2High)
s2BullCloseValid = bullCloseOk(s2High)
s2BearRetestZone = bearRetestZoneOk(s2Low)
s2BearCloseValid = bearCloseOk(s2Low)

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if newS3
    clearObjects(s3Box, s3MidLine, s3Label)
    s3High := high
    s3Low := low
    s3Mid := (s3High + s3Low) / 2.0
    s3StartTime := time
    s3Finalized := false
    s3BullBroken := false
    s3BearBroken := false

    s3BearBreakBar := na

    if showBoxes
        s3Box := box.new(left=time, top=high, right=time_close, bottom=low, xloc=xloc.bar_time, bgcolor=bg3, border_color=s3Color)
    if showMidline
        s3MidLine := line.new(x1=time, y1=s3Mid, x2=time_close, y2=s3Mid, xloc=xloc.bar_time, extend=extend.none, color=s3Color, style=line.style_dashed)
    if showLabels
        s3Label := label.new(x=time, y=high, text=s3Name, xloc=xloc.bar_time, style=label.style_label_down, textcolor=color.white, color=s3Color)

s3OREnd = na(s3StartTime) ? na : s3StartTime + s3ORMin * 60 * 1000

if inS3 and not na(s3StartTime)
    if not s3Finalized
        if time < s3OREnd
            s3High := math.max(s3High, high)
            s3Low := math.min(s3Low, low)
            s3Mid := (s3High + s3Low) / 2.0

            if showBoxes and not na(s3Box)
                box.set_top(s3Box, s3High)
                box.set_bottom(s3Box, s3Low)
                box.set_right(s3Box, time_close)

            if showMidline and not na(s3MidLine)

                line.set_y2(s3MidLine, s3Mid)

            if showLabels and not na(s3Label)

        else
            s3Finalized := true
            s3ActiveRetestRange := true

if s3Finalized and s3ActiveRetestRange
    if showBoxes
        extendBoxToCurrentBar(s3Box)
    if showMidline and not na(s3MidLine)
        line.set_x2(s3MidLine, time_close)

s3BreakUpSrc = breakoutByClose ? close > s3High : high > s3High
s3BreakDnSrc = breakoutByClose ? close < s3Low : low < s3Low

s3BullBreak = s3ActiveRetestRange and s3Finalized and not s3BullBroken and s3BreakUpSrc
s3BearBreak = s3ActiveRetestRange and s3Finalized and not s3BearBroken and s3BreakDnSrc

if s3BullBreak
    s3BullBroken := true
    s3BullBreakBar := bar_index

if s3BearBreak
    s3BearBroken := true
    s3BearBreakBar := bar_index

s3BullRetestZone = bullRetestZoneOk(s3High)
s3BullCloseValid = bullCloseOk(s3High)
s3BearRetestZone = bearRetestZoneOk(s3Low)
s3BearCloseValid = bearCloseOk(s3Low)

s3BullRetest = s3ActiveRetestRange and allowRetestNow and s3BullBroken and not na(s3BullBreakBar) and bar_index > s3BullBreakBar and bar_index - s3BullBreakBar <= maxRetestBars and s3BullRetestZone and s3BullCloseValid
s3BearRetest = s3ActiveRetestRange and allowRetestNow and s3BearBroken and not na(s3BearBreakBar) and bar_index > s3BearBreakBar and bar_index - s3BearBreakBar <= maxRetestBars and s3BearRetestZone and s3BearCloseValid

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Combined Retest States
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
anyBullRetest = s1BullRetest or s2BullRetest or s3BullRetest
anyBearRetest = s1BearRetest or s2BearRetest or s3BearRetest
anyRetest     = anyBullRetest or anyBearRetest

paintNextBull = anyBullRetest[1]
paintNextBear = anyBearRetest[1]
paintNext     = paintNextBull or paintNextBear

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Visual Markers
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plotshape(showRetestLabels and s1BullRetest, title="S1 Bull Retest", location=location.abovebar, style=shape.circle, size=size.tiny, color=s1Color, text="S1 RT")
plotshape(showRetestLabels and s1BearRetest, title="S1 Bear Retest", location=location.belowbar, style=shape.circle, size=size.tiny, color=s1Color, text="S1 RT")

plotshape(showRetestLabels and s2BullRetest, title="S2 Bull Retest", location=location.abovebar, style=shape.circle, size=size.tiny, color=s2Color, text="S2 RT")
plotshape(showRetestLabels and s2BearRetest, title="S2 Bear Retest", location=location.belowbar, style=shape.circle, size=size.tiny, color=s2Color, text="S2 RT")

plotshape(showRetestLabels and s3BullRetest, title="S3 Bull Retest", location=location.abovebar, style=shape.circle, size=size.tiny, color=s3Color, text="S3 RT")
plotshape(showRetestLabels and s3BearRetest, title="S3 Bear Retest", location=location.belowbar, style=shape.circle, size=size.tiny, color=s3Color, text="S3 RT")

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Candle Coloring
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
candlePaint = anyRetest ? retestCandleColor : paintNext ? nextCandleColor : na

barcolor(candlePaint)
plotcandle(open, high, low, close, title="Retest Candle Overlay", color=candlePaint, wickcolor=candlePaint, bordercolor=candlePaint)

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Alerts
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
alertcondition(s1BullRetest, title="Session 1 Bull Retest", message="Session 1 bullish retest")
alertcondition(s1BearRetest, title="Session 1 Bear Retest", message="Session 1 bearish retest")

alertcondition(s3BearRetest, title="Session 3 Bear Retest", message="Session 3 bearish retest")

alertcondition(paintNextBull, title="Bullish Next Candle After Retest", message="Immediate next candle after bullish retest")

items.source:
//@version=5
indicator("MNQ ORB Fib TRIM Indicator", overlay=true)

// =====================================================
// SETTINGS
// =====================================================
fib50Level  = 0.5
fib618Level = 0.618

marketOpenHour   = 6
marketOpenMinute = 30

cutoffHour   = 10
cutoffMinute = 0

// =====================================================
// STATE
// =====================================================
var float rangeHigh = na
var float rangeLow  = na
var float sessionOpen = na

var bool rangeLocked = false
var int barCount = 0

var bool bullishBias = false
var bool bearishBias = false

var bool longTrigger = false
var bool shortTrigger = false

var int signalsToday = 0

// =====================================================
// RESET
// =====================================================
newDay = ta.change(time("D"))

if newDay
    rangeHigh := na
    rangeLow := na
    sessionOpen := na

    rangeLocked := false
    barCount := 0

    bullishBias := false
    bearishBias := false

    longTrigger := false
    shortTrigger := false

    signalsToday := 0

// =====================================================
// SESSION START
// =====================================================
sessionStart =
     hour(time, "America/Los_Angeles") == marketOpenHour and
     minute(time, "America/Los_Angeles") == marketOpenMinute

if sessionStart
    sessionOpen := open

// =====================================================
// OPENING RANGE
// =====================================================
if sessionStart
    barCount := 1
    rangeHigh := high
    rangeLow := low
    rangeLocked := false

else if barCount > 0 and barCount < 8
    barCount += 1

    rangeHigh := math.max(rangeHigh, high)
    rangeLow := math.min(rangeLow, low)

if barCount == 8
    rangeLocked := true

rangeReady =
     rangeLocked and
     not na(rangeHigh) and
     not na(rangeLow)

// =====================================================
// LOCKED DAILY BIAS
// =====================================================
rangeMid = (rangeHigh + rangeLow) / 2

if rangeReady and not bullishBias and not bearishBias

    bullishBias := close >= rangeMid
    bearishBias := not bullishBias

// =====================================================
// FIB LEVELS
// =====================================================
rangeSize =
     math.max(
         rangeHigh - rangeLow,
         syminfo.mintick)

bullFib50 =
     rangeHigh - (rangeSize * fib50Level)

bullFib618 =
     rangeHigh - (rangeSize * fib618Level)

bearFib50 =
     rangeLow + (rangeSize * fib50Level)

bearFib618 =
     rangeLow + (rangeSize * fib618Level)

fib50 =
     bullishBias ? bullFib50 : bearFib50

fib618 =
     bullishBias ? bullFib618 : bearFib618

// =====================================================
// TIME FILTER
// =====================================================
validTradingTime =
     (hour(time, "America/Los_Angeles") < cutoffHour) or
     (
         hour(time, "America/Los_Angeles") == cutoffHour and
         minute(time, "America/Los_Angeles") <= cutoffMinute
     )

// =====================================================
// LONG SETUP
// =====================================================
if rangeReady and bullishBias and signalsToday < 1

    if close < fib618
        longTrigger := true

longSignal =
     longTrigger and
     close > fib50 and
     validTradingTime

if longSignal
    longTrigger := false
    signalsToday += 1

// =====================================================
// SHORT SETUP
// =====================================================
if rangeReady and bearishBias and signalsToday < 1

    if close > fib618
        shortTrigger := true

shortSignal =
     shortTrigger and
     close < fib50 and
     validTradingTime

if shortSignal
    shortTrigger := false
    signalsToday += 1

// =====================================================
// VISUALS
// =====================================================
plot(
     rangeLocked ? rangeHigh : na,
     color=color.green,
     linewidth=2,
     title="Range High")

plot(
     rangeLocked ? rangeLow : na,
     color=color.red,
     linewidth=2,
     title="Range Low")

plot(
     rangeLocked ? fib50 : na,
     color=color.yellow,
     linewidth=2,
     title="Fib 50")

plot(
     rangeLocked ? fib618 : na,
     color=color.orange,
     linewidth=2,
     title="Fib 618")

plot(
     sessionOpen,
     color=color.white,
     linewidth=2,
     title="Session Open")

// =====================================================
// BIAS BACKGROUND
// =====================================================
bgcolor(
     bullishBias ? color.new(color.green, 92) :
     bearishBias ? color.new(color.red, 92) :
     na)

// =====================================================
// SIGNAL LABELS
// =====================================================
plotshape(
     longSignal,
     title="BUY",
     location=location.belowbar,
     color=color.lime,
     style=shape.labelup,
     text="BUY")

plotshape(
     shortSignal,
     title="SELL",
     location=location.abovebar,
     color=color.red,
     style=shape.labeldown,
     text="SELL")

// =====================================================
// ALERTS
// =====================================================
alertcondition(
     longSignal,
     title="MNQ LONG",
     message="MNQ ORB Fib Long Signal")

alertcondition(
     shortSignal,
     title="MNQ SHORT",
     message="MNQ ORB Fib Short Signal")

// This Pine Script® code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
// © ericfeng26
//@version=6
//version 2.0

indicator("ORB | Feng Futures", overlay=true, max_lines_count=500)

// ---------- GROUP NAMES ----------
gORB      = "⚙️ ORB Time Settings"
gColors   = "🎨 Visual: Colors & Lines"
gLabels   = "🏷️ Label Customization"


// ---------- INPUT SETTINGS ----------
maxSavedOrbs = input.int(5, "Show number of previous session ORBs", group=gORB)


// ---------- ORB TIME SETTINGS ----------
orbSessionRange  = input.string("America/New_York", "Timezone",options=["America/New_York","America/Chicago","America/Denver","America/Los_Angeles","Europe/London","Asia/Tokyo"],group=gORB)
orbStartSession   = input.session("0930-0945", "ORB Session Range", group=gORB, tooltip="Start–end for the ORB window (exchange local time unless chart TZ is set).")
sessionStartTime  = input.session("0930-1600", "Trading Session Range", group=gORB)

// ---------- VISUAL ----------
highColor    = input.color(color.green, "Orb High", group=gColors)
lowColor     = input.color(#FF5252,        "ORB Low", group=gColors)
midlineColor = input.color(color.white,     "ORB Mid", group=gColors)
linewidth    = input.int(2, "Line Width", minval=1, maxval=4, group=gColors)

// ---------- LABELS ----------

showLabels     = input.bool(true, "Show Price Labels", group=gLabels)
labelBgColor = input.color(color.new(color.black, 100), "Background", group=gLabels)
labelTextColor = input.color(#000000, "Text", group=gLabels)
labelSizeOpt   = input.string("Normal", "Size", options=["Tiny","Small","Normal","Large","Huge"], group=gLabels)
labelOffset    = input.int(5, "Label X Offset", minval= -10, maxval=100, group=gLabels)


// -------------- TIMEFRAME CHECK --------------
// Hide ORB lines on daily timeframe and higher (daily, weekly, monthly, etc.)
isDailyOrHigher = timeframe.isdaily or str.contains(timeframe.period, "W") or str.contains(timeframe.period, "M") or str.contains(timeframe.period, "D")



// -------------- HELPER FUNCTIONS --------------
// Map string to label size enum
labelSize = labelSizeOpt == "Tiny" ? size.tiny :labelSizeOpt == "Small" ? size.small :labelSizeOpt == "Normal" ? size.normal :labelSizeOpt == "Large" ? size.large :size.huge

f_plotLabel(_y, _text) =>
    if showLabels
        label.new(x=bar_index + labelOffset,y=_y,text=_text + " - " + str.tostring(_y, format.mintick),style=label.style_label_left,textcolor=labelTextColor,size=labelSize,color=labelBgColor)

// -------------- TIME LOGIC -------------- 
// Parse session string (e.g., "0930-0945")
parseSession(session) =>
    parts = str.split(session, "-")
    startStr = array.get(parts, 0)
    endStr = array.get(parts, 1)
    startHour = math.round(str.tonumber(str.substring(startStr, 0, 2)))
    startMin = math.round(str.tonumber(str.substring(startStr, 2, 4)))
    endHour = math.round(str.tonumber(str.substring(endStr, 0, 2)))
    endMin = math.round(str.tonumber(str.substring(endStr, 2, 4)))
    [startHour, startMin, endHour, endMin]

// ORB Session (e.g., 0930-0945)
[orbStartHour, orbStartMin, orbEndHour, orbEndMin] = parseSession(orbStartSession)
orbStartTime = timestamp(orbSessionRange, year, month, dayofmonth, orbStartHour, orbStartMin)
orbEndTime   = timestamp(orbSessionRange, year, month, dayofmonth, orbEndHour, orbEndMin)
inOrbSession = time >= orbStartTime and time < orbEndTime

// Trading Session (e.g., 0930-1600)
[tradeStartHour, tradeStartMin, tradeEndHour, tradeEndMin] = parseSession(sessionStartTime)
tradeStartTime = timestamp(orbSessionRange, year, month, dayofmonth, tradeStartHour, tradeStartMin)
tradeEndTime   = timestamp(orbSessionRange, year, month, dayofmonth, tradeEndHour, tradeEndMin)
inTradingSession = time >= tradeStartTime and time < tradeEndTime

// -------------- ARRAYS --------------
var line[] orbHighLines = array.new_line()
var line[] orbLowLines  = array.new_line()
var line[] orbMidLines  = array.new_line()
var line[] fibLines     = array.new_line()

// -------------- ORB VARIABLES --------------
var float sessionHigh   = na
var float sessionLow    = na
var float mid           = na
var int orb_index       = na
var line liveHighLine   = na
var line liveLowLine    = na
var line liveMidLine    = na
var int start_index     = na
var bool sessionFinalized = false
// -------------- PREVIOUS DAY DATA --------------
var line prevHighLine = na
var line prevLowLine  = na

prevHigh = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "D", high[1])
prevLow  = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "D", low[1])

if dayofmonth!=dayofmonth[1]
    start_index := bar_index

// -------------- ORB SESSION LOGIC --------------
if not inOrbSession[1] and inOrbSession
    // Reset for new ORB session
    orb_index := bar_index
    sessionHigh := na
    sessionLow := na
    mid:=na
    sessionFinalized := false
    line.delete(liveHighLine)
    line.delete(liveLowLine)
    line.delete(liveMidLine)
    liveHighLine := na
    liveLowLine := na
    liveMidLine := na

// Calculate ORB during ORB session
if inOrbSession
    sessionHigh := na(sessionHigh) ? high : math.max(sessionHigh, high)
    sessionLow := na(sessionLow) ? low : math.min(sessionLow, low)
    mid:= (sessionHigh + sessionLow) / 2

// Label declarations
var label orbHighLabel = na
var label orbLowLabel  = na
var label orbMidLabel  = na
var label prevHighLabel = na
var label prevLowLabel  = na

// Stop lines when trading session ends - do this FIRST to prevent extension
if inTradingSession[1] and not inTradingSession and not isDailyOrHigher
    if not na(liveHighLine) and not na(liveLowLine) and not na(liveMidLine)
        // Stop current session lines at session end
        line.set_x2(liveHighLine, bar_index - 1)
        line.set_x2(liveLowLine, bar_index - 1)
        line.set_x2(liveMidLine, bar_index - 1)
        
        // Create final lines for this session and add to history
        if not na(orb_index) and not na(sessionHigh) and not na(sessionLow) and not na(mid)
            finalHighLine = line.new(x1=orb_index, y1=sessionHigh, x2=bar_index - 1, y2=sessionHigh,
                                     color=highColor, width=linewidth, style=line.style_solid)
            finalLowLine  = line.new(x1=orb_index, y1=sessionLow,  x2=bar_index - 1, y2=sessionLow,
                                     color=lowColor, width=linewidth, style=line.style_solid)
            finalMidLine  = line.new(x1=orb_index, y1=mid,    x2=bar_index - 1, y2=mid,
                                     color=midlineColor, width=linewidth, style=line.style_solid)
            
            // Store lines in arrays
            array.push(orbHighLines, finalHighLine)
            array.push(orbLowLines,  finalLowLine)
            array.push(orbMidLines,  finalMidLine)
            
            // Limit to maxSavedOrbs
            if array.size(orbHighLines) > maxSavedOrbs
                line.delete(array.shift(orbHighLines))
                line.delete(array.shift(orbLowLines))
                line.delete(array.shift(orbMidLines))
        
        // Move labels to final position
        if not na(orbHighLabel) and not na(orbLowLabel) and not na(orbMidLabel)
            label.set_x(orbHighLabel, bar_index - 1 + labelOffset)
            label.set_x(orbLowLabel, bar_index - 1 + labelOffset)
            label.set_x(orbMidLabel, bar_index - 1 + labelOffset)

// Draw lines during trading session ONLY (skip on daily timeframe and higher)
if inTradingSession and not na(orb_index) and not na(sessionHigh) and not na(sessionLow) and not isDailyOrHigher
    line.delete(liveHighLine)
    line.delete(liveLowLine)
    line.delete(liveMidLine)

    // Draw real-time updating lines
    liveHighLine := line.new(x1=orb_index, y1=sessionHigh, x2=bar_index+2, y2=sessionHigh,color=highColor, width=linewidth)
    liveLowLine := line.new(x1=orb_index, y1=sessionLow, x2=bar_index+2, y2=sessionLow,color=lowColor, width=linewidth)
    liveMidLine := line.new(x1=orb_index, y1=mid, x2=bar_index+2, y2=mid,color=midlineColor, width=linewidth)

// Update labels during trading session to follow current bar (skip on daily timeframe and higher)
if inTradingSession and showLabels and not na(sessionHigh) and not na(sessionLow) and not na(mid) and not isDailyOrHigher
    label.delete(orbHighLabel)
    label.delete(orbLowLabel)
    label.delete(orbMidLabel)
    
    orbHighLabel := label.new(x=bar_index + labelOffset, y=sessionHigh, text="ORB High - " + str.tostring(sessionHigh, format.mintick), style=label.style_label_left, textcolor=labelTextColor, size=labelSize, color=labelBgColor)
    orbLowLabel  := label.new(x=bar_index + labelOffset, y=sessionLow, text="ORB Low - " + str.tostring(sessionLow, format.mintick), style=label.style_label_left, textcolor=labelTextColor, size=labelSize, color=labelBgColor)
    orbMidLabel  := label.new(x=bar_index + labelOffset, y=mid, text="ORB Mid - " + str.tostring(mid, format.mintick), style=label.style_label_left, textcolor=labelTextColor, size=labelSize, color=labelBgColor)

items.source:
// Custom ORB Volume Alert
//@version=6
indicator("ORB Volume Breakout Alert", shorttitle="ORB Vol Alert", overlay=true, max_labels_count=500, max_lines_count=500, max_boxes_count=50)

// === Inputs ===
tz                 = input.string("America/New_York", "Timezone")
marketSession      = input.string("NY", "Market Session", options=["NY", "ASIA", "London"])
orbType            = input.string("30", "ORB Length", options=["30", "15"])
dashboardLocation  = input.string("Top Right", "Dashboard Location", options=["Top Right", "Bottom Right"])

volLen             = input.int(20, "Volume Average Length", minval=1)
volMult            = input.float(1.5, "Breakout Volume Multiplier", minval=0.1, step=0.1)

tpStep             = input.float(0.5, "Target Step - ORB Range Multiple", minval=0.1, step=0.1)
labelOffset        = input.int(1, "Target Labels Left Of ORB Start", minval=0, maxval=20)

showMid            = input.bool(true, "Show ORB Midpoint")
showTargets        = input.bool(true, "Show 3 Profit Targets")
showSignals        = input.bool(true, "Show Breakout Labels")
showDashboard      = input.bool(true, "Show Dashboard")

showFvgOnCandles   = input.bool(true, "Show Current Timeframe FVG")
fvgDisplayCount    = input.string("3", "FVGs To Show", options=["1", "2", "3", "4", "5"])
removeFilledFvgs   = input.bool(true, "Remove Filled FVGs")
showFvgMidpoint    = input.bool(true, "Show FVG Midpoint")
fvgFillTransp      = input.int(88, "FVG Fill Transparency", minval=0, maxval=100)
fvgBorderTransp    = input.int(35, "FVG Border Transparency", minval=0, maxval=100)

fvgMaxCount = fvgDisplayCount == "1" ? 1 : fvgDisplayCount == "2" ? 2 : fvgDisplayCount == "3" ? 3 : fvgDisplayCount == "4" ? 4 : 5

// === Helpers ===
priceText(_name, _price) =>
    _name + "  " + (na(_price) ? "-" : str.tostring(_price, format.mintick))

clearTargets(_lines, _labels) =>
    if array.size(_lines) > 0
        for i = 0 to array.size(_lines) - 1
            line.delete(array.get(_lines, i))
    if array.size(_labels) > 0
        for i = 0 to array.size(_labels) - 1
            label.delete(array.get(_labels, i))
    array.clear(_lines)
    array.clear(_labels)

addTarget(_lines, _labels, _x, _price, _text, _color) =>
    newLine = line.new(_x, _price, bar_index, _price, extend=extend.right, color=_color, style=line.style_dashed, width=1)
    newLabel = label.new(_x, _price, _text, style=label.style_label_right, color=_color, textcolor=color.white, size=size.small, textalign=text.align_center)
    array.push(_lines, newLine)
    array.push(_labels, newLabel)

updateRightLabel(_label, _price, _text) =>
    if not na(_label)
        label.set_x(_label, bar_index + 1)
        label.set_y(_label, _price)
        label.set_text(_label, _text)

chartTfName() =>
    timeframe.isminutes and timeframe.multiplier < 60 ? str.tostring(timeframe.multiplier) + "m" :
     timeframe.isminutes ? str.tostring(timeframe.multiplier / 60.0, "#.##") + "H" :
     timeframe.isdaily ? "D" :
     timeframe.isweekly ? "W" :
     timeframe.ismonthly ? "M" :
     timeframe.period

ftfcDir(_open) =>
    na(_open) ? 0 : close >= _open ? 1 : -1

ftfcText(_dir) =>
    _dir == 1 ? "UP" : _dir == -1 ? "DOWN" : "-"

ftfcBg(_dir) =>
    _dir == 1 ? color.new(color.green, 15) : _dir == -1 ? color.new(color.red, 15) : color.new(color.gray, 45)

dashInfoRow(_tbl, _row, _name, _value) =>
    table.cell(_tbl, 0, _row, _name, text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 30), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(_tbl, 1, _row, _value, text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 45), text_size=size.small)
    for c = 2 to 6
        table.cell(_tbl, c, _row, "", bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 45))

dashFtfcValue(_tbl, _col, _dir) =>
    table.cell(_tbl, _col, 4, ftfcText(_dir), text_color=color.white, bgcolor=ftfcBg(_dir), text_size=size.small)

// === FVG Storage ===
var box[] fvgBoxes = array.new_box()
var label[] fvgLabels = array.new_label()
var line[] fvgMidLines = array.new_line()
var int[] fvgDirs = array.new_int()
var float[] fvgTops = array.new_float()
var float[] fvgBottoms = array.new_float()
var int[] fvgLeftTimes = array.new_int()

deleteFvgAt(_idx) =>
    curBox = array.get(fvgBoxes, _idx)
    curLabel = array.get(fvgLabels, _idx)
    curMidLine = array.get(fvgMidLines, _idx)

    if not na(curBox)
        box.delete(curBox)
    if not na(curLabel)
        label.delete(curLabel)
    if not na(curMidLine)
        line.delete(curMidLine)

    array.remove(fvgBoxes, _idx)
    array.remove(fvgLabels, _idx)
    array.remove(fvgMidLines, _idx)
    array.remove(fvgDirs, _idx)
    array.remove(fvgTops, _idx)
    array.remove(fvgBottoms, _idx)
    array.remove(fvgLeftTimes, _idx)

clearAllFvgs() =>
    while array.size(fvgBoxes) > 0
        deleteFvgAt(0)

trimFvgsToMax(_maxCount) =>
    while array.size(fvgBoxes) > _maxCount
        deleteFvgAt(array.size(fvgBoxes) - 1)

addFvg(_dir, _top, _bottom, _leftTime) =>
    fvgColor = _dir == 1 ? color.green : color.red
    fvgText = chartTfName() + (_dir == 1 ? " B FVG" : " S FVG")
    mid = (_top + _bottom) / 2.0

    newBox = box.new(left=_leftTime, top=_top, right=time, bottom=_bottom, xloc=xloc.bar_time, extend=extend.right, bgcolor=color.new(fvgColor, fvgFillTransp), border_color=color.new(fvgColor, fvgBorderTransp), border_width=1)
    newLabel = label.new(bar_index + 1, mid, fvgText, style=label.style_label_left, color=fvgColor, textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)

    line newMidLine = na
    if showFvgMidpoint
        newMidLine := line.new(_leftTime, mid, time, mid, xloc=xloc.bar_time, extend=extend.right, color=color.new(fvgColor, 0), style=line.style_dashed, width=1)

    array.unshift(fvgBoxes, newBox)
    array.unshift(fvgLabels, newLabel)
    array.unshift(fvgMidLines, newMidLine)
    array.unshift(fvgDirs, _dir)
    array.unshift(fvgTops, _top)
    array.unshift(fvgBottoms, _bottom)
    array.unshift(fvgLeftTimes, _leftTime)

updateFvgs() =>
    i = array.size(fvgBoxes) - 1

    while i >= 0
        curBox = array.get(fvgBoxes, i)
        curLabel = array.get(fvgLabels, i)
        curMidLine = array.get(fvgMidLines, i)
        dir = array.get(fvgDirs, i)
        top = array.get(fvgTops, i)
        bottom = array.get(fvgBottoms, i)
        leftTime = array.get(fvgLeftTimes, i)
        filled = removeFilledFvgs and ((dir == 1 and low <= bottom) or (dir == -1 and high >= top))

        if filled
            deleteFvgAt(i)
        else
            fvgColor = dir == 1 ? color.green : color.red
            fvgText = chartTfName() + (dir == 1 ? " B FVG" : " S FVG")
            mid = (top + bottom) / 2.0

            if not na(curBox)
                box.set_right(curBox, time)
                box.set_bgcolor(curBox, color.new(fvgColor, fvgFillTransp))
                box.set_border_color(curBox, color.new(fvgColor, fvgBorderTransp))

            if not na(curLabel)
                label.set_x(curLabel, bar_index + 1)
                label.set_y(curLabel, mid)
                label.set_text(curLabel, fvgText)
                label.set_color(curLabel, fvgColor)

            if showFvgMidpoint
                if na(curMidLine)
                    curMidLine := line.new(leftTime, mid, time, mid, xloc=xloc.bar_time, extend=extend.right, color=color.new(fvgColor, 0), style=line.style_dashed, width=1)
                    array.set(fvgMidLines, i, curMidLine)
                else
                    line.set_y1(curMidLine, mid)
                    line.set_y2(curMidLine, mid)
                    line.set_x2(curMidLine, time)
                    line.set_color(curMidLine, color.new(fvgColor, 0))
            else
                if not na(curMidLine)
                    line.delete(curMidLine)
                    array.set(fvgMidLines, i, na)

        i -= 1

// === Current Timeframe FVG Detection ===
if not showFvgOnCandles
    clearAllFvgs()
else
    updateFvgs()

    bullFvg = barstate.isconfirmed and not na(high[2]) and low > high[2]
    bearFvg = barstate.isconfirmed and not na(low[2]) and high < low[2]

    if bullFvg
        addFvg(1, low, high[2], time[2])

    if bearFvg
        addFvg(-1, low[2], high, time[2])

    trimFvgsToMax(fvgMaxCount)

// === Session Windows ===
orbWindow = marketSession == "NY" ? (orbType == "30" ? "0930-1000" : "0930-0945") :
     marketSession == "London" ? (orbType == "30" ? "0300-0330" : "0300-0315") :
     orbType == "30" ? "2000-2030" : "2000-2015"

tradeWindow = marketSession == "NY" ? "0930-1600" :
     marketSession == "London" ? "0300-1130" :
     ""

asiaTrade1 = "2000-2359"
asiaTrade2 = "0000-0200"

inOrb = not na(time(timeframe.period, orbWindow, tz))
inTrade = marketSession == "ASIA" ?
     (not na(time(timeframe.period, asiaTrade1, tz)) or not na(time(timeframe.period, asiaTrade2, tz))) :
     not na(time(timeframe.period, tradeWindow, tz))

newSession = inTrade and not inTrade[1]
orbJustStarted = inOrb and not inOrb[1]
orbJustEnded = not inOrb and inOrb[1]

// === Previous Day High / Low, NY Only ===
pdHighRaw = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "D", high[1], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_off)
pdLowRaw = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "D", low[1], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_off)

dayChange = ta.change(time("D"))
newDay = not na(dayChange) and dayChange != 0

var line pdHighLine = na
var line pdLowLine = na
var label pdHighLabel = na
var label pdLowLabel = na

newNyDailyLevels = marketSession == "NY" and (newDay or na(pdHighLine)) and not na(pdHighRaw) and not na(pdLowRaw)

if newNyDailyLevels
    if not na(pdHighLine)
        line.delete(pdHighLine)
    if not na(pdLowLine)
        line.delete(pdLowLine)
    if not na(pdHighLabel)
        label.delete(pdHighLabel)
    if not na(pdLowLabel)
        label.delete(pdLowLabel)

    pdHighLine := line.new(bar_index, pdHighRaw, bar_index, pdHighRaw, extend=extend.right, color=color.new(color.blue, 0), style=line.style_dashed, width=1)
    pdLowLine := line.new(bar_index, pdLowRaw, bar_index, pdLowRaw, extend=extend.right, color=color.new(color.orange, 0), style=line.style_dashed, width=1)

    pdHighLabel := label.new(bar_index + 1, pdHighRaw, priceText("PDH", pdHighRaw), style=label.style_label_left, color=color.new(color.blue, 0), textcolor=color.white, size=size.small, textalign=text.align_center)
    pdLowLabel := label.new(bar_index + 1, pdLowRaw, priceText("PDL", pdLowRaw), style=label.style_label_left, color=color.new(color.orange, 0), textcolor=color.white, size=size.small, textalign=text.align_center)

if marketSession == "NY" and not na(pdHighLine)
    line.set_y1(pdHighLine, pdHighRaw)
    line.set_y2(pdHighLine, pdHighRaw)
    line.set_y1(pdLowLine, pdLowRaw)
    line.set_y2(pdLowLine, pdLowRaw)
    updateRightLabel(pdHighLabel, pdHighRaw, priceText("PDH", pdHighRaw))
    updateRightLabel(pdLowLabel, pdLowRaw, priceText("PDL", pdLowRaw))

// === NY Premarket High / Low ===
inPremarket = marketSession == "NY" and not na(time(timeframe.period, "0400-0930", tz))
pmJustStarted = inPremarket and not inPremarket[1]
pmJustEnded = not inPremarket and inPremarket[1]

var float pmHigh = na
var float pmLow = na
var bool pmLocked = false
var int pmStartBar = na
var line pmHighLine = na
var line pmLowLine = na
var label pmHighLabel = na
var label pmLowLabel = na

if pmJustStarted
    pmHigh := high
    pmLow := low
    pmLocked := false
    pmStartBar := bar_index

    if not na(pmHighLine)
        line.delete(pmHighLine)
    if not na(pmLowLine)
        line.delete(pmLowLine)
    if not na(pmHighLabel)
        label.delete(pmHighLabel)
    if not na(pmLowLabel)
        label.delete(pmLowLabel)

    pmHighLine := na
    pmLowLine := na
    pmHighLabel := na
    pmLowLabel := na

if inPremarket
    pmHigh := na(pmHigh) ? high : math.max(pmHigh, high)
    pmLow := na(pmLow) ? low : math.min(pmLow, low)

if pmJustEnded and not na(pmHigh) and not na(pmLow)
    pmLocked := true
    lineStart = na(pmStartBar) ? bar_index : pmStartBar

    pmHighLine := line.new(lineStart, pmHigh, bar_index, pmHigh, extend=extend.right, color=color.new(color.aqua, 0), style=line.style_dashed, width=1)
    pmLowLine := line.new(lineStart, pmLow, bar_index, pmLow, extend=extend.right, color=color.new(color.fuchsia, 0), style=line.style_dashed, width=1)

    pmHighLabel := label.new(bar_index + 1, pmHigh, priceText("PMH", pmHigh), style=label.style_label_left, color=color.new(color.aqua, 0), textcolor=color.black, size=size.small, textalign=text.align_center)
    pmLowLabel := label.new(bar_index + 1, pmLow, priceText("PML", pmLow), style=label.style_label_left, color=color.new(color.fuchsia, 0), textcolor=color.white, size=size.small, textalign=text.align_center)

if pmLocked
    updateRightLabel(pmHighLabel, pmHigh, priceText("PMH", pmHigh))
    updateRightLabel(pmLowLabel, pmLow, priceText("PML", pmLow))

// === ORB State ===
var float orbHigh = na
var float orbLow = na
var bool orbLocked = false
var bool alertedLong = false
var bool alertedShort = false
var int orbStartBar = na
var int orbEndBar = na

var box orbBox = na
var line orbHighLine = na
var line orbLowLine = na
var line orbMidLine = na
var label orbHighLabel = na
var label orbLowLabel = na
var label orbMidLabel = na
var line[] targetLines = array.new_line()
var label[] targetLabels = array.new_label()

// === Reset At New Session ===
if newSession
    orbHigh := na
    orbLow := na
    orbLocked := false
    alertedLong := false
    alertedShort := false
    orbStartBar := na
    orbEndBar := na

    if not na(orbBox)
        box.delete(orbBox)
    if not na(orbHighLine)
        line.delete(orbHighLine)
    if not na(orbLowLine)
        line.delete(orbLowLine)
    if not na(orbMidLine)
        line.delete(orbMidLine)
    if not na(orbHighLabel)
        label.delete(orbHighLabel)
    if not na(orbLowLabel)
        label.delete(orbLowLabel)
    if not na(orbMidLabel)
        label.delete(orbMidLabel)

    clearTargets(targetLines, targetLabels)

    orbBox := na
    orbHighLine := na
    orbLowLine := na
    orbMidLine := na
    orbHighLabel := na
    orbLowLabel := na
    orbMidLabel := na

// === Build ORB Range ===
if orbJustStarted
    orbStartBar := bar_index
    orbHigh := high
    orbLow := low
    orbLocked := false

if inOrb
    orbHigh := na(orbHigh) ? high : math.max(orbHigh, high)
    orbLow := na(orbLow) ? low : math.min(orbLow, low)
    orbLocked := false

    if na(orbBox)
        orbBox := box.new(left=orbStartBar, top=orbHigh, right=bar_index, bottom=orbLow, bgcolor=color.new(color.yellow, 90), border_color=color.new(color.yellow, 35), border_width=1)
    else
        box.set_right(orbBox, bar_index)
        box.set_top(orbBox, orbHigh)
        box.set_bottom(orbBox, orbLow)

if orbJustEnded and not na(orbHigh) and not na(orbLow)
    orbLocked := true
    orbEndBar := bar_index - 1
    if not na(orbBox)
        box.set_right(orbBox, orbEndBar)

// === ORB Calculations ===
afterOrb = inTrade and orbLocked and not inOrb
orbRange = orbHigh - orbLow
orbMid = (orbHigh + orbLow) / 2.0

longTP1 = orbHigh + orbRange * tpStep
longTP2 = orbHigh + orbRange * tpStep * 2.0
longTP3 = orbHigh + orbRange * tpStep * 3.0

shortTP1 = orbLow - orbRange * tpStep
shortTP2 = orbLow - orbRange * tpStep * 2.0
shortTP3 = orbLow - orbRange * tpStep * 3.0

// === Draw ORB Lines And Target Labels ===
if orbLocked and na(orbHighLine)
    lineStart = na(orbStartBar) ? bar_index : orbStartBar
    targetX = math.max(0, lineStart - labelOffset)

    orbHighLine := line.new(lineStart, orbHigh, bar_index, orbHigh, extend=extend.right, color=color.green, width=2)
    orbLowLine := line.new(lineStart, orbLow, bar_index, orbLow, extend=extend.right, color=color.red, width=2)

    orbHighLabel := label.new(bar_index + 1, orbHigh, priceText("ORB HIGH", orbHigh), style=label.style_label_left, color=color.green, textcolor=color.white, size=size.small, textalign=text.align_center)
    orbLowLabel := label.new(bar_index + 1, orbLow, priceText("ORB LOW", orbLow), style=label.style_label_left, color=color.red, textcolor=color.white, size=size.small, textalign=text.align_center)

    if showMid
        orbMidLine := line.new(lineStart, orbMid, bar_index, orbMid, extend=extend.right, color=color.gray, style=line.style_dashed, width=2)
        orbMidLabel := label.new(bar_index + 1, orbMid, priceText("MID ORB", orbMid), style=label.style_label_left, color=color.gray, textcolor=color.white, size=size.small, textalign=text.align_center)

    if showTargets
        addTarget(targetLines, targetLabels, targetX, longTP1, "1  " + str.tostring(longTP1, format.mintick), color.green)
        addTarget(targetLines, targetLabels, targetX, longTP2, "2  " + str.tostring(longTP2, format.mintick), color.green)
        addTarget(targetLines, targetLabels, targetX, longTP3, "3  " + str.tostring(longTP3, format.mintick), color.green)
        addTarget(targetLines, targetLabels, targetX, shortTP1, "1  " + str.tostring(shortTP1, format.mintick), color.red)
        addTarget(targetLines, targetLabels, targetX, shortTP2, "2  " + str.tostring(shortTP2, format.mintick), color.red)
        addTarget(targetLines, targetLabels, targetX, shortTP3, "3  " + str.tostring(shortTP3, format.mintick), color.red)

if orbLocked
    updateRightLabel(orbHighLabel, orbHigh, priceText("ORB HIGH", orbHigh))
    updateRightLabel(orbLowLabel, orbLow, priceText("ORB LOW", orbLow))
    updateRightLabel(orbMidLabel, orbMid, priceText("MID ORB", orbMid))

plot(orbLocked ? orbHigh : na, title="ORB HIGH Price Tag", color=color.green, display=display.price_scale)
plot(orbLocked ? orbLow : na, title="ORB LOW Price Tag", color=color.red, display=display.price_scale)
plot(orbLocked and showMid ? orbMid : na, title="MID ORB Price Tag", color=color.gray, display=display.price_scale)
plot(marketSession == "NY" and pmLocked ? pmHigh : na, title="PMH Price Tag", color=color.aqua, display=display.price_scale)
plot(marketSession == "NY" and pmLocked ? pmLow : na, title="PML Price Tag", color=color.fuchsia, display=display.price_scale)
plot(marketSession == "NY" ? pdHighRaw : na, title="PDH Price Tag", color=color.blue, display=display.price_scale)
plot(marketSession == "NY" ? pdLowRaw : na, title="PDL Price Tag", color=color.orange, display=display.price_scale)

// === Breakout Volume Logic ===
volAvg = ta.sma(volume[1], volLen)
volRatio = not na(volAvg) and volAvg > 0 ? volume / volAvg : na
breakoutVolume = afterOrb and barstate.isconfirmed and not na(volRatio) and volRatio >= volMult

reenteredOrb = afterOrb and close <= orbHigh and close >= orbLow

if reenteredOrb
    alertedLong := false
    alertedShort := false

longVolumeBreakout = breakoutVolume and close > orbHigh and not alertedLong
shortVolumeBreakout = breakoutVolume and close < orbLow and not alertedShort
anyVolumeBreakout = longVolumeBreakout or shortVolumeBreakout

if longVolumeBreakout
    alertedLong := true
    alertedShort := false

if shortVolumeBreakout
    alertedShort := true
    alertedLong := false

plotshape(showSignals and longVolumeBreakout, title="ORB VOL BUY", style=shape.labelup, location=location.belowbar, color=color.green, textcolor=color.white, text="ORB VOL BUY", size=size.small)
plotshape(showSignals and shortVolumeBreakout, title="ORB VOL SELL", style=shape.labeldown, location=location.abovebar, color=color.red, textcolor=color.white, text="ORB VOL SELL", size=size.small)

// === Alerts ===
alertcondition(anyVolumeBreakout, "ORB Breakout Volume Alert", "ORB breakout volume on {{ticker}}. Close: {{close}} Volume: {{volume}}")
alertcondition(longVolumeBreakout, "ORB VOL BUY", "ORB VOL BUY on {{ticker}}. Close: {{close}} Volume: {{volume}}")
alertcondition(shortVolumeBreakout, "ORB VOL SELL", "ORB VOL SELL on {{ticker}}. Close: {{close}} Volume: {{volume}}")

if longVolumeBreakout
    alert("ORB VOL BUY: " + syminfo.ticker + " | Close: " + str.tostring(close, format.mintick) + " | Volume: " + str.tostring(volRatio, "#.##") + "x avg", alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)

if shortVolumeBreakout
    alert("ORB VOL SELL: " + syminfo.ticker + " | Close: " + str.tostring(close, format.mintick) + " | Volume: " + str.tostring(volRatio, "#.##") + "x avg", alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)

// === FTFC Dashboard Data ===
m30Open = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "30", open, lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_off)
h1Open = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "60", open, lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_off)
h4Open = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "240", open, lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_off)
dOpen = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "D", open, lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_off)
wOpen = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "W", open, lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_off)
mOpen = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "M", open, lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_off)

m30Dir = ftfcDir(m30Open)
h1Dir = ftfcDir(h1Open)
h4Dir = ftfcDir(h4Open)
dDir = ftfcDir(dOpen)
wDir = ftfcDir(wOpen)
mDir = ftfcDir(mOpen)

// === Combined Dashboard ===
dashPos = dashboardLocation == "Top Right" ? position.top_right : position.bottom_right
var table dashboard = table.new(dashPos, 7, 5, border_width=1)

if showDashboard and barstate.islast
    table.cell(dashboard, 0, 0, "Session:", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 0), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dashboard, 1, 0, marketSession, text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 30), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dashboard, 2, 0, "ORB:", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 0), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dashboard, 3, 0, orbType + " min", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 30), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dashboard, 4, 0, "", bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 30))
    table.cell(dashboard, 5, 0, "", bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 30))
    table.cell(dashboard, 6, 0, "", bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 30))

    dashInfoRow(dashboard, 1, "High:", na(orbHigh) ? "-" : str.tostring(orbHigh, format.mintick))
    dashInfoRow(dashboard, 2, "Low:", na(orbLow) ? "-" : str.tostring(orbLow, format.mintick))

    table.cell(dashboard, 0, 3, "FTFC", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 0), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dashboard, 1, 3, "30m", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 20), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dashboard, 2, 3, "1H", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 20), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dashboard, 3, 3, "4H", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 20), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dashboard, 4, 3, "D", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 20), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dashboard, 5, 3, "W", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 20), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dashboard, 6, 3, "M", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 20), text_size=size.small)

    table.cell(dashboard, 0, 4, "", bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 0))
    dashFtfcValue(dashboard, 1, m30Dir)
    dashFtfcValue(dashboard, 2, h1Dir)
    dashFtfcValue(dashboard, 3, h4Dir)
    dashFtfcValue(dashboard, 4, dDir)
    dashFtfcValue(dashboard, 5, wDir)
    dashFtfcValue(dashboard, 6, mDir)
