items.title: Futures Levels: ON / PD / PW / PM / ATH + MAs + VWAP + Orb
items.author: imsanesam
items.source:
//@version=6
indicator("Futures Levels: ON / PD / PW / PM / ATH + MAs + VWAP + Orb", overlay=true, max_lines_count=500, max_labels_count=500)

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Futures-only gate
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
isFutures = (syminfo.type == "futures")

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Input Groups
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
gLevels = "// Levels //"
gMAs = "// Moving Averages //"
gVWAP = "// VWAP //"
gORB = "// ORB (Opening Range Breakout) //"
gStyle = "// Style //"
gLevelsStyle = "// Levels Style //"
gMAStyle = "// Moving Averages Style //"
gVWAPStyle = "// VWAP Style //"
gORBStyle = "// ORB Style //"

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Level Toggles and Settings
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Level Visibility Toggles
showON = input.bool(true, "Show ON (Overnight)", group=gLevels, tooltip="ON = Overnight session high/low from previous or current overnight session")
showPD = input.bool(true, "Show PD (Previous Day)", group=gLevels, tooltip="PD = Previous Day RTH (Regular Trading Hours) high/low")
showPW = input.bool(true, "Show PW (Previous Week)", group=gLevels, tooltip="PW = Previous Week high/low")
showPM = input.bool(true, "Show PM (Previous Month)", group=gLevels, tooltip="PM = Previous Month high/low")
showATH = input.bool(true, "Show ATH (All-Time High)", group=gLevels, tooltip="ATH = All-Time High from the beginning of the chart")
showVAH = input.bool(true, "Show VAH (Value Area High)", group=gLevels, tooltip="VAH = Value Area High from RTH session")
showVAL = input.bool(true, "Show VAL (Value Area Low)", group=gLevels, tooltip="VAL = Value Area Low from RTH session")
showPOC = input.bool(true, "Show POC (Point of Control)", group=gLevels, tooltip="POC = Point of Control (price with highest volume) from RTH session")
showPrevDayVA = input.bool(true, "Show Previous Day VAH/VAL/POC", group=gLevels, tooltip="Show Value Area levels from previous day's RTH session")
vaPercentage = input.int(70, "Value Area Percentage", minval=50, maxval=90, group=gLevels, tooltip="Percentage of volume to include in Value Area (default: 70%). Standard values are 60-70%.")

// Trading Session Configuration
tradingSession = input.string("New York", "Trading Session", options=["New York", "London", "Tokyo", "Chicago", "Sydney"], group=gLevels, tooltip="Select trading session. Automatically configures timezone, RTH, and ON session times.")

// Configure timezone and sessions based on selection
tz = switch tradingSession
    "New York" => "America/New_York"
    "London" => "Europe/London"
    "Tokyo" => "Asia/Tokyo"
    "Chicago" => "America/Chicago"
    "Sydney" => "Australia/Sydney"
    => "America/New_York"

rthSession = switch tradingSession
    "New York" => "0930-1600"
    "London" => "0800-1630"
    "Tokyo" => "0900-1500"
    "Chicago" => "0830-1500"
    "Sydney" => "1000-1600"
    => "0930-1600"

onSession = switch tradingSession
    "New York" => "1600-0930"
    "London" => "1630-0800"
    "Tokyo" => "1500-0900"
    "Chicago" => "1500-0830"
    "Sydney" => "1600-1000"
    => "1600-0930"

// Level Style Settings (for line.new() - style settings in Inputs tab)
cON  = input.color(color.new(color.aqua,    0), "ON Color", group=gLevelsStyle)
cPD  = input.color(color.new(color.orange,  0), "PD Color", group=gLevelsStyle)
cPW  = input.color(color.new(color.fuchsia, 0), "PW Color", group=gLevelsStyle)
cPM  = input.color(color.new(color.lime,    0), "PM Color", group=gLevelsStyle)
cATH = input.color(color.new(color.red,     0), "ATH Color", group=gLevelsStyle)
cVAH = input.color(color.new(color.blue,    0), "VAH Color", group=gLevelsStyle)
cVAL = input.color(color.new(color.blue,    0), "VAL Color", group=gLevelsStyle)
cPOC = input.color(color.new(color.yellow,  0), "POC Color", group=gLevelsStyle)

levelLineStyle = input.string("Solid", "Level Line Style", options=["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], group=gLevelsStyle)
levelLineWidth = input.int(1, "Level Line Width", minval=1, maxval=5, group=gLevelsStyle)

// Helper function to convert style string to line style
getLineStyle(styleStr) =>
    switch styleStr
        "Solid" => line.style_solid
        "Dashed" => line.style_dashed
        "Dotted" => line.style_dotted
        => line.style_dashed

// Helper function to create or update a horizontal line with extend.both
updateLevelLine(lineId, price, lineColor, lineWidth, lineStyle) =>
    var line result = lineId
    if not na(price)
        if na(result)
            result := line.new(bar_index, price, bar_index + 1, price, xloc=xloc.bar_index, extend=extend.both, color=lineColor, width=lineWidth, style=lineStyle)
        else
            line.set_xy1(result, bar_index, price)
            line.set_xy2(result, bar_index + 1, price)
            line.set_color(result, lineColor)
            line.set_width(result, lineWidth)
            line.set_style(result, lineStyle)
    result

// Level Label Settings (grouped in Style section)
labelTextColorON  = input.color(color.white, "ON Label Text Color", group=gLevelsStyle)
labelTextColorPD  = input.color(color.black, "PD Label Text Color", group=gLevelsStyle)
labelTextColorPW  = input.color(color.white, "PW Label Text Color", group=gLevelsStyle)
labelTextColorPM  = input.color(color.white, "PM Label Text Color", group=gLevelsStyle)
labelTextColorATH = input.color(color.white, "ATH Label Text Color", group=gLevelsStyle)
labelTextColorVAH = input.color(color.white, "VAH Label Text Color", group=gLevelsStyle)
labelTextColorVAL = input.color(color.white, "VAL Label Text Color", group=gLevelsStyle)
labelTextColorPOC = input.color(color.black, "POC Label Text Color", group=gLevelsStyle)
labelOffsetBars = input.int(2, "Label Offset from Right Edge (Bars)", minval=0, maxval=10, group=gLevels, tooltip="Small offset to position labels just to the right of the last visible bar. Keeps labels close to the right edge without cluttering. Default: 2 bars.")


//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Moving Averages Settings
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Moving Average 1
showMA1 = input.bool(false, "Show MA 1", group=gMAs)
ma1Type = input.string("EMA", "MA 1 Type", options=["EMA", "SMA", "WMA", "RMA", "DEMA", "TEMA"], group=gMAs)
ma1Period = input.int(9, "MA 1 Period", minval=1, group=gMAs)
ma1Color = input.color(color.new(color.blue, 0), "MA 1 Color", group=gMAStyle)
ma1Style = input.string("Solid", "MA 1 Style", options=["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], group=gMAStyle)
ma1Width = input.int(1, "MA 1 Width", minval=1, maxval=5, group=gMAStyle)

// Moving Average 2
showMA2 = input.bool(false, "Show MA 2", group=gMAs)
ma2Type = input.string("EMA", "MA 2 Type", options=["EMA", "SMA", "WMA", "RMA", "DEMA", "TEMA"], group=gMAs)
ma2Period = input.int(21, "MA 2 Period", minval=1, group=gMAs)
ma2Color = input.color(color.new(color.yellow, 0), "MA 2 Color", group=gMAStyle)
ma2Style = input.string("Solid", "MA 2 Style", options=["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], group=gMAStyle)
ma2Width = input.int(1, "MA 2 Width", minval=1, maxval=5, group=gMAStyle)

// Moving Average 3
showMA3 = input.bool(false, "Show MA 3", group=gMAs)
ma3Type = input.string("EMA", "MA 3 Type", options=["EMA", "SMA", "WMA", "RMA", "DEMA", "TEMA"], group=gMAs)
ma3Period = input.int(34, "MA 3 Period", minval=1, group=gMAs)
ma3Color = input.color(color.new(color.green, 0), "MA 3 Color", group=gMAStyle)
ma3Style = input.string("Solid", "MA 3 Style", options=["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], group=gMAStyle)
ma3Width = input.int(1, "MA 3 Width", minval=1, maxval=5, group=gMAStyle)

// Moving Average 4
showMA4 = input.bool(false, "Show MA 4", group=gMAs)
ma4Type = input.string("EMA", "MA 4 Type", options=["EMA", "SMA", "WMA", "RMA", "DEMA", "TEMA"], group=gMAs)
ma4Period = input.int(50, "MA 4 Period", minval=1, group=gMAs)
ma4Color = input.color(color.new(color.purple, 0), "MA 4 Color", group=gMAStyle)
ma4Style = input.string("Solid", "MA 4 Style", options=["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], group=gMAStyle)
ma4Width = input.int(1, "MA 4 Width", minval=1, maxval=5, group=gMAStyle)

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// VWAP Settings
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// VWAP Main Settings
showVWAP = input.bool(false, "Show VWAP", group=gVWAP)
vwapAnchor = input.string("Session", "VWAP Anchor", options=["Session", "New Day", "Start of Day", "Day", "Week", "Month", "Year"], group=gVWAP, tooltip="Session = resets at RTH start (6 PM), New Day = resets at 6 PM for futures, Start of Day = resets at midnight (00:00), Day = resets daily, etc.")
vwapColor = input.color(color.new(color.white, 0), "VWAP Color", group=gVWAPStyle)
vwapStyle = input.string("Solid", "VWAP Style", options=["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], group=gVWAPStyle)
vwapWidth = input.int(2, "VWAP Width", minval=1, maxval=5, group=gVWAPStyle)
vwapExtendAfterSession = input.bool(true, "Extend VWAP After Session", group=gVWAP, tooltip="Extend VWAP line to the right after session ends")

// VWAP Bands Settings
showVWAPBands = input.bool(false, "Show VWAP Bands", group=gVWAP)
showVWAPBand1 = input.bool(true, "Show Band 1", group=gVWAP, tooltip="Enable/disable first VWAP band")
showVWAPBand2 = input.bool(true, "Show Band 2", group=gVWAP, tooltip="Enable/disable second VWAP band")
showVWAPBand3 = input.bool(true, "Show Band 3", group=gVWAP, tooltip="Enable/disable third VWAP band")
vwapBandMultiplier1 = input.float(1.0, "Band 1 Multiplier", minval=0.1, step=0.1, group=gVWAP)
vwapBandMultiplier2 = input.float(2.0, "Band 2 Multiplier", minval=0.1, step=0.1, group=gVWAP)
vwapBandMultiplier3 = input.float(3.0, "Band 3 Multiplier", minval=0.1, step=0.1, group=gVWAP)
vwapBandMode = input.string("Standard Deviation", "Band Calculation", options=["Standard Deviation", "Fixed Offset"], group=gVWAP, tooltip="Standard Deviation = uses price std dev, Fixed Offset = fixed price offset")
vwapStdDevLookback = input.int(20, "Std Dev Lookback Period", minval=2, maxval=200, group=gVWAP, tooltip="Number of bars to use for standard deviation calculation")
vwapBandLineColor = input.color(color.new(color.blue, 0), "Band Line Color", group=gVWAPStyle)
vwapBandLineStyle = input.string("Dashed", "Band Line Style", options=["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], group=gVWAPStyle)
vwapBandLineWidth = input.int(1, "Band Line Width", minval=1, maxval=5, group=gVWAPStyle)
showVWAPBandFills = input.bool(false, "Show VWAP Band Fills", group=gVWAP, tooltip="Enable background fills between VWAP bands")
vwapBandColor = input.color(color.new(color.blue, 80), "Band Background Color", group=gVWAPStyle)

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// ORB (Opening Range Breakout) Settings
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// ORB 5 Minute
showORB5 = input.bool(false, "Show ORB 5min", group=gORB, tooltip="Show 5-minute Opening Range Breakout levels")
orb5Color = color.new(color.yellow, 0)  // Default color, can be overridden in Style tab

// ORB 10 Minute
showORB10 = input.bool(false, "Show ORB 10min", group=gORB, tooltip="Show 10-minute Opening Range Breakout levels")
orb10Color = color.new(color.orange, 0)  // Default color, can be overridden in Style tab

// ORB 15 Minute
showORB15 = input.bool(false, "Show ORB 15min", group=gORB, tooltip="Show 15-minute Opening Range Breakout levels")
orb15Color = color.new(color.purple, 0)  // Default color, can be overridden in Style tab

// ORB 30 Minute
showORB30 = input.bool(false, "Show ORB 30min", group=gORB, tooltip="Show 30-minute Opening Range Breakout levels")
orb30Color = color.new(color.teal, 0)  // Default color, can be overridden in Style tab

// ORB 60 Minute
showORB60 = input.bool(false, "Show ORB 60min", group=gORB, tooltip="Show 60-minute Opening Range Breakout levels")
orb60Color = color.new(color.maroon, 0)  // Default color, can be overridden in Style tab

// ORB General Settings
orbExtendToEndOfDay = input.bool(true, "Extend ORB to End of Day", group=gORB, tooltip="Extend ORB lines to the right until end of trading day")

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Helper Functions
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// getLineStyle removed - plot() uses plot.style_line, plot.style_linebr, etc. managed by Style tab

// DEMA calculation
calcDEMA(src, period) =>
    ema1 = ta.ema(src, period)
    ema2 = ta.ema(ema1, period)
    2 * ema1 - ema2

// TEMA calculation
calcTEMA(src, period) =>
    ema1 = ta.ema(src, period)
    ema2 = ta.ema(ema1, period)
    ema3 = ta.ema(ema2, period)
    3 * ema1 - 3 * ema2 + ema3

getMA(type, period, src) =>
    switch type
        "EMA" => ta.ema(src, period)
        "SMA" => ta.sma(src, period)
        "WMA" => ta.wma(src, period)
        "RMA" => ta.rma(src, period)
        "DEMA" => calcDEMA(src, period)
        "TEMA" => calcTEMA(src, period)
        => ta.ema(src, period)

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Session helper
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
inSess(sess) =>
    not na(time(timeframe.period, sess, tz))

inRTH = isFutures and timeframe.isintraday and inSess(rthSession)
inON  = isFutures and timeframe.isintraday and inSess(onSession)

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Overnight High/Low (ON) - Uses stateful variables tracking from bar 0
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Use stateful variables to track ON session high/low from first bar processed
// This approach works because Pine Script processes from bar 0 when indicator is added
var float curONHigh  = na
var float curONLow   = na
var float prevONHigh = na
var float prevONLow  = na

onStart = inON and not inON[1]
onEnd   = not inON and inON[1]

if isFutures and timeframe.isintraday
    if onStart
        curONHigh := high
        curONLow  := low
    else if inON
        curONHigh := math.max(curONHigh, high)
        curONLow  := math.min(curONLow, low)

    if onEnd and not na(curONHigh) and not na(curONLow)
        prevONHigh := curONHigh
        prevONLow  := curONLow

var label onHighLab  = na
var label onLowLab   = na

onHigh = inON ? curONHigh : prevONHigh
onLow  = inON ? curONLow  : prevONLow

// ON level lines with extend.right
var line onHighLine = na
var line onLowLine = na

if showON and isFutures and timeframe.isintraday
    onHighLine := updateLevelLine(onHighLine, onHigh, cON, levelLineWidth, getLineStyle(levelLineStyle))
    onLowLine := updateLevelLine(onLowLine, onLow, cON, levelLineWidth, getLineStyle(levelLineStyle))

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Previous RTH Day High/Low (PD) - Uses stateful variables tracking from bar 0
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Use stateful variables to track RTH session high/low from first bar processed
// This approach works because Pine Script processes from bar 0 when indicator is added
var float curRTHHigh  = na
var float curRTHLow   = na
var float prevRTHHigh = na
var float prevRTHLow  = na

rthStart = inRTH and not inRTH[1]
rthEnd   = not inRTH and inRTH[1]

if isFutures and timeframe.isintraday
    if rthStart
        curRTHHigh := high
        curRTHLow  := low
    else if inRTH
        curRTHHigh := math.max(curRTHHigh, high)
        curRTHLow  := math.min(curRTHLow, low)

    if rthEnd and not na(curRTHHigh) and not na(curRTHLow)
        prevRTHHigh := curRTHHigh
        prevRTHLow  := curRTHLow

var label pdHighLab  = na
var label pdLowLab   = na

// PD level lines with extend.right
var line pdHighLine = na
var line pdLowLine = na

if showPD and isFutures and timeframe.isintraday
    pdHighLine := updateLevelLine(pdHighLine, prevRTHHigh, cPD, levelLineWidth, getLineStyle(levelLineStyle))
    pdLowLine := updateLevelLine(pdLowLine, prevRTHLow, cPD, levelLineWidth, getLineStyle(levelLineStyle))

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Value Area High/Low and Point of Control (VAH/VAL/POC) - RTH Session Only
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Value Area is calculated as 70% of volume during RTH session
// POC is the price level with the highest volume
// Calculated for both current day and previous day RTH sessions

// Price bucket size for volume tracking (use tick size)
tickSize = syminfo.mintick
priceBucketSize = tickSize * 10  // Group prices into buckets (10 ticks)

// Current day RTH volume tracking
var array<float> curRTHPrices = array.new<float>()
var array<float> curRTHVolumes = array.new<float>()
var float curRTHTotalVolume = 0.0
var float curRTHVAH = na
var float curRTHVAL = na
var float curRTHPOC = na

// Previous day RTH values
var float prevRTHVAH = na
var float prevRTHVAL = na
var float prevRTHPOC = na

// Helper function to round price to bucket
roundToBucket(price) =>
    math.round(price / priceBucketSize) * priceBucketSize

// Reset and calculate Value Area during RTH
if isFutures and timeframe.isintraday
    if rthStart
        // Store previous day values BEFORE resetting (only when new day starts)
        if not na(curRTHVAH) and not na(curRTHVAL) and not na(curRTHPOC)
            prevRTHVAH := curRTHVAH
            prevRTHVAL := curRTHVAL
            prevRTHPOC := curRTHPOC
        
        // Reset arrays for new RTH session
        array.clear(curRTHPrices)
        array.clear(curRTHVolumes)
        curRTHTotalVolume := 0.0
        curRTHVAH := na
        curRTHVAL := na
        curRTHPOC := na
    
    if inRTH
        // Accumulate volume at price levels
        // Use HL2 as the representative price for volume distribution
        priceBucket = roundToBucket(hl2)
        
        // Find or add price bucket
        found = false
        arraySize = array.size(curRTHPrices)
        if arraySize > 0
            for i = 0 to arraySize - 1
                if array.get(curRTHPrices, i) == priceBucket
                    // Update volume for this price bucket
                    currentVol = array.get(curRTHVolumes, i)
                    array.set(curRTHVolumes, i, currentVol + volume)
                    found := true
                    break
        
        if not found
            // Add new price bucket
            array.push(curRTHPrices, priceBucket)
            array.push(curRTHVolumes, volume)
        
        curRTHTotalVolume := curRTHTotalVolume + volume
        
        // Calculate VAH/VAL/POC continuously during RTH (not just at end)
        if curRTHTotalVolume > 0 and array.size(curRTHPrices) > 0
            // Calculate POC (price with highest volume)
            maxVolume = 0.0
            float pocPrice = na  // Reset each bar (no var)
            for i = 0 to array.size(curRTHPrices) - 1
                vol = array.get(curRTHVolumes, i)
                if vol > maxVolume
                    maxVolume := vol
                    pocPrice := array.get(curRTHPrices, i)
            
            curRTHPOC := pocPrice
            
            // Calculate Value Area using standard algorithm:
            // 1. Sort price buckets by price
            // 2. Start from POC, expand to ADJACENT levels (not highest volume anywhere)
            // 3. Compare volume of next level above vs below, add whichever is higher
            // 4. Continue until targetVolume (70%) is reached
            
            pricesArraySize = array.size(curRTHPrices)
            volumesArraySize = array.size(curRTHVolumes)
            float vahPrice = na
            float valPrice = na
            
            if pricesArraySize == volumesArraySize and pricesArraySize > 0 and not na(curRTHPOC)
                // Create sorted arrays by price (ascending)
                var array<float> sortedPrices = array.new<float>()
                var array<float> sortedVolumes = array.new<float>()
                array.clear(sortedPrices)
                array.clear(sortedVolumes)
                
                // Copy to sorted arrays
                for i = 0 to pricesArraySize - 1
                    array.push(sortedPrices, array.get(curRTHPrices, i))
                    array.push(sortedVolumes, array.get(curRTHVolumes, i))
                
                // Simple bubble sort by price (ascending)
                sortSize = array.size(sortedPrices)
                if sortSize > 1
                    for i = 0 to sortSize - 2
                        for j = 0 to sortSize - i - 2
                            if array.get(sortedPrices, j) > array.get(sortedPrices, j + 1)
                                // Swap prices
                                tempPrice = array.get(sortedPrices, j)
                                array.set(sortedPrices, j, array.get(sortedPrices, j + 1))
                                array.set(sortedPrices, j + 1, tempPrice)
                                // Swap volumes
                                tempVol = array.get(sortedVolumes, j)
                                array.set(sortedVolumes, j, array.get(sortedVolumes, j + 1))
                                array.set(sortedVolumes, j + 1, tempVol)
                
                // Find POC index in sorted array
                pocIdx = -1
                for i = 0 to sortSize - 1
                    if math.abs(array.get(sortedPrices, i) - curRTHPOC) < priceBucketSize / 2
                        pocIdx := i
                        break
                
                if pocIdx >= 0
                    targetVolume = curRTHTotalVolume * (vaPercentage / 100.0)
                    accumulatedVolume = array.get(sortedVolumes, pocIdx)

                    vahPrice := curRTHPOC
                    valPrice := curRTHPOC
                    
                    // Pointers for expansion (adjacent levels)
                    upperIdx = pocIdx + 1  // Next level above POC
                    lowerIdx = pocIdx - 1  // Next level below POC
                    
                    // Expand from POC to adjacent levels
                    maxIterations = 100
                    iteration = 0
                    
                    while accumulatedVolume < targetVolume and iteration < maxIterations
                        iteration := iteration + 1
                        
                        // Get volume at adjacent levels (0 if out of bounds)
                        volAbove = upperIdx < sortSize ? array.get(sortedVolumes, upperIdx) : 0.0
                        volBelow = lowerIdx >= 0 ? array.get(sortedVolumes, lowerIdx) : 0.0
                        
                        // If both out of bounds, we've included all buckets
                        if upperIdx >= sortSize and lowerIdx < 0
                            break
                        
                        // Add the adjacent level with higher volume
                        if volAbove >= volBelow and upperIdx < sortSize
                            accumulatedVolume := accumulatedVolume + volAbove
                            vahPrice := array.get(sortedPrices, upperIdx)
                            upperIdx := upperIdx + 1
                        else if lowerIdx >= 0
                            accumulatedVolume := accumulatedVolume + volBelow
                            valPrice := array.get(sortedPrices, lowerIdx)

    "Start of Day" => startOfDay  // Reset at midnight (00:00) in selected timezone

    "Week" => ta.change(weekofyear) != 0
    "Month" => ta.change(month) != 0

    // New Day: calculate during both RTH and ON sessions (full trading day, resets at ON session start based on selected session)
    // Start of Day: calculate on all bars
    // Other anchors: calculate on all bars
    shouldCalc = switch vwapAnchor
        "Session" => inRTH or inON  // Calculate during both ON and RTH
        "New Day" => inRTH or inON
        => true  // Start of Day, Day, Week, Month, Year calculate on all bars
    
    if shouldCalc
        if vwapReset or na(vwapValue)
            // Reset VWAP at anchor start
            vwapValue := hl2
            vwapVolumeSum := volume
            vwapPriceVolumeSum := hl2 * volume
            vwapStartBar := bar_index
        else
            // Accumulate volume-weighted price: VWAP = Σ(Price × Volume) / Σ(Volume)
            vwapVolumeSum := vwapVolumeSum + volume
            vwapPriceVolumeSum := vwapPriceVolumeSum + (hl2 * volume)

    if showORB5 and orb5Calculated and not na(orb5High)

    // Apply fixed horizontal offsets to each label type so all are visible

    arraySize = array.size(labelPrices)
    baseHorizontalOffset = labelBarDurationMs * 0.5  // Base horizontal offset (0.5 bars worth of time)
    
    // Create/update labels with fixed horizontal offsets
    if arraySize > 0
        for i = 0 to arraySize - 1

            labelText = array.get(labelTexts, i)
            bgColor = array.get(labelColors, i)
            textColor = array.get(labelTextColors, i)
            
            // Assign fixed horizontal offset multiplier based on label type
            // Group POC/VAH/VAL together, and other labels together
            offsetMultiplier = switch labelText
                // Regular levels group (0-18) - close together horizontally
                "ON HIGH" => 0
                "ON LOW" => 1
                "PD HIGH" => 2
                "PD LOW" => 3
                "PW HIGH" => 4
                "PW LOW" => 5

            else if labelText == "ORB 60min HIGH"

            else if labelText == "ORB 60min LOW"

            else if labelText == "VAH"

            else if labelText == "VAL"

            else if labelText == "POC"

            else if labelText == "PD VAH"

            else if labelText == "PD VAL"

            else if labelText == "PD POC"

            if na(labelId)
                // Create new label with small size and semi-transparent background
                newLabel = label.new(adjustedTime, basePrice, labelText, style=label.style_label_left, textcolor=textColor, color=color.new(bgColor, 20), xloc=xloc.bar_time, size=size.small, yloc=yloc.price)
                // Store label reference

                else if labelText == "PD HIGH"

                else if labelText == "PM HIGH"

                else if labelText == "PM LOW"

                else if labelText == "ALL TIME HIGH"

                else if labelText == "ORB 5min HIGH"
                    orb5HighLab := newLabel
                else if labelText == "ORB 5min LOW"
                    orb5LowLab := newLabel
                else if labelText == "ORB 10min HIGH"
                    orb10HighLab := newLabel
                else if labelText == "ORB 10min LOW"
                    orb10LowLab := newLabel
                else if labelText == "ORB 15min HIGH"
                    orb15HighLab := newLabel
                else if labelText == "ORB 15min LOW"

                else if labelText == "ORB 30min HIGH"

                else if labelText == "ORB 30min LOW"

                else if labelText == "ORB 60min HIGH"
                    orb60HighLab := newLabel
                else if labelText == "ORB 60min LOW"

                else if labelText == "VAH"
                    vahLab := newLabel
                else if labelText == "VAL"
                    valLab := newLabel
                else if labelText == "POC"
                    pocLab := newLabel
                else if labelText == "PD VAH"
                    prevVAHLab := newLabel
                else if labelText == "PD VAL"
                    prevVALLab := newLabel
                else if labelText == "PD POC"

            else
                // Update existing label

    // Clean up arrays for next iteration

items.source:
//@version=5
indicator("Globex Overnight Futures ORB with FIB's by TenAMTrader", overlay=true)

// === Input Settings === //
startHour   = input.int(18, "Primary Start Hour", minval=0, maxval=23)
startMinute = input.int(00, "Primary Start Minute", minval=0, maxval=59)
endHour     = input.int(18, "Primary End Hour", minval=0, maxval=23)
endMinute   = input.int(15, "Primary End Minute", minval=0, maxval=59)

// === Color Settings === //
highColor     = input.color(color.green, "High Line Color")
lowColor      = input.color(color.red, "Low Line Color")
midColor      = input.color(color.yellow, "Midpoint Line Color")
cloudTopColor = input.color(color.new(color.green, 86), "High-Mid Cloud")
cloudBotColor = input.color(color.new(color.red, 86), "Low-Mid Cloud")

// === Display Toggles === //
showOpeningHigh      = input.bool(true, "Show Opening High Line")
showOpeningLow       = input.bool(true, "Show Opening Low Line")
showOpeningMidpoint  = input.bool(true, "Show Opening Midpoint Line")

// === Alert Toggles === //
alertAboveHigh = input.bool(true, "Enable Alert: Cross Above Opening High")
alertBelowLow  = input.bool(true, "Enable Alert: Cross Below Opening Low")
alertMidPoint  = input.bool(true, "Enable Alert: Cross Opening Midpoint")

// === Fib Levels === //
fibColorDefault = input.color(color.teal, "Default Fib Line Color")
fib_m0236Color = input.color(color.teal, "Fib -0.236 Color")
fib_m0382Color = input.color(color.teal, "Fib -0.382 Color")
fib_m0500Color = input.color(color.teal, "Fib -0.50 Color")
fib_m0618Color = input.color(color.orange, "Fib -0.618 Color")
fib_m0786Color = input.color(color.teal, "Fib -0.786 Color")
fib_m1000Color = input.color(color.teal, "Fib -1.0 Color")
fib_1236Color = input.color(color.teal, "Fib 0.236 Color")
fib_1382Color = input.color(color.teal, "Fib 0.382 Color")
fib_1500Color = input.color(color.teal, "Fib 0.50 Color")
fib_1618Color = input.color(color.orange, "Fib 0.618 Color")
fib_1786Color = input.color(color.teal, "Fib 0.786 Color")
fib_2000Color = input.color(color.teal, "Fib 1.0 Color")
fib_2236Color = input.color(color.teal, "Fib 1.236 Color")
fib_00382Color = input.color(color.teal, "Fib -1.382 Color")
fib_0500Color = input.color(color.teal, "Fib -1.5 Color")
fib_00618Color = input.color(color.orange, "Fib -1.618 Color")
fib_00718Color = input.color(color.teal, "Fib -1.718 Color")
fib_001000Color = input.color(color.teal, "Fib -2.0 Color")
fib0786_betweenColor = input.color(color.orange, "Fib 0.786 (Within Range) Color")
fib0618_betweenColor = input.color(color.orange, "Fib 0.618 (Within Range) Color")
fib00786_betweenColor = input.color(color.orange, "Fib -0.786 (Within Range) Color")
fib00618_betweenColor = input.color(color.orange, "Fib -0.618 (Within Range) Color")

// === Show Fibonacci Levels Toggle === //
showFibLevels = input.bool(true, "Show Fibonacci Levels")
showAllFibExtensions = input.bool(false, "Show All Fibonacci Extensions", inline="allfib")

// === Time Helpers === //
startT   = timestamp("America/New_York", year, month, dayofmonth, startHour, startMinute)
endT     = timestamp("America/New_York", year, month, dayofmonth, endHour, endMinute)

inPrimary = time >= startT and time <= endT
afterPrimary = time > endT

// === Track Daily Session Change === //
isNewDay = ta.change(time("D"))

// === Primary Range Calculations === //
var float rangeHigh = na
var float rangeLow  = na
var float rangeMid  = na
var float fib0786_between = na
var float fib0618_between = na
var float fib0214_between = na
var float fib0382_between = na

if isNewDay
    rangeHigh := na
    rangeLow := na
    rangeMid := na
    fib0786_between := na
    fib0618_between := na
    fib0214_between := na
    fib0382_between := na

if inPrimary
    rangeHigh := na(rangeHigh) ? high : math.max(rangeHigh, high)
    rangeLow  := na(rangeLow)  ? low  : math.min(rangeLow, low)

if afterPrimary and na(rangeMid)
    rangeMid := (rangeHigh + rangeLow) / 2
    fib0786_between := rangeLow + (rangeHigh - rangeLow) * 0.786
    fib0618_between := rangeLow + (rangeHigh - rangeLow) * 0.618
    fib0214_between := rangeLow + (rangeHigh - rangeLow) * 0.214
    fib0382_between := rangeLow + (rangeHigh - rangeLow) * 0.382

// === Plotting Primary Range === //
plot1 = plot(rangeHigh, title="Opening High", color=highColor, linewidth=1, display=showOpeningHigh ? display.all : display.none)
plot2 = plot(rangeLow,  title="Opening Low",  color=lowColor,  linewidth=1, display=showOpeningLow ? display.all : display.none)
plot3 = plot(rangeMid,  title="Opening Midpoint", color=midColor, linewidth=1, display=showOpeningMidpoint ? display.all : display.none)

fill(plot1, plot3, color=cloudTopColor, title="High-Mid Cloud")
fill(plot3, plot2, color=cloudBotColor, title="Low-Mid Cloud")

// === Fibonacci Projections === //
rangeComplete = not na(rangeHigh) and not na(rangeLow)
rangeSize = rangeHigh - rangeLow
fibLevels = showFibLevels and rangeComplete


fib_m0236 = rangeLow - rangeSize * 0.236
fib_m0382 = rangeLow - rangeSize * 0.382
fib_m0500 = rangeLow - rangeSize * 0.5
fib_m0618 = rangeLow - rangeSize * 0.618
fib_m0786 = rangeLow - rangeSize * 0.786
fib_m1000 = rangeLow - rangeSize * 1.0
fib_m00236 = rangeLow - rangeSize * 1.236
fib_m00382 = rangeLow - rangeSize * 1.382
fib_m00500 = rangeLow - rangeSize * 1.5
fib_m00618 = rangeLow - rangeSize * 1.618
fib_m00786 = rangeLow - rangeSize * 1.786
fib_m001000 = rangeLow - rangeSize * 2.0
fib_1236 = rangeHigh + rangeSize * 0.236
fib_1382 = rangeHigh + rangeSize * 0.382
fib_1500 = rangeHigh + rangeSize * 0.5
fib_1618 = rangeHigh + rangeSize * 0.618
fib_1786 = rangeHigh + rangeSize * 0.786
fib_2000 = rangeHigh + rangeSize * 1.0
fib_2236 = rangeHigh + rangeSize * 1.236
fib_2382 = rangeHigh + rangeSize * 1.382
fib_2500 = rangeHigh + rangeSize * 1.5
fib_2618 = rangeHigh + rangeSize * 1.618
fib_2718 = rangeHigh + rangeSize * 1.718
fib_3000 = rangeHigh + rangeSize * 2.0

plot(fibLevels ? fib_m0236 : na, title="-0.236", color=fib_m0236Color, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(fibLevels ? fib_m0382 : na, title="-0.382", color=fib_m0382Color, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(fibLevels ? fib_m0500 : na, title="-0.50",  color=fib_m0500Color, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(fibLevels ? fib_m0618 : na, title="-0.618", color=fib_m0618Color, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(fibLevels ? fib_m0786 : na, title="-0.786", color=fib_m0786Color, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(fibLevels ? fib_m1000 : na, title="-1",     color=fib_m1000Color, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)

plot(fibLevels ? fib_1236 : na, title="1.236", color=fib_1236Color, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(fibLevels ? fib_1382 : na, title="1.382", color=fib_1382Color, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(fibLevels ? fib_1500 : na, title="1.50",  color=fib_1500Color, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(fibLevels ? fib_1618 : na, title="1.618", color=fib_1618Color, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(fibLevels ? fib_1786 : na, title="1.786", color=fib_1786Color, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(fibLevels ? fib_2000 : na, title="2.0",   color=fib_2000Color, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)

plot(showAllFibExtensions ? fib_2236 : na, title="1.236", color=fib_2236Color, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(showAllFibExtensions ? fib_2382 : na, title="1.382", color=fib_00382Color, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(showAllFibExtensions ? fib_2500 : na, title="1.5",   color=fib_1500Color, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(showAllFibExtensions ? fib_2618 : na, title="1.618", color=fib_1618Color, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(showAllFibExtensions ? fib_2718 : na, title="1.718", color=fib_00718Color, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(showAllFibExtensions ? fib_3000 : na, title="2.0",   color=fib_2000Color, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(showAllFibExtensions ? fib_m00236 : na, title="-1.236", color=fib_2236Color, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(showAllFibExtensions ? fib_m00382 : na, title="-1.382", color=fib_00382Color, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(showAllFibExtensions ? fib_m00500 : na, title="-1.5",   color=fib_0500Color, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(showAllFibExtensions ? fib_m00618 : na, title="-1.618", color=fib_00618Color, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(showAllFibExtensions ? fib_m00786 : na, title="-1.718", color=fib_00718Color, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(showAllFibExtensions ? fib_m001000 : na, title="-2.0",   color=fib_001000Color, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)

plot(fibLevels and not na(fib0786_between) ? fib0786_between : na, title="Fib 0.786 Between", color=fib0786_betweenColor, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(fibLevels and not na(fib0618_between) ? fib0618_between : na, title="Fib 0.618 Between", color=fib0618_betweenColor, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(fibLevels and not na(fib0214_between) ? fib0214_between : na, title="Fib 0.214 Between", color=fib00786_betweenColor, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(fibLevels and not na(fib0382_between) ? fib0382_between : na, title="Fib 0.382 Between", color=fib00618_betweenColor, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)

items.author: ilfauno
items.source:
//@version=5
indicator("ORB 15m + AVWAP (Futures) [Stable Lines]", overlay=true)

// ===== INPUTS =====
orbMinutes = input.int(15, "ORB Minutes")
showVWAP   = input.bool(true, "Show AVWAP")

// ===== SESSION =====
inSession = not na(time(timeframe.period, "0930-1600"))
newSession = inSession and not inSession[1]

// Track bars since open
var int barCount = 0
if newSession
    barCount := 0
else if inSession
    barCount += 1

barsInORB = math.round(orbMinutes / timeframe.multiplier)

// ===== ORB CALC =====
var float orbHigh = na
var float orbLow  = na

if newSession
    orbHigh := high
    orbLow  := low
else if inSession and barCount < barsInORB
    orbHigh := math.max(orbHigh, high)
    orbLow  := math.min(orbLow, low)

// ===== DRAW LINES =====
var line highLine = na
var line lowLine  = na

// When ORB completes → draw new lines
if barCount == barsInORB
    // delete previous day's lines
    line.delete(highLine)
    line.delete(lowLine)

    // create new ones
    highLine := line.new(bar_index, orbHigh, bar_index + 1, orbHigh, extend=extend.right, color=color.green, width=2)
    lowLine  := line.new(bar_index, orbLow,  bar_index + 1, orbLow,  extend=extend.right, color=color.red, width=2)

// ===== AVWAP =====
var float cumVol = 0.0
var float cumPV  = 0.0

if newSession
    cumVol := volume
    cumPV  := hlc3 * volume
else if inSession
    cumVol += volume
    cumPV  += hlc3 * volume

avwap = cumPV / cumVol

plot(showVWAP and inSession ? avwap : na, "AVWAP", color=color.blue, linewidth=2)

lineHighColor = input.color(color.green, "High Line Color", inline="HighLine", group=groupVisual)
lineLowColor = input.color(color.red, "Low Line Color", inline="LowLine", group=groupVisual)
lineMidColor = input.color(color.gray, "Mid Line Color", inline="MidLine", group=groupVisual)
lineWidth = input.int(2, "Line Width", minval=1, maxval=5, group=groupVisual)
showMidLine = input.bool(true, "Show Mid Line", group=groupVisual)

// Alert Settings
groupAlerts = "Alert Settings"
enableBreakoutAlerts = input.bool(false, "Enable Breakout Alerts", group=groupAlerts)
alertHighBreakoutMessage = input.string("Price broke above the first 15-minute high!", "High Breakout Message", group=groupAlerts)
alertLowBreakoutMessage = input.string("Price broke below the first 15-minute low!", "Low Breakout Message", group=groupAlerts)

// Variables to track the high, low, and mid-point of the first 15-minute candle
var float firstCandleHigh = na
var float firstCandleLow = na
var float firstCandleMid = na
var line highLine = na
var line lowLine = na
var line midLine = na
var int startBarIndex = na

// Check if the timeframe is 15 minutes or lower
is15MinOrLower = timeframe.isintraday and timeframe.multiplier <= 15

// Determine if we are in the first 15-minute candle
isFirst15MinCandle = is15MinOrLower and (hour(time) == marketHour and minute(time) >= marketMinute and minute(time) < marketMinute + 15)

// Reset the high, low, and mid values and delete previous lines at the session start
if is15MinOrLower and (hour(time) == marketHour and minute(time) == marketMinute)
    firstCandleHigh := na
    firstCandleLow := na
    firstCandleMid := na
    if not na(highLine)
        line.delete(highLine)
    if not na(lowLine)
        line.delete(lowLine)
    if not na(midLine)
        line.delete(midLine)
    highLine := na
    lowLine := na
    midLine := na
    startBarIndex := bar_index  // Capture the starting bar index at the configured market start time

// Record the high, low, and calculate the mid-point of the first 15-minute candle
if isFirst15MinCandle
    firstCandleHigh := na(firstCandleHigh) ? high : math.max(firstCandleHigh, high)
    firstCandleLow := na(firstCandleLow) ? low : math.min(firstCandleLow, low)
    firstCandleMid := na(firstCandleHigh) or na(firstCandleLow) ? na : (firstCandleHigh + firstCandleLow) / 2

// Check if the bar belongs to the current day
isCurrentDay = year == year(timenow) and month == month(timenow) and dayofmonth == dayofmonth(timenow)

// Draw horizontal lines for the high, low, and mid-point of the first 15-minute candle after the candle closes
if is15MinOrLower and not na(firstCandleHigh) and na(highLine) and not isFirst15MinCandle
    highLine := line.new(x1=startBarIndex, y1=firstCandleHigh, x2=bar_index, y2=firstCandleHigh, color=lineHighColor, width=lineWidth, extend=extend.right)
if is15MinOrLower and not na(firstCandleLow) and na(lowLine) and not isFirst15MinCandle
    lowLine := line.new(x1=startBarIndex, y1=firstCandleLow, x2=bar_index, y2=firstCandleLow, color=lineLowColor, width=lineWidth, extend=extend.right)
if is15MinOrLower and showMidLine and not na(firstCandleMid) and na(midLine) and not isFirst15MinCandle
    midLine := line.new(x1=startBarIndex, y1=firstCandleMid, x2=bar_index, y2=firstCandleMid, color=lineMidColor, width=lineWidth, extend=extend.right)

// Plot background color to identify the first 15-minute candle of the current day
bgcolor(is15MinOrLower and bgShow and isFirst15MinCandle and isCurrentDay ? bgColorInput : na)

// Trigger alerts for breakouts
if is15MinOrLower and enableBreakoutAlerts and not isFirst15MinCandle
    if not na(firstCandleHigh) and close > firstCandleHigh
        alert(alertHighBreakoutMessage, alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)
    if not na(firstCandleLow) and close < firstCandleLow
        alert(alertLowBreakoutMessage, alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)

// Define breakout conditions
highBreakout = is15MinOrLower and not na(firstCandleHigh) and close > firstCandleHigh and not isFirst15MinCandle
lowBreakout = is15MinOrLower and not na(firstCandleLow) and close < firstCandleLow and not isFirst15MinCandle

// Create alert conditions
alertcondition(highBreakout, title="High Breakout", message="Price broke above the first 15-minute high!")
alertcondition(lowBreakout, title="Low Breakout", message="Price broke below the first 15-minute low!")

//@version=6
indicator("5-Min First Candle Breakout/Breakdown", overlay=true)

// Input session start time
startHour = input.int(9, "Session Start Hour", minval=0, maxval=23)
startMinute = input.int(15, "Session Start Minute", minval=0, maxval=59)
firstCandleTime = timestamp("GMT+5:30", year, month, dayofmonth, startHour, startMinute)

// Identify the first 5-min candle of the day
isFirstCandle = (time == firstCandleTime)

// Store high and low of first candle
var float firstHigh = na
var float firstLow = na
if isFirstCandle
    firstHigh := high
    firstLow := low

// Carry forward the values after first candle
firstHigh := na(firstHigh) ? firstHigh[1] : firstHigh
firstLow := na(firstLow) ? firstLow[1] : firstLow

// Plot breakout and breakdown lines
plot(firstHigh, title="First Candle High", color=color.green, linewidth=2)
plot(firstLow, title="First Candle Low", color=color.red, linewidth=2)

// Generate signals
longSignal = ta.crossover(close, firstHigh)
shortSignal = ta.crossunder(close, firstLow)

// Plot Buy/Sell signals
plotshape(longSignal, title="Buy Signal", location=location.belowbar, color=color.green, style=shape.labelup, text="BUY", textcolor=color.white)
plotshape(shortSignal, title="Sell Signal", location=location.abovebar, color=color.red, style=shape.labeldown, text="SELL", textcolor=color.white)

// Price Labels on signal
if longSignal
    label.new(bar_index, low, "Buy @ " + str.tostring(close, format.mintick), style=label.style_label_up, color=color.green, textcolor=color.white)

if shortSignal
    label.new(bar_index, high, "Sell @ " + str.tostring(close, format.mintick), style=label.style_label_down, color=color.red, textcolor=color.white)

items.name: First 12 Candles High/Low Breakout
items.title: First 12 Candles High/Low Breakout
items.author: anmolsunnysingh
items.source:
//@version=5
indicator("First 12 Candles High/Low Breakout", overlay=true)

// User inputs for manual testing
session_start = input.time(timestamp("2023-01-01 09:30 GMT-4"), title="Session Start Time", confirm=true)
num_candles = input.int(12, title="Number of Candles for High/Low", minval=1)
target_points = input.int(100, title="Target Points")
stop_loss_points = input.int(100, title="Stop Loss Points")

// Calculate the end time of the specified period
var int session_duration_minutes = 5 * num_candles
session_end = session_start + session_duration_minutes * 60 * 1000

// Capture the high and low of the specified number of candles
var float high_level = na
var float low_level = na

if (time >= session_start and time < session_end)
    high_level := na(high_level) ? high : math.max(high_level, high)
    low_level := na(low_level) ? low : math.min(low_level, low)

plot(high_level, title="High Level", color=color.green, linewidth=2)
plot(low_level, title="Low Level", color=color.red, linewidth=2)

// Check for breakout and set targets
var bool buy_signal = false
var bool sell_signal = false
var float entry_price = na
var float tp_price = na
var float sl_price = na

if (not na(high_level) and not na(low_level))
    if (not buy_signal and not sell_signal)
        if (close > high_level)
            buy_signal := true
            entry_price := close
            tp_price := entry_price + target_points
            sl_price := entry_price - stop_loss_points
            label.new(x=bar_index, y=entry_price, text="Buy", color=color.green, style=label.style_label_down, textcolor=color.white)
            label.new(x=bar_index, y=tp_price, text="TP", color=color.blue, style=label.style_label_up, textcolor=color.white)
            label.new(x=bar_index, y=sl_price, text="SL", color=color.red, style=label.style_label_down, textcolor=color.white)
            label.new(x=bar_index, y=entry_price, text="Buy: " + str.tostring(entry_price), color=color.green, style=label.style_label_down, textcolor=color.white)
            label.new(x=bar_index, y=tp_price, text="TP: " + str.tostring(tp_price), color=color.blue, style=label.style_label_up, textcolor=color.white)
            label.new(x=bar_index, y=sl_price, text="SL: " + str.tostring(sl_price), color=color.red, style=label.style_label_down, textcolor=color.white)
        else if (close < low_level)
            sell_signal := true
            entry_price := close
            tp_price := entry_price - target_points
            sl_price := entry_price + stop_loss_points
            label.new(x=bar_index, y=entry_price, text="Sell", color=color.red, style=label.style_label_down, textcolor=color.white)
            label.new(x=bar_index, y=tp_price, text="TP", color=color.blue, style=label.style_label_down, textcolor=color.white)
            label.new(x=bar_index, y=sl_price, text="SL", color=color.green, style=label.style_label_up, textcolor=color.white)
            label.new(x=bar_index, y=entry_price, text="Sell: " + str.tostring(entry_price), color=color.red, style=label.style_label_down, textcolor=color.white)
            label.new(x=bar_index, y=tp_price, text="TP: " + str.tostring(tp_price), color=color.blue, style=label.style_label_down, textcolor=color.white)
            label.new(x=bar_index, y=sl_price, text="SL: " + str.tostring(sl_price), color=color.green, style=label.style_label_up, textcolor=color.white)

// Plot the entry, TP, and SL lines
plot(entry_price, title="Entry Price", color=color.yellow, linewidth=2, style=plot.style_stepline)
plot(tp_price, title="Take Profit Price", color=color.blue, linewidth=2, style=plot.style_stepline)
plot(sl_price, title="Stop Loss Price", color=color.red, linewidth=2, style=plot.style_stepline)

// This work is licensed under a Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/

//@version=6
indicator('Initial Balance Breakout Signals [LuxAlgo]','LuxAlgo - Initial Balance Breakout Signals', overlay = true, max_lines_count = 500, max_boxes_count = 500, max_labels_count = 500)
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
//CONSTANTS & STRINGS & INPUTS
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{
GREEN                   = #089981
RED                     = #F23645
SILVER_50               = color.new(color.silver,50)

DOTTED                  = 'Dotted'
DASHED                  = 'Dashed'
SOLID                   = 'Solid'

FORECAST1               = 'IB Against Previous Open'
FORECAST2               = 'Filter By Current Day Of Week'

EM_SPACE                = ' '
EN_SPACE                = ' '
FOUR_PER_EM_SPACE       = ' '
SIX_PER_EM_SPACE        = ' '

initialBalanceSpacing   = SIX_PER_EM_SPACE+SIX_PER_EM_SPACE
extensionSpacing        = EM_SPACE+EN_SPACE+SIX_PER_EM_SPACE
forecastSpacing         = EM_SPACE+FOUR_PER_EM_SPACE+FOUR_PER_EM_SPACE

EXTENSION_GROUP         = 'EXTENSIONS'
FIBONACCI_GROUP         = 'FIBONACCI LEVELS'
FORECAST_GROUP          = 'FORECAST'
STYLE_GROUP             = 'STYLE'

forecastMethodTooltip   = 'Select the forecast method.\nIB Against Previous Open calculates the average difference between the IB high and low and the previous day\'s IB open price.\nFilter by Current Day of Week option calculates the average difference between the IB high and low and the IB open price for the same day of the week.'
forecastLengthTooltip   = 'The number of data points used to calculate the average.'
forecastMultTooltip     = 'This multiplier will be applied to the average. Bigger numbers will result in wider predicted ranges.'

initialBalanceSizeInput = input.int(    10,         'Display Last X IBs',                       inline = 'ibAll',   minval = 1)
displayAllInput         = input.bool(   true,       'Display All',                              inline = 'ibAll')
initialBalanceInput     = input.session('0830-0930','Initial Balance'+initialBalanceSpacing,    inline = 'ib0')
initialBalanceAutoInput = input.bool(   true,       'Auto',                                     inline = 'ib0')
breakoutsInput          = input.bool(   true,       'Breakouts',                                inline = 'break0')
breakoutsSessionInput   = input.session('0930-0830','',                                         inline = 'break0')
breakoutsAutoInput      = input.bool(   true,       'Auto',                                     inline = 'break0')

topExtensionInput       = input.bool(   true,       'Top Extension %'+extensionSpacing, group = EXTENSION_GROUP,    inline = 'top')
topMultiplierInput      = input.int(    50,         '',                                 group = EXTENSION_GROUP,    inline = 'top',     minval = 1, step = 5) / 100
bottomExtensionInput    = input.bool(   true,       'Bottom Extension %',               group = EXTENSION_GROUP,    inline = 'bottom')
bottomMultiplierInput   = input.int(    50,         '',                                 group = EXTENSION_GROUP,    inline = 'bottom',  minval = 1, step = 5) / 100

fibonacciInput          = input.bool(   true,       'Display Fibonnaci',                group = FIBONACCI_GROUP)
fiboReverseInput        = input.bool(   false,      'Reverse',                          group = FIBONACCI_GROUP)

fiboLevel5DisplayInput  = input.bool(   true,       '',     group = FIBONACCI_GROUP,    inline = 'fibo5')
fiboLevel5Input         = input.float(  0.786,      '',     group = FIBONACCI_GROUP,    inline = 'fibo5')
fiboLevel5ColorInput    = input.color(  SILVER_50,  '',     group = FIBONACCI_GROUP,    inline = 'fibo5')
fiboLevel5StyleInput    = input.string( DASHED,     '',     group = FIBONACCI_GROUP,    inline = 'fibo5',   options = [DOTTED,DASHED,SOLID])

fiboLevel4DisplayInput  = input.bool(   true,       '',     group = FIBONACCI_GROUP,    inline = 'fibo4')
fiboLevel4Input         = input.float(  0.618,      '',     group = FIBONACCI_GROUP,    inline = 'fibo4')
fiboLevel4ColorInput    = input.color(  SILVER_50,  '',     group = FIBONACCI_GROUP,    inline = 'fibo4')
fiboLevel4StyleInput    = input.string( DASHED,     '',     group = FIBONACCI_GROUP,    inline = 'fibo4',   options = [DOTTED,DASHED,SOLID])

fiboLevel3DisplayInput  = input.bool(   true,       '',     group = FIBONACCI_GROUP,    inline = 'fibo3')
fiboLevel3Input         = input.float(  0.500,      '',     group = FIBONACCI_GROUP,    inline = 'fibo3')
fiboLevel3ColorInput    = input.color(  SILVER_50,  '',     group = FIBONACCI_GROUP,    inline = 'fibo3')
fiboLevel3StyleInput    = input.string( DASHED,     '',     group = FIBONACCI_GROUP,    inline = 'fibo3',   options = [DOTTED,DASHED,SOLID])

fiboLevel2DisplayInput  = input.bool(   true,       '',     group = FIBONACCI_GROUP,    inline = 'fibo2')
fiboLevel2Input         = input.float(  0.382,      '',     group = FIBONACCI_GROUP,    inline = 'fibo2')
fiboLevel2ColorInput    = input.color(  SILVER_50,  '',     group = FIBONACCI_GROUP,    inline = 'fibo2')
fiboLevel2StyleInput    = input.string( DASHED,     '',     group = FIBONACCI_GROUP,    inline = 'fibo2',   options = [DOTTED,DASHED,SOLID])

fiboLevel1DisplayInput  = input.bool(   true,       '',     group = FIBONACCI_GROUP,    inline = 'fibo1')
fiboLevel1Input         = input.float(  0.236,      '',     group = FIBONACCI_GROUP,    inline = 'fibo1')
fiboLevel1ColorInput    = input.color(  SILVER_50,  '',     group = FIBONACCI_GROUP,    inline = 'fibo1')
fiboLevel1StyleInput    = input.string( DASHED,     '',     group = FIBONACCI_GROUP,    inline = 'fibo1',   options = [DOTTED,DASHED,SOLID])

fibosLabelsInput        = input.bool(   false,      'Display Labels'+FOUR_PER_EM_SPACE,                    group = FIBONACCI_GROUP,    inline = 'fiboLabels')
fibosLabelSizeInput     = input.int(    10,         '|'+FOUR_PER_EM_SPACE+' Text Size'+FOUR_PER_EM_SPACE,   group = FIBONACCI_GROUP,    inline = 'fiboLabels')

forecastInput           = input.bool(   true,       'Display Forecast'+forecastSpacing, group = FORECAST_GROUP,     inline = 'forecast')
forecastModeInput       = input.string( FORECAST1,  '',                                 group = FORECAST_GROUP,     tooltip = forecastMethodTooltip,    options = [FORECAST1,FORECAST2], inline = 'forecast')
forecastLengthInput     = input.int(    10,         'Forecast Memory',                  group = FORECAST_GROUP,     tooltip = forecastLengthTooltip,    minval = 2)
forecastMultiplierInput = input.float(  1.0,        'Forecast Multiplier',              group = FORECAST_GROUP,     tooltip = forecastMultTooltip,      minval = 0.1,   step = 0.25)

forecastTopColorInput   = input.color(  GREEN,      'Forecast Top Color',               group = FORECAST_GROUP)
forecastBottomColorInput= input.color(  RED,        'Forecast Bottom Color',            group = FORECAST_GROUP)
forecastStyleInput      = input.string( DOTTED,     'Forecast Style',                   group = FORECAST_GROUP,     options = [DOTTED,DASHED,SOLID])

ibTopColorInput         = input.color(  GREEN,      'IB Top Color',                     group = STYLE_GROUP)
ibBottomColorInput      = input.color(  RED,        'IB Bottom Color',                  group = STYLE_GROUP)
transparencyInput       = input.int(    80,         'Extension Transparency',           group = STYLE_GROUP,        minval = 0, maxval = 100)

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
//DATA STRUCTURES & VARIABLES
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{
type initialBalance
    int startTime
    int endTime    
    int dayOfWeek
    float openPrice
    float top
    float bottom
    int endOfSession
    array<line> lines
    box background
    array<line> fibos
    array<label> labels
    array<line> forecast
    float forecastTop
    float forecastBottom

type forecastData
    float top
    float bottom

type forecastArray
    array<float> tops
    array<float> bottoms

var array<initialBalance> initialBalances       = array.new<initialBalance>()
var forecastData currentForecast                = forecastData.new(na,na)
var forecastArray simpleForecastArray           = forecastArray.new(array.new<float>(),array.new<float>())
var array<forecastArray> dayOfWeekForecastArray = array.from(forecastArray.new(array.new<float>(),array.new<float>()),forecastArray.new(array.new<float>(),array.new<float>()),forecastArray.new(array.new<float>(),array.new<float>()),
     forecastArray.new(array.new<float>(),array.new<float>()),forecastArray.new(array.new<float>(),array.new<float>()),forecastArray.new(array.new<float>(),array.new<float>()),forecastArray.new(array.new<float>(),array.new<float>()),
     forecastArray.new(array.new<float>(),array.new<float>()))

bool forecastFilter         = forecastModeInput == FORECAST2
var int autoIBStartTime     = time
autoIBStartTime             := session.isfirstbar_regular ? time : autoIBStartTime
int autoIBEndTime           = autoIBStartTime + 3600000
insideAutoInitialBalance    = time >= autoIBStartTime and time < autoIBEndTime
insideAutoBreakoutsSession  = time >= autoIBEndTime
insideInitialBalance        = initialBalanceAutoInput ? insideAutoInitialBalance : not na(time(timeframe.period, initialBalanceInput))
initialBalanceStart         = insideInitialBalance and not insideInitialBalance[1]
insideBreakoutsSession      = breakoutsAutoInput ? insideAutoBreakoutsSession : not na(time(timeframe.period, breakoutsSessionInput))

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
//USER-DEFINED FUNCTIONS
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{
updateCurrentForecast() =>
    if initialBalances.size() > 0
        forecastArray f_orecastArray    = forecastFilter ? dayOfWeekForecastArray.get(dayofweek) : simpleForecastArray
        float openPrice                 = forecastFilter ? open : initialBalances.get(-1).openPrice
        currentForecast.top             := openPrice + forecastMultiplierInput * f_orecastArray.tops.avg()
        currentForecast.bottom          := openPrice + forecastMultiplierInput * f_orecastArray.bottoms.avg()    

addForecastData(float top, float bottom, float openPrice, int dayOfWeek) =>    
    forecastArray f_orecastArray = not na(dayOfWeek) ? dayOfWeekForecastArray.get(dayOfWeek) : simpleForecastArray    
    f_orecastArray.tops.push(top - openPrice)
    f_orecastArray.bottoms.push(bottom - openPrice)

    if f_orecastArray.tops.size() > forecastLengthInput
        f_orecastArray.tops.shift()
        f_orecastArray.bottoms.shift()

gatherForecastData() =>
    float top       = 0
    float bottom    = 0
    if initialBalances.size() >= 2
        initialBalance currentInitialBalance = initialBalances.get(-1)        
        if forecastFilter
            addForecastData(currentInitialBalance.top, currentInitialBalance.bottom, currentInitialBalance.openPrice, currentInitialBalance.dayOfWeek)            
        else
            initialBalance lastInitialBalance = initialBalances.get(-2)
            addForecastData(currentInitialBalance.top, currentInitialBalance.bottom, lastInitialBalance.openPrice, na)            

gatherData() =>
    if initialBalanceStart
        if forecastInput                    
            gatherForecastData()
            updateCurrentForecast()
        initialBalances.push(initialBalance.new(time,time,dayofweek,open,high,low,time,array.new<line>(),na,array.new<line>(),array.new<label>(),array.new<line>(),currentForecast.top,currentForecast.bottom))

    if initialBalances.size() > 0
        initialBalance currentInitialBalance= initialBalances.last()
        currentInitialBalance.endOfSession  := time
        
        if insideInitialBalance            
            currentInitialBalance.endTime   := time
            currentInitialBalance.top       := math.max(currentInitialBalance.top,high)
            currentInitialBalance.bottom    := math.min(currentInitialBalance.bottom,low)                    

breakouts() =>    
    bool bullishBreakout = false
    bool bearishBreakout = false
    
    if breakoutsInput and initialBalances.size() > 0 and insideBreakoutsSession
        initialBalance currentInitialBalance = initialBalances.last()
        bullishBreakout := close[1] < currentInitialBalance.top and close > currentInitialBalance.top
        bearishBreakout := close[1] > currentInitialBalance.bottom and close < currentInitialBalance.bottom

    [bullishBreakout,bearishBreakout]

style(string style) =>
    switch style
        DOTTED  => line.style_dotted
        DASHED  => line.style_dashed
        SOLID   => line.style_solid

drawFibonacciLevel(bool drawLevel, initialBalance currentInitialBalance, float fibonacciLevel, color fibonacciColor, string fibonacciStyle) =>
    if drawLevel
        float fibonacciRange    = math.round_to_mintick(fibonacciLevel * (currentInitialBalance.top - currentInitialBalance.bottom))
        float priceLevel        = fiboReverseInput ? currentInitialBalance.bottom + fibonacciRange : currentInitialBalance.top - fibonacciRange
        chart.point lastPoint   = chart.point.new(currentInitialBalance.endOfSession,na,priceLevel)
        currentInitialBalance.fibos.push(line.new(chart.point.new(currentInitialBalance.startTime,na,priceLevel),lastPoint,xloc.bar_time, color = fibonacciColor, style = fibonacciStyle, width = 1))
        
        if fibosLabelsInput
            currentInitialBalance.labels.push(label.new(lastPoint,str.format('{0} ({1})',fibonacciLevel,priceLevel),xloc = xloc.bar_time, yloc = yloc.price, color = color(na), textcolor = fibonacciColor, style = label.style_label_left, size = fibosLabelSizeInput))

drawFibonnaciLevels(initialBalance currentInitialBalance) =>

    for eachLine in currentInitialBalance.fibos
        eachLine.delete()

    for eachLabel in currentInitialBalance.labels
        eachLabel.delete()    

    drawFibonacciLevel(fiboLevel1DisplayInput,currentInitialBalance,fiboLevel1Input,fiboLevel1ColorInput,style(fiboLevel1StyleInput))
    drawFibonacciLevel(fiboLevel2DisplayInput,currentInitialBalance,fiboLevel2Input,fiboLevel2ColorInput,style(fiboLevel2StyleInput))
    drawFibonacciLevel(fiboLevel3DisplayInput,currentInitialBalance,fiboLevel3Input,fiboLevel3ColorInput,style(fiboLevel3StyleInput))
    drawFibonacciLevel(fiboLevel4DisplayInput,currentInitialBalance,fiboLevel4Input,fiboLevel4ColorInput,style(fiboLevel4StyleInput))   
    drawFibonacciLevel(fiboLevel5DisplayInput,currentInitialBalance,fiboLevel5Input,fiboLevel5ColorInput,style(fiboLevel5StyleInput))

drawInitialBalanceLevel(initialBalance currentInitialBalance,float level, bool extension, float multiplier, color c_olor) =>
    currentInitialBalance.lines.push(line.new(chart.point.new(currentInitialBalance.startTime,na,level),chart.point.new(currentInitialBalance.endOfSession,na,level),xloc.bar_time, color = c_olor, width = 1))            
    if extension
        float extensionLevel = math.round_to_mintick(level + multiplier * (currentInitialBalance.top - currentInitialBalance.bottom))
        currentInitialBalance.lines.push(line.new(chart.point.new(currentInitialBalance.startTime,na,extensionLevel),chart.point.new(currentInitialBalance.endOfSession,na,extensionLevel),xloc.bar_time, color = c_olor, width = 1))
        linefill.new(currentInitialBalance.lines.get(-1),currentInitialBalance.lines.get(-2), color.new(c_olor,transparencyInput))

drawForecast(initialBalance currentInitialBalance) =>
    for eachLine in currentInitialBalance.forecast
        eachLine.delete()
    currentInitialBalance.forecast.push(line.new(chart.point.new(currentInitialBalance.startTime,na,currentInitialBalance.forecastTop),chart.point.new(currentInitialBalance.endOfSession,na,currentInitialBalance.forecastTop),xloc.bar_time, color = forecastTopColorInput, width = 1, style = style(forecastStyleInput)))            
    currentInitialBalance.forecast.push(line.new(chart.point.new(currentInitialBalance.startTime,na,currentInitialBalance.forecastBottom),chart.point.new(currentInitialBalance.endOfSession,na,currentInitialBalance.forecastBottom),xloc.bar_time, color = forecastBottomColorInput, width = 1, style = style(forecastStyleInput)))            

drawInitialBalance(initialBalance currentInitialBalance) =>
    if forecastInput
        drawForecast(currentInitialBalance)

    if fibonacciInput
        drawFibonnaciLevels(currentInitialBalance)
                                    
    for eachLine in currentInitialBalance.lines
        eachLine.delete()

    drawInitialBalanceLevel(currentInitialBalance,currentInitialBalance.top,topExtensionInput,topMultiplierInput,ibTopColorInput)
    drawInitialBalanceLevel(currentInitialBalance,currentInitialBalance.bottom,bottomExtensionInput,-1*bottomMultiplierInput,ibBottomColorInput)            

    currentInitialBalance.background.delete()
    currentInitialBalance.background := box.new(chart.point.new(currentInitialBalance.startTime,na,currentInitialBalance.top),chart.point.new(currentInitialBalance.endTime,na,currentInitialBalance.bottom),border_color = color.new(color.silver,90),bgcolor = color.new(color.silver,90), xloc = xloc.bar_time)

drawInitialBalances(int initialBalanceNumber) =>
    size = initialBalances.size()
    if size > 0    
        int startIndex = size - (displayAllInput ? size : initialBalanceNumber)
        for currentInitialBalance in initialBalances.slice(startIndex,size)
            drawInitialBalance(currentInitialBalance)

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
//MUTABLE VARIABLES & EXECUTION
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{
gatherData()

[bullishBreakout,bearishBreakout] = breakouts()
plotshape(bullishBreakout,  'Bullish Breakout', shape.triangleup,   location.belowbar,  ibTopColorInput,    size = size.tiny)
plotshape(bearishBreakout,  'Bearish Breakout', shape.triangledown, location.abovebar,  ibBottomColorInput, size = size.tiny)

if barstate.islastconfirmedhistory
    drawInitialBalances(initialBalanceSizeInput)

if barstate.islast
    drawInitialBalance(initialBalances.last())
   
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
