items.title: Initial Balance Breakout (IBB)
items.author: Bnf6082
items.source:
// =============================================================================
// Initial Balance Breakout (IBB) Strategy — Pine Script v6
// Compatible: ES1!, NQ1!, YM1!, RTY1!, GC1! on 5-min timeframe
// =============================================================================
//@version=6
strategy(
     title                  = "Initial Balance Breakout (IBB)",
     shorttitle             = "IBB",
     overlay                = true,
     default_qty_type       = strategy.fixed,
     default_qty_value      = 1,
     commission_type        = strategy.commission.cash_per_contract,
     commission_value       = 2.50,
     slippage               = 1,
     pyramiding             = 0,
     calc_on_every_tick     = false,
     process_orders_on_close= true
 )

// =============================================================================
// INPUTS
// =============================================================================
var g_ib = "Initial Balance Window"
ib_start_hour   = input.int(9,  "IB Start Hour",   group=g_ib, minval=0, maxval=23)
ib_start_minute = input.int(30, "IB Start Minute", group=g_ib, minval=0, maxval=59)
ib_end_hour     = input.int(10, "IB End Hour",     group=g_ib, minval=0, maxval=23)
ib_end_minute   = input.int(30, "IB End Minute",   group=g_ib, minval=0, maxval=59)

var g_entry = "Entry Rules"
entry_window_end_hour   = input.int(13, "Entry Window End Hour",   group=g_entry, minval=0, maxval=23)
entry_window_end_minute = input.int(0,  "Entry Window End Minute", group=g_entry, minval=0, maxval=59)
retracement_pct  = input.float(25.0, "Retracement % for Entry", group=g_entry, minval=1, maxval=99, step=1)
min_ib_size_pct  = input.float(0.3,  "Min IB Size %",           group=g_entry, minval=0.05, step=0.05)
max_ib_size_pct  = input.float(1.5,  "Max IB Size %",           group=g_entry, minval=0.1,  step=0.1)

var g_exit = "Exit Rules"
close_hour      = input.int(15, "Time Stop Hour",   group=g_exit, minval=0, maxval=23)
close_minute    = input.int(30, "Time Stop Minute", group=g_exit, minval=0, maxval=59)
stop_pct_of_ib  = input.float(60.0, "Stop Loss % of IB Range", group=g_exit, minval=1, maxval=99, step=1)
tp1_multiplier  = input.float(0.50, "TP Multiplier (× IB)",    group=g_exit, minval=0.1, step=0.05)

var g_viz = "Visualization"
show_ib_lines = input.bool(true, "Show IB Lines",  group=g_viz)
show_ib_box   = input.bool(true, "Show IB Box",    group=g_viz)
show_labels   = input.bool(true, "Show IB Labels", group=g_viz)

// =============================================================================
// TIME HELPERS — all in America/New_York
// =============================================================================
ny_hour   = hour(time,   "America/New_York")
ny_minute = minute(time, "America/New_York")
ny_time   = ny_hour * 60 + ny_minute  // minutes since midnight ET

ib_start_mins         = ib_start_hour   * 60 + ib_start_minute   // 570 = 9:30
ib_end_mins           = ib_end_hour     * 60 + ib_end_minute      // 630 = 10:30
entry_window_end_mins = entry_window_end_hour * 60 + entry_window_end_minute
close_mins            = close_hour * 60 + close_minute

at_ib_start     = ny_time == ib_start_mins                        // first 5-min bar of IB (9:30)
in_ib_window    = ny_time >= ib_start_mins and ny_time < ib_end_mins
ib_just_closed  = ny_time == ib_end_mins                          // first bar after IB (10:30)
in_entry_window = ny_time >= ib_end_mins and ny_time < entry_window_end_mins
at_close_time   = ny_time >= close_mins

// =============================================================================
// DAILY STATE — reset every day at 9:30 ET (first IB bar)
// Using at_ib_start ensures we only reset once per session on a 24-hr futures chart
// =============================================================================
var float ib_high      = na
var float ib_low       = na
var float ib_range     = na
var bool  ib_valid     = false
var bool  ib_locked    = false
var bool  traded_today       = false
var bool  broke_high         = false
var bool  broke_low          = false
var bool  order_placed_today = false

if at_ib_start
    ib_high            := high
    ib_low             := low
    ib_locked          := false
    ib_valid           := false
    traded_today       := false
    broke_high         := false
    broke_low          := false
    order_placed_today := false

// Expand IB during the formation window
if in_ib_window and not ib_locked
    ib_high := math.max(ib_high, high)
    ib_low  := math.min(ib_low,  low)

// Lock IB at 10:30 and validate range
if ib_just_closed and not ib_locked and not na(ib_high)
    ib_locked  := true
    ib_range   := ib_high - ib_low
    ib_pct     = ib_high > 0 ? ib_range / ib_high * 100 : 0.0
    ib_valid   := ib_pct >= min_ib_size_pct and ib_pct <= max_ib_size_pct

// =============================================================================
// BREAKOUT TRACKING — accumulate within entry window
// =============================================================================
if ib_locked and ib_valid and in_entry_window and not traded_today
    if high > ib_high
        broke_high := true
    if low < ib_low
        broke_low  := true

// =============================================================================
// ENTRY SIGNALS — recalculated fresh every bar (no var)
// =============================================================================
retrace_long_zone  = not na(ib_high) and not na(ib_range) ? ib_high - ib_range * (retracement_pct / 100) : na
retrace_short_zone = not na(ib_low)  and not na(ib_range) ? ib_low  + ib_range * (retracement_pct / 100) : na

// Long: broke IB High, price retracted into 25% zone, not already traded today
long_signal = ib_locked and ib_valid and in_entry_window and not traded_today and
              broke_high and not broke_low and
              not na(retrace_long_zone) and
              close <= retrace_long_zone and close >= ib_high - ib_range * 0.5

// Short: broke IB Low, price retracted into 25% zone, not already traded today
short_signal = ib_locked and ib_valid and in_entry_window and not traded_today and
               broke_low and not broke_high and
               not na(retrace_short_zone) and
               close >= retrace_short_zone and close <= ib_low + ib_range * 0.5

// =============================================================================
// POSITION MANAGEMENT
// =============================================================================
var float entry_price     = na
var float stop_price      = na
var float tp1_price       = na
var int   trade_direction = 0

// Detect fill: limit order was pending and position just opened
if strategy.position_size != 0 and not traded_today
    traded_today := true

// Place limit order on FIRST bar after breakout — antes de o preço retrair
// A ordem fica pendente e preenche exatamente no nível de 25%
long_order  = ib_locked and ib_valid and in_entry_window and not traded_today and not order_placed_today and broke_high and not broke_low
short_order = ib_locked and ib_valid and in_entry_window and not traded_today and not order_placed_today and broke_low  and not broke_high

if long_order and strategy.position_size == 0
    entry_price        := retrace_long_zone
    stop_price         := ib_high - ib_range * (stop_pct_of_ib / 100)
    tp1_price          := ib_high + ib_range * tp1_multiplier
    trade_direction    := 1
    order_placed_today := true
    strategy.entry("Long",   strategy.long,  limit=entry_price)
    strategy.exit("Long TP", from_entry="Long",  limit=tp1_price, stop=stop_price, comment="TP")

else if short_order and strategy.position_size == 0
    entry_price        := retrace_short_zone
    stop_price         := ib_low + ib_range * (stop_pct_of_ib / 100)
    tp1_price          := ib_low - ib_range * tp1_multiplier
    trade_direction    := -1
    order_placed_today := true
    strategy.entry("Short",   strategy.short, limit=entry_price)
    strategy.exit("Short TP", from_entry="Short", limit=tp1_price, stop=stop_price, comment="TP")

// Cancela ordem pendente se: janela de entrada fechou OU lado oposto rompeu
if order_placed_today and not traded_today and strategy.position_size == 0
    if not in_entry_window or (trade_direction == 1 and broke_low) or (trade_direction == -1 and broke_high)
        strategy.cancel_all()
        order_placed_today := false

// Time stop: close all at 15:30 ET
if at_close_time and strategy.position_size != 0
    strategy.close_all(comment="Time Stop")

// =============================================================================
// VISUALIZATION
// =============================================================================
var line  line_ib_high = na
var line  line_ib_low  = na
var line  line_ib_mid  = na
var box   box_ib       = na
var label label_ib     = na

if ib_just_closed and ib_locked
    ib_mid = (ib_high + ib_low) / 2

    if show_ib_lines
        if not na(line_ib_high)
            line.delete(line_ib_high)
        if not na(line_ib_low)
            line.delete(line_ib_low)
        if not na(line_ib_mid)
            line.delete(line_ib_mid)
        line_ib_high := line.new(bar_index, ib_high, bar_index + 50, ib_high,
             color=color.red,  width=2, extend=extend.right)
        line_ib_low  := line.new(bar_index, ib_low,  bar_index + 50, ib_low,
             color=color.blue, width=2, extend=extend.right)
        line_ib_mid  := line.new(bar_index, ib_mid,  bar_index + 50, ib_mid,
             color=color.gray, width=1, style=line.style_dashed, extend=extend.right)

    if show_ib_box
        if not na(box_ib)
            box.delete(box_ib)
        box_ib := box.new(bar_index - 12, ib_high, bar_index, ib_low,
             border_color=color.new(color.gray, 60),
             bgcolor=color.new(color.gray, 85))

    if show_labels and not na(ib_high) and ib_high > 0
        if not na(label_ib)
            label.delete(label_ib)
        ib_pct_str = str.tostring(math.round(ib_range / ib_high * 10000) / 100) + "%"
        label_ib := label.new(bar_index, ib_high,
             text="IB: " + str.tostring(math.round(ib_range * 100) / 100) + " pts (" + ib_pct_str + ")",
             color=color.new(color.gray, 70), textcolor=color.white,
             style=label.style_label_down, size=size.small)

// Entry arrows — only on bars that actually trigger a new entry
plotshape(long_signal  and strategy.position_size == 0, title="Long Entry",
          style=shape.triangleup,   location=location.belowbar,
          color=color.green, size=size.small)
plotshape(short_signal and strategy.position_size == 0, title="Short Entry",
          style=shape.triangledown, location=location.abovebar,
          color=color.red,   size=size.small)

// =============================================================================
// PERFORMANCE TABLE (bottom-right)
// =============================================================================
var table perf_table = table.new(position.bottom_right, 2, 9,
     border_color=color.gray, border_width=1, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 70))

total_trades     = strategy.closedtrades
winning_trades   = strategy.wintrades
losing_trades    = strategy.losstrades
gross_profit     = strategy.grossprofit
gross_loss       = strategy.grossloss
net_profit       = strategy.netprofit
initial_capital  = strategy.initial_capital
total_return_pct = initial_capital > 0 ? net_profit / initial_capital * 100 : 0.0
win_rate         = total_trades > 0 ? winning_trades / total_trades * 100 : 0.0
profit_factor    = gross_loss != 0 ? gross_profit / math.abs(gross_loss) : na
avg_win          = winning_trades > 0 ? gross_profit  / winning_trades : 0.0
avg_loss         = losing_trades  > 0 ? math.abs(gross_loss) / losing_trades : 0.0

var int max_consec_loss = 0
var int cur_consec_loss = 0
if barstate.islastconfirmedhistory
    cur_consec_loss := 0
    max_consec_loss := 0
    for i = 0 to strategy.closedtrades - 1
        if strategy.closedtrades.profit(i) < 0
            cur_consec_loss += 1
            if cur_consec_loss > max_consec_loss
                max_consec_loss := cur_consec_loss
        else
            cur_consec_loss := 0

if barstate.islast
    table.cell(perf_table, 0, 0, "Metric",         text_color=color.yellow, text_halign=text.align_left)
    table.cell(perf_table, 1, 0, "Value",           text_color=color.yellow, text_halign=text.align_right)
    table.cell(perf_table, 0, 1, "Total Trades",    text_color=color.white,  text_halign=text.align_left)
    table.cell(perf_table, 1, 1, str.tostring(total_trades), text_color=color.white, text_halign=text.align_right)
    table.cell(perf_table, 0, 2, "Win Rate",        text_color=color.white,  text_halign=text.align_left)
    table.cell(perf_table, 1, 2, str.tostring(math.round(win_rate * 10) / 10) + "%",
               text_color=win_rate >= 40 ? color.green : color.red, text_halign=text.align_right)
    table.cell(perf_table, 0, 3, "Profit Factor",   text_color=color.white,  text_halign=text.align_left)
    table.cell(perf_table, 1, 3, na(profit_factor) ? "N/A" : str.tostring(math.round(profit_factor * 100) / 100),
               text_color=not na(profit_factor) and profit_factor >= 1.5 ? color.green : color.red, text_halign=text.align_right)
    table.cell(perf_table, 0, 4, "Avg Win",         text_color=color.white,  text_halign=text.align_left)
    table.cell(perf_table, 1, 4, "$" + str.tostring(math.round(avg_win * 100) / 100),
               text_color=color.green, text_halign=text.align_right)
    table.cell(perf_table, 0, 5, "Avg Loss",        text_color=color.white,  text_halign=text.align_left)
    table.cell(perf_table, 1, 5, "$" + str.tostring(math.round(avg_loss * 100) / 100),
               text_color=color.red, text_halign=text.align_right)
    table.cell(perf_table, 0, 6, "Max Consec Loss", text_color=color.white,  text_halign=text.align_left)
    table.cell(perf_table, 1, 6, str.tostring(max_consec_loss),
               text_color=max_consec_loss >= 5 ? color.red : color.white, text_halign=text.align_right)
    table.cell(perf_table, 0, 7, "Net Profit",      text_color=color.white,  text_halign=text.align_left)
    table.cell(perf_table, 1, 7, "$" + str.tostring(math.round(net_profit * 100) / 100),
               text_color=net_profit >= 0 ? color.green : color.red, text_halign=text.align_right)
    table.cell(perf_table, 0, 8, "Total Return",    text_color=color.white,  text_halign=text.align_left)
    table.cell(perf_table, 1, 8, str.tostring(math.round(total_return_pct * 10) / 10) + "%",
               text_color=total_return_pct >= 0 ? color.green : color.red, text_halign=text.align_right)

items.author: samjNQ
items.source:
//@version=6
strategy("Initial Balance Breakout [MES] v3",
     overlay=true,
     default_qty_type=strategy.fixed,
     default_qty_value=1,
     commission_type=strategy.commission.cash_per_contract,
     commission_value=2.25,
     slippage=1,
     calc_on_every_tick=false)

// ─── Inputs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ib_session    = input.session("0930-1030", "IB Window (60 min)", tooltip="First hour of RTH defines the Initial Balance")
trade_session = input.session("1030-1430", "Trade Window",        tooltip="No new entries after 2:30 PM ET")
ext1_mult     = input.float(1.0, "Target 1 (× IB range)", step=0.25, minval=0.25)
ext2_mult     = input.float(1.5, "Target 2 (× IB range)", step=0.25, minval=0.5)
sl_mode       = input.string("Opposite IB", "Stop Loss at", options=["Opposite IB", "IB Midpoint"])
min_ib_pts    = input.float(8.0,  "Min IB Range (pts)", step=1.0, minval=1.0, tooltip="Skip day if IB is too narrow")
max_ib_pts    = input.float(60.0, "Max IB Range (pts)", step=1.0, minval=5.0,  tooltip="Skip day if IB is too wide")
use_vwap      = input.bool(true,  "VWAP Trend Filter",            tooltip="Long only above VWAP, short only below VWAP")

// ─── VWAP ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
vwap_val = ta.vwap(hlc3)

// ─── Session Masks ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
in_ib    = not na(time(timeframe.period, ib_session,    "America/New_York"))
in_trade = not na(time(timeframe.period, trade_session, "America/New_York"))
in_eod   = not na(time(timeframe.period, "1555-1600",   "America/New_York"))

// ─── Daily State ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
var float ib_high      = na
var float ib_low       = na
var bool  ib_locked    = false
var bool  ib_tradeable = false
var bool  long_taken   = false
var bool  short_taken  = false

if ta.change(time("D")) != 0
    ib_high      := na
    ib_low       := na
    ib_locked    := false
    ib_tradeable := false
    long_taken   := false
    short_taken  := false

// ─── Build IB ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if in_ib
    ib_high   := na(ib_high) ? high : math.max(ib_high, high)
    ib_low    := na(ib_low)  ? low  : math.min(ib_low,  low)
    ib_locked := false

if not in_ib and not na(ib_high) and not ib_locked
    ib_locked := true
    rng        = ib_high - ib_low
    ib_tradeable := rng >= min_ib_pts and rng <= max_ib_pts

// ─── Derived Levels ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ib_range = ib_locked ? ib_high - ib_low : na
ib_mid   = ib_locked ? math.avg(ib_high, ib_low) : na
t1_long  = ib_locked ? ib_high + ext1_mult * ib_range : na
t2_long  = ib_locked ? ib_high + ext2_mult * ib_range : na
t1_short = ib_locked ? ib_low  - ext1_mult * ib_range : na
t2_short = ib_locked ? ib_low  - ext2_mult * ib_range : na

sl_long  = sl_mode == "IB Midpoint" ? ib_mid : ib_low
sl_short = sl_mode == "IB Midpoint" ? ib_mid : ib_high

// ─── VWAP Trend Filter ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
vwap_long_ok  = not use_vwap or close > vwap_val
vwap_short_ok = not use_vwap or close < vwap_val

// ─── Signals (unconditional for history tracking) ─────────────────────────────
cross_above_ibh = ta.crossover(close,  ib_high)
cross_below_ibl = ta.crossunder(close, ib_low)

// ─── Plots ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
active = ib_locked and ib_tradeable
plot(active ? ib_high  : na, "IB High",  color=color.new(color.blue,   0),  linewidth=2, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(active ? ib_low   : na, "IB Low",   color=color.new(color.blue,   0),  linewidth=2, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(active ? ib_mid   : na, "IB Mid",   color=color.new(color.gray,   0),  linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(active ? t1_long  : na, "T1 Long",  color=color.new(color.green, 40),  linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(active ? t2_long  : na, "T2 Long",  color=color.new(color.green,  0),  linewidth=2, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(active ? t1_short : na, "T1 Short", color=color.new(color.red,   40),  linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(active ? t2_short : na, "T2 Short", color=color.new(color.red,    0),  linewidth=2, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(use_vwap ? vwap_val : na, "VWAP",   color=color.new(color.orange,  0), linewidth=1)

bgcolor(in_ib ? color.new(color.yellow, 88) : na, title="IB Window")
bgcolor(ib_locked and not ib_tradeable ? color.new(color.gray, 93) : na, title="Filtered Day")

// ─── Entry & Exit Logic ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
long_ok  = active and in_trade and not long_taken  and strategy.position_size == 0 and vwap_long_ok
short_ok = active and in_trade and not short_taken and strategy.position_size == 0 and vwap_short_ok

if long_ok and cross_above_ibh
    strategy.entry("Long IB", strategy.long)
    strategy.exit("Long Exit", "Long IB", stop=sl_long, limit=t2_long)
    long_taken := true

if short_ok and cross_below_ibl
    strategy.entry("Short IB", strategy.short)
    strategy.exit("Short Exit", "Short IB", stop=sl_short, limit=t2_short)
    short_taken := true

if in_eod and strategy.position_size != 0
    strategy.close_all("EOD Flat")
